tei:div.tei:p: ༷// ༷hūṃ rgirdoṭwāṃ: hūṃ/ //rgi byeX/ṭwāṃ /ṭwāṃ~X 5 51 dī ཿ dro7shāshā shā 2༷༵ chi 30 mi3sdulta 7
༄7/ / gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/(tha)gung thang bstan pa'i sgon mes brtsams/mirigasadaposkrun khab/

za za 1ba1ma tsho thayozam 10 7mcho samarṣazazo shāditho zamamaloṣṭha 2005 12132ma 7—105—07463—91 za po khya ma mam khoza maza— zla sa 39466—53 zalo khra tho01thamatshoṣṭhazo(2005)zo158415byu༅cho ṣṭham tshobo dizastetsho 43mo14 tho ma 13 977sal 46ཿ4 4 dithorwa pomangagrami/tholo lngasalo ma2ཿ6ca2za 1lo 2༅6ro2za 6zaza mayimam 850 4ma1168pa ba 1 2 yi 16 625yim0001—2 000 zayi3350zaglo mdzo5 82ཿ shā tshobo zlosasbyordo1smojusgro

༄/ / dpe sgrun gsalabashad/dpe skrun gsal bshad/de yang gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'am mtshan yongs gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon me dbang phyug sder 'bod pa'i dam pa de nyid rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu pho rta lo ste spyi lo 1762lor mdo smad shar lho'i mdzod dge'i smad kyi yul du yab the bo lcags po byams pa dang / yum bo chog gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ khong dgung lo bdun par phebs dus kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad de bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ khong gis kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i drung nas dge bsnyen dang rab byung dge tshul bcas dkyus gcig tu zhus shing mtshan la dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me zhes gsol/ de nas rdo rams pa blo bzang rin chen slob dpon du bsten nas yi ge'i sbyor klog dang blo 'dzin sogs legs par sbyangs pa ma zad/ rim gyis rgya dang sog po'i skad yig sbyangs pas thugs su chud/ dgung lo bcu bdun par dbus su phebs nas 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwar zhugs/ jor skal bzang dngos grub dge rgan du bsten nas dbu ma dang / mdzod/ 'dul ba/ tshad ma/ phar phyin bcas gzhung bka' pod lnga la brdar sha chod par sbyangs/ dgung lo nyer gcig par rgyal ba blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos/ dgung lo nyer gnyis par dge bshes lha rams pa'i mtshan btags blangs/ dbus su lo brgyad tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gzhung kun la mkhyen pa thogs 1

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/med du gyur cing / dbus gtsang gi mkhas mang dkyil na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar kun gyes gtsug tu bkur ba'i gnas su gyur/ dgung lo nyer lnga bar yul mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ dgung lo sum cu bar chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri chen du 'khod pas gdan rabs nyer gcig pa yin/ de nas bzung yul mdo smad lho byang gi chos grwa chen po rnams su 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gye bya ba'i yo lang kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu mo lug lo ste spyi lo 1823lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'thim/ dbal mang paṇḍi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs slob ma mkhas chen mang du byung ngo / /khong gi gsung rtsom ni phar phyin sdom dang / mdzod sdom/ 'dul ba sdom/sgradang snyan ngag sman dang rtsis/ lha ris thig tshad sogs sgyu rtsal skor gyi bstan bcos rnams gcig tu bsdus te po ti bcu gcig byas nas shing par du brkos yod pa de dag kun kyang tshad mar 'dzin pa'i legs bshad sha stag yin pas nged cag dpe skrun khang gis bla brang gi shing par gzhir bzung nas dpar du btab pa'i dge ba 'di yis thams cad bkra shis bde legs su gyur cig /mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

༄/ /dkar chagadakar chagatshe lha rnam gsum gyi mngon rtogs bzhugs so/ / (1)grub chen brgyad cu'i rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so/ / (4)seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dga' ston zhes bya ba /pa/(//tha //na/ 111 (17)rta mgrin phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (23)sman chog mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ / (34)sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga ltung ba'i mun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (36)yon sbyong gi cho ga sgrib pa'i mun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (49)tshe dpag med la brten pa'i tshe sgrub bzhugs so/ / (56)mi 'khrugs pa'i gos sku bkram skabs kyi 'don cha'i go rim bzhugs ///〈 (//byed////)'phags mchog 'jam dpal nag po la brten pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga nyes pa kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (66)bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgo nas bum chu sgrub tshul gyi cho ga gdung sel zla ba'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (93)bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgo nas yul khrus bya tshul klu bsang bcas bzhugs so/ / (104)

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/'phags mchog seng ge'i sgra'i mngon rtogs bum sgrub dang bcas pa ཿpa (//tha //sa 11/ (110)ye shes khyung khra'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa byin rlabs dga' ston zhes bya bzhugs so/ / (113)bcom ldan 'das ma 'od zer can ma'i bsnyen sgrub kha skong las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ / (125)sman byin rlabs bya tshul bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs /sde/sa (//ga41///rdo ////gzungs sngags zab mo du ma kha ton du bya ba'i tshul dge ba'i 'phrul 'degs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (150)mdo sde thar ba chen po'i 'don thabs mdo nyid kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du rgyas par bkod pa bzhugs so/ / (159)'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'don thabs bzhugs so/ / (173)bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten sātstsha 'deb chog dang rab gnas mdor bsdus kyi skor bzhugs so/ / (179)su rū pa'i gtor ma gtong tshul gyi rnam bzhag bzhugs so/ / (192)bzang spyod la brten pa'i 'chi blu'i cho ga skye 'gro'i dbugs 'byin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (198)tshe bdag mgon po la brten nas 'chi blu bya tshul tshe nyams gso byed bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (210)rdza dkar lha lnga'i nor sgrub bya ༅ gyi zur 'debs gser gyi lde mig dang dzi dmar sgrub thabs 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin sogs ཿpa ////ཿsa//sa / (218)g.yang 'bod yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bzhugs so/ / (236)2

༄/ /dkar chagadus kyi 'khor lo'i lam la slob tshul gyi smon lam tshig lhug tu byas pa ཿpa/sdo//tha //sa/ /sa/ (239)tshe dpag med kyi bla brgyud smon shis sogs smon shis le tshan bzhugs ///sgo (///rdo4pa//4pa//)'phags mchog 'jam dpal dkar po la bstod pa 'jam mgon dgyes pa skyed byed bstod sprin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs /sde/sa (///rdo/rdo//////)'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i 'dod gsol las bzhi lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (270)mdo sngags kyi lam yongs rdzogs zung ldan gyi sgo nas bstan pa rgyal ba dgyes pa'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (272)khyab bdag rjo rje 'chang kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po la thog ma'i zung ldan gyi sgo nas bstod pa dge legs dpal mchog ces bya ba bzhugs so / / (275)'jam mgon bla ma la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa ka la pigo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (282)'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ / (288)ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la ma brjod par bstod pa sgo mtha' yas sogs bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor byin rlabs gter gyi sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ / (290)dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi deb yig mgo rgyan phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i rol mtsho sogs deb rgyan sna tshogs bzhugs/ / (387)dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi bca' yig yang dag sgrub pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (399)3

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi bca' yig zur 'debs bzhugs so/ / (418)a ru hor chen dgon pa bkra shis bsam 'grub gling gi bca' yig chos kyi snang ba zhes bya bzhugs so/ / (429)khri thabashad thabasdo//ba/25 res/ (437)mdo'i tshigs bcad gsum gyi don cung zad bkral ba sogs le'u tshan thor bu sna tshogs bzhugs so/ / (444)

༄/ /tshe lhanam gsum gyisangonanogs/༄༅/ /che lha rnam gsum gyi mngon rtogs bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /tshe sbyin lhag pa'i lha mchog rnam gsum la/ /sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas phyag bgyid do/ /dus min 'chi ba'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /dge mtshan shis pa mchog gis deng 'dir skyongs/ /'dir tshe lha gsum gyi sgo nas tshe sgrub bya bar 'dod pas rten dang mchod pa bshams/ skyabs sems sngon du btang / su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la rang sems hrī yig dmar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur ba las mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams shing mtshan dpes spras pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas hūṃ yig cig chad de g.yas phyogs su pad zla'i gdan la babs pa las gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ dang po gnyis sna tshogs rdo rje dang zhags pa/ gnyis pa gnyis 'od dpag med dang skyabs sbyin/ gsum pa gnyis mda' gzhu/ bzhi ba gnyis mchog sbyin dang bum pa bsnams pa/ thugs ka nas tai yig cig chad de g.yon phyogs su pad zla'i gdan la babs pa las 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog dkar mo/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon utpal bsnams pa/ gnyi ga'ang gzhon nu ma lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyes spras shing skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang gi spyi bor rma/ mgrin par ma thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ nub phyogs

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/bde ldan zhing gi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i thugs ka nas tshe lha gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dbang lha dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sogs kyis mchod/ me long gcig la rab 'byams gzugs snang bzhin/ / rgyal kun thugs rje byin rlabs gcig bsdus nas/ / tshe yi lha mchog gsum gyi rnam rol pa'i/ /zhabs kyi padmar gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / rang gi thugs gar sa bon la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas/ 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha dang drang srong rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub dang / 'jig rten khams kyi rtsi bcud bkrag mdangs mtha' dag bsdus pa sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/lusakyi nang thams cad gang bas rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs dang 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la gsum ga'i sngags rim par bzla/ rang gi tshesnub la 'di tsam gyis chog cing / gzhan don du bum sgrub sogs byed na bum pa gtsang mar bya rgyud kyi bum rdzas dang tshe sgrub kyi ril rgyun sogs btab pa'i chu'am ril bu blugs te bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po tshad dang ldan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du pad zla'i gdan la trī yig dmar po zhes sogs rang sgra dor te bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin bya/ mchod phreng rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma sogs tshigs bcad byas kyang rung / bzlas pa'i skabs/ 'od zer 'phros dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe'am/ sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe la bar du gcod pa'i nyes pa thams cad sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas zhes pa man chad 'dra/ bzlas pa'i mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / gtor ma bya rgyud ltar byin 2

༄/ / tshe lha3ma gsum gyisangonatogs/gyis brlabs la mchod sngags la ba li ta btags pa'am/ a kā ro gsum sogs kyis bsngo/ mchod bstod byas la/ bum pa'i lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bum pa'i chu'am ril bu'i rnam par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsngo smon bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni tshe lha gsum char sgrub par 'dod kyang so sor mi spyogs pa rnams la 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir 'di 'dra zhig dgos zhes dad brtson ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog zla bas bskul ngor/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /3

༄/ /yo bang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / grub chen brgyad cu'i rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo badzra dha rā ya/ 'dir grub chen brgyad bcu'i rjes gnang bya tshul ni/ thun re la rjes gnang ci tsam byed pa'i grangs kyi maṇḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa mchod pa rnams bshams/ skyabs sems sngon du btang ste/ su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la oṃ ā : yongs su gyur pa las ranganyid rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo dril bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ mtshan dpes spras shing rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā / thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ ma rtu baṃ to gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ nang mchod dang / mchod pa bla med ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ badzra a pra tī tstsha ya swā hā nas shama'i bar gyis mchod/ pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ 〉 rtu gis nang mchod 'bul/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen sogs kyis bstod/oṃ ya badzra ṅgā ra ya hūṃ/ zhes bzla zhing / mdun bskyed kyi tshom bu dang po'ang gong bzhinabasgrubs nas mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar bya/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyisabarlabs la/ oṃ badzra dhā ra ya'i mjug tu a kā ro btags te 'bul/ phyogs skyong rnams skad cig gis spyan drangs la/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā raya kā ro sogs kyis gtor ma dang mchod pa 'bul/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor yang 4

༄/ /grub chen brgyad cu'irjes gnang bya tshul/dkyus bzhin gtong / thun rer rjes gnang du ma byed tshe/ tha ma'i 'das gtor gyi mjug tu phyogs skyong gi gtor ma dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor btang yang rung ngo / de bzhin du maṇḍal gnyis pa'i tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la oṃ ā ཿ yongs su gyur pa las grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po lca sde pa sku mdog du ba'i mdog can/ sku gzi byin dang ldan zhing / rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ rus pa'i rgyan gyes spras pa/ skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ya thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par spyan drangs/ dza : baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas la/ oṃ ā lca ste pa ya hūṃ/ zhes pa bzla/ gtor 'bul gyi tshe/ oṃ ā lca ste pā ya a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sbyar ba sogs 'og ma kun la 'dra/ de bzhin du grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po li la pa sku mdog ser po rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ sku gzi byin dang ldan zhing /rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ de'i spyi bor sogasaman chad 'dra/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā lī la sba ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / de nas grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ku si ri pa sku mdog dkar po rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ sku gzi byin dang ldan zhing / rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ 〉 ku si ri pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ḍom ki pa sku mdog ser po rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā 'o ki pā ya hūṃ/zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub dge slong gi cha byad can/ 'khor dge slong dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā nā gārdzu nā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ki kha la pa sku mdog 5

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/dkar po rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ sku gzi byin dang ldan zhing / rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā ke khal pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhabs skyil krung gi gar can/ sku gzi byin dang ldan zhing /rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā sa ro ru hā badzra pā ya hūṃ/ zhesapa'o/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po za nyal 'chag sku mdog sngo lngang dge slong gi cha byad can/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ 〉 pu su ku pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po sa ra ha sku mdog ser po bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya can/ sku gzi byin dang ldan zhing / rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā sha ra ha pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ri khrod pa sku mdog du ba'i mdog can rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ sku gzi byin dang ldan zhing / rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā sha pa ri pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po sgeg pa'i rdo rje sku mdog ser po rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya can/ sku gzi byin dang ldan zhing / rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā tpa la sa badzra pā ya hūṃ/ zhesapa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dha ri ka pa sku mdog ser po rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ sku gzi byin dang ldan zhing / rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ / oṃ ya dha ri ka pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ye shes zhabs dge slong gi cha byad can/'khoraskyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā sto na pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po utta ta pa sku mdog nag po rnal 'byor 6

༄/ /grub chen brgyad cu'irjes gnang bya tshul/pa'i cha byad can/ sku gzi byin dang ldan zhing / rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ya tize pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po padma rdo rje sku mdog dkar sham 'bas g.yas brkyangs/ g.yon phyed skyil krung gar gyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ lnga padma badzra ya hūṃ/ zhesapa'o/ / grub pa'idabang phyug chen po dbyig gi gnyen po sku mdog ser po dge slong gi cha byad can/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya can/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/sngags ni/ oṃ ā ba su ban rlu pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dza lan dha ra pa ro gnyer ba dang mtshungs pa gar zhabs can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā dza li dha ra pra pa pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po chos kyi grags pa sku mdog dmar ser dge slong gi cha byad can/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ya dharma kyirti pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po bhu ba pa sku mdog ser po rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/sngags ni/ oṃ ā byu ba pā ya hūṃ/ zhesapa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ka shi ri pa bzhengs pa gur gum gyi mdog can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā ka na ri pā ya hūṃ/ zhesapa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po tog rtse pa sku mdog ljang khu rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor skyes padang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ya sgo dha li pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po yind+ra bo dhi sku mdog sngo ljang rgyal po'i 'gying bag gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ yu yi dra skru ta ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po zur ba pa sku mdog dmar srug nyi ma stong la mnan pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ 7

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/ya bi ru pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po klu'i byang chub sku mdog nag po spyi bor phyed skra'i phyag rgya can/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/sngags ni/ oṃ ā nā ga po dha ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'od mdzad zhabs sku mdog rdza gsar gyi mdog can ral gri bsnams pa/'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ya pra bhā ka rā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen ya ka pa dri pa sku mdog sngo lngang rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā ma ma garta pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po sasnyi pa sku mdog dkar sham stag gi smad steng na gnas pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/sngags ni/ oṃ ā 'o sti pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po thod pa can sgu mdog dkar sham rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā kasba li pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po lwa ba pa lwa ba bsnams pa sku mdog rdza gsar gyi mdog lta bu rnal 'byor ba'i cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/oṃ ā ka pā li pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ti lo pa sku mdog nag po rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/sngags ni/ oṃ 〉 ti lo pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po mar me mdzad sku mdog dkar sham gzhon nu'i cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ya dī paṃ ka rā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dge bsnyen zla ba sku mdog sngo ljang po ti'i phyag rgya can/'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā tsand+ra go ma ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ra bu ta sku mdog nag po rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ 〉 bu ru tā ya 8

༄/ /grub chen brgyad cu'irjes gnangabyu tshul/hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dga' ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā ra ti badzra ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ka do la pa phyag slong ba'i snod can/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā ka to la pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po lcags lham mkhan sku mdog dkar po rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/sngags ni/ oṃ 〉 pa na rnyi pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po sngag la pa sku mdog nag po bzhengs pa phyag na bum pa bsnams pa/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ u pā ka lā ya hūṃ/ zhesapa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ba su ba rnya pa sku mdog rdza gsar gye mdog can g.yas pas rlung g.yab dang g.yon pas bum pa bsnams pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā ba su brnya pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po tsa ba tri pa sku mdog gur kum gyi mdog can spyan 'byar khyom dang ras bsnams pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā tsar pa tri pā ya hūṃ/ zhesapa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dam tshig rdo rje sku mdog sngo ljang bdud rtsi thod pa bsnams pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ya sa ma ya badzra ya hūṃ/ zhesapa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po lce spyang zhabs sku mdog ser po rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā shrī gā li pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po garna pa sku mdog sngo ljang rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā karṇa pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dha mu pa sku mdog nag po phyag ni rnga bsnams pa/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā dha mu pā ya 9

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dru ma pa sku mdog ser po bzhengs pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā byu ma pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ku ma ri pa gzhon nu'i mdog dang cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ shā ku mā ra ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po bande rus pa'i rgyan can phyag na gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa/ gar gyi zhabs can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā rta de pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ku pa ji pa sku mdog gur kum gyi mdog can thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ya ku mā rā ya hūṃ/zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rin chen myu gu rin po che'i phur ba sngo ljang / 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ yo ā ratta ku ra pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ral gri grub pa sku mdog nag po ral gri dang lhung bzed kyi phyag rgya can/ 'greng 'dug 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ mā kharna si ye hūṃ/ zhesapa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rta sa ki pa sku mdog rdza gsar gyi mdog can rdza rnga bsnams pa/'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā rta sa kri pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ka ma ru pā sku mdog dkar po gar gyi zhabs can/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā kā ma ru pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug ḍa ḍa pa sku mdog ser po rtsa phad bzung ba/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā rshan ḍa nā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po spyod pa ba sku mdog gur kum gyi mdog can 'greng ba/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā tsārdze3/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ko las mkhan lag sha 10

༄/ /grub chen brgyad cu'i rjes gnang bya tshul/bzung ba/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā tsā ma ra ye hūṃ/zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po kun bzang zhabs sku mdog gur kum gyi mdog lta bu rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/sngags ni/ oṃ sko sadngha dha kā pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dhi ka pa ri sku mdog ser po thal mo sbyar ba/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/sngags ni/ oṃ ya di ba ra krirta ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po gzhi gtum sku mdog nag po rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā tsa ra ka ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbangaphyug chen po dge slong mdun phyogs sku mdog rdza gsar gyi mdog lta bu rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ yā sa gha rakṣi tī ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po khrus mkhan sku mdog gur kum gyi mdog lta bu rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ya bho pā ya hūṃ/ zhesapa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po bho ki di pa sku mdog ser po rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ya dha ka tī pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po be sna pa sku mdog sngo ljang rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā ba na pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dbyug pa sgu mdog ser po rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/oṃ yā la pa nyi pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po yan lag med pa'i rdo rje sku mdog ser po khro bo'i zhabs mtshan ma gyen du 'greng ba rdor dril 'dzin pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā ya rna ga badzā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'phags pa lha 'greng ba dge slong gi cha byad can/ 'khor 11

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ u ārya de pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po la pa pa sku mdog gur gum gyi mdog can mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ yā kaspa lā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po tha ga mkhan sku mdog dkar sham 'khril ba/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā dza pa ri pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po sha ri pa sku mdog nag po 'greng ba mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/sngags ni/ oṃ ā sha ra ha pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dpal 'dzin chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā shrī dhā rā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po tsa ra li ba sku mdog gur gum gyi mdog can bzhengs pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā tsant+ra la ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ko ki li pa sku mdog rdza gsar gyi mdog can bzhengs pa/'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ 〉 ko ki lī ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dril bu pa sku mdog gur gum gyi mdog can rdor dril 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum bzhengs pa/'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ yā ghaṇḍa pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po nā ro pa sku mdog sngo ljang rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā nā ro pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po khyi mo can mi g.yo mdog can bzhengs pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ kusku ri pā ya hūṃ/zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rin 'byung zhi ba sku mdog ser po dge slong gi cha byad can/ po ti 'dzin pa/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/12

༄/ /grub chen brgyad cu'irjes gnang bya tshul/sngags ni/ oṃ ā ratna ka ra shānta ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ska ra li pa sku mdog ser po bum pa 'dzin pa gar gyi zhabs can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā ka ra bha la ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po kha mkhan sku mdog ser po rdor dril 'dzin pa/glog la sdigs mdzub byed pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/oṃ 〉 te lo pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po khab ta ri pa sku mdog me tog ku su ma'i mdog can bya'i tshogs spro ba/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ yā smo ri pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbangaphyug chen po g.yung sku mdog me'i mdog can g.yas pa tho ba 'bar ba thogs pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā ma te ga ye hūṃ/zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po byi ba can sku mdog me lo'i mdog lta bu rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ma bi ra li pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ka na pa rnal 'byor ma sku mdog ser po gar chag dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā ka la ba na dzo ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnal 'byor ma me kha la sku mdog me'i mdog me'i mdog can rdor dril 'dzin pas phyag sked par gnas pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig la/ sngags ni/ oṃ ya me kha la dzo yi hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnal 'byor ma grub pa can dpal mo sku mdog sngo bsangs zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa me rol gnas pa rdor dril 'dzin pa/ rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā lakṣa nī sirnyi dzo ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ni lo pa sku mdog sngon po rol pa'i phyag rgya can/ 'khor skyes pa dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ 13

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/ā ni lo pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ye shes myu gu sku mdog dkar po mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya can/ 'khor bud med dang lhan cig pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ ā dzā tyā ku ra bā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'o/ / bdag bskyed grub thob so sor byas kyang rung la/ bdag bskyed rdo rje 'chang gcig pur byas te/de'i sgo nas mdun bskyed so sor bsgrubs kyang rung ngo /rjes gnang dngos gzhi ni/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ gang gi drin gyis zhes sogasadang / bla ma rin po che bdag la grub chen rnams kyi dbang bzhi'i byin rlabs stsal tu gsol/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ sdom bzung gi dmigs rnam brda sprad de/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes sogs kyis byang sdom dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ / zhes sogs kyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung / mdun bskyed bsgrubs zin pa de nyid yang bskyar gyis gsal 'debs par gsungs pas/ mdun gye nam mkhar pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la oṃ ā ྅ yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhes pa nas thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ mchod pa dang nang mchod gong bzhin 'bul/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pas/ de'i smin mtshams nas oṃ yig dkar po zhig byung / slob ma rnams kyi smin mtshams nas phar thim pas/ lus thams cad oṃ yig dkar po skya mer gyis gang zhing bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ sku rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la bkod byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod la mtshan sngags bzla/ gsung dang thugs kyi rjes gnang so sor yang mchod pa 'bul bar bshadakyang / 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir mchod pa dang pos chog pa byas la/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gus 'dud byas la/ ā ga dmar po zhig byung / slob ma rnams kyi mgrin pa nas phar thim pas lus thams cad ā dmar pos mer 14

༄/ / grub chen brgyad cu'i rjes gnang bya tshul/gyis gang / gsang ba'i dbang thob cing ngag gi dri ma dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ gsung rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la bkod/ de bzhin du thugs ka nas hūṃ yig sngon po zhig byung / slob ma'i snying kha nas phar thim pas/ slob ma'i lus thams cad hūṃ yig sngon pos mer gyis gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob cing yid kyi dri ma dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ thugs rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la bkod/ dpral mgrin thugs ka nas oṃ ā ྅ gi yi ge gsum byung / slob ma'i gnas gsum nas phar thim pas/ lus thams cad 'bru gsum 'od zer sna lnga dang bcas pas mer gyis gang / dbang ba'i ba thob cing / sgo gsum gye dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag sa gsung thugs gsum char gyi byin rlabs thams cad zhugs/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gigo 'phang la bkod byung snyam pa'i mos pa byed du gzhug de nas bla ma'i thugs ga'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa zhig byung ste zhal nas thon/slob ma'i kha nas zhugs/ snying khar 'khod pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas oṃ ya badzra dhā rā ya hūṃ zhes pas mtshon/ de dang de'i sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum dang / bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ / bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / zhes pa'ang lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ bla mas me tog 'thor mang / bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ / 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / zhes brjod/ slob mas gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul zhing / bla mas mchod bstod nyer bsdu sogs dkyus bzhin bya/ rjes gnang rdzogs par grub pa'i mjug tu tshogs 'khor yang byas na legs so/ /zhes pa 'di ni mdo sngags rab 'byams kyi dgongs don dpyis phyin par thugs su chud pa'i zeg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po e waṃ chos 'khor gling gi slob zur dkon mchog dar rgyas pa'i zhal snga nas kyis 'di lta bu'i lag tu blang bde ba 'ig 15

sa / /gung thang bstan ba'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/dgos zhes gsol ba yang yang btab pa'i ngor/ grub chen de dag dang mi gnyis pa'i rje btsunabla ma rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis bka' stsal pa'i yi ge pa'ang de dag so so'i byin rlabs rjes gnang gi rim pa legs pa mnos pa zu su ku ratna yā nantas bgyis pa'o/ /16

༄/ / seng sdenganags sgol gyi sgrub thabs/༄༅/ / seng sdeng nags sgol gyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / bder gshegs bya grub ye shes 'phrin las kyi/ / gdugs dkar 'jigs pa brgyad sogs gdung skyob par/ / 'phags ma tā re'i mtshan gsol rgyal ba'i yum/ / bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje'i gter la 'dud/ / gang gi sgrub thabs mkha' la 'phur 'gro'i grangs/ / ma lus gzhan phan dkar ba'i 'od ldan yang / / deng 'dir thugs rje bskul ba'i man ngag gnad/ / rab gsal pa sangs snang ba 'god la spro/ / de yang rje btsunas sgrol ma'i lha tshogs ji snyed pa kun gyi rtsa ba lta bu seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su sgrol ma nyer gcig gam gtso 'khor gsum pa'am gtso rkyang gi sku dang / gzhan yang 'od dpag med spyan ras gzigs sogs kyi sku bris 'bur ci rigs kyis mtshon pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram/ gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i mchod pa legs par bshamasate/ spyod lam tshul dang mthun par 'khod/ sems rnal du phab nas rang gi mdun du dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i skyabs yul nam mkha' gang ba dang / mtha' bskor du pha ma rigs drug gi sems can thams cad srug shig ge 'khod par bsam la/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor/ mjug tu/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes sbyar ba'i skyabs 'gro sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ khyad par ma sems can thams cad 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi 17

༄/ /gung/ thang bstanapa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/sdug bsngal dang 'jigs pa ma lus pa las skyob pa'i phyir du 'phags ma sgrol ma'i go 'phang myur ba myur bar mngon du bya/ de'i phyir du 'phags ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bya'o/ / zhes khyad par gyi sems bskyed bya/ skyabs yul mtha' dag rim gyis bsdus te bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i mgon po tshe dpag med rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma seng ldeng nags kyi sgol ma la sgrol ma nyer gcig gis bskor ba'i lha tshogs kyi rnam pa gsal bar gyur/ gang gi zhabs sen snying la 'grogs pa yis/ / 'chi med tshe dang mchog gi dpal ster ba/ / bla ma rgyal ba tshe dpag med mgon la/ / sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ / snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje'i gangs ri las/ / legs 'ong 'phren las rnam bzhi'i rlabs phreng g.yo/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i gdung sel bcom ldan ma/ / 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / stong gsum kun khyab yid 'ong mchod pa'i tshogs/ / ma lus zhum med blo yis blangs te 'bul/ / bzod dka' sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i sdig ltung tshogs/ / snying la gnas kun 'gyod pa drag pos bshags/ / dam pa'i mdzad pa kun la rjes yi rang / / da dung bdag sogs mgon du rtag bzhugs nas/ / chos 'khor rgya cher bskor phyir gsol ba 'debs/ / dge tshogs kun kyang byang chub chen por bsngo/ / zhes yan lag bdun pa dang / sa gzhi spos byug mas maṇḍal dbul/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang zhes sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ tshogs zhing rnams kyi sku las 'od zer 'phros/ rang dang snod bcud thams cad la phog pas/ ma dag pa'i nyes pa sbyang / 'od gsal stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba/ de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid rta yig sngon po/de yongs su gyur pa las yutpal la sngon po lte bar tai yig gis mtshan pa/ de 18

༄/ / sengaldenganagasasgol gyi sgrub thabs/las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen po brgyad la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag las skyabs/ las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs te 'phags ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ rgyal ba sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las dang byin rlabs nus mthu mtha' dag bsdus te phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa la thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur ba las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma sku mdog ljang sngon margad gzhon nu'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas shing 'od zer 'phro ba/ gnag la snum pa'i smin tshugs ring po can/ utpal mthing ku'i 'dab ma lta bur rab tu rgyas pa'i spyan zung 'dzum pa'i nyams kyis gzigs shing / mchu sgros bim pa'i mdog ltar dmar ba/ sku'i yan lag thams cad rab tu rgyas la 'jam zhing gzhon sha can/ rked skabs phra zhing zag med kyi bde ba ster ba'i nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ lhug phran gsar ba'i yal ga bzhin du 'gril zhing mnyen pa'i phyag g.yas pus mo'i steng du bskyangs te mchog sbyin dang / g.yon dkon mchog gsum mtshon gyi phyag rgya mdzad de/phyag gnyis gas utpal sngon po re re bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad gar kha phye ba/ sku stod la srab 'jam reg na bde ba'i lha'i gos kyi stod g.yogs dang /sku smad la 'ja' tshon ltar bkra ba'i dar sna tshogs kyi smad g.yogs can/zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ do shal la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā / thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams nas rje btsun ma la 19

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/dza ྅ baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ lus gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mgon po tshe dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa bya rgyud ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i za gsol/ oṃ arya tā re a pra titstsha swāhā nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ nam mkha'i mthas gtug rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ / nam mkha'i mthas gtug 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs/ / nam mkha'i mthas gtug 'azin las rgyun mi 'chad/ /dpag yas yon tan phung bo khyod la 'dud/ / dngos kun mngon par 'du byed ma dmigs pas/ / 'bad dang rtsol ba'i mtshan ma dang bral yang / /dpag bsam shing bzhin 'dod pa kun 'jo ba/ / rgyal kun 'azin las lha mo khyod la 'dud/ / ring nas 'gro la phan dgongs bya ba'i khur/ / yongs su grub pa'i ye shes ngo bo nyid/ / bde gshegs don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi yum/ / rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'khor 'das kun byed sems rta rlung gi khams/ / yongs dag btang snyoms chen por rnal gnas pas/ / chags sdang g.yo ba'i skyon las ring du 'das/ / bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / phra rags nyes pa'i tshang tshing las brgal te/ / bskal bzang skye bo srid zhi'i 'jigs las bsgral/ / phyi ma'i mthar yang mkha' mnyam lus can kun/ / sgrol mdzad sgol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dug gsum kun spyor 'ching ba'i 'jigs pa dang / / mi dang mi min 'byung bo'i 'jigs pa sogs/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun las skyob mdzad 20

༄/ / seng sdenganags la gyi sgrub thabs/pas/ / skyabs kyi mchog gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / tshe yi mchog sbyin bla ma 'od dpag med/ / snying rje'i gter chen mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /'jigs pa mtha' dag sel mdzad bcom ldan ma/ / rnam gsum dbyer med zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa kun bsal te/ /phul byung tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / 'di nas 'phos tshe bde ldan zhing mchog tu/ / 'od dpag med pas rjes su 'dzin par shog / shin tu gdul dka' mi bsrun gdug pa'i sems/ / thugs rje byin rlabs chu yis brlan par mdzod/ / tshe rabs phreng bar ma zhum snying stobs kyis/ / rgyal sras spyod la tshul bzhin slob par shog / dam chos bsgrub la bar du gcod pa yi/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun las bskyab tu gsol/ / nam mkha' dzi sred thabs mkhas spyod pa yis/ / 'gro ba'i dbugs 'byin chen por bdag gyur cig / ces pas bstod/ rigs bdag dang mdun gyi tshe dpag med gnyis ga'i thugs ga'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud thams cad bsdus/ rigs bdag tshe dpag med phyag gi bum par thim/de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam la/ tshe gzungs bzla/ de nas/ rang gi snying khar zla ba la rta yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te thim par bsam zhing / oṃ tā re tu re tu re swāhā/ zhes yi ge bcu pa ci 'grub bzla/ gtor ma bya rgyud ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ mdun gyi lha tshogs la dbul/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun bskyedal bstem/ rang tha mal gyi rnam par gnas shing / mdun gyi gtso mo'i phyagagayas mchog sbyin du gnas pa de nyid skyabs sbyin du bsgyur ba'i 'og tu chungabar bsam la/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can/ / khyod 21

༄/ /gung tha bstan ba'i sgroname' gsung 'bum/min skyabs gzhan med do brtse bas dgongs/ / nad rims gdon bgegs byad phur kha smras dang / / dbul phongs mi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa sogs/ /phyi dang nang gi nyer 'tshe rgud pa'i rigs/ / ma lus myur du zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ / bslab gsum nyams len rnam dag shes rab dang / / mtshan ldan bshes gnyen dam chos sgrub pa'i grogs/ / tshe dang bsod nams snyan pa'i grags pa sogs/ / mthun rkyen yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba 'debs/ sgrol ma nyer gcig po so so'i zhabs la 'jus te gsol ba btab pas/ rang rang gi phyag g.yas pa'i mthil gye bum pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ / de dang de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos grub rnams thob par bsam la/ sgrol bstod ci 'grub 'don/ mjug tu/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgol ma dang / / nas dpal du bdag gyur cig / ces yan lag bdun pa dbul/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can/ / bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi/ / zhes sogs kyis slar yang gsol ba btab pas mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i lha tshogs rang la thim zhing byin gyis brlabs par bsam/bsngo smon dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /'phags ma'i thugs rje ba ku la/ / sgrub thabs zegs ma'i 'gram chang gis/ / phye bas dngos grub sbrang rtsi yis/ / skal bzang rkang drug tshim gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dkon mchog rab rgyas kyis nan tan chen pos yang yang bskul ba'i ngor btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /22

༄/ /rtasagrin phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabasadangos grub gterabadzod/༄7/ / rta mgrin phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub gter mjod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / mthu stobs nyi ma 'bar ba'i gzis/ / nag po'i rtsa lag mthar byed pa/ / khro rgyal rta mgrin la btud nas/ / de yi bskang 'phrin mdo tsam bri/ / de'ang rten gyi mdun du mchod gtor dam rdzas tshogs par byas la/ skyabs sems sngon du btang / rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ ces skad cig dkrong bskyed dam/ rgyas par byed na tshogs 'khor skabs kyi bdag skyed bzhin bya/ nang mchod a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las yi las rlung ram̐ las me/ ā las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du ā las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gcig pa de'i nang gi phyogs bzhi dang dbus su hūṃ e dzi khaṃ hūṃ las sha lnga/ mtshams bzhi dang dbus su li mi paṃ hūṃ baṃ las bdud rtsi lnga/ de'i steng du oṃ 〉 rtu gi yi ge gsum brtsegs te gnas par gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba dang / yi ge gsum gyi 'od zer gyis sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum bsdus te so so la thim pa rnams thod par lhung nas zhu bas/ ma dag pa'i dri ma rnams sbyangs nas/zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā ྅/lan gsum/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las ā las byung ba'i 23

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i name'i gsung 'bum/thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin stong ba/ rnam pa mchod rdzas so'i rnam pa can/ byed las dbang bo drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ oṃ a ā : nas/ shasta ā0rtu/ oṃ rū pa 〉 rtu nas oṃ sbarsha ā : gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa shurtso sarba dharma su bhā wa shusgo ྅rta/ chos thams cad rang bzhin mi dmigs pa stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrī yig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin padma dbang chen sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dmar la blum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar g.yo zhing /mche ba non po bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra smin ma dmar ser dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar zhing / dbu'i gtsug na rta mgo ljang nag rta skad 'tsher ba/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pas stong gsum me'i ra gur gyis 'gengs shing bdud kyi dkyil 'khor sreg par byed pa/ g.yas dbyug to 'phyar zhing / g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ sbul dang rus pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan zhing stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sha ma thabs can/ g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par bee thugs gar hrī la hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ thugs ga'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shesapa spyan drangs/ dza : baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar 24

༄/ / rtamagrin phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub gteramadzod/yang thugs ga'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros te dbang gi lha thams cad spyan drangs/ bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur zhing snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ bde stong ting 'dzin mchog gi rol ba yis/ / brtan g.yo kun khyab mchod pa'i sprin phung las/ / zag med dga' ba'i mchog sbyin mchod yon 'dis/ / rab dgyes mchog thun dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ oṃ ha ya gri wa a pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar dang / gzugs mchog sgra snyan/ dri mchog ro mchog rig mchog rnams dang / a gyi gnas su pākyi nas spar sha'i bar bcug la dbul/ oṃ ha ya spi wa oṃ ā : gis nang mchod dbul/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i sor rtog ye shes dngos/ / longs spyod rdzogs pa gsung gi rang gdangs lha/ / gdug pa 'dul byed gtum chen khro bo'i rgyal/ / padma dbang chen zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / rang gi thugs ga'i trī yig gi 'od zer gyis rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ yig brgya nyer gcig bzlas la/ bla ma mchog gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang / / khro chen ha ya gri wa 'khor dang bcas/dmigs med snying rje'i thugs kyis nyer dgongs te/ / bdag gi nyes pa dbyings su spyong bar mdzod/ / rmongs shing ma dad log lta'i dbang gyur bas/ / dam tshig las 'gal bsnyen cing bsgrub la g.yel/ / mi gtsang grib phog mchod gtor chag pa sogs/ / nongs pa gang bgyis 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags/ / thog med nas bsags mi bzad sdig ltung tshogs/ / rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chag bcas/ / thugs rje che ldan rnams kyi byin rlabs mthus/ / ma lus lhag med byang zhing dag gyur cig / bskang rdzas bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong 'khor bcas mnyes par byed 25

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/pa'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma yi dam chos skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid/pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā wa rta ya ā wa rta ya ho badzra sba ra khaṃ/ lan gsum/ hrī/ kun bzang smon pa'i mthu dang ting 'dzin gyis/ / legs bris ngo mtshar bkod pa mtha' yas pas/ / bla ma yi dam rta mgrin lha tshogs kun/ / zag med bde dga' mchog gis sim gyur cig / rasti'i mchod yon me tog sna tshogs dang / / spos kyi dud sprin rab gsal sgron me'i tshogs/ / bzang po'i dri chab ro brgya'i zhal zas dang / / snyan zhing brjid chags sna tshogs rol mo 'dis/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / / yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / / khyad par khro ba'i rgyal po gsung gi lha/ / padma dbang chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / / bcom ldan khro bo'i dbang phyug bka' nyan pa/ / chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / / thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su skong gyur nas/ / rnal 'byor dpon slob nyams chag sos gyur cig / mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad zlog pa dang / / mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsal tu gsol/ / thod pa skam rlon zhing chen glang lpags dang / / 'khor lo rna cha la sogs rus pa'i rgyan/ / stag lngags sham thabs sna tshogs gdug pa'i sbrul/ / rin chen phra tshom mdzes pa'i rgyan rnams kyis/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma sogs 'dra/ / bdud sde mthar byed seng ldeng dbyug to sogs/ / rno ngar mtshon cha'i bye brag sna tshogs dang / / mi mthun g.yul gyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i/ / sra mkhregs rdo rje'i go cha 'bar ba yis/ / rtsa brgyud ྾ / / sna tshogs bla bre gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / / lha klu mi yi nor bu rin po che/ / bzang po'i sman dang 'bru sna sna tshogs bcas/ / mkho dgu'i yo byad 26

༄/ / rtamagrin phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs dngosakhrub gter mdzod/zad pa med pa yis/ / rtsa brgyud ma / / stag seng khyung 'brug 'brong g.yag glang po che/ / rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i gcan gzan sna tshogs dang / / cang shes rta dang ra lug rkang 'gro'i rigs/ / mdzes sdug skad snyan 'dab chags tshogs rnams kyis/ / rtsa brgyud ma / / ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla rin chen bdun/ / bkra shis rtags rdzas 'dod yon rnam lnga dang / / bris sku glegs bam rdor dril bgrang 'phreng sogs/ / bsten pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang med pa yis/ / rtsa brgyud ྾ / / rnam dag dam tshig sdom pas legs bsdams shing / / lta sgom spyod pa gtsang ma'i nyams len dang / / khyad par sgrib bral chos sku'i bdag nyid du/ / rtse gcig mos pa'i dad gus drag po yis/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / / zhes pa nas/ mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsal tu gsol/ / hrī0chos sku yangs pa'i pho brang nas/ / padma dbang chen 'khor bcas kyis/ / mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/ rgyas par mdzod cig khro bo'i rgyal/ / oṃ badzra krodha ha ya spi wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa ci 'grub dang / yig brgyas lhag chad bskang /gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ lha'i ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ha ya spri wa yi di pa bla ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul/ oṃ ha ya gri wa a sogs kyis mchod pa dang / 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dbul/ bcom ldan khro bo'i rgyal po yis/ / mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang / / 'jig rten bde 'byor phun sum tshogs/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i tshogs zhi zhing / / mthun rkyen legs tshogs ma lus pa/ / lhun gyis grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / ces 'phrin las bcol/ mkha' 'gro'i spyi gtor dang ga'i bdag 27

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/gtor ma bsngo/ bstod pa ni/ hrī bde gshegs snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje'i gar/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang khros pa'i rnam rol ba/ / bdud sde mthar byed khro rgyal bcom ldan 'das/ / rta mgrin padma dbang chen zhabs la bstod/ / byu ru'i lhun po rab 'bar bskal ba'i mes/ / 'khyud pa lta bu bzod dka'i gzi brjid can/ / dbang gi mdog 'chang khro rgyal bcom ldan 'das/ / rta mgrin padmang / / g.yas pas seng ldeng dbyug pa mkha' la 'phyar/ / g.yon pa sdigs mdzub rab tu bsgrengs pa yis/ / bstan dgra tshar gcod khro rgyal ྾ / / rta mgrinam / / rta skad bzhad pas khams gsum g.yo byed cing / / me yi tsha tsha 'phros pas gdon gsum bsregs/ /snang srid dbang bsgyur khro rgyal nga / / rta mgrin ྾ / / sder phreng g.yo ba'i stag lpags sham thabs gsol/ / sna tshogs sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ / brkyang bskum gar mdzad khro rgyalam / / rta mgrinam / / drag sngags nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pa yis/ / nag phyogs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams skrag byed cing / / skal ldan dbugs 'byin khro rgyal ྾ / / rta mgrin nga / / sgrib bral mkhyen pas chos kun mngon sum gzigs/ /dmigs med snying rjes 'gro ba kun skyong zhing / / mthu stobs thogs med khro rgyal bcom ldan 'das/ / rta mgrin padma dbang chen zhabs la bstod/ / khro rgyal khyod la bstod cing gsol btab mthus/ / rgyal bstan dar zhing dpon slob yon mchod kun/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun las rnam rgyal te/ / legs tshogs don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig / ces bstod/ gtang rag gi mchod pa byin gyes brlab/ mchod pa dang nang mchod dbul zhing / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i sor rtog ye shes dngos/ / zhes sogs kyis bstod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / khro rgyal rta mgrin 'grub gyur nas/ / 'gro ba gcig kyang ma 28

༄/ / rtasagrin phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub gter mdzod/lus pa/ / de yi sa la 'god par shog / yig brgya dang / gang yang bdag blo zhes sogs kyi mthar/ spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rten dang dbyer med du gyur/ yo su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ rten gyi drung ma yin pa phyogs gzhan du byed na/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ ces gshegs gsol byed/ che ba'i che mchog ces sogs bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni a 'gang dgon pa'i tshogs 'don du dgos tshul dad brtson ldan pa hor kyā rab 'byams pa blo bzang dkon mchog lu kyu rab 'byams pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ lu kyā dge slong dar rgyas nyi ma rnams kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /tshogs 'khor bya tshul ni/ tshogs rdzas dang gtor ma phyag len bzhin bshams/skyabs sems sngon du btang / oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā washurnya sarba dharma sa bhā wa shusgo ྅haṃ/ chos thams cad rang bzhin mi dmigs pa/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gye steng du rang sems hrī yig dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin padma dbang chen sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dmar la skum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar g.yo zhing /mcheb non po bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra smin ma dmar ser dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar zhing / dbu'i gtsug na rta mgo lngang nag rta skad 'tsher ba/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pas stong gsum me'i ra gur gyis 'gengs shing bdud kyi dkyil 'khor sreg par byed pa/ g.yas dbyug to 'phyar zhing / g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan zhing stag gi pags pa rlon 29

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs gar hrī la hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dza nyu baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros te dbang gi lha thams cad spyan drangs/ bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur zhing snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las ā las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rol mo rnams rang bzhin stong ba/ rnam pa mchod rdzas so so'i rnam pa can byed las dbang bo drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ oṃ a ā ( nas shasta ā : gi bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ nang mchod dang tshogs gtor a mṛ tas bsangs su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las yi las rlung / ram̐ las me/ā las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gye steng du/ ā las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gcig pa de'i nang gi phyogs bzhi dang dbus su hūṃ yi ji khaṃ hūṃ las sha lnga/mtshams bzhi dang dbus su li mi paṃ rta paṃ las bdud rtsi lnga/ de'i steng du oṃ 〉 rtu gi yi ge gsum brtsegs te gnas par gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba dang / yi ge gsum gyi 'od zer gyis sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum bsdus te so so la thim pa rnams thod par lhung nas zhu bas/ ma dag pa'i dri ma rnams sbyangs nas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/30

༄/ / rtamagrin phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabasadangos grub gteramadzod/oṃ ā shā/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ha ya gre wa ambha nas shasta pra tī tsā hūṃ swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod dbul/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i sor rtog ye shes dngos/ / longs spyod rdzogs pa gsung gi rang gdangs lha/ / gdug pa 'dul byed gtum chen khro bo'i rgyal/ / padma dbang chen zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pas bstod/ rang gi thugs kur hrī yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas gdon gsum gyi nyer 'tshe thams cad bcom zhing / rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa bsdus te thim par bsam la/ oṃ badzra krodha ha ya spri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa ci 'grub dang / mchod bstod gong ba'in bya/tshogs 'khor dngos gzhi ni/ e ma ho lhan skyes bde ba che'i/ / sgyu 'phrul snod bcud dag pa'i dngos/ / gang snang stong ba'i ye shes kyis/ /rgyas btab zung 'jug rol bar gyur/ / hrī 'og min bde ldan la sogs zhing mchog nas/ / dmigs med thugs rje chen pos nyer dgongs te/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol/ / yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ / khyad par khro bo'i rgyal bo gsung gi lha/ / padma dbang chen 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ / bcom ldan khro bo'i dbang phyug bka' nyan pa/ / chos srung dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong lha klu gzhi bdag dang / / rigs drug la sogs mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ / mdun gyi nam mkhar kun bzang mchod sprin dbus/ / rang rang dgyes pa'i phun tshogs gdan khri la/ / brtan par bzhugs te tshogs mchod rgya mtsho la/ / dga' mgur rol ba'i bde bas tshim gyur cig / ho lhan skyes bde ba mchog gi ting nge 'dzin/ / zab mo gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags dang / / rgya chen phyag rgya grub pa'i bden 3/

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/tshig mthus/ / byin brlabs zag med tshogs mchod rgya mtsho 'di/ / mtsho skyes rdo rje rgyal ba gnyis pa sogs/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kun la 'bul/ / oṃ 〉 rtu/ 'dod dgu'i dpal la rol bas tshim mdzad nas/ /e ma ho byin rlabs char chen dbab tu gsol/ / ho lhan skyes bde ba mchog gi ting nge 'dzin/ / zab mo nas tshogs mchod rgya mtsho 'di/ / khro rgyal rta mgrin padma dbang chen sogs/ / yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ / oṃ ā :/ 'dod dgu'im / / e ma ho dngos grub char chen dbab tu gsol/ / ho lhan skyes bde ba nas rgya mtsho 'di/ / bcom ldan khro bo'i dbang phyug bka' nyan pa/ / chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ / oṃ ā :/ 'dod dgu'imo / / e ma ho 'phrin las char chen dbab tu gsol/ / ho lhan skyes nas rgya mtsho 'di/ / phyogs skyong zhing skyong lha klu gzhi bdag sogs/ / dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs rnams kun la 'bul/ /oṃ 〉 rtu/ 'dod dgu'ir / / e ma ho mthun rkyen sdongs grogs mdzad du gsol/ / ho lhan skyes nas rgya mtsho 'di/ / rigs drug sems can gnod byed gdon bgegs sogs/ / lan chags sha 'khon gnyer ba kun la 'bul/ / oṃ 〉 rtu/ 'dod dgu'i dpal la rol bas tshim mdzad nas/ /e ma ho las nyon sgrib pa dag gyur cig / de nas tshogs phung bteg ste/ e ma ho tshogs kyi 'khor lo che/ / dus gsum bde gshegs gshegs bshul te/ /dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ / de ltar shes nas dpa' bo che/ /rnam par rtog pa'i sems bor la/ / tshogs kyi 'khor lor rgyun du rol/ /ces dbul zhing / de nas tshogs mang la brims nas bzhes te/ a ho ma hā su kha/zhes brjod/ tshogs lhag snod gcig tu bsdus par slob dpon gyis kha bkrus btab la/oṃyā rtu/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ ho lhan skyes bde ba nas tshogs 32

༄/ / rtasagrin phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub gteramadzod/lhag rgya mtsho 'di/ / padma dbang chen bka' nyan lhag sdud pa/ / phyogs bcur rgyu ba'i las byed tshogs la 'bul/ / oṃ ā :/ 'dod dgu'i dpal la rol bas tshim mdzad nas/ / e ma ho 'phrin las ma lus sgrub tu gsol/ / zhes brjod de phyi rol tu dor/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / / zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ ye shes pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ ces tshogs zhingabasdu/ bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / 'di ni tshogs 'khor rkyang ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ bskang gso sogs kyi mjug tu byed na/ bdag mdun gyi mngonatogs bskang bshags bstod pa'i bar dkyus bzhin btang la/ de nas tshogs 'khor gyi mchod gtor byin rlabs byas te/ e ma ho lhan skyes bde ba che'i/ / sgyu 'phrul snod bcud dag pa'i dngos/ / zhes pa man chad 'di bzhin bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di'ang a 'gang dgon pa'i tshogs 'don du dgos tshul dad brtson ldan pa hor kyā rab 'byams pa blo bzang dkon mchog lu kyā rab 'byams pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho/lu kyu dge slong dar rgyas nyi ma rnams kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ / bkra shis/ /33

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/ro༅/ / sman chog mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /snyigs dus nyam thag mgon med 'gro ba la/ /lhag par brtse ba'i ston pa thugs rje can/ /bde gshegs mched bdun thub dbang 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir byon bdag sogs mgon du bzhugs su gsol/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod tshogs ma lus 'bul/ /sdig ltung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / / bskal brgyar bzhugs te chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /dge tshogs kun kyang byang chub chen por bsngo/ /sa gzhi spos kyis nas spyod par shog /snyigs dus nyam thag mgon med 'gro ba la/ /lhag par brtse ba'i ston pa thugs rje can/ /mtshan legs yongs bsgrags dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gdung bas 'o dod 'bod do brtse bas dgongs/ /thugs bskyed bden pa'i dus la bab lags na/ /mgon po khyod kyi rlabs chen smon lam 'bras/ /deng 'dir bdag la mngon du gyur pa yis/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa kun las bskyab tu gsol/ /snyigs dus nyam thag mgon med 'gro ba la/ /lhag par brtse ba'i ston pa thugs rje can/ /zhes pa'i rkang ba gnyis kye 'phror/ sgra dbyangs rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gser bzang dri med snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mya ngan med mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo mngon mkhyen rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bcom ldan sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam 'dren shākya'i gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa re re'i mthar/34

༄/ / sman chogamador bsdus/gdung pas 'o dod/ ces sogs tshig rkang lhag ma lnga spyor/ mjug tu'ang / snyigs dus nyam thag mgon med 'gro ba la/ / lhag par brtse ba'i ston pa thugs rje can/ / bde gshegs mched bdun thub dbang 'khor bcas kyis/ / rjes bzung sa lam bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / ces bsngo bas mtshams sbyar la/ rkang ba tha ma'i dod du/ legs tshogs ma lus stsol ba'i bkra shis shog / ces shis pa brjod pas kyang mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni dur ped tā wang gi shog nas lhag bsam dang mkhyen dpyod rmad du byung ba rdo rams pa bsod nams grags pas/ da lta'i skye bo blo shin tu rtul zhing g.yeng bas khyer ba rnams la phan pa'i thabs su gdung dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs tshul shin tu gzung sla ba zhig dgos zhes bskul ba dang /rang gis kyang de rigs la phan nam snyam pa'i blos/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /35

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga stung ba'i mun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / bla ma thub pa'i dbang bo sangs rgyas so lnga'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gdung byed sdug bsngal rba klong 'khrugs pa'i mtshor/ / 'dren byed mi dge'i las kyi chu bo'i rgyun/ / zlog byed stobs bzhi'i bshags pa'i cho ga yi/ / gsal byed lag len rim pa 'dir bshad bya/ / de'ang rje bdag nyid chen pos/ sgo gsum sdig ltung dri mas sbags pa 'di/ / lhag par las sgrib spyong ba gnad che bas/ / rgyun du stobs bzhi tshang bar bsten pa gces/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang cag rnams dge ba gang byas pha bong gyen du bsgril ba ltar shugs chung la/ sdig pa byed tshe chu klung drag po thur du babs pa bzhin stobs che zhing grangs mang ba dang / dge bar rlom pa rnams kyang dug gsum gyi rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i dbang gis sdeg dang 'dres pa shin tu mang ste/ mdor na rang gi sgo gsum gye spyod pa mtha' dag rgyal ba'i bka' dang bsdur tshe mi dge ba'i phung bo 'ba' zhig tu song ba shas che bas/blo dang brtson pa'i shugs ci yod kyis dus rgyun du bshags bsdams la 'bad dgos/ bshags pa'ang phyogs re re tsam gyis mi chog pas/ stobs bzhi tshang ba dgos te/ chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo las/ byams pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na sdig pa byas shing bsags pa zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro/ / bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ rnam par sun 36

༄/ / sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga lhung ba'i mun sel/'byin pa dang / gnyen po kun tu spyod pa dang / nyes pa las ldog pa dang /rten gyi stobs so/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ dper na nad pa zhig 'chi nad kyis thebs pa'i tshe rkyen de'i dbang gis rang nyid 'chi bar shes na de las thar pa'i thabs tshol ba bzhin dang por las kyi rnam smin mthong nas skyon du lta dgos pas rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang / nad de sel ba'i thabs dngos gzhi sman dpyad byed pa dang 'dra bar gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang / nad slar mi ldang ba'i thabs dang spyod lam gzab dgos pa bzhin nyes pa las slar ldog pa'i stobs dang / de thams cad la sman pa mkhas pa nad g.yog dang bcas med mi rung du tshol dgos pa ltar rten gyi stobs gal che'o/ / des na ltung bshags kyi cho ga 'dir ni stobs bzhi'i gnad ma tshang ba med par 'dus pa yin te/ de'ang bdag gi skye ba 'di dang / zhes pa nas/mi sbed do zhes pa'i bar gyis rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang / slan chad kyang gcod cing sdom par bgyid lags so zhes pas nyes pa las slar ldog pa'i stobs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa so lnga'i mtshan brjod cing phyag 'tshal ba gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang / thog ma'i skyabs 'gro dang 'og gi sems bskyed rnams ni rten gyi stobs yin la de'ang phung bo gsum pa zhes bshad pas/ phung bo gsum du bsdu tshul ni/ dpon slob blo gros rgya mtsho'i stung bshags kyi ḍikka sogs su mi 'dra ba mang du gsungs kyang / gtso bor gyur pa ni sdig pa bshags pa dang / rjes su yi rang sogs thabs mkhas kyi spyod pas tshogs rgya chen po gsog pa dang / bsngo ba'i sgo nas dge rtsa rnams gong du spel ba gsum yin no/ / bsngo ba'ang sbyin pa tha na zhes sogs phar phyin dang po/ tshul khrims zhes sogs phar phyin gnyis pa/ tshangs par spyod pa zhes sogs tshangs pa'i gnas pa byams sogs tshad med bzhi la slob pa'i phar 37

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/phyin gsum pa/ sems can zhes sogs gzhan don la spro ba'i brtson 'grus/byang chub mchog tu zhes sogs rdzogs byang du sems rtse gcig pa'i bsam gtan/ bla na med pa'i zhes sogs ye shes chos kyi sku'i rgyu mthun pa'i shes rab kyi phar phyin te phyin drug gis bsdus pa'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa mtha' dag la slob cing de thams cad rdzogs byang gi rgyur bsngo ba smon 'jug gi nyams len cha tshang ba'i gnad dam pa yin no/ / des na tshul de nyid ji ltar nyams su len pa'i rim pa la/ thog mar gnas khang byi dor byas shing sangs rgyas so lnga'i sku bris 'bur ci rigs kyis gtsos pa'i sku gsung thugs kye rten legs par bkram/ de'i mdun du ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa gtsang zhing gya nom pa bsham/ rang nyid thog med nas 'khor bar 'khyams tshul dang / da dung yang dbugs kyi 'gyu ba phra mo 'di rkyen glo bur ba zhig gis yud kyis 'gags pa na/rnam par shes pa bya spu rlung gis khyer ba bzhin du rang dbang med par 'gro dgosal/ lhag par da lta rang gi spyod pa bag med pas bcas rang gi nyes ltung char bzhin du 'bab pa 'di la dpags na phyi mar 'gro sa ngan song las ma 'das shing / der skye na sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa'i tshul/ de las skyob pa'i nus pa skyabs dkon mchog gsum la yod tshul dang / khyad par du'ang sangs rgyas so lnga'i mtshan re re brjod pa tsam gyis kyang mtshams med lnga dang mi dge bcu la sogs pa bskal ba du mar bsags pa'i sdig ltung sbyong tshul mnyam med jo bo chen po'i bzhed pa ltar rgyal tshab kyi gsung las 'byung ba ltar gyi phan yon thun mong ma yin pa rnams dang / rje bdag nyid chen pos kyang 'ol kha chos lung du 'di nyid la thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad pa'i tshul sogs sgo du ma nas bsams te kun slong legs par bcos la/ skyabs sems sngon du btang / thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag / gseg ma la sogs med pa 38

༄/ / sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga lhung ba'i mun sel/dang / / lag mthil ltar mnyam baiḍūrya'i/ / rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig / ces sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa'i stobs kyis mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad kyang kun tu bzang po'i smon pa'i mthu las byung ba/ skyabs yul rnams la zag pa med pa'i dgyes pa skyed par byed pa'i kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ zhes bdun nam nyer gcig sogs brjod de mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab/ su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las rang gi mdun du seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri lha grangs dang mnyam pa dbus dang steng 'og phyogs mtshams so sor gnas pa'i dbus ma'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ sku la chos gos ngur smrig gi mdog can gsum mdzes par gsol pa/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ sku las skyes pa'i 'od kyi phung bo'i dkyil na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ steng du de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje snying bos rab tu 'joms pa ser po phyag gnyis chos 'chad/ shar du de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'phro dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag shar sgor de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang gi rgyal po zhal dang mgrin pa dkar 'ing lhag ma sngob klu'i rgyab yol can phyag gnyis chos 'chad/ lhor de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bo'i sde ser po phyag g.yas cung zad brkyangs nas skyabs sbyin dang /39

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/g.yon chos 'chad mdzad pa/ lho nub tu de bzhin gshegs pa dpal dgyes ser po phyag gnyis chos 'chad/ nub tu de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen me dmar po/ nub byang du de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen zla 'od dkar po/gnyis ka phyag g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag byang du de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba don yod ljang gu phyag g.yas thugs gar skyabs sbyin dang /g.yon mnyam bzhag byang shar du de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen zla ba dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa sngon po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ de dag gi phyi rol gyi steng du de bzhin gshegs pa dpal sbyin ser po phyag gnyis chos 'chad steng 'og tu mdzad pa/ shar du de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa ser po phyag g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ shar lhor de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pas byed dmar ser phyag gnyis chos 'chad/ lhor de bzhin gshegs pa chu lha dkar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag lho nub tu de bzhin gshegs pa chu lha'i lha dkar po phyag gnyis chos 'chad/ nub tu de bzhin gshegs pa dpal bzang ser po phyag g.yas cung zad brkyangs nas skyabs sbyin dang / g.yon chos 'chad/ nub byang du de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan dpal sngon po phyag g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag byang du de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid mtha' yas dmar po phyag gnyis chos 'chad/ byang shar du de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpal sngon po phyag g.yas byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal sku mdog dmar skya phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad pa'o/ / de dag gi phyi rol gyi steng du de bzhin gshegs pa sred med kyi bu ser po phyag gnyis steng 'og tu chos 'chad mdzad pa/shar du de bzhin gshegs pa me tog dpal ser po phyag g.yas brkyangs pa'i 40

༄/ / sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga stung ba'iwan sel/mtheb mdzub sbyar ba dang g.yon chos 'chad/ shar lhor de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i 'od zer rnam par rolapas mngon par mkhyen pa sku mdog ser po dang / lhor de bzhin gshegs pa padma'i 'od zer rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa sku mdog dmar po/ gnyis ka phyag g.yas sa gnon dang /g.yon mnyam gzhag lho nub tu de bzhin gshegs pa nor dpal sngon po dang /nub tu de bzhin gshegs pa dran pa'i dpal ser po/ gnyis ka phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag nub byang du de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan dpal shin tu yongs grags dkar po phyag g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam gzhag byang du de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po sngon po phyag g.yas rgyal mtshan phrag pa g.yon par bzung zhing / g.yon mnyam gzhag byang shar du de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu rnam par gnon pa sngon po phyag g.yas ral gri/g.yon mnyam gzhag 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa g.yul las shin tu rnam par rgyal ba sngon po khrab 'dzin pa'o/ / de dag gi phyi rol gyi shar du de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gnon pas gshegs pa'i dpal sngon po phyag g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag lhor de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas snang ba bkod pa'i dpal dang / nub tu de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen padmas rnam par gnon pa/ de gnyis ka sku mdog dmar ser phyag g.yas cung zad brkyangs nas skyabs sbyin dang / g.yon chos 'chad mdzad pa/ byang du de bzhin gshegs pa ri dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis kyis ri rab 'dzin pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan zhing / rab tu byung ba sprul ba'i sku'i cha lugs kyis padma zla ba rin po che seng ge'i khri steng na/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs 41

༄/ /gung thang bstanaba'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/gar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas de bzhin gshegs pa sum cu so lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can kun gye mgon gyur cing / / bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ / dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i/ / bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / badzra sa ma ya dza dza nyu baṃ ho dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a snu dza me gha sa mu traspa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ a gyi gnas su/ 〉bye/ puṣpe/ jupe/ ā lo ke/ gadhe/dzee wi bya/ shasta rnams bcug la mchod/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ / bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / / de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / gang gi thugs rje'i nyi 'od reg pa yis/ / nyes ltung sdig pa'i grang reg sel byed cing / / mngon mtho nges legs lam bzang gsal mdzad pa/ / bde gshegs so lnga'i lha tshogs rnams la bstod/ / bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /thog med nas bsags nyes brgya'i phung bo kun/ / thugs rje'i bdud rtsi'i chab kyis byang gyur te/ / yang dag lam bzang rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ / ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ / sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog / ces maṇḍal grangs bsags te dbul/ de nas rang gi g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mtha' skor du rigs drug gi sems can sa'i dreg pa ltar bgrangs kyis mi lang bas bskor te gnas pa'i mos pa dang / mdun du skyabs yul rnams rang cag la thugs brtse ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i dmigs pa legs paragasal btab la/ bdag dang ma sems can thams cad gnas skabs su'ang sdug 42

༄/ / sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga lhung ba'i mun sel/bsngal gyis mnar tshul dang / slad kyang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'ba' zhig bsgrub pas ngan songagasum gyi g.yeng khar nye ba'i tshul bsams nas/ shas mi bzod pa'i 'jigs skrag dang / de las skyob pa'i nus pa mdun gyi skyabs yul rnams kho na la yod par yid ches pa'i nges shes shugs drag po bskyed de blo lings kyis bkal ba'i sgo nas sems can thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu brjod par bsam la/ ngag tu'ang / bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus rtag par bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ / sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ / chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ / dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes pa'i bar lan mang du brjod de dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'og tu tshud par bsam/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms laganas par gyur cig khyad par bdag gis ma sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur ba nyid du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i sgrub pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /snyam du sems bskyed/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'di rnams 'og gi stobs lhag ma rnamasal nus pa 'don byed kyi gtso bo yin pas/ gnad du 'gro nges pa gal che'o/ /denas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ ratna ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ abha te/ samya kle burnya ya/tabya thā/ oṃ rasne rasne mahā rasne ratna bi dza ye sāhā/ sngags 'di brjod nas phyag lanagacig byas pa'ang bye ba phrag gcig tu 'gyur bar gsungs pas/ lan gsum mam bdun sogs nges can du brjod/ de nas langs te lus thams cad sa la phab pa'i brkyangs phyag tu grags pa'am/ lag pa'i mthil gnyis/ pus mo'i lha nga gnyis/43

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/dpralab ste yan lag lnga sa la reg pa'i phyag tshul dang mthun par btsal la/ padmo kha 'bus lta bu yi/ / lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar te/ da lus dpag med pa'i ngag yid kyis/ / mchod 'os kun la phyag 'di bgyid/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ / slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ / dang po me tog phog pa yi/ / dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ / ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ / skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ / 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ / bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa nas/ ri dbang gi rgyalapo la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bar mtshan re re'ang lan gsum gsum gyi bar du brjod cing / dang po'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sku'i rnam pa gsal btab/ gnyis pa'i tshe rang gi thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad lce'i steng du paṃ yig nag po'i rnam par nag phung nge yod pa'i mos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas de nyid bkrus te sa la thim pa'am sangs kyis dag pa'i dmigs pa bya/ gsum pa'i tshe yar langs pa na de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sku las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chad de rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa rjes ma de'i mtshan brjod cing sku'i rnam pa gsal 'debs pa sogs dal bu'i sgo nas rgyud shin tu 'khul nges pa gnad che'o/ / rgyas par spro na/ mtshan rnamasardzogs pa'i rjes su/ sangs rgyas kun gyis 'dul dka' ba/ / zhes sogs de bzhin gshegs pa so so'i phyag 'tshal gyi tshigs bcad lho brag bka' 'bum sogs las 'byung ba bzhin bya/ de nas/ de dag la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gye khams thams cad na/ zhes pa nas/ thal mo sbyar ba bgyis te skyabs su nye bar 44
