༄/ / sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga stung ba'i mun sel/mchi'o/ / zhes pa'i bar kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying thag pa nas re ltos 'cha' ba'i tshig don dran bzhin par gdon/ de'ang 'di nyid la nyams len gyi snying po chig dril du byed na slar yang skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te sngar bzhin byas la lan bcu gcig gam/ nyer gcig gam/ so lnga la thun re re byas pa'i thun gsum mam/ bzhir byas na shin tu legs so/ / thun gyi mthar de bzhin gshegs pa spyi'i snying bo 'di nyid lan gcig brjod na'ang bskal ba 'bum phrag brgya'i sdeg pa 'dag par gsungs pas/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta tre da ya/ a nu ga te/ oṃ ku ru ki ni swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa re'am/ ma mtha' nyer gcig bzla/ mjug tu yi ge brgya bas lhag chad bskang / gtor ma cha bzhi bshams la/ saṃ bha ra'i sngags lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma dang po sangs rgyas so lnga gtso bor gyur ba'i dkon mchog gsum la dmigs te/bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di/ / bla ma dkon mchog gsum la 'bul/ /bzhes nas mchog dang thun mong gi / dngos grub ma lus stsal tu gsol/ / gnyis pa rgyal chen sde bzhi sogs chos skyong rnams la dmigs te/ bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di/ / chos skyong srung ma rnams la 'bul/ / bzhes nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi / 'phrin las ma lus bsgrub tu gsol/ / gsum pa/ bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di/ / yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul/ / bzhes nas ru nga ma mdzad par/ / sdongs grogs gnas po bzang po mdzod/ / ba'i ba/ bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di/ / rigs drug sems can rnams la 'bul/ / bzhes nas sdug bsngal las grol te/ / myur du sangs rgyas thob par shog / bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ / de bzhin gathegs pa'i byin stobs dang / / chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ / don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun/ / de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ / thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sogs kyis mchod/ mgon po thugs rje zhes sogs kyis gong bzhin bstod/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin 45

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gshegs pa sum cu so lnga'i lha tshogs khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas phan ba de'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams zhabs pad brtan pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams bshad sgrub kye bya ba gong du 'phel zhing / 'jig rten mtha' dag chos 'byor bde skyid kyis 'tsho ba dang / bdag dang pha ma rigs drugagi sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu ba rang gi smin mtshams nas thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsams/mjug tu bzang bo spyod pa dang / bde ba can gyi smon lam sogs bsngo smon rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab bo/ / de'ang thog med nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las sna re re tsam ma yin par sgo mtha' dag nas bsags pa'i dbang gis gnyen po yang phyogs re tsam gyis chog shes mi bya bar cha mtha' dag nas 'bad dgos/ de'ang bslab btus su/sher mdo lta bu bri klog sogs mdo sde zab mo la brten pa dang / stong ba nyid la mos pa dang / rdor sems bsgom bzlas lta bu bzlas pa la brten pa dang / bris 'bur gyi sku dang satsā 'debs pa sogs sku gzugs la brten pa dang / mchod pa la brten pa/mtshanal brten pa ste drug gsungs pas/ tha ma ni 'di'i dngos gzhi gtso bo yin la/gzhan rnams phal cher thun mtshams kyi skabs su lag len la 'debs ci thub byas te/shes rgyud nyes ltung gis ma gos pa'i nyams len rnam par dag pa la skul byed kyi gzungs las gsungs pa'i sdig pa dag pa'i ltas rnams byung byung gi bar du 'bad de dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan par bya'o/ / smras pa/ gang zhig rang la brtse ba mi dman zhing / / legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo dang ldan rnams la/ / dgos don kun gyi nang na gal che ba'i/ /46

༄/ / sangs rgyas gum cu so lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga lhung ba'i mun sel/'dun ma'i rtsa ba nyes ltung sbyong 'di yin/ / de phyir rnyed dka' mi yi lus thob cing / / dmyal me bzod dga'i sgo 'phar gcod nus tshe/ / don med g.yeng ba bor nas 'di 'dra ba'i/ / nyams len snying bor mdzod cig grogs po dag / 'dis mtshon rang gzhan dge tshogs gaṅgā'i klung / / sdig ltung dri ma spyong byed lha yi chus/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i yid kyi nyes pa'i tshogs/ /sbyangs te 'chi med thar ba'i gnas thob shog / ces sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga ltung ba'i mun sel zhes bya ba 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dkon mchoga'abyung gnas kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i gsung la gzhi byas/ kha 'gengs 'os cung zad rnams gzhan nas kyang bsnan te/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes rang dang skal mnyam rnams la phan du re bas/ chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dad brtson ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam bskal bzang gi / rnam 'dren rgyal ba stong dang bde gshegs brgyad/ / sangs rgyas so lnga nye sras brgyad la sogs/ / rgyal ba sras bcas thugs bskyed bden pa'i mthus/ / bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bgyes pa/ / mi mthun rkyen gyis nam yang mi gzhom zhing / / dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ / 'bras bzang mtha' dag 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig g.yeng zhing bsam sbyor dman pas bgyis rnamasakyang / / phul byung dge ba'i dngos por bsgyur byas te/ / de yi mthu las sngon bsags sdig ltung kun/ / lhag med byang zhing dag par byen gyes rlobs/ / 'di snang 'gag tshe nye ba'i sras rnams kyis/ / dbugs dbyung bde ba can du 'khrid pa dang / / der ni 'od dpag med pa'i 'al mthong ste/ / gsung gi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston myong bar shog / skye zhing skye bar 47

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung ཿma/bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ / 'bral med rjes bzung bka' bzhin sgrub pa dang / / phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i rkyen gyis mi g.yo bar/ / sa lam bgrod pa myur du mthar phyin shog / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa 'jigs med yar 'phel gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ /48

༄/ /yonastong gi cho ga sgrib pa'i mun sel/༄༅/ / yon spyong gi cho ga sgrib pa'i mun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / thugs rje byin rlabs 'bar ba'i me 'od kyis/ / dkor sgrib nyes pa'i tshang tshing sreg byed cing / / mngon mtho nges legs lam bzang gsal mdzad pa/ / bcom ldan thugs rje'i gter chen de yis skyongs/ /ldan grol yon tan gdeng tshad mi ldan par/ / 'ju dka'i dkor la bag med spyod pa yis/ / gtan bde'i srog 'phrog nad kyis zin pa rnams/ / skyob byed sman gyi spyor ba mdo tsam spel/ /de yang gzhan gyis dad pas sbyin pa longs spyod pa'i tshul la/ bdag po'i tshul gyis spyod pa dang / byin pa'i tshul du spyod pa/ bu lon gyi tshul du spyod pa/ lcags gong me lce 'bar ba'i tshul du spyod pa dang bzhi mdo sde las gsungs pa'i phyi ma ni/ lcags gong me lce 'bar 'dra ba/ / zos par gyur pa ches sla yi/ / tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdom pas/ / yul 'khor bsod stoms za ba min/ / zhes pa ste/ da lta rang cag sdom pa gsum gyi khas len shin tu rgya che yang / de'i bcas mtshams rnam par dag pa sna re tsam yang bsrung ba semasal 'dzin rgyu med par gson gshin gyi dad zas la bag med du longs spyod cing / da dung yang lan tshwa'i chu bzhin ngoms pa med par sred pa lhag par 'phel te/ kha gsag gzhog slong sogs thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas log pa'i 'tsho ba 'ba' zhig bsgrubs pa ni/ tshe thung dgun nyi lta bu 'di yud kyis 49

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/zad de/ 'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i dkor zas thams cad rmi lam gyi dga' ston ltar dran pa'i yul du bzhag de'i sgrib pa thams cad sems steng du khur te dmyal ba'i gting du phyin nas lo grangs bye ba phrag khrig mang por khro chu khol ma'i btung ba dang / lcags kyi thu lum 'bar ba zas su za dgos pas/ rang la rang gces par 'dzin pa rnams kyis rab dkor sgrib tshan po ches ma gos pa dang / ma mtha' yang dkor sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs ma nor ba re la 'bad par byed dgos so/ / de yang spyir ston pa thugs rje can gyis dkor sbyong yang rim pa du ma zhig gsungs la/ khyad par du bya sla zhing don che bar gzigs te de bzhinagashegs pa rin chen 'od kyi rgyal po me 'od rab tu gsal ba'i mtshan/na ma sa manta pra bha rā dzā ya zhes sogs yon sbyong gi gzungs dang bcas pa gsungs la/ na mo bha ga wa te/ su me ru galpa rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyaka saṃ budhā ya/ tangu thā/ oṃ galpe galpe/ ma hā galpe/ galpe pa ri sho dha ni swāhā/zhes gzungs rkyang ba gcig kyang gsungs so/ / 'gyur phal cher du kun nas 'od kyi rgyal po zhes pa tsam las mi 'byung yang / ltung bshags kyi lha so lnga'i nang gi rin chen mo yin par mngon te/ rgyal tshab rjes jo bo'i gsung rgyun ltar mtshan gyi phan yon bkod pa las/ rin chen mes dge 'dun gyi dkor la 'bag pa'i sdig pa 'dag go / zhes gsungs pa dang / mdo 'di'i phan yon du/ yon mang po la spyad pa yang byang bar 'gyur ro/ / yon bdag de'i yon yongs su 'phel bar 'gyur zhing tshogs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs pa gnyis don 'dra bar snang ngo / / de ltar na kun nas 'od kyi rgyal po zhes pa zhing gi sgo nas btags pa yin la/ rin chen me'am/ me 'od rab tu gsal ba zhes pa mtshan dngos yin te/ me tog gi tshogs kyi mdo las/ byang phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba brgya stong gi tha ma 50

༄/ /yonasbyong gi cho ga sgrib pa'i mun sel/na 'jig rten gyi khams nor bu snang ba can zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen me zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'od dang snang ba rnam grangs su byas par mngon/ ston tshul de 'dra ba mang ste/ mdo der rdo rje snying pos rab tu 'joms pa'i mjug thogs su/ rin chen me dang rin chen zla 'od gnyis gsangs pa lta bu ltung bshags kyi lha tshogs rags rim zhig thor bu thor bur gsungs la/ dang po yang rdo rje'i snying bo can zhes pa zhing dang / rdo rjes rab tu 'joms pa zhes pa mtshan dngos yin par gsungs kyang / phung bo gsum pa'i mdor rdo rje'i snying bos rab tu 'joms pa zhes bsdus nas gsungs pa bzhin no/ / des na mgon po 'di nyid la brten nas dkor gyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs zab mo nyams su len pa la/ thog mar 'di nyid kyi sku brnyan zur ba'am/ ltung bshags kyi bris thang lta bu'i mdun du mchod pa legs par bsham/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ rang gi mdun du seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri mtho zhing yangs pa'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od kyi rgyal po me 'od rab tu gsal ba sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ sku la chos gos ngur smrig gi mdog can gsum mdzes par gsol ba/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ sku las skyes pa'i 'od kyi phung bo'i dkyil na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ byang phyogs nor bu snang ba can gyi zhing khams nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen me la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis 51

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bskor ba spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / / bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ / dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i/ / bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / dza : baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ dkor sgrib nyes ltung khur gyis non pa yis/ / srid mtsho'i gting du bying ba'i nyam thag rnams/ / byin rlabs gru gzings mchog gis sgol ba'i gnyen/ / bde gshegs rin chen me la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ / dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun/ / bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la/ / lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgye'o/ / bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ / rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du/ / zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ / rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ / rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ / sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag / de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa/ /thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos/ / de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ / dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis/ / rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing / / bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ / me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang / / sil snyan rnams dang byugs pa gdugs mchog dang / / mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis/ / rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ / na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang / / phye ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang / / bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis/ / rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ / mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ / de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos/ / bzang bo spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ / rgyal ba kun 52

/ /yonastong gi cho ga sgrib pa'i mun sel/la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ / lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang / / sdeg pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ / de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /khyad par 'dod la sred pa'i dbang gyur te/ / mchog gsum dkor dang dad pas byin pa'i rdzas/ / bag med spyad pas bu lon chags pa kun/ / gdungs pas 'gyod pa drag pos mthol zhing bshags/ / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ / rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang / / 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang / / de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang / / gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma rnams/ / byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes/ / mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la/ / 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul/ / mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la/ / 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir/ / bskal ba zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang / / bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi/ / phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / / rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ / dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ / thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por bsngo/ / sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ / ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ / 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od kyi rgyal po me 'od rab tu gsal ba laphyag 'tshal lo/ / lan gang mang / de nas/ ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung thams cad dang / khyad par du mchod rten gyi dkor ram dge 'dun 53

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron 'i gsung 'bum/gyi dkor dang / gson gshin gyi dad rdzas sogs la bag med par longs spyad pa'i nyes pa dpag tu med pa rnams/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ye shes su gyur pa/ spyan du gyur pa/ dpang du gyur pa/ tshad mar gyur pa/ mkhyen pas gzigs pa khyed kyi spyan sngar mthol lo/ / mi 'chab bo/ / 'chags so/ /slan chad kyang gcod cing sdom par bgyid lags so/ / mgon po khyed kyi thugs rje byin rlabs bsam gyes mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de'i thugs gar zla ba laganas pa'i hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las bdud rtsi sna lnga 'od zer dang bcas pa'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas thog med nas bsags pa'i dkor sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa thob par gyur par bsams la/ na ma sa manta pra bhā rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyaka saṃ bujo ya/ na mo mdzi thi ye/ ku mā ra sgru tā ya/ bo rnyi satwa ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru tsi kā ya/ tarya thā/ oṃ ni rā lasbe ni dwa bhā se/ dza ye dza ye lab dhe/ ma hā ma te dge dge hūṃ me pa ri shodhā ya sāhā/ zhes bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ mjug tu yi ge brgya bas lhag chad de bskang / dkor sgrib nyes ltung khur gyis non pa yis/ / srid mtsho'i gting du byeng ba'i nyam thag rnams/ / byin rlabs gru gzings mchog gis sgol ba'i gnyen/ / bde gshegs rin chen me la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa ma lus 'bul/ /thog med nas bsags sdig ltung thams cad bshags/ / skye 'phags dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / / 'khor ba ma stongs bar du legs bzhugs nas/ /'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ / 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ / deng nas ji srid byang chub snying bo'i bar/ / 'dren pa 54

༄/ /yonastong gi cho ga sgrib pa'i mun sel/mchog gis 'bral med rjes bzung nas/ / las nyon sgrib pa'i dri ma drungs phyung ste/ / yang dag lam bzang skye bar byen gyis rlobs/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas 'od kyi rnam par zhu ste rang gi smin mtshams nas thim par gyur par bsams la bsngo smon gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / 'di'i phyag mtshan klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa'i ltung bshags kyi 'grel ba las/ rin po che dang me'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa ni rin chen ma ste zhes 'byung yang / dze tā ri'i ltung bshags kyi ṭīkra dang / nag po pa'i phung bo gsum pa'i sgrub thabs sogs su de dang sgo bstun pa'i zur tsam yang ma byung la/ sa paṇa gyis sdom gsum rab dbyer bkag cing / rje bla mas kyang de la tshang mar ma mdzad par rang gi gzigs snang dang bstun nas bzang skyong ba sogs la gsungs pa bzhin/ lho brag grub chen gyi ltung bshags cho gar yang bkod snang bas so/ /'grel ba de ni rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtshos klu sgrub la kha g.yar ba'i bod gzhung zhig yin par gsungs pa ltar 'thad de/ 'grel pa de nyid du/ shar lho klu yis khyab pa'i zhing na klu dbang gi rgyal po ste sngon po klu shing dang sbrul sngon po bsnams pa'o/ / zhes bshad pa klu sgrub kyi gsung gzhan dang mi mthun zhing / klu dbang rgyal po'i zhing yang sbrang rtsi can du me tog gi tshogs kyi mdo las gsungs pa bzhin dam pa gong ma rnams kyang dgongs pa mthun pas shes par nus so/ / phyi dus mu mtha' yas pa'i bskal ba ru/ / bzod dka'i rnam smin khur chen 'khyer dka' bas/ / deng dus dal 'byor tshang ba'i gnas skabs 'dir/ / gtan gyi bde ba sgrub la 'bad par rigs/ / de phyir sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs kyi mchog / gzungs mdo'i cho ga lag tu blang ba'i tshul/ / bkod pa'i dge bas ngan song sgo bkag ste/ / bde chen thar ba'i sa la reg gyur cig / ces yon spyong gi cho ga sgrib pa'i mun sel zhes bya ba 'di ni or tu su'i shog nas lhag bsam rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa sman pa bla zur blo bzang yon tan gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ /55

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ /che dpag med la brten pa'i che sgrub bzhugs so/ /༄༅//bde gshegs kun gyi thugs rje'i ngo bo nyid/ /bde legs rtsa ba drin can bla ma dang / /bde ldan zhing mgon snang ba mtha' yas kyis/ /bde chen bdud rtsi'i 'chi med mchog sbyin mdzod/ /de'ang dpal ldan bla ma rnams dang bstan 'dzin gye skyes bu bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sogs rang gzhan gyi don du tshe sgrub bya bar 'dod pas rten dang mchod gtor bshams/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad zla'i gdan la shrī yig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ rgyal ba sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnamasakyi byin rlabs mtha' dag bsdus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa padma rā ga'i lhun po bzhin du sku mdogadamar zhing gsal ba 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba/ shin tu 'dzum zhing zhi ba'i nyams can/ mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs shing rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa la rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang lha'i gos kyis 'ja' tshon klubs pa bzhin du mngon par bkra ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā56

༄/ /tshe dpag med la brten pa'i tshe sgrub/thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ma'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs/ 7 3 baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par thim/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ sprul sku 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las rma las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du mchod pa rnams phul du byung ba'i lha rdzas su gyur/ oṃ arnya 〉 rtu nas/ shasta ā : gi bar gyis byin gyes brlabs/ oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yur dzā na a / nas/ shasta pra tī smo swāhā'i bar gyis mchod/ dgyes 'dzum 'od kyis tshe dpal padma 'byed/ / stan 'jeb gsung gis nyam thag dbugs dbyung mdzad/ / mkhyen brtse'i thugs kyis 'gro la bu bzhin dgongs/ / bcom ldan tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rang gi thugs gar zla ba la trī 'i mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/'byung ba chen po lnga'i nus pa sogs srid zhi'i khams kyi tshe bcud/ grub pa'i bcudalen gyi rdzas/ dregs ldan yongs kyi tshe dpal bsod nams/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas tshe yar ba nyams pa thams cad sor chud de/ lus kyi zungs dang srog gi rten du gyur bas 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur bar bsams la/ oṃ na mo swāhā/ zhes gzungs ring dang / oṃ na mo hūṃ ā yurto na hrī ā ro lis hūṃ trī zhes dang / tarya thā/ a ba ri mi ta ā yudzā na hrī rtu hūṃ swāhā/ zhes dang / oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzi brnye swāhā/ zhes pa'i gzungs thung rnams kyang ci 'grub bzla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskangs te/ mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya'o/ / bum chu'am ril sgrub byed na/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du rma byas btegs 57

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad zla'i gdan la hrī yig dmar po ring cha chog drag dang bcas pa/ zhes sogs rang sgra dor ba ma gtogs/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyi bar bdag skyed bzhin bya/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing khams mtha' yas pa/ / yid 'ong mchod yon mtha' yas kyis bkang ste/ / bcom ldan mgon po snang mtha' yas pa la/ / 'bul lo tshe mtha' yas pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /zhes mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil sogs sbyar zhing / so so'i mthar gong gi mchod sngags rnams btags la dbul/ bstod pa'i tshigs bcad kyi 'phror/ mkhyen dang brtse dang nus pa mthar son pa'i/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon dang skyabs khyod la/ / rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyes gsol 'debs na/ / brtse bas dgongs te tshe yi mchog spyin mdzod/ / thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'od stong 'bar ba yis/ / dus min 'chi ba brgyad sogs rgud pa'i smag / bsal nas 'chi med rig 'dzin mchog thob ste/ / lam bzang gegs med 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ / zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed kyi thugasaka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs/ 'jig rten khams kyi tshe bcud bkrag mdangs phun tshogs thams cad bsdus te sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur bar bsams la gong gi sngags rnams bzla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ 'od du zhu bas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsams te mtshan sngags la/ ba bla ta btags pa gsum sogs kyis dbul mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ bum pa'i lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bum chu'am ril bu'i rnam par gyur bar bsams la/ bsngo ba dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /58

༄/ /tshedapag med la brten pa'i tshe sgrub/zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa ri khrod pa don grub rgya mtsho dang dge slong 'jigs med blo gros gnyis kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dgon gsar dga' ldan rab rgyas gling du bris pa'o// //59

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / mi 'khrugs pa'i gos sku bkram skabs kyi 'don cha'i go rim bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo gu ru maci nā thā ya/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum/spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ de nas/ ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ / skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ / 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /skyabasaganas kun 'dus de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ / bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / / de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dag pas 'dod chags bral bar gyur/ / dge bas ngan song las grol ba/ / gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ / zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ / grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ / bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ / zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/ /dge 'dun la yang gus phyag 'tshal/ / gzhon nu'i cha lugs 'chang ba bo /shes rab sgron mes rab tu brgyan/ / 'jig rten gsum gye mun sel ba/ /'jam dpal la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ / sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ / yon tan dam pa kun bsags pa/ / spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ / rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ / stobs po che la drag shul che/ / rig sngags rgyal po dge ba can/ / gdul dka' po dag 'dul ba po/ / rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ / chos dbyings rang bzhin ind+ra nī la'i mdog / zhal gcig phyag gnyis sa gnon mnyam bzhag bzhugs/ / lha yi 60

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa'i gos sku bkram skabs kyi 'don cha'i go rim/gos dang rin chen rgyan mang mdzes/ / bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / oṃ kri li kyi li badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ badzra dhrika dzwa lha dzwa la ya ban dhā ri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams phul tu byung ba'i lha rdzas su gyur/bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ / tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ / bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / / thugs kyis thugs dpag mdzad du gsol/ / bdag ni khyed la gus dang ldan/ / oṃ sasbo ta thā ga ta a khro bhya maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra a pra tī tsā hūṃ swāhā/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ / tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi zhabs bsil bzhes nas kyang / / thugs kyis thugs dpag mdzad du gsol/ / bdag ni khyed la gus dang ldan/ / oṃ pra wa ra sad ka re pāhūṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ / rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ / yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ / rol mor bcas pa du mas sku bsil lo/ / oṃ sadru de wa ta a tsinta a mṛ ta swā hā/sna tshogs dbang bo'i gzhu bzhin rab bkra zhing / / gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba/ / gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ / bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog / oṃ badzra want+ra ā ka swā hā/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir/ / rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang / / rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ / mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sgu lus thob par shog / oṃ badzra ā li kā ra wa pu ṣa chi swā hā/gtsang zhing gtsang ma las byung ba'i/ / lha rdzas bzang po'i dri 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ / bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ / ā ha ra ā ha ra satho bīdu dhā ri pū dzi te swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang 61

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/ma las skyes pa'i/ / lha rdzas bzang po'i me tog 'di/ / bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ / bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ / yā ha ra ā ha ra sa bīngu dhā ri glu dzi te swā hā/ nags tshal bcud ni yid du 'ong / / dri yi sbyar ba lha yi rdzas/ / bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ / bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ / ā ha ra ā ha ra saze dīngu bhā ri snu dze te swā hā/sman rnams bcud ni yid du 'ong / / sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ / bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ / ā ha ra ā ha ra sadru bīngu tī ri snu dzi te swā hā/ gnod rnams 'joms shing bkra shis pa/ / dge zhing mun pa rnam sel 'di/ / bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ / mar me 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ / ā lo ka ya ā lo ka ya bīngu dhā ri pū dzi te swā hā/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ / rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ / sems can sdug bsngal sel mdzad pa'i/ / sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig / oṃ saspru ta thā ga ta akhro ca sa pa ri wā ra shasta pra tī tstsha swā hā/ u hu lags bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po zhes sogs lan gsum/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/zhes pa nas/ thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ / zhing khams 'bul bar zhu nas/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'di nyid bla ma rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ sa gzhi spos kyi zhes sogs/ ke ka ni bzla/ dus gsum skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bshes gnyen la ma gus pa nas bdag gnyis su mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i bar gyi 62

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa'i gos sku bkramaskabs kyi 'don cha'igo rim/phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag myur du 'gag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/bshesaganyen la gus pa nas bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i bar gyi phyin ci ma log pa'i blo sna mtha' dag bde blag tu skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyi dang nang gi bar gcod thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi zhes sogs lan gsum/byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ / ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig / skyes pa nyams pa med par yang / / gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog / yang dag lta ba rin po che/ / ma skyes pa rnams zhes sogs/ / pha ma sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig / ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs pa dang / / byang chub sems dpa' gang na su bzhugs pa/ / de dag kun gye smon lam 'grub gyur cig / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / /mkha' mnyam 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba dang / / bdag gzhan ma lus tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyangs nas/ / myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon tshe bde bar gshegs pa spyan chen po'i/ / spyan sngar thugs bskyed mdzad pa nas bzung ste/ / phyi nang rkyen gyis nam yang mi 'khrugs pa/ / mi bskyod rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / khyed kyi thugs bskyed bslu med bden pa'i mthus/ 'dis mtshon bdag gi dus gsum dge tshogs kun/ / nyid kyis bdag sogs don du gang btab pa'i/ / smon pa'i gnas kun 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig / yid srub dpung dang de yi byed pa'i las/ / mi bzad dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung sogs/ / las nyon sgrib pas nam yang mi brdzi bar/ / yang dag lam bzang bde blag bgrod gyur cig / zhing mtshag mngon par dga' ba der skyes nas/ / bskal bzang rnam 'dren kun gyi zhabs bsten cing / / so thar byang sems rig pa 'dzin pa yi/ / tshul khrims 63

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/phung bo yongs su rdzogs gyur cig / rnam dag tshul khrims them skas la brten nas/ / mdo sngags lam gyi khang bzang rtser 'dzegs te/ / mi 'jigs sku bzhi'i khri la dbang bsgyur zhing / / ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon du 'gyur bar shog / bla mas/ bdag sogs rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs shing bsnyen sgrub phyag mchod la sogs pa bgyis pa 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas ring bor mi thogs par sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs te/ gang gi mtshan tsam thos pas kyang / bdud kyi nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi zhing tshul khrims kyi phung bo yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i go 'phang bde blag tu thob par gyur cig de lta bu'igo 'phang mchog ma thob pa'i skye ba thams cad du'ang rgyal ba'i bstan pa lung dang rtogs pa la thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa rnam par dag pa sgrub pa'i rten sha stag thob par gyur cig rten de yang mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun gyi rgyan dang / mi 'bral bar gyur cig bdag ni skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ / ngan song ngan 'gro log par ñtsang ba yi/ / skye gnas rnams su nam yang mi skye zhing / / dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus thob par shog / de lta bu'i gnas skabs thams cad du'ang sngon gyi gnas ji lta ba bzhin du dran pa'i tshe rabs dran pa thob par gyur cig skye ba thams cad du srid pa mtha' dag la snying bo med par mthong zhing thar ba'i yon tan gyis yid 'phrogs pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslang ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba byed par gyur cig skyes ma thag gnas srid pa'i bde ba la/ / nam yang ma chags thar ba thob bya'i phyir/ / nges 'byung bsam pas tshangs spyod tshol ba la/ / brtson 'grus lhod pa med par 'jug 64

༄/ /mi 'khrugs pa'i gos sku bkram bas kyi 'don cha'i go rim/par shog / bdag ni rab tu 'byung bar byed pa la/ / 'khor dang nye du longs spyod gang gis kyang / / gegs byed med par mthun pa'i rkyen rnams kun/ / ji ltar bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par shog / rab tu byung ba'i tshe na yang nyes ltung phra mos kyang ma gos par tshul khrims kyi phung bo mthar phyin par mdzad pa'i sgo nas byang chub chen po brnyes pa dge slong mi 'khrugs pa lta bur gyur cig rab tu byung nas ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ / mkhan slob spyan sngar ji ltar khas blangs bzhin/ / bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'i/ / nyes pas nam yang gos par ma gyur cig / tshangs spyod rten la theg pa chen po ye/ / zab cing rgya che'i chos rnams ji snyed pa/ / ma rnams don du dka' ba du ma yis/ / bskal ba dpag tu med par bsgrub par shog / 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / / kun tu bzang bo de yang de bzhin te/ / de dag kun gye rjes su bdag slob phyir/ / dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ / dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngob gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ / bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / / bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ / mi 'khrugs mgon dang thub dbang 'od dpag med/ / ma pham 'jam dbyangs gsang bdag spyan ras gzigs/ / bde gshegs 'khor bcas rten 'bral mi sru ba'i/ /bden pas smon lam ji btab myur 'grub shog / sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob/ / ces pa nas/ bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig / 'di ni dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin nas lo star chags kyi lnga ba'i gdung mchod la bcu gnyis sogs nyin gsum gyi ring mi 'khrugs pa'i dus bzang gi thogabacu gsum la mi 'khrugs pa'i gos sku chen mo bzo bkod khyad mtshar can bkram pa'i skabs kyi 'don pa'i go rim sogs kyi 'don sgrig ljags bkod gnang ba ji lta ba bzhin bkod pa'o/ /65

༄ / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / 'phags mchog 'jam dpal nag po la brten pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga nyes pa kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes 'bar ba'i 'od/ / spros bral dbyings dang ro gcig zhugs pa yi/ / rang mdangs beeḍūrya snang gzugs kyi sku'i/ / rnam rol 'jam dpal dpa' bos dge legs stsol/ / phyi nang bla med sbyin sreg cho ga yi/ / las nyon sgrib pa'i dug tsher kun gzhom zhing / /dngos grub rin chen gter gyi sgo 'byed par/ / gsung phyir dam pa'i gsung bzhin spel bar bya/ / de yang dpal ldan sa skya pa rnams kyi thugs dam zab mo shin tu gsang zhing thugs gtsigs che ba'i gser chos bla na med par mdzad pa bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal nag po'i sbyin sreg ji ltar bya ba'i tshul 'chad pa la/ thog mar lha 'di la gtso bor brten nas dngos grub sgrub par 'dod pa rnams kyis 'di'i sbyin sreg sogs la yang nan tan byed dgos te/ sam zu ṭa las/ sbyin sreg lha rnams tshim par byed/ tshim pa las ni dngos grub stsol/ / sngags ni lhag gam ma tshang na/ / thams cad sbyinasreg dag gis skong / / zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ me lha'i khar ni nges par lha/ / sbyin sreg dngos grub rab tu ster/ / zhes gsungs shing / kha sbyor sogs du mar/lha yi kha ni me ru gsungs/ / zhes sogs kyis sbyinasreg ni lha rnams mchod pa'i sgo mchog tu gyur pa dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs phul du phyin par gsungs la/ der ma zad lhagapa'i lha gang yin kyang / de'i byin rlabs rang rgyud la nye bar byed pa'i bsnyen pa gal che bar dam pa thams cad dgongs pa mthun zhing / de ltar yin na bsnyen pa de'i 66

༄/ / 'phagasamachog 'jamadapalanag po la brten pa'i sbyinasregachad lhag sogs kyi nyes pa sbyong zhing / nus pa bskyed pa'i sbyin sreg kyang dgos par mtshungs so/ / des na kun gzigs lnga ba chen pos 'di la mchod bstod dbang bskur rgyas gdab sogs kyi spros pa byas par dgag bzhag gnang ba yang / dam pa'i man ngag mi shes pa kha cig gis de 'dra med pa'i yig rnying sogs ma dag pa'i grangs su bcug ste/mtha' gcig tu de thams cad byed dgos par bshad pa bkag pa yin gyi/ de 'dra mi rung ba min te/ dper na yig drug lta bu spyod lam gang gi skabs su yang bzlas chog paragasung na yang / khrus dang gtsang sbra sgyung bar gnas pa sogs kyi sgo nas bzlas na lhag par nus pa che ba bzhin no/ / de nas thog mar bdag bskyed ni/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ su bha was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs padma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid dī mthing nag las ral gri 'bar ba trī sa mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun 'jam dpal sku mdog mthing kha/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas ral gri 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon mtheb srin gyis thugs gar utpa la'i yu ba bsnams pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad gar kha phye ba'i steng na sher phyin gyi po ti 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing /dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ sku rngam brjid dang ldan zhing / ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sgom padang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ ye shes pa dza ཿ baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas 67

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname gsung 'bum/pa yongs su gyur pa las/ mi skyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ a 〉 rtu nas shasta 〉 rtu gi bar gyi byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ maci shrī ka la ya sa pa ri wā ra a pra tītstsha swā hā nas shasta pra ti tstsha sā hā'i bar gyes mchod/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gcig bsdus pa/ / mig sman mdangs can mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter/ / byin rlabs dngos grub mchog stsol lhag pa'i lha/ / 'jam dpal khyod kyi sku gsung thugs la bstod/ / gang gi zhabs rdul gus pas bsten pa rnams/ / gdon gsum gnod pa'i dpung gis mi badzi zhing / /nyams grib dri ma mtha' dag byang byed pa'i/ / byin rlabs gter chen khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ / rtse gcig yid kyis lhag pa'i lhar bsten na/ /dmigs med thugs rje mchog gis nyer dgongs te/ / phyi dang nang gi nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / / mchog thun dngos grub ma lus grub par mdzod/ / rang gi thugs gar nyi gdan la dī0yig mthing nag gi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog nag pos bskor ba las 'od zer dmar po me 'od lta bu 'phros/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod 'tshe bsam ngan sbyor dzub grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cadakhyang zhing dag par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ tur ta sod/ snying mgo la chod/ kha la dza ki shaṃ tram̐ rbad phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa 'di rtsa sngags yin pa'i ci rigs par skabs su babs pa'i spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bcas te bzla'o/ / 'di la sngags gsum yod pa las/ dza yan chad 'dra ba la/ sha ke shaṃ ṭaṃ ṭa tai rbarda swāhā/ zhes pa dang / yang na/ shaṃ ke sā hā/ zhes pa ste 'on kyang dam pa gong 68

༄/ / 'phagasasachog 'jamadapalanag po la brten pa'isnyinasregam rnams sngags dang po gtso bor mdzad/ ro langs kyi gnod pa zlog byed/ tur mi sod/ zhes pa tur ta sod/ ces pa'i mjug tu sbyar kyang rung la ma ba'ag kyang chad pa'i nyes par mi 'gyur zhes paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan ye shes gsungs/bzlas pa'i mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang zhing mchod bstod bya/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na gtor ma bsang sbyangs bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jam dpal nag po'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ mtshan sngags la/ a ka ro btasas pa lanagasum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ bstod pa'i mjug gi tshigs bcad phyi mas 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas sbyin sreg bya ba la/ cho ga sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/dang po ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi ba la dkar rtse btab/ thog mar tshangs zur gyi thig btab/ thig skud khru phyed pa gcig gis dbus nas blum por bskor/ de la sor ba'i bsnan nas thum skor dang / slar yang sor ba'i bsnan nas blum por bskor bar bya'o/ / de nas tshangs thig gi steng nas sor gnyis phyir gzhal ba'i mtshams su bya rjes btsal te zur thig nas zur thig gi bar la thig skud brkyangs nas gru bzhir gdab/zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje/ phyi'i kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba/ thab kyi dbus su padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar ral gri/ blum thig nang ma'i steng nas bud thing skam po'am/ dgon pa'i ba lang gi lci ba srog chags med pa blum por brtsigs/ g.yas phyogs su 'jig rten pa'i lha la 'bul rgyu'i mchod gtor dang / yam shing sogs rdzas chen bcu gnyis dang khyad par gyi rdzas gang 'byor dang / de'i phyi rol tu 'jig rten pa'i mchod gtor bsregs rdzas rnams bkod/ g.yon phyogs su padma 'dab brgyad dkar po byis pa la chu bzhi dang bzed zhal bsang gtor gyi ku sha'i chun po bcas dgod/ g.yas phyogs su rdor dril dgang gzar blug kha sbyar las bum so rtsi gos zung dpal 'bar rlung g.yab ku sha 'thor nas sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs par byas te/ rang nyid kha 69

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/shar du phyogs pas stan bde ba la padma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod nas bsang chu la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun dang mchod rdzasarnams la g.yas skor gyis lan gsum bsangs/ mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsang / su bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ gzhan yang 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ a ā : nas shasta 〉 rtu gi bar bajod/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya byas la/ nam sarba budha bornyi satwa rna/ oṃ sarba bid byu ra snu ra/ su ra su ra/ a wa rta ya a wa rta ya ho badzra spa ra ṇa khaṃ/mthar se gol dang bcas dgrol ba gsum/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur las gung gong mo gnyis rtse sprad pa'i phyag rgyas bsreg rdzas rnams la ston cing / oṃ swā hā/ zhes pas bsreg rdzas rnams spyir bkrus par bsam/ oṃ ā swā hās yi shing dang / oṃ thi swā hās zhun mar dang / oṃ rdza swā hās 'bru dang / oṃ ku ru swā hās gzhan pa'i rdzas rnams sbyangs par bsams/ rdzas rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs shing dag nas phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ me gang yang rung ba/ oṃ ā :/ lan gsum brjod de sgod du bzhag la/ las sngags brjod pa dang bcas pas bsang chus g.yas skor du lan gsum bsang / rtsa'i chun po dang bcas thab kyi nang dubacug la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐/ zhes gzi byin bskyed/ hūṃ/ zhes brjod de rlung g.yab kyis me sbar/ rtsa sngags lan bdun brjod la mar khu blug gzar bdun gyis me gso ku sha lag tu bzung la/ oṃ badzra satwa ā lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ 70

༄/ /'phagasamachog 'jam dpalanag po la brten pa'i sbyinasregaku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge/ tshangs pa'i lha rnams dag byed cing / /dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa/ / sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying / / bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni/ / zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ / zhes brjod nas ku sha gnyis gnyis rtse mo gshibs pa rang gi g.yon ngos nas brtsams te thab kyi kha khyer la rtse mo shar dang / lho dang / nub dang / byang du bstan la snga ma'i rtse mos phyi ma'i rtsa ba non par bkram zhing / thab khung du rtse mo shar du bstan pa'i ku sha ba lang gi rna ba lta bu ha cang yang mi ring bas g.yog ku sha bkram zin pa dang thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gi bgegs thams cad zhi ba dang bkra shis par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab bo /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ thog mar 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa/ bar du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa/ mthar 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o /dang po ni/ thab sngar bzhin bsang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las hūṃ dkar po zhu ba las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs blum pa rgyar khru gang ba/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i kha khyer la rdo rje phreng bas bskor ba/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ thab kyi nang gi dbus su sna tshogs padma'i lte bar ram̐ las bgras phreng re gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las zhiba'i me lha 'dzin byed sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'phro zhing 'du ba/ rwa skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon spyi blug 'dzin pa/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ smin ma dang ral pa'i thod dang sma ra 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa gsus khyim che zhing gzi brjid dang ldan pa/g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i thugs gar me gru gsum pa ram̐ gyis 71

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/mtshan pa/ drang srong gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ lag pa g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas mthe bong g.yab cing / oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung bo che/ / me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog / bsregs blug zhal zas bzhes slad du/ / 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod/ / gzi bajid chen po me yi lha/ / 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ / thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ / 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ / ṭakki hūṃ dza thab kyi kha khyer gyi ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/a mṛ tas sngags kyis bsang chu 'thor zhing phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badzra yi ku sha dza badzra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badzra sbo ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍi ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ ā trī pra wa ra sang ka ram̐ prokṣa rna pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes bsang gtor dang / prokṣa rna gyi gnas su añtsa ma rṇa/ a / mabye/rnams sbyar te chu bzhi phyag len ltar 'bul/ oṃ ag ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha sā hā/ de bzhin du/ byu pe/ ā lo ke/ gadhe/ nee wi bye/ shasta/ rnams sbyar bas mchod/ dril stabs dang bcas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mgon gyi sras/ / me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis dbang skur ba/ / shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg / 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ / me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa/ / rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ / nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ / bskal ba'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ / mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ / thabs kyis sprul 72

༄/ / 'phagasamachog 'jamadapalanag po labarten pa'isbyinasregapa'i theg pa bcibs/ / rigs sngags gsung zhing bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gruṇḍi bsnams/ / chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ / nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ / 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ / zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ / de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / zhes yongs rdzogs sam tshigs bcad dang po ci rigs kyis bstod/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā zu ta dzwa la dzwa lā yas rba bhasmi ku ru sarba dusgo hūṃ phaṭa tri bya dza ཿ baṃ ho sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa mā ya haṃ/ zhes dam tshig lan gsum brjod pas las bcol ba zhal gyis bzhes par bsam mo/ / me lha'i ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar po la re yig dang / dgang blugs kyi kha la dī yig 'od zer dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur/ 'dir dgang blugs kyi kha la skabs thob kyi lhag pa'i lha de'i sa bon byed pa 'thad pa yin te/ 'od snye las/ dgang gzar dang blug gzar gyi kha la rang gi lha'i sa bon yi ge gsum gyi spel ba'i 'od zer dang bcas pa dang / me lha'i zhal du re rnam par bkod la/ zhes dang / spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis de'i mchan 'grel du/ rang gi lha'i sa bon hūṃ dang a sogs oṃ ā ཿ gi yi ge gsum gyi spel ba'i 'od zer dang bcas pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na kha cig skyabs mgon mchogagi 'jam dkar gyi sbyin sreg tu a yig gsung ba yi ge ma dag par byed pa mi 'thad par mngon no/ / de nas/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas blug gzar gyi mar khus dgang gzar bkang ba bzung ste/ oṃ asga ye a di byā a di byā a bi sha a bi sha ma hā shrī ye ha byā ka byā ba ha nā ya/ bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang / nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shīrnyi ku ru swā hā/ 'di bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi dbang du byas shing /gang 'dod pa'i spel tshig spyor ba'i khyad par shes dgos so/ / lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya'i mjeb srin gyis yam shing gnyis gnyis rtse mo lha la bstan nas 'bul/yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing gi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ asde ye a di byā 73

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/nas ba ha nā ya/ oṃ bodhi brikṣa ya/ bdag cag gi nas bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang / khyad par du gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ mar khu/ oṃ asde ye zhes pa nas/ba ha nā ya/ oṃ asda ye/ bdag cag nas thams cad dang / khyad par du 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnye ku ru ye swā hā/til la/ oṃ asna ye zhes pa nas sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya/ bdag cag nas thams cad dang / khyad par du sdig sgrib thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ dur ba la/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe/ tshe la bar du gcod pa thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā/'bras la/ oṃ badzra puṣā ya/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ zho zan la/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ ku sha la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra yi/ grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad shīrnye ku ru ye swā hā/yungs gar la/ oṃ sarba atpa sid dha ye/ bgegs thams cad shirnye ku ru ye swā hā/so ba la/ oṃ badzra bi dzā ya/ nor dang 'bru rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnye ku ru ye swā hā/ nas la/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya/ myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ sran ma la/oṃ ma hā bā la ya/ stobs rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ gro la/ oṃ badzra ghasma rim nad thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ khyad par gyi rdzas la/oṃ asna ye zhes pa nas/ bdag cag nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ sngar bzhin zhal bsil dang bsang gtor dbul/ mar khu blug gzar gang thab tu phul nas/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐/ me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ thab kyi me sngar bzhin 74

༄/ /'phagasamachog 'jam dpalanag po la brten pa'isbyinasregabasang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las sna tshogs padma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ji yig mthing nag las ral gri 'bar ba ji0sa mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun 'jam dpal zhes pa nas/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/lha'i sku las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phro bar gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par 〉 thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs gar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i dī yig las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa ma dza ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / / bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ / dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i/ / bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / bcom ldan bskal ba grangs med du ma ru/ / 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs zhing / / smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ / khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na/ / de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ / rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ / yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ / 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ / 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / / nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / / mchog rnams legs par stsal tu gsol/ / bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ / bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ / bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / / 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ / bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ / nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ / ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ / de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /75

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgran me'igasung 'bum/dza nyu baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sti ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye mā nyu/ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ / bsang gtor ji snyed yod pa dang / / bdag gis phul ba'i bsang gtor 'di/ / bzhes nas bdag la dngos grub stsol/ / oṃ ā hrī pra wa ra sad ka ram̐ prokṣa rna pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas bsang gtor dang /de bzhin du bsang gtor gyi gnas su/ zhal bsil/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil rnams dang / prokṣa ṇi gyi gnas su/ añtsa ma ṇi/ a:/ 〉hūṃ rnams sbyar te chu bzhi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul lo/ / rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /me tog ji snyed yod pa dang / / bdag gis phul ba'i me tog 'di/ / bzhes nas bdag la dngos grub stsol/ / oṃ maci shrī ka la sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pa tītsā swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shasta'i bar sbyar la mchod/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ lha'i zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad gdangs pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ sngags kyi mjug tu/ oṃ asde ye swā hā/ bdag gi ting nge 'dzin zhe sa pa nas/ shīrnyi ku ru swā hā/ zhes mar khu dgang blugs bdun phul/ yi shing la rtsa sngags dang / yi bo dhi prikṣa ya/ bdag cag ces pa nas/ shārto ku ru ye swā hā/de bzhin du bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams la sngags dang spel tshig gong bzhin sbyar te gsum mam bdun nam nyer gcig sogs mang nyung rigs pas dpyad cing yi shing dang mar khu gtsobo yin pas gang mang dang / 'di rtsog grib sogs la ched du bsngags pas ku sha 76

༄/ / 'phagasamachog 'jamadapalanag po la brten pa'isbyinasregayang gtso bor byed cing / lhag chad kyi nyes pa sbyong ba dgos pa'i gtso bo yin pas kha skong la til gyi grangs gsog dgos/ de bzhin du khyad par gyi rdzas yang mang tsam dbul/rtsa sngags brjod cing / mar khu dgang blugs bdun dang / mchod yon/ bsang gtor/zhal bsil gsum sngar bzhin sngags rgyas dbul/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ / mgon po 'jam dbyangs sku la gsol/ / mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ / bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog / oṃ badzra was sru swā hā/ zhes pasagos zung dang / oṃ badzra ti bu la ye swā hā/ zhes pas so rtsi dbul/ nyer spyod rolamo dang bcas pas mchod/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ ā rtu 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ ā :/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ lha'i ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṭwāṃ angu nutpa〉 twa ta ba lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsumamam bdun gyis me nang du blugs gzar gyis phul/ gong gi bstod pa sho lo ka gsum gyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dbyings kyis bdag cag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ pha rol gyi byad ma rbad 'dre rbod gtong dang bcas pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa mtha' dag dang / sa bdag dang klu gnyan sogs mi dang mi ma yin pa'i nyer 'tshe nad rims gdon bgegs rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa/ grib dang mi gtsang ba la sogs pa thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ mdor na phyi nang gi mi mthun pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi zhing mthun rkyen legs tshogs thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ oṃ ā hrī pra 77

༄/ /gungajang bstan ba'i name'i gsung ཿma/wa ra sad ka re a pra tītsā swā hā/ zhes mchod yon phul/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ / nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ / gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ / mgon pos de kun bzod par gsol/ / zhes nongs pa bzod par gsol/ yig brgya bzlas te/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / rang gi yul du gshegs nas kyang / / slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ / badzra mu ma shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur/gsum pa mthar 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐/ zhes brjod de/ mar khu dgang blugs gsum phul bas/ thab kyi me de nyid slar yang me lha'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ oṃ a ye zhes pa nas/ ba ha nā ya pukhye pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shalta'i bar sbyar te mchod/ bsang gtor dang / zhal bsilakyang phul/ oṃ badzra ti bu la ye swā hā/ zhes bas so rtsi dang / sna tshogs dbang bo'i nas gos kyis brgyan par shog / oṃ badzra was sru swā hā/ zhes pas gos zung phul/ rdzas lhag me lha la sngar bzhin phul/ 'jig rten dbang phyugazhes sogs kyis bstod/ zhal bsil dang bsang gtor kyang phul/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyinang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā ཿ/ lan gsum/ oṃ asna ye sogs kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ / drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ / mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ / nad med tshe dang dbang phyug 78

༄/ /'bags chog 'jamadapalanag po la brten pa'isbyinasregadang / / dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / / longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / / zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ / las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ / dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ / dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ / dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / / gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ / rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ / bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ / 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / / 'bru rnams rgyas shing chos 'phel dang / / bde legs thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / oṃ ā hrī pra wā ra sad ka ram̐ a pra tī tstsha sā hā/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / / gang yang nus pa ma mchis pā/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ / de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ / oṃ badzra satā ā rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ / sgrub mdzad bsreg bya za ba gshegs/ / ji bzhin dus su slar byon zhing / / bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrub/ oṃ yā badzra mu me lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa/ bdag bskyed kyi mjug bsdu/ bsngo ba smon lam shis bajod sogs rgyas par bya/ me ma shi bar du 'jog long med na gzhi la thabs dang las kyi rjes mi mngon pa sogs phyag len ltar bya'o/ /smras pa/ snyan snyan tshig gi sbyor ba spel legs shing / / 'grig 'grig don gyi rim pa blos byas rnams/ / blo chung byis pa'i snying la dga' bskyed kyang / / gsang sngags zab mo'i chos la spang bya yin/ / de phyir dam pa'i man ngag ji lta bar/ / legs sbyar dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyi/ / mi bzad nyes pa'i rgud pa kun sel zhing / / ring min 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i gnas thob shog / ces 'jam dpal nag po la brten pa'i sbyinasreg gi cho ga nyes pa 79

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/kun sel zhesabyu ba 'di ni/ dge sbyor la gcig tu gzhol zhing / khyad par du lha mchog 'di'i bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa lhur byed pa dka' bcu nor bu rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes yig rnying dang / lha btsun rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgros sogs la gzhi byas te chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du sbyar ba 'dis kyang skye 'gro kun la phan thogs par gyur cig /rilhod lha mo'i sbyin sreg byed chul tho tsam du bkod pa bzhugs/na mo ratna tra yā ya/ 'dir grib dang mi gtsang ba la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad bsrung zhing / khyad par snyigs ma'i brlang spyod kyis ma mo 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs rimasand la sogs pa zhi bar byed pa la byin rlabs shin tu myur ba ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i bsnyen pa sngon du btang ste sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas thab thig sogs spyi ltar la/dbus su rdo rje ser po rtse lnga ba'i lte bar baṃ yig gis mtshan pa bri/ mchod gtor rdzas rnams dkyus dang 'dra/ a mṛ ta lan bdun gyis bsang chu sgrub/ mchod rdzas bsangs spyangs bya rgyud ltar byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ swā hā/ zhes sogs kyis rdzas kyi nyes pa sbyangs/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ zhes dpal 'bar sbar te las sngags kyis lan gsum bsangs/thab tu bcug ste badzra dzwa las gzi byin bskyed cing hūṃ zhes rlung g.yab g.yob/ ri khrod ma'isngags lan bdun brjod de mar khu blug gzar bdun gyis me gso/ ku sha byen rlabs tshigs bcad bkram tshul sogs spyi dang 'dra/ thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thre las thab khung me 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i dbus su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gye steng du re yig dmar po de las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las zhi ba'i me lha sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi ba/ ag tshom ser la 'khyil ba/ gsus pa che 80

༄/ / 'phags chog 'jamadapalanag po la brten pa'i sbyinasregal 'bar ba gzi brjid can/ phyag g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang bgrang 'phreng /g.yon gnyis skyabs sbyin dang gutwe bsnams pa/ thugs gar me gru gsum pa ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros shar lho nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la phyag rgya bca' zhing / oṃ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ / lha yi rgyal po drang srong mchog / bsreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du/ / 'bar ba'i nang du gshegs sugasol/ / oṃ e bye ti maska ye ma hā rā dza ga dza hūṃ/ 'byung ba chen po lha yi lha/ / lha rgyal drang srong bde ba'i mchog / bsreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du/ / 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ / oṃ badzra abyu sha dza oṃ badzra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badzra sgoṭa phaṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa ho zhes pas dgug gzhug bcings dbang dus/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ badzra asde sa pa ri wā ra prokṣa ḍi pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ zhes pas bsang gtor dang chu lhag ma gsum dbul/ puṣpe sogs sbyar te nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ces sogs kyis bstod pa dang / oṃ badzra ā na la zhes sogs kyis dam tshig bsgrags pa rnamasaspri dang 'dra/ me lha'i lngags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar po la re yig dang dgang blugasakyi kha la baṃ yig 'od zer dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur/ me lha'i sngags kyi mjug tu bsnyen pa'i kha skong yin na/ bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang / nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa dang / rim gro lta bur/bdag cag dpon slob sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par du gag lhog rgyu gzer yams nad rims nad thams cad shāsto ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa lta bu skabs su gang bab sbyar te lan bdun dbul/ rdzas lhag ma rnams kyang de'i rig pa sbyar 8/

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'izlaname'i ཿngababum/tespyi ltar bya la/ khyad par du ku sha yungs gar gro rnams gtso bor byas na legs sam snyam/ rdzas rnams grub nas chu gnyis dbul/ me lha'i thugs gar me gru gsum rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su baṃ las padma dang ri las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du paṃ yig gser gyi mdog can/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal gser gye mdog can/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la dmar zhing blum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen tu badzes pa la sbrul dkar pos dkris pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga ba/ gnyis pas dgra sta 'deb pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/ gsum pas mda' gsor zhing 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs gar mdzad pa/gnyis pas shing yo gsar ba'i sbrang g.yas g.yob ba/ gsum pas gzhu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas kyi rting bas 'og phyogs brten cing pus mo gdan du btsugs pa/ g.yon bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang shing lo gsar ba'i smad g.yogs can/ sbrul dkar po'i phreng bas se ral kha byas pa/ de'i thugs gar sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i steng du rje btsun ma nag mo/ mgrin par sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i steng du rje btsun ma dmar mo sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs surdzogs pa/ nag mo dang dmar mo gnyi ga'i phyag gi grangs dang phyag mtshan gtso bo ltar byed pa'am yang na phyag gnyis pa rtsa ba'i phyag mtshan gnyis 'dzin pa gang rung byed par gsung la/ 'gro mgon 'phags pas sngon mo phyag bzhi ba dang / dmar mo phyag gnyis par gsungs shing phyag mtshan yang cung mi 'dra/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sku 82

༄/ /'bagasamachog 'jamadapalanag po la brten pa'i sbyinasregalas 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phro bar gyur/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par yā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ma'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / / zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig dang / bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ / tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / / thugs kyi thugs dpag mdzad du gsol/ / bdag ni khyed la gus dang can/ / oṃ pasmo sha wa rī sa pa ri wā ra a pra tī tsās mchod yon dang / badzra yi ku sha dza zhes sogs kyis dgug gzhug dbang bskur mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang / / bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rikhrod lo ma gyon ma dang / / rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ / nad dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang / /dngos grub ma lus stsal tu gsol/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa sha wa dī sa pa ri wā ra a pra tī tsā sku dza me snya sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes sogs kyis chu bzhi nyeraspyod rol mo rnams dbul/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ oṃ pi shā tsi parṇa sha wa dī sarba dzwa ra pra sha ma ḍā ya swā hā/ zhes snying bo'am/ oṃ pi shā tsi parṇa sha wa rī hrī ha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes nye snying gang rung gis mar khu dgang blugs bdun dbul/ de rjes yam shing nas brtsams te rdzas rnams sngar bzhin dbul/ gtor ma bya rgyud ltar byin gyis brlabs te mtshan sngags la pa bla ta btags pas dbul/ slar dgang blugs lan gsum dang / mchod yon dang bsang gtor zhal bsil gsum phul/ oṃ badzra wa sa sru swā hās gos zung dang / oṃ badzra tasbu la ye sā hās so rtsi dbul/ nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas 83

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/mchod cing / bstod pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yis/ / cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba las byung ba'i/ / lha mo gang gis sgrub po'i nad gdon bgegs/ / kun nas zhi mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhing dang yul rnams kun tu rnam 'phrul zhing / / khyad par ri khrod gnas su rnam rol nas/ / sgrub pa po la dngos grub kun stsol ba/ / ri khrod dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sna tshogs zhal dang phyag zhabs sna tshogs dang / / sna tshogs mdog dang sna tshogs cha lugs dang / / sna tshogs rgyan dang sna tshogs phyag mtshan gyis/ / rnam par sgeg pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / khyad par gang gis 'dul ba'i dus mkhyen nas/ me tog 'bras bu du mas rnam spud pa'i/ / shing lo gsar ba'i na bzas rab bklubs pa/ / lo ma gyon ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gsung gi rig sngags zhi ba'i nga ro yis/ / 'gro ba'i rims dang sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing / / drag po'i gsang sngags 'brug ltar cher bsgrags pas/ / gdug pa 'joms mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nyid thugs zhi bas 'gro ba zhi mdzad cing / / brtse bas rjes chags dgos pa chen po yis/ / tshe dang dpal 'byor rnam thar rgyas mdzad ma/ / rnam grol yangs pa'i thugs mnga' khyod la 'dud/ / sgrub dang bzlas brjod brtson pas khyod kyi thugs/ / bskul bas bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ / bgegs dang nad sogs sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / / tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ / skye ba kun tu bdag gi mgon mdzad de/ / nyam nga'i 'jigs pa kun las skyob pa dang / / srid zhi'i bde dga' rgya mtshos rab 'byor cing / / rdzogs sangs yon tan rgya mtshor 'gyur bar mdzod/ / ces 'gro mgon 'phags pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'di nyid kyis bstod la/ mjug tu/bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la 84

༄/ / 'phagasamachog 'jam dpalanag po la brten pa'i sbyinasregasbyin sreg gi mchod pa phul ba'i mthu la brten nas bdag gis tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las nyon sdig sgrib thams cad byang 'ing dag ste tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig / khyad par du'ang bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la nad kyi rigs su gyur pa rlung dang / mkhris pa dang / bad kun dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa dang /gag lhog rgyu gzer yams dang rims nad thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig /gdon gyi rigs su gyur pa gdon stong phrag brgyad cu las thar bar mdzod cig / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/zhes me tog 'thor ba dang bcas lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i lha mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa dpag tu med pa spos te rang nyid dam bsgrub bya zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa la khrus byas pas sdig sgrib nad gdon sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dag nas lus shel ltar gyur par bsams/ bdag cag snyigs ma lnga'i dus kyi sems can du gyur pas yo byad ma tshogs pa dang / bdag cag las dang po bar gyur pas sems la dbang ma thob ste bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / cho ga nyams te chad lhag tu gyur pa thams cad la bzod pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / / gtan du gshegs pa ma lags pas/ / slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ / mu gatstsha/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs shing / dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam mo/ / slar me lha la nyer spyod rol mo/ bsang gtor zhal bsil rnams kyis mchod/ so rtsi dang gos zung phul/ gong bzhin bstod/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma sngar ltar du dbul/ gtor ma a kā ro'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs nas me lha'i sngags la ba 85

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/bla ta btags pa gsum mam bdun gyis phul la mchod/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ / zhes sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ / zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pa'i bar gyis 'azin las bcol/ / gang yang bdag blo sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ / sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs/ / ji bzhin dus su tshur spyon cing / / bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ oṃ badzra mu me lha ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsams la shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / ri khrod lha mo'i mthu stobs kyi/ / me dpung gzi byin 'bar ba yis/ / nyes pa'i tshang tshing kun bsregs te/ / phan bde'i dpal la rol gyur cig /ces ri khrod lha mo'i sbyin sreg byed tshul tho tsam du bkod pa 'di ni yor du su shog nasaltag bsam rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa sman pa dge slong brtson 'grus dpal ldan gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /chosacul gsang sgrub/na mo gu ru mdzi shrī badzra snyi ra wā ya/ 'dir chos rgyal gsang sgrub kyi sbyin sreg byed pa la rgyas pa yongs grags 'od snye'i dgongs pa ltar rung la/ bsdus pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha ma bskyed par yul de gcig pu la thab dang rdzas kyang gang 'byor gyis sbyin sreg 'bul tshul ma mgon sogs la me mchod ces gzhan du 'byung ba dang 'dra bar/ 'dir yang 'jam dbyangs chos skor las sa bon tsam gsungs pa gzhir byas cung zad kha bskangs te 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis 'god pa la/ stegs bu zla gam la thab kyang zla gam dmar po bcad kha rang la bstan pa'i dbus su padma 'dab 86

༄/ /'phagasamachog 'jam dpalanag po la brten pa'isnyinasregabargyad la nor bu'am yidamar po bris pa dang / ma 'byor na me slang ngam thab sogs su bud shing brtsegs te byas kyang rung ngo / / rdzas kyang mar khu yam shing so sor bya la/gzhan rnams so sor byed pa'am mnyam du bsres pa dang / rgyun 'khyer la rdzas rnams zhib btags ril bur byas na'ang rung ngo / / mchod gtor yo byad sogs legs par bsgrigs la yi dam gyi bdag skyed rgyas pa'am dkrong skyed sngon du btang / mchod pa dang rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs 'jigs byed ltar byin gyis brlabs/ de nas thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang gi thab dmar po zla gam gyi dbyibs can/mdun rang la bstan pa'i mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa 'od zer dmar po 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ asde ya dzwa la ri/ zhes me sbar/ thab kyi me'i klong du padma dang nyi ma'i steng du ma te dmar po'i gdan la yi dmar po las 'od 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dam can gshin rje'i rgyal po sku mdog dmar po ma he'i gdong ba can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang bsaganas pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du badzes pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i dprab par oṃ/ mgrin par ma thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas chos kyi rgyal po'i lha tshogs spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas gshin rje'i gshed rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sarba sirnyi a nas/ shasta pra tītstsha hūṃ swā hā/87

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i na me'i gsung 'bum/'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' sdod mchog / mi bsrun bstan pa'i dgra rnams tshar gcod cing / / sgrub pa po la dngos grub char 'bebs pa/ /chos rgyal yid bzhin nor bu la phyag 'tshal/ / lha'i lngags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dmar po la ram̐ yig dang / dgang blugs kyi kha la yi yig gis mtshan par gyur/oṃ ya ma rā dza sarba sirnyi hūṃ/ lan bdun gyi mthar/ oṃ asde ye swā hā/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor legs tshogs gang la dmigs pa thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru ho mas gzhan gang yod la rang rang gi sngags dang sbrags nas dbul/ bsres nas 'bul na de'i grangs kyi lha'i sngags brjod la de'i mjug tu rdzas sngags med par spel tshig gcig pubus pas 'thus/ gtor ma 'bul na nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas mchod/sngagasa'i i rda ba bla ta btags pa gsum mam bdun sogs kyis dbul/ mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ dam can gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis/ / sa gsum dregs ldan skye dgu ma lus pa/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan la gus pa dang / / rnal 'byor bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ / phyi nang bar chad bgegs rigs kun zhi zhing / / tshe dpal bsod nams 'khor 'bangs snyan grags dang / / bshad sgrub bstan pa'i bya ba ma lus pa/ / yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / ces 'phrin las bcol bas chos kyi rgyal po'i sku las 'od zer nyi 'od lta bu 'phros pas srid zhi'i dpal 'byor thams cad dbang du bsdus/ chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs thams cad rgyas paragyur/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / gang yang bdag blo zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ badzra mu ma shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig ba me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsams la shis pa brjodapas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed lha zhis sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /88

༄/ / 'phagasamachog 'jam dpalanag po la brten pa'isnyinasrega'ajigs byed dang chosaculasprags pa'i sbyin sreg bya tshul tho tsam bzhugs/'jigasabyed dang chos rgyal sprags pa'i sbyin sreg bya tshul ni/ me lha'i thugs gar me gru gsum rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ zhes pa nas/ yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag la cung zad dmar pa'i mdog can gyi steng du sna tshogs padma dang zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po/ zhes sogs/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar dang / dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs gar zla gdan la nas/ 'od zer lnga 'phros/ de'i g.yon du padma dang nyi ma dang dgra bgegs rnams kyi nas/ rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa nas/ 'khor bskyed 'dod na/ yab yum gnyis kyi 'khor du gshin rje ya ba ti nas/ mo rgyud kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/lha thams cad kyi sku las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phro bar gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mig gnyis su khro nas hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ oṃ hrī ha bho nas/ ku ru swā hā/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las zhes pa nas/ brten par bcas pa dang bka' sdod las kyi gshin rje yab yum mam/ yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad pa sogs dkyus ltar la/rtsa zhal gye dbu la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing / chos rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga bas dbu brgyan par gyur/kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ mchod phreng 'jigs byed la dkyus ltar/ chos rgyal la/ gshin rje rgyal po'am/ stong gsum khyon ltar ma lta bu dang / nang mchod/hrī khye sa 'jigs byed dang / ya matta gas chos rgyal 'khor bcas la 'bul ba'am/89

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/yang na/ hrī0khye dang / kā la rū pa tsa muṇḍi gsum gyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pa dang / ya ba ti la sogs pa'i gshin rje pho mo'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā ཿ/ zhes sbyar/ bstod pa/ gnyis med ma'i mjug tu phyi sgrub kyi bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs sbyar/ ljags byin rlabs sogs dkyus ltar dang /rdzas 'bul ba'i tshe/ hrī ṣṭha sa 'jigs byed dang / chos rgyal yab yum gnyis la rang sngags dang / chos rgyal gyi 'khor rnams la oṃ 〉 rtu gis 'bul bar gsungs so/ /chos rgyal rkyang ba'i sbyin sreg byed na/ me lha'i thugs gar me gru gsum rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su padma dang nyi ma dang / zhes sogs gong gi 'jigs skor rnams dor bas 'grub bo/ / zhes pa 'di'ang kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rgyun gye man ngag ltar bkod pa'o/ /bla ma gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'dir 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa dang chos rgyal gyi bsnyen pa btang ste/ de'i kha skong gi sbyin sreg sprags mar bya bar 'dod pas ngag 'don gye rim pa 'byin 'jug bya tshul tho tsam ni gzhan rnams dkyus ltar la/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig mthing ga 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de'i mdun du padma nyi ma ma te'i steng du ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa/de yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po/ zhes pa nas/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lha'i sku las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phro ba/ yab yum gnyi ga'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par 〉 thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/oṃ trī ha sto ma hā kro dha ā gatstsha nas rang bzhin gye gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor las kyi gshin rje yab yum dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ hrī ṣā sogs kyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ mugo rā dza nas/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa las kyi gshin rje'i dbu la rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod phreng gzhung ltar la/ maya mānta ka sa pa ri wā ra prokṣa rṇa zhes sogs spyor/ nang mchod kyi skabs/ mahrī khye90

༄/ / 'phagasamachog 'jamadapal nag po la brten pa'isbyinasreganas/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ kā la rū pa'i zhal du oṃ ā hūṃ/ tsa muṇḍi'i zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/bstod pa/ gnyis med thun mong nas/ 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'jam dpal bka' nyan bstan srung ni/ / zhes pa nas/ mgon po khyod la bdag bstod do/ / lha'i ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar po la re yig dang dgang blugs kyi kha la hūṃ yig 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur/ mar khu dang yam shing nas khyad par ba'i rdzas kyi bar 'dra/ oṃ trī khyi blu kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa oṃ bo rnyi dṛkka ye bdag cag dpon slob nas/ bkra mi shis pa dang ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing cho ga dang sngags kyi chad lhag gi nyes pa thams cad dang khyad par du gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnye ku ru ye swā hā/ mang nyung ji tsam 'bul ba skabs dang bstun la/ oṃ kā la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye bdag cag nas/ shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ oṃ tsa muṇḍi hūṃ phaṭa oṃ bo dhi dṛkṣa zhes sogs rang rang grangs ci tsam phul grub pa'i rjes su mar khu'ang de bzhin dang til nas khyad par ba'i bar 'dra/ gzhan thams cad gzhung bzhin la/ mchod bstod nang mchod gong dang 'dra/ /seng gdong ma'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg gi skabs/ me lha'i thugs gar me gru gsum rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su oṃ las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i zhes pa nas/ lha'i sku las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phro bar gyur nas mi skyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod sngags oṃ badzra rnga kyi ni sidha mu kha sa pa ri wā ra prokṣa ṇi nas/ shasta'i bar dang / nang mchod dbul/bstodapa ni/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ nas/ 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lha'i ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar po la ram̐ yig dang dgang blugs kyi kha la hūṃ yig sogs 'dra/ yi ge bcu bzhi ba'i sngags kyi mthar sngags dang spel
