tshig sbyor ba gzhan dang 'dra/ mchod bstod chu bzhi so rtsi sogs gzhung bzhin no/ /lha mo'i bsnyen pa byed tshe thun dang por 'jigs byed kye cho ga gtor 'bul dang bcas pa grub rjes/ nang mchod dang mchod pa byin rlabs/ de nas rten bskyed spyo ra9/

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/smo zhes pa nas/ spyan drangs/ spyo dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti/ sogs/rdor 'chang mtshan btags ma/ rgya gar yul bzhugs ma/ lha gtso ma gsum res mos byas kyang chog thun rjes ma gsum la skad cig dkrong skyed byas rjes/sbyo ragro sogs sngar bzhin/ thun tha ma la gtor ma med mi rung du 'bul dgos/bstod pa'i skabs/ sa bcu ma sogs gtso mo'i bstod pa gang rigs/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ma sogs 'khor gyi bstod pa man 'dra/bsnyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg gi skabs/ me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ thab kyi dbus su rlung nag 'tshub ma'i gur gyi nang du dre'u (drel)rkyang ser ga pa/ zhes pa nas/ g.yon thams cad thod pa gdug pa'i khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ lha'i sku las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phro ba/ gtso 'khor tha /sa cad kyi mig gnyis su khro zhes pa nas/ spyan drangs/ sbyo dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti/ sogs dang / spyo sngon gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ / zhes pa nas/ dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol/ / zhes pa'i 'phror/ bhyo ming brgya ma la mtshan stong ma/ nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed yum dang bcas pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ sbyo bdag gi dngos bshams yid kyis sprul ba las/ / zhes sogs chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon rnams gzhung bzhin dang / nang mchod sngags kyis dbul/bstod pa/ sku gsum lhun grub sho lo ka gcig pus kyang chog lha'i ljags rdo rje'irnam pa can dkar po la ram̐ yig dang dgang blugs kyi kha la byo yig 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur/ mar khu dang / yam shing nas/ khyad par ba'i rdzas kyi bar lha mo'i sngags la sngags dang spel tshig sbyar ba ma gtogs/ cho ga gzhan thams cad sbyin sreg gi gzhung spyi dang 'dra/ zhes pa 'di rnams shis tshang dge slong khya dge 'jam dbyangs bsod nams kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes a mchog dgon nas 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /92

༄/ / bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'isgonas bum chu sgrub tshul gye cho ga༄༅/ / bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgo nas bum chu sgrub tshul gyi cho ga gdung sel zla ba'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo gu ru nā ga rā jo shā rā ya/ gang gi thugs rje zla ba'i 'khri shing byin/ / rab rgyas ka tū ra yi 'dab 'phreng gis/ / lus can gdung ba bsil ba'i mchod sbyin mkhan/ / klu yi dbang phyug rgyal pos dge legs sgol/ / nges gsang rgyud sde'i dgongs don ba ku la/ / legs gsung bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis rab phye nas/ / stsol mdzad 'jigs med dbang po'i 'bas pad la/ / lus pas 'dud do byang chub bar du skyongs/ / bskyed bstem mchod bstod bzlas pa'i 'gros tsam la/ / chog bsgrigs mkhan por rlom min mdo dang sngags/ / drang nges de nyid rig pas legs bshad kyi/ /mchod yon sbreng ngo mkhas rnams dgyes par mdzod/ /de la 'dir bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgom sgrub nyams su len parasted pa la/ mngon rtogs rkyang ba dang / bum gter sgrub tshul sogs dang 'brel ba'i yi ge dam pa gong mas mdzad pa shin tu mang na'ang bum chu sgrub tshul 'di nyid gsal bar bshad pa nyung zhing / 'di la brten nas khrus dang bum chu'i rgyun sogs kyi sgo nas gzhan la phan pa'i 'phrin las kyi dgos pa che bar snang bas/ 'dir brgyud ldan dam pa'i man ngag bzhin du bum chu sgrub tshul gyi lhan thabs cung zad phye ste 'god pa la/thog mar bcom ldan 'das 'di nyid klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad sel ba'i 93

ra / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/skyabs mchog tu gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ spyir sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam pa nyid gsum gyi sgo nas mnyam par gsungs kyang / rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i smon lam mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa du ma 'byung zhing / lhag par yang mgon po 'di ni sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa na/ sku'i skye ba bzhes pa'i skabs shig gru brgya stong mang po rnams sdug bsngal las bskyabs par mdzad de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas gnas pa 'am yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyang rung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang gzhan dag tu'ang klu gang dang gang dag gis lce 'chabs pa'am/ gnod pa'i ser ba 'bebs par 'gyur ba'am/ 'jigs pa'am/ nad dam/ gnod pa'am/ nad 'go ba gtong ba der bdag gi ming bajod na gnod pa de dag med par gyur cigabaden pa'i tshig 'dis bde bar gyur cig ces smon lam gnang ba'i stobs kyis yin no/ / 'di la sbyor dngos rjes kyi rim pa gsum las/dang po ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su stegs bu ji ltar 'tsham pa'i khar 'bru dkar gyis padma 'dab brgyad bris pa la ku sha'i gdan dgram/ de'i steng du bum pa gas chag med pa mgul chings can chu mig gtsang ma lta bu nas blangs pa'i chu phud ma nyams pas sum gnyis gang ba'i nang du/ gser dngul mu tig byu ru mu men te rin po che lnga/nas 'bras gro sran til te 'bru lnga/ sle tres gaṇḍa ka ri dbang lag rgya mtsho'i spu ba shu dag ste sman lnga/ tsan dan dkar dmar dza ti ga bur gur gum ste dri lnga dang / sbrang gar zho 'o ma mar te phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga sbyar ba'i bya rgyud kyi bum rdzas nyer lnga btab/ 'o ma can gyi shing gis kha brgyan cing bum pa'i steng du dung chos dri bzang gis bkang ba'i khar gzungs rdor bzhag mdun du bcom ldan 'das la 'bul rgyu'i blum gtor gcig dang phyogs skyong la 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma gcig klu la 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma klu sman dang sbyar ba gcig ga'an yang bdag bskyed dang bum bskyed kyi lha la 'bul rgyu'i mchod pa chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pa tshar gnyis la sogs pa bshams/ mchod pa thams cad la sha chang sgog tsong sogs kyi dri tsam yang ma 'dres pa'i gtsang sbra thon pa shin tu gal 94

༄/ / bcom ldan 'das klu'idabang phyug rgyal po'isgo nas bum chu sgrub tshul gyi cho gache'o /dngosagazhi la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang /su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du hūṃ las rang nyid de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po sgu mdog nor bu rin po che mi dpog pa'i mdog lta bu/ zhal dkyil zla ba ltar dkar ba/ mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus spras pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ klu thams cad klu'i skye gnas las thar bar byed pa'i phyag rgya can/ ba'in 'dzum pa 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phro ba/ sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ga'i rgyab yol can/ de'i mdun du pad zla la sgrib sel sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas rin po che'i myu gu dang g.yon bum pa bsnams pa/ g.yas su pad zla la byams pa dmar ser/ g.yas klu shing gi me tog dang g.yon ril bu spyi blug bsnams pa/rgyab tu pad zla la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ser po/ g.yas ral gris mtshan pa'i utpal dang g.yon glegs bam bsnams pa/ g.yon du pad zla la spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ g.yas shel 'phreng dang g.yon pad dkar 'dzin pa/ bzhi ga'ang bcom ldan 'das la blta ba/ g.yas phyogs su byang sems dpag med/ g.yon phyogs su dgra bcom pa dpag med/ 'og phyogs su klu'i tshogs dpag med kyis rin po che thogs te thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la blta ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āthugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/dza : baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi las nyon dang sdug bsngal sbyangs/ khyad par klu rnams mkha' lding dang bye tshan sogs kyi gnod pa 95

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/dang klu'i skye gnas las thar bar byas/ de'i mthus klu'i gdon dang dug nad kyis zin pa'i sems can mtha' dag sdug bsngal de las rnam par grol te bde ba dang ldan par gyur bar bsam la/ tadu thā/ oṃ ta thā ga ta bha ga wa na nā ga rā dze shā ra a dhispyo na a dhispri te swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzlas la yi ge brgya bas lhag chad bskang / bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sbyi las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can ster bar nus pa phul du byung ba'i lha rdzas su gyur/ na mo ratna tra ya ya/ na ma tsarsha badzra pā ṇa ye/ mahā yakṣa si na pa ta ye/na mo badzra kro dha ya/ tadu thā/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/atshu te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a 〉 rtu/ nas shasta 〉 rtu/ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nā gend+ra rā dza sa pa ri wā ra a sogs kyis mchod/rgyas par byed na/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang sbyar te 'bul/gangagi mtshan tsam dran pas srid zhi yi/ / mi bzad sdug bsngal mtha' dag sel mdzad pa'i/ / klu yi dbang phyug rgyal bo gtso 'khor lngar/ / lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ de nas bum pa sgrub pa ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ bum pa stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las sbre las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar bo lto ba che ba/mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ tasnye taste mahā tasnye swā hā/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ bum pa phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la nang lha'i gzhal yas khangamatshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang gi 96

༄/ / bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang byug rgyal po'isgo nas bum chu sgrub tshul gyi cho gdabus su pad zla'i steng du hūṃ las de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po/zhesapa nas/ gnyis su med par gyur/ ces pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar la/ de nas bum lha'i mchod pa gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs te/ e ma ho chos kyi dbyings kyi rol ba las/ / 'ja' tshon ltar snang kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ / yid 'ong mchod yon bkod pa sna tshogs kyis/ / rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing khams kun bkang ste/ / bcom ldan klu yi dbang phyug rgyal po la/ / gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nā gend+ra rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arnya pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba la mchod yon gyi gnas su/zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/sgra snyan zhes dang / saṅgha gyi gnas su pātram̐/ buṣpe/ rtsu pe/ ā lo ke gadhe/ dzee wi rgya/ shasta rnams bcug la bya rgyud rang gzhung ltar gyi phyag rgya dang bcas te dbul/rgyal ba'i zhing khams bco brgyad 'das pa na/ / spang (sbrang) rtsi can zhes bya ba'i zhing gi gtso/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i gdung ba sel mdzad pa/ / klu yi dbangaphyug rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo/ / rtse na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa yi/ / brtan brjid baiḍūrya yi lhun po la/ / mtshams sprin gsar bas 'khyud 'dra mdzes pa'i sku/ / bcom ldan klu yi dbang bo la phyag 'tshal/ / gang gi mtshan tsam yid la byed pa yi/ nyin byed zer gyi snang ba phra mos kyang / / klu gnyan 'tshe ba'i mun pa mthar byed pa/ / bdag gi skyabs gcig bcom ldan khyod la bstod/ / gang gi sras kyi thu bo'i tshul 'dzin pa/ / sgrib sel byams mgon 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs/ / gzhan yang byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal dang / / gdangs can bdag po'i tshogs la'ang bstod par bgyi/ / bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ / bdag cag lus sems gdung ba kun zhi zhing / / 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs chos 97

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/'phel ba'i/ / bkra shis dge mtshan dngos grub kun stsol zhig / ces pas bstod/ bya rgyud kyi skabs 'dir lha skyed tshul 'di ltar dam ye so sor byed pa dang / de lta ma yin par gdan gsal btab nas lha rnams mgron gyi tshul du spyan drangs te gdan 'bul ba'i tshul mdo lugs dang phyogs mthun pa gnyis ka rung bar gsungs kyang /'dirayongs su grags pa'i 'jug pa bde ba dang / mthar dam tshig pa bum pa'i chu la bstem pa'i byin rlabs kyi khyad par yang yod pa'i gnad kyis snga ma'i dbang du byas so/ /de nas gzungs thag snying gar bzung la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta u dha ka ṭha hūṃ/dung chos kyi chu ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas pas rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kye rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'azeng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas bum pa'i lha'i thugs gar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/de'i thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ / sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang byin rlabasanus mthu ma lus pa 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs te bum pa'i lha'i thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu dang lhan cig tu bum pa'i chu la thim/ slar yang mdun gyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag med 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdugabasngal sbyangs/ khyad par du klu rnams mkha' lding dang bye tshan sogs kyi gnod pa dang klu'i skye gnas las thar bar byas/ de'i mthus klu'i gdon dang dug nad kyes zin pa'i sems can mtha' dag sdug bsngal de las rnam par grol te bde ba dang ldan par byas/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'od zer dang lhan cig tshur bsdus te bum pa'i chu la thim par gyur 98

༄/ / bcom ldan 'das klu'idabang phyug rgyal po'isgo nas bum chu sgrub tshul gyi cho gapar bsam/ dmigs bsal dge 'dun gyi sde lta bu'i rim gror dmigs pa yin na/nyon mongs pa'i sdug bsngal sbyangs zhes pa dang / khyad par zhes pa'i mtshams su dge 'dun gyi sde 'dir dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas skal ldan gyi gdul bya sogs mi nor zas gsum mkho dgu'i dpal 'byor thams cad dbang du 'du zhing / pha rol gyi bsam ngan sbyor tsub mtha' dag nye bar zhi zhing / mdo sngags bshad sgrubakyi bya ba rnams dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur ces pa 'jug /sbyin bdag gi ched yin na de'i mtshams su/ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i mi nor phyugs gsum gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi zhing / mthun rkyen tshe bsod stobs 'byor rigs rgyud mnga' thang rnams dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur/ zhes dang char chu sogs kyi ched yin na/ 'jig rten gyi khams spyi dang khyad par yul phyogs 'dir sad ser than pa sogs mi dang mi ma yin gyis bskyed pa'i bsam ngan spyor tsub thams cad myur du zhi nas/ char chu dus su 'bebs pas rtsi bcud dang lo tog la sogs pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas te skye 'gro kun gyi re ba tshim par byas/ zhes pa bcug pas mtshon skabs dang 'brel ba'i kha bsgyur tshul shes par bya/bzlas pa ci 'grub byas pa'i mthar yig brgyas brtan par bya/ de'ang klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs las/ zhag bdun du snying bo rgyun ma chad par bzlas na dbul ba thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar bdun phrag gcig tu sgrub rgyukhyang na shin tu legs pas nyin du mar sprel te byed na thun snga ma rnams la mtshams 'dir mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas nas 'od du mi byed par/ thun rjes ma la 'jug pa'i tshe sngar yod gsal 'debs pa'i tshul du/ stong ba'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa dkar po zhes pa nas pad zla'i steng du de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po zhes 'don par bsgyur/ dgung thun tha ma la gtor ma ngos can du 'bul dgos pas de'i tshul ni/ gtor ma rnams a mṛ tas bsangs su bhā was sbyang / stong 99

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/ba'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ ā ཿ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma dang po la dmigs te/ bum pa'i lha rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nā gersā rā dzas ba ri wā ra yi de ba lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis gtor ma dbul/ snying po tshar gcig dang hūṃ bdun brjod la dung chos kyi mchod yon bum nang du dbul/ a mṛ ta'i sngags brjod la me tog dkar po gsum bum par gzhug mtshan sngags la pukhye sogs btags pas mchod cing /gang gi mtshan tsam zhes sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas shing / mi nad phyugasand sogs klu dang sa bdag gi gnod 'tshe thams cad myur du zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ badzra 4 bum pa'i lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur bar bsam/ de'ang kun rig ṭīka chen las/ rnal 'byor rgyud man chad la bum lha mi bzhu bar bshad pa ni skabs gzhan la dgongs pa yin gyi gcig tu nges bzung min te/ kun snying gis kun rig dkyil mchog (chog) tu bum lha bzhu bar bshad cing / slob dpon byang chub snying bos 'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi dkyil chog las kyang gtso bo'i bum par skad cig gis lha tshang bar bskyed la dgug gzhug dang mchod bstod dang bzlas pa bya'o/ / zhes pa nas/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa bzhu bar bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / de nas gtor ma gnyis pa bsngo zhing /grol ba'i thun tha ma ma yin pa'i dgung thun gzhan la bum lha'i gtor ma phul zin pa'i rjes su mtshan sngags la a sogs btags pa'i mchod pa dang bstod pa mdor bsdus bya/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ / zhes pa 100

༄/ / bcom ldan 'das klu'idabang phyug rgyal po'isgonas bum chu sgrub tshul gyi cho gnas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pa'i bar cha gsum gyi gzhung ltar phyogasaskyong la bsngos/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka bā la sa pa ri wā ra a: pra tītstsha swāhā/gtsā/ phyogs skyong 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod/gtor ma gsum pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ klu'i rgyal po 'khor bcas dang / khyad par du bdag cag dpon slob sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod par byed pa'i klu'i rigs thams cad spyan drangs/badzra sa mā dza oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ / 'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ / padma padma chen po dang / / dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no/ / lha mo lha mo chen po dang / / zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ / dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang / / sog ma med dang hu lunta/ / dga' bo dngani nye dga' bo/ / rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / / tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang / / dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ / rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang / / gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang / / lto 'phye chen po tshi li dang / / tshi li chen po rnams dag ni/ / mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / oṃ ā gatstsha ā gasmo mahā nā ga a rnyi pa ta ye sarba zu ra zu ba phru phu swāhā/padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ oṃ mahā nā ga a rnyi pa ta ye grosde rda arnya / nas/ shasta'i bar gyes mchod/ oṃ hi li hi li mahā hi li phyo phu swāhā/ lan gsum dang / oṃ bhakhra ya bhakṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣṭha phye phu swāhā/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / / dge ba phun sum tshogs pa spyad/ / rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ / 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ / zhes brjod de chos kyi sbyin pa bya/ klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas kyis/ / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snomasal/ / zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces 'phrin las bcol/ yi nā ga a rnyi pa ta ye gatstsha/ klu rnams dgyes bzhin rang gnas su 10/

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gshegs par gyur/ ma rung ba'i klu lhag ma rnams tsham rngams kyis bskrad par bsam la/ oṃ ga ruṭa haṃ sa te tsa le tsa le swāhā/ zhes lan gcig dang / bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ / zhes sogs kyis bden stobs bajod/smon lam ni/ bcom ldan klu yi dbang phyug thugs rje'i mtshor/ / bsgom bsgrub bzlas pa'i gru gzings legs sbyar te/ / smon pa'i ba dan dkar pos bskyod pa yis/ / byin rlabs nor bu'i dga' ston thob par shog / rmongs dang sdang ba'i lce gnyis g.yo ba can/ / las kyis 'khon gyur gdug pa'i gdengs can rnams/ / bzod dka'i lus sems gdung ba rab zhi nas/ /byams ldan bde ba'i dga' ston myong bar shog / ston pa'i zhal mthong bstan la dga' ba'i klu/ / dga' bo nye dga' la sogs 'khor dang bcas/ / dpal 'byor rgyas shing chos kyi lam gnas te/ / 'jig rten mtha' dag chos bzhin skyong bar shog / de yi mthu las nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon/ / spyi dang khyad par yul phyogs 'di rnams su/ / sad ser than pa 'byung 'khrug nad yams sogs/ / zhi zhing chos 'byor dga' ston rgyas par shog / nam zhig 'di snang 'gags tshe mgon khyod kyi/ / zhing mchog sbrang rtsi can du padmo las/ / brdzus te skyes nas bcom ldan 'khor bcas kyi/ / zhal bzang mig gi bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog / de nas khyod gsungs bdud rtsi'i bcud myang ste/ / thun mong lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ / mtshan bcas mtshan med lam bzang rim bgrod de/ / ring bor mi thogs byang chub mchog thob shog / bdag ni mngon par sangs rgyas zhing der yang / / phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i rigs rnams mi 'byung zhing / / bdag gi ming tsam yid la byasapas kyang / / ma lus 'gro ba'i gdung ba sel gyur cig / yig brgyas lhag4da bskang / gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ / nyes byas cung zad 102

༄/ / bcom ldan 'das klu'idabang phyug rgyal po'i nas bum chu sgrub tshul gyi cho gagang bgyis pa/ / gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ / mgon khyod de kun bzod mdzad rigs/ / ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / / gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ / 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ / de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ / oṃ ya badzra mu bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo zhes sogs dkon mchog gsum gye shis brjod dang / klu rgyal dga' bo nye dga' bo/ / zhes sogs dang / 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs zhes sogs bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /smras pa/ bskul tshig nor rgyas kyis bzung ba/ / brtson pa'i ri bo mardo ras/ / rnam dpyod chu gter bsrubs pa las/ / legs bshad gsar ba'i zlab shar/ / mdo sngags nyi zla'i rna cha dang / / rig gnas rgyu skar do shal can/ / sngo bsangs bu mo'i 'gram pa la/ / gsar bshad dbang bo'i gzhu ris bzhin/ / rtog ge'i blos byas ma yin rgyud dang mthun/ / 'ol tshod rang bzo ma yin man ngag bcol/ / ha cang rgyas bsdus ma yin 'tsham pa yi/ /sgrub thabs 'di ko kun gyis dga' ston mdzod/ / 'dir 'bad las byung legs byas klung phran yang / / dus gsum skye 'phags dge ba'i gaṅgā dang / /gcig tu 'dres te nam yang mi zad pa/ / byang chub mchog gi rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni gso ba rig pa'i gnas la rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa dkon mchog bstan dar gyis gtsos brag lung ri khrod pa spyi tshogs nas bskul ba ltar/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dga' ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis kun nas 'khyil ba'i gling gi 'du khang chen mo'i yang rtser bris pa 'dis kyang skye 'gro la phan thogs par gyur cig /103

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i khrung 'bum/༄7/ / bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgo nas yul khrus bya tshul klu bsang bcas bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / thugs bskyed sprin gyi gdengs ka las/ / byin rlabs char gyi rgyun 'bebs pas/ / phan bde'i lo tog rgyas mdzad pa/ / klu yi dbang phyug rgyalapor 'dud/ / de yang klu dang sa bdag gi nyer 'tshe zhi ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgo nas yul khrus bya bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis thog mar bdag skyed dang / 'di'i sgo nas bum chu sgrub tshul gyi cho ga sogs logs su bkod yod pa bzhin tshad dang ldan par byas la/ gzhi bdag gtso che ba rnams kyi gnas ri sogs mthong ba'i phyogs su phyin pa'am/ yang na de dag gi ming dang dbyibs gzugs sogs ri mor bris pa me long la 'char du bcug de dag gi nam mkhar sprin gyi phung bo kha dog sna lnga ba 'khrigs pa las/ klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i thugs rje byin rlabs kyi ngo bo char gyi rgyun dpag tu med pa babs pas/ snod bcud mtha' dag gi nyer 'tshe'i rgud pa'i rigs ma lus pa lhag med du bkrus par bsams la/ thog mar bcom ldan 'das kyi gzungs lan mang du brjod/de nas/ bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i thugs rje'i mthu dang bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas/ yul phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag thams cad kyi lus sems la gnod pa'i phyi nang gi nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad shīrnyi ku ru yeswāhā/ sa gnyan brkos pa/ ri 104

༄/ /klu'idabang byug rgyal po'isgo nasayul khrusaco tshul/gnyan rlog pa/ shing gnyan bcad pa/ chu gnyan dkrugs pa sogs la brten nas byung ba'i gnod pa dang khon thams cad shīnta ku ru swā hā/ mdze grib yug grib dme grib ro grib sogs grib dang mi gtsang ba'i gnod pa thams cad ྾ / mdze dang phol mig dreg grum/ skya rbab/ gzhog skam/ zha 'theng / sha bkra sogs sha rus pags par gnas pa'i nad kyi rigs thams cad ྾ / bye tshan dang mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa drag sngags mnan gtad sogs kyis gdungs pa thams cad ྾ / yul lha rnams la gnod pa'i rkyen las byung ba'i mi phyugs kyi nad yams mtha' dag shīrnyi ྾ / sad ser than pa dus mayin pa'i rlung dang kha char sa g.yos sogs 'byung ba'i khams kyi gnod pa thams cadam / gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa dang / rgyal bo dang chom rkun gyi gnod pa sogs mi dang mi ma yin pa'i nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad ྾ / pha rol gyi byad kha phur kha dang mi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa thams cad sa mdor na phyi nang snod bcud mtha' dag gi nye bar 'tshe ba dang bkra mi shis pa'i rigs thams cad shīrnyi ku ru swāhā/ zhes khrus bya/ de nas snod gcig tu chu cung zad blugs la/ rma bya'i sgo'i chun po'i steng du zla ba rdo rje dang bcas pas mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ bkrus pas ma dag pa'i dri ma lhag ma rnams byabs te mdun gye chu la thim par bsams shing / shīrnyi ku ru zhes pa'i tshab tu/ a pa na ya zhes pa sbyor/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi nga / dge 'dun gyim / khyad par du bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i thugs rje bden pa'i stobs kyis yul phyogs 'di nyid la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad khrus chu 'dis tshim par byas te/ gnod pa dang gdug pa'i sems zhi zhing / phan pa dang zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas rang rang so so'i gnas su songs shig sum bha ni'i sngags brjod cing yungs dkar gyis brab ste 105

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/khrus chu rgyang ring du dor/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ zhes pa nas/bden pa rgyal gyur rdzun ma lags/ bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i tshig 'di dag gis sa phyogs yul khams dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu thams cad phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe'i g.yul las rgyal te/ mthu stobs gzi byin rgyas shing de'i stobs kyis mi nor longs spyod chos srid kyi dpal 'byor mtha' dag 'phel zhing rgyas nas bkra shis par gyur cig dza ya dza ya sirnyi sirnyi/ de nas gnas thams cad du rdo rje rgya gram gyi tshul du reg pa'i stangs ka dang bcas gzungs brjod cing / shīrnyi ku ru'i tshab tu/ rakṣa rakṣa zhes bajod pas/ yul phyogs mtha' dag srung ba rdo rje'i gur khang gi nang du tshud pa'i dmigs pa byed/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / / klu yi dbang phyug rgyal po'i mthu stobs kyis/ / yul phyogs 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gyi/ / 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig ces brjod cing / che ba'i che mchog ma sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni ming gan shog nas dad brtson ldan pa dge slong blo bzang lhun grub kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa dge legs 'phel/mtshan tsam dran pa'i ga bur gyis/ / klu gdon tsha ba'i gdung sel ba/ / klu dbang rgyal dang seng ge'i sgrar/ / btud nas klu bsang cho ga bri/ / de'ang thog mar klu sman sna tshogs/ dug rigs ma yin pa'i shing sna du ma/dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs bsang dang gtor ma'i rdzas gtsang zhing gya nom pa sha khrag dang gla rtsi sogs kyi dri mas ma sbags pa legs par bsham/ skyabs sems sngon du btang / rang nyid skad cig gis pad zla dang seng ge'i gdan gyi steng du 'phags mchog seng ge'i sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/g.yas pa pus mo'i steng du btsugs shing / g.yon pa gdan la brten pas sbrul 106

༄/ /klu'idabang phyug rgyalawa'isgo nasayul khrusabu tshul/gyisadakris pa'i tri shu la dang sman gyis bkang ba'i thod pas mtshan pa'i padma bsnams pa/ dka' thub kyi cha lugs can rgyal po rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las mchod gtor dang bsang rdzas rnams mchod yul spyi dang khyad par klu rigs 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ sarba bad pru ra snu ra/ su ra su ru/ ā warta ya ā warta ya/ ho badzra spa ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ subhā tha bi shurnyi dharmā te badzra sidhi hūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ arna sā dha ne swāhā/de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs rje dang chos kyi dbyings kyi bden pa'i stobs kyis klu rnams mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis tshim zhing dgyes nas sha 'khon gnod pa thams cad zhi ste byams pa'i sems kyis chos dang ldan pa'i 'phrin las tshul bzhin du sgrub par gyur cigabadag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ / zhes pa nas/ thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig / lhun po rol mtsho bdun dang bcas pa la/ / gnas bcas chu mi bdag po wa ru ṇa/ / dga' bo nye dga' klu chen brgyad la sogs/ / 'jig rten skyong ba'i klu rigs thams cad dang / / 'dzam gling gdengs can bdag po ma dros pa/ / bye brag bod khams 'dir gnas klu yi tshogs/ / khyad par bdag cag gnas kyi yul phyogs 'di'i/ / mtsho dang chu klung chu mig lteng ka dang / / ri brag ljon shing sogs la gnas pa yi/ /rigs bzhir gtogs pa'i klu gnyan ma lus pa/ / thogs med rdzu 'phrul 107

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlan me'i gsung 'bum/shugs kyis 'dir gshegs shig / dkar gsum mngar gsum bza' bca' btung ba dang / / rin chen rnam mang mkho dgu'i yo byad sogs/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin phung 'dis/ / klu rgyal 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed gyur cig / khyad par bzang bo'i sman sbyor brgya phrag dang / / dri zhim bsung shing sna tshogs dud pa'i sprin/ / 'chi med lam kun yongs su khyab pa 'dis/ / klu dang sa bdag gnyan po ma lus bsang / / rko rlog thab gzhob shing bcad chu bo dkrugs/ / mkhar las zhing sa mchor (mtshor) mal nyes pa dang / / gzhan gyi mnan gtad khram la btab pa sogs/ / gnod pa ci mchis bsang gis dag gyur cig / dme 'khon yug grib dmar dang ro grib kyis/ / bskyed pa'i don snod yan lag pags pa'i nad/ / gag lhog mdze dang phol mig dreg grum sogs/ / klu yi nad kun bsang gis dag gyur cig / sngon chad 'khrul ba'i nongs pa ci mchis pa/ / bsang mchod dam pa 'di yis byang gyur te/ / deng nas ko long phrag dog ma mdzad par/ / rnal 'byor yon mchod kun gyi grogs mdzod cig / mi dang phyugs kyi nad yams god kha chod/ / sad ser than pa 'gong bo'i gnod pa srungs/ / sngags nag gdug pas rbad pa'i gtad rgya khrol/ / mdor na phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun las srungs/ / nyes spyod lnga spong gtan gye khrims mnos te/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma'i spyan sngar khas blangs shing / / yi dam dkyil 'khor gnyan por dam bcas bzhin/ / chos ldan 'azin las sgrub la ma g.yel cig / mi phyugs zas nor g.yang gi mtsho bskyil te/ / bde skyid dga' ba'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i dbus/ / chos 'byor sbrang rtsis myos pa'i rkang drug pa/ / grags snyan gru dbyangs len pa'i bkra shis stsol/ / oṃ 6 klu rnams dgyes bzhin rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par 108

sa / / klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'isgo nasawal khrus bya tshul/bya'o/ / de nas gtor ma dang 'o ma'i phud sogs chu mig gam chu klung du dor bar bya zhing / seng ge'i sgra'i gzungs sgrog pa dang / klu rgyal dga' bo nye dga' bo/ /zhes pa nas/ gtan du bde ba thob par shog / ces sogs klu rnams dang rang gzhan la phan pa'i don du bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab bo/ /zhes klu bsang gtong tshul mdor bsdus 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dkon mchog snyan grags kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ /109

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / 'phags mchog seng ge'i sgra'i mngon rtogs bum sgrub dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang seng ge'i sgras/ / lag ldan gdug pa'i gdengs can tshogs/ / bcom nas lus can phan bde yi/ / gangs kyi ri bo skyong bar mdzod/ / 'phags mchog seng ge'i sgra'i sgo nas bum sgrub bya bar 'dod pas rten dang mchod gtor bshams/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bha was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las padma la gnas pa'i seng ge'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hrī yig dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun seng ge'i sgra sku mdog dkar bo/ zhal gcigaphyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga phral te pus mo g.yas pa dkrong nge ba'i steng nas kha spub pa'i phyag gi nang du gzigs shing / phyag g.yon pa gdan la brten pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi zhags mig nas padma'i spug ma skyes te gnyis su gyes pa'i ring ba'i ngos kyi padma'i steng du ral gri dang nye ba'i ngos kyi padma'i steng la me tog dri zhim pos bkang ba'i thod pa dkar pos mtshan pa bsnams pa/g.yas logs su zla gdan la btsugs pa'i tri shu la sbrul dkar po kha nas khrag 'dzags pas dkris pa/ ral ba'i cod pan dang ras skud dmar po'i tshangs skud dang / pus mo g.yon pa zla ba la cung zad ma 'byar ba'i bar nas bzung /g.yas pa dkrong nge ba'i ngos su dar dmar po'i skud pas pus dkris byas pa'i 110

༄/ /'phagasamachog seng ge'i sgra'imangonanogs bum sgrub/sne gnyis g.yas ngos nas 'phyang ba/ sku sha skem pa/ gzhon nu dka' thub pa'i cha lugs can/ rgyal po rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ thugs gar zla gdan la tī yig gis mtshan pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ dza : baṃ to gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa/ a mṛ tas bsang zhing bya rgyud ltar byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sidha nā da a pra tī smo ye swāhā/ zhes sogs kyis mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ / yon tan dam pa kun bsags pa/ / spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ / rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/thugs gar sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng gis mtshan par bsam nas/ oṃ ā ṣṭha sidha nā da hūṃ phaṭa/ ce4ci 'grub bzla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang /mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /bum pa chu gtsang gis sum gnyis bkang bar bya rgyud kyi bum rdzas btab la stegs la bkod de bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangab la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ taste taste ma hā taste swāhā/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi phyed par gyur/bum pa'i nang du padma la gnas pa'i seng ge'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/de'i steng du 6 yig dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/'dus yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun seng ge'i sgra sku mdog dkar po/ zhes pa nas/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyi bar gong bzhin la/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma dang gong gi 111

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/mchod sngags sprel nas mchod pa 'bul/ sangs rgyas kun gyis ma phyag 'tshal lo/ / sngon dus 'jam dpal mchod gyur tshe/ / thugs bskyed smon lam mdzad pa bzhin/ / nag phyogs klu rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ / seng ge'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gdug pa'i klu dang sa bdag gi / nyer 'tshe nad rims sad ser sogs/ / mi 'dod rgud pa kun zhi zhing / / chos 'byor bde skyid 'phel bar mdzod/ / ces gsol ba btab pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ klu dkar phyogs pa rnams kyi gzi byin lang tsho rgyas shing nag po'i phyogs kyi bsam spyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar byas/de'i mthus bdag cag dpon slob bam/ sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kye phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe klu dang sa bdag gi nad rims la sogs pa thams cad sangs kyis dag rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs mtha' dag bsdus te thim pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur bar bsam la sngags bzla zhing yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te mtshan sngags la pa ling ta btags pas dbul/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas te/ bum pa'i lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ bkru bya ba byed na sngags dang lha'i mtshan brje ba ma gtogs rnam 'joms bzhin byas pas 'thus/ mjug tu bsngo smon dang bkra shis kyis brgyan par bya'o/zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog sbyin pas bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dgon gsar dga' ldan rab rgyas gling du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /112

ga / /ye shes khyung khra'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/da bya/ / ye shes khyung khra'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa byin rlabs dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / 'byung lnga'i dug lnga dag pa'i kha dog lnga/ / rlung lnga rigs lngar 'char ba'i yi ge lnga/ / 'gro lnga sku lngar bsgyur ba'i ye shes lnga/ / lnga phrag lnga ldan lnga bdo'i mgon der 'dud/ / thabs shes gshog yangs rdo rje'i zlos gar gyes/ / gdon gsum mthar byed dpa' bo ga ru ṭa/ / bsnyen cing sgrub dang las spyor mdor bsdus bcas/ / dam pa'i man ngag ji ba'in 'dir 'god bya/ / de yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ mkha' lding rkang ba nas ni sked mthar ser po yin te de bzhin lte ba'i mtshams su gangs dang mtshungs/ / mgrin pa'i bar du dmar po'i mdog dang 'khri shing lta bu'i smin ma'i bar nyid sprin nag dang mtshungs so/ / de ni nges par sna tshogs mdog ste gdengs ga'i rigs dang ldan pa de nyid lnga yis rgyas btab pa/ phyag rgya de nyid bsgoms pas gdengs ga'i dug dang 'byung po'i nad la sogs pa nges par 'joms par byed/ / ces sogs kyis lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom bzlas phan yon dang bcas pa gsal bar bstan pa'i ye shes khyung khra sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis skyabs sems sngon du btang / swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi zla sgra gcan dang bcas pa'i steng du klu rgyal sog ma med pa gan rkyal du bsgyel ('gyel )ba'i gdan la rang sems yi ge khro ljang gu de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can rnams kyi brtan g.yo'i dug gi gnod pa sbyangs te dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus 113

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid ye shes kyi khyung khra bo mgrin pa nas pus mo'i bar mi'i rnam pa la rkang ba bya'i sder mo can/ zhabs gnyis tsog pu'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ brla man chad sa'i rang bzhin ser po gser btso ma lta bu/ lto ba chu'i rang bzhin gangs ri ltar dkar ba/ stod me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ mgo bo rlung gi rang bzhin sol mdog ltar shin tu gnag pa/gshog pa dang spyi bo nam mkha'i rang bzhin kha dog sna tshogs pa/ rwa gnyis kyi dbus na klu'i rgyal po las 'phrog pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bus brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas klu dkar phyogs la dga' ba rnams rjes su 'dzin cing / g.yon khro bo'i sdigs mdzub kyis nag phyogs la dga' ba rnams tshar gcod pa/ gnam lcags kyi mchu sder shin tu no zhing mi bzad pa'i ngar dang ldan pa/ phrag gong g.yas g.yon na nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba/ sku las sprul ba'i khyung du ma phyogs bcur spros pas sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad brgyal zhing sngangs par byed pa/ sprin sna tshogs kyi phung bo la rgyab brten pa/ de'i mgrin par padma 'dab ma bzhi ba'i dbus su sangs rgyas rigs kyi khyung dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ shar du rdo rje'i rigs kyi khyung sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ lhor rin po che'i rigs kyi khyung ser po g.yas rin po che/nub tu swa padma'i rigs kye khyung dmar po g.yas padma/ byang du las kyi rigs kyi khyung ljang gu g.yas ral gri 'dzin cing / g.yon thams cad rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i gdug pa'i sbrul du ma bzung nas khyur mid byed pa/thugs gar padma 'dab ma bzhi ba'i dbus su oṃ dkar po/ shar du ba sngon po/lhor khro ser po/ nub tu su dmar po/ byang du hā ljang gu/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dbang lha dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ dza : baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang lhas 114

༄/ /ye shes khyung khra'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/dbang bskur/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa amṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ oṃ ā :/ lan gsum/ oṃ badzra ga ru ṭa a pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du shasta'i bar gyis mchod/bstod pa ni/ dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas sgyu 'phrul gar/ / brtan g.yo'i biṣa ma lus 'joms mdzad cing / / sgrub pa po la mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / rdo rje mkha' lding dbang bor phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'am/ yang na/ 'byung ba lnga yi kha dog sna tshogs 'bar/ / nyon mongs dug lnga 'joms pa'i sgra chen sgrogs/ / ye shes lnga ldan mkha' lding dbang bo la/ / yan lag lngayis btud de phyag 'tshal lo/ / ye shes khyung lnga'i mchu sder 'jigs rung dang / / yi ge lnga yi 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ / 'byung ba lnga las gyur pa'i dug rnams dang / / klu rigs lnga yi dug rnams zhi bar mdzod/ / ces bstod/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ mgrin pa'i khyung lnga las rang 'dra kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa lta bu dpag tu med pa dang / snying ga'i yi ge lnga las 'od zer sna lnga'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i dug thams cad dang / klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bcom/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs nus pa thams cad bsdus te thim par bsams la/ oṃ pakhro swā hā/ zhes dpa' bo 'bru lnga'i bsnyen pa bya/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las rin po che'i sgod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā :/lanagasum/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangasate mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam/ mchod pas mchod/ lha'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ga 115

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/ru ṭa sa pa ri wā ra yi de ba bla ta pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ skabs 'dir gzhi bdag la gtor ma bsngo bar 'dod na/ a kā ros bsngo/rgyun du ngag 'don byas tshe gtor ma 'bul ba sogs ma byas na'ang chog mod kyi/ 'di ni bsnyen pa'i dbang du byas so/ /'di'i sgo nas khrus sogs byed na/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las baṃ las rin po che'i bum pa/ zhes pa nas/ dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ bum pa'i nang du pad nyi zla ba sgra gcan dang bcas pa'i steng du klu rgyal sog ma med pa gan rkyal du bsgyel ('gyel) ba'i gdan la yi ge khye ljang gu/ zhes pa nas/rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar rang sgra dor ba ma gtogs gong bzhin bya/ bum pa'i mchod pa byin gyis brlabs shing 'bul te bstod pas bstod/bum pa'i lha'i thugs ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod dang bcas pa la gnod pa'i brtan g.yo'i dug gi 'tshe ba thams cad dang / dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i klu rnams kyi gdung ba mtha' dag sbyangs/ nag po'i phyogs su gyur pa'i klu rigs thams cad tshar bcad/rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa bsdus te sngags phreng la thim/sku'i cha dang thugs ga'i sngags phreng las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la bzlas pa bya/ yig brgya bzlas te mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas la/ bum pa'i lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gye gnas su gshegs dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ gzhan la khrus byed na/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ / lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ / lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ / de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ / sngags lan bdun bzlas la/ bcom ldan 'das ye shes khyung khra'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs rje'i bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i nad thams cad shīrnyi ku 116

༄/ /ye shes khyung khra'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ ru swā hā/ rims thams cad shirnyim / gdon thams cad ma / bgegs thams cadamo / grib thams cadang / byad thams cad ma / bya ra thams cad nga /skal ba ngan pa thams cadamo / ltas ngan pa thams cad ma / rmi lam ngan pa thams cad mo / mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad nga / bkra mi shis pa thams cadam / brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dug thams cad ma / gdug pa'i sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad nga / ma rung ba'i klu gnyan gyi 'tshe ba thams cad ma /gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa thams cadam / mdor na lus ngag yid gsum la gnod pa'i phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad shārnyo ku ru swāhā/ zhes khrus byed/ yang sngags bzlas la shārnyo ku ru'i tshab tu/ a pa na ya swāhā/ zhes pa btagasal ku shas byabs/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gye bden pa dang / khyad par du bcom ldan 'das ye shes khyung khra'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis che ge mo la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad khrus chu 'dis tshim par gyis la/ gnod pa dang gdug pa'i sems zhi zhing / phan pa dang zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas rang rang so so'i gnas su songs shig susta ni'i sngags brjod cing khrus chu rgyang du dor/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ / zhes pa nas/ sirnyi sirnyi/ gong gi shārnyo ku ru'i tshab tu/ rakṣa rakṣa bcug pas srung ba bya/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / / rdo rje mkha' lding dbang po'i mthu stobs kyis/ / 'gro ba 'di kun bdag gis bsrungs zin gyi/ / 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cigaces brjod/yang gag lhog rma dang skrang ba sogs la sngags chu gdab dgos pa byung na/thog mar bum pa legs par bsgrubs te/ rang khyung du gsal ba'i sder mos brus/ lcags kyi mchus tog tog blangs nas zos par bsgoms la/ sngags 117

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/btab pas skrang ba sogs mar la chu skol btab pa bzhin bsams la/ nad dmigs gang yod sar mchil ma gdab cing / sngags chu 'thung du gzhugayang thog mar bsnyen pa 'bum phrag lnga la sogs pa sngon du btang ste/las sbyor gyi tshe rang gi lag pa'i mthil du bong nga bzhag la/ lag pa g.yas kyi mthe bong la oṃ/ mdzub mo la pa/ gung mo la khro/ srin mdzub la swā/ mthe'u chung la hā/ de rnams kha dog dkar po las bdud rtsi dkar po byung nas bong nga la thim pas/ bong nga bdud rtsir gyur par bsams shing / sngags stong la sogs pa bzlas te/ thog ma tsam nas rim gyis je cher btang ste rtag tu zos pas bcud len du 'gyur zhing / gzhan la byin na'ang grang ba dang / snying rlung dang / tshad pa la sogs pa'i nad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ / gzhan yang lhog pa/ sbrul/ sdig pa/ sre mong khyi spyon la sogs pa dug can rnams kyis so btab pa rnams kyang dug gi rigs yin te/ de rnams la yi ge bkod pa'i lag pas byabs pa dang / sngags bzlas pa'i mchil ma gdab pa dang /sngags chu blud na de dag gi dug nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ / yang bong nga cha gcig gu gul cha gnyis/ a ru gser mdog cha gsum rnams sbyar bas ril bu yungs 'bru tsam byas te/ gsum/ bdun/ bcu gcig rnams btang na gnyan tshad kyi nad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ / yang rang gi lag pa'i sor mo lnga la khyung lnga dang yi ge lnga bsams te/ rang ngam gzhan gyi na ba'i sar byabs nas khyung rnams kyis 'dre gdon thams cad zos(sos)/ sngags kyi nus pas nad la sogs pa bsregs/ yig 'bru rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas nad pa'i lus bkrus par bsams la sngags bzlas te sngags chu khong du btang bar bya'o/ / yang rang nyid khyung du gsal ba'i sor mo lnga khyung lngar bsams la/ zas gang yin der reg pas bdud rtsir gyur par mos na zas dug sogs su mi 'gyur pas phan yon shin tu che/ yang sman chen/ a ru 118

༄/ /ye shes khyung khra'i sgrub thabs las tshogasadang bcas pa/ra/ shu dag nag po/ ru rta/ gla rtsi dri thon tsam rnams zhib par btag la/dge slong ngam/ byis pa lo brgyad pa'am/ yang na gu gul gyi chus sbyar/'dam thags yun ring du byas pa'i ril bu gang 'grub byas te thod pa la sogs pa'i snod du bcug na bza' gsol te rang gi mdun du bzhag la/ rang dang sman rnams khro las khyung dam tshig par bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ snu dzas mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ sngags bzlas pa'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang /brtan g.yo'i bcud thams cad bsdus nas ye shes pa la thim par bsam mo/ / bzlas pa'i mthar khyung 'od du zhu nas ril bu la thim pas/ ril bu rnams nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsams/ de lta bu zhag bdun la sogs par bsgrubs nas/ ril bu ser bus ma khyer ba byas te/ nad gdon sogs gang la'ang phyogs med du btang bas spyi 'joms kyi gnyen po mchog tu 'gyur ro/ / ril bu'i spyor sde rgyas par byed na rgyal po khyung lnga/blon po gros byed lnga/ 'khor go cha lnga/ 'bangs mtshon thogs lnga rnams man ngag bzhin sbyar te/ na tshad dang bstun pa'i gtong tshul sogs gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /srung skud sogs 'dogs na/ srung skud kha dog sna lnga ba la mdud pa lnga byas/ nang du khyung rigs lnga gsal btab ste/ sngags bzlas nas byin pas phan no/ /yang ser ba bzlog na/ bdag skyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa gnad du 'gro nges byas te/ rang gi snying gnas khyung gi tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spros/ser ba gzhan du 'das shing / khyung rnams las me 'bar bas ser ba lhag med du chur zhu bar bsams nas phus btab pas phan no/ / 'di dag ni nye bar mkho ba'i man ngag lag tu blangs bde ba thor bu tsam bkod pa yin gyi/119

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i ryāng 'bum/lamaspyor rgyas pa bya khyi gnam gsum gyi bcos pa zhes/ bya mig tu grags pa sogs byis pa'i gdon bcos pa dang / khyi dug gis mtshon pa'i dug nad gso ba/ steng gdon srung ba gsum gyi lag len rgya che ba rnams ni sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal pas bsgrigs pa dang / de'i gsal byed pha la'i ming can gyesasbrar ba/ shar 'bun cu pa dpal ldan grags pas bkod pa sogs las shes par bya'o/ / sku mdog kyang sngon gyi yig rnying 'ga' zhig tu/ sum mdo dmar po/ lto ba dkar po/ snying ga ser por bshad pa dang / yang kha cig pus mo man chad ser po/ brla gnyis dkar po/ lte ba dmar por bshad la/la las mgrin pa rlung gi rang bzhin lngang gu/ spyi bo nam mkha'i rang bzhin sngon por bshad pa sogs mi 'dra ba mang du snang na yang / kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung nyid rgyud dang mthun par snang bas/ de nyid gzhir bzhag cing / las tshogs rnams ni yig rnying du ma las btus pa yin no/ /smras pa/ dkar po'i klu rnams skyob byed bsil ba'i gdugs/ / nag phyogs gdengs can gzhom pa rdo rje'i thog / ye shes lnga ldan mkha' lding dbang bo yi/ / bsnyen sgrub mdor bsdus brjod pa'i dge ba 'dis/ / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / brtan g.yo'i ngag gi gnod pa las grol te/ bde chen ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ / dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces ye shes khyung khra'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa byin rlabs dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di ni/ a ba ga ho shu'u nas dad brtson ldan pa dka' bcu dkon mchog bsam gtan gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ /120

༄/ /ye shes khyung khra'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/'jam dpalarwa ga rakka'i sgo nas bkru byabs srung gsum bya tshul bzhugs/'jam dpal rgyal ba'i ye shes chu gter las/ / snying rje'i na bun 'khrigs pa klu'i srin po/ / 'jigs pa'i sprin nag ig sha'i sgra brgya ba/ /byen rlabs gru char g.yo ba de yis skyongs/ / de yang 'jam dpal nā ga raka'i sgo nas bkru byabs bya bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis skyabs sems sngon du btang / subhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las sbrul mtha' yas pa'i tshogs las grub pa'i pho brang chen po rin po che sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa'i dbus su sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad gan rkyal du bsgyel ('gyel) ba'i gdan la pho yig nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rakka sku mdog ha la'i dug ltar gnag pa zhal dgu phyag bcu drug pa/rtsa zhal srin po'i gdong can shin tu khros pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i sbrul mgo dgu bar snang khams su 'phye ('phyo)ba/ sbrul mgo dbus ma'i spyi bor rin po che'i brog zhu'i nang du rgyal ba mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad kyis gri gug g.yon brgyad kyis sbrul zhags 'dzin pa'i dang po gnyis thugs gar 'dzings stabs su bsnol ba/sku stod srin po'i gzugs can/ sku rgyab ri rab la brten pa/ sku smad sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i gting du 'byil ba/ zhal thams cad nas yig sha'i sgra chen po sgrogs pas sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad brgyal zhing sngangs par byed pa/sbrul nag po stong gi ral ba bsigs pa la sdom dang sdig pa'i tsha tsha 'phro ba/ klu chen po brgyad kyis sku la brgyan pa/ klu rigs thams cad zas su za ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor 12/

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/oṃ/ mgrin par ma thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ de dang pho las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa dang dbang lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ jo rtu baṃ to gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ nā ga rakka sa pa ri wā ra a nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ mig sman lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ / gdengs can mthar byed drag sngags bzhad pa'i gsung / / mkhyen brtse'i gting mtha' dpag par dka' ba'i thugs/ / 'jam dpal klu yi srin po la phyag 'tshal/ / rang gi snying gar pi yig nag po'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer dang me'i tsha tsha drag po 'phros pas gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ phe li hūṃ/ zhes yig 'bru bzhi ba ci mang bzla zhing / nag po ti pa tsa nā ga rakka oṃ phi lam̐ hūṃ/ zhes drag sngags kyang cung zad bzla/mthar gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ de nas bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa/ zhes pa nas/ dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ bum pa'i nang du sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad bsgyel ('gyel) ba'i gdan la phi yig nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rakka/ zhes pa nas/ srin po la phyag 'tshal/ / zhes pa'i bar bdag skyed bzhin la/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs gar pho yig nag po'i mthar sngags phreng gsal btab ste bzlas pa bya ba sogs gong dang 'dra la/ mthar mchod bstod byas pa'i mjug tu/ bum pa'i lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang dbyer mi phyed par gyur par bsams/ khrus byab la bsgrub bya mdun du bzhag ste/ ji ltar bltams pa nas khrus bgyi'o/ /yig 'bru bzhi pa lan bdun bzlas la/ bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rakṣa'i thugs rje'i mthu dang bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs la brten nas rdo rje 122

༄/ /ye shes khyung khra'i sgrub thabs las tshogasadang bcas pa/slob ma 'di'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru swā hā/ dme grib yugs grib sogs grib dang mi gtsangaba'i gnod pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru swāhā/ steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa thams cad ྾ / bar gdon btsan dang rgyal po'i gnod pa thams cadam / 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad mo /gag lhog tshad rims sogs kyi nad thams cadang / pha rol gye byad kha phur kha thams cadang / rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa thams cad ma / bdud kyi zhags pa thams cadang / gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad ra / bkra mi shis pa thams cadam / mdor na lus ngag yid gsum la gnod pa'i phyi nang gi nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad shīrnyi ku ru swā hā/ de nas bum chu khar 'dzin du bcug ste/ sngags lanabadun brjod la/ shīrnyi ku ru'i tshab tu/ a pa na ye swā hā/ zhes pa sbyar te rma bya'isgos byabs/ kha nang gi chu snod du 'dor bcug la/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rakka'i thugs rje bden pa'i stobs kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad khrus chu 'dis tshim par gyis la/ gnod pa dang gdug pa'i sems zhi zhing / phan pa dang zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas rang rang so so'i gnas su songs shig sum bha ni'i sngags brjod cing / yungs gar gyis brab ste khrus chu rgyang ring du dor/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ / zhes pa nas/ bden pa rgyal gyur rdzun ma gyur/ / bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i tshig 'di dag gis rdo rje slob ma bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas bkra shis par gyur cig dza ya dza ya/ sirnyi sirnyi/ pha la pha la ho/ gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram gyi tshul du reg la/ shīrnye ku ru'i tshab tu/ rakṣa rakṣa zhes brjod/ rgyal 123

༄khya/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / / khro rgyal nā ga rakka'i mthu stobs kyis/ / slob ma 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gyi/ / 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig / ces brjod cing / che ba'i che mchog ma sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa rnam rgyal mkhas mchog gis bskul ngor/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / thutsā/ /124

༄/ / bcom ldan 'dasam 'od zer canasa'i bsnyen sgrub khasgong /༄༅/ / bcom ldan 'das ma 'od zer can ma'i bsnyen sgrub kha skong las chogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /sa / / dngos kun rnam par snang mdzad 'od brgya pa/ / mi bzad rims nad nyer 'tshe'i mun 'phrog cing / / chom po'i srin bya long bar sgrub byed pa'i/ / 'od zer can ma dad pa'i dbyings su rol/ / dmigs med thugs rje'i rol ba dus kyi khams/ / 'gog med zhi khro rab 'byams sprul pa'i gar/ / srid pa kun tu rtsen mdzad lhag pa'i lha/ / byin rlabs mi zad gter 'di bsgrub par 'os/ / de phyir byin rlabs dbang gi brgyud ldan zhing / / spyi dang bye brag gdams pa'i gnad mthong ste/ / nyung ngu'i tshig gis lha mchog sgrub pa'i thabs/ / tshang la ma nor dga' ston deng 'dir spro/ /de'ang rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i ye shes sgyu ma'i rol ba lha'i 'khor lo sna tshogs su shar ba las/ 'dir nad rims gdon bgegs sogs kyi nyer 'tshe thams cadadang / khyad par du dmag jag rkun po sogs kyi 'jigs pa mtha' dag sel ba la byinarlabs kyi tshan kha bla lhag tu che ba bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo 'od zer can ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su len par byed pa la/ 'di nyid rgyud sde gang gi khongs su gtogs pa ni/ spyir rdo rje dbyangs can ma lta bu dgra nag dang / khyung khra dus 'khor gyi rgyud nas phyung yang bya rgyud du gtogs pa sogs rgyud de dang de'i nang du yod pa tsam gyis der gtogs mi dgos pas/ 'di'ang rgyud gzhan gyi khongs nas bstan pa re gnyis tsam 'byung yang / 'di'i rtsa ba'i rtog pa sogs ni 'gro mgon 'phags pas rgyud sde'i ngos 'dzinagyi skabs bya rgyud la tshan gsum du phye nas rigs kyi lha mo'i grangs su gsungs/125

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/rgyud sde spyi rnam las 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum dang mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi pho nya mor gsungs pa der lha'i rnam pa dngos su ma bstan la/ jag chings byed lugs sogs 'di dang cha mtshungs pas phyogs gcig tu sdud dgos pa 'dra zhing / rdor phreng mi tra sogs su'ang 'di nyid bya ba'i rgyud du mdzad do/ / lha mchog 'di nyid la nang gses kyi sku'i rnam pa dang sgrub tshul tha dad pa mang du yod de/ 'od zer can gyi tog pa brgya phrag bdun pa las/ yang na bcom ldan 'das ma ni las kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i mdog yin te/ zhes sogs zhi rgyas dbang drag bskrad dgug dbye rengs sogs la las mthun gyi kha dog sna tshogs dang / phyag gnyis/ bzhi/ drug brgyad/ bcu/ bcu gnyis ma sogs gong 'og tu rigs sna tshogasapa zhig 'byung / de dag gi rjes su 'brang ste sgrub thabs brgya rgyam gnyis dang /pa tshab brgya rtsa rnams su rjes gnang mi 'dra ba'ang du ma mdzad do/ / 'on kyang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can ma'am/ mya ngan med pa la dga' ba'i 'od zer can ma ser mo phyag gnyis ma 'di ni dgra bo 'ching ba sogs la gtso bor bsngags te/ sgyu ma'i 'odazer can 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ de nas sbyor ba gzhan ni 'di yin te/ gser mdog can gyi phag pa bsgom la/ de'i steng du 'od zer can gos dkar po'i sham thabs can bsgom par bya'o/ / de'i spyi bor mchod rten dang / g.yon pa'i phyag gis mya ngan med pa'i yal ga me tog dang bcas pa'i phyag can no/ / 'jigs pa chen po'i dus su bdag nyid phag pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba bsgom par bya'o/ / snying gar chos gos kyi sne bzung ste lan bdun du bsngags la mdud pa byas na lam du rkun ma la sogs pas chom par mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes dang / rtog pa brgya phrag bdun pa las kyang / 'di ni spyor ba gzhan yin te/ / zhes sogs tshig zur tsam ma gtogs de bzhin du gsungs/'od zer can gyi gzungs gdon pa'i man ngag pa tshab kyi 'gyur las kyang / mya ngan med shing ljon pa yi/ / phyag g.yon yal ga'i rtse nas 'dzin/ / mchog sbyin phyag ni bsnams gyurapa/ / g.yas pa'i phyag ni bskyod par mdzad/ / ces mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can phyag gnyis ma 'di nyid gsungs te/ rje'i gsung dang 'gro mgon 'phags pa 126

༄/ / bcom ldan 'dasas 'odazer canama'i bsnyen sgrub kha skong /sogs kyang sbyin sreg las tshogs phal cher mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can ser mo phyag gnyis ma 'di la sbyar nas gsungs so/ / de ltar tshad mar gyur pa'i rgyud dang dgongs 'grel rnams kyi bzhed pa bzhin 'di'i man ngag 'god pa la/ sngon du bsnyen pa bya tshul/de'i kha skong gi sbyinasreg las spyor gyi rim pa dang gsum/dang po ni/ gnas yid du 'ong bar lha mo'i sku dang / gzungs chog la sogs pa'i rten dgram/ mchod gtor legs par bshams/ khrus dang gtsang sbra byas te stan bde ba la 'khod nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams sngon du btang / 'dir sngags sdom 'dzin pa rgyud sde'i skabs dang mi 'brel la/ yig cha snga ma 'ga' zhig tu bshad kyang khungs mi thub ste/ dper na gdugs dkar gyi dkyil chog rgya gzhung gnyis su sngags sdom 'dzin pa bshad kyang / rje yab sras kyi gsung las bkag pa bzhin no/ / de nas/ oṃ su bhā wa shu sarba dharmā su bhā wa shurnyo3rta/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdanas hūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rang bzhin can gyi byang chub chen po'i mchod rten mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su hūṃ las 'khor lo hūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'al gcig phyag gnyis/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad cing / rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mtshan dpes spras shing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyes klubs pa'i thugs gar rang gi sems nyid mi las mya ngan med pa'i shing mi gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las rang nyid lha mo 'od zer can ma sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga thugs gar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing / dar dkar po'i 127

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/stodagayogs can/ shin tu mdzes shing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i gser gyi shing rta la gnas pa'i pad zla'i steng du zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing / sku'i cha thams cad nas nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od zer lta bu phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kun tu khyab par sprob/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ma thugs gar hūṃ dang / de'i nang logs su mi yig ser po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ mi 'gyur chos dbyings rang bzhin pho brang nas/ / me longaye shes sgyu 'phrul gzugs kyi sku/ / mu mtha' yas pa'i 'phrin las 'od zer can/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i don phyir gshegs su gsol/ / oṃ mā rī byo sa mādza ma rtu baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs na'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/'di'i skor gyi rgya gzhung rnams su mchod pa ye shes pa gzhug pa'i sngon dang / rgyas gdab kye rjes su byed pa ci rigs yod kyang / 'phags pas ye shes pa gzhug pa'i sngon dang / mjug gi mchod bstod bzlas pa grub ste/ dam tshig pa las ye shes pa logs su phye nas 'bul bar gsungs pa/ bya rgyud spyi la srol de gtso che ba dang sgo bstun bar snang la/ yongs grags ltar 'jug pa bde ba'i ched skabs 'dir byas kyang 'gal ba med pas mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu 128

༄/ / bcom ldan 'dasas 'od zer canama'i bsnyen sgrub khaskong /ba las/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ oṃ a 〉 rtu nas/ shasta ā : gi bar gyes byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ mā rī byo sa pa ri wā ra a pra tītstsha swā hā/ mchod yon gye gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ sgra snyan rnams dang / a gyi gnas su/ pābye/pukhye/ ju pe/ ā lo ke/ gadhe/ nee blubya/ shasta rnams bcug la dbul/ gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang / / 'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob byed cing / / dri med bde chen nye bar stsol mdzad pa/ / lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ / phag bdun gyis drangs rin chen shing rta'i khrir/ / padma zla ba'i gdan la bder bzhugs shing / / zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser bzang mdog mtshungs pa/ / bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyagagayas gdul bya rnams la mchog stsol zhing / / g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin pa/ / sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan zhing dgyes dgur spyod/ /bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ / khyod kyi gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yis/ / rnam par brgyan pas chos tshul kun sgogs shing / /sngags tshul du mas dngos grub kun stsol ba/ / chos sngags yi ger 'phrul la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gdod nas rnam dag spros pa nyer zhi yang / / mkhyen dang brtse bas kun nas rab rtsen zhing / / gdul bya'i yid la sna tshogs kun 'jug pa'i/ / ye shes lnga yi thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bdag gis khyod sku dran zhing sngags bzlas te/ / rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs kyis/ / bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang / / srid zhi'i dngos grub ma lus stsal tu gsol/ / zhes pa'am/ yang na/ rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings nam mkha' la/ / lhun grub sku gsum dkyil 'khor rab rgyas 129

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronami'i gsung 'bum/shing / / gzhan phan 'azin las 'bum gyi 'od zer can/ / bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dmigs med thugs rje rta mchog bdun gyis drangs/ / gnyis med ye shes me shel khams las grub/ / mtha' yas gzugs sku'i snang ba'i 'od zer can/ / bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mdzad bzang gser gyi thur ma brgya phrag gis/ / skal ba ji bzhin lus can phan bde yi/ / 'dab stong cig car 'byed pa'i 'od zer can/ / bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / kun rmongs sdig pa'i 'bras bu nad rims sogs/ / cher snyigs thun gsum dus kyi nyer 'tshe'i rigs/ / ma lus drungs nas 'byin pa'i 'od zer can/ / bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / brlang spyod ri bo'i zom la gnas bcas shing / / gdug pa'i than skad sgrogs pa'i chom rkun gyi/ / srin bya'i dga' ba 'phrog pa'i 'od zer can/ / bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mtha' yas bstan dang 'gro ba'i nor 'dzin gyi/ / khor yug yangs pa'i khyon kun gcig car du/ / dge legs snang bas khyab byed 'od zer can/ / bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / khyod zhabs gus pas bsten cing gsol btab mthus/ / mi shis rgud pa'i mun pa nyer zhi zhing / / byin rlabs gser zhun 'od kyis 'khyud pa yis/ / don gnyis dge ba'i pad tshal rgyas gyur cig / ces pas bstod/ de nas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i mi yig gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus te thim par bsams la/ oṃ mā rī byo mi swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzlas/ rgyud las nyin mo nyi ma dang mtshan mo zla ba la 'god par gsungs pa las sbyor gyi tshe sngags 'khor las lha mo sprul pa'i gdan yin gyi/ sngags 'khor gyi gdan min te/ 'di ni rgyud las/ zla ba'i 130

༄/ / bcom ldan 'dasam 'od zer can ma'i bsnyen sgrub kha skong /dkyil 'khor dmigs byas la/ / de steng gnas pa'i sa bon 'di/ / zhes zla gdan du gsungs so/ / sngags kyang rje'i gsung gi mngon rtogs sogs su nye snying ma gtogs ma bkod pas de nyid gcig pu bzlas pas chog la/ ga'an rnams bzla 'dod tshe/ sa bon gyi mthar sngags 'phreng bzhi skor du gnas par mos te/ tarya thā/ rma ba tā kra ma si/ba ra kra ma si/ ud ya ma si/ ni ra ma si/ akka ma si/ makka ma si/ ur ma ma si/ can ma si/ gul ma ma si/ tsi ba ra ma si/ ma hā rtswa ba ra ma si anta ra dha na ma si swā hā/ zhes rtsa sngags dang / tadu thā/ oṃ bdā li/ ba tā li/ ba ra le/ bdā le/ ba ra ha mu khi/ sarba du / pra duṣṭha ṭwāṃ/ tsagrur mu khaṃ bhan dha bhan bha/ bhan dha/ mu khi/ dzambha ya/ stasta ya/ mo ha ya swā hā/ oṃ mā rī byo swāhā/ oṃ ba ra le/ bdā le/ batta le/ ba ra ha mu khi/ sarba duṣṭha nee/ phra du ṣṭha rna/ tsagrur mu khaṃ ban dha ban dha swāhā/ zhes snying po dang / na mo ratna tra yā ya/tadu thā/ oṃ ā lo/ ta lo ka sid tstsha lo ka sam ya mur dha ṭirakṣa rakṣa mi/bdag dang sems can thams cad la 'tshe ba dang 'jigs pa dang / nad thams cad las srungs shig swā hā/ zhes las sngags rnams bzlas te/ de nas gtso bor nye snying la 'bad/ bsnyen pa'i grangs 'bru 'bum dgos par 'di'i rgyud las gsungs shing / lhag par las spror byed pa la 'bum phrag bdun cu dgos par 'gro mgon 'phags pas gsungs so/ / de nas yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang la/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 〉 rtu 'od du zhu ba las zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ mā rī byo sa pa ri wā ra i dam pa liz-i zlo pa ya gro hā pa ya swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis gtor ma 131

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/dbul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas la/ oṃ badzra mu sa bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa dang gtor mgron rang gnas su gshegs/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ / bsnyen pa'i tshe bdag bskyed rkyang bas chog cing / bum pa'am tshom bu sogs sgrub gzhi la brten nas mdun skyed bya bar 'dod na bdag sgra dor te tshig phrad tsam bsgyur ba ma gtogs 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa sbyin sreg bya ba la/ thab kyi rgya dpangs kha khyer sogs kyi tshad dkyus dang 'dra/ kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba bya zhing / dbus su padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la rdo rje bri bar 'di'i rgyud las gsungs kyang / skabs 'dir mya ngan med pa'i shing bri bar 'phags pas gsungs pa ni rgyud don man ngag gis 'grel tshul zhig yin par mngon/rdzas dang yo byad bsham tshul sogs dkyus bzhin byas/ a mṛ ta lan bdun bzlas pas bsang chu sgrub/ mchod pa la zhal bsil dang bsang gtor de'i sngags gnyis bcas bsnan nas gong ltar byin gyes brlabs/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur las gung mo gnyis rtse sprad de bsreg rdzas rnams la bstan cing / oṃ swā hā/ oṃ ā sā hā/ oṃ shrī swā hā/ oṃ dzre swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ de dag las gzhan pa'i rdzas rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs nas bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ bajod bzhin pa'i ngang nas dpal 'bar lag pa g.yas pas blangs shing / g.yon pas bsangs te/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūṃ/zhes brjod pas bab nang du bcug la hūṃ zhes brjod de rlung yab kyis me sbar/ 'khyil ba'i sngags lan bdun brjod la mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis me gso/ de nas kha khyer la 'god rgyu'i ku sha blangs la/ badzra sa twa lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge / tshangs pa'i lha rnams dag byed cing / /dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa/ / sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying / / bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni/ / zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ / oṃ badzra sa twa a zhes brjod cing ku sha phyag len ltar dgram/ thal mo 132

༄/ / bcom ldan 'dasam 'od zer can ma'i bsnyen sgrub kha skong /sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gi bgegs thams cad zhib dang bkra shis par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas thab sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ dkar po zhu ba las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs blum pa/ rgyar khru gang ba/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ thab kyi nang gi dbus su sna tshogs padma'i lte bar re las bgrang phyed ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las zhi ba'i me lha 'dzin byed sku mdog dmar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing / ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ smin ma dang ral ba'i thod dang sma ra 'bar zhing 'khrig pa/ gsus khyim che zhing gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i thugs gar me gru gsum pa ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/rangagi thugs kha'i sa bon las spros pa'i khro bo 'dod rgyal gyes thar lho nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/de'ang 'gro mgon 'phags pas mdzad pa'i 'di'i sbyin sreg tu/ g.yas dbyu gu gsum pa dang g.yon bgrang phreng 'dzin par bshad/ 'od zer can 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ zla gdan la me lha dkar po phyag ba'i pa/ dbyu gu/ ril ba sbyi blugs/ phreng ba/mchog sbyin 'chang bar gsungs/ rtog pa brgya phrag bdun pa las/ nyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ phyag bzhis mchog sbyin dang ril ba/ padma'i phreng ba/ dbyug pa/ bgrang phreng rnams 'dzin par gsungs pa sogs mi 'dra ba mang yang / 'dir spyi 'gro dang bstun pa yin no/ / de nas spos 'dzin cing mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas mthe bong g.yab pa dang bcas te/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung bo che/ / me lha'i rgyal po drang 133

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/srong mchog / sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ / 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod/ / gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ / 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ / thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ / 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ / ṭakki hūṃ dza thab kyi me mtshams kyi kha khyer gyi ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ las sngags brjod cing bsang chu gtor nas phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ jo rtu baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ ā hrī pra wa ra sad ka re prokṣa ṇi pra tī tstsha swā hā/ zhes bsang gtor dang / prokṣa ṇi gyi gnas su/ añtsamani/ a / mabye rnams sbyar te chu bzhi phyag len ltar dbul/mam ye sa pa ri wār pukhre pratī smo swā hā/ de bzhin du/ ju pe/ ā lo kegadhe/ nee we te/ shasta rnams sbyar bas mchod/ dril stabs dang bcas/'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ / me lha'i rgyal bo ṭakkis dbang bskur ba/ / shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzinabyed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ / tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ / me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog / 'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/ / thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa/ / rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ / nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ / bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ / mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ / thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs/ / rig sngags gsung zhing bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan guṇḍi bsnams/ / chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ / nyes la'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ / 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ / zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ / de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / zhes yongs rdzogs sam/ tshigs bcad dang po gang rigs kyis bstod/oṃ badzra a na la ma hā thu ta dzwa la dzwa lā ya sarba bhasmi ku ru sarba du ṣān hūṃ phaṭa/ tri 134

༄/ / bcom ldan 'dasam 'od zer canama'i bsnyen sgrub kha skong /byo dza ( baṃ ho sa ma ya rta/ sa ma ya haṃ/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis dam tshig bsgrags/ me lha'i ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar po la ram̐ yig dang / dgang blugs kyi kha la rma yig 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur/byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung ste/ oṃ a ye ā di byā ā di byā ā bi sha ā bi sha ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba hā na ya/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong lta bu yin no/bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing lhag chad kyi nyes pa sogs sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shāsto ku ru le swā hā/ zhes pa dang /bar chad sogs zhi ba'i ched du yin na/ bdag cag gam sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi phyi nang gi nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad nad rims dgra rkun sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shāsto ku ru le swā hā/ zhes pa sbyararo/ / 'di la dpag ste las so so ba'i skabs kyi spel tshig sbyor tshul shes dgos/dgang blugasamar gyis bkang ba g.yas su bskor te lan gsum mam/ bdun gyis byon zan dbul zhing / dgang blugs kyi yu ba pus mo'i lha nga las ma 'das par bya'o/ / de nas lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya'i mtheb srin gyis yam shing gnyis gnyis rtse mo lha la bstan nas 'bul/ yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing gi rang bzhin du gyur/oṃ aska ye ā di byā ā di byā yā bi sha a bi sha ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā hā na ya/ oṃ bo rnyi bri kṣa ya/ bdag cag ces pa nas/ thams cad dang khyad par du gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad sharto ku ru le swā hā/mar khu la/ oṃ aska ye nas ba hā na ye'i mthar/ oṃ yasna ye/ bdag cag sogs kyi mthar/ 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shārnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ de bzhin du til la/ oṃ a ye nas oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye/bdag cag ces pa nas/ sdig sgrib thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ dur ba la/oṃ asna ye nasa.oṃ badzra a yu ṣe/ bdag cag ces pa nas tshe la bar du gcod pa 135

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ 'bras la/ oṃ asna ye nas oṃ badzra puṣā ya/bdag cag ces pa nas bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ zho zan la/ oṃ a ye nas oṃ sarba saṃ bā de/bdag cag ces pa nas bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ ku sha la/ oṃ as ye nas oṃ a pra ti ha da badzra ye/bdag cag ces pa nas grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye ye swā hā/yungs dkar la oṃ a ye nas oṃ sarba aṇa sirto ye/ bdag cag7ces pa nas bgegs thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ so ba la/ oṃ badzra bi dza ya/ bdag cag ces pa nas nor dang 'bru rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ nas la/ oṃ aska ye nas ma hā be ga ya/ bdag cag ces pa nas myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ sran ma la/ oṃ asna ye nas oṃ ma hā ba la ya/ bdag cag ces pa nas stobs rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ grol/ oṃ ag ye nas oṃ badzra gha sma ri/ bdag cag ces pa nas nad thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ khyad par gyi rdzas la/ oṃ asda ye nas ba hā na ya/ bdag cag ces pa nas mchog thun gyi dngos grub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīrnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ de ltar bsreg rdzas rnams phul nas/ zhal bsil dang bsang gtor sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul lo/ / mar khu blugs gzar gang thab tu phul/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐/me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis me la bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thab kyi dbus su pad zla'i gdan la sbyi las/ zhes pa nas/ rgyan gyis klubs pa'i thugs gar mi las mya ngan med pa'i shing / zhes sogs rang sgra dor ba ma gtogs bdag bskyed ltar dbang 136

༄/ / bcom ldan 'dasam 'od zer canama'ibasnyen sgrub kha skong /bskur rgyasagadab bar du bya/ dag cing dri med mas chu bzhi/ lha yi me tog ma sogs kyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams dbul/ gang gi mtshan tsam zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ lha'i lngags mi yig las skyes pa'i 'od kyi spu gu can du gyur/ oṃ mā rī byo mi swā hā/ bdag cag ces sogs spel tshig gong bzhin sbyar ba'i mar khu dgang blugs bdun dbul/ yam shing sogs la rang rang gi sngags dang spel tshig rnams gong gi me lha'i skabs bzhin sbyar te brgya dang khri 'bum la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa 'bul/rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas rang 'dras ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ bsgrub bya zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa la khrus byas pas sdig sgrib dang nad gdon la sogs pa bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sbyangs nas lus shel ltar dag par gyur/ ces brjod/oṃ mā rī rtsu mi swā hā/ zhes pas mar khu dgang blugs bdun phul/ mchod yon/bsang gtor/ zhal bsil rnams sngar gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul/ de nas dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ srab 'jam yangs pa lha yi gos/ / 'od zer can ma'i lha tshogs la/ / mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ / bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog / oṃ badzra wa sa sru swā hā/ 'es pas gos zung phul/ oṃ badzra te bu la ye swā hās so rtsi dbul/ de nas nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga la sogs pa sngags tsam mam tshigs bcad ci rigs kyis dbul/ de nas gtor ma bsangs sbyangs te/ stong pa'i dang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ ā : 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ ā ྅/ lan gsum brjod de byin gyis brlabs/ lha'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ mā rī rtsu sa pa ri wā ra i de ba lidṛzlo pa ya gro zlo pa ya swā hā/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ rang bzhin rnam dag ces sogs sam/ yig rnying gi bstod pas bstod/ oṃ ā hrī pra wā ra sad ka ram̐ atshu pra 137
