༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon phul/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ / nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ / gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ / 'phags mas de kun bzod par mdzod/ / ces bajod cing bzod par gsol nas 'dod don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma 'od zer can ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrinalas/ skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid pa dang / khyad par du bdag cag gam sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad nad gdon bgegs rigs/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba/ pha rol gye bsam spyor ngan pa dgra jag chom rkun sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ yig brgya bzlas te/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / rang gi gnas su gshegs nas kyang / / slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ / badzra yu ma shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs shing / dam tshig pa rang la dbyer medadu thim par gyur/ ces bajod/ de nas dzwa la'i sngags kyis thab tu mar khu dgang blugs gsum phul bas/ thab kyi me 'bar ba'i rnam pa de nyid slar yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ zhes brjod de/ thab kyi me lha la/oṃ asna ye/ zhesapa nas/ ba hā na ya buṣpe pra tī tstsha swā hā/ zhes pa nas/ shasta pra tītstsha swā hā'i bar dang / sngar bzhin bsang gtor dang zhal bsil dbul/ oṃ badzra ti bu la ye swā hā/ zhes pas so rtsi dang / sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing / / gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i/ / gos bzang rin chen 138

༄/ /bcom ldan 'dasam 'od zer canama'i bsnyen sgrub kha skong /bdag blo sbyangs phyir 'bul/ / bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog / oṃ badzra wa sa sru swā hā/ zhes pas gos zung phul/ de nas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams 'jig rten pa'i me lha la sngar bzhin 'bul/ de nas dril stabs dang bcas te/'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ / zhes sogs kyis bstod/zhal bsil dang / bsang gtor sngar bzhin 'bul/ gtor ma bsangs sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā (/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ a ye/zhes pa nas/ bā hā na ya a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā tram̐ adu nu tpardo twad oṃ ā (/gsum gyis 'bul/ me lha'i sngags kyi mthar puṣpe sogs btags la nyer spyod rol mo dngabacas pas mchod/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ / drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag / shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ / mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ / rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ / nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / / dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / / longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / / zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ / las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ / dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ / dngos grub kun gyi sdongs grogs mdzod/ / dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / / gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi bar mdzod/ / mi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ / bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ / 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / / 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / / bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang / / yid la 'dod pakun 'grub shog / oṃ yā tī bra wā ra sad ka re a pra tītsā swā hā/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / / gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ / 'dir ni 139

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/bya ba gang bgyis pa/ / de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ / me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed kyis phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ zhes sogs sngar ltar gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badzra sa twa a oṃ rang gi don dang gzhan gye don/ /sgrub mdzad bsreg bya za ba gshegs/ / ji bzhin dus su slar spyon ('byon)zhing / / bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrub/ / oṃ ya badzra mu me lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ / dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ de nas bsngo ba shis brjod sogs rgyas par bya'o/ / me ma shi bar du 'jog pa'i long med na gzhil ba'i thabs dang / las kyis rjes mi mngon par bya ba sogs slob dpon mkhas pa'i phyag len ltar nyams su blang ngo / /gsum pa las sbyor ni/ sbyin sreg la yang rdzas kyi bye brag gis nad sel ba/ rgyal po dang gnod sbyin mo sogs dbang du byed pa/ dug nad sel ba/ dgra bo 'chi ba sogs dang / rdzas sogs so so la brten nas char 'bebs pa/ bsad bskrad dbye rengs kyi las tshogs du ma dang / 'khor lo'i sgo nas dgra'i dpung las rgyal bar byed pa dang / mtshon bsrung ba sogs las rab 'byams shig rgyud sde nas gsungs kyang / da lta phyag len rim par brgyud pa'i myong khrid dang yig cha sogs mi snang bas bri bar ma spobs kyang / thog mar dbang dang rjes gnang thob/ bsnyen pa tshad du 'khyol na las sbyor rgyud kyi dngos zin tsam dang bstun te byas kyang phan yon 'byung bar gdon mi za'o/ / chom rkun bsrung ba 'di'i sgos chos gtso bor brgya rgyam sogs kyi rgya gzhung dang / rje'i gsung du'ang 'byung bas/ de'i tshul ni thog mar skyabs se ma nas bzung dbang bskur rgyas gdab mchod bstod dang bcas pa'i bar bdag bskyed bye gzhung bzhin byas la/ bstod pa'i mjug tu/ bdag dang bdag gi gnyen bshes kun/ / lam dang de bzhin lam log dang / / skye bo'i 'jigs dang rgyal rigs kyi/ / 'jigs pa kun las bskyab tu gsol/ / de bzhin glang chen chom rkun dang / / seng ge stag dang me dang chu/ / sbrul dang dug dang phyir rgol dang / / dgra yi 'jigs pa 140

༄/ / bcom ldan 'dasas 'od zer canasa'i bsnyen sgrub kha skong /kun las skyob/ / bdag ni gnas skabs thams cad du/ / ji lta'i tshul gyis gnas kyang rung / / gdon rims 'khrugs pa thams cad las/ / kun nas yongs su bsrung du gsol/ / zhes 'dod don la gsol ba 'debs/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa snga ma'i mjug tu/ slar yang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i sne mor snang byed kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i lha mo 'od zer can zhal gcig phyag gnyis khab skud thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ gnod byed kyi kha mig thams cad btsem/ lus rengs shing dran pa nyams par byas te 'od kyi dra bas bcings par gyur bar bsams la/ sngags bzla/snang byed kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ nyin dus yin na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang /mtshan dus zla dkyil du gsal 'debs par gsungs so/ / phyogs su 'gro ba'i nangs dus nyi ma shar ba na lha mo 'od zer can byon byung snyam pa byas la/ shar ro shar ro dpal shar ro/ / lha shar ro/ / dpal gyi 'od zer shar ro/ / lha mo 'od zer can ma shar ro/ / bdag de ring gi dus su dgra jag chom rkun gcan gzan 'byung ba sogs kyi 'jigs pa las srungs shig / ci 'dod pa'i don thams cad 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol cig / ces brjod la sngags nyer gcig bzla/ lam du'ang sngags bgrang bzhin par song na bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur bar gsungs/ yang bdag skyed dkyus ltar byas la chom rkun rnams kyi dbang po dang yan lag thams cad bcings par mos te gos kyi sne mo mdud pa byas pa la bar bar du sngags 'deb cing song ste gnas su phyin pa na bcings pa las grol ba'i dmigs pa byas te mdud pa bshig par gsungs/ gzhan la srung ba byed na'ang / dmigs pa de nyid kyis skud pa la mdud pa bdun byas te sngags btab nas sbyin par bshad/ rims nad bsrung ba la/ gdan gyi phag rnams drag tu gzir bas/ de dag las rang 'dra dpag tu med pa spros/ nad bdag rnams kyi sha khrag zos shing rus pa mur te/ lhag ma rnams rmig pas badzis nas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug par brdas pa'i dmigs pa bya/141

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/yang 'od zer can ma mdun du skad cig gis byon par bsam la/ gang gi mtshan tsam/zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstod/ de'i zhabs la 'jus te thugs rje bskul ba'i mos gus dang bcas te 'od zer can gyi gzungs chog tshar gsum bklags te phyogs gang du song yang nyer 'tshe'i rigs kyis mi tshugs par gsungs so/ /smras pa/ ris med 'jig rten khyon la srid zhi yi/ / gdung sel bsil ba'i grib ma rtag 'bab cing / / 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin dus las mi yol ba/ / sngon med yongs 'du'i dbang ba bcom ldan ma'i/ / bsnyen sgrub rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang mchog / kha skong byed pa'i kha pad mngon mtho zhing / / las tshogs gser sbyangs las grub rgyal mtshan gyis/ / rab mdzes skal bzang lha brgya'i 'jug ngogs 'di/ / bskrun pa las 'ongs rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ / nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs 'gro ba kun/ / mi bzad rgud pa'i chu bo las bsgral te/ / dngos grub nor bu'i gling du phyin gyur cig / ces bcom ldan 'das ma 'od zer can ma'i bsnyen sgrub kha skong las tshogs dang bcas pa 'di ni/ dad brtson mchog tu dge zhing lha mchog 'di la lhag par mos pa kha kya'i rab 'byams pa ngag dbang chos 'dzin gyis bskul ba'i ngor 'di'i dbang rdor phreng du bzhugs pa dang / brgya rgyam gyi rjes gnang sogs smin byed rnams legs par thob pa'i/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'di nyid kyi rgyud dang /'phags bod kyi gzhung rnams la zhib par dpyad de bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni blo dang ldan pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /142

༄/ / smanakyin rlabasaphya tshul bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/༄7/ / sman byin rlabs bya tshul bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / bdud rtsi'i zer gyi snang ba 'bum 'gyed pas/ / las nyon sdug bsngal tsha gdung 'phrog byed cing / / phan bde'i ku mud rgyas mdzad bla ma dang / / dbyer med sman gyi bla la phyag bgyis te/ / bzang po'i sman spyor bde 'byung ral ba'i bcud/ / mchog gsum byin rlabs dza hū'i zhal sgo las/ / nye bar drangs te lus can bro nad kyi/ / dri ma 'khrud pa'i cho ga deng 'dir spel/ / de'ang sman byin rlabs ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ bshad rgyud kyi le'u so gcig pa gso ba po sman pa'i le'ur rgyu dang ngo bo sogs don tshan drug dang rgyu la'ang nang gses kyi khyad par drug tu byas pa'i gsum pa dam tshig dang ldan pa'i don la blo bzhag drug bzung bya gnyis/ shes bya gsum zhes 'byung ba'i phyi ma gsum gyis sman byin rlabs byed tshul gsungs pa yin te/ rgyud las/ gsum pa sman rnams nor bu bdud rtsi dang / / mchod rdzas shes par bya ba gsum yin te/ / zhes sman nor bur shes par bya ba/ sman bdud rtsir shes par bya ba/ sman mchod rdzas su shes par bya ba gsum du byas nasagasungs so/ / de gsum gyi nang nas kyang byin rlabs dngos gzhi ni sman bdud rtsir shes par bya ba de yin kyang bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho ga tsam gyis go mi chod par sman sbyor cha tshang ba nan tan chen pos rtsol sgrub kyis gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin 'dzom nges su bya dgos pas/ dang por sman nor bur shes par bya ba 'dis sbyor ba bstan pa yin te/ dang po rin po che de btsal la bcangs/ / zhes rgya mtsho nas nor bu len pa'i tshe rgyu dang tshegs la mi blta bar brtson pa bzhin sman sde tshan thams cad tshang 143

༄/ /gung tha bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/nges su btsal ba gal che yi/ rin thang gang chung ba'i sman sna kha shas re tsam btsal nas tsha bsil phyogs phyed tsam gyi sbyor ba byed pa ni rang gzhan gnyi ga sru byed yin pas/sman mtha' dag ro nus zhu rjes kyi khyad par/ byang zur gyi lugs so so'i ngos 'dzin ma 'dres pa rnams slob dpon mkhas pa'i ngag rgyun/ sman gyi 'dra dpe khyad par mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len la brten nas som nyi'i dra ba chod nges su gtan la dbab/ sngo sman rnams kyang skye gnas ma yin pa dang / dus las yol ba/ rlan dang nyi lhags kyis gdungs pas rtswa skya lta bur gyur pa ni sman de'i rdzas tsam yin kyang nus pa ci yang med pas/ gzhung nas bshad pa ltar gyi rang rang gi skye gnas dang / rtsa ba dang me tog 'bras bu sogs gang dgos kyi dus tshod ma 'dzol ba/ sngo chol dang grib skam sogs lag len du thebs nges pa dgos pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar gces spras su bya bar gsungs pa yin no/ /dngosagazhi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das sman bla'i sku sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel sogs rten 'gangs che ba rnams legs par bkram pa'i mdun du mchod pa gtsang ma bsham/ stegs bu mthon po rten khebs kyis g.yogs par 'bru dkar la lhung bzed dam rin po che sogs kyi snod gtsang mar dman lhag log pa'i skyon dang bral bar tshul bzhin du sbyar ba'i sman rnams bzhag skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla beeḍūrya'i 'od kyi rgyal po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba 'dzin zhing / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā byugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la sangs rgyas dang byang chub 144

༄/ / smanagyinaphobs tshul bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/semasadapa' sde bzhi'i drang srong rig pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / bka' srung gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon zhing blon 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ sman rnamasabyin gyis rlobs pa'i phyir mchod pa'i gnas su dgyes bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ mchod pa a sbo tas bsangs/ mchod pa rnams phul du byung ba'i lha rdzas su gyur/ yi 〉 rtu/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ gang la brten na srid zhi'i gdung sel ba/ / bcom ldan 'das sman pa'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la/ / lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon 'di 'bul bas/ / stod kyi nad rigs dag pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arnyi pra tītstsha swā hā/ gang la brtenan nas/ zhabs bsil 'di 'bul bas/ / smad kyi nad rigs dag pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod/ / pābye sogs/ gang la brten na nas/ me tog 'di 'bul bas/ / mgo dang yan lag nad sel mchog sbyin mdzod/ / puspe sogs/ gang lo nas/ bdug spos 'di 'bul bas/ / sna dang 'tsher ba'i nad sel mchog sbyin mdzod/ / hū paṃ sogs/ gang la nas snang gsal 'di 'bul bas/ / ming dang mchin pa'i nad sel mchog sbyin mdzod/ / a lo ke sogs/ gang la nas/ dri chab 'di 'bul bas/ / snying dang yid kyi nad sel mchog sbyin mdzod/ / gasnya sogs/ gang la nas/ zhal zas 'di 'bul bas/ / lce dang lho (glo) ba'i nad sel mchog sbyin mdzod/ / nee blu tya sogs/gangal nas/ sgra snyan 'di 'bul bas/ / skad dang mkha' (mkhal) ma rna ba'i nad sel mdzod/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta thāsta pratī tstsha swā hā/ 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das/ / dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ / sku mdog mthing ga baiḍūrya yi 'od/ / sprul ba'i sku la mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ / rlung mkhris bad gan nad kyis gdungs pa la/ / nad kyi gnyen po phyag g.yas las ru ra/ / phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed par bu 145

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/bsnams/ / baiḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rig pa'i gnas mchog bco brgyad thugs su bcud/ / tshe la dbang ba'i bcud len dngos grub brnyes/ / mngon shes snying rjes 'gro mchog 'du ba snyoms/ / drang srong rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sngon tshe ston pa'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes bzhin/ / 'tsho byed rnams kyi mgon dang grogs mdzad cing / / nad rims gdon bgegs nyer 'tshe kun sel ba/ / sman gyi bka' srung rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rlung mkhris bad gan bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ / tshe la bar du gcod pa zhi ba dang / / gnod pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang / / ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa/ / bsam pa'i bar du gcod pa zhi bar mdzod/ / ces gsol ba btab bas skyabs yul rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i snod bcud kyi bkrag mdangs/ lha yul dang rgya mtsho na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi/ bcud len gyi rdzas la sogs pa thams cad bsdus te thugs ga'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la zem/ de las 'od dang bdud rtsi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung ste thim pas sman gye snod rin po che las grub pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sman rnams nad rigs mtha' dag sel bar nus pa'i 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ snyi ṣa dzre gu ru beeḍūrya pra bha rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya arta ti saṃ myaka saṃ buchu ya/ tadu thā/ oṃ lha ṣa dzre snyi ṣadzre/ mahā snyi ṣa dzre snyig byo rā dzas mug te swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring bdun dang / tarya thā/ man chad snying po ci mang bzla/mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / de nas/ bcom ldan 'das sman pa'i rgyal po drang srong gi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu shis pa 146

༄/ /smanagyinalobasaphya tshul bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/brjod par bsams pa/ lha rnams kyi ni bdud rtsi lta bu dang / / klu rnams kyi ni gtsuganor lta bu dang / / drang srong rnams kyi bcud len lta bur ni/ / khyod la sman 'di nye bar gnas gyur cig / ces rgyud rang las 'byung ba dang / stong chenarab 'joms nas gsungs pa/ rdzogs sangs rnam par sangs rgyas tshe/ /'jig rten skyong bas phyogs bzhi nas/ / snod bzhi dag ni blangs nas su/ /bde bar gshegs la phul ba dang / / mthu yis gcig tu sprul mdzad pa/ /lha yi sgod mchog de dang ni/ / bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi mchog / ston pa'i phyag na bsnams gyur pa/ / bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis/ / sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog / de bzhin lha mo 'phrog ma yis/ / lha rdzas dge ba a ru ra/ / blangs nas ston par rab phul ba/ / bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi mchog / bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis/ / nad pa rnams kyi nad sel zhing / / nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa'i/ / sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyurab shog / sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang / / gtsug tor can gyi stobs rnams dang / / thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang / / log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang / / gser zhes bya ba'i ye shes dang / / 'od srungs kyi ni rdzu 'phrul dang / / shākya seng ge'i mthu rnams kyis/ / sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog / ces shis pa brjod de byin gyis brlab cing /thugs ga'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa'ang 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu nas sman rnams la thim par gyur par bsams la phud lan gsum nam mkha' la gtor te/ bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin tshogs rnams mchod/ / bka' srung zhing blon sde dang bcas pa mchod/ / don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i byin phob cig / ces brjod cing rang gi lce thog tu bzhag cing dngos grub blangs pas rang gi nad gdon 147

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/b.rachad thams cad bsal zhing 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams/'di ni rgyud las/ bdud bzlas bdud rtsir bsam ste rig 'dzin mchod/ /dngos grub blangs pas rang gi nad gdon bsal/ / zhes gong du shes par bya ba gsum du gsungs pa'i phyi ma mchod rdzas su shes par bya tshul yin la/ 'di ni dngos gzhi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid bog dbyung ba'i rjes kyi bya ba khyad par can yin te/ rdzas de dkon mchog gi mchod par byas pa na/'di la ro mi zhim pa ro mchog snang / / zhes rgyan las gsungs pa ltar de dag gi tshogs gnyis rlabs po che'i mthus dngos po la'ang bdud rtsir 'gyur ba dang / thog mar dkon mchog ma tshad pas bsod nams 'phel zhing rang gzhanagyi nad gdon bar chad thams cad myur du zhi nas bde skyid phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ 'jig rten dag na bde zhing skyid pa/ de kun dkon mchog mchod las byung bas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ der ma zad dkon mchog la phul ba'i lhag mar byas pa na de'i byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis sdig pa tshan po che'ang myur du byang nus na/nad gdon phra mo lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i lhag ma 'di/ / sdig pa rnam par zad byed yin/ zhes rgyud sde las gsungs pa bzhin no/ / de ltar lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen mchog gsum thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs pa dang / nang gi nyer len gong du/ rgyu ni blo ldan bsam pa dkar ba dang / zhes sogs ltar gso ba rig pa'i gnas cha lag dang bcas par thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad cing goms 'dris kyis myong byang chub par byas la/ gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam rnam par dag pas lag len du btab na don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dga' ston la spyod par 'gyur ro/ / 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po'i byin rlabs dang / / 'tsho byed drang srong tshogs kyi bden 148

༄/ /smanakyin rlabasaphya tshulabadud rtsi'i thigs pa/pa'i mthus/ / rnam mang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / / rnam kun mkhyen pa'i sa la 'god gyur cig/ ces sman byin rlabs bya tshul bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes byab 'di ni gso rig smra ba dkon mchog yar 'phel gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa ratna ā narnya 'o/ /149

༄/ /gung thang brtan pa'i name'igasung babum/༄7/ / gzungs sngags zab mo du ma kha ton du bya ba'i tshul dge ba'i 'phrul 'degs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄za/ / yo hūṃ 'gro 'ong ('od) rgyu bas lam gsum du/ / 'phyan pas dub pa yid kyi khye'u chung / / spros bral 〉 yi gdangs su ngal sos pa'i/ /bde chen la sbyor gsang sngags thabs kyi lam/ / gang la brten na 'bad pa chung ngus kyang / / sdug bsngal rgyu bcas mun pa'i dpung bcom ste/ / legs byas snang ba'i mchog spyin skal bzang la/ / 'god mdzad bshes gnyen rnams kyis rtag tu skyongs/ / de yang snyigs ma'i skye bo blo dang rtsol ba zhan cing g.yeng bas khyer ba rnams kyis kyang sgrub par sla la don che ba shin tu nye bar mkho ba'i gzungs sngags zab mo 'ga' zhig kha ton du bya ba'i tshul 'god pa la/ nangs snga bar khrus byas te rang gi lce'i steng du zla ba la sngags phreng gis bskorab las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad dbyangs gsal gyi rnam par bsdus te sngags phreng la thim par bsam zhing / oṃ a ā i ste u lca ṛ dṛ le thā e i o yo i a ka kha ga gha nga /tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa rta ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/sha ṣa sa ha/ kṣa ye dharmā he tu bra bhā wa te turnye ṣānta thā ga to hya ba da ta/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e baṃ pā dī mahā shram swā hā/ lan gsum/ sngags phreng 'od du zhu nas lce la thim pas/ lce rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ oṃ sa 150

༄/ /gzungasajagasajabayo dum kha ton dus ba'i tshul/ra sasta ra/ bi ma na sa ra mahā dza ba hūṃ/ zhes dang / oṃ sma ra sma ra bi ma na ska ra mahā dza ba hūṃ/ zhes 'gyur sngags lan bdun brjod/ bka' gdams glegs bam dusngags snga ma las mi 'byung bas/ de gcig pus kyang chog par mngon/ oṃ ru tsir maṇi pra wa rta ya hūṃ/ zhes lan bdun bzlas te phreng ba la btab/ de yang spyir bzlas brjod tsam du ma zad/ gzhung klog pa sogs la yang lung mnos pa gal che bas/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par mos la/ de dag gis gsung lhang lhang chos de nyid kyi lung bstsal pa na rjes su zlos pa'i tshul gyis rang gis brjod par mos te bton na chos la dbang za ba'i nyes pa mi 'byung zhing byin rlabs 'jug sla ba dang / ring bor mi thogs par chos kyi rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob nas sangs rgyas rnams las gdams pa dngos su nod pa'i skal ba can du byed pa sogs dgos pa du ma yod pas/ de ltar byed pa la chos spyi'i lung nod pa'i cho ga zhes grags shing /tshul de nyid jo bo yab sras kyi gsung rgyun dang phyag bzhes yin par gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ges bshad do/ / yang mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bzhugs par bsams la mos gus drag po'i ngang nas 'don pa'am/ thub pa'i dbang po lta bu gcig gsal btab ste/ gzhan thams cad de'i rang bzhin du bzhugs par mos nas 'don pa che ba'i bdag nyid du 'don pa dang / rang bzhin med kyang snang ba brag cha'i sgra ltar mdo dang sngags de dang de'i sgra lhang lhang grags par mos nas 'don pa stong nyid kyi ngang du 'don pa ste/ de gnyis ni mdo sngags thun mong gi 'dod tshul yin par rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis chos spyod rin chen 'phreng bar gsungs la/ rim pa bzhin/ thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ / ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ / ces dang / stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog ste/ /151

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/zab cing rgya che'i sgra sgrogs pa/ / zhes pa'i man ngag gi 'don tshul yin par yang de nyid kyis gsungs so/ / sngags lugs thun mong ma yin pa ni/ mgrin palongs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i bdag nyid a yig gis mtshan pa de las gzungs sngags thams cad mar me'i 'phreng ba bzhin spros nas sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar byas/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs mtha' dag bsdus te a yig la bstem zhing / slar yang sngags phreng spro ba sogs mgal me'i 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor bar bsam nas bzla ba ni/ a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog / don chen yi ge dam pa yin/ / khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med/ / ces pa'i man ngag gi 'don tshul dang / yang na rang lha'i nga rgyal la gnas te/ zhi ba yin na snying gar zla gdan la rang rang gi sa bon nam sngags thams cad kyi rtsa ba a yig la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'jam zhing bsil ba 'phros/ rang gzhan gyi las nyon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen thams cad sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs bsdus te thim pas legs tshogs kyi yon tan thams cad rgyas par bsams la bzla/ khro bo yin na nyi gdan la 'khod pa'i sngags phreng las 'od zer tsha zhing tsub pa me 'od lta bu spros/ gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad bsreg cing tshar bcad par bsams la bzla ste/ 'di gnyis ni/ rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che/ / rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od/ / ces pa'i gdams ngag yin par gsungs so/ /gzhan yang gzugs su snang ba thams cad lha de dang de'i rnam pa/ sgra thams cad de'i sngags kyi rang gdangs/ dran rtog thams cad de dag gi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang dbyer med du lta ba 'khyer so gsum gyi rnal 'byor yang bzlas pa gang byed thams cad kyi skabs su sbyar na phun sum tshogs 152

༄/ /gzungs gas zabalo dum kha ton duphya ba'i tshul/par 'gyur ro/ / 'don tshul de dag gi sgo nas gdon par bya rgyu'i sngags ni/spyir tshad mar gyur pa'i rgyud snga las gsungs pa'i sngags thams cad rgyal ba'i thugs bde stong gi ye shes nyid sngags kyi rnam par shar ba chos sku'i ring bsrel yin pas mchog dman gyi dbye ba med kyang / gnas skabs gdul bya'i las 'brel gyi dbang gis dam pa gong ma rnams gtsor 'don mdzad pa ni/ dper na/ 'khor lo sdom pa dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs kyi sngags rnams ches snyigs ma bdo ba'i tshe 'grub sla zhing sdig sgrib 'joms pa la bskal pa'i me lta bur gsungs pa dang / dpal ldan 'dus pa'i sngags rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying bo bsdus pa yin pas rgyal ba kun gye byin rlabs gcig char du 'dren par gsungs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed ni rang re rje bla ma'i rjes 'jug rnams kyi lha skal lta bu yin pas sgrub sla zhing / zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi gnad tshang bas 'di'i bzlas brjod cung zad re byas pas kyang bgegs thams cad zhi zhingarnam 'byed kyi shes rab shin tu 'phel bar gsungs/ de bzhin du las sgribasbyong ba la mi 'khrugs pa dang sman bla'i gzungs las sogs pa mchog tu bsngags shing / phyi mar dga' ldan du skye ba dang / ma 'ongs pa na rje btsun byams mgon gyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur byams pas dam bca'i gzungs la ched du bsngags pa mdzad/ yang yig drug lan re bzlas pas kyang bskal ba dpag med kyi sdeg pa 'dag cing bsod nams tshad med pa 'thob pas gzungs gcig la 'di las phan yon che ba med par yang gsungs pa sogs brjodakyis mi lang bas/ rang rang gi mos pa dang bstun te sngags re re la rtsal 'don pa'am/ thams cad la bag chags ci thebs re bgyid pa sogs gang byas kyang legs so/ / 'dir rgyun gyi spyod lam dang bstun te 'don rgyu'i sngags thor bu 'ga' zung zhig 'god pa la/ tho rangs skya rengs 'char ba'i tshe 153

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/shar phyogs su bltas te byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po yid la byas nas/ tadu thā/ su mṛ sha su mṛ sha su mṛ sha kā ru ṇi ka/ tsa ra tsa ra bi tsa ra sa tsar/ kā ru ṇi ka mung mung / be ga dha ri ma tsa me/ sgru dza pā da kāru ṇi ka/tsirnya ma ṇi snu ra ya kāru ṇi ka/ sarba sha mesta pā ya mdzā dha ri/ spu gung spu gung /ru ti bi be ka gung dṛkhyi bi be ka gung / snu ra ya kā ru ṇi ka pū ra yachu mam a sha/sarba paze tsa a sho ka ga ti swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gsol ba btab na snga ma'i nyes ltung 'dag cing nyer 'tshe thams cad sel bar bslab btus las gsungs so/ / mtshan mo rmi lam ngan pa byung na yang tho rangs yar langs ma thag na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma sarba burnya a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā rna/ tadu thā/oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūṃ hūṃ/ dzwa la dzwa la/ pra dzwa la pra dzwa la/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha phaṭa phaṭa sāhā/ zhes lan gcig bzlas pas mtshan ltas ngan pa thams cad bzlog par 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las gsungs/rten gyi drung du phyag 'tshal ba'i tshe thog mar/ na mo maci thi ye/ na mo blu the ye/ na mo utta ma shri ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas phyag stong 'gyur du 'gro bar gsungs/ mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshe/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bhag wa te/ badzra sā nga pra ma rnga ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te sasmakle budhāya/tadu thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ mahā badzre/ mahā te dza badzra/ mahā bibyu badzre/ mahā bodhi tsitta badzre/ mahā bo dhe mazlo pa saṃ ka ma ṇa badzre/ sarba garma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre sā hā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs brjod bzhin du phul bas mchod pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par 'gyur la/me tog 'bul ba'am maṇḍal gyi 'bru sogs la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/pukhri ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te sasmakre budhā ya/ tadu thā/ oṃ pukhri pukhri swā hā/ pukhri su bu / bukhro rte we/ pukhri saṃ bha we/ puṣṭha a ba ka ri ṇi swā 154

༄/ /gzungasasngags zabapo dus kha ton du༅ ba'i tshul/hā/ zhes lan bdun bzlas te btab pas bye bar 'gyur ro/ / nyin der byes su 'gro dgos pa lta bu yod na nyi ma shar ba'i tshe de'i zer la lha mo 'od zer can ma byon par bsams te/ oṃ ma rī byo māṃ swā hā/ zhes lan bdun bzlas na dgra jag sogs kyi nyer 'tshe thams cad zlog pa'i srung ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /skor ba byed na/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ ratna ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/arta te sasmakre budhā ya/ tadu thā/ mar sne rasne mahā ra sne ra tna bi dzā ya sā hā/zhes lan bdun sogs brjod pas bye ba phrag gcig tu 'gyur la/ 'di'i sgo nas phyag byas na yang bye ba'i 'gyur du gsungs so/ / zas la longs spyod pa'i tshe oṃ ā : gis byin gyis brlabs shing 'bul tshul sogs rgyas par chos spyod gsal sgon du bshad pa ltar ram/ bsdu na/ oṃ gu ru burnya bo dhi satwa sarba dharmā pā las ba ri wā ra badzra nee wi bya 〉 rtu gis mgron thams cad la dbul/ zas kyi mjug tu/ na ma sa manta bra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te sasma kle budhā ya/ tadu thā/ na mo mdzi shrī ku mā ra skru tā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ mahā satā ya/mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tadu thā/ oṃ ni rā la ste/ ni rā bhā se/ dza ye dzā ya la bhi/ma te mahā ma te/ dakṣi dakṣi tram̐ me pa ri sho dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod na dkor sgrib sbyong ba la ches mchog tu bsngags so/ /tha na zag pa 'dor ba'i tshe yang / mchil ma la/ oṃ ā thekhri ā ha re bhya swā hā/ lud pa la/ oṃ ma khye ta ā ha re dhu swā hā/ snabs la/ oṃ ā bi gha na ā ha re bhya swāhā/ lus kyi dri ma la/ oṃ ā ma la ā ha re bhya swā hā/ dri chen la/ oṃ ā tpa ṭa ā ha re rgya swā hā/ dri chu la/ oṃ ā sku tra ā ha re rgya swā hā/ zhes bsngos pas tshogs chen po zhar byung du rdzogs pas dgos pa shin tu che'o/ /gzhan du 'gro ba'i lam du srog chags 'chi kha ma lta bu'am/ phyugs la 155

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/sogs pa'i rna lam du yang / na mo ratna shi khe ne ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te saṃ myakre budhā ya/ tarya thā/ oṃ rasne rasne ratna shi khe ne swā hā/ zhes rin chen gtsug tor can gyi gzungs 'di bsgrags pas de dag gi 'khor ba mtha' can du byed cing rang la yang phan yon tshad med pa 'byung ngo / / yang rang gi rkang mthil du/oṃ khri tsa ra gan hūṃ hri sā hā/ zhes bzlas nas bsngags te song na rkang 'og tu shi ba'i srog chags rnams kyang ngan 'gro las thar zhing / rgyud la thar ba'i sa bon 'jog pas phan yon shin tu che/ lam du bla ma'am sku gsung thugs rten sogs kyi grib ma 'go ma dgos pa byung ba'i tshe steng du bteg par bsams la/oṃ badzra be gā kra ma hūṃ/ zhes brjod nas 'gom yang nyes pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /sha la longs spyod pa'i tshe/ oṃ ā li ra hūṃ khe tsar/ zhes lan bdun bzlas nas btab na srog chags de nyid mtho ris su skye zhing rang la yang nyes pa mi 'byung bar gsungs so/ /satstsha 'debs pa'i sngags sogs ni de'i cho ga rnams su shes par bya la/mdo sde klog pa ma nus na/ de'i dod du yang gzungs 'di rnams bklag par gsungs te/ stong phrag brgya ba gzung bar 'gyur ba'i sngags ni/ tadu thā/oṃ mu ni dha rme saṃ gra ha dha rme a nu gra ha dha rme bi musnyi dha me sa dā a nu gra ha dha rme bee shra ba ṇa pa ri brti ta dha me sarba kārya pa re pra ma ṇa dha rmes manta pa ri brtan dha rme swāhā/ oṃ pradzā bru ti spro ti bi dza ye dhi dha ra ṭī ye swāhā/ zhes dang / phal bo che gzung bar 'gyur ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ spri/ na ma ze burnya ṭwāṃ/ oṃ rmā bhya st+waṃ/tadu thā/ oṃ hūṃ/ na masma manta bunta rnya rna/ a pra ti ha ta sha sa nā rna/ oṃ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ta thā ga ta u rnya ba shārnye ba ra te utta ma ta thā ga ta usto ba hūṃ phaṭa/sdong bo bkod pa'i mdo gzung bar 'gyur ba'i sngags ni/ na ma sa 156

༄/ / gzungs sngags zabapo dus kha ton duco ba'i tshul/manta bu ṭwāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ṭwāṃ/ oṃ ki ṇi keṇi/ ta thā ga ta yurte ba shārnye ba ra te utta ma utta ma/ ta thā ga ta urte ba hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po gzung bar 'gyur ba'i sngags ni/ na ma sa manta budhwa ṭwāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shās nā ṭwāṃ/ oṃ zu na drun hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'di dag ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ gzhan yang de 'dra ba shin tu mang ngo / /nyal ba'i tshe nyin der ltung ba byung ma byung bsngo bgrang byas la phyir bcos dang / ma mtha' yang sngags byang sems kyi nyes pa sbyong ba'i phyir/ oṃ a mo gha shī la saṃ bhā ra/ bha ra bha ra/ mahā shurnya satwa padma pi ju ṣi ta thu dza/ dha ra dha ra/sa manta a ba lo ke te hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs dang /na ma ste ya dhi kā ṭwāṃ/ ta thā ga tā ṭwāṃ/ sarba tā pra ti ha dzāpāsta dha dma tā ba liṭwāṃ/༷ ༷ dhi ༵ ༷ / ༵ temarnyo ༵ sdi ṭwāṃX ṭwāṃ / ༷ ṭwāṃ// ༵ ༵ ༵ ༵/ ༵ ༵ ṭwāṃ ༵ ṇa ༵ / na/ mahā ba ra la kṣa ṇi/ dzwa la dzwa la na sā ga re swā hā/ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya dang / sngags sdom gyi nyes pa 'dag phyir rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya rnams ci 'grub bzla/ dge rtsa gang byas mtha' dag gong du spel ba'i slad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje bskul ba'i phyir/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta tre da ya a nu ga te oṃ ku ru gi ni swāhā/ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa spyi'i snying po ci 'grub bzla/ nyal ba'i tshe/ oṃ sirnyi sirnyi burnya burnya bo dha ya bo dha ya ba la ba la tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hrī ke pa ki pa pa ra gtsu gtsā bha wa ti ma bi li ba a le swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di lag mthil g.yas par btab ste 'gram par sbyar nas seng ge'i nyal stabs su gnyid log pas gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin cing / sher phyin gyi don myur du rtogs par gsungs/ yang de'i tshe mgon po 'od dpag med kyi sku'i rnam pa gsal btab nas de'i bang du mgo 157

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/bzhag par mos te tsha gzungs ring thung ci rigs bzla bzhin par gnyid log na dus mtha'i skabs su yang phan che bas/ phyi mar bde ba can du skye ba sogs kyi dgos pa chen po yod par bsam gtan nyal sgom gyi man ngag las gsungs so/ / 'dir nyer mkho mdor bsdus tsam bkod pa yin gyi/ de 'dra ba'i rigs nyams su len par 'dod na rgyud 'bum sogs su btsal bar bya'o/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i 'phrul 'degs kyis/ / dka' ba med par tshogs chen po/ / rdzogs pa'i thabs mkhas rmad byung 'di/ / skal bzang skye bo'i 'jug ngogs yin/ / sngags dang ting 'dzin zung 'jug 'dab yangs kyis/ / tshogs gnyis lha lam gzhal ba'i mthu rdzogs nas/ / mi bzad srid pa'i gcong rong las brgal te/ / nges legs ri dbang spo mthor phyin gyur cig / ces gzungs sngags zab mo du ma kha ton du bya ba'i tshul dge ba'i 'phrul 'degs zhes bya ba 'di ni a bag pe li'i shog nas chos don rnam par 'byed pa'i blo mig can rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa skye bo kun la phan thogs par gyur cig /158

༄/ /mdosde thar ba chen po'i 'don thabs/༄7/ / mdo sde thar ba chen po'i 'don thabs mdo nyid kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du rgyas par bkod pa bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo ratna tra bee ya/ thugs bskyed rmad byung ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / thugs bcud gdams pa'i nying khu dam pa'i chos/ / thugs dam mdzad pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bcas/ / thugs rje bden pas byang chub bar du skyongs/ / thub pa'i dbang bo'i mgur nas gsung ba yi/ / theg pa chen po'i chos kyi snying bo mchog / thar ba chen po'i mdo sde klog pa yi/ /thabs mkhas chen pos gtan 'dun sgrub par rigs/ / mtshan gcig brjod kyang phan pa mtha' yas na/ / cho ga ji bzhin rgya cher bklag pa yis/ / mi bzad sdig ltung lhag med byang ba sogs/ / phan yon bsam las 'das phyir 'dir zhugs shig /de'ang thar ba chen po'i mdo sde 'di nyid 'don pa la/ mdo sde nyid las/ tshigs bcadagacig 'chad dam klog na bsod nams 'di lta bu dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ gang gis mdo sde 'di 'dzin yang / / sdug bsngal kun dang yongs 'bral lo/ /nam du'ang ngan 'gror mi ltung ste/ / bde ba'i gnas su phyin par 'gyur/ /zhes mdo cha tshang klog pa lta zhog nang gi tshigs bcad re re dang mtshan re re bklag pa tsam la'ang phan yon tshad med pas/ nyin grangs dang 'don thabs kyi lag len rgyas bsdus gang byas kyang rung ngo / / 'on kyang 'dir mdo rang las 'byung ba'i cho ga'i yan 159

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/lag thams cad tshang bar byas te lag len rgyas pa'i dbang du byas nas 'god pa la/mdor/ dben pa'i gnas khang ba gcig gi nang du dkyil 'khor byas la/ dri'i chus chag chag gdab/ 'phan gdugs bzang bos brgyan cing spos zhim po bsregs zhes dang / khang ba dben pa gtsang ma'i nang ba dan dang rgyal mtshan nang gdugs kyis brgyan nas/ zhes pa ltar nyin snga ma nas gnas khang byi dor byas la mchod rdzas du ma bkod pa mdzes par bstar/ rigs lnga dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku gzugs bris 'bur gang mang / sman mdo brgyad brgya ba sogs bka'i glegs bam/ sa tshwa yan chod thugs rten ci 'byor ba rnams legs par dgram pa sogs tshags su tshud par byas la/ dngos gzhi'i nyin theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong gi sdom pa len pa gal che ste/ mdor/ sha dang chang mi 'tshal bar sdom pa la gnas shing / bdag nyid rtsed 'jo la sogs pa spangs te/ zhes dang / cho ga nyin zhag bdun gyi bar du nyin gcigabaza' gcig tu byas la/ zhes chang dang rgyan glu gar dus ma yin pa'i kha zas sogs spangs te dkar chog stan gcig tu bya ba'i tshul gyis yan lag bzhi dngos su bstan pas rtsa ba bzhi don gyis 'grub bo/ / de ltar na zhag grangs kyang mtha' gcig tu nges gzung min yang zhag bdun du byas na shin tu legs te/ mdor/ nyin zhag bdun gye bar du nyin re re zhing mdo sde 'di bklag ste/ zhes dang / gdugs bdun gyi bar du mdo sde gzhan mi bsam par/ zhes sogs gdugs bdun bya bar yang yang gsungs so/ / sdom pa bzung ba'i thog mar yang 'khor ba mi rtag pa'i ngang tshul bsam nas 'jigs pas skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byams snying rje'i dmigs rnam gsal btab ste sems bskyed tshad med bzhi dang bcas pa bsgom dgos pa'ang / mdor/ mi rtag pa la rnam par rtog par bya na nyon mongs pa rnam par spangs te/ yang dag pa'i dran pa mngon du bzhag la byams pa dang snying rje thog mar 'gro bar bya ste/ zhes so/ / der ma zad theg pa chen po'i lam thabs shes zung du 'jug pa med mi rung yin pas/ stong nyid kyi lta bas rgyas 'debs pa'ang gal che ste/ mdor/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yun ring du bsgoms la/ chos kye mtshan nyid la bdag dang / gang zag dang / sems can la 160

༄/ /mdosde thar ba chen po'i 'don thabs/sogs pa'i lta ba med par mngon par bya ste/ zhes gsungs so/ / tshul de ltar thabs shes zung 'brel du nyams su blangs na rgya mtsho dang rmig rjes bzhin dman pa'i dge tshogs mtha' dag zil gyis gnon pa la dgongs nas/ 'og tu/ theg chen dpe tshad rgya mtsho bzhin/ / theg pa chung ngu ba rjes chu/ / theg chen dpe tshad ri rab lhun/ / theg pa chung ngu grog ma'i mkhar/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa yin no/ / des na tho rangs lag ris mthong ba'i tshod tsam la phyag btsal cing skyabs sems sngon du btang ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang bo chen po/ bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ sred par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de dag gis/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir gso sbyong yang dag par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang /dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges par rtogs par 161

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bya ba'i phyir gso sbyong yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ / zhes lan gsum gyis sdom pa gzung / thabs legs byas la/ deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / /gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya/ / 'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyod cing / / rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ / skyon ni mang po nyer brten pa'i/ / chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ / khri stan che mtho mi bya zhing / / de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ / dri dang phreng ba rgyan dang ni/ / gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ / srog gcod la sogs mi byed ltar/ / de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spang / / bla med byang chub myur thob shog / sdug bsngal mang 'khrugs 'jig rten 'di/ / srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog / lan gcig rjes zlos byas nas bslab pa bsrung bar dam bca'/ rten gyi drung yinan/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol zhes pa dang thabs lags mi dgos/ gzhan rnams rang gis brjod/ mjug tu/ oṃ a mo gha shī la saṃ bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ mahā shurnya satwa padma bi ཿ ṣi ta sgru dza/ dha ra dha ra/ sa manta/ a wa yo ki te hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs nyer gcig brjod/ khrims kyi tshul khrims zhes sogs kyis smon lam gdab bo/ / dngos gzhi la rgyud chags gsum gyi thog ma phyag 'tshal dgos par 'dul ba sogs nas gsung bar ma zad mdo 'dir/ dus gsum phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ byang sems du ma dang bcas par phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul nan tan du gsungs pas/ 'greng ste dad pa shugs drag po dang bcas yan lag lngas phyag tshul dang mthun par btsal la/sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor 'od mi 'gyur/ / nyi zla mar me gsal ba nyi khri sogs/ / 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gcig bcu brgya stong khri/ / sogs kyis mtshon te gaṅgā'i bye ma'i rdul/ / bye ba brgya stong snyed las 'das pa la/ / sgo gsum mi byed dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / phyogs bcu'i zhing na 'tsho bzhes 162

༄/ /mdoshe tharab ra po'i 'don thabs/rgyalanams dngaka / shāka thub gsal rgyal 'bum phrag bcu la sogs/ / da lta'i sangs rgya4gcigabacu brgya stong khri/ / sogs kyis mtshon te gaṅgā'i bye ma'i rdul/ / bye ba brgya stong snyed las 'das pa la/ / sgo gsum mi byed dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / phyi ma'i dus su 'byon par 'gyur ba yi/ / rgyal ba byams mgon rnam dag sku la sogs/ / ma 'ongs sangs rgyas gcig bcu brgya stong khri/ / sogs kyis mtshon te gaṅgā'i bye ma'i rdul/ / bye ba brgya stong sted las 'das pa la/ / sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung du bstan pa sogs/ / yan lag bcu gnyis lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ / phyogs bcu'i zhing khams gcig bcu brgya stong khri/ /sogs kyis mtshon te gaṅgā'i bye ma'i rdul/ / bye ba brgya stong snyed du bzhugs pa la/ / sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs dbang mthu chen thob/ / brtson 'grus rtag dang rgyun mi gtong ba sogs/ / sems dpa' chen po gcig bcu brgya stong khri/ / sogs kyis mtshon te gaṅgā'i bye ma'i rdul/ / bye ba brgya stong snyed las 'das pa la/ / sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ / nas/ thams cad bdag gis bstod/ / ces pa'i bar phyag dang sbrags te bya/ thog ma'i phyag 'di ni shin tu gal che bas/ mdor/ dad skyes brtson 'grus phyag 'tshal na/ / tshad med sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur/ / de bas rtse gcig phyag tshol cig / ces gsungs so/ / sangs rgyas byang sems grangs med pa de sted yidayul du byas nas phyag 'tshal ba lta zhog de'i nang gi byang sems re re'i mtshan 'dzin pa'ang don shin tu che ba ni/ mdor/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i nang gi sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gcig gam/ byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan gcig brjod na sang zag de tshe 'di nyid la bde ba thob ste sdig pa rnams mi mthong zhing / tshe zad de 'chi 'phos 163

༄/ /gungajang bamami'i sgron 'i gsung 'bum/na'angabyang chubasems dpa' bdag cag rnams kyis sngon du lam drangs te/ bdag cagagis 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dag pa'i gnas gcig tu skye bar bgyi'o/ /zhes 'di phyi gnyi gar don shin tu che tshul gsal bar bstan pa bzhin no/ / sangs rgyas rnamasani sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa mnga' zhing chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin kun tu khyab pas mdun na mngon sum du bzhugs yod par dmigs shing / de ltar blo thag chod pa byung nas chod shin tu che bas/ mdor/ sangs rgyas grangs med pa'i 'du shes skyed de mthong ba dang 'dra bar dmigs la/ zhes so/ / phyag grub nas stan la 'khod de/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhes sogs mchod 'phreng rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ me tog dam pa nas phyag 'tshal mchod par bgye/ / zhes mchod pa dbul/ bslab btus su sdig pa spyong ba'i thabs drug gsungs pa las/ 'dir mdo sde zab mo la brten pa gtso boyin zhing / mtshan la brten pa dang / bzlas pa la brten pa gnyis kyang nang du gsal la/ 'og tu/ shes rab stong ba nyid kyi phyir sdig pa'i rang bzhin stong ba nyid do/ / zhes stong ba nyid la brten par gsungs pa sogs don gye gnad thams cad tshang ngo / / des na dngos gzhi'i gtso bo 'gyod tshang gis sdig pa sbyong ba yin pas bshags pa'imatshams 'dir mdo sde bklag par bya'o/ / klog pa'i tshe 'ga' zhig gis chos la dbang ba po lta bur byas te gus pa med par gar bab tu 'jog pa dang lag pa snum dang dri mas sbags pas bzung ste nog por byed pa dang / sems g.yeng bas chad lhag dang sgra log tu 'don pa sogs ni phan yon las nyes dmigs che bas shin tu mi rung ste/ mdor/sug pa mi gtsang bas mdo sde 'di bzung ngam/ ma gus par bklags sam/ kha ton du bgyis na/ bdag cag gis gang zag de 'gro sdod 'dug nyal gyi spyod lam rnam bzhir lus dang sems mi bde bar brgya'o/ / zhes ma gus par byas na dkar phyogs skyong ba rnamasakyis gnod pa byed tshul dang / lag pa gtsang mas blangs shing 'chang ngam/ /khrus bgyis te bdug spos kyis bdug cing blang ngam/ zhes sogs nas/ bsrung bar bgyi'o/ / zhes gus pa la grogs byed tshul gsungs pas/ gal te bdug spos kyis bdug pa ma byung yang / sgog btsong tha ma kha sogs dri ngan gyis ma bdugs pa zhig gal 164

༄/ /mdosde tharab ra po'ibadon thab /che'o/ / gtso bo bsam pa'i khyad par ji rtobusaglog pa'abamador/ semagathag la nabami 'khrugs pa dang / sems thag panas mi nobab dang / na cigags pa ba dang / sems thag pa nas dus kyis 'grus pa dang / sems thag pa nas dad pasnyed pa dang / sems thag pa nas dga' ba skyed pa dang / zhes sogs dang / gong du thabs shes khyad par can gyi kun slong gsal 'debs tshul gsungs pa de lta bu'i bsam sbyor rnam dag ya ma bral ba'i sgo nas gdon dgos so/ / mdo bklags pa'i 'phror/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ / zhes pa nas/ so sor bshags/ /rgyal bu dge mthong skye bo sum stong bcas/ / mi bzang sdig ltung dpag med byas na yang / / mdo sde 'dir brten 'gyod tshang bgyis pa yis/ / nyes pa'i dri ma lhag med byang ba bzhin/ / dus gsum phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal rnams dang / / mdo sde bcu gnyis rgyal sras tshogs kyi mthus/ / bdag sogs 'brel thogs 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ / sgo gsum nyes tshogs byang zhing dag gyur cig / khyad par tshe 'das lta bu'i don yin na rkang ba gsum par/dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa 'di nyid kyi/ / zhes sam/ tshe 'das rab brtan bzang bo zhes bya 'di'i/ / zhes pa lta bur bsgyur kyang rung / de nas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang zhes sogs kyi yan lag lhag ma rnams bya'o/ / de nas bzang spyod kyi sngon 'gro dang / bde ba can gyi smon lam/ byams pa'i smon lam sogs rang gi mos pa dang bstun pa'i bsngo smon rnam dag gis mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / thun mtshams su/ namo burnya ya/ na mo dharma ya/ na ma sasgo ya/ a darnyi dhā ra ṇi/ tadu thā/ ha ā ka sha ni ba bī/ sarba dharmā ba bī/ a sham dhi/ bi ba sha na/ bi ma la su pa ri darma ṇi kha na/ ba ru ṇi tsa ya ta ma le tsa le/ hu lu su lu/ shi bi de mgro mgro swāhā/zhes pa'i sngags 'di bzla zhing skor ba bya/ yang mdor/ thog ma'i nyin par nas zhag drug tu lon pa'i nang bar lus la spos chus bkru bar bya'o/ / gsungs pa bzhin/ thog ma nas chu gtsang bzhag ste sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pa'i 165

༄/ /gung ba bstan pa'izla 'i ryāng 'a4/dmigs pa dang bcas mdo dang gzungs bzlas pa'i mthar phu gdab cing / sgrub pa thon pa'i nyin rang dang yon bdag sogs la khrus bya zhing / gshin bu rus bu sogs la btabana'ang phan yon shin tu che'o/ / de ltar bsam pa thag pas mdo sde 'di nyid la brten nas mthol tshang tshul bzhin du byas na ji lta bu'i sdig pa stobs po che'ang lhag med dukhyang zhing dag par 'gyur bar ston pa thub pa'i dbang bos bslu ba med pa'i bden tshig gis zhal gyis bzhes pa yin te/ mdor/ de bzhin mthol tshang byed nus na/ /rtsa babazhi dang mtshams med lnga/ / log spyod bar du sdig byang ste/ / sangs rgyas 'grub par gdon mi za/ / zhes gsungs pa snying la bcang bar bya'o/ / thar dka' srid pa'i btson rar tshud pa las/ / thar bar 'dod pa'i blo ldan skye bo rnams/ / thar ba chen po'i them skas 'dir brten nas/ / thar ba'i grong khyer mchog tu 'jug gyur cig /ces mdo sde thar ba chen po 'don thabs mdo nyid kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du rgyas par bkod pa 'di ni/ ming gan shog nas dad ldan dge slong ngag dbang bkra shis dang sman pa rab 'byor gnyis kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni sngags rams pa kun dga'o/ /gang gi thugs rje nyin byed gdengs ka las/ / 'gro ba'i nyes ltung grang reg kha ba'i ri/ / 'joms byed gsung gi tsha zer 'bum 'phro ba/ / thub dbang chos dang dge 'dun bcas la 'dud/ / yan lag drug cu'i rgyud du gang 'khrol ba/ / mtha' dag 'chos skyob yon tan dpal 'dzin yang / /khyad par sdig ltung sbyangs te ngan song sgo/ / gcod byed thar ba chen po'i mdo 'di bsngags/ / de phyir thog med dus nas 'khyams pa yi/ / srid 'dir phyi ma med pa'i phyag bgyis te/ / rnam grol gling du 'jug 'dod don mthun rnams/ / yang dag thabs kyi gru gzings 'dir zhugs shig / de yang mdo sde zab mo rnams rang gis klog pa'am/ gzhan la 'chad pa sogs kyi tshe ji ltar 'don pa'i tshul ni thub pa'i dbang bo nyid kyis gsal bar gsungs te/ 'dul ba lung las/ rgyud 166

༄/ / mdosde thar ba chen po'i 'don thabs/chagasagasum pa bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa la/ de ji ltar bya ba ma shes nas slar yang zhus pas/ dang por phyag 'tshal ba dang / bar du mdo 'don pa dang / ma thar bsngo ba byaba'o/ / zhes sbyor dngos rjes kyi rim pa gsum du bsdus nas gsungs so/ / dang por phyag 'tshal ba yang bstan pa'i bdag po thub pa bcom ldan 'das gtso bor byas pa'i skyabs yul rnams gsal btab ste/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang / rang nyid 'khor ba spyi dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal la 'dzigs shing skrag pa sogs skyes bu chung 'bring thun mong gi bsam pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal 'ing skyabs su 'gro tshul tsam zhig dngos zin la smos pa ni rigs can gsum gas theg pa che chungagi sde snod gang la yang thos bsam byed tshul spyi tsam gyi dbang du byas pa yin la/khyad par du theg pa chen po'i rigs can rnams kyi dbang du byas na de tsam gyis mi chog par skyabs yul rnams kyi yon tan mthong ba'i dad pas yid drangs te/ rang nyid kyang de lta bu'i go 'phang bla na med pa mngon du bya bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa sems bskyed kyi rtsis zin pa dgos pas/ de ltar na rgyud chags dang po'i khongs su spyor ba'i rim pa cha tshang bar bstan pa yin no/ / bar du mdo 'don pa'i tshe yang snga ma'i kun slong de nyid mabarjed pa'i dran 'dun du re ba dang / rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis rang nyid la lung 'bogs pa'i rjes su zlos pa'am/ dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha la sogs pa mi dngami ma yin rnams la chos kyi sbyin pa byas pa'i mos pa dang / mdo sde rang rang gi brjod bya'i don la dpyad sgom byed pa rnams ya ma bral ba'i dang nas 'don dgos shing /mjug tu dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag chud mi za bar bya ba'i phyir bstan 'gro'i don dang byang chub mchog gi rgyur bsngos te smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas 'debs pa gsum char tshang ba'i stobs kyis thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung ma lus pa'i sbyor dngos rjes kyi 'bras bu mtha' dag sbyong zhing / rnam par byang ba'i phyogs kyi bdag 'bras rnam smin rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par 'byung ngo / / der ma zad tshul 'di ni sher phyin gyi mdo'i dgongs pa bla na med pa dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa la slob tshul mthar thug pa'ang yin te/ sher mdo las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan 167

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/pa'i yid la byed pas mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sbyin sogs la slob cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs pa/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyasakyi sar bsngor mi gzhug go / zhes spyod pa gang la slob pa'i tshe dang por sems bskyed dang mjug bsngo bas rgyas 'debs par gsungs pa/ 'dir rgyud chags gsum du byed tshul dang dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab bo /de ltar nges pa brtan po bskyed de/ dngos gzhi ngag 'don gyi rim pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ thabs mkhas thugs rje'i spyod pa rmad byung bas/ / cher snyigs gdul dka'i 'dren pa thub pa'i dbang / / sangs rgyas so lnga bde gshegs bdun la sogs/ / rab 'byams yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / /sgrib sel kun bzang nam snying byams 'jam dbyangs/ / spyan ras gzigs dang gsang bdag sa snying sogs/ / byang sems nyan rang mkha' 'gro chos srung bcas/ / bslu med skyabs kyi dam pa ma lus pa/ / bdag sogs nyam thag 'gro la rjes brtse bas/ / rab 'byams zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis/ / 'dir byon sprin gyi phung bo 'khrigs pa bzhin/ / mkha' dbyengs khyab par dgyes bzhin bzhugs su gsol/ / gang la brten na ngag 'gro'i 'jigs 'phrog cing / / thar 'dod thar bar 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mchog / thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan mdzod 'dzin pa/ / skyabs mchog mtshungs med kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bdag lus longs spyod rnam dkar dge tshogs bcas/ / yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin du legs shar te/ / kun bzang bden pa'i stobs kyis 'bul lags na/ / brtse ldan nyid kyi mthu yis bzhes su gsol/ / sngon mtha' mi mngon srid pa'i grong khyer du/ / dug gsum dbang gyur sdig ltung gang bsags pa/ / rgyal kun mthu dang mdo sde'i byin rlabs kyi/ / bdud rtsi'i chu yis lhag med sbyang du gsol/ / gang zhig 168

༄/ / mdosde thar ba chen po'i 'don thabs/rnamadag lhag bsam mos gus kyis/ / thub dbang gsung gi snying bo dam pa 'di/ / 'dzin cing klog dang tshul bzhin sems pa sogs/ / chos spyod lhur len kun la rjes yi rang / / srid pa'i g.yang sar 'khyams pa'i dmus long kun/ / 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan thugs rje mnga' ba rnams/ / rtag tu bzhugs nas zab rgyas dam chos kyi/ / yang dag lam bzang ji bzhin bstan du gsol/ / 'dis mtshon rang gzhan dge tshogs ci mchis pa/ / don med 'khor ba'i rgyu ru mi smin zhing / / mi mthun rkyen gyis nam yang mi gzhom par/ / rgyal kun smon pa'i klong du sim gyur cig / sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ / ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ / sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ / 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog / rnam 'dren thub pa'i dbang bo 'khor bcas kyis/ / bdag blo log pa'i lam las bzlog pa dang / / yang dag lam gyi rtogs pa ma lus pa/ /gegs med myur du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ / lan gsum/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ / byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ / bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis/ / 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum/ de nas mdo sde ji tsam klog par 'dod pa rnams sgra dag cing gsal la chad lhag med par bton te/ mjug tu/'byung bo gang dag phyogs 'dir lhags gyur te/ / sa 'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung / / skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing / / nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog / bdag sogs deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ / mi khom brgyad spangs dal ba'i rten thob cing / / bathes gnyen dam pas dgyes bzhin rjes bzung ste/ / rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i bstan la 'jug gyur cig / khyad par tshul khrims dag pa'i dga' tshal du/ / rgya chen 169

༄/ /gung bang bstan ba'i name'i gsung 'bum/thos pa'i myu gu g.yur za zhing / / phul byung nyams rtogs 'bras bzang smin pa yis/ / rnam grol bde ba'i dus ston rgyas gyur cig / bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa yi/ / go 'phang thob nas skyon gyi dgra btul te/ / rga dang na dang 'chi ba'i rlabs 'khrugs pa'i/ / srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog / rgyal sras smon lam gaṅgā'i klung rnams ni/ / dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam nang 'dus par/ / gsungs phyir dge tshogs ji snyed bsags pa ni/ / kun kyang thub bstan rgyas pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ / zhes sogasadang / gzhan yang bde ba can dang dga' ldan lta bur skyes pa'i rgyur ched du dmigs pa yin na/ de dang 'brel ba'i smon lam gyis kha bsgyur ba sogs rang gi mos pa dang sbyar te bya'o/ / mdo sde klog 'don rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin/ / rgyud chags gsum du bsdus te bya ba'i tshul/ / bkod pa'i dge bas 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / thar ba'i go 'phang mchog la gzhol gyur cig / ces thar ba chen po'i mdo sde kha ton du bya ba'i tshul 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dkon mchog blo gros kyis 'di'i 'don thabs gsal bar bkod pa zhig dgos zhes nan cher bskul ba'i ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /na mo gu ru mu dī ya/ de'ang mdo sde thar ba chen po'i 'don thabs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung gzhir bzhag ste cung zad kha skong zur 'debasakyi tshul du 'god pa la/ rten dgram zhing mchod pa bshams/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas sa gzhi byin gyis brlab cing skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang / bdud tshar gcod pa'i sngags sam thar snying gdon tshul/ skyabs yul spyan 'dren pa rnams gzhung bzhin byas la/'dir gong du phyag lan gsum btsal te zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ni 'dul ba'i sde snod las/ mdo gdon pa'i tshe dang por phyag 'tshal ba bar 170

/ /mdosde tharab chen po'i 'don thabs/du mdo gdon pa/ tha mar bsngo ba byed pa dang bcas rgyud chags gsum du gsungs pa la dgongs par 'dug pas/ dngos su phyag 'tshal ba dang sbrags bzhin pas tshigs bcad 'di dag gdon par bya ste/ bde gshegs gzhan gyis gdul bar ma nus pa/ / cher snyigs lnga bdo'i dus kyi 'gro ba la/ /lhag par brtse ba'i ston pa thugs rje can/ / 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ / mi bzad ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sa 'grim/ / rgyus med bar do'i 'phrang du bgrod rnams la/ / lhag par brtse ba'i ston pa thugs rje can/ / 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ / thog med dus nas mi dge bsags pa'i steng / / sgo gsum bag med dam tshig nyams pa la/ / lhag par brtse ba'i ston pa thugs rje can/ / 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ / gnyen bshes 'khor dang longs spyod kun bor te/ / phyi mar las kyi skyes chen 'degs rnams la/ / lhag par brtse ba'i ston pa thugs rje can/ / 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /bden gsung thub pa'i dbang bo'i bden tshig gis/ / nyes kun byang zhing mtho ris thar ba'i lam/ / rim bzhin bgrod par zhal gyis bzhes pa yi/ /bden pa deng 'dir mngon du 'gyur bar mdzod/ / ces phyag bya ba sngon du btang nas dngos gzhi mdo 'don tshul gzhung ltar la/ tshig don yid la byed pa'i dmigasanam dang / chos spyi'i lung nod pa'i cho ga jo bo'i man ngag tu grags pa ltar thub pa'i dbang pos gsung lhang lhang rang la 'doms par mos pa dang / chos bsgrags pa'i mdo bzhin dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu sogs la chos kyi sbyin pa byas par dmigs na dgos don khyad par can du ma dkyus gcig la 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / mjug tu bzang bo spyod pa sogs kyis bsngo ba bya/ khyad par gshin po lta bu'i don du yin na/'di ltar 'bad pa'i dge tshogs thams cad kyang / / dmigs yul tshe 'das 171

༄/ /gungango bstagayosgroname'iryāng 'a4/de yirjesazhugayote/ /ngan songabar do'i 'jigs skrag kun zhi nas/ /rgyal ba'i gsung giyodabug4'byin thob par shog /rtagatu dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten thob cing /bshes gnyen dam pasa'abral med rjeyosu bzung / /sa dang lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ /thar ba'i go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig /rang gi sgrib sbyong lta bur ched du dmigs pa yin na/ thog ma med nas dug gsum dbang gyur te/ /bla ma mchog gsum drin can pha ma dang / /nyam thag 'gro la gnod 'tshe bgyis pa sogs/ /mi bzad sdig pa'i tshogs rnams byang gyur cig /sdom gsum bcas pa'i mtshams las 'das shing 'gal/ /dad zas gshin zas bag med spyad pa sogs/ /nyes ltung dri ma ma lus byang gyur te/ /mtho ris thar ba'i them skas bgrod gyur cig /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba sogs dang / shākya'i dbang bo zhes sogs bya/zhes pa 'di ni or tu su'i shog nas dad brtson ldan pa gnyer ba dam chos dpal bzang gis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /172

༄/ /'jamadapalabs brjod kyibadon thabs/ro༅/ / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'don thabs bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ / na mo maspu sgo ṣā ya/ rnam kun mchog ldan chos dbyings dang / / dbyer med sgrib bral rgyal ba'i thugs/ / dam pa'i don gyi 'jam dpal la/ / mchog tu dad pas phyag bgyi'o/ / 'dir 'jam dpal mtshan brjod nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis thog mar skyabs 'gro lan gsum/sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i phyir du 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par bajod pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ / zhes pa lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal du gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal la dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ 'jam dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang bdag dang / / sangs rgyas gsang ba sgeg pa'i rdo rje sogs/ / gsang don rgyud sde so sor 'grel mdzad pa'i/ / dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gagon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ / ye shes sgon mes rab brgyan cing / / 'jig rten gsum gye mun sel ba/ / 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bdag lus longs spyod rnam dkar dge tshogs bcas/ / yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin du legs shar te/ / kun bzang bden pa'i stobs kyis 'bul lags na/ / brtse ldan nyid kyi mthu yis bames 173

༄/ /yo thang bstanaba'i name'i gsung 'bum/su gsol/ / sngon mtha' mi mngon srid pa'i grong khyer du/ / dug gsum dbang gyur sdig ltung gang bsags pa/ / rgyal kun mthu dang rgyud sde'i byin rlabs kyi/ / bdud rtsi'i chu yis lhag med sbyang du gsol/ / skye 'phags kun gyi dge tshogs /mtha dang / / khyad par zab cing rgya che'i sde snod 'dir/ / tshul bzhin thos bsam sgom pas rang gzhan gyi/ / don mchog bsgrubs pa rnams la rjes yi rang / / srid pa'i g.yang sar 'khyams pa'i dmus long kun/ / 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan thugs rje mnga' ba rnams/ / rtag tu bzhugs nas zab rgyas dam chos kyi/ / yang dag lam bzang ji bzhin bstan du gsol/ / 'dis mtshon rang gzhan dge tshogs ci mchis pa/ /don med 'khor ba'i rgyu ru mi smin zhing / / mi mthun rkyen gyis nam yang mi gzhom par/ / rgyal kun smon pa'i klong du sim gyur cig / sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ / ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ / 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog / sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / ces pa nas/ btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig / tshogs zhing rnams 'od du zhu ba rang gi smin mtshams nas thim par gyur/ oṃ su bhā wa shurnya sarba dharmā subhā wa shurnyo ྅nya/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo dī yig dmar ser yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi ba/ phyag g.yas dang pos ral gri/ gnyis pas mda'/ g.yon dang pos po ti dang / gnyis pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ ral ba'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyes brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/174

༄/ /'jam dpalamatshan brjod kyi 'don thabs/thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnasanas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ dza : baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ārya maci shrī arnya pratī tstsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ bāhūṃ nas/ shasta pra tītstsha hūṃ sāhā/ zhes mchod/rnam dag chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med pa'i/ / ye shes sgyu 'phrul gzhon nu'i rnam rol ba/ / dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig pu/ / rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rmad byung mkhyen rab 'od brgya'i snang ba yis/ / mi shes rmongs pa'i mun pa drungs phyung ste/ / mdo rgyud dka' gnad 'dab brgya 'byed pa yi/ / zab gsal blo gros snang ba stsal tu gsol/ / zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a yig la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyigasung gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus pa ma lus pa bsdus te sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par bsams la/ oṃ sarba dharmā bhā wa su bhā wa bi shu badzra tsa a ā e a pra kro ti pa ri shu sarba dharmā ya du ta sarba ta thā ga ta/ dzā na kā ya mdzi shrī pa ri shurnyi tā mu pa dā ye ti i ma sarba ta thā ga ta tre nga yi ha ra ha ra oṃ hūṃ hrī lha ga bān/ tshwa na sturnyi wā gī shwa ra ma hā pā tsa sarba dharma/ ga ga nā ma la su pa ri shu dharma ṅgā tu sko na gatta 〉 zhes bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/de nas dbus kyi sa bon las mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i tshig rnams gser gyi yi ge lta bu mar me'i phreng ba bzhin du rim gyis byung nas zla gdan la 'khod par gyur bar bsams rte/ mtshan brjod rdzogs par 'don/ mthar mchod bstod bya/ gang tshe blta bar 'dod pa'am/ / cung zad 'dri bar 'dod na 175

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgran me'igayo 'bum/yang / / mgon po 'jam dbyangs de nyid ni/ / gegs med par yang mthong bar shog / 'di bton pa las byung ba yi/ / dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa/ / des ni sems can ma lus pas/ / 'jam dbyangs go 'phang thob par shog / badzra yu ma shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rang nyid ma tshig par gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba zhes sogs dkonamachog gsum gyi shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / de yang mdo lugasakyi mdo 'don tshul ni/ 'dul ba lung las/ sbyor ba phyag bya ba dang /dngos gzhi mdo 'don pa/ mjug bsngo ba ste rgyud chags gsum du bsdus shing /mdo gdon pa'i tshe de'i bajod don yid la byed pa dang / rgyal ba rnams kyis rang la lung 'bogs pa'i rjes su zlos pa dang / dkar phyogs kyi lha sogs la chos sbyin gyi tshul du byas pa'i dmigs pa skyong ba tsam las med kyang / rgyud kyi gzhung 'don pa la/ de dag gi steng du lha'i rnal 'byor dang yang sbrags na byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che bar bla ma dam pa rnams kyis gsungs so/ / thub pa'i gsung gi snying bo mchog / gdon pa'i cho ga 'di bris pa'i/ / dge bas 'gro ba ma lus pas/ / rnam dag ye shes mchog thob shog / ces 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'don thabs 'di ni u rad shog nas dad brtson ldan pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog 'od zer gyis bskul ngor/ 7skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang rje btsun 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung la gzhi byas/ yan lag bdun pa sogs cung zad kha bskang ste/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni snyigru ratna ā nanta'o/ /rgyal ba'i dngos kun la zhugs dus kyi dbyings/ / spros bral ye shes 'jam dpal don dam pa'i/ / mtshan yang dag par brjod phyir 'dud pa 176

༄/ / 'jam dpalasatshanabarjod kyi 'don thabs/la/ / ye shes lus su grub pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod/ de'ang bla med kyi rgyud spyi dang / bye brag dus kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ gsang ldan sogs rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gang du'ang gzhol zhing 'bab pa/ 'phags bod kyi grub pa'i dbang bo ma lus pa'i thugs dam gyi snying bo 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i don dam pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa kha ton du bya ba la 'don thabs kyi rim pa 'di nyid las 'byung ba ni/thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ / ces rgyal ba sras bcas kyis rang la mgrin gcig tu gsung bar mos pa dang / ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ / ces thub dbang lta bu gcig gsal btab kyang gzhan kun de dang ye shes chos sku'i bdag nyid du dbyer med pas go chod par bsam pa dang / stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog ste/ / zab cing rgya che'isgra sgrogs pa/ / zhes brjod bya rjod byed 'khor gsum mi dmigs kyang snang stong brag cha lta bur nyan pa dang / a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog / don chen yi ge dam pa yin/ / khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med/ / ces mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor dbus kyi gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo a yig las sngags 'phreng spro ba sogs su sems pa dang / rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che/ / rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od/ / ces gdan yang zhi khro'i dbye bas zla gdan dang nyi gdan la 'god pa sogs 'di'i 'don thabs kyi man ngag yin par rje btsun grags pa rgyalamatshan gyis gsungs so/ / 'dir de dag gi gnad tshang bar byas te ngag 'don nyung bsdus su 'god pa la/ skyabs sems sngon du btang / su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo dī yig dmar ser yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon utpal la gnas pa'i sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/ gzhon nu'i cha lugs can rin po che'i rgyan gyes spras shing rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 177

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgronama'i gsung 'bum/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgon mes rab brgyan cing / / 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gang gi ye shes sgyu 'phrul las/ / ma lus 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir/ / sras bcas rgyal ba'i rnam rol ba/ / kun la dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ / rab 'byams mchod pa'i sprin gyes mchod/ /sdig ltung ma lus snying nas bshags/ / ngo mtshar spyod la rjes yi rang /zab rgyas chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ / mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba 'debs/ / dge tshogs byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ / rgyud don yang dag lam bzang kun/ / mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams kyis dgyes bzhin du lhang lhang gdams shing / thugs ka nas mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i tshig rnams gser gye yi ge lta bu mar me'i 'phreng ba bzhin rim par byung ste/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la dī yig gi mthar 'khod/ de dang mnyam du rang gi mgrin pa'i ā tpag las kyang tshigs bcad rnams rang sgra dang bcas pa grag stong brag cha lta bu mkha' khyab tu bsgrags pas sems can kun gyi rgyud la thar ba'i sa bon khyad par can bskrun par bsams te/ tshig don dran bzhin par dal bus gdon zhing / mjug tu/gang tshe blta bar 'dod pa zhes sogs bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /'di bton pa las byung ba yi/ / dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa/ / des ni 'gro ba ma lus pas/ / 'jam dbyangs go 'phang thob par shog / ces pa 'di ni hal ha'i shog gi dpyod ldan bka' bcu skal bzang bsam gtan gyis bskul ngor/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ /178

༄/ / bdebaragashegs pa'i thugs kyirten snatsā 'deb chog༄7/ / bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten sātstsha 'deb chog dang rab gnas mdor bsdus kyi skor bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / na mo dharma kā ya bi shu ye/ las dang nyon mongs nyes pa'i rdul dang bral/ / mkhyen dang brtse ba'i bang rim mngon par mtho/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i/ / mchod sdong bde gshegs chos kyi sku la 'dud/ / bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rtsa brtan rgyal dbang dpag bsam gsar ba'i ljon/ / bsod nams rnam 'phrul ngo mtshar mdzad bzang yal ga'i khyon yangs rgyas pa'i rtser/ / bsod nams 'bras bu gzugs su shar ba bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyad/ / bsod nams zhing sar gcig tu sdud pa'i rmad byung thabs mkhas bla na med/ /bsgrub par sla zhing shin tu don che ba/ / sngon rabs dam pa mang bo'i thugs dam mthil/ / satstsha'i gdams pa nyams su len pa'i tshul/ / legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston spro bar bya/ / de'ang jo bo rje lha gcig dī baṃ kā ra dang /'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje sogs dam pa gong ma mang bo'i phyag bzhes su bstar zhing / bsags sbyang gi gnad la ches mchog tu bsngags pa sātsā'i gdams pa nyams su len pa'i tshul 'phros don dang bcas cung zad phye ste 'chad pa la/ thog mar sa blang ba'i gnas ni jo bo'i tsha dgu mar/ sa chu srog chags med pa la/zhes gsungs pa'i rags pa rtogs sla'ang gtso bor gyur pa ni/ 'dul ba'i mdor/ skye 179

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/ba bo phra mo'i gnas dang ldan pa nyid/ zhes gsungs pas 'bu srin phra mo sogs kye rigs yod med legs par brtags te gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar gye sa chog rgyas pa grub na legs shing ma mtha'ang mchod rten gyi gzungs las/ gtor ma la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang sa phyogs don gnas pa'i lha dang klu dang lha ma yin la sogs pa rnams la mchod cing bsngos te/ zhes pa ltar dkar gtor sngon du btang / oṃ badzra kha na kha na hūṃ/ sa gzhi rin chen bdun gyi rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes sa gzhi byin gyis brlab/ brko ba'i sngags ni 'dul 'dzin gyis ye rnyarmā dang / rgyal dbang gi sa 'og nas 'byung ba'i brdung sngags la bya bar gsungs shing / gzungs rang las/ byin rlabs kyi sngags de nyid kyis brko ba dang / 'jim pa badzi ba'i tshe brdung sngags bzlas shing sa btul te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces badzi chu byin gyis rlob par gsungs so/ / de nas g.yon pa'i mthe bong gis mtheb chung mnan pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya kha yar bstan/ g.yas pa de bzhin byas la kha sbub pa bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi phyag rgya'i bar du 'jim pa bzung ste/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ ces sam/ gzhan gyi lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal la gnas te/su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du hūṃ las 'jim pa rin po che'i phung por gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de'i thugs nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te sems can thams cad kyi sdigazib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus 'jim pa la thim pas de nyid sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ na mo phyag 'tshalalo/ bha ga bcom ldan 'das/ wa te bai ro tsa nā ya rnam par snang mdzad la/ / pra bha rā dzā ya 'od kyi rgyal po la/ / ta thā ga tā ya de bzhin gshegs pa/ / arta te dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i samya kle bud dhā ya sangs rgyas la/ / tadu thā 'di lta ste/ /180

༄/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyirten sna 'deb choga.oṃ srusgre phra mo thā 'di lta ste/ srusgrephra mo/ sa mnyam pa me sa ma ye dam tshig/ shā 'i ba rnye dā rte dul ba/ a sa ma ro pemanyam pa med pa'i rang bzhin/ a na laste kun nasadamigs pa med pa/ ta ram snye sgrol ba/ ya sho wa te grags pa dang ldan pa/ ma hā te dzo gzi bajid chen po ni ra kū le/ kun nas rigs med pa/ nirba ṇi mid pa mya ngan las 'das pa/ sarba burtse sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ a dhiṣṭha na byin gyis rlabs kyis/ a byen gyis rlobs shig dhikhyi te swāhā/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas te byin gyis brlab cing / bsdu na/ oṃrtu ṭwāṃ hrī lnga zhes bzlas te byin gyis brlab de nas 'jimagong las dum bu so sor bcad de/ na ma sa manta bud dhā nā na/ kun nas sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhārdo rje'i tshe/ oṃ ba su de swāhā nor stsol/ zhes brjod/ 'bi 'bi bya ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ badzra ud bha wā ye sāhā/ rdo rje las yang dag par 'byung ba/ zhes gdon cing / ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rgyas par mos/'bru mar byugs pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ a rdul med pa ra dze bi rdul dang bral ba ra dze swāhā/ zhes brjod la shes rgyud gyi sdig ltung sgrib pa'i dri ma phyis te byang chub kyi sems kyis brlan par bsam/ rgyar gzhug pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badzra dhā tu gaste swāhā rdo rje dbyings kyi snying bo/ oṃ dharma dhā tu gaste sāhā chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po/ zhes brjod de bar du bcug pa dang thabs shes dbyer med du bsgom/ brdung sngags ni/ oṃ badzra mugo ra a ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā rdo rje tho bas kun nas brdungs shig zhes gdon/ oṃ sarba bibya swāhāthams cad rig pa/ zhes pas me tog 'bul/ oṃ dharmā te sā hā chos kyi dga' ba/ zhes skol phor nas dbyung / oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swāhā shin tu rab tu gnas pa'i rdo rje/ zhes pas bzhugs su gsol/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mtshams 'dir gong gi snum byugs pa'i sngags dang dmigs pas skudakar gsol bar gsungs pa/ grub na legs la med kyang chad pa'i nyes par mi 'gyur ro/ de nas/ a thra tas bgegs bsangs/ su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ las rnam par snang 181

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā /thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ dza nyu baṃ to gnyis su med par gyur/slar yang 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ dbang lhas dbangabaskur/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor 'khor los dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ phyag byar 'os palogs kyis bstod/ su pra tiṣṭha'i sngags kyis brtan par bzhugs su gsol zhing /lha rnams 'od du zhu nas mchod rten gyi rnam par gyur par bsams la bkra shis brjod/ de las kyang bsdus par byed na/ oṃ sarba ta de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ ta thā ga ta ma ṇi nor bu sha ta brgya dī pa sna ba te/ dzwa la 'bar ba dzwa la 'bar ba/ rnyarma dhā tu gaste swāhā/ nor bu/ brgya/ snang ba/ 'bar ba/ 'bar ba/chosakyi dbyangs kyi snying bo/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di brjod pas rab gnas kyi go chod par gsungs/ de nas/ oṃ su bhā wa bi shud dhe/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa/ ā ha ra/kun nas btus/ ā ha ra/ kun nas btus/ ā gatstsha/ kun nas byon/ ā gatstsha/kun nas byon/ dharma ṅgā tu gaste swāhā/ chos kyi dbyings kyi snying bo/ zhes brjod cing gnas gzhan du gdan 'dren par bshad la/ gang du spyan 'dren pa'i yul ni dri gtsang khang sogs 'o mi brgyal ba'i gnas dang / der ma zad las kye sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs las/ mchod rten 'bum byas la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas legs par mchod nas rgya mtsho chen po'am/ yang na chu klung du btang na des thams cad dmyal ba la sogs pa nas thar bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bzhin/ bu ston gye gshin po rjes 'dzin du'ang rab gnas byas te sdig pa sbyangs pa'i phyir chu klung 182

༄/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyirten sna 'deb chogadu btang ba'am/ lam gyi bzhi mdor mchod rten bya ba gnyis bshad/ zhes rang lugs mdzad pa'i phyogs dam pa gong ma mang bos kyang bzhed la/ bka' gdams kyi bstan rim las/ yang kha cig gis tsha tsha chur skyur ba'am/ chur ma bskyur yang chu'i khyer la khad chu 'gram du 'jog pa yod/ de chung ba la tsha tsha/che ba la mchod rten zer ba yin pas de mchod rten 'jig pa nye ba'i mtshams med yin gsungs/ zhes pu to ba'i gsung sgros su bkod snang ba ji ltar yin snyam na snga ma rgyud las dngos su gsungs pas de mi 'thad par bzhed pa ga la yin kyang / 'di'i dgongs pa ni 'dul 'dzin gyi rab gnas bsdus par/rang gi 'dod pa'i sa cha der mi mkho bar shes nas spong ba yin na rnam pa thams cad du mi rung ngo / / zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gi gnas der sa gcodadogs pa'am/ rang la mi 'phrod par dogs pa sogs rang don gtso bor byas te rten la rtsis med kyis chur bskyur na nye ba'i mtshams med du 'gyur ba'i don yin zhing / gcig shos chu'i srog chags sogs la phan sems kho na'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ / 'on kyang deng sang dkon mchog la gus zhen med cing / 'dres brlam dang mo ma'i kha la tshad mar byed pa'i dbang gis sdig po chegasog nyen 'dug pas lung ston pa po dang zhu ba po thams cad kyis bag zon bya dgos par snang ngo / / 'byung ba gzhan chu dang rlung sogs la 'debs pa'i bya ba ma gtogs gzhan rnams byar med pas de dag gi sngags dang dmigs pa sogs mi dgos la/ 'debs pa'i sngags ni/ chu la/ oṃ ste ya rte sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya gaste/ dzwa la dharma dhā tu gaste/ saṃ ha ra ṇa ā yu saṃ sho dha ya/ pā paṃ sarba ta thā ga tā sa manta/ bim la ukhyi ṣa bi shudhe/ ma hā bi ra dze ra ga ra si dharma dhā tu bi bi sa ra a a ma ma gi swāhā/ zhes bajod cing chu de thams cad thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin gyi mchod rten 183
