༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/du gyur bar bsam/ rlung dang bar snang skya seng sogs la/ oṃ sbyo ye rtezhes pa nas bi bi sa ra a a e yi su hā/ zhes gdon/ de ltar btab pa rjes su dge ba spel ba'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa ni/ tadu thā/ surje susgre/ sharnye sharnye/ darnye darte/ni ra ku le/ ya sho te dzo/ sarba bu / arnyi ji na/ arnyi spyo te/ a nu mi ri te swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di lan gcig brjod nas mchod rten gcig btab pa'ang bya ba btab pa'i dge rtsar 'phel ba gzungs nyid las gsungs pas shin tu gnad che'o/ / mjug gi bsngo ba sogs ni thun mong du bya ba'am/ jo bo'i tsha dgu mar dge ba so sor bsngo tshul gsungs pa gang mos bya/ de'ang sa la btab na phyag mchod skor ba sogs kyi rten du bzhugs pas bsod nams yun du 'phel ba dang / chu dang rlung la btab na rgyun dang dzi phyogs kyi srog chags thams cad la phan pas dgos pa che zhing / me la de gnyis ka ma tshang bas 'debs byed kyi sngags sogs ma gsung ngo / / 'di la kha cig 'di snyam du/ chu dang rlung la sngags 'debs par gsungs pa yin gye/ tsha tsha 'debs pa'i don ma yin pas chu 'bum rlung 'bum sogs la shes byed med do snyam na/shes pa thams cad mthar phyin par grub pa mchod rten gyi gzungs las/'byung ba chen po gang la mchod rten btab kyang bskal ba dpag tu med pa thams cad kyi sgrib pa'i dri ma dag nas/ khyim bdag gi rigs shing sā la chen po lta bur skyes nas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes sa'i 'byung ba gcig pu tsam zhig ma yin par chu sogs 'byung ba gang dang gang la btab kyang phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ don 'di ni rigs pas kyang grub ste/ 'od zer dri med las/ mchod rten 'di lta bu mi lam du rmis sam/ rgyang nas mthong ngam/ dril bu'i sgra thos sam/mchod rten bzhengs pa rna bar gtam thos pa de dag kyang mtshams med pa lnga la 184

༄/ / bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten snasmo 'deb chogasogs te sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang ste/ zhes de la btags pa'i dril bu rlung gis bskyod pa'i sgra thos pa tsam gyis kyang sdig sgrib 'dag par gsungs na/ mchod rten gyi rnam par bzhengs pa'i chu sogs kyis reg pas sdig sgrib 'dag pa smos ci dgos pa'i phyir te/ gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs las/ tha na grib ma phog na'ang yongs su grol bar 'gyur na/ bya ba mang du byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar mthong thos dran reg tsam la bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i mtshad rten de lta bu gsar du bzhengs pas bsod nams ji snyed cig thob ce na/ las dang phan yon bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs las/ phan yon bco brgyad gsungs zhing /khyad par du kṛ ya dgung bzang las/ gtsang zhing rab tu dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ / 'jim pa'am ni bye ma las byas pa'i/ / bde gshegs mchod rten rten 'brel snying bo can/ / sdig pa sbyangs pa'i phyir ni rtag tu gdab/ / ces sgrib sbyong gi mchog tu gsungs pa dang / khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'di rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa can la las rin chen sna bdun gyis bkang ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa rnams dang / lan gcig phyir 'ong ba rnams dang / phyir mi 'ong ba rnams dang / dgra bcom pa rnams dang /rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun la phul ba bas/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mchod rten 'jim pa las skyu ru tsam byed du 'jug srog shing ni khab tsam 'dzugs su 'jug gdung ni rgya shug gi lo ma tsam 'gebs su 'jug na/ kun dga' bo 'di nyid de bas bsod nams shin tu mang bar nga smra'o/ / zhes pa nas stong gsum gyi bar du sbyar te/ rin chen bdun gyis bkang nas de dag la phul ba las tsha tsha skyu ru ra tsam zhig bzhengs 185

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/pa bsod nams che bar gsungs shing / byang sa'i 'grel ba rgya mtsho sprin gyis mdzad pa las kyang mchod rten gcig bzhengs pa'i bsod nams yongs su bzung ba'ang tshangs pa'i bsod nams bzung bar 'gyur na/ du ma nyid bzhengs pas ni tshangs pa du ma nyid kyi bsod nams yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes sogs mtha' yas kyang 'dir ni spro ba skyed pa'i phyir zur tsam smos pa yin gyi/ rgyas par ni rgyud dang mdo mang sogs las shes par bya'o/ /smras pa/ 'di lta'i rnam dkar las la brtson rnams kyi/ / lag pa'i yal 'dab dge ba'i 'khri shing ste/ / gzhan du bza' btung kho nar spyor ba de'i/ / mnyen ldug sor mo ring yang lder phreng yin/ / nyam chung sgyu ma'i lus kyi 'jim gong yang / / yon tan kun ldan rgyal ba'i mchod rten du/ / sgyur byed thabs kyi yang rtser skor phor 'di/ / mdo rgyud dgongs don bzhu blug 'phrul las byung / / 'dir 'bad las byung legs byas mchog gi rgyas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i 'dzin mar btab pa las/ / spangs rtogs yon tan grwa zur rdzogs pa yi/ / mchod sdong 'phreng ba tshar du dngar bar shog / ces satsāgadab pa'i tshul chu dang rlung sogs la'ang 'deb pa'i shes byed phan yon mdor bsdus pa dang bcas pa 'di ni thu med pe'i si'i shog gzhung don 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa rdo rams pa 'jigs med rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du bris pa'o/ /sku par dang sātsā btab pa sogs la me tog 'thor 'bul bgyid tshul bzhugs so/ /na mo ratna tra yu ya/ de'ang rten la rab gnas dngos gzhi byed na rgyas bsdus 186

༄/ /bdebar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten sna 'deb chogagang dgosashāng dam pa gong mas mdzad pa mang la/ 'dir nyin re bzhin sku par dang satsā btab pa lta bur me tog 'thor 'bul bgyid tshul ni/ na mo rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos srung dang bcas pa rnams dang /khyad par du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bden pa'i stobs kyis rten 'di nyid 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing du gnas pa la bar chad rtsom par byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs rnams rang gnas su songs shig / susta ni sogs brjod de bgegs bskrad/ ye dharmā lan bdun bzlas la/ ye dharmā 'od du zhu nas me tog la thim par gyur/ zhes 'thor 'bru byin gyis brlabs/ rten rnams trī khyi 'am/ a spo tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las pad nyi la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje 'jigasabyed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag so bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/mgrin par ā thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ma'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ rab tu gnasakhya'i lha so so'i ye shes pa gshin rje'i gshed po'i lha tshogs kyi rnam pa can dbang lha dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ dam ye dbyer med du gyur cing dbang lhas dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ / 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ / rgyal ba rnams kyis khyod kyi ni/ / mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal/ / oṃ tsagru tsakhru sam nta tsa bi sho dha na ye sā hā/ zhes spyan dbye/ mchod pa so sor byin gyis brlabs par mos la/ oṃ ā :/ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ ya manta ka arnya sogs kyis mchod/gdugs mchog mchog tu drag po che/ / zhes sogs kyis bstod/ trī khyi dang /ya mānta ka/ yo ā ྅/ rnams lan bdun re bzlas la/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed 'od du zhu nas rten so so'i rnam par gyur/ ces gzugs bsgyur/ 'groba'i 187

lhu/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/don gzigs brtse chen mthu ldan rnams/ / sems can don phyir rtag tu 'dir bzhugs nas/ / thub bstan dar zhing bdag sogs ma lus pa'i/ /sgrib byang don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/lan gsum/ bla ma yi dam rnams kyi bkra shis shog / bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog / ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dam can chos srung rnams kyi bkra shis shog / gnas skabs tshe ring nad med bkra shis shog / mthar thug byang chen 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / yangs pa'i 'jig rten bde 'byor bkra shis shog / thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / ces me tog 'thor/ 'on kyang sāsmo la de'i cho ga bsdus pa zur du yod pas/ de bzhin byas kyang legs so/ / zhes pa 'di ni dadaldan sbyin pa'i bdag po thu sa lag chi rnam rgyal rdo rjes bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /sprun dbye'i cho ga lagatu blang bde ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru be/ bdag bskyed grub nas dkar gtor bsngo/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ zhes pa nas/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rab tu gnas pa la bar chad rtsom par byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad skad cig gis 'dir bkug par gyur/ ces sogs nas/ nga yis gnas 'dir rab gnas cho ga byed/ / ces tshig sgyur/ bgegs gtor grub rjes/ hrī khyi sa bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams mi dmigs pa stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las 188

༄/ /bdebar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi na sna 'deb chogardo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag ces pa nas/ g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ṭwāṃXpa / dho~X ṭwāṃsna dazhesapa na sa du rshar ba nghruni/sa dī~X ༵ ༷ ༷ ṭwāṃX su ṭwāṃ /hrī ha sto mahā kro dha/ zhes pa nas/ ku ru swā hā/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gye nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ trī khyi blu kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ trī khyi ha zhes pa nas/ gtso bo'i rtsa zhal gyi dbu la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid la thim par gyur/ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ / 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis khyod kyi ni/ / mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal/ / oṃ tsakhru tsagru sa manta tsakhru bi sho dha na ye swāhā/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang / / gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ / sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog / zhi ba la sogs pa'i las rnams bsgrub pa'i don du sbyin bdag la sogs pa la ye shes kyi gzigs pa lhur mdzad par gyur/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ dag cing dri med mas chu bzhi/ rgyal ba rnams ni yon tan mchog gi sku/ / sogs kyis nyer spyod rol mo/ rin chen dbang rgyal mas 'dod yon lnga/ dzam bu chu gser mas rgyal srid sna bdun rnams dbul/ yab yum gnyis ga'i sngagasagasham du 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dbul/ 'jam dpal gser mdog mas bstod/ oṃ hrī khyi blu kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya mānta ka hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ hūṃ ṭwāṃ spyo ya rnams 'tsham pa re bzlas la/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum 'od du zhu nas gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rnam par 189

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gyur/ gsung rab sogs la'ang tshig sgyur skabs bstun bya/ ye dharmā ci mang bzlas la/ye dharmā 'od du zhu nas me tog gi tshom bu re re la gnas par gyur/ phyogs bcu / rdotram̐X dhri rdodī ༵ngarji dīsda /dī dī ra lab da nga mnya ༵༷dī ṭwāṃdī ༵ dī/ dhri khams rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu'ang sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di dag las dang chu dang me dang rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar de srid du sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye sāhā/ phun sumatshogs pa mas shis brjod bya gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ rab 'byams rgyal ba ma dang / rgyal yum 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug khyod/ /sgrub sde 'di yi srung mar mnga' gsol lo/ / phyi dang nang gi 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / / mthun rkyen ma lus 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / mthu stobs nus pa ma dang / sngags 'chang bka' srung chen po khyod nyid kyis/ /sde 'dir 'tshe ba'i dgra rnams gzhom pa dang / chu bdag gdengs can 'di yi mgon mdzad cing / / chos dang mthun pa'i longs spyod rgyas par mdzod/ /gsang 'dus kyi rab yangs mas shis brjod bya'o/ / shin tu bsdus pa byed na/ hrī khyis bsangs/ swā bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu/ phyag so bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug pa/ g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par bee thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros bsgoms pa 190

༄/ /bdebar gshegs pa'i thugs kyirten snatsho 'deb chogadang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dbang lha dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ dza : baṃ hoganyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa dang nang mchod sngags kyis dbul/ gzugs mchog mas bstod/ ya mānta ka dang / oṃ (tī 〉 〉 zhes pa lan gsum re bzlas la/rdo rje 'jigs byed 'od du zhu nas gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rnam par gyur/ yedha rmā nas/ su pra tiṣṭha'i bar dang / che ba'i che mchog mas shis brjod bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di dag ni ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi 'du khang rten dang brten par bcas par rab gnas brgya rtsa byed skabs lag tu blang bde bar/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bsgrigs pa'o/ /191

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / su rtsapa'i gtor ma gtong tshul gyi rnam bzhag bzhugs so/ /༄za/ / bla ma dang 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gang gi thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / las nyon sdug bsngal gdung ba kun sel zhing / / zag med bde ba'i dpal la sbyor mdzad pa/ / thugs rje'i gter chen de yis ring du skyongs/ / de yang sgrub par sla la don shin tu che ba su rū par grags pa'i gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis dus nam gyi tshe gtong ba ni/ de nyid kyi gzungs las/zas ma zos pa'i sngon rol nyid du sbyin par bya'o/ / zhes dang / kun gzigs lnga bas/ gtor ma gong ma gsum po'i dus la nges pa med cing su rū pa ni nges par bza' btung gang yang ma byas pa'i sngon du gtong dgos la/deng sang phyag len lhan cig tu mdzad pa'i dbang gis tho rangs kyi cha'am 'phyi yang zas skom la longs ma spyad pa'i gong du/ zhes gsungs pa ltar la/ de yang 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa yan chad du gtor ma cha bzhi'i grangs su 'byung ba las zur du mi mdzad kyang / phyis su dam pa 'ga' zhig gis 'phags pas mdzad pa'i rgyun gtor gyi nang nas yi dwags la gtor ma gtong tshul de nyid logs su bkol bar sngags kyi sgo nas ming yang su rū pa zhes grags so/ / de la su ni nyer bsgyur nyi shu'i nang gi mdzes pa dang legs pa sogs la 'jug cing / rū pa gzugs kyi skad dod yin pas de bzhin gshegs 192

༄/ / su rū pa'i gtoras gtong tshul gyirnam bzhagapa gzugs mdzes kyi sngags kyi sgo nas gtor ma sbyin pa yin te/ 'di'i gzungs kyi mjug tu yang / gzugs legs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / kha cig de ltar ma go bar su rū pa zhes pa bod skad du 'khrul nas tsha gsur grang gsur dang / me gsur chu gsur sogs kyi tha snyadabyed pa don ma yin te/ kun gzigs lnga bas/ deng sang me gsur chu gsur zhes mchog dman kun la grags shing / yi ge mang bor yang phyogs mthun du bkod par snang mod/ me gsur la mdo sogs kyi zin so med cing /gsang sngags gsar ma'i phyogs su ma grags pas sngon rabs khungs btsun gyi yiger yang ma 'khod/ de'i khungs ni gsang sngags rnying ma phyogs la brten dgos shing / rdzas me la btab pa'i gsur ming dang don mthun pa yin/zhes pa nas/ chus gsur mi yong ba gnag dzi rgan pos kyang shes pa de'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ / 'dir gang gi lha'i rnal 'byor dang sngags kyi sgo nas gtor ma gtong ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes ni/ paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi gtor ma'i rnam bshad las/ 'di dag gi ngos 'dzin la kha cig rin chen mang rin 'byung / gzugs mdzes dam pa su rū pa'i dus kyi gzugs mdzes/ sku 'byams klas rnam snang gangs chen mtsho/ 'jigs bral don grub tu 'dod/ sa skya pa ni bzhi bo de sngon byung 'das pa'i dus sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan bzhi bo sangs rgyas dbang phyug yon tan dang spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs nas shākya thub pa la gsungs par bzhed la zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar lugs sna tshogs yod kyang / jo bo yab sras kyis/ rin chen mang shāka thub/ gzugs mdzes spyan ras gzigs/ sku 'byams klas 'jam dbyangs 'jigs bral phyag rdor du bzhed cing / rgyu mtshan ni/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad par/ gzugs mang mnga' zhing bde skyid rab sbyin 193

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/pa/ / zhes dang / mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa tshig lhug tu/ yid du mchi ba/sdug pa/ blta na sdug pa/ nyams dga' bar bgyid pa zhes 'byung la/'jam dbyangs kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad par/ sems can rnams kyi bsod nams tshogs/ / shin tu rgyas pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ / zhes mtshan gyi phan yon sbyin pa'i ngo bo sogs je rgyas su 'gyur bar gsungs pa dang / phyag rdor gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad par/ 'jigs las grol ba rab 'jigs pa/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa la brten nam snyam/ 'on kyang kun mkhyen bla ma'i chu gtor rnam bshad las me tog gi tshogs zhes bya ba'i mdor/ gzugs snang ba dang ldan pa'i zhing gi de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs zhes pa de gzugs mdzes yin la/ rin chen mang yang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag sum cu na 'jig rten gyi khams mthu bo che dang ldan par sangs rgyas rin chen mang zhes pa zhig bzhugs par 'og nas 'byung ba de nyid yin par gsungs te/gzhan gnyis ngos 'dzin gsal kha ma mdzad kyang / mdo 'di'i bam po gsum po ril gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan 'ba' zhig gsungs pas/ de'i grangs shig yin par mngon/ gang ltar yang / gzugs mdzes kyi mtshan brjod pas yi dwags rnams kyi lus dang / sbyin rgyu'i gtor ma sogs kyi yid du mi 'ong ba'i cha thams cad sbyangs nas dga' bde phun sum tshogs pa skyed par gsungs pas/ 'dir yang de'i sgo nas gtso bor byed pa yin no/ / de la thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang /rang nyid skad cig gis de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes su gyur/ oṃ badzra a spi ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa shu sarba dharma su bhā wa shurnyo ྅rta/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las sbyi las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ las gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa 194

༄/ /su rū pa'i gtoras gtong tshul gyinam bzhagazag med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā rtu/ lan gsum brjod/mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis yi dwags thams cad bkug ste bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po la longs spyad pas tshim 'ing bde bas rgyud gang bar gyur/ g.yon pas se gol gtog cing / na ma su rū pā ya ta thā ga tā ya arta te sa myag saṃ burnya ya/ tadu thā/ oṃ su ru su ru/ pra su ru pra su ru/ ta ra ta ra/ bha ra bha ra/ sasta ra sasta ra/ sma ra sma ra/ santadhā ༷zhi/ nas /bheg ༵ ༵ rjidzhai ṭwāṃ / ṭwāṃ ༷༷ /phya/ ༷ rjo~X ༵sum rdom ba didin ga didi/sa dī gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes brjod pas yi dwags rnams kyi mdun du zad mi shes pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dod yon lnga la sogs pa byung bar bsam sa pa sa rachu/ a ba tā ra/ prekṣi ḍodhā me haṃ/ sarba lo ka dha tu bha bī rna/ sarba bretā nā ma hā ram/ zhes pa'am/ yang na de nyid bod skad du bsgyur te/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i yi dwags rnams la bdag bza' ba 'di ster gyi/ glags lta ba rnams phyir dengs shig ces brjod/ ye dha rma'i sngags sam/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / / de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ / rgyu las 'gog pa gang yin pa/ / dge spyong chen pos de skad gsungs/ / zhes pa'i tshigs bcad brjod de chos kyi sbyin pa bya/ phan tshun 'dzer dang 'thab rtsod med pa ru/ / bde bar zas thob longs spyod dbang bo tshim/ / bkres skom phongs pa'i sdug bsngal las grol nas/ / mtho ris thar ba'i bde ba thob par shog / ces smon lam gdab/ 'di la rgyal dbang gi gsung dpar mar/ phan tshun byer dang zhes 'byung yang / 'gro mgon 195

༄/ /gung bstan pa'izlaname gsung 'bram/'phags pas mdzad pa'i rgyun gtor las/ phan tshun 'dzer ba dang / 'thab rtsod la sogs pa med par ci bde bar mnyam por thob cing / zhes 'byung ba de nyid tshigs bcad du bsdebs par snang bas snga ma yi ge ma dag par mngon/yang na paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi gsung las 'byung ba ltar/ yi dwags thams cad bza'ab dang btung ba la sogs pa'i 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod par gyur cig / bkres pa dang skom pa dang phongs pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag las grol bar gyur cig/ mtho ris dang thar ba'i bde ba rnam par dag pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig sbyin pa 'di yi bsod nams gang / / de dag yi dwags rjes 'gro zhing / / yi dwags 'jig rten rab 'jig nas/ / de kun gnas nas thar bar shog / ces sogs kyi bsngo bas rgyas 'debs/ sarba bhu ta gasmo/ zhes brjod pas yi dwags rnams rang gnas su song bar bsam mo/ / de ltar bsngos pas yi dwags rnams kyis thob tshul ni/su rū pa'i gzungs mdo las/ gzungs 'dis chu dang bcas pa'i zan la lan bdun yongs su bzlas te/ lag pa g.yon pas se gol gye sgra lan gsum du byas nas yi dwags thams cad la dben pa'i sa phyogs su sbyin par bya zhing /zhes pa nas/ yi dwags thams cad la 'bras bre bo che re re'i bza' ba so sor sbyin par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs shing / paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kye gtor ma'i rnam bshad las/ yi dwags re res kyang 'bras chan dang bdud rtsi yul ma ga dha'i bre tshad bdun bdun thob par bshad/ bre tshad re re la tshong 'dus mgur mo'i gser bre'i khal bzhi dang bre bzhi 'gro ba 'dug pas/ de la rtsis pas 'o skol gyi khal brgyad bre brgyad 'thob pa 'dug gsungs/ zhes pa ltar na mdo rgyud kyi bshad tshul gzhan yang mang du yod par mngon/ de ltar btang ba'i phan yon yang 'di nyid kyi gzungs mdo las/ de ltar byas na skye 196

༄/ / su rū pa'i gtoram gtong tshul gyi3ma bzhagab nas skye bar yang nyams chung bar mi 'gyur ro/ / dbul bor mi 'gyur ro/ / stobs che ba dang / mdzes pa dang / mthong na dga' ba dang / phyug cing longs spyod che che bar 'gyur ro/ / tshe ring zhing nad med pa dang / myur dubla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ / shi 'phos nas kyang bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i tshul la tshad ma'i lung gi rjes su 'brang bas yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po bskyed de 'bad pa lhur blang bar bya'o/ /'dir 'bad dge ba'i sprin sngon phung bo las/ / rlabs chen bsod nams gru char babs pa yis/ / mngon mtho'i dpal gyi snye ma g.yur za zhing / / nges legs 'bras bu'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni snga sor dad brtson blodang ldan pa ra kho ye shes kyis 'di'i cho ga shes byed kyi khungs dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul gyi bskul ma byas yod pa'i thog nye char rab 'byams pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa dza yachu/ /197

༄/ /gung tha bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / bzang spyod la brten pa'i 'chi blu'i cho ga skye 'gro'i dbugs 'byin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rten bzang yid bzhin nor/ / ring du gnas pa shin tu don che bas/ / 'tsho ba brtan byed 'chi blu'i cho ga ni/ / rgyud dang dam pa'i man ngag bzhin bshad bya/ / de'ang 'chi blu'i gdams pa ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas dam tshig gsum bkod/ sgrol dkar/ sor 'brang sogs la brten pa dang / dze tā ris tshe dpag med la brten pa sogs gsungs pa las/ dam tshig gsum bkod la brten pa bzang spyod 'chi blur grags pa 'di ni don shin tu che ste/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i 'chi blu'i gzhung las/ bzang spyod yi dam bcas pa yi/ / cho ga yis ni 'bum bzlas na/ / thar ba nges par skyed byed na/ / 'chi ba blu ba smos ci dgos/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de'ang bzang spyod yi dam bcas zhes pa ni gtso bor bzang bo spyod pa ste sems can la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis zin dgos pa'i don yin pa ni dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po las/ ji ltar sems can rnams 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces rnam par bsam la bzlas pa bya'o/ / de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi nad rnams rab tu zhi ba dang / zhes pa nas/ stobs bcu mkhyen pa'i sa la sems can so sor gnas paragyur cig ces bya ba la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang sems can la phan pa'i rgyur dmigs te sngags bzla bar bya'o/ / zhes dang / sgrub pa 'dis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la rab tu dang ba bskyed nas byang chub kyi sems kyis 198

༄/ / bzangaspyod la brten pa'i 'chi blu'i cho g.yongs su bzung ba de yis nges par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs so/ / 'on kyang de gsal 'deb pa'i phyir bzang spyod sogs gdon pa'ang bstan pa yin te/ de nyid las/ thabs la mkhas pa 'dis kyang yongs su zin par bya ste/ smon lam rgya chen poco ba dang / zhes pa nas/ sdong bo bkod pa la sogs pa shin tu rgya chen po'i mdo dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rgyu la rab tu 'jug pa klog pa nyid dang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ cho ga zhes pa sgrub tshul yin la/ de'ang gtso bor yan lag bdun pa'i sgo nas byed tshul rgyud 'di'i gong 'og kun tu gsungs pa dang / mchod bstod smon pa sogs kyi mthu skyed pa'i thabs mkhas kyi sngags kyang lan du mar gsungs pa rnams yinasgo/ / dpe la lar/ cho ga yis ni 'di bzlas na/ / zhes 'byung yang / 'bum bzlas na zhes pa dag ste/ der sgrol dkar sogs la 'bum phrag bcu dgos par gsungs pa bzhin/ 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya 'bum bzla dgos pa'i don yin gyi bzang spyod kyi grangs min no/ / 'bum gsungs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang du byas kyi nges gzung min te/ nyin zhag gcig gis kyang 'grub par gsungs pas so/ / thar ba nges par skyed byed na/ / 'chi ba blu ba smos ci dgos/ / zhes pa ni rgyud de nyid las tshig zin la 'chi ba blu bar bstan pa med kyang gnas skabs mthar thug gi phan yon mang du gsungs pa'i mthar/ mdor na mthar gyis byang chub la gzhol zhing so sor 'god pa de/ zhes byang chub thar ba'i go 'phang la'ang 'god nus na tshe bsring nus pa smos ci dgos zhes don gyis 'phang bas phan yon bstan pa yin no/ / 'di nyid lag tu na par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su byi dor byas la dkon mchog gi rten mang du bkram/ mchod pa sna lnga nyung mtha' nyer gcig tsam gyis mtha' bskor/ gtso bo la thum gtor rgyan ldan gcig dang gzhan dkar gtor ba'i bcas bsham/ 'dir bsham rgyu'i rten yang rgyud de nyid las gong 'og tu bris sku byed tshul rim pa du ma zhig gsungs na'ang / skabs 'di dang 'brel ba la gtso bo dam tshig gsum bkod sku mdog gser mdog chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya can sprul sku'i rnam pa dang /g.yas su kun tu bzang bo sku mdog ser po ral gri'am rin po che 'dzin pa/ g.yon du 199

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/rta mchog gi shugs can ma sku mdog lngang gu phyag thal mo sbyar ba dang / phyag na rdo rje sku mdogasngon po phyag g.yas rdo rje 'dzin cing g.yon thal mo sbyar ba/ de gsum sems dpa'i cha lugs can/ kun tu bzang bo'i 'og tu sgrub pa po rang nyid gtso bo la mngon du phyogs nas yong ba 'bri bar gsungs pa lta bu'am/ yang na paṇa chen gsung gi e waṃ las dam tshig gsum bkod kyi mngon rtogs su bkod pa ltar bris pa byung na legs la/de min yang dam tshig gsum bkod kyi sku dang / de ma byung tshe thub pa'i sku zhig med mi rung du dgos so/ / sgrub pa po'ang dge slong tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bzhi tsam ma mtha' dgos pas/ de dag tshogs nas thog mar sdom gsum so so'i phyir bcos gzhung bzhinabyu/ gal te ma 'dzom na'ang spyi bshags lan gsum mthong sdom dri ba thabs legs dang bcas pa rgyud dag nges par bya/ de nas rgyud las/ sems can sdug bsngal brnams kyi don yongs su mi nyams par bya ba'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ zhes pa nas/snga dro dang po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bdag nyid dbul bar bya ste/ zhes bdag 'bul ba'i sgo nas byang sdom gso dgos par gsungs pas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi dmigs rnam legs par gsal btab la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā da brnya ṭwāṃ ka ro mi/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la byang chub snying bo la mchis kyi bar du bdag nyid dus thams cad du yong ye 'bul na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bdag bzhes su gsol/bdag la dngos grub bla na med pa stsal tu gsol/ zhes bdag 'bul/ thal mo bkan pa las mdzub mo bkug pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dam rgya bcas la oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta urnya wa ye swāhā/ zhes phyag rgya mgo bor bzhag de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul gsal btab la/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ / byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ / rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ / bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ / zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs 200

/ /bzangaspyod la brten pa'i 'chi blu'i cho ga'agro sems bskyed bya/ de nas/ mar gyur sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / ces sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/de nas/ de ltar bdag gi de kho na nyid don dam par spros pa thams cad dang bral ba ji ltar yin pa de bzhin du lha'i de kho na nyid kyang de ltar yin pas/ de gnyis chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin du rnam par mi rtog pa'i snang ba'i sgo de nyid du bdag dang lha'i de kho na nyid dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las na ma ste ya dhi kā rna ta thā ga tā ṭwāṃ/ sarba tā pra ti ha tā bā ste dharma tā pā li ṭwāṃ/༵ ༵ / ༵ / ༷༵ ṭwāṃ ྅༷ sdi ༷ ༷ shā ༷ ṭwāṃ /bā~X ra ༵ ༷ /ha ༷/ ra ༵ ༵ ༵ /yab / gab na ma hā ba ra lakṣa ṇi/ dzā le lan sā ga re swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi gdangs kyi rnam pa nam mkha' la grags par gyur/ bdag dang lha'i de kho na nyidadabyer mi phyed pa'i rnam pa can gyi rang gi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sngags kyi gdangs kyi rnam pa nam mkha' la grags pa de nyid shin tu dag pa'i dngul chu gser gyi bye ma la zhen pa ltar yig 'bru bris pa'i rnam pa can du 'khod pa yongs su gyur pa las bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed kyi mthar na ma ste ya/ zhes pa nas na sā ga re swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis mtshan par gyur/ zla ba phyag mtshan sngags dang bcas pa las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros pa'i rtse mo las bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i lha'i gzugs dpag tu med pa byung bas nam mkha'i dbyengs thams cad khyab par byas/ rgyal ba thams cad la mchod pa'i sprin chen po sprul bas legs par mchod/ gzhan yang sprin chen po sprul ba las bdud rtsi'i char rgyun babs pas dmyal ba la sogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi me rnams zhi zhing bde bas tshim par byas nas lha'i sku dang bcas pa'i 'od zer slar log rang 201

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang phyag mtshan sngags dang bcas pa la dzim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dam tshig bkod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu dar gyi chos gos dang mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ phyag gnyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgyas 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sel bar gyur ba'i spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar oṃ gyis mtshan pa/mgrin par spru las padma dmar po'i lte bar ā sa mtshan pa/ thugs gar hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ sngar gyi dam rgya spyi bo/ snying ga smin mtshams/ mgrin pa/ dpung mgo gnyis te gnas drug tu reg cing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta urte wa ye swāhā/ zhes bajod/ thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ na ma sarba bu bo rnyi satwa ṭwāṃ/ sarba thā ugo te spa ra ṇa hi mi ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes mchod pa 'byung ba'i sngags brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ jo rtu baṃ to gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa shuste sarba dharma su bhā wa shusgo ྅nya/stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin stong ba rnam pa mchod rdzas byed las dbang bo drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ na ma sarba bu bo dhi satā ṭwāṃ/ sarba thā ugo te spa ra ṇa nyi mi gag na khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ ā ā : nas/ oṃ shasta 〉 rtu gi bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ na ma sarba bu bo dhi satā ṭwāṃ/ sarba tra saṃ ku su mi ta a snyi sko rā shi ni na ma stu te sāhā/ zhes bstod pa 'byung ba'i sngags kyis thog 202

༄/ /bzangastod la brten pa'i 'chi blu'itsho gadrangs/ gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe/ / sa chen 'di la gom pa bdun bor nas/ / nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs/ / de tshe mkhagapa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ / ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra/ / grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba/ / mgon po mchog brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal/ / gser mchog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis/ / mnyam med mkhyen can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ / bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / / de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dag pas 'dod chags bral bar gyur/ / dge bas ngan song las grol cing / / gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ / zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ / grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ / bslab pa dag la rab tu gnas/ / zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/ / dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ / sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum la rtag tu gus phyag 'tshal/ / zhes phyag bya/ de nas/ rang gi thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tri yig dri ma med pa gser btso ma lta bu'i mtha' skor du na ma ste ya dhi kā ṭwāṃ ta thā ga tā ṭwāṃ/ sarba tā pra ti ha tā ba sti dharma tā bā li ṭwāṃ/ a sa ma sa ma sa marnyo3sgyu bste shā sa ni/ ha ra ha ra sma ra sma ra ṇa/bi ga ta rā ga bud dha rnyarma te/ sa ra sa ra sa ma thā la/ ha sa ha sa/ tra ya tra ya/bha ga wā na mahā ba ra lakhra ṇi/ dzwa la dzwa la na sā ga re sāhā/ zhes pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rnams zhi bar byas/sangs rgyas sras bcas la mchod pa phul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 203

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'isgroname'i khrung 'bum/thams cad bsdus te rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya ba'i sngags de nyid gang mang bzla/ gtso bo la 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las hūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i lha tshogs spyan drangs/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur par bsams la oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta yi de ba bla ta kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma dbul/ arnya sogs kyis mchod/ bcom ldan thugs rje mnga' ba yis/ / bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas/ / dus min 'chi ba las bskyabs te/ / mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsol/ / ces 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ dkar gtor bzhi sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ tsa tur mahā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e bye nyi/ zhes rgyal chen bzhi spyan drangs/ dkar gtor dang por dmigs te/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ tsa tur mahā rā dza sa pa ri wā i de ba bo ta kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ gsum sogs kyis dbul/ tsa tur mahā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arnya sogs kyis mchod/ dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs thams cad du/ / chos skyong srung ma khyed rnams dang 'grogs nas/ / bar chad spyi dang khyad par 'chi ba kun/ / myur du bsgog pa'i 'phrin las dam pa mdzod/ / ces 'phrin las bcol/ dkar gtor gnyis pa/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sasta ra sasta ra hūṃ/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis 'byung bo la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 204

༄/ / bzangaspyod la brten pa'i 'chi spu'i cho ga'atshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo / de bzhinagashegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun tshogs 'dod yon lnga ldan pa'i/ / bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di/ /tshe dang srog rnams 'phrog pa yi/ / 'byung bo'i gdon rnams kun la bsngo/ /bzhes nas tshe yi bar chad kun/ / myur du bzlog par byas nas kyang / / byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang / / rtag tu sdongs grogs gnyan po mdzod/ / ces 'phren las bcol/ dkar gtor gzhan gnyis slar 'chi ba zlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pa na gtang rag la dbul snyam du gta' gtor gyi tshul du 'jog /de nas dkon mchog spyi la bshams pa'i mchod pa/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i sgod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin stong ba rnam pa mchod rdzas byed las dbang bo drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ oṃ arnya ā : nas oṃ shasta 〉 rtu gi bar dang mchod pa 'byung ba'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab/ de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dmigs nas spyan 'dren pa 'di ltar brjod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa' dang / / yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang / / nyan thos rang rgyal 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas/ / khyed rnams 'chi bdag bdud kyi sde bcom pa'i/ / bden pa de yis deng 'dir 'chi bdag dpung / / 'joms phyir 'khor dang bcas pa rdzu 'phrul gyis/ / thogs pa med par mdun gye nam mkhar gshegs/ / bdag dang sbyin bdag rnams la dgyes bzhin bzhugs/ / zhes spyan drangs pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs 205

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/pa'i rin po che'i khri dpangs mtho zhing yangs pa'i steng du skyabs yul rnams bdag dang sbyin bdag la dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsams shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams kun tu bzang bo'i mchod sprin du dmigs nas phul bar mos la/ dag dang ma dag zhing khams ji snyed pa/ / de snyed kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis gang / / de kun mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang / /bdug spos mar me dri ro rol mor bsgyur/ / de yis bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ / bdag dang 'di la thugs brtses bzhes nas kyang / / 'chi ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal ba dang / / thar ba'i go 'phang ster ba'i dngos grub stsol/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a snu dza me gha pa mu da spa ra ṇa sa ma ye 〉 rtu/ de bzhin du pābye nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang / /gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla rdzas rtags gnyis/ / rgyal srid bdun dang nye ba'i rin chen bdun/ / mchod pa'i sprin phung ma tshang med pa yis/ /bcom ldan thugs rje'i gter gyur shākya'i rgyal/ / la sogs dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum/ / mnyes phyir 'bul gyi dgyes bzhin legs bzhes nas/ / 'chi ba blu ba'i dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa nas/ sparsha'i bar dang / aṣā mgo la snu dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye ā rtu/zhes pa dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba snu dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye ā :/zhes pa rnams kyis mchod/ skabs 'dir khrus gsol bya/ de nas maṇḍal phul zhing me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mu 206

༄/ / bzangaspyod la brten pa'i 'chi blu'i cho gamatha' grangs med pa na 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang rgyal ba'i sras po rnams dang nyan thos chen po rnams dang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dang / khyad par du sbyin pa'ibadag po che ge mo 'khor g.yog ltos bcas thams cad dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba las ldog pa dang / tshe zad pa las ring du spel ba'i dngos grub dam pa stsal tu gsol/ khyad par du kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyi mthu dang bden pa'i byen gyis brlab kyi mthu zab mo mngon sum du bstan du gsol/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ na ma sde ya dī kā ṭwāṃ/ ta thā ga tā ṭwāṃ/sa manta gā meṭwāṃ/ u dzā la ya swāhā/ zhes brjod na kun tu bzang pos zhal ston par gsungs༄/ na ma ste ya dhi kā ṭwāṃ/ ta thā ga tā ṭwāṃ/ oṃ a sta bar snyo gi swāhā/zhes brjod na kun tu bzang po'i smon pa ltar gyi spyod pa las phyir mi ldog par byin gyis brlabs te smon lam 'grub par gsungs pas sngags de gnyis kyang lan kha shas re sngon du btang la/ sgra dag cing bar ma chad par byas nas/bzang spyod lan nyer gcig sogs ci 'grub re 'don/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ / rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ / yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ / rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sti ṣe ka ta sa ma ya thi ye hūṃ/ zhes khrus gsol bas cho ga chad lhag gi nyes pa sogs kyang dag par bsam/ thun rjes ma'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa' dang / zhes sogs kyis spyan drangs te mchod pa 'bul ba sogs sngar bzhin bya/ bzang spyod tshar dang po'i mgor yan lag bdun pa'i skabs slob dpon gyis maṇḍal lag tu thogs te gdangs dang bcas dal bus gsungs shing / thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ / zhes pa'i 207

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/mtshams su maṇḍal dbul/ tshar phyi ma rnams skabs dang bstun par bya/ de ltar thun bzhi byas nas thun rjes ma'i mjug tu sngar ma phul ba'i dkar gtor gnyis slar yang byin gyis brlab la/ dang po 'di nyid kyi sgos kyi chos skyong rgyal bo chen po bzhi la dbul te/ de'ang / tsa tur ma hwa rā dza e gye hi/ oṃ blu ta rā ya/ oṃ bi rū rtakṣa ya/oṃ bi rū pākhru ya/ oṃ bai tha ma ḍā ya sa pa ri wā ra a nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod la/ rgyal bo chen po dpal ldan pa/ / margad mdog mtshungs pi waṃ 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ / yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ / kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ / grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ / 'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ / kha dog dmar ser sbul zhags 'dzin/ / klu yi tshogs la mnga' mdzad pa'i/ / mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ded dpon chen po gser mdog can/ / bee con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ / gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ / rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod/ rgyal bo chen po bzhi'i lngags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ tsa tur ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba bla ta kha kha khā ti khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ yang sngar bzhin a sogs kyis mchod/ rgyal bo chen po 'khor bcas kyis/ / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ / bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi / bar gcod ma lus zlog par mdzod/ / ces 'phrin las bcol/ gtor ma gnyis pa 'byung bo spyi la sngar bzhin bsngo/ / yang na rgyal bo chen po bzhi'i gtor ma 'bul tshul tshe chog las 'byung bzhin bya/ de nas/ gang yang bzang bo spyod pa'i smon lam 'di/ /'chang ba dang ni ston tam klog pa yi/ / de yi rnam par smin pas 'chi ba dag / blu ba la ni som nyi ma byed cig / ces lan bdun gyis bden tshig bajod/208

༄/ / bzangaspyod la brten pa'i 'chi blu'i cho ga'achi ba'i dgra las nges par thar bar 'gyur ro snyam du yid ches kyi dad pa skyed pa 'in tu gal che ste/ ngag gi dbang byug grags pas/ 'chi bdag blu ba 'bad pa ni/ / dad payis ni byed par nus/ / de bas dad pa brtan par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de nas/ 'jam dpaladapa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / / zhes sobs kyi bsngo bas rgyas 'debs shing / yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / ma rnyed yongs su zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gye gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rten dang dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ mgron gzhan rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ rten med na/ dam tshig pa rnams bdag nyid la bstem/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ / zhes sogs bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i dge ba yis/ / bstan 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs brtan cing / /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshe dpal rgyas/ / bstan 'gro'i dge legs 'phel gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa rgyal mkhan po rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'don cha dngos gzhi byin rlabs kyi khyad nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung sor bzhag la/ cung zad rgyud sogs nas kha bskangs te bsgrigs pa 'dis kyang skye bo rnams dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las rgyal bar gyur cig /209

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / che bdag mgon po la brten nas 'chi blu bya tshul che nyams gso byed bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / rgyal kun thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs/ / khros pa'i zlos gar myur mdzad mgon po ni/ / tshe yi lhar bzhengs tshe bdag mgon po la/ / btud nas 'chi ba blu ba'i cho ga bri/ / de'ang myur mdzad mgon po la brten nas 'chi blu bya bar 'dod na/ tshe bdag mgon po ni ngo bo de nyid yin kyang tshe'i dngos grub stsol ba la ched du bstan pa yin pas/ de'i sgo nas byas na 'brel chags pas de ltar byed pa la/ mgon po'i mchod gtor nang mchod/ bum pa bcud kyis bkang ba mgul chings can dang / thod pa chang gis bkang bar bdud rtsi ril bu btab/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu 'thor nas sogs 'du bya/ thog mar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bzlas pa'i chus bsgrub bya'i yan lag lnga bkrus te khrus chu phyed kham phor gsar ba'i nang du blugs nas shar du bzhag phyed la shā sa na bzlas te bsngags/ mchod rten zhig pa'i sa dang ro sol sa nag sogs bsres te gshin rje'i gzugs 'jigs su rung ba dbyug pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa mdog nag po can byas la sla nga'i nang du sgrubs nas bzhag gdan nag gi steng du ras sogs kyi gos nag po bkab/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su mgo lhor bstan pa bzhag de'i mdun du kham phor 'o mas gang ba dang / nya sha'i bdug spos kyi snod/nyer spyod lnga/ 'bru nag sna tshogs/ me tog nag po/ sha mar/ tshwa/ bu ram/ gser/dngul/ g.yu/ gos dar sna tshogs/ rma bya'i mdongs/ dur ba/ ngar glud gang mang /srog chags sna tshogs kyi gzugs sogs gshin rje'i rdzong rnams dang / de rnams 'jal 210

༄/ /tshe bdagasagon po la brten nas 'chi blus tshul/ba'i bre la lha 'dre'i mig bsgyur ba'i sngags/ oṃ arma sarba sa tsi mur ti thibs swāhā/nyer gcig 'debs/ oṃ thib ta mthong ba'i rgyal po swā hā/ zhes pa ja sogs 'degs pa'i srang la 'debs/ oṃ ma ti tra mo ta na thibs swā hā/ zhes pa gser dngul sogs 'jal ba'i zho cha dang srang gnyis ga la nyer gcig re gdab/ 'brang rgyas phyed dkar po bil ba'i dbyibs can la mar gyi lha bshos lnga/ rtsa ba nag po la snum gyi sdong bu btsugs pa shar du dang / dkyil 'khor gye byang du ku sha'i gdan la bsgrub bya'i gludagos tshon skud sna lngas rgya gram du bcings pa bzhag dug sna btab pa 'o chu 'dres pas gang ba'i kham phor yang glud kyi mdun du bzhag stan dkar po gos dkar me tog dkarapo sogs kyang ci rigs su sta gon bya/ de nas skyabs sems sngon du btang la/su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las pad nyi tshogs kyi bdag po'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog ljang gu 'al gcig phyag drug pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ bar ba gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang rtse gsum tha ma gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ smin ma dang sma ra rab tu 'bar ba dbu skra kham ser gyen du badzes pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol zhing rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba sogs rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdogasngon mo g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/mdun du sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sku mdog dkar mo 'khor lo dang thod khragalhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo rin po che dang thod khrag nub tu padma mkha' 211

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/ 'gro dmar mo padma dang thod khrag byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mkha' 'gro lnga bo'ang thod skam lngas dbu la brgyan cing skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /de'isbyi rol tu mkha' 'gro 'bum sde dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ lte bar swā ser po/ gsang gnas su hā ljang gus mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas tshe bdag mgon po la mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba skad cig gis spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e bye he/khri ring bo nyer gcig brjod/ ma rtu baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra a: sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzi bha wa a snyi khyeñtsa hūṃ/zhes dbang bskur sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la rnam snang / rin chen mkha' 'gro ma la rin 'byung / padma mkha' 'gro ma la snang mtha'/ las kyi mkha' 'gro ma la don grub kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa dang nang mchod a mṛ tas bsangs/ byin gyis brlab/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la pañtsa ḍā gī sa pa ri wā ra a nas/shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ā 4 btags la nang mchod dbul/ margad lhun po'i dpal ltar brjid pa'i sku/ / mi bzad nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pa'i gsung / / brtse chen 'jig rten kun la brtse ba'i thugs/ / tshe bdag mgon 212

༄/ /tshebadagamagon po la brtenanas 'chi blu bya tshul/po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod/ mgon po yab yum gyi thugs kur nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i thugs gar yab kyi thugs gar hūṃ dang yum gyi thugs gar ā / de gnyis kyi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i tshe thung 'gyur gyi sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag slar yang sngags phreng las 'od 'phros pas rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad dang / 'jig rten khams kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur par bsams la/ yo badzra mahā kā la ha ri ni sa sarba ā yur sto na sidhi dza/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang la mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab cing / rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas shar lho bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ lngags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dkar po 'od kyi spu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la pañtsa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra yi de ba bla ta kha kha khā hi khā ti/ lan bdun gyis gtor ma dbul/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ de nas rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdzas rnams kyi rang rangagi ming yig dang po thig lesabargyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed par nus pa'i mchod rdzas mkho dgu ma tshang ba med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stob4dang ni/ / zhes pa nas/ thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig / rang nyid spyan ras gzigs mgon tshe bdag 213

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/tu/ / gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ / 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ / mdun gyi gzugs la dbyer med thim par gyur/ / ho chos dbyings bden pa bsam mi khyab/ / rten 'brel snang ba cir yang 'char/ / sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyi/ / bden pa'i byin rlabs las byung ba/ / dar tshon sna lnga rnam shes glud/ / rma bya'i mdongs bkra dbang po'i glud/ / ngar glud 'byung bzhi lus kyi glud/ / dur ba rin chen tshe yi glud/ / rin chen sna lnga bsod nams glud/ / srog chags sna tshogs phyugs kyi glud/ / 'bras bu sna tshogs dpal 'byor glud/ / gling bzhi gling phran dbang thang glud/ / bre dang srang la 'jal rung rnams/ / gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum sogs/ / gzhal te 'chi bdag 'khor bcas la/ / yon gyi bdag po 'di nyid kyi/ / tshe dang srog gi glud du 'bul/ / mchod yon 'bru sna sna tshogs dang / / 'dod yon rin chen sna lnga dang / / zhal zas me tog nag pos mchod/ / 'di dag longs la tshe srog byin/ / bzung ba thongs la bcing ba khrol/ / yar ba sdud cing nyams pa gsos/ / bla tshe brkus pa phyir gtad de/ / bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig / khrus chu phor ba dang lhan cig gshin rje mdun du bzhag 'brang rgyas phyed mar bcad la nag po'i mar me sbar/a kā ros byin gyis brlab/ sarba bisnyan/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sbyo zhes sogs kyis mdun gyi gshin rje 'khor bcas la lam rgyags kyi tshul du bsngo/ arnya nas/shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal brtan po la gnas pas rol mo gdangs dpa' bcas te/ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na/ / dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol na/ / thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer na/ / yi dwags kun gye ded dpon po/ / ma mo kun gyi tshogs rje bo/ / gson gshin kun gyi zam kha ba/ / gson po brkos la 'debs pa po/ / shi ba kun gyi gshin bu rje/ /214

༄/ /tshe bdagasagonapo la brten nas 'chi blukhya tshul/dge ba can gyi stangs 'dzin pa/ / sdig pa can gyi chad pa mkhan/ / nyes legs chos bzhin spyod pa po/ / chos rgyal gshin rje zhes bya ba/ / mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs can/ / 'khor bcas 'dir ni bdag la nyon/ / khyod kyi 'khor gyi yi dwags la/ / bza' ba bzang bo 'di 'bul gyi/ / 'di zo 'khor gyi yi dwags rnams/ / ma 'tshe bar ni gzhan du dengs/ / drag sngags brjod/ rol mo drag tu bya/ gshin rje'i gzugs rdzong chas nyer spyod gtor ma khrus khu gdan zhal kheb sogs ma lus pa lho'i grong zad mthar deb pa'i tshul mi byed par dal bus mgo lhor bstan nas 'jog cing rdzong chas rnams de'i mdun du bzhag la/ skyel mkhan rnams phyi mig mi blta ba gnad do/ / de nas glud gos kyi tshon skud bkrol la des bsgrub bya'i yan lag lnga bcing / na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i/zhes pa nas/ khyad par du'ang ye shes kyi mgon po tshe yi bdag po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlab kyis che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon chag che nyam nga / rtsog grib mi gtsang ba/ lo zla zhag skeg mthu gtad byad phur/ dus kyi zhags pa/gshin rje'i pho nya bkye ba la sogs pa bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs gang yin pa thams cad tshon skud 'di nyid la mchis shing thim par gyur cig lan gsum gyi mthar phyag g.yas kyi dang po'i gri gug gis rbad rbad gtub par bsams la sha san bzla bzhin du tshon skud gcod/ bsru med mchog gsum bden pa dang / /'jig rten skyong ba che rnams kyi/ / bden stobs mthu dang gzi byin gyes/ /byad stems las rnams chad gyur cig / oṃ sarba brnya kā kho rda smo da nā ya swā hā/zhesabarjod cing thung ngu thung ngur gtubs/ kham phor so ma'i nang gi 'o chab dug chu bsresapa'i nang du dum bu re dang / las bum gyi chu thigs pa re bsgrub bya'i lus la bskor te blugs la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ / 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ / bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'/ / sangs rgyas 215

༄/ /tshe bdagasagon po la brten nas 'chi byukhya tshul/tsug thu no mon han blo bzang bstan dar dbang phyug gi gsung gis bskul ngor/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /217

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / dzo dkar lha lnga'i nor sgrub bya tshul gyi zur 'debs gser gyi sde mig dngardza dmar sgrub thabs 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin sogs bzhugs/ /༄༅/ / ārya dzambha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de'ang rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa'i dzi dkar gyi nor sgrub la cung zad kha 'gengs 'os rnams bsnan te zur 'debs kyi tshul du 'god pa ni/ gsang sgrub dang yang gsang gi sgrub tshul gang gi skabs su'ang mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang bcas pa grub pa'i mtshams der g.yang 'bod byas na legs shing / de'ang rgyas par byed na g.yang rten gyi gtor ma dang g.yang rdzas bshams pa sogs yongs grags ltar bya la/dngos su bshams pa med kyang mos pa brtan pos tshig tu brjod na'ang rung bas/ gtso 'khor lnga'i thugs ga'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus srid zhi'i dpal 'byor mtha' dag rdo khab len gyis lcags phye 'dren pa bzhin bsdus te rang dang bsgrub bya la bstem zhing /gnas khang yul phyogs thams cad kyang dpal 'byor rgya chen pos gang bar bsams la/thugs rje chen po ārya dzambha la/ / snang srid dbang sdud mkha' 'gro bzhi dang bcas/ / brtse bas dgongs te gnas 'dir byin phobs la/ / bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal stsol cig / dge ba'i nyer len rang la gnas pa'i gzhir/ / bde ba'i rkyen bzang 'dod dgu'i legs tshogs kun/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / dal 'byor rten gyi rin chen bum bzang la 'chi ba 218

༄/ / rdza dkar lha lnga'isgor sgrubaco tshul kyizur 'debs/ med pa'i tshe dpal bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / sngon bsags bsod nams lhun stug ri bo'i rtser/ / zas nor longs spyod dbyar gyi na bun bzhin/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / bkra shis g.yang chags khyim dang bang mdzod la/ / gser dngul gos dar nor dang 'bru yi tshogs/ /phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / brtsan zhing yangs pa'i phyugs lhas ra ba ru/ /gnag lug rta mdzos yi dreg pa bzhin/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / zhi dul bzang po'i rang bzhin 'o ma'i mtshor/ / mthun pa'i gnyen bshes g.yog 'khor ngang ba'i khyu/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / cho rigs gtsang ma'i dpag bsam sdong bo la/ / ya rabs mdzangs pa'i rigs rgyud me tog 'phreng / / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / sgo gsum legs byas rnam dkar sprin gyi klong / / ma smad grags snyan g.yu 'brug sgra brgya pa/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / mchod sbyin dge tshogs gzhon nu'i lang tsho la/ / 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam lnga'i rgyan 'phreng tshogs/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / lha yi bde skyid tshe dang klu'i 'byor ba/ / mi yi chos dang srid kyi phun tshogs kun/ /phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge 219

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / mos gus brtan po'i yid kyi gshong bu la/ /mchog gsum thugs rje byen rlabs char gyi rgyun/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / dad brtson blo gros rgyal mtshan rtse mo la/ / rigs gsum mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bsam 'phel nor/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / bden tshig grub pa'i legs byas nor 'dzin gzhir/ / bkra shis rtags rdzas rten 'brel me tog char/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i zhing sa la/ / thos bsam sgom gsum legs smin snye ma'i tshogs/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / rtse gcig ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i nam mkha' la/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i nyi zla skar ma'i tshogs/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / dri med shes rab nor bu'i me long ngos/ / chos tshul rab 'byams dgongs don snang brnyan 'bum/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / mang thos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i gangs ri la/ / mkhas dang grub pa'i rtsal rdzogs gdong lnga ba/ / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ / lung rtogs bstan pa nor bu'i ba gam rtser/ / don gnyis lhun grub thar ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog / phyogs dus kun nas phywa dang g.yang du byon/ / bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod/ /mdor na nor bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis/ / srid zhi'i khams na 220

༄/ / rdza dkar lha lnga'i ra sgrubaco tshul kyizur 'debs/ji snyed mchis pa yi/ / rgyu yi dge tshogs mtha' dag dpal du khugs/ /'bras bu bde 'byor thams cad g.yang du longs/ / sa la g.yang chags rtsi bcud lo 'bras smin/ / yul la g.yang chags nad mug 'khrug rtsod 'i/ / mi la g.yang chags tshe bsod chos 'byor rgyas/ / phun tshogs bkra shis rgya mtshos gang gyur cig / ces g.yang 'bod bya'o/ /yang gsang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i gter sba tshul ni/ bdag skyed sngon du btang la bsangs sbyangs/ ga'u 'am bum pa rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i gter chen pos yongs su gang ba lnga'i nang du paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus ma'i steng du dzo yig dkar po zhes pa nas/ phyed skyil gyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ shar gyi ga'u'am bum pa'i nang gi gdan la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ lho'i ga'u'am bum pa'i nang gi gdan la tt+waṃ las rin po che ṭwāṃ gis mtshan pa/ zhes sogs bsgyur ba ma gtogs gsang sgrub kyi skabs ltar bya/gang du sba ba'i gnas ni sa'i gnad bzhi tshang zhing / rgyab ri mtho la dgye ba/ mdun ri dma' zhing dgu ba g.yas g.yon gyi ri rnams kyang tshur 'dud pa'i rnam pa can/ chu bo'ang mdun du tshur 'bab pa sogs sa dpyad legs shing ming bkra bzang po can/gzhi bdag dkar phyogs pa gnas pa'i sa de lta bur sba dgos la/ de'ang thog mar bsgrubs zin nas der gdan 'dren pa'i tshe stabs bde na spos rol sogs rgyas par bya zhing / ma mtha'ang dar tshon sogs kyis brgyan te spos 'grim sngon du 'gro bas bkur ste dang bcas gdan 'dren/ de'ang gaspo ḍā kyi'i ga'u ri thang mtshams dang / padma ḍā kyi'i ga'u yul gyi chu'i mgo badzra ḍā kyi'i ga'u ri'i rtse mtho sar sba bar gsungs kyang / rtse mo nas cung zad mar bab pa'i rtse lkog tsam du byas na legs par bshad/ chu mig kyang rgyun par 'gro rgyu med pa'i lkugs pa dang / mtshams mtshams su skam pa'i dar rgud can ma yin par rtag tu 'gro zhing chu klung chen por 'dres pa dgos/ gang du sba ba'i gnas der 221

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/sa brus nas rdo'i khang bu che chung ji ltar 'tsham pa byas te/ dang por sgrub dus gtso bo la phyogs pa'i ngos de ma nor bar byas te de mdun du bstan nas gzhug mdun ngos der sa ral dang 'obs sogs daphyad mi legs pa'i rigs med pa lhag par yang gal che'o/ / rin chen mkha' 'gro'i ga'u thab tshang gi rgyab gang 'os shig tu sba bar gsungs pas sa dpyad sogs ji bzhin mi 'ongs kyang 'jog tshul sogs gong dang 'dra/ gtso bo'i ga'u mdzod phugs su sba bar gsungs kyang / mdzod khang du gzhan gyis ma mthong bar byas nas bzhag nas brus nas sba mi dgos so/ / der bzhag nas kyang so sor rang rang gi skyed chog bzlas pa mjug gi mchod bstod kyi bar gong bzhin byas la/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ / dga' ldan du ni gnas pa las/ / lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ / de bzhin gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ / 'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas/ / byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / / yon gyi bdag po'i don slad du/ / bdag gi 'byor ba nyid kyis ni/ / ci 'byor ba yi mchod pa dang / / me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig / bdag dang slob mar bcas rnams la/ / rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ / kun gyis 'di la byin rlobs shing / / 'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ / zhes dang / mgon po nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i bcom ldan 'das gter gyi dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs te 'dod dgu'i 'byor ba zad mi shes pas yongs su gang ba'i gter mdzod 'di rnams su ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gye khams rnams zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi gter chen po'i longs spyod la dbang 'byor bar ma gyur gyi bar de srid du brtan par bzhugs nas dbul zhing phongs pa'i sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs te byen gyis rlobs la zas nor longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung ba dang / mchog dang thun mong gi 222

༄/ / dze dkar lha lnga'isgor sgrub bya tshul kyezur 'debs/dngos grub ma lus pa stsol rbar mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tikhye badzra ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum dang / bde gshegs kun bzang mthong ba'i bkra shis ltar/ / rgyal ba sras bcas deng 'dir bde legs shog / ngan sdig log pa'i tshogs rnams bcom gyur nas/ / rgyal sras rig 'dzin tshogs rnams 'phel dar zhing / / zhal mthong tsam gyis bde ba'i mchog brnyes nas/ / nyi ltar zhal dro zla ltar 'od gsal zhing / / bdag dang 'gro la zhal dro byin che bas/ / bskal ba'i mthar thug bar du bzhugs su gsol/ / ji srid me dang chu dang ni/ / rlung gis bskal ba 'jig bar du/ / sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ / bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod/ / mgon po bskal ba ji bzhin du/ / sna tshogs gzugs ni bzung nas kyang / / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams su/ / des ni 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/ / ces brjod de brtan bzhugs bya/ khyad par ni/ gaspo ḍā kyi la/nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes shing thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa gazla ḍā ki ma khyed sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis/ zhes pa nas/ dngos grub ma lus pa stsol zhing / khyad par du yul mi thams cad dbang du 'dus te zas nor mtha' dag char bzhin du 'bebs par mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes sbyor/ padma ḍā kyi la/ nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes shing thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa padma ḍā ki ma khyed sngags dang / zhes pa nas/ ma lus pa stsol zhing / khyad par du rol mtsho bdun sogs la gnas pa'i klu rgyal rnams dang yul phyogs 'di'i klu rnams kyis mtshon 'og klu'i 'jig rten thams cad dbang du 'dus te dngos grub ster du gzhug par mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes pa dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la/ badzra ḍā ki ma khyed/ ces dang / ma lus pa stsol zhing / khyad par du steng lha'i 'jig rten 223

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/dang gnas 'di mthong tshad thams cad dbang du 'du bar mdzad cing / zhes dang / rin chen mkha' 'gro la/ ratna ḍā ke ma khyed/ ces dang / khyad par du ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i zas kyi 'byor ba rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad cing / zhes bsgyur ba ma gtogs gzhan 'dra'o/ / de nas rdo khang gi kha legs par bcad de mi mngon par bya/ mjug tu ye dhasmo bdun la sogs pa brjod de me tog byen gyes brlabs nas mdo las byung ba'i dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis sogs shis pa brjod pa'i tshig ci rigs pa'i sgo nas me tog gi char chen po dbab par bya'o/ / zhes dzi dkar lha lnga'i nor sgrub bya tshul nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi zur 'debs gser gyi lde mig ces bya ba 'di ni rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa sngags rams pa 'jam dbyangs bde chen gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /yid bzhin nor dang dpag bsam shing lta bur/ / dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gter gyi bdag / nor gyi dbang phyug āslo dzasta lar/ / gus pas 'dud do byin rlabs char du snyil/ / 'jungs med gtong ba yangs pa'i sa bon ni/ / yi dam lha yi byin rlabs chus bran pas/ / sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs yongs 'du'i ljon/ / rnam grol 'bras bus spa ba'i thabs 'di rmad/ /'dir gter ston grwa pa mngon shes kyi lugs kyi dzasta la dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa la/ bdag bskyed kyi sgo nas bsnyen pa bya tshul dang / mdun bskyed la brten nas dngos grub blang ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ rang dzasta lar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'odazer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas akhye dzambha la la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ ākhro dzambha la sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas/ shasta pra ti tstsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum 224

༄/ / rdza dkar lha lnga'inor sgrub bya tshul kyizur 'debs/la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum dang / sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur par bsams la/su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las padma/ a las zla ba/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du rang gi sems nyid dzi yig dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ rgyal ba sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs dang srid zhi'i dpal 'byor thams cad bsdus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dzasta la sku mdog padma rā ga'i lhun po ltar dmar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ shin tu sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa klu chen po brgyad sbrul gyi gzugs can dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas kun nas spras pa/ rtsa zhal dmar zhing g.yas dkar g.yon sngo ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ bar ba na lcags kyu/ g.yon dang po na thod pa rin po chesagang ba/ bar ba na zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis gter gyi rte'u le re re bsnams nas 'tshir bas nor bu skyug pa/ zhabs bzhis nyi ma'i steng du gnod sbyin nor bu skyug pa gnyis mnan te bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs gar sbas pa'i yum ku ru kulle dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ g.yas 'og mas lcags kyu dang / g.yon 'og mas zhags pa bsnams pa'i thugs gar hrī yig dmar pos mtshan pa'i sems dpa' gsum gye bdag nyid can/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ma thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ / gong ltar mchod la/ dza : paṃ ho baṃ 225

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/ho sa gnyis su med par bstem/ slar yang thugs kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa rilta ra arnya nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sabaṃ ta thā ga ta a sti ṣpeñtsa tu mi/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzi bha a stiṭīñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa a spo tas bsangs/ swa bha was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams phul du byung ba'i lha rdzas su gyur/ oṃ a 〉 rtu nas oṃ shasta ā ka gi bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ākhye dzambha la a pra tī tstsha swā hā/ sogs kyis mchod/ bde gshegs kun gyi gsung las rab sprul cing / / thugs rje chags pas sku mdog dmar por bzhugs/ / dbang gi 'azin las rdzogs mdzad dzambha la/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong la phyag 'tshal/ / zhes pas bstod/ rang gi thugs gar nyi ma'i steng du hrī yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ 'jig rten khams kyi nor longs spyod 'bru bang mdzod/rkang 'gro rin po che la sogs pa mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dgos 'dod thams cad bsdus nas rang gi yul khams rnams gang / khyad par du hrī yig las mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad dang / bye brag tu gang zhig dbang du sdud par 'dod pa thams cad lcags kyus bzung zhing zhags pas bcings te bkug nas rang gi dbang du 'dus par gyur bar bsams la/ oṃ dzasta la dza lesta ya dha na me rnyi hrī swā hā/ zhes yid gzhan du ma yengs par bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / bcom ldan 'das mgon po dzasta la 'khor dang bcas pas bdag 226

༄/ / rdza dkar lha lnga'inor sgrub bya tshul kyizwar 'debs/cagadapon slob yon mchod kun gyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa bsal nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub mtha' dag bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ bsnyen pa'i skabs bdag skyed gcig pus chog la/ de'i tshe thun so so'am dgung thun la gtor 'bul nges can du dgos pas 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dbul/ mjug tu mchod bstod bya/ tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas thun gsum la sogs par byas te bzlas sgom la 'bad pas/ grub pa'i rtags ni/rab ser sna sogs kyi kun 'dzin zhi zhing yi dam lhas zhal dngos su bstan pa dang /'bring nyams snang la lha'i zhal mthong ba dang / tha ma mi lam du skye bo mang pos rang la 'dud pa dang / rin po che'i khri la 'dzeg cing gdan 'ding ba/ nyi zla 'char ba/ char chen po 'bab pa/ chu mig rdol ba/ gter rnyed pa/ gos dmar po khyad par can gyon pa/ rol mo sna tshogs 'khrol ba sogs yang yang mis na grub pa'i mtshan mar bshad do/ / bzlas pa'i grangs rab yig 'bru'i grangs kyis 'bum phrag bco lnga dang / ma mtha'ang 'bum phrag gcig tshad dang ldan par 'gro nges pa dgos so/ /gnyis pa mdun bskyed la brten nas dngos grub blang ba'i tshul la gnyis/ chu sbyin la brten nas rgyun 'khyer bya ba'i tshul dang / gsang rten byas te 'chang tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rin po che'am zangs gzhong gtsang ma'i nang du dzasta la'i sku rgyu rin po che sogs las bsgrubs pa gzungs gzhug dang rab gnas can zhabs khag legs par bsdams te rlan gsher gyi skyon mi 'jug par byas pa bzhugs su bcug la/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug kha sar pā ṇi'i skur gyur/mdun du pad zla nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gye gdan la rdza yig dmar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las dzasta la sku mdog padma rā ga'i lhun po ltar/ zhes pa nas/gnyis mnan te bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā / thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/227

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/dbang lhas dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/de'i thugs gar re yig gis mtshan pa las me 'od gyen du 'phros pas skom pas gdungs shing bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun phul bas sku lus thams cad gang nas gdung ba thams cad zhi ste bde ba chen pos rab tu dgyes/ bdud rtsi'i rdul phra rab rnams mu tig gi phreng bar gyur pas sku lus kyi nang thams cad yongs su gtams shing zhal nas mu tig gi char babs/ phyag gi ne'u le dang zhabs 'og giganod sbyin gnyis gnyis kyi zhal nas kyang nor bu dpag tu med pa bskyug pas sa phyogs dang gnas khang thams cad phyur bur gang bar gyur par bsams la/ chu gtsang zangs gzhong du sbrengs shing / oṃ dzasta la dza letsā ya dha na me rnyi hrī swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags brgya rtsa bzla/ gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na/ gtor ma nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyibs can bu ram sogs kyis brgyan pa bsham ste/ bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsams la/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ lan gsum brjod de byin gyis brlab/ sngags gsham du/ i rda ba bla ta kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lnga'am bdun gyis dbul/ oṃ ākhro dzambha la a sogs kyis mchod/ nyi ma stong phrag 'od kyis 'khyud pa yi/ / byu ru'i ri bo lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ / zhal gsum phyag drug 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa/ / mgon po dzasta la la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gang sku yid la ri mor bris pa'am/ / mtshan snyan rna ba'i bdud rtsir gyur pas kyang / / dbul ba'i gdung ba ming gi mthar byed pa/ / skyob pa mtshungs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / khyod zhabs gus pas mchod pa lhur len na/ /mtha' dag rgud pa'i tshogs las skyob pa dang / / dam chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen ma lus pa/ / 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / ces bstod cing gsol ba gdab/ 'dir ni gzugs dang zhes sogs kyis rten la brtan 228

༄/ / dzi dkar lha lnga'irnar sgrub bya tshul kyizur 'debs/bzhugasabyu/ rten med par mos pa tsam gyis byas pa yin na/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag nyid la thim par bsam/ chu'i rdul phra rab rnams dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub byin par bsams la 'bru gsum brjod cing mtheb srin gyis chu blangs te rang gi lce thog tu sbyin/ chu cung zad phyogs bzhir gtor zhing yig brgya bzla/ chu lhag ma gzhan du ma 'khyar bar longs spyod/ yang chu sbyin shin tu bsdus pa la mos na/ rang nyid kha sar pā ṇir gsal ba'i mdun/ / pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la dzasta la/ / sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug par/ /chu rgyun dbul lo bzhes nas dngos grub stsol/ / ces chu rgyun sprengs shing sngags brgya rtsa dang / mchod bstod sogs gong bzhin byed/gnyis pa gsang rten byas te 'chang tshul ni/ bris sku byed na bzo bo mtshan nyid dang ldan pas/ skar ma rgyal dang sa ri sa ga gang rung gza' spen pa sogs dang 'dzom pa'i dus tshes bzang po la 'bri gzhi dar dmar po dri bzang gis bsgos pa'am/ shog bu rgya tshos kyis kha bsgyur ba la gser ram snyi wang gis bcad byas te dzasta la'i sku tshad dang ldan pa bri/ sku'i rgyab tu sngags tshar gsum tsam la/ khams gsum gyi snod bcud legs tshogs thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru ho zhes spel tshig btags pa dang rten 'brel snying po bri/ rab gnas byas la/ rin po che lnga/ 'bru lnga/ sman lnga/ dar sna lnga/khyi phag bong bu ma gtogs pa'i rta nor lug gsum sogs kyi spu rigs zas sna sogs dang lhan cig tu gos dar sogs kyis legs par dril/ tshon skud sna lngas bcings te mchan khungagayon du gdags shing gzhan gyis ma mthong ba dang 'gom yug ma shor ba byas na dngos grub shin tu myur bar gsungs so/ / mdzod khang sogs su bzhugs par 'dod na sku dang rdzas rnams gong bzhin du 'du byas la/ pa'i ga'u'am/ tsardon dang shug pa sogs shing bzang po'i sgrom bur bzhugs su bcug ste bdag skyed sngon du btang /mdun gyi bsgrub gzhi bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las ga'u'am sgrom bu rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i 229

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/yidabazhin gyi nor bu'i gter chen pos yongs su gang ba'i dbus su paṃ las padma/ a las zla ba/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du dzi yig dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/rgyal ba sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs dang srid zhi'i dpal 'byor thams cad bsdus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las dzasta la sku mdog padma rā ga'i lhun po ltar dmar zhing / zhes pa nas/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab mchod pa byin rlabs yan chad bdag skyed kyi skabs bzhin byas la/ kun bzang bde chen rol ba las byung ba'i/ / yid 'ong mchod yon bkod pa mtha' klas pa/ / bcom ldan mgon po dzasta la la 'bul/ / dgyes bzhin bzhes nas dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ / oṃ ārya dzasta la a snu dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo dang / a gyi gnas su/ pārdu sogs btags pas mchod/ nyi ma stong phrag ces sogs kyis bstod/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrī 'i mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/'jig rten khams kyi nor longs spyod 'bru bang mdzod/ rkang 'gro rin po che la sogs pa mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dgos 'dod thams cad bsdus nas rang gi yul khams rnams gang / khyad par du hrī yig las mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad dang / bye brag tu gang zhig dbang du sdud par 'dod pa thams cad lcags kyus bzung zhing zhags pas bcings te bkug nas rang gi dbang du 'dus par gyur par bsams la/ bzlas pa ci 'grub dang / yig brgyas lhag chad bskang zhing /230

༄/ / rdza dkar lha lnga'isgor sgrubaco tshul kyizwar 'debs/gtor ma gong bzhin dbul/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ thun phyi ma rnams su sa bon las mi skyed par/ gter chen pos yongs su gang ba'i dbus su padma dang zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dzasta la/ zhes sbyor/bsgrub gzhi 'bur sku byed na rgyu rin po che sogs las bsgrub pa sor bzhi las mi chung ba bya zhing / 'bri gzhi gong ltar la gser ram ghi wang gis sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa rten 'brel snying bo sogs bris pa gzungs gzhug tu dbul zhing / yang na rin po che'i phye ma/ gnas chen gyi sa sna/ dgon sde chen po dang rgyal po'i pho brang / yul mi phyug po sogs kyi khang sa rnams bsres pa la 'brang rgyas mtheb rtse tsam byas te de sku gzugs kyi nang du bcug na'ang legs par gsungs so/ / de nas sku brnyan de nyid ga'u'am sgrom bu rin po che sna lnga sogs kyis bkang ba'i dbus stod kyi char bzhugs su bcug la ras bris kyi skabs ltar sgrub/ de ltar zhag grangs ci tsam byed pa'i mthar mdzod khang du gdan 'dren pa na spos dang rol mo sogs kyi mchod pas sngon bsus te ji lngar 'os pa'i gdan khri phun sum tshogs par bkod/ mchod bstod tshar gcig byas la me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ / dga' ldan du ni gnas pa las/ / lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ / de bzhin gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ / 'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas/ / byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / / yon gyi bdag po'i don slad du/ / bdag gi 'byor ba nyid kyis ni/ / ci 'byor ba yi mchod pa dang / / me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig / bdag dang slob mar bcas rnams la/ / rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ / kun gyis 'di la byin rlobs shing / / 'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ / zhes dang / mgon po nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i bcom ldan 'das gter gyi dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs te 'dod dgu'i 'byorab zad mi shes pas yongs su gang ba'i gter mdzod 'di rnams su ji 23/
