༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi khams rnams zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi gter chen po'i longs spyod la dbang 'byor bar ma gyur gyi bar de srid du brtan par bzhugs nas dbul zhing phongs pa'i sems can rnamasal thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs te byin gyis rlobs la zas nor longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung ba dang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol bar mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣā badzra ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum dang / bde gshegs kun bzang mthong ba'i bkra shis ltar/ / rgyal ba sras bcas deng 'dir bde legs shog / ngan sdig log pa'i tshogs rnams bcom gyur nas/ / rgyal sras rig 'dzin tshogs rnams 'phel dar zhing / / zhal mthong tsam gyis bde ba'i mchog brnyes nas/ / nyi ltar zhal dro zla ltar 'od gsal zhing / / bdag dang 'gro ya zhal dro byin che bas/ / bskal pa'i mthar thug bar du bzhugs su gsol/ / ji srid me dang chu dang ni/ / rlung gis bskal pa 'jig bar du/ / sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ / bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod/ / mgon po bskal pa ji bzhin du/ / sna tshogs gzugs ni bzung nas kyang / / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams su/ / des ni 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/ / ces brjod de brtan bzhugs bya/ ye rnyarma bdun la sogs pa brjod de me tog byin gyis brlabs nas mdo las byung ba'i dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis sogs shis pa brjod pa'i tshig ci rigs pa'i sgo nas me tog gi char chen po dbab pa bya'o/ /smras pa/ gang gi thugs rje'i 'od stong rtse dga' yis/ / legs byas dpal gyi 'dab brgya rgyas byed pa/ / dzam lha dmar po'i sgrub thabs bkod pa'i dges/ / 'gro kun phan bde'i dpal la spyod gyur cig / ces grwa pa 232

༄/ / rdza dkar lha lnga'irnar sgrubaco tshul kyizur 'debs/mngon shes kyi lugs kyi dzam lha dmar po'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin zhes bya ba 'di ni/ a lag shā shog nas dad brtson blo dang ldan pa mgron gnyer ye shes don grub kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / ma lha dmar po'i mngon rtogs bzhugs/ /nyin byed brgya yis mi dpog 'azin las kyi/ / gzi 'od 'bar bas longs spyod padmo'i tshal/ / rgyas mdzad mgon po ākhyo dzasta lar/ / gus pas 'dudado dngos grub char du snyil/ / de'ang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i lcags ri mi 'da'aba'i gser chos bcu gsum mam bcu bzhir grags pa'i ya gyal/ dzam dmar srog sgrub kyi bsgom bzlas nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dmar ser 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ las gser gyi bum pa rin po che sna tshogs pas gang ba kha g.yas g.yon du lta ba gnyis kyi steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su rang gi sems nyid rdza dang baṃ dmar po las yid bzhin gyi nor bu dzi dang baṃ gyes mtshan pa gnyis/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can rnams kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur ba las/ rang nyid ākhro dzasta la sku mdog padma rā ga'i ri bo ltar dmar zhing gsal la rab tu brjid pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ dbu'i steng du yid bzhin gyi nor bu nyi ma ltar 'tsher zhing 'od zer 'bar bas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po dang / g.yon 233

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gter gyi rme'u le kha nas rin po che skyug pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon cung zad bskum pa rgyal po rol ba'i stangs stabs can/ de'i pang na yum rgyas byed ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas nor bu 'bar ba bsnams nas sgrub pa po la dngos grub kyi char 'bebs shing / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzung nas yab la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon pas yab kyi sked nas 'khril ba/ yab yum mnyam par spyor ba'i rjes chags kyi bde ba chen pos myos shing / khro 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs shing / rin po che'i rgyan dpag du med pas spras pa/ sku'i cha las 'od zer dpag med 'phros pas 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor rgyas par byed pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ma thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dza : baṃ hoganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs gar hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sti ṣe ga ta sa ma ya thi ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du hūṃ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams/ ngo bo stong ba/rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las zag med kyi bde chen 'dren pa'i mthu dang ldan paragyur/ oṃ a 〉 rtu nas shasta 〉 rtu gi bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ ākhye dzambha la sa pa ri wā ra a nas shasta pra tī tstsha hūṃ swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ āslo dzasta la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ā : gis nang mchod 'bul/ mnyam nyid ye shes yon tan yongs rdzogs nas/ / nor gyi dpal ster rmugs 'dzin rnam 'phrul gyis/ / thar 'dod skye bo'i dbul ba sel mdzad pa/ / ārya dzasta la la phyag 234

༄/ / rdza dkar lha lnga'irnar sgrubaco tshul kyibar 'debs/'tshal bstod/ / rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du dzo dang baṃ gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten khams kyi zas nor longs spyod sogs dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus te sngags phreng la thim par bsam zhing / oṃ dzambha la dza lerdo ya dha rna me —hrī ḍā ki ni dzā la sasta ri swā hā/ zhes ci mang bzla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / mchod bstod sngar bzhin byas la/ nor gyi dbang phyug lha yi lha/ /thugs rje che la gsol 'debs kyi/ / dbul ba'i sdug bsngal kun bsal nas/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ / zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ oṃ ā badzra mu bdag skyed kyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag nyid la bstem pa sogs bya/mdun bskyed sgrub na/ bsgrub gzhi rdul tshon dmar pos bris pa'i padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar mdzi'i steng du me long la siskyo ra byugs pa'i dbus su dzi baṃ dang /mthar g.yas skor du sngar gyi bzlas sngags de nyid dbu can du bris pa bzhag gtor ma nor bu'i dbyibs can sogs mchod gtor rgyas par bshams/ ngag 'don la rang nyid ces pa'i tshig phrad bsgyur ba ma gtogs bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin la/ bzlas pa'i mjug tu gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas gong gi mtshan sngags la ba bla ta btags pas 'bul zhing / de nas mchod bstod gshegs gsol bkra shis kyis mtha'abargyan pa sogs dkyus bzhin bya'o/ / smras pa/ rmugs 'dzin dngos grub gter gyi sgo/ / 'byed byed 'phrul gye lde mig 'di/ / legs sbyar dge bas 'gro ba kun/ / phongs pa'i sdug bsngal las grol shog / ces dzasta la dmar po srog sgrub kyi mngon rtogs khrigs chags su bkod pa 'di ni/ dad brtson lngan pa bkra shis mkhyen rab kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dga' ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i gling gi 'du khang chen mo'i yang rtser sbyar ba'o/ /235

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / g.yang 'bod yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / chos dbyings ngang las dregs pa'i skur bzhengs te/ / chos bzhin sgrub pa kun dang khyad par du/ / chos grwa'i 'chad nyan sgrig sogs srung mdzad pa/ / chos skyong chen po ma g.yel deng 'dir dgongs/ / 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bzhad pa'i rdo rje yis/ / dgon gnas bshad sgrub gnyer du gtad pa bzhin/ / dge 'dun 'dus tshogs 'chad nyan longs spyod kun/ / dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin rgyas pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / rnam smin yon tan brgyad kyi lus rtsal rdzogs/ / thos bsam padma'i tshal la dga' bas rtsen/ / lung rigs 'dab ma dbyangs snyan sgrogs yi/ / rkang drug bgrang yas 'du ba'i phywa g.yang stsol/ / mkhas btsun lhag bsam can gyi slob dpon dang / / dad brtson shes rab ldan pa'i slob ma gnyis/ / rten 'brel lhan cig 'dzoms pas 'chad nyan gyi/ / rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs pa'i phywa g.yang stsol/ / gzhung don gdams par shar ba'i go ba dang / / tshig don phra zhib 'byed pa rigs pa'i 'phrul/ / nges pa skyed byed rgyab rten lung dang bcas/ / rtsod ngag dga' ston 'phel ba'i phywa g.yang stsol/ / dam chos 'dul ba'i dgongs don 'dus pa'i khrims/ / las 'bras drang thig 'deb pa'i las byed pa/ / tshar gcod rjes 'dzin rteng gnon mi yol ba'i/ /bca' khrims rmang gzhi brtan po'i phywa g.yang stsol/ / ngan shed brag la 'cha' 236

༄/ /g.yang 'bodayid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ba'i 'ug pa dang / / blang dor lam du rgyu ba'i shan 'byed pa/ / las 'bras bden pa'i nyi ma 'od po che'i/ / snang ba mngon du 'gyur ba'i phywa g.yang stsol/ / sdig spyod rgyan du ngoms pa log pa'i gtam/ / phyogs lhung tsam gyis bsngags pa'i mu cor sogs/ / ma yin chos kyi grags pa chos ba'in du/ /bsgrags bya snyan pas kun khyab phywa g.yang stsol/ / bsod nams zhing gi mchog gyur dge 'dun dang / / bsod nams dad gtong 'dzoms pa sbyin pa'i bdag / bsod nams sdig dang ma 'dres rgyu sbyor gyis/ / bsod nams dus ston dar ba'i phywa g.yang stsol/ / mngon 'dod tshang ba'i blo yi g.yo ba las/ / byung min bshad sgrub bstan pa gnas gyur na/ / ngang gis 'du ba srung ma'i 'phrin las kyis/ / phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phywa g.yang stsol/ / khyad par blo gsal don gnyer tshul mthun rnams/ / nad rims gdon bgegs rkyen gyis mi badzi bar/ / thos bsam bya ba bde blag mthar phyin te/ / don gnyis smon pa bzhin du 'grub par mdzod/ / mdor na mi 'dod nyer 'tshe kun dang bral/ / phun tshogs legs byas ma lus lhun gyis grub/ / rgyal bstan nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser mchod pas/ / snang srid dge legs snang bas khyab gyur cig / bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ / snyan grags chen po nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ / tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ / yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni thos bsam gling gi spyi gnyer dad brtson ldan pa rab 'byams pa blo bzang dpal ldan gyis grwa tshang gi las don dang 'brel ba'i g.yang 'bod bya tshul rgyal gsolagyi mjug tu 'don rgyu zhig dgos tshul zer bar dge 'dun spyi'i g.yang 'bod tshulakhrims rnam par dag pa dang / sgos su mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi g.yang 'bod bka' pod lnga'i 'chad nyan/ sngags grwa rnams kyi g.yang 'bod rgyud don rim gnyis kyi bshad 237

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/sgrub/ 'don phyag len sogs yin gyi/ g.yang mgron po 'bod pa bzhin byed pa dka' na'ang / rang rang gis rgyu bsgrubs pa'i thog tu rkyen srung ma'i thugs rgyud bskul na phan par bsams te/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /dpon slob dgon gnas dge 'dun bcas pa yis/ / bsgrub bsgrub bsten pa'i srung ma khyod min pa/ / re sa gzhan na med do brtser dgongs te/ / gzhi lam byes gsum kun tu skyabs mdzod cig / nyin gsum 'bod do nyin gyi bya ra mdzod/ / mtshan gsum 'bod do mtshan gye mel tshe mdzod/ /mi nad phyugs nad kha smras chom rkun sogs/ / mi 'dod nyer 'tshe thams cad phyir zlog cig / zas nor longs spyod rkang 'gro rin chen sogs/ / mkho dgu'i 'byor ba dbyar gyi sprin bzhin 'dus/ / rnam dkar chos kyi bya ba ma lus pa/ / smon pa bzhin du 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / ces pa 'di yang rje nyid kyi gsung ngo / /238

sa / / dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam lazlab tshul gyi smon lam tshig lhug tu byas pa/ko༅/ / dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam la slob tshul gyi smon lam chig sprug tu byas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / kā la tsakra mi 'gyur bde ba'i mkhar/ / kha dog rnam bkra stong gzugs dbang gzhus 'khyud/ / ga bur tsardon sbyar ba bdud rtsi'i chus/ /nga yi snying gi ze'u 'bru smin par mdzod/ / nga ro drag pos rtse gcig gsol 'debs na/ / ga shed skyes chen 'degs tshe sems kyi rta/ / kha lo bsgyur te gzhan du mi gol bar/ / ka lā pa yi grong du 'khrid par mdzod/ / bdag sogs 'gro ba yongs kyi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs mtha' dag gcig tu bsdoms te grub pa'i gnas mchog byang shasta la zhes grong bye ba dgu bcu go drug gi bdag nyid/ longs spyod lha dang mnyam zhing sa padma 'dab brgyad kyi rnam par gnas pa'i lte bar ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal dang / padma dkar po'i mtsho dang yid kyi mtsho la sogs pas bskor ba'i pho brang chen po ka lā pa rgyu rin po che sna lnga las grub cing / dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi khyon dang ldan par rigs ldan 'khor bcas bzhugs te mdo sngags kyi lam bzang mtha' dag 'doms par mdzad pas mnga' 'bangs thams cad nyin mtshan kun tu chos kyi dga' bdes rol ba de nyid du skye ba'i rgyur gyur cig 'di nas 'phos ma thag srid pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'am re ltar thogs kyang 'jam mgon bla ma'i thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul drag po 'khor lo can gyes 'dzam gling chen po'i sa dum bu bcu gnyis la bstan pa'i dus bzhi phyi ma gsar du 239

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgonatha'i gsung 'bum/'dzug pa'i thog ma kho nar de'i 'khor du skye bar gyur cig skyes ma thag nas rigasaldan rgyal pos dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung ste theg pa gsum gyi chos ma lus par bsdus pa rtsa ba gsum dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du rim pa dang po'i snod rung du byed pa byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun bskur te khams lnga sogs kyi dri ma bdun sbyangs nas sa bdun 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhagarim pa gnyis pa'i bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i snod rung du byed pa'i dbang gong ma kun rdzob 'jig rten pa'i dbang bzhi dang / gong ma'i gong ma nges don 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bzhi/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang dang bcas pa mnos te sku bzhi dang rdo rje bzhi 'grub pa'i sa bon khyad par can thebs par gyur cig dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rtsa ba'i ltung ba thun mong ma yin pa dang bcas pa bdun dang / thun mong ba bdun te bcu bzhi bsrung ba dang / sdig pa lnga dang nye ba'i sdig pa lnga sogs spong ba'i brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga la sogs pa rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig mtha' dag tshul bzhin du bsrung bar gyur cig de nas nyi zla'i chos lho byang gi bgrod pa gnyis dang / dkar nag gi phyogs gnyis tshes sum brgya drug cu sogs zhib par rtsis kyis phye bas phyi dus kyi 'khor lo snod kyi rnam bzhag rgyud gzhan las gsal bar rtogs shing / de tsam du nang dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa rlung zeg le'i gnad phra mo rnams khong du chud pa bzhin/ de sbyong bar byed pa gzhan dus kyi 'khor lo rim pa gnyis kyi lam la rgya cher slob par gyur cigasbyor ba'i rim pa srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa sngon du btang ste/ rnam thar sgo bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin gyis skad cig ma gcig gis mngon par byang chub pa'ingang las phyi nang gsang ba'i gzhal yas khang du rnam pa lngas mngon par 240

༄/ / dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam lapob tshul gyi smon lam tshig lhug tukhyas pa/byangasgrub pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bsnyen pa'i yan lag rnam pa nyi shus mngon par byang chub pa las rgyal mchog nyer sgrub kyi yan lag yas bab kyi dga' ba bzhi mtshon pa thig le'i rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i yan lag mas brtan gyidaga' bzhi mtshon pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon par byang chub pa sgrub chen gyi yan lag ste/ byang chub pa bzhis tha mal gyi snang zhen sbyangs te rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag skye ba'i snod du smin par gyur cigade nas stong gzugs kyi sku gang las sgrub pa'i gzhir gyur ba'i gzugs sngar med gsar du sgrub pa dang / grub zin brtan par byed pa thog mar dge ba'i rnal 'byor sor bsam gnyis/ gzugs de nyid grub nas dbang du byed pa dang gong nas gong du gnas gyur byed bar du dge ba'i rnal 'byor srog 'dzin gnyis/ tha mar dge ba rten stong gzugs kyi sku dngos grub pa rjes dran dang /brten pa mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba grub pa ting 'dzin gyi yan lag ste sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rtogs pa rnal ma rgyud la skye bar gyur cig de lta bu'i stong gzugs dang bde ba chen po zung du 'jug pa'i lam gyis dru tī'i nang du khams dkar dmar nyi khri chig stong drug brgya steng 'og tu brtsegs pas dngul chus lcags za ba bzhin sem po'i khams zad cing / mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba nyi khri chig stong drug brgyas de snyed kyi las rlung bkag ste/ rlung gi 'pho ba bcu gnyis 'gag pas sa bcu gnyis rim gyis bgrod par gyur cig de nas 'bras bu dus kyi 'khor lo mchog mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen gyi thugs dang /stong gzugs yab yum kha spyor gyi sku dbyer mi phyed pa rdul phra rab kyi chos kyi phung sogs zad cing / gnas skabs bzhi'i sgrib pa spangs pa bden don bcu gnyis dang / de nyid bcu drug gi bdag nyid dang po'i sangs rgyas ris med pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang mngon du byed par gyur cig rigs ldan 241

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/mgon gyis brtse bas rjes bzung ste/ / sbyang gzhi phyi yis mtshon pa nang gi lus/ / sbyong byed byang chub bzhi bzhi'i bdag nyid gzhan/ / rim gnyis lam gyis smin cing grol gyur cig / dum bu bcu gnyis kla klo drungs phyung bzhin/ / 'pho ba bcu gnyis rlung gi rgyu ba 'gags/ / sa rnams bzu gnyis rim gyis bgrod pa yis/ / bden don bcu gnyis mngon du 'gyur bar shog / ces byang phyogs shasta lar skye zhing dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam la slob tshul gyi smon lam lhug par byas pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes hal ha ja sag thu rgyal po'i shog nas lhag bsam rnam dpyod yangs pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog smon lam gyes bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /dmigs med bde ba mchog gi dus 'khor lo/ / stong gzugs phyag rgya che dang dbyer med pa/ / gsum ldan ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rol gar mkhan/ / bla ma dang po'i mgon por gus phyag 'tshal/ / ma 'ongs bstan pa'i tha mar gyur pa na/ / kla klo mthar byed drag po 'khor lo can/ / dpung tshogs dang bcas sa la dbang bsgyur tshe/ / bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i 'khor du skye bar shog / dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du/ / dbang thob dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung / / yan lag drug gi lam bzang rim bgrod de/ / ring min 'khor lo'i mgon po'i gnas thob shog / mdor na dus gsum dge ba ci bgyis pa/ / de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdoms byas nas/ / skye zhing skye bar dpal ldan dus 'khor gyi/ / lam bzang mchog la slob pa'i rgyur gyur cig / bslu med bla ma mchog gsum byen rlabs dang / /bdagagi rtse gcig mos pa'i bden stobs kyis/ / ji ltar smon pa bzhin du myur 'grub ste/ / 'gro ba kun kyang srid las sgrol bar shog / ces pa 'di ni 242

sa / /dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam lazlab tshul gyi smon lam tshig lhug tu byas pa/dad brtson ldan pa rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dang u cu mu chin ja lang gzungs bsdus don grub gnyis kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /243

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / che dpag med kyi bla brgyud smon shis sogs smon shis le tshan bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / lha mi'i ston pa tshe dpag med mgon gyi/ / dkyil 'khor legs bsgoms mchod bstod bzlas pa sogs/ / 'bad pa'i dge bas bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ / snang ba mtha' yas go 'phang myur thob shog / rtag tu dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten thob cing / / tshe rabs kun tu tshe dpag med mgon gyis/ / 'bral ba med par dge ba'i bshes mdzad de/ / rgyal bas bsngags pa'i lam la slob gyur cig / srid pa'i bde la zhen log nges 'byung dang / /'gro drug pha mar shes pa'i byang chub sems/ / srid rtsa gcod byed yang dag lta ba sogs/ / thun mong lam gyis shes rgyud spyong gyur cig / de nas tshe mtha' yas pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ / legs zhugs chu dang cod pan dbang bskur gyis/ / mtshan bcas mtshan med lam gyi snod gyur te/ / dam tshig mtha' dag tshul bzhin srung gyur cig / sngags dang phyag rgyas bdag dang gnas bsrung bas/ / rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i 'gal rkyen kun bzlog cing / /mchog gsum zhing la spyor ba tshogs bsags sogs/ / mthun pa'i rkyen rnams yongs su rdzogs gyur cig / stong sgra yig gzugs phyag rgya mtshan ma'i lha/ / drug gis lha skur bsgoms shing srog rtsol kun/ / bsdams te bzlas brjod bsam gtan yan lag bzhis/ / tha mal snang zhen dri ma 'khrud par shog / de nas bzlas brjod sogs la mi ltos pa/ / me dang sgra la gnas pa'i 244

༄/ /tshedapagamed kyi blabargyud ma shis sogs yo shis le tshan/bsam gtan gyis/ / rgyal gsung gsang sngags nus pa smin byed pa'i/ /mtshan ma dang bcas rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog / sgra mthar chos rnams kun gyi de bzhin nyid/ / mngon gyur thar pa ster ba'i bsam gtan gyis/ /chos sku sgrib pa med pa rgyal ba'i thugs/ / sgrub pa'i mtshan med rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog / byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i bgo skal la brten nas/ / dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs las skyob pa sogs/ / gang la gang 'dul rab 'byams 'phrin las kyis/ / sras bcas rgyal ba'i mdzad pa sgrub gyur cig / nam zhig 'di snang 'gag par rtsom pa na/ / 'od dpag med mgon nye ba'i sras dang bcas/ / dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal mngon gyur dga' dad gyis/ /'jigs skrag gdung ba'i mun pa sel gyur cig / de nas bla ma lha yis lam bstan te/ / ngo mtshar dpag yas bde ldan zhing mchog tu/ /'dab stong padma'i snying po las skyes nas/ / rgyal ba 'khor bcas mchod pas mnyes byed shog / de yis legs gsungs gdams pa'i bcud myang zhing / /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa mthar phyin nas/ / rnam kun gzigs pa'i go 'phang mchog brnyes te/ / 'gro kun phan bde'i dpal la 'god gyur cig / dge legs 'od mtshan snang ba mtha' yas pas/ / 'jig rten kun khyab bcom ldan 'khor bcas kyi/ / byin rlabs zad mi shes pa'i sprin phung las/ / mchog thun dngos grub me tog char du bsnyil/ / spyan sogs shis brjod sgra brgya'i glu dbyangs len/ / khro rgyal bgegs 'joms rdo rje'i zer ma 'phro/ / phun tshogs ma tshang med pa'i dpal yon gyes/ / mchog tu shis par sgrub la rab dga' skyed/ / lha mi'i ston pa bcom ldan tshe dpag med/ / 'chi med rig 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mo dang / / blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po sras dang bcas/ / snang ba mtha' yas dpal ldan ye shes zhabs/ / rigs kun 245

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i ཿnga 'bum/khyab bdag 'jigs med dbang po sogs/ / dngos dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma la/ / legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ / khyed kyi mi mthun rgud pa kun zad cing / / bde legs yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel gyur nas/ / phun tshogs dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog / lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal bo'i dkyil 'khor gye lha'i tshogs rnams la legs pa'i tshogs ji snyed cig mchis pa'i bkra shis pa'i dam pa des skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag khyed cag 'dir 'khod pa rnams la dus thams cad du phun sum tshogs pa'i dga' ston gyi dpal la rtag tu rol ba'i shis pa lhag par skyong bar gyur cig 'khor lo'i mgon po rnam snang tshe dpag med/ / rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs/ / kun gzigs ye shes yon tan mi g.yo ste/ / tshe dpag med mgon lha dgu'i tshogs rnams la/ / legs tshogs ji snyed zhes pa nas/bya rgyud padma'i rigs kyi gtso bor gyur pa steng phyogs kyi tshe dpag med kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang / bde ba can gyi tshe dpag med kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'di nyid kyi rgyud dang gzungs kyi skor rnams dang / rgyud don nyams su len pa'i 'jug sgo chu dang cod paṇa gnyis kyi dbang dang dam tshig sku rdo rje 'grub byed lha drug gi skyed chog dang bsam gtan yan lag bzhi/ gsung rdo rje 'grub byed me gnas dang sgra gnas kyi bsam gtan/ thugs rdo rje 'grub byed sgra mthar thar pa ster ba'i bsam gtan te mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi lam la sogs pa lung dang rtogs pa'i 'khor lo gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams la legs pa'i tshogs zhes sogs dang / dus min 'chi ba'i rims nad kun sel ba/ / rdo 246

༄/ / tshedapagamed kyi bla brgyud smon shis sogs smon shis le tshan rje 'chang dbang zhal gyi bdud rtsi'i bcud/ / mtshan brgya brgyad dang 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs/ / chu dang cod paṇa dbang bskur dam tshig dang / /mtshan bcas mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor sogs/ / lung rtogs bdag nyid dam pa'i chos rnams la/ / legs tshogs zhes pa nas/ ston pa dang de'i gsung la yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po rnyed nas sngags kyi sgor zhugs te/dngosagrub kyi rtsa ba dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung zhing yang dag pa'i lam la sgrub pa lhur byed pa dang / gzhan la 'doms pa sogs kyi sgo nas zab lam rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rang gzhan gyi rgyud la spel bar byed pa'i dge 'dun dam pa rnams la legs pa'i tshogs zhes sogs dang / rtse gcig dad pa'i shugs kyis yid drangs te/ / yang dag lam bzang sgrub pa lhur byed cing / / legs par 'doms pas gzhan la spel mdzad pa/ / rigs grol 'phags pa'i dge 'dun tshogs rnams la/ / legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i zhes pa nas/rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa'i ye shes lnga'i rang mdangs/ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas par tha gru yangs pa/ nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od las rgyal ba'i gzi byin 'bar zhing / rin thang med pa'i nor bu rin po che du ma'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ thar pa chen po'i pho brang mchog la legs pa'i tshogs zhes sogs dang / nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs pa'i pho brang mchog / nyi zla'i 'od dang mnyam pa'i 'od 'phro zhing / /grangs med rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes pa la/ / dge mtshan ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ / khyed cag gang dang gang du gnas pa des/ / mi shis mtshan ma 'ga' yang mi 'byung zhing / / zhing gi 'byor pa phul du byung ba yis/ /bde legs rgyun mi 'chad pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa 'di ni khya dase legs bshad gling du sngar nas rje bla ma'i dngos slob lha gzigs grags pa rgya mtsho'i tshe dpag gi 247

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/cho ga 'don rgyun bzhin/ de'i kha skong bla brgyud smon shis dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul nang 'og ma'i bla ma rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub rgya mtsho dang / dge slong blo bzang dar rgyas bcas kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /tshe dpal mchog sbyin mgon po snang mtha' yas/ / snying po'i zhabs dang paṇa chen dze tā ri/ / bo dhi bha dra ting 'dzin bzang po la/ / gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / rdo rje gdan pa gnyis dang ba ri pa/ / brtson 'grus seng ge rgya zhang phugs pa dang / / shes rab rin chen dpal 'byor lhun grub la/ / gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / shar ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang bzhi thog pa/ / byang sems rgyal ba ye shes grags pa dpal/ / chos 'phags rgyal mtshan zhabs dang yang rtse bar/ / gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston yab sras dang / / nam mkha' rgyal mtshan rin chen dpal grub zhabs/ / mkhyen rab chos rje bsod nams mchog grub la/ / gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / bkra shis rgyal mtshan ratna sa mu tra/ / zhwa lu mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub dang / / kun gzigs rgyal dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho la/ / gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / blo bzang sbyin dang blo bzang rin chen zhabs/ / rnal 'byor dbang phyug ngag dbang mchog ldan dang / / rgyal ba'i dbang po bskal bzang rgya mtsho la/ / gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / snang ba mtha' yas mi yi zlos gar mkhan/ / thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan ye shes dang / / bka' drin mnyam med bstan pa'i sgron me la/ / gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / dus min 'chi ba'i g.yul ngo las rgyal 248

༄/ / tshedapag med kyi blabargyud smon shis sogs smon shis le tshan/zhing / / tshe rabs kun tu tshe dpag med mgon gyis/ / rjes bzung sa lam rtogasapa myur bgrod nas/ / snang ba mtha' yas go 'phang myur thob shogaces pa 'di'ang khya dge dgon gye nang 'og ma'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub dang /dad ldan dge slong blo bzang dar rgyas gnyis kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /na mo gu ru maci shrī sto na satwa sru maṇḍa le bhya bstan pa'i bdag po thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / / rgyal kun ye shes gcig bsdus 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / chos 'di'i bka' babs 'jam dpal grags pa la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / sgeg rdor nyi ma'i snying po pu tudhi/ / dharma rā dza sru dra sidhi dang / / de bi sha ra shārto garbha la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyes rlobs/ / tshangs sde bye ma lung pa chos rdor dang / / dar ma rgyal po mtshur dum bzang mo pa/ / rin bzang chos rgyal don grub dpal pa la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / sangs rgyas yon tan rngog ston byang chub grags/ / garma 'phrin las bsod nams lhun grub dang / / bsod nams bstan 'dzin 'jam dbyangs 'od zer la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / bsod nams mchog ldan rin chen rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ / mang thos rgya mtsho chos kyi rdo rje dang / / byams pa rgyal po blo gsal chos rgyan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / rgyal ba kun dngos 'jigs med dbang bo'i sde/ / rgyal sras bskal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ / rgyal bstan gsal mdzad dge legs bstan 'dzin la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / dus mthar ches dkon gsang chen gdams pa mchog / gsal mdzad smra ba'i seng ge zla med pa/ / bka' 249

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/drin mtshungs bral rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / thugs rje'i gter chen rtsa brgyud bla ma yi/ / byin rlabs lam gsum 'bab pa'i mchod yon gyes/ / las nyon dug can dri ma kun byang ste/ / lam bzang mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar dpal ldan sku gsum 'chang ba'i lha/ / ye shes lnga bdag dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi/ / rnal 'byor tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i dge tshogs kun/ / ye shes sku mchog 'grub pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ / de yi mthu las bdag sogs lus can kun/ / bco brgyad chos ldan dal ba'i rten thob cing / / mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung ste/ / thun mong lam gyis shes rgyud spyong bar shog / de nas rnam dag dbang gi gru gzings cher/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ded dpon gyis khrid de/ / ches zab gsang chen rgya mtsho'i 'jings zhugs nas/ / dam tshig nor bu tshul bzhin bsrung bar shog / rgyud kye rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i don/ / grub mchog 'jam dpal grags pas bkral ba bzhin/ / rnal 'byor rgyud ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul/ / legs par rtogs nas ji bzhin sgrub par shog / phyi nang khrus kyis nyes skyon dri ma sbyangs/ / bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur gzhengs (bzhengs) te/ /bgegs rigs tshar bcad srung ba'i 'khor lo yis/ / mi mthun bar chad g.yul las rgyal bar shog / lce lag yid dang mchod sogs byin brlabs nas/ / rlabs chen bsod nams phung po rdzogs byed cing / / snying rjes brgyan pa'i ye shes rnam pa lnga'i/ / mngon byang rim pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog / chos kyi dbyings las stong gsum 'jig rten dang / / mnyam pa'i mchod rten phyi nang gzhal yas sogs/ / bsgoms pas gang du mngon par 'tshang rgya'i zhing / / 'grub byed dge ba'i rtsa ba smin par shog / dang 250

༄/ / tshedapag med kyi blabargyud smon shis sogs smon shis le tshan/por dkyil 'khor bdag po'i skur bzhengs shing / / de nas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rdzogs pa dang / / phyag rgya bzhes btab mchod bstod bzlas pa sogs/ / ting 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor rdzogs par shog / mtshan bcas phra rags ting 'dzin mthar phyin nas/ / mtshan med spros dang bral ba'i shes rab kyis/ / lha dang sngags kyi de nyid la dmigs pas/ / ma rig 'khrul ba'i dra ba gcod par shog / khyad par rmongs pa'i mun pa mthar byed pa/ / rgyal kun ye shes sgyu 'phrul nyin mor byed/ / snying dbus shar bas chos tshul rab 'byams la/ / thogs med blo gros snang ba rgyas par shog / 'khrul bral dge ldan lugs bzang g.yas 'khyil dung / / lhag bsam rnam dpyod dbugs kyis bskul ba las/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sgra dbyangs sa gsum du/ / khyab pasasrid zhi'i rims nad sel bar shog / mdor na tshe rabs kun tu lhag pa'i lhas/ / rjes bzung rgyal kun chos kyi mdzod bzung ste/ / ring min 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i gnas thob nas/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba srid las sgol gyur cig / rnam kun mchog ldan chos dbyings lha yi lam/ / ye shes lnga yi 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa las/ / dge legs bye ba'i me tog char 'bebs pas/ / deng 'dir shis pa lhag par skyong gyur cig / 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya'i rgyal po dang / / rang byung ye shes sku mnga' 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / de yis rjes bzung grub pa'i dbang po sogs/ / dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog rnams la/ / legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ / khyed kyi mi mthun rgud pa kun zad cing / / bde legs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel gyur nas/ / phun tshogs dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog / de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang sems ma bzhi/ / phyi nang sems dpa' bcu drug phrag gnyis dang / / sgeg sogs lha mo brgyad dang sgo srung bcas/ / dkyil 'khor 'khor 25/

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/lo'i lha yi tshogs rnams la/ / legs tshogs ji snyed zhes sogs/ thub pa'i ljags yangs padmo las 'ongs pa/ / dpal ldan sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud la sogs/ / rjod byed lung dang brjod don lam 'bras kyi/ / mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa mtha' dag dag la/ / legs tshogs zhes sogs/ 'jam mgon thugs rje'i 'od zer zhugs pa yis/ / blo gros 'dab stong grol ba'i snying po ru/ / rgyud don sprang rtsi'i bcud kyis gdams pa yi/ / rab 'byams zhing gi dge 'dun 'dus tshogs la/ / legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ / zhes pa nas/ phun tshogs dpal la rol pa'i bkra shis shog /nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs pa'i pho brang mchog / ces sogs bya/ zhes pa 'di'ang a mchog bde mo thang dga' ldan chos 'khor gling 'di nyid 7skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun 'jigs med dbang po'i phyag 'debs kyi dgon lag gtso bo yin pas sku 'phreng rim pa'i 'grin las su dgongs te tshogs chen khri rin po che dkon mchog seng ge nas de ga'i lam rim grwa tshang du 'jam dpal gsang ldan gye cho ga sgrub mchodadang bcas gsar 'dzug gi bkod khyab dang thebs stsal cing / grwa tshang dpon slob 'jam dbyangs phun tshogs sogs kyis khur du blangs te gsar du btsugs skabs cho ga'i cha lag tu bla brgyud smon lam shis brjod sogs cha tshang ba zhig dgos tshul gyi bskul ma byung ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du bris pa'o/ /252

༄/ / tshe dpag med kyi bla brgyud smon shis sogs smon shis le tshan/grub chen mi tra jo ki'i lugs kyi thugasarje chen po'i brgyad 'debs smon shis bzhugs/dpal ldan rigs brgya'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / / snying rje'i gter chen mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen te/ / rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ / lam gyi gtso bo gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ /zab gsal gnyis med rnal 'byor la brten nas/ / myur du smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / dngos grub mchog brnyes tai lo sher bzang dang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rol pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs/ / 'phags pas rjes bzung mi tra dzo ke ste/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba/zhes pa nas/ 'jig rten mig gcig lo chen byams pa dpal/ / mkhas thing grub pa bsod nams dbang phyug dang / / nyams rtogs mthar son bsod nams seng ge'i zhabs/ / rje btsun rin chen seng ge rnam bzhi la/ / gsol ba/ zhes pa nas/ thams cad mkhyen dngos bu ston rin chen grub/ / khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams dang / / rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ / thub bstan yongs kyi mnga' bdag rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba/zhes pa nas/ smra ba'i nyi ma mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ / snyan brgyud bka' babs chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / / 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes chos rdo rje/ / dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba/ mas pa nas/zab lam mngon gyur rgyal ba dben sa pa/ / mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas ye 253

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'i sgroname'i khrung 'bum/shes dang / / blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rje/ / mtshungs med bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba/ zhes pa nas/ sngags 'chang chen po dge 'dun don grub dang / / lung rtogs mnga' bdag ngag dbang bstan 'dzin zhabs/ / 'dul 'dzin dam pa blo bzang mkhas btsun te/ / gsang chen gdams pa'i gter mdzod rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba/zhes pa nas/ kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde/ / rje btsun blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhabs/ / smra ba'i dbang phyug blo bzang dar rgyas te/ / byang phyogs skye rgu'i 'dren mchog rnam gsum la/ / gsol ba zhes sogs/ rigs kun khyab bdag 'jigs med dbang po'i sde/ / thar lam gsal mdzad bstan pa'i sgron me mchog / snyigs dus nyam thag 'gro ba'i skyabs kyi phul/ bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ / lam gyi gtso bo gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ /zab gsal gnyis med rnal 'byor la brten nas/ / myur du smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / mdor na snying rje'i gter chen bla ma lha/ / dbyer med thugs rje bden pa'i zil mngar gyis/ / bskyangs pas yang dag lam gyi rtsal rdzogs shing / / don gnyis dga' ba'i tshal la rol gyur cig thugs rje'i gter chen ngur smrig 'chang ba'i gar/ / grub mchog mi tra dzo ki'i bka' srol bzhin/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang bsgom bzlas mchod bstod sogs/ / bgyis pa 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs kun/ / drin can pha ma gnyen bshes rtsa lag dang / / bkol spyad bzang ngan 'brel thogs rnams kyis mtshon/ / nam mkha'i mtha' khyab rigs drug sems can rnams/ / phyag na padmas rjes 'dzin rgyu ru bsngo/ / dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang brgyud mar thob/ / theg mchog dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su 254

༄/ /tshedapag med kyi bla brgyud smon shis sogs smon shis le tshan/bzung / / nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba sogs/ / thun mong lam gyis shes rgyud sbyong gyur cig / 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang dkyil 'khor du/ / zhugs nas dngos grub kun gye gzhi dang rten / rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig sdom pa kun/ / srog dang bsdos te tshul bzhin bsrung gyur cig / phyag rgya bzhi yi thabs mkhas sgyu 'phrul gyis/ / tha mal lus ngag yid dang bya ba bzhi/ / sbyangs nas sku gsung thugs dang mdzad pa bzhi/ / bsgrubs pas yang dag lam bzang mthar phyin shog / shin tu snyigs ma bdo ba'i dus mtha' 'dir/ / rgyal ba kun las byin rlabs ches myur ba/ / khyod kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od stong gis/ / nad mug 'khrugs pa'i mun pa sangs gyur cig / khyod kyi thugs rje bdud rtsis 'gro ba'i rgyud/ / brlan pas dge bcu'i las kyi 'bras bzang smin/ / de yi mthu las rtsi bcud lo 'bras sogs/ / snod kyi 'jig rten dpal 'byor rgyas gyur cig / khyad par tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags ma thag / mtshungs med snying rje'i gter chen sa mkhan gyis/ / zhing mchog bde ba can dang po ṭa lar/ / khrid nas sras kyi thu bor 'gyur bar shog / mdor na mdo sngags zung du 'jug pa yi/ /yang dag lam bzang gegs med myur bgrod nas/ / mngon byang lnga yis spyan ras gzigs mgon gyi/ / go 'phang thob ste 'gro kun sgol gyur cig /mkha' dbyings kun khyab spyan ras gzigs mgon gyi/ / lha tshogs shis brjod snyan pa'i gdangs dang bcas/ / dge legs me tog char du bsnyil ba yis/ / phul byung legs byas dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ / khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang spyan ras gzigs/ / mi tra dzo ki rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhabs/ / rigs kun khyab bdag 'jigs med dbang po sogs/ / dngos dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma la/ / legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra 255

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/shis des/ / khyed kyi mi mthun rgud pa kun zad cing / / bde legs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel gyur nas/ / phun tshogs dpal la rol pa'i bkra shis shog / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag po pad dkar 'chang / / nor bu 'dzin dang mu tig 'dzin pa sogs/ / sems dpa' bzhi dang sgo mtshams lha mo brgyad/ / rab 'byams lha yi 'khor lo mtha' dag la/ / legs tshogs zhesapa nas/ gdul bya'i blo dang skal ba ji bzhin du/ / rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel bar sgrub tshul gyes/ / yo ga'i rgyud dang rgyud 'grel man ngag sogs/ / bstan don lam gyi rim par bcas pa la/ / legs tshogs zhes pa nas/ bsil ldan ra bas mtshan pa'i ljongs 'di sogs/ / mtha' dag zhing na lha mchog 'di nyid la/ / gcig tu gus shing sgrub pa lhur len pa'i/ / skye 'phags 'dus pa ji snyed mchis pa la/ / legs tshogs zhes pa nas/ nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs pa'i pho brang mchog / ces pa nas/ bde legs rgyun mi 'chad pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa 'di ni reb tsha rgyal mo nas mi tra dzo ki'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po lha bcu gsum ma'i sgo nas ma ṇi sgrub tshul kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhadapa'i gsung gi steng nas byed kyin yod 'dug pa der kha skong gi tshul du brgyud 'debs smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul lhag bsam rnam dpyod yangs pa sman pa dkon mchog bstan dar gyis bskul ba bzhin/ 7 btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i brgyud 'debs ni/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rtsibs stong rdzogs pa yis/ / srid zhi'i gdung ba kun skyob skyabs kyi phul/ / mchog gsum 'dus pa bla ma'i ngo bo nyid/ / bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma gdugs dkar la/ / gsol ba 'debs so nyer 'tshe kun zhi 256

༄/ /tshe dpag med kyi bla brgyud smon shis sogs smon shis le tshan/zhing / / don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin phyag na rdo rje dang / / bsam gtan bcu pa tsand+ra go mi'i zhabs/ / ghi ra ba ti rdo rje rnon po dang / padma lcags kyu rin chen rdo rje la/ / gsol ba 'debs so nyer 'tshe kun zhes sogs/ dze ta ri dang rdo rje gdan pa gnyis/ / pa ri ba dang skyu ra a skyabs dang / / sa chen kun snying grags pa rgyal mtshan zhabs/ / gser gling ba dang byang chub dpal pa la/ /gsol ba zhes sogs/ 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa dang a ka ra/ / dkon mchog tshul khrims gzhon nu tshul khrims dang / / tshul rgyal ba dang bla ma ngag dbang la/ / yon tan 'od dang seng ge rgyal mtshan pa/ / gsol ba zhes sogs/ bsod nams bzang po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang / / mkhyen rab rdo rje shākya don grub dpal/ / kun dga' legs grub kun dga' chos grags dang / / mchog legs rdo rje mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin la/ / gsol ba zhes sogs/ / ngag dbang lhun grub dam tshig rdo rje'i zhabs/ / snang ba mtha' yas blo bzang ye shes dang / / blo bzang rig grol blo bzang chos 'phel pa/ / rnal 'byor dbang phyug blo bzang mtha' yas la/ / gsol ba zhes sogs/ dkon mchog rnam gsum thugs rje gcig bsdus nas/ / 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad 'jigs med dbang po dang / / de yi lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ / gsol ba zhes sogs/ blo ldan tshogs la chos bzang lha'i mdun sar/ / thub pas legs bstan rig sngags bden pa'i mthus/ / nad rims gdon sogs 'jigs pa rmeg med du/ / zhi nas dge legs rgya mtshos khyab gyur cig /'di'ang rje btsun bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung ngo / / smon lam ni/stobs bcu mnga' ba thub pa'i dbang po yis/ / mthon mthing gtsug tor 257

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/bltar mi mngon pa las/ / nye bar 'khrungs pa rgyal yum gdugs dkar mo'i/ / rnal 'byor tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i dge tshogs mthus/ / deng nas brtsams te skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ / bar ma chad par dal 'byor rten bzang brgyud/ / theg mchog dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung ste/ / skyes bu gsum gyi lam la slob gyur cig /258

༄/ /'jamasagon dgyes pa skyedabyed bstod sprin rgyamatsho/༄7/ / 'phags mchog 'jam dpal dkar po la bstod pa 'jam mgon dgyes pa skyed byed bstod sprin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / mtha' bral shes rab 'od dkar snang bas mtha' 'dzin mun pa drungs nas phyung / / snying rje'i rang bzhin bsil ba'i zer gyis rang nyid gces 'dzin tsha gdung bcom/ / lus can phan bde'i lam bzang ma lus gsal bar byed pas mi ngal ba/ / smra ba'i zla ba 'jam dpal dpa' bo dad pa'i zur phud rgyan du rol/ / dga' tshal yid 'ong mchog tu mdzes kyang dmus long skye bos mthong min ltar/ / khyod kyi gsang gsum ngo mtshar rmad byung bdag blo'i spyod yul ga la zhig / 'on kyang 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i legs gsung rgyud mangs sgra yi rjes 'brang nas/ / bstod tshig snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len la thugs rje ldan khyod yud tsam dgongs/ / yon tan ma lus rtsa ba shes rab dang / / shes rab mchog sbyin lha mchog khyod las lhag / med ces tshad ma'i lung gi lcags kyu yis/ / bdag yid dbang med khrod kyi phyogs su drangs/ / yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas grags pa'i dbyangs/ / ngang ba'i rgyal po kun gyis snyan sgrogs kyang / / rang don la gus chu skyar phru gu bdag / re ba'i mgrin pa cung zad 'degs la spro/ / bsam spyor dngos po phun tshogs tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i mthar son pas/ / thugs gsung sku dang mtshan dpe dpe zla med pa'i zhing khams sogs/ / yon tan ma lus lhun 259

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/rdzogs rdzogs sangs rgyas la bsngags pa yis/ / rnyed dka' dal ba'i rten 'di 'di dang phyi mar don chen 'gyur/ / ke la sha yi ri bo kha ba'i mdangs/ / ma dor ltem gyis zhu ba 'khyil ba ltar/ / dkar zhing dwangs la mchog tu gsal ba yi/ / 'o ma'i chu gter pha mtha' yangs pa'i ngogs/ /lhag mar lus pa'i gangs ri'i dum bu bzhin/ / gnyis 'thung dbang po'i khyu tshogs dal gyis rgyu/ / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyang mgrin rnga brdung bzhin du/ / 'phur lding rol pa'i gar gyis kun dga' skyed/ / mardo ra dang ku mu da la sogs/ / mdog legs 'od 'bar dri bzang rdzogs pa yi/ / me tog rab rgyas tshal na bung ba'i 'phreng / / myos pa'i glu dbyangs dri za'i 'jig rten mtshungs/ / bsung zhim bser bus bskyod pa'i rlabs kyi 'phreng / / zla shel myu gu gsar ba'i spu long g.yo/ / lbu ba rab dkar mu tig 'phreng 'thor ba/ / skar tshogs khrus kyi dzing bur rtsen pa bzhin/ / mu mtha' yas pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams kyi/ / mi zad snod bcud 'byor ba'i dpal bsdus te/ / me long dag pa'i ngos la 'ja' tshon bzhin/ / ma 'dres gsal bar snang ba'i yid bzhin mtshor/ / yid 'ong 'dab stong bzhad pa'i padma dkar/ / gser mdog ge sar 'phreng ba ldem pa'i rtser/ / nya gang zla ba rgyas pa'i maṇḍa lar/ / skyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /mtshungs pa med pa lhag pa'i lha mchog mchog tu zhi ba'i nyams ldan zhing / /zhing khams kun khyab sku yi 'od snang snang byed bdag po'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ / bzhin bzang smin ma'i 'khri shing gis mdzes mdzes sdug lang tsho'i dpal gyis sgeg / sgeg cing 'dzum la dul ba'i dpal mnga' mnga' bdag mkhyen pa'i gter la 'dud/ / chu mtshams las brgal lhun po'i shar gye phyogs/ / chu shel dri med rang bzhin ngos yangs lhar/ / che zhing drang la chu 260

༄/ /'jamasagonadagyes pa skyedabyed bstodasprin rgyamatsho/zheng gab pa'i sku/ / brang yangs thal gong rgyas shing phrag pa mtho/ / 'jam mnyenagazhon sha chags pa'i phyag zhabs kyi/ / sor mo blum rgyas ring zhing dra bas 'brel/ / gsal rdzogs 'khor lo'i ri mos mthil mdzes shing / / ma btud par yang phyag gis pus mor sleb/ / g.yas pa mchog sbyin brkyangs pas ral gri dang / / g.yon pa chos 'chang phyag rgyas pu ste gas/ / mtshan pa'i utpal sdong bu legs bzung nas/ / 'gro la yang dag lam bzang mtshon par byed/ / phyag zhabs mkhrig ma'i 'bur dang rtsa mi mngon/ / ltag pa'i phyogs sogs ma rnyong kun nas mnyam/ / spe ba gnag bag med pa pags pa'i mdog / btso ma'i gser bzhin gsal la srab cing 'jam/ / nya gang zla ltar rgyas pa dpral pa'i dbyings/ / gnag snum sru mnyam smin tshugs ring po'i dbus/ / thig le'i gnas na skyu ru ra yi tshad/ / pa sangs ltar dkar g.yas 'khyil mdzod srus mdzes/ / snyan shal ring du 'phyang zhing mnyam pa'i rtser/ / dri bral nor bu'i rna lung 'khrol ba'i gzi/ / mchog tu rgyas pa 'gram pa'i me long gi / ngos su 'khyud pa'i 'od kyi rtse dga' 'dzin/ / gzengs mtho shangs kyi rgyud ni yid 'ong zhing / / mchu sgos bi pa'i dga' tshal lta na sdug / thags bzang bzhi bcu'i tshem phreng dkar zhing mnyam/ / ro mchog myong ba'i lngags mnyen srab cing ring / / nor bu mthon mthing bzhin du dkar nag cha/ / ma 'dres dmar ba'i ra ris dang bral zhing / / utpal 'dasaltar yangs pa'i dkyus ring spyan/ / phyed du zum pa zhi ba'i lta stangs can/ / gdugs ltar rgyas pa'i dbu la cod pan dang / / ral pa'i thor cog rtse na nor bu'i tog / yid 'ong mgrin par 'phyang ba'i do shal sogs/ /rgyan gyi bkod pa mdzes sdug 'gran pa bzhin/ / byin pa rlum 'ing zhabs mnyam rting ba yangs/ / gsang gnas rta mchog bzhin du nub pa sogs/ /261

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/mdzes pa dman pa'i skyon dang kun bral yang / / rnam bkra dar gyi smad g.yogs tshul bzhin bgos/ / mdor na ba sru'i khung bu re re zhing / / legs 'khrungs g.yas su 'khyil nas gyen phyogs pa'i/ / sku yi ba spu gcig gi mdzes pa'i dpal/ / srid gsum mtshar sdug yongs kyis mtshon ma yin/ / tshogs gnyisasgyu 'phrul 'phrul gyi bzo pos legs bskrun bskrun zla med pa'i sku/ /mthong tsam nyid las las nyon gdung sel 'gro kun kun dga'i dpal la sbyor/ / dge legs brgyas mtshan mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can dga' mar bcas/ / bdag gi snying la la 'ur byon te bdag blo blo gros gter du mdzod/ / yongs su dag pa'i sems nyid me long ngos/ /yid byed dad pa'i bar gyis bris pa'i gzugs/ / yab gcig mkhyen gter dngos su bzhengs pa yis/ / yang dag lam gye snang ba rtag stsol cig / tshe rabs kun tu 'jam mgon lhag pa'i lhas/ / tshad med thugs rje'i phyag gis yongs bzung ste/ / tshang la ma nor rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ / tshul bzhin slob pa'i dga' ston myong gyur cig / dag dang ma dag zhing khams rab 'byams su/ / gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i zlos gar gyes/ / srid pa ji srid 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ / rje btsun thugs rje che ldan sku thob shog / 'phags mchog 'jam dpal dkar po la bstod pa 'jam mgon dgyes pa skyed byed bstod sprin rgya mtsho las sku la bstod pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ /'jam zhing dul ba rten cing 'brel 'byung gtam/ / dbyangs snyan chos kyi dril chen 'khrol ba'i sgras/ / 'gro ba gti mug gnyid las slong mdzad pa/ / ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ / zab mo'i de nyid nyid kyis gzigs pa ji bzhin legs gsung gsung gi 'od zer gyis/ / rgyal ba'i gsung rab rab 'byams dgongs don ji bzhin gsal mdzad mdzad pa 262

༄/ /'jamasagon dgyes pa skyedabyed bstod sprin rgyamatsho/kun gyi mchog / gdul bya'i las dbang dbang po'i rim pa ji bzhin chos ston ston pa bla na med/ / bka' drin ches lhag lhag pa'i lha khyod ji bzhin gdams ngag ngag la dbang 'byor mdzod/ / khyod gsung kun gyi khams bzhin 'jug pas mnyen/ / thos pa'i mod la yid bde skyed pas 'jam/ /bajod don rmad byung ston pas yid du 'ong / / rjod byed phun sum tshogs pas yid du 'thad/ / ji bzhin gzigs te gsung bas rnam par dag / sgrib pa med par gsung bas dri ma med/ / go sla'i ngag gis 'doms phyir 'od gsal zhing / / lta ngan 'joms pa'i stobs ldan snyan la 'jebs/ / bka' bsgrubasanges par thar byed mnyan par 'os/ / pha rol rgol bas glan ka mi tshugs shing / / gnas skabs su yang dga' ba skyed pas snyan/ / nyon mongs gdul phyir gtan du phan pas dul/ / sbyor ba 'jam pos dgrol bas mi tsub cing / / phyir 'chos thabs sogs ston pas mi brlang la/ / rigs can gsum char 'dren pas rab tu dul/ / gzhan yid 'phrog par byed pas rna bar snyan/ / shin sbyang bde ba 'dren pas lus tshim la/ / lhag mthong shes rab skyed pas sems tshim zhing / / the tshom zug rngu 'byin pas snying tshim ste/ / ma rtogs log tog sel bas bde dga' skyed/ / gdams don 'bras bus mi bslu gdung ba med/ / thos byung blo rgyas kun tu shes par bya/ /bsam pas sgro 'dogs gcod phyir rnam rig bya/ / dpe mkhyud med par ston pas rnam par gsal/ / theg gsum 'bras bu 'grub mthong dga' byed la/ / byis pa rnams kyang tshul nges mngon dgar byed/ / bsam gyis mi khyab gnas kun shes byed cing / / phung sogs bsam bya'i chos kun rnam rig byed/ / rnam gsum tshad mas gnod bral rigs shing 'thad/ / snod dang 'tsham par ston phyir skabs dang 'brel/ / rnam grangs don ldan zlos pa'i 263

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/skyon dang bral/ / mu stegs klad 'gems seng ge'i sgra dang mtshungs/ /yangs shing 'dzer ba med pa glang po'i skad/ / brjid cing che la kun khyab 'brug gi sgra/ / 'jebs shing btsun pa gdengs can bdag po'i tshig / sgra skad kun las snyan pa dri za'i glu/ / rgyun chags snyan 'gyur ka la pigo'i gdangs/ /rgyun mi 'chad par grags pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ / shis pa'i dpal ster shang shang te'u'i dngags/ / gzhan gyis 'da' bar mi nus dbang po'i bka'/ / kun las rnam par rgyal bas rnga sgra ste/ / gzhan gyis bstod kyang rlom pas khengs pa med/ / smad pa yis kyang dman zhing zhum mi 'gyur/ / ji bzhin lung ston sgra kun rjes su 'jug / bsnyel ba med pas tshig gi zur phyin cing / / gzhan phan thabs kyi rnam pa mi tshang med/ / mi 'jigs bzhi dang ldan pas mi zhum zhing / / rnyed dang bkur ste'i ro la zhen pa spangs/ / 'chad la skyo ngal med pas rab tu dga'/ / rig gnas ma lus ston pas kun tu khyab/ / gzhan phan don kun tshags su tshud cing chub/ /bar ma chad du gsung bas rgyun chags 'byung / / ming tshig rnam pa du ma ston pas 'brel/ / 'gro kun so sor go bas sgra kun rdzogs/ / khams bzhin dad sogs dbang po kun tshim byed/ / gsung bzhin 'grub par 'gyur bas smad pa med/ / 'dul ba'i dus las gzhan du mi 'gyur zhing / / mchog tu brtan pas rings shing brtabs pa med/ / gdul 'os 'khor tshogs nye ring med par thos/ / srid pa'i 'ching ba 'dod chags zhi bar byed/ / legs tshogs 'joms pa'i zhe sdang dgra bo 'dul/ / kun tu rmongs pa'i gti mug mun pa sel/ / bdud kyi dpung tshogs mtha' dag pham par byed/ / rnam mang dpes mtshon rnam kun mchog dang ldan/ / mdor na dbyangs kyi yan lag kun tshangs tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa'i gsung / / gsung gcig gis 264

/ /'jamasagonadagyesapa skyedabyed bstod sprin rgyamatsho/kyang gdul bya tha dad dad brtson blo yi rim pa ltar/ / ltar snang lam las bzlog nas chos gang gang la 'tsham zhing phan byed de/ / de dang de la nye bar ston yang yang dag mtha' las ldang ba med/ / rnam 'dren sku yi cha shas kun nas 'byung / / rnam mang 'gro bas rang rang skad du thos/ / rnam kun chad med sgrogs kyang 'bad rtsol gyi/ / rnam rtog mi mnga' lha yi rnga bzhin grags/ / rtag tu ngu yis chos 'phags bsten pa ltar/ / rtag par khyod gsung bdud rtsi'i bcud myang ste/ / rtag chad lta ba'i g.yang sa kun spangs nas/ / rtag brtan thar pa'i grong du 'jug gyur cig / 'chad rtsod rtsom la mi 'jigs seng ge'i sgras/ / smra ngan glang po stong gi klad 'gems shing / /thub bstan gangs kyi ri sul skyong nus pa/ / mkhas mchog gdong lnga'i dbang por bdag gyur cig / ji srid srid pa'i 'khor lo stongs min par/ / de sridasred gsum bla ma khyod bzhin du/ / snang srid srid pa bden stong sgyu ma'i glus/ / srid 'gro dbugs 'byin gsung gi dpal thob shog / 'phags mchog 'jam dpal dkar po la bstod pa 'jam mgon dgyes pa skyed byed bstod sprin rgya mtsho las gsung la bstod pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /zla 'od 'bum gyis byugs pa'i gangs kyi ri/ / 'o ma'i chu gter dbus na gsal ba bzhin/ / yid 'ong sku yi rnam pa dran pas kyang / / yid kyi gdung sel lhag pa'i lha des skyongs/ / gting zab 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sdug bsngal mi bzad rba klong 'khrugs pa'i gting / / mtshungs med bla ma khyod dang bdag cag sngon tshe lhan cig 'khyams par mtshungs/ / de nas khyod ni snying rje'i mthu brtas rang don 'khri ba kun bcad de/ / rdzogs byang sgrub la gcig tu gzhol bas rgyal sras spyod pa yongs su rdzogs/ / bdag cag 'di na da dung mi lam tshun/ / rang bde 'dod pas de phyir ches ngal yang / / sdug 265

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'isgroname gsung 'bum/bsngal g.yang sa brgyud mar lhung ba yis/ / 'khor ba'i gting rdor gyur 'di rmongs pas bslus/ / rang gi bde la zhen pa'i nyan rang rnams/ / bdag med gnyis kyi don tsam mthong na yang / / rlabs chen spyod dang rjes su ma 'brel bas/ / 'bras bu spangs rtogs nyi tshe tsam du gyur/ / thabs mchog snying rje'i chab dang ma bral bar/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i gdar gyis brdar ba yis/ / sgrib gnyis 'ching ba gcod pa'i rno rgyun can/ / shes rab ral gri'i phyag mtshan khyod kyis brnyes/ / 'khrul snang srin po'i 'bag gis byis pa rnams/ / 'jigs skrag skyed pa'i kun rtog tho co mkhan/ / rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin mtshon rnon gyis/ / bsgral te sku bzhi'i rgyal srid khyod kyis bzung / /khyod thugs dbyings kyi mkha' las mi g.yo bas/ / ji snyed 'dzin ma'i khyon gsal nyi ma bzhin/ / mnyam brjes res 'jog gyur na sgron ma ltar/ /phyogs re tsam las kun mkhyen ga la srid/ / srid dang zhi bar kun tu ro mnyam mnyam brjes dbyer med ma 'dres chos/ / chos nyid don gzigs sgrib bral ye shes shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun tu khyab/ / khyab bdag dpal ldan bdud bzhi las rgyal rgyal sras tshul 'dzin 'gro ba'i mgon/ / mgon khyod srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas gnas med gnas de gnas pa'i mchog /rang bzhin stong pa kho na'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ / mthun pa'i rgyu las 'bras 'byung gnas nyid dang / / bzlog pa gnas min rten 'byung mi bslu'i don/ /gzigs 'di mkhyen pa rmad byung kun gyi gzhi/ / dkar nag las kyi rnam smin ma 'dres shing / / chud mi za bar gzigs nas 'gro ba rnams/ / dge bcu'i khrims kyis ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa las/ / sgrol mdzad long pa'i tshogs kyi sa mkhan bzhin/ / bsam gtan gzugs med sogs kyi snyoms 'jug la/ /bkod nas 'dod pa las 'das chags bral gyi/ / ting 'dzin bde bas 266

༄/ /'jamabagon dgyes pa skyedabyed bstodathin rgyamatsho/gnas skabs tshim mdzad pa/ / dbul po'i re skong gtong ba'i mnga' bdag bzhin/ / thar 'dod dbang po no rtul rim pa bzhin/ / brjod bya phra rags rjod byed rgyas bsdus su/ / ston pas yongs su 'dzin mkhas dge ba'i bshes/ / mdzangs pa'i ma yis bu gces skyong ba bzhin/ / 'phral la mngon gyur spyod pa tsam min par/ / gang la mos pa'i shugs ldan der gzigs nas/ / 'doms phyir ches cher phan pa'i don 'gyur ba/ / gab tshad sel ba'i 'tsho byed mkhas pa bzhin/ / nyan rang sogs kyis mthong min ches phra ba/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba'i khams rnams mngon sum du/ / gzigs phyir skyob pa'i dus las mi 'da' ba/ / sa 'og gter mthong lha yi mig ldan bzhin/ / lam ngan gol ba mtha' dag ring spangs te/ / theg gsum thar par 'jug dang bgrod pa'i lam/ / ji bzhin ston mdzad rigs can gsum gyi mgon/ / nor bu'i gling du 'khrid pa'i ded dpon bzhin/ / sngon tshe mu med skye ba'i 'phreng ba ru/ / gnas lus longs spyod mtho dman ji snyed cig / blangs shing dor te yid brtan med pa yi/ / rnam pas skyo byed las kyi me long bzhin/ / srid pa ya nga'i 'brog tu bag med par/ / 'khyams rnams rmongs pa'i gdon dang dbye byas te/ / phyi ma'i rnam smin drag po'i 'jigs bstan nas/ / zlog byed spyo 'bog sel ba'i sngags mkhan bzhin/ / las nyon zag pas bcings pa'i nyam thag 'gror/ / gdams dang rjes bstan gsung gis reg pa yis/ / zag zad srid gsum bla ma lha yi skur/ / sgyur bar byed pa brgya byin gtsug tor bzhin/ / de ltar gnas dang gnas min las rnam smin dang snyoms 'jug mkhyen stobs gsum/ / dbang mos khams dang kun 'gro sngon dang phyi mtha' zag zad mkhyen stobs bdun/ / rim bzhin mngon mtho nges legs ster bas khyod bzhed 'gro don der nges 267

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/shing / / de nyid gegs med nges par sgrub nus de phyir stobs zhes gtso bor bsngags/ / thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa theg mchog las/ / slu bar byed pa'i bdud rnams 'joms pa yis/ / skyes bu gsum gyi don byed stobs yin zhing / / sgrib gsum 'joms pa'i rdo rje'ang stobs yin no/ / de bzhin 'chad bya 'chad byed so so rim/ / spangs rtogs kun la bsnyen bral mi 'jigs bzhi/ / spyod dang rtogs dang ye shes 'azin las te/ / bco brgyad thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos/ / srung med gsum dang dran pa nyer bzhag gsum/ / gzhan phan dus las mi g.yel thugs rje tshe/ / rtag cing lhun grub smon gnas mkhyen pa dang / / 'gro ba'i 'ching gcod nyon mongs med pa sogs/ / shes bya kun la khyab pa'i mkhyen pa dang / / lus can yongs la rjes brtse'i snying rje'i sems/ / de yi rgyu can mkha' khyab 'azin las bcas/ / chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin bsam mi khyab/ / 'od gsal ye shes shes rab ral gri bden stong stong pa'i dbyings su gdengs/ / 'gro la rjes chags chags pa chen po'i rang bzhin bzhin lag gar gyis rtsen/ /brtan g.yo mtha' dag dag pa'i 'khor lor sdom mdzad mdzad pa mtha' yas te/ / bde chen nyag gcig gcig las du ma'i gar rol rol rtsed su yis dpog / kun mkhyen mkhyen rab rab gsal nyi ma'i 'od/ / gang thugs thugs rjes rjes chags zla ba'i zer/ / bstod dbyangs dbyangs snyan snyan dgur 'khrol ba yis/ / 'gro kun kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dpal thob shog/ mtha' yas zhing du bzhugs pa'i rgyal rnams las/ / mtha' bral de nyid gdams pa'i bcud myang ste/ / mthu chen rgyal sras tshogs kyi rnam thar dang / / mthun par tshogs gnyis spyod pa mthar phyin shog / gzungs spobs ting 'dzin mngon par shes pa sogs/ / yon tan dkyil 'khor 268

༄/ / 'jamasagonadagyes pa skyedabyed bstod sprin rgyamatsho/yongs su rdzogs gyur te/ / zad med legs bshad bdud rtsi'i 'od snang gis/ / lus can snying gi gdung ba sel gyur cig / 'jigs med zla dang bral ba'i rnam dpyod kyi/ / dpung ba snying stobs brtsan po'i shugs 'chang pas/ / 'khrul bral blo bzang rgyal ba'i mdo sngags kyi/ / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rtag tu bsgreng gyur cig / 'phags mchog 'jam dpal dkar po la bstod pa 'jam mgon dgyes pa skyed byed bstod sprin rgya mtsho las thugs la bstod pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing na mtha' yas rgyal bas rgyun chad med par rab bsngags pa/ / gang gi snyan pas 'jig rten gsum bkang 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes rab tu grags/ / gang de'i yon tan cung zad gus pas brjod pa'i bstod sprin rgya mtsho 'di/ / gang zhig 'dzin cing klog pa de yi yid la 'jam dbyangs myur 'jug shog / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson blo gros dang ldan pa bsod nams bzang pos lha mchog 'di la bstod pa rgyas pa rje bla ma'i gsung gi bstod sprin rgya mtsho lta bu zhig dgos zhes nan gyis bskul bar brten/ tshig don gang thad nas de'i phyogs su 'gro ba tsam 'ong ba'i re ba ga la yod kyang / mkha' lding dbang pos bgrod pa'i shul du bye'us rtsol ba ltar dam pa'i rjes su kha mig yar bltas pa la ga'an gyis 'phyas gdags pa'i don med cing rang nyid skal ba bzang po'i rten 'brel du bsams te/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil gyi nye 'dabs dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du sug bris bgyis pa las shog bur 'bebs pa po ni bikhru ratna ā nanta'o/ / 'di'ang rang gzhan kun gyi rgyud la gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can skye ba'i rgyur gyur cig /269

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i 'dod gsol las bzhi sbun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / rnam dag dang ba'i yid kyi me long ngos/ / rgyal kun thugs rje'i ri mo yongs smin las/ / dge legs snang ba'i mchog sbyin bcom ldan ma/ /yid bzhin 'khor los shis pa mchog gis skyongs/ / gang gi thugs rje'i nor bu ke ta ka / / gnyug ma'i sems nyid kun gzhi'i mtshor zhugs pas/ / mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i snyigs ma kun byang ste/ / dge mtshan bye ba'i rang 'od 'char bar mdzod/ / tshe dpag med mgon thugs bskyed ral ba'i bcud/ / 'phags ma'i zhal sgo las 'ongs gaṅgā mas/ / dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen gyi dri ma kun/ / lhag med byang zhing dag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bshes gnyen ri dbang lhun po rtag brtan cing / / rgyal bstan nyi zla'i 'od snang 'grib pa med/ / 'jig rten bde 'byor 'khyil ba'i rgya mtshor bcas/ / thugs rje khor yug ri bos yongs bzung mdzod/ / sdug bsngal g.yang sa brgyud mar brdeg 'cha' ba'i/ / byed po kun tu rmongs pa mthug po'i smag / drungs nas 'byin pa'i byin rlabs zla shel gye/ / 'od zer dkar po'i snang bas khyab par mdzod/ / dpag yas yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas las/ / thon pa'i tshe dpal bsod nams lung rtogs kyi/ /dzasbu nā da'i rgyal mtshan mthor bsgrengs pa'i/ / 'od zer ser po'i snang bas khyab par mdzod/ / srid na ches mtho'i skye dgu nyi ma'i 'phreng / / mngon 270

༄/ /'phagasamayid bzhin 'khor lo'i 'dod gsol/'dod dad pa'i skya rengs kyis drangs te/ / nye bar 'du ba rtsom pa'i mtshams sprin gyi/ / 'od zer dmar po'i snang bas khyab par mdzod/ / bstan dgra phye mar 'thag pa'i mthu stobs kyi/ / gnam lcags thog mda' 'bebs pa'i sgra brgya pa/ / dbyar skyes beeḍūr ri bo brtsegs 'dra ba'i/ / 'od zer sngon po'i snang bas khyab par mdzod/ / mos pa khams dang skal ba tha dad pa'i/ /gdul bya'i re ba rdzogs byed rab 'byams las/ / sna tshogs rkang 'thung g.yu yi tshal 'khrigs pa'i/ / 'od zer lngang gu'i snang bas khyab par mdzod/ /'gal rkyen gang gis mi tshugs bsrung ba'i mchog / khor yug yongs bskor spug nag lcags ri'i ngos/ / ye shes me lce'i mdangs kyis 'khyud pa yi/ /'od zer mchin kha'i snang bas khyab par mdzod/ / mdor na skyob pa rigs lnga ye shes lnga'i/ / bdag nyid mi shigs 'od kyi gur khang du/ / lhan skyes bzhin du 'bral med yongs bzung ste/ / mi mthun bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod/ / 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi rgya mtshor 'khyil/ / dpal 'byor mnga' thang lhun po'i spo ltar mtho/ / lung rtogs yon tan mkha' ltar rgya che ba'i/ / legs tshogs ma lus lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / ji srid byang chub la gnas de srid du/ / rje btsun ma yis 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / yang dag lam gyi bgrod pa yongs rdzogs nas/ / 'gro kun sgrol mdzad sgol ma'i sku thob shog / ces 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i 'dod gsol las bzhi lhun grub cesabyu ba 'dini bsngags 'os yon tan du ma'i rgyan ldan zhabs drung dkon mchog rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /271

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / mdo sngags kyi lam yongasastsogs zung ldan gyi sgo nas bstan pa rgyal ba dgyes pa'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can bcas la gus btud nas/ /gsung rab rab 'byams kun gyi dgongs pa'i don/ / snyan tshig tshig 'phreng nyung ngur spel ba yis/ / mdo rgyud rgyud mangs 'khrol ba'i dbyangs su len/ / legs tshogs tshogs gnyis 'bras bur bcas pa yi/ / 'byung gnas gnas skabs mthar thug dus kun gyi/ / skyabs mchog mchog gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / bla ma ma bcos dad pas tshul bzhin bsten/ /'dod gzugs gzugs med kun tu 'khyams na yang / / chos tshul tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i dal 'byor rten/ / rnyed dka' dka' ba brgya yis bsgrubs na yang / / myur du du ma'i rkyen gyis 'jig par nges/ / ngan song song tshe 'gyod kyang byar med pas/ / de las las 'bras blang dor shes dus 'dir/ / bdag bde bde 'gro'i go 'phang don gnyer gyis/ / skyabs 'gro 'gro ba bzhi bral la 'bad de/ / phyi ma ma kir mi 'gro'i gdeng tshad cig /gang skyes skyes bu chung ngu'i yang rtse yin/ / ji srid srid pa'i rtsa ba ma chod pa/ / de srid srid 'dir bde ba'i skabs med pas/ / srid la la 'ur 'jigs shing skrag pa yis/ / de spong spong bdun khrims la legs gnas te/ / nyer zhi zhi bde gtso bor sgrub 'dod kye/ / blo skyes skyes bu 'bring gi 272

༄/ /mdosngags kyi lamayongs rdzogs zung ldan gyisgo nas bstan pa/lam du bshad/ / srid 'di 'di ltar thog ma med nas myul/ / pha ma ma byas sems can 'ga' yang med/ / des na na 'chi srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ / 'gro kun kun mkhyen thar pa'i grong mchog tu/ / 'khrid phyir phyir mi ldog pa'i sems skyed mchog / nam skyes skyes bu chen po'i grangs su tshud/ / ga'an phan phan sems tsam gyis mi 'grub pas/ / bya dka' dka' ba brgya phrag spyod dgos la/ / de yang yang dag lam gyi spyi sdom ni/ / bdog kun kun 'dzin med pa sbyin pa'i mchog / ngang tshul tshul dang mthun pa khrims kyi mchog / dgra gnyen gnyen du snyoms pa bzod pa'i mchog / bya bar bar gcod mi tshugs brtson pa'i mchog / ting 'dzin 'dzin med gsal stong bsam gtan mchog / bden zhen zhen yul drungs phyung shes rab mchog / snying rjes rjes su chags pa thabs mchog bcas/ / theg chen chen po bdun ldan lam bzang la/ / 'bad de de ni rgyal ba'i gzhung lam yin/ / de tshe tshe gcig nyid la rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / sgrub rnams rnam dag dbang thob dam tshig bsrung / /zab lam lam bzang skyed rdzogs gnyis sogs la/ / go rim rim pa bzhin du slob pa gces/ / 'od gsal gsal bar 'char ba'i lus kyi gnad/ /mthar thug thugs ga'i rtsa mdud rdzogs par grol/ / spros kun kun gsal dbyings su zhi ba ni/ / nges don don dam bden pa'i rim pa yin/ / lus kun kun da zhu ba'i bde chen gyis/ / khyab las las rlung rgyu ba kun 'gags te/ / gang snang snang stong lha yi 'khor lo ru/ / shar kun kun rdzob bden pa'i rim pa yin/ / bden gnyis gnyis su mi phyed sgyu lus dang / / 'od zung zung du 'jug pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ / kun khyab khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / / legs thob thob bya'i 'bras bu mthar thug yin/ / sgra rgyan rgyan gyi lugs dang mi 'gal zhing / / brjod don don gyi snying po kun 'dus 273

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/pa'i/ / gtam 'di 'di 'dra'i tshul la mos rnams kyis/ / gsan te te por lag tu len par mdzod/ / dge bas bas mthar sgrub pa'i bcud myong zhing / / snyan ngag ngag gi longs spyod mgrin glu len/ / mang thos thos don sgrub la gzhol rnams kyis/ / tshul 'di 'di bzhin gegs med spyod gyur cig / de'ang zung ldan gyi sbyor tshul ni rje bla ma'i gsung rab rnams las mang du 'byung ba bzhin/ snga phyi mi zlos shing don dang 'brel ba zhig dgos na'ang /da lta 'ga' zhig gis dkar dkar mang mang bzang bzang zer ba lta bu bsgrigs 'dug pa ni dgos nus chung bar snang bas/ mdo sngags kyi lam yongs rdzogs zung ldan gyi sgo nas bstan pa rgyal ba dgyes pa'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di'ang rje'i gsung gi rjes su 'brangs te/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /dal 'byor don che dang rnyed dka' bsam na/ / don med bya ba la bkol ba phang ngo / / nam 'chi nges med dang bzlog med bsam na/ / bag med sos dal du sdod pa 'khrul lo/ / bzod dka' thar med kye ngan song bsam na/ / skyabs shig de ring rang mi btsal thabs med/ / las 'bras nges pa dang 'phel tshul bsam na/ / dge sdeg phra mor yang bag zon byed dgos/ / 'khor ba mtha' ngan gyi ngang tshul bsam nas/ / nges 'byung tshul khrims la slob par byed dgos/ / drin lan 'khor med kyi ma rnams don du/ / sems bskyed phyin drug gi spyod la slob dgos/ / khyad par mtha' bral gyi lta bas rgyas btab/ / zab lam gsang sngags kyi snon pa 'debs dgos/ / de dag thams cad kyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen/ / bsten tshul rten 'brel gyi mgo nas 'grig dgos/ / zhes pa'ang rje nyid kyi gsung yin no/ /274

༄/ / thogama'izung ldan gyisgonas bstod pa dge leṭa dpalamachog༄7/ / khub bdag rdorje 'chang kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po la thog ma'i zung ldan gyi sgo nas bstod pa dge legs dpal mchog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄za/ / dge legs chu gter gting mtha' mi mngon zhing / / dge tshogs rin chen rdul brtsegs lhun po'i spor/ / dge 'dun 'dus pa lha brgya'i gtsug gi rgyan/ / dge ldan bstan pa'i gnyen gcig rgyal gyur cig / legs byas bye ba brgya yis bsgrun pa'i sku/ / legs bshad zab mo'i dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa'i gsung / / legs nyes blang dor ma lus gzigs pa'i thugs/ / legs pa'i lam ston 'dren pa gtsug gis mchod/ / dpal mchog bde ba chen po'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ / dpal stug dag pa'i brtan g.yo rab 'byams kyi/ / dpal du shar ba dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /dpal ldan bla ma snying gi ze'u 'brur bzhugs/ / mchog tu mi 'gyur chos sku'i mkha' dbyings las/ / mchog thun dngos grub gru char 'jo ba yis /mchogadaman skye rgu'i re ba rdzogs mdzad pa/ / mchog gi dang po'i mgon po der phyag 'tshal/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes me shel khams/ / rab yangs bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i nam mkha' la/ / rab gsal 'phrin la sa 'od kyi snang ba 'bum/ / rab tu spro mdzad sa gsum 'gro ba'i mig / skyabs 275

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/gnas dkon mchog rnam gsum gcig bsdus te/ / skyabs kyi mchog gyur bshes gnyen tshul bzung ba/ / skyabs gcig 'jigs med dbang po'i zhabs pad la/ / skyabs su mchi'o byang chub bar du skyongs/ / kun bzang spyod tshul dpag yas rnam par thar/ / kun gsal mtha' dang mnyam pa'i cha tsam zhig / kun nas dang ba'i yid kyis spel ba 'di/ / kun mkhyen bla ma dgyes pa'i mchod par 'bul/ / rgyal bstan kun la mang thos mthar son cing / /rgyal gsung drang nges ma lus gdams par shar/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin sgrub pa yis/ / rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rnam thar rang gir mdzad/ / rnam 'dren yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhabs kyi rdul/ / rnam pa kun tu gus pas legs bsnyen te/ / rnam mang chos kyi mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas/ / rnam thar dang po'i rten 'brel sgo 'phar phyes/ / gnas gsum gzhal bya'i khyon yangs ji snyed dang / / gnas lugs ji lta ba yi don gzigs shing / / gnas lnga rig pa'i pha rol son pa yis/ / gnas skabs kun tu 'khrul ba'i dri ma bral/ /smra ngan spobs pa 'phrog byed sgra tshad dang / / smra bsam lus bzo gso ba rig pa'i gzhung / / smra dbang thub bstan snying po nang don kun/ / smra la zla med ma hā paṇḍi ta/ / sa steng mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ / sa gsum mthar 'dod yongs kyi mig gcig pu/ / sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal sras tshogs kyi rje/ / sa 'dir kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang por grags/ / chos mdzod zad mi shes pa'i gter grol te/ / chos 'dod skal ldan yongs kyi mos pa bzhin/ / chos sbyin mi zad 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin pa/ / chos kyi rgyal po khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon/ / rgya chen 'khor dbus legs bshad 'doms pa na/ / rgya mtsho chen por gru gzings btang ba bzhin/ / rgya bod mkhas mang gzhung brgya'i khog phul ste/ / rgya cher bshad pas blo gros rgyas par byed/ /276

༄/ / thogama'izung ldan gyisgonas bstod padage leṭa dpalamatshoba'ajam mnyen ljags kyi dbang po nyer bkram ste/ / 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i legs bshad snyan dgu'i tshogs/ / 'jam zhing snyan pa'i gdangs su bsgrags pa na/ / 'jam dpal gzhon nu nyid dang dbyer ma mchis/ / ma dag srid pa'i btson rar chud pa yi/ / ma rnams bde chen thar bar 'khrid pa'i phyir/ / ma lus dbang khrid lung dang man ngag kun/ / ma ltar brtse ba'i thugs kyis 'doms par mdzad/ / dus kyi dbang gis chos rgyun nyams pa rnams/ / dus mthar dam chos 'dzin pa'i thugs bskyed mthus/ / dus 'dir sa steng kun tu rgyas mdzad pas/ / dus gsum rgyal kun bzhed pa yongs su bskangs/ / phyogs glang grags pa'i rigs lam zab mo yis/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal rnga gsang ldir ba na/ / phyogs 'dzin rmongs pas mngon rlom gyes mtho ba'i/ / phyogs snga kun gyi snying rtsa lkog mar bros/ / smra ba ngag gi dpal la dbang 'byor ba'i/ / smra ba'i seng ge'i rtsod ngag gad rgyangs kyis/ / smra ba ngan pa'i wa skyes tshogs rnams kun/ / smra bcad dgun gyi khu byug bzhin du byas/ / legs sbyar sgra don rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis/ / legs gsung sde snod nor bu'i mdzod 'dren pa/ / legs bshad dri med rtsom pa'i dga' ston mchog / legs par spel bas mkhas kun yid rab 'phrogs/ /so thar sogs kyi tshul khrims rnam par dag / so na gnas pa'i rtse gcig ting 'dzin brtan/ / so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab cher rgyas pas/ / so so rang rig ye shes mngon du mdzad/ / bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems goms pas/ / bdag bde gzhan la gtong zhing sdig sdug kun/ / bdag gi steng du len la mi zhum pa/ / bdag nyid chen po'i ngang tshul e ma rmad/ /rnam dag khrims kyis nyes spyod kun sdom zhing / / rnam kun dge ba'i chos tshul yongs su sdud/ / rnam mang sems can kun gyi don sgrub pas/ / rnam gsum 277

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname gsung 'bum/tshul khrims spyod pa yongs su rdzogs/ / pha ma rigs drug 'gro la rjes brtse bas/ / pha rol phyin drug spyod pa'i gzings sbyar te/ / pha mtha' mi mngon srid pa'i chu gter gyi/ / pha rol sgrol ba'i ded dpon bla na med/ / shin sbyangs mchog gis zin pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ / shin tu gsal ba'i mngon shes me long ngos/ / shin lkog bskal pa'i gnas rnams mtha' dag kyang / / shin tu gsal zhing ma 'dres 'ja' tshon bzhin/ / mtha' bral lta ba'i sgron mes rtag chad kyi/ / mtha' la zhen pa'i mun pa rab bsal te/ / mtha' spangs dbu ma'i lam bzang gsal mdzad pas/ / mtha' dag thar 'dod gdul bya'iblo mig phyes/ / snang ba ji bzhin bden par mi dmigs kyang / / snang tsam nyid la bya byed 'thad pa sogs/ / snang stong zung 'jug klu sgrub dgos pa'i gnad/ / snang byed smra ba'i zla ba khyod min su/ / rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dbang gis rgyud smin cing / / rgyud 'grel man ngag gdams pa'i mdzod bzung ste/ / rgyud don ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa yis/ / rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i khyon la dbang bsgyur te/ / rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ / rdo rje theg pa'i gnad rnams 'doms mdzad cing / / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zab mor gzhol ba yis/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshogs kyi gtso bor gyur/ / rab tu brtan pa'i rim gnyis lam bzang gis/ / rab rmongs kun rtog spros pa sder bcas bcom/ / rab zhi'i dbyings las sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ / rab 'byams dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag por bzhengs/ / mi bzad srid pa'i sdug bsngal las 'das pa/ / mi 'gyur bde chen thugs dang ro gcig pa'i/ / mi shigs rlung gi rang 'od zung 'jug sku/ / mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs/ / bstan pa kho na lus can phan bde'i gzhir/ / bstan bzhin tshad ma'i nges pa legs 'khrungs pas/ / bstan 278

༄/ / thogasa'izung ldan gyisgonas bstod pa dge leṭa dpalasachogapa'ibu bar gcig tu gzhol ba la/ / bstan 'dzin kun gyi khrod na zla dang bral/ / chos gzhi gsar bskrun gso dang rten bzhengs sogs/ / chos spyod rnam bcu ris su ma chad pa/ / chos ldan bya ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong gis/ / chos kyi rgyal srid 'jig rten kun tu bskyangs/ / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs zhing khams rab 'byams su/ / nam mkha' ji srid 'gro rnams skyob pa la/ / nam yang bsnyel ba med pa'i thugs rje can/ / nam mkha'i rdo rje lhag pa'i lha yi mchog / gdams ngag rjes su bstan pa'i mdzod gyur kyang / / gdams yul dbye ba med par mi ston par/ / gdams pa'i bka' bab so sor 'doms pa yis/ / gdams don ji bzhin nam yang bslu ba med/ / rnam grol don gnyer gdul bya mchog rnams la/ / rnam kun mchog ldan stong dang rten 'byung sogs/ / rnam mang mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i bcud bsdus nas/ / rnam par bstan te byang chub gsum la sbyor/ / tha mal rnams kyang yal bar mi 'dor bar/ / tha snyad rig lam phra mo nas bzung ste/ / tha na yi ge 'bri brkos tshun chad la/ / tha dad blo dang 'tsham par sbyor mdzad pas/ / gang zhig khyod zhabs padmo bsten pa rnams/ / gang las ma drangs srid zhi'i rgud pa dang / / gang la ma bkod phun tshogs legs byas dpal/ /gang de kun mkhyen gyis kyang dmigs su med/ / mi bsrun bdud kyi gnyen gyur du ma yis/ / mi bzad gshe skur gnod pa'i tshogs bgyis kyang / / mi 'khrugs gnod lan phan pa sgrub mdzad phyir/ / mi mchog skyes bu 'dul ba bla na med/ / dam tshig rdo rje'i gdengs ka 'phyar ba yis/ / dam can chos srung rgya mtsho bran du 'khol/ / dam nyams tshar gcod skal ldan rjes 'dzin sogs/ / dam pa'i rmad byung thabs mkhas bsam mi khyab/ / yid srub sde dang bcas pa'i dpung 'joms shing / / yid bzhin nor ltar 'gro ba'i re ba 279

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/skong / / yid la dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel ba/ / yid can kun gyi mgon dang skyabs kyi phul/ / khyod ni bla ma khyod ni yi dam dang / / khyod ni mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun dngos te/ / khyod min skyabs gzhan 'ga' yang mi 'tshol bas/ / khyod kyis thugs rjes nam yang ma gtong zhig / don che rnyed dka' dal ba'i rten bzang 'di/ / don med bya ba'i ngang du mi gtong bar/ / don ldan chos la gcig tu brtson pa yis/ / don gnyis dga' ston 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / srid gsum 'khor ba me 'obs ltar mthong ste/ / srid pa'i phun tshogs kun la zhen log nas/ / srid bral zhi ba'i go 'phang don gnyer gyis/ / srid las nges par 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs/ / ma lus rgyal sras spyod pa'i gzhi dang rten/ / ma ltar brtse ba chen po'i dbang gyur te/ / ma rnams sgrol 'dod rin chen byang chub sems/ / ma bcos rnal ma skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ / mtshan ldan bshes gnyen gdams pa'i mig sman gyis/ / mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rab rib kun bsal te/ /mtshan med spros bral lta bas gnas lugs kye/ / mtshan nyid mngon sum mthong bar byen gyis rlobs/ / rim par rgyud sbyangs gsang sngags sgor zhugs te/ / rim pa dang po'i phra rags rnal 'byor dang / / rim lngas bsdus pa'i sbyor ba yan lag drug / rim bzhin rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /srid par 'ching ba'i nyes pa kun spangs kyang / / srid 'dir bsam bzhin skye ba'i gar mdzad pa/ / srid gsum bla ma thugs rje'i bdag nyid des/ / srid pa ji srid rjes su 'dzin gyur cig / sa mkhan bshes gnyen dam pa'i rjes zhugs te/ / sa dang lam gyi rtogs pa rim bgrod nas/ / sa bcu'i mthar son spangs rtogs kun rdzogs te/ / sa gsum 'gro ba'i mgon du 'gyur bar shog / bstan pa'i rtsa lag mchog rnams zhabs brtan cing / / bstan srung 280

༄/ / thogama'izung ldan gyisanas bstod padage leṭa dpalamachogargya mtshos 'azin las tshul bzhin sgrubs/ / bstan la gus mchod bgyid rnams mnga' thang rgyas/ / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur bsgreng gyur cig / ces bka' drin 'khor med khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigasamed dbang bo'i zhal snga nas la thog ma'i zung ldan gyi sgo nas bstod pa dge legs dpal mchog ces bya ba ni/ a mchog lam rim grwa tshang gi slob zur lhag bsam rnam dpyod phul du byung ba 'jam dbyangs phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes thun mong snang tshod kyi rnam thar rags tsam zhig sgro skur spangs te sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni sngags rams pa kun dgas bgyis pa 'di'ang tshe rabs kun tu bla ma mchog gis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /281

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / 'jam mgon bla ma la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pag la thaba'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄za/ / blo bzang dbyangs can ngag gi dpal mnga' ba/ / grags pa'i rdza rnga phyogs kyi mdzes mas brdung / / dpal ldan mkhas pa kun gyi mgos gtugs pa/ / khyod kyi zhabs la bdag kyang phyag bgyid do/ / ngo mtshar zad mi shes pa lung rtogs kyi/ / yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas gting dang mtha'/ / rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i dpal dang nam mkha'i khyon/ / lhan cig mnyam pa nyid du brjod las 'das/ / brjod bral brjod par rtsom pa'i ngal khur gyes/ / dbyangs ldan dbyangs kyi nga ro 'dar dang bcas/ / phang 'gro phang bar nyal ba'i zol brten na/ / phal bas phul du phyin par ga la zhig /'on tang khung bu ma yin kha sgo las/ / sngags kyis rengs par ma byas ro 'dzin gyis/ / tshe rabs 'di dang gzhan du 'dod pa'i don/ / sgrub phyir cha tsam spel la ches cher spro/ / ya rabs rigs mtho skyes ri mthon po'i rgyud/ /'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rgyun gyi ngogs/ / tsong kha zhes grags 'dzin ma'i thig le ru/ / gzigs pa rnam lnga'i dge mtshan skya rengs shar/ / snyigs ma'i gshin rjer khros pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / ral ba rwa yi gdengs gar bsgyur bas kyang / / ma ngoms gser gyi cod pan rtse gcig tu/ / bsgril te srid pa'i lto ba 'dral bar chas/ / rigs gsum rnam par 'phrul ba'i ltas kyi 282
