༄/ /'jamasagon blam la bstod pa'i rab tubyed pa/gtam/ / dpyad gsum dag pa'i gtan tshigs che na yang / / dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kyi mkhyen brtse dang / / nus gsum 'bral ba'i dogs pa gang na mchis/ / don kun grub pa gnyis pa'i gzhon nu de/ / don grub rin chen bshes kyis yongs bzung bas/ / don dam blo gros bzang por grags pa'i mtshan/ / don dang mthun pa rna ba'i bcud len gyur/ / ma la yar skyes lngug phran mngar ba'i bsung / / lhan skyes gdung sel cho ga rdzogs pa des/ / 'di na dri bzang byugs pa'i gor ma la/ / snoms pa'i tshogs la 'phya ba gor ma chag / mkhyen rab snang ba'i mchog sbyin mkhyen gter gyis/ / rjes su brtse bas 'bral med rjes bzung zhes/ / bsngags pa gzhan sems 'brid pa'i bsngags brjod de/ / rang gi byed pa ji ltar rang la 'jug / de nas dran dbang gser ri'i 'phreng bstar ba'i/ / dbus 'gyur chos kyi rgya mtshor mngon phyogs pa/ / gdos pa zung gis bskyod pa'i gzings bzhin te/ /thugs dang blo dang brtson 'grus 'khar bas brten/ / der yang mkhas dgu'i thugs bcud phon po'i tshogs/ / re re'i kham gyis lhag mar ma lus tshe/ / re ba'i phyogs su snoms pa'i gnyis 'thung dbang / / rang gi gtsug skyes 'gram chang kho nas myos/ / de lta na yang gzhon nu'i blo gros mtsho/ /mkhas pa'i dbang bo gzhon nu blo gros kyi/ / legs bshad klung brgyas cha tsam gangan yang / / lta ba 'tshol ba'i rta gdong ngoms ma gyur/ / klu sgrub klu yi dbang bo'i rol gnas las/ / zla bral zla ba'i legs bshad bdud brtsi'i chus/ / gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i bden don zung / / ma nor ma 'dres 'byed pa'i spobs pa brnyes/ / rang bzhin stong ba'i mkha' las mi 'da' yang / / lta la chags pa'i gnas med spros dang bral/ / ji snyed 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor kun gsal yang / / 'gar yang mngon zhen dmigs gtad 283

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/reg pa med/ / snang ba tsam gye tha snyad me long la/ / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i byi dor bya byed kun/ / bsnyon med 'char ba'i ngo mtshar gzigs mo yis/ / blo ldan sgeg mo'i dgos don ci yang 'grub/ / rten 'byung 'doms pa rgyal ba'i ngo mtshar sku/ / dwangs pa'i thugs kyi me long la 'phos tshe/ / bar ba mtshan med gtam gyi brag cha'i dbyangs/ / de yis khyod kyi mgur nas bsgrags pa bzhin/ / rtag chad 'phrang skya thags su 'khrul ba yis/ / dgag sgrub rkang stabs 'cha' ba'i rab rib can/ / kun kyang blo mig gser gyi thur ma yis/ / phye tshe dga' dang skrag pas 'dar ba bsten/ / ka dī ka yi rung chu 'debs pa nas/ / sa ma dza yi bden gnyis dbyer med par/ / mdo sngags bcu drug cha shas lam gyi lus/ / dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs te thugs mkhar gsal/ / drang nges ri klung bkod pa mtha' yas kyang / / rton pa rnam bzhi'i mkha' la lding ba yi/ / rnam dpyod grib ma mthun par 'jug pa ni/ /'gal ba'i gcong rong brgya yis dgag tu med/ / brda sprod las bzhi bya ba'i 'khor lo sogs/ / bstan pa'i gdugs dkar rtsibs ma re re ste/ / rdzogs par 'degs la mdo sngags lam rim nyid/ / yu bar phul byung zhabs dang khyod kyis gzigs/ / rab dkar gangs ris bskor yang mun nag gtibs/ / kun kyang dbu mar bsnyems bzhin mtha' la lhung / / rig 'dzin phal cher sngags la ma phyogs pas/ / rgyal bstan ming gi lhag mar gyur pa na/ / thub pas khyod la dbang bo'i tog gi drung / / dam bcas bu lon bzhin du bsnyegs pa'i lan/ / chos tshul rab 'byams nor bu'i zong bkram pas/ / thar 'dod yongs kyi re ba gcig car bskangs/ / sgyu lus sgyu ma'i glang bo bzhin gyur cing / / 'od gsal 'od snang yal bar rtsom pa na/ /zung du sprel te zung 'jug gnad dang bcas/ / rdo rje 'chang dbang rdo rje'i 284

༄/ /'jamamagon blas la bstod pa'i rab tubyed pa/tshig gis bkral/ / rtsing spyod rba klong 'khrugs pa snyigs ma'i mtshor/ / bying ba rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i rig byed gzhung / / bshad sgrub rus sbal zol gyis btegs pa na/ / 'phrog byed rang gi snyems pa'ang gting du byings/ /gsung rab kun la rgyas btab phyag rgya ste/ / mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug na nor bu'i tog / smra ngan kun la dus kyi chad pa bzhin/ / gyur pa khyod gsung rnam pa kun dang ldan/ / de yi brag cha phyogs kyi ri bo'i mgul/ / kun nas bsgrags pa ma smad ri bo'i dbyangs/ / rgya mtsho'i ska rags 'chang ba'i 'dzin ma 'dir/ / mtha' dbus med pa lha yi rnga bzhin khyab/ / mngon par 'phel lo zla bas rgya mtsho dang / / 'od stong 'bar ba'i zer gyis padma'i tshal/ /khyod kyi mdzad pas thub bstan mtha' dag dang / / gzur gnas dad pas khyod kyi grags pa'i 'phreng / / chos don padma'i tshal la 'phur lding gis/ /rtsen pa'i rkang drug nyer zhi'i dri bsung dang / / da lta rnyed bkur zang zing sha rul la/ / 'khor ba'i sprang bu 'di snang dri nga mtshon/ / chos dang chos min mi phyed skye bo la/ / grags par grags pa phal cher log pa ste/ / mkhas pa'i mkhas pa kun gyi mgos gtugs pa'i/ / mgon khyod mgon du bsten rnams skal ba bzang / / legs bshad mdzes dga' ma yin lang tsho la/ / rjes su chags pa'i dran dbang gzhon nu'i tshogs/ / khyod zhabs padma'i drung du bsnyegs pa ni/ / so ga'i glang chen mtsho la 'du ba bzhin/ / gang gi yon tan rmad byung sbrang rtsi'i chang / / cha tsam myang tshe phyi phyir 'phel ba yis/ /shugs drag 'dun pa bzlog tu ma mchis pas/ / gzhan gyi lta sgom spyod pas drangs su med/ / srid pa gsum na cher 'phags yongs 'du'i ljon/ / gang gsung las skyes me tog re re'i bsung / / phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i mtha' la 'khyud pa na/ / bdag nyid chen po'i rang bzhin su yis dpog / yab 285

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gcig khyod kyi thugs rjes yongs bzung ba'i/ / skal ldan dus kyi mthar yang mi 'chad phyir/ / dpyad gsum dag pa'i bshad sgrub 'phrin las rgyun/ /bskal ba phyi mthas gtugs par chad pa med/ / 'dzin ma 'dzin bzod mi dbang blon 'bangs sogs/ / 'byor ldan 'byor ba'i snying bo kun bstabs pa/ / rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams la mchod sprin dang / / dge ldan dge 'dun 'dus pa'i chas su bsgrubs/ / gzhan du 'dod yon 'dod lha'i dga' ma'i 'dzum/ / thar ba'i srog 'phrog srin mo'i khro gnyer du/ / gzigs nas sreg bral srid gsum bla ma khyod/ / longs spyod gdug sbrul gdengs ka rdog pas mnan/ / mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i spyod pa rnam par dag / mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i sgom pa mnyam par 'jug / mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i lta ba spros dang bral/ / de phyir kun tu dbu ma chen por gnas/ / thub bstan rin chen 'dzin skyong spel ba'i thabs/ / rgyal sras rnams kyis bskal bar dgongs pa'i don/ / mtha' dag ma tshang med par bsgrubs pa yis/ / gangs can bstan 'dzin kun gyi rtse mor son/ / rgyan drug mchog gnyis grub chen brgyad cu sogs/ / 'dus zhal gcig pur gyur pa khyod kyi zhabs/ / bsten pas kun gye gsang mdzod 'thob nus na/ / bzang po'i skal bar mi spyod shes ldan gang / / de phyir bdag kyang bde gshegs snying bo'i 'bras/ / byang chub gserasbyang khams su smin pa'i bar/ / khyod kyi thugs rje byin rlabs ma dros mtshor/ / 'bral med bsten pa smon pa'i snying bor bgyid/ / de nyid kho na yid la brnag pa yis/ / bstod tshig ka la ping ga'i glur blangs te/ / mkhas dbang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi mgrin pa'i rnga / / phyogs brgyar 'khrol ba yis kyang spro ba skyes/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob gcig pu ste/ / thub bstan yongs kyi mnga' bdag gcig pu dang / / ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon 286

༄/ /'jamamagon blam la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa/skyabs gcig pu ba/ / khyod kyi zhabs la snying nas phyag brgyadalda/ / 'dis mtshon dge tshogs zla ba'i 'khri shing ni/ / dal 'byor tshes kyi 'phel ba mi nyams shing / / rnam dag bslab gsum cha shas yongs gang las/ / legs bshad bsil ba'i zer brgya spro bar shog / yab rjes ji ltar gdams pa'i bka' srol mchog / tshang la ma nor mdo sngags lam bzang la/ / gol ba med pa'i bgrod pa mthar phyin te/ / nges legs khang bzang rtse mor 'jug gyur cig / ma lus rgyal ba'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa/ / khyod bzhin khyod kyi gsang ba'i mdzod bzung ste/ / thar 'dod yongs la mchod sbyin 'gyed pa yis/ / 'gro kun srid zhi'i dbul ba sel gyur cig / gangs ri'i thor cog zhu ba gaṅgā'i rgyun/ / zab yangs rgya mtsho'i klong du sim pa bzhin/ / rnam dkar dge tshogs mgon khyod thugs bskyed kyi/ / rgya mtshor ro gcig mi zad gnas thob shog / mdor na kun tu bzang dang 'jam dpal sogs/ /rgyal sras kun gyi rlabs chen smon lam dang / / spyod pa kun la zhum med slob pa yis/ / ring min kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i gnas thob shog / ces 'jam mgonabla ma la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa ka la pigo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni a mchog dge bshes kyi sprul sku mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug ratna shā sa na rta dzas rje'i rtogs brjod snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung gi tshigs bcad 'di'i rgyas bshad kyi tshul du/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /287

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ /'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ /༄7//blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i thugs kyi bcud/ /gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'dzin cing / /grub rigs bye ba'i gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /shes rab serge'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sde snod gsum gyi rgya mtsho'i 'jing la gnas/ / rnam dag bslab gsum nor bu'i bang mdzod 'dzin/ /'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang gru char 'bebs/ /dge 'dun phun tshogs zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mang du thos pas legs bshad dga' ston 'gyed/ /tshul bzhin sgrub pas rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ /'phrin las bzang pos rgyal bstan phyogs mthar spel/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khrul bral lha dang bla ma'i bka' lung gis/ / nyer drangs skal bzang dad pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /lung rigs 'od stong spro mdzad chos kyi rje/ /dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mer gsol ba 'debs/ /khe grags dor te bshes gnyen mang du bsten/ /skyo ngal spangs te gzhung lugs rgya mtshor sbyangs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas skal ldan rjes su 'dzin/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i ke lā sha/ /man ngag bdud rtsis gtams pa'i chu rgyun gyis/ /dug gsum nad kyi gdung sel 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mtshungs med bshesaganyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /skye zhing skye bar rje btsun bla ma 288

༄/ / 'khrungasarabs gsol 'debasanor bu'iphreng ba/yis/ / 'bral ba med par dgyes bzhin rjes 'dzin cing / / gsung gi bdudaci nyams su myong ba yis/ / rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa 'di ni dad gtong lhag bsam dang blang dor 'byed pa'i blo gros sogs dpal 'phreng dang chos mtshungs pa rdzong 'gag rgyal mo bsod nams sgrol ma'i gsung gis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dwa tshang dgon gyi bla brang bkra shis rab brtan du bris pa'o/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jigs med dbang bo'i sde/ / rigs kun khyab bdag chos kyi rdo rje'i zhabs/ / thar lam gsal mdzad bstan pa'i sgron me ste/ / dpal ldan bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ / rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje'i mthus/ / sgo gsum chos ldan bgyis pa ma lus pa/ / phyi nang nyer 'tsho'i dbang du mi 'gyur bar/ / ji ltar smon bzhin lhun gyis 'grub par shog /289

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la ma brjod par bstod pa sgo mtha' yas sogs bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor byin rlabs gter gyi sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄za/ / na mo mu ni dharmā kā yā ya/ snang dang gnas tshul bden pa'i dri bzhon gyi/ / rjes 'gro tshogs gnyis sprin chen snang stong las/ / lhun grub 'job 'phrin las gru char gyis/ / 'jig rten kun khyab rgyal ba'i yon tan ni/ / srid pa yang 'byung med par bcom pa'i rgyud/ / spros bral zag med bde dang skya bsgril ba/ / gsung las skyes dang rkyen rtogs gsum rig tshogs/ / spobs pa'i khyams las ring du 'das gyur na/ / kun sbyor 'ching ba ma grol zag bcas kyi/ / bsod nams rnam smin skad cig gzi ldan pa/ /rang byung bde 'byung bdag po 'dod pa sogs/ / cha tsam dpog pa'i go skabasag la zhig / rgyal ba sras kyi thu bor bcas rnams kyi/ / mkhyen pas khyab kyang 'khor ba'i mtha'i bar du/ / bajod pas rdzogs min mtha' bral rang gi gshis/ / mtha' ldan bgyi ba bden gnyis tshul las 'das/ / de phyir tshig gi lam du mtshon min par/ / bsam yas mkha' mtha' mnyam par yid ches pas/ / thal sbyar gus pas btud pa'i dge ba 'dis/ / kun la gsang mdzod mngon du 'gyur bar shog / ces ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo la ma 290

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyisgor/brjod par bstod pa sgo mtha' yas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bstan pa'i rjes su slob pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes phul ba'o/ /gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe/ / sa chen 'di la gom pa bdun bor nas/ / nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs/ / de tshe mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ / ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra/ / grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba/ / mgon po mchog brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med maba'i zhal/ / gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis/ / mnyam med mkhyen can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nyi ma'i 'od zer dag gis padma kha 'byed ltar/ / gsung gi 'od zer dag gis 'jig rten sad par mdzad/ / ston pa shākya thub pa sgron me thugs rje can/ / mya ngan 'da' ston gang yin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mgon po khyod kyi thugs rje'i 'od stong gis/ / mi shes rmongs pa'i mun pa bsal du gsol/ / thog med nas bsags las nyon sdig sgrib kun/ / thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chab kyis sbyang du gsol/ / gsung rab rgya mtsho'i dgongs don khong du chud/ / thos don ji bzhin sgrub pas nyams su lon/ / blo bzang rgyal bstan phyogs mthar spel ba yi/ / smon pa gegs med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / mdor na bdag sogs ltos bcas 'brel thogs kun/ / ston pa mchog des 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / bstan la gegs med tshul bzhin bslab pa yis/ / sku gsum go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed chas pa rgya mkhar sprul sku dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nas jo shāka sogs mjal skabs 'don rgyu'i gsol 'debs smon tshig cig dgos tshul skul ma byung ba ltar 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan 291

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang mdzod mtha' dag dang / / khyad par rgya chen spyod pa'i srol bzung ste/ / sbas don mngon rtogs rim pa gsal mdzad pa/ / rgyal tshab byams pa mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lam gyi rim pa kun la nges rnyed cing / / byang chub sems mchog myong ba mthar son te/ / gzhan phan gzugs sku 'grub pa'i thabs kyi mchog / bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang mdzod mtha' dag dang / / khyad par zab mo lta ba'i srol bzung ste/ / dngos bstan stong nyid rim pa gsal mdzad pa/ / mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zab mo rten 'byung don la nges rnyed cing / / yang dag lta ba'i myong ba mthar son te/ / sgrib bral chos sku 'grub pa'i thabs kyi mchog / ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / rje btsun ārya mi tri maci shrī/ /dbyer med thugs rje bden pa'i byin rlabs mthus/ / zab rgyas lam gyi nyams len mthar son te/ / don gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas myur thob shog / ces pa 'di ni dkon mchog ye shes kyis bskul ngor 7dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /'chi med tshe dang ye shes dpal ster zhing / / mi bzad dus kyi rgud pa mthar mdzad pa/ / 'gro ba'i mgon po 'jig rten mtha' dag las/ / rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / yid 'ong 'ja' tshon bkra ba'i gur khang dbus/ / pad zla'i gdan la sgeg pa'i nyams ldan pa/ / dkar ser sngo ba'i zhal dkyil rab rgyas shing / / sna tshogs nyams kyis rol ba de la 'dud/ / ral ba'i thor cog rin chen rgyan gyis srud/ / spyan mdzes shangs kyi rgyud ni yid du 'ong / / mchu sgros 'dzum ldan nor bu'i rna lung g.yo/ /292

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/yid 'phrog blta bas mi ngoms khyod la 'dud/ / rdo rje snang mtha' mnga' dang mchog sbyin g.yas/ / g.yon bzhi'i zhags pa mi 'jigs phyag rgya dang / /gzhudang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang gis/ / mi zad tshe yi dga' ston spel la 'dud/ / brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i dpal mnga' mdzes pa'i sku/ / dri med shel gyi 'khri shing gzhon nu'i dngos/ / rnam bkra'i gos dang do shal rtse dga' 'dzin/ gdul bya'i khams bzhin ston par mdzad la 'dud/ / rmongs pa kun bcad bden gnyis mngon sum gzigs/ / kun la snyoms pa'i thugs rje rgyun chad med/ / 'jigs pa kun skyob phan dang bde ster ba/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog khyod la 'dud/ / rgyal sras phyag na padma rdo rje 'dzin/ / mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug sngon stobs po che/ / gtsang ma'i gnas kyi gzhon nu gnyis la sogs/ / dag pa'i 'khor gyis bskor la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ring nas bdag cag don du thugs bskyed cing / / 'phrin las dusalas yol ba mi mnga' na/ / ji skad gsungs pa'i gzungs kyi phan yon rnams/ / deng 'dir bdag la mngon du 'gyur bar mdzod/ / phyi nang 'gal rkyen nyes ltung kun zhi zhing / / tshe dpal lung rtogs yon tan rgyas pa dang / / byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs la dbang 'byor te/ / bdud dpung 'joms la mthu dang ldan par shog / mdor na bshes gnyen dam pa mnyes byas nas/ / thub pa'i dgongs pa rnyed pa'i mang thos kyis/ / bsgrub pa'i bya ba legs par mthar phyin nas/ / rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas byed shog / ces gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma la bstod pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dkon mchog dam chos kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes byin rlabs kyi khyad nas rje bla ma'i gsung gi tshig sna bsdus te bsdebs pa'o/ /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ye shes lnga ldan zur phud 293

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/'bar ba'i klong / / bden gnyis rwa gdengs snang stong srin po'i gar/ /rnam gsum gshin rje'i gshed du bsgyur ba'i lha/ / khro rgyal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ / gang thugs bde stong sgyu ma'i rol ba las/ / mi 'gyur lhan cig skyes dga'i mchog sbyin phyir/ / bskal pa'i mthar yang spyor ba'i yum gcig ma/ / rdo rje ro langs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gdul bya'i khams bzhin zhi khro'i rol gar brgya/ / bsgyur mdzad 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i bkod pa bzhin/ / mdzes sdug rgya mtsho'i zla ris dbyangs ldan ma/ /drag mo'i skur bstan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ston mtshan mkha' la g.yo ba'i sprin sngon gyi/ / khongs las rgyu skar tshom bu rgod pa bzhin/ / gshin rje'i gshed dang mnyam sbyor gcer mo'i lus/ / rus pa'i rgyan phreng bkra ba khyod la 'dud/ / me long gcig la rab 'byams gzugs snang bzhin/ / dag pa'i rten dang brten pa lha'i 'khor lo/ / mtha' yas kun tu spro zhing 'dzin mdzad pa/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bka' yi 'khor los gnas gsum ḍā ki'i tshogs/ / kun la mnga' bsgyur ye shes mtha' 'gro ma/ / khyod zhabs gus bsten dam tshig ldan pa'i bur/ / ma dang sring ltar brtse bas nyer dgongs shig / deng nas ji srid 'jam dpal gnas thob pa/ / de srid khyod kyis 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / dngos grub bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis rab bskyangs nas/ / zag med dga' ba'i lang tsho rgyas gyur cig / ces bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje ro langs ma la bstod pa 'di ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rams pa 'jigs med rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba ltar 7dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bkra shis 'khyil du bris pa'o/ /na mo badzra dhā rā ya/ gsang chen sgyu 'phrul gar gyi ri mo 'bum/ / cir yang 'char ba'i ngo mtshar thabs mkhas kyis/ / thar 'dod thar bar 'khrid 294

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/pa'i sa mkhan mchog / bzhad pa'i rdo rje srid pa gsum na rgyal/ / kun gsal mtha' las 'gongs pa'i yon tan gyi/ / rin chen snye ma g.yur du za ba las/ / rang blor dpag pa'i rnam thar musnyi ga'i/ / phreng ba rnam dpyod sor mos bstar bar bya/ / mi la'i rigs 'khrungs ming thos dga' ba khyod/ / zhi ba'i mgron slad srid pa'i rgud pa brgyas/ / skyabs med dam dang lhan cig mnar byas kyang / / da dung gdangs snyan glu ru len de mtshar/ / de tshe zhe sdang bdag mo'i 'thor rlung gis/ / khyod mthu gsar ba'i me chen sbar ba yis/ / gnyen ming dgra sde thal bar brlag pa na/ / yid srub rang gnas bsreg pa'i ltas kyis 'jigs/ / sgyu ma'i sdig chen sbyong ba'i mig 'phrul du/ / ded dpon mang bkur mtho ris rten la yang / / dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bzod pa'i dka' thub kyis/ / mkhar lan la sogs ltas mo ci yang bstan/ / de nas mar ba lo tsā he badzra/ / gnyis med ye shes rang bzhin dkyil 'khor du/ / sku bzhi'i sa bon 'grub pa'i dbang bskur gyis/ / smin tshe grol byed lam la rings par chas/ / kun rtog tsher ma gzing ba'i sems kyi zwa/ / bcud du bsgyur ba'i thabs mkhas rnal 'byor che/ / khyod thugs stong pa'i dbyings su zhugs pa na/ / sku yang nam mkha'i mdangs bzang ston pa bzhin/ / 'chi med lam las brgal nas zhi ba'i grong / / bsnyegs 'dra g.ya' ri gangs kyi ri sul nas/ / ras gos rkyang bas grang reg gzhom pa de/ / gtum mo'i tsha zer khong nas bzhad min nam/ / de tshe bzhi ral brgyad gyes khang ba dang / / lhu tshigs kun nas rgod pa a ma'i gdung / / gtol med phyogs mthar 'khyams pa sring mos kyang / 'khor ba'i ngang tshul bstan nas chos la bskul/ / brtson pa brtson pa'i skul ma rjes 'gro can/ / drag 'phyurakham nag dbyar gyi chu klung bzhin/ / las nyon sgrib pa'i lngan ljin ma 295

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i me'i gsung 'bum/lus pa/ / lhag med byang tshe rtogs pa klong nas rdol/ / rim gnyis gom stabs bsgyur la snyigs ma'i tshe/ / thung yang mi'u thung gi gom gcig gis/ /bskal mang bgrod dka'i sgra chen sangs rgyas sa/ / mnan tshe rgyal rnams stobs ldan rdzu la brten/ / 'od gsal sgyu ma'i ras dkar 'dab ma zung / /bskyod pa'i gnyis skyes ka la ping ka khyod/ / mgrin pa'i 'khor lo grol las gsang chen glu/ / lhang lhang bsgrags tshe ḍā ki'i snying rtsa 'dar/ / lung bstan bu slob rgyal phran stong gi dbus/ / zung 'jug 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal thabs mkhan/ / 'khor ba'i dgra sde kun las rgyal khyod la/ / mi min 'ga' yis ma tshugs mtshar skad mtshar/ / rdzu zhing 'phrul ba'i rnam rol phra mo yis/ / khyod la bsngags pa'ang byis pa'i blo gros te/ / sngon nas ngo mtshar ma la ya rlung gis/ / 'phags yul brtan g.yo'i 'dab ma bsnyel min nam/ /e ma grags pa'i gzhir gyur khyod kyi mthu/ / lce rtse'i mtsho la dbyangs can ngang mo 'bum/ / gcig car 'khyud kyang bskal brgyar rdzogs min na/ / rmongs pas rmongs pa bdag 'dras ji ltar bajod/ / 'on kyang cha tsam spel ba'i dge ba 'dis/ / chos brgyad 'gong bo rdog pas badzi byas te/ / rim gnyis lam bzang gom pa'i gar stabs kyis/ / mi bskyod rgyal ba'i gnas su bgrod par shog / ces bsil ljongs grub rigs yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje la bstod pa grub dbang dgyes pa'i 'dzum zer zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khyab bdag chen po de nyid kyi rnam thar la yid mos kyang rkyen dbang du shor ba'i snyoms las pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes rang lo nyer bdun pa la dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du mtshams la sdod skabs shig mtshan mo gnyid kyi bar skabs su gang dran yid kyi me long la bris pa'o/ /mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pa la bstod pa'i rab byed don gsal 296

/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/zhes bya ba bzhugs/ rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam mgon mkhyen pa'i gter/ / rab khros phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje'i gshed/ / ngur smrig 'chang ba'i gar rol tsong kha pa/ / dbyer med thugs rjes byang chub bar du skyongs/ / yab rje chos kyi lhun po'i mdun sa ru/ / rnam dpyod zla bral gser gyi ri bo bzhin/ / lung rtogs yon tan nyi zla'i cod paṇa mdzes/ / ngag dbang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / rtse gcig mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis/ / 'jam dbyangs bla ma ring du mnyes byas tshe/ / byang chub bar du skyong ba'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ / ngag dbang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / de yi gsung gsang zab rgyas a mṛ tas/ / 'di phyi'i snang shas mi bzad srid pa'i nad/ / drungs phyung 'chi med thar ba'i srog thob pa/ / ngag dbang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro la rjes chags dri bzhon gyis/ / drangs pa'i byang chub thugs kyi sprin chen las/ / rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i gru char 'bebs/ / ngag dbang grags pa'i ྾ / / spros bral dbyings kyi mkha' la rnam rol yang / / kun byang blang dor rten 'byung 'dzin ma'i khyon/ / gsal bas rtag chad mun pa'i go skabs 'phrog / ngag dbang grags pa'i ྾ / / de nas gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i sgor/ / 'jigs mdzad khro bo chen po rang nyid kyis/ / dngos su bcug ste dbang bzhi'i dga' ston stsal/ / ngag dbang grags pa'i ྾ / /rim gnyis lam gyi sku gsum gser 'gyur rtsis/ / gzhi yi sku gsum lcags kyi khams sbyangs te/ / sngags dang ye shes lha yi rnam rol ba/ / ngag dbang grags pa'i nga / / mi 'gyur bde ba mchog gi ting 'dzin las/ / rab 'byams dkyil 'khor 'khor lo spro bsdu'i gar/ / 'bum du rtsen pa'i snod bcud spyong mdzad pa/ / ngag dbang grags pa'i nga / / khyad par mthu 297

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung ཿma/stobs zho 'thung rus pa'i mtshon/ / rig sngags rtse brgya 'bar ba'i gdengs ka yis/ / rgol ngan sa 'dzin yongs kyi bgrod pa bcom/ / ngag dbang grags pa'i ྾ / / dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam grub pa'i mthus/ / tshang la ma nor mdo sngags lam gyi srol/ / phyogs mthar gsal mdzad thub bstan yongs kyi bdag / ngag dbang grags pa'i ྾ / / mtha' 'khob mgon med 'dul dka'i 'gro ba la/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba las lhag bka' drin can/ / khams gsum skye dgu'i 'dren pa bla na med/ / ngag dbang grags pa'i nga / / sngon dang phyi ma'i skyes rabs kun tu yang / / mkha' khyab bstan dang 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad cing / / chos skyong bran 'khol snang srid zil gyis gnon/ / ngag dbang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / de ltar khyod kyi yon tan chu gter las/ / cha shas tsam zhig brjod pa'i bsod nams mthus/ / tshe rabs kun tu 'jam mgon yab sras kyis/ / 'bral med dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin par shog / 'dren pa mchog gi rnam par thar ba bzhin/ / lam gyi gtso bo gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ / rnam dag dbang thob dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung / / bskyed rim mthar phyin las bzhi lhun 'grub shog / lhan skyes bde chen bdag nyid rnal 'byor bzhis/ / kun rtog bzhon par bcas pa'i dpung bcom ste/ / dpal ldan dus dgra'i dbang po'i skur bzhengs nas/ / ma lus 'gro ba sred las sgrol gyur cig / ljongs 'dir thub bstan snying po'i bshad sgrub rgyas/ / rgyal blon sder bcas chab srid yun du 'phel/ / 'gro la rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i chos srid kyi/ / bkra shisadage mtshan kun tu rgyas gyur cig / ces mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i mchog 'phags pa ka ta ya na dang chos mtshungs pa rje bla ma'i nang thugs kyi sras po mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pa la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni/ sngar don gnyer can du mas 298

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/rnam thar gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes bskul yang / sa bon med stabs rim 'gyangs su song ba las/ nye char mkhan chen gyi sku gdung mjal skabs rang rgyud dad pasanye bar bskul zhing / rnam thar yang zhib tu brtag tshe rje bla ma'i dgyes pa'i zhal bzhes dang / thun mong ba lam gtso rnam gsum thun mong ma yin pa 'jigs byed kyi rim gnyis gdams pa'i yig chung du ma bcas bstsal pa rnams gung bsgrig na/ deng dus bla mas bshad lo dang / slob mas thos lo'i rnam grangs gang khom du byas pa lta bu ma yin par/ rgya gar grub chen rnams la lha dang bla mas nyams rtogs kyi rim pa dang bstun nas gdamasangag 'bog pa'i rim pa ji lta ba bzhin yin 'dug pas de nyid gzhir byas te/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes mchod sdong rin po che'i mdun nas 'phral du sug bris bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /bgrang yas rgyal ba'i 'khor lo bsdus pa'i gar/ / blo bzang 'jam dpal snying po'i zhal skyin du/ / legs bsgyur lha dang mir bcas 'gro ba'i mgon/ / rje btsun bla ma lus can gtsug na rgyal/ / ye shes rta gdong me ri stong ba'i mtshor/ / zhugs las bde ba chen por khol ba'i rlabs/ / cir yang 'char ba'i lhu 'phreng gzugs kyi sku'i/ / bkod pa mi zad gsang ba gsum gyi mdzod/ / smra bar bskul tshe dbyangs kyi rgyal mo yang / / zol skyes phang 'gro'i rgyud la spyan gtod na/ / byis pa'i hub kyis gaṅgā gzhal min yang / /ci tsam btung bas rang gi gdung ba sel/ / gser thub rgyal ba'i nyi ma 'dzum rlabs kyis/ / theg mchog rigs kyi sa bon smin pa las/ /dmigs med snying rje'i sdong bu mngon dga'i rtser/ / rin chen byang chub sems kyi 'dab rgya grol/ / legs par bsdams pa'i shes rab gru bo che/ /brtan zhing rkyen bzod mkho dgu sbyin pa'i gter/ / bsdu bzhi'i ba dan brtson pa'i dri bzhon gyis/ / bskyod tshe 'khor ba rgya mtsho'i mtha' yang 299

sa / /gung ba bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/thung / /khyad par tshe gcig 'tshang rgya myur ba'i lam/ / mtha' bral lta ba'i bcud ldan rdo rje'i theg / klu sgrub lugs bzang gsal ba'i legs bshad kyi/ / 'od dkar 'bum 'gyed zla ba grub pa'i gtso/ / slar yang dus mthar 'jam mgon bstan pa'i gdugs/ / mdo sngags zab gnad rtsibs stong rdzogs pa 'di/ / bsgrengs phyir ngur smrig gar gyis rnam rol pa'i/ / khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' de la 'dud/ / mgon khyod gzigs pa lnga yi nyi gzhon zer/ / skye dgu'i legs byas mkha' la 'phos pa yis/ / rgud pa'i mun pa dum bur bcad pa'i khrag / ngo mtshar ltas bzang 'char kha'i sprin du 'khrigs/ / sngon goms 'phags chen spyod pa'i bag chags kyis/ / byis pa'i rol gar chos su rtsen pas kyang / / sde dang bcas pa'i bdud rnams gdungabyed cing / / skal ldan 'gro la thar ba'i lam bzang mtshon/ / de tshe srid 'byor sprul gdug lce rtse ltar/ / 'jigs bcas g.yo ba'i ngang tshul gzigs pa yis/ / nges 'byung me chen 'bar la 'di snang gi / bsru brid mtha' dag bud shing gzhan bzhin gyur/ / de nas dbus 'gyur zhes grags bsil ljongs kyi/ / byang chub snying por gshegs tshe bla ma lha'i/ / lung bstan dbugs dbyung dbyar rnga dang 'grogs pa'i/ / gnas bdag srung ma'i bsu skyel na bun gtibs/ / bshes gnyen mang bkur gzhon nu nor bzang bzhin/ / brnag dka'i dka' spyad bzod la rtag tu ngu/ / gzhung lugs 'bum sde'i mdzod 'dzin dbyig gi gnyen/ / gnyis pa gzhan zhig gangs ri'i khrod 'dir byung / / bskal bar goms pa'i rnam dpyod gser mig tu/ / 'khyil ba'i mkha' lding na tshod phra na yang / / khengs ldan mkhas rlom 'dab chags rgan po'i khyu/ / cig car non pa'i rigs kyi mthu de rmad/ /gzhi lnga'i rang bzhin phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i khyon/ / ma lus ji bzhin gzigs 300

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/pa'i dpa' bo khyod/ / ma pham thugs bcud bdud rtsi'i stobs rgyas shing / /yon shag gdams pa'i don gyi go bgos te/ / rtog ge'i tshig don grags pa'i gnam ru las/ / nyer drangs mtha' bral dbu ma'i rigs pa'i mtshon/ /dngos 'dzin 'bod sgrog gnad du bsnun pa'i khrag / bde ba chen por btung ba'i dga' bas myos/ / sde snod 'dzin ma'i mthar 'khyud 'dus pa'i mkha'/ / 'dab yangs mkhyen pas skad cig gis gzhal tshe/ / sgra dang bzo gso snyan dngags sdeb sbyor sogs/ / ri bo stong phrag bgom la mtshar du ci/ / dpal ldan mkhas pa ma lus bzhin gyi snod/ / nor bu'i khri la rnam dpyod stangs stabs can/ / khyod kyi blo gros ra ba las 'gong ba'i/ / chos de mkha' yi 'dab stong rtse na mdzes/ / ris su ma chad bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gnad/ / phra zhing phra ba kun kyang ma 'dres par/ / ji bzhin 'byed la 'jam mgon bla ma dang / / mgon khyod tha dad dbye ba gang las shes/ / de ltar thos pa'i mthar son gnad rnams kun/ / gcig tu bsgrub pa snying por mdzad pa khyod/ / mi mngon dben pa'i nags su gzhol na yang / / grags pa'i pho nya phyogs kyi pha mthar spros/ / de tshe legs smon dri bzhon gyes drangs shing / / legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dog pa la chags pa'i/ / skal bzang rkang drug bye ba'i dga' ston du/ / 'khor lo gsum gyi 'dab brgya cig car bzhad/ / khyad par shes phyogs byang du dar ro zhes/ / lung bstan rba rlabs 'khri shing g.yo ba'i rtser/ / bkra shis ri mo g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /thon pa'i dge mtshan sgra yis sa gsum khyab/ / sgrub dang sun 'byin mi bzad mchu sder can/ / rtsod ngag rtsal rdzogs gdong lnga'i dbang po khyod/ / lung rigs ral khur cung zad gseg pas kyang / / rgol ngan glang mo log lta'i mngal khur 'phen/ / 'phags bod gzhung brgya'i chu gtor las thon 301

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'i name'i gsung 'bum/zhing / / snyan brgyud man ngag ri dwags mtshan ma can/ / blo gsal blo yi kun da rgyas byed pa'i/ / gsar bshad zla ris thub bstan mkha' la mdzes/ / nyung ngu'i gtam gyi spyor ba re rer yang / / mdo dang rgyud sde'i dka' gnad ma lus pa/ / gsal 'char rtsom pa'i dwangs shel 'di mthong tshe/ / gzhan zer 'grig 'grig rdo ba'i me long bzhin/ / snang zhen dri bral ye shes a da ru/ / gang 'dul mos pa'i tshon brgyar 'grogs pa las/ / zhi khro rab 'byams rten dang brten pa yi/ / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rol ba cir yang 'char/ / las kyi rgyal mchog sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ / 'bum du bsgyur bas 'gro kun rjes 'dzin cing / / blo mchog gdul bya dbang bzhis smin mdzad nas/ / nyams khrid zab mos grol byed lam la spyor/ / khyod gsung dri med nor bu'i cod pan gyes/ / zur phud mdzes byas rgyal phran bye ba brgyas/ / rgya mtsho'i gos can khyon kun bzung ba yis/ / snyan brgyud zab gsang gnas la shid zan btang / / mdor na dge ldan bstan pa'i gser ldan ma/ / cher snyigs dus kyi chu mtshor byings pa na/ / rus sbal zol gyes 'degs pa'i tha gu'i lto/ / snying stobs gter chen khyod mtshungs gzhan yod min/ / de phyir khyod kyi yon tan chu gter las/ / dang sems ku sha'i rtse mo la chags pa'i/ / bstod bsngags mu tig zegs ma 'thor ba yi/ / rnam dkar lhan skyes bsil ba'i rang bzhin nges/ / deng nas bzung ste skye zhing skye ba ru/ / mi khom brgyad kyi gdung ba rab zhi zhing / / mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan rten thob nas/ / khyod zhabs padmo 'bral med rten gyur cig /de tshe khyod mnyes 'ba' zhig sgrub byed cing / / gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms med btung ba yis/ / bshes la mi gus dal 'byor chud gzon sogs/ / log pa'i blo sna mtha' dag 'gag par shog / bshes gnyen sangs rgyas dngos su 302

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyiskor/mthong ba sogs/ / thun mong lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs te/ / smin byed gsang chen lam gyi sgor zhugs nas/ / dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung bar shog / tha mal skye shi bar do'i lcags kyi khams/ / sku gsum gser du bsgyur ba'i thabs mkhas rtsi/ / rim gnyis lam bzang skas kyi gdang bu la/ / brten nas zung 'jug rgyal ba'i sar bgrod shog / ces khams gsum chos kyi rgyal bo kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa nyin byed snang ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag la rnam dpyod kyi 'jug pa padma'i 'dab ma ltar yangs pa'i dge bshes blo bzang 'jigs med kyis bskul bal brten nas/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du bris pa'o/ /'jam dpal dbyangs bstan padma dkar po'i tshal/ / bzhad pa'i rnam dpyod nyin byed rtse dga' yis/ / skal bzang rkang drug bye ba'i gnyen gyur pa/ / mi bskyod dgyes bzhad rdo rje gtsug na rgyal/ / bskal pa brgyar goms thugs bskyed grub pa'i mthus/ / 'phags bod mkhas grub skye phreng rol ba'i gar/ / 'bum du bsgyur bas rgyal bstan rin chen gdung / / 'dod dgur spel ba'i rang bzhin brjod las 'das/ / khyad par cher snyigs gdul dka'i 'gro ba rnams/ / thabs mkhas thugs rje'i spyod pa brgya phrag gis/ /thar ba'i lam du bkri ba'i mig gcig pu/ / 'jigs med dbang bo'i zhabs la snying nas 'dud/ / gang thugs bden gnyis zung 'jug lte ba ru/ /gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul rtsibs stong rdzogs pa yi/ / ngo mtshar tshur mthong blo yi yul min kyang / / cha tsam dran pas dad pa'i spu long g.yo/ / mgon khyod srid zhi'i yon tan rin chen tshogs/ / gang las 'byung ba'i rtsa ba bshes gnyen du/ / gzigs nas sngon rabs dam pa'i lam bsten pas/ /303

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/mtshungs med dge mtshan skya rengs dang po shar/ / de dag thugs bcud yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ / lung rigs rlabs kyi phreng bas mngon dga' zhing / / man ngag mu tig spu ba'i 'dzum dkar can/ / mtha' dag khyod thugs chu bo'i gter du 'khyil/ / de phyir mdo 'dul ma mo rdo rje theg / sgra tshad bzo gso yan lag kun dang bcas/ / ris med bstan pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son nas/ / nges don chos kyi rgyal sa rang gir mdzad/ / gdul bya'i mos par gzigs pa'i legs bshad gtam/ / thar 'dod snying gi gdung sel bdud rtsi ste/ / rgol ngan lta ba'i tshang tshing ma lus pa/ / sreg byed bskal pa'i me yang gzhan yod min/ / rtsom pa'i zla ris nyams 'gyur 'bum rdzogs shing / / zab rgyas don bzang ri dwags mtshan ma can/ / kun gyi yid dang 'tsham par 'char ba yi/ / ngo mtshar grags snyan srid pa'i khongs las brgal/ / gzhan phan kho nar rjes chags khyod kyi thugs/ / kun sbyor bag chags bcas pa las 'das phyir/ / bsrung med gsum gyi rang bzhin 'di mthong tshe/ / btsun par snang ba phal cher 'ja' tshon bzhin/ / lha mthong lung bstan mnos pa'i sgra bo che/ / mi spyom thub pa'i rang lugs la gnas kyang / / don gnyis dga' ston 'dod dgur dpyid 'jo ba'i/ / 'bras bu'i mtshan ma 'di las cis mi dpog / e ma gang gi mdzad pa'i phyogs rer 0 yang / / rgyal kun gsang gsum sgeg mos gar bsgyur na/ / blo dman byis pa'i blo dang 'tsham pa ru/ / bstod 'dis bdag la nongs par mi 'gyur grang / / mdor na gzigs pa sgrib med mkhyen pa dang / / mkha' mnyam 'gro la rjes chags brtse ba che/ / mi mthun tshogs las rgyal ba'i mthu nus gsum/ / mthar phyin khyod ni skyabs kyi dam sas/ / brtse ba'i 'dab stong bzhad pa'i pad dkar 'chang / / bdud dpung thal bar brlag mdzad rdo rje 304

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/can/ / dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bor gsol ba 'debs/ / don dam dkon mchog rang bzhin rdzogs pa'i thugs/ / 'jigs med chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa'i gsung / / sa 'dzin dbang po lta bur bajid pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / bla med ye shes dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing / / brtson 'grus lhod med thugs bskyed ri mo can/ /grags pa mi mnyam bsil zer spro ba'i zla/ / mi bskyod dgyes bzhad rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ / gang gi zhabs rdul nor bus gtsug mdzes shing / /gzhung brgya 'byed pa'i blo gros lus stobs rgyas/ / tshul khrims chu gter la gnas gdengs can gtso/ / dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mer gsol ba 'debs/ / deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs phreng ba ru/ / bshes gnyen dam pas 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / zab cing rgya che gsung gi a mṛ tas/ /las nyon sgrib pa'i dug dpal gzhom par shog / 'khor lo bzhi ldan dal 'byor shing rta che/ / nges 'byung byang sems lta dang rim gnyis sogs/ /yon tan rin chen bye bas legs gtams te/ / byang chen thar ba'i grong du 'jug gyur cig / ces rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang gzugs 7rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i 'bas la bstod pa rnam thar dang 'brel ba 'di ni rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa dka' bcu dkon mchog bsam 'grub kyis sbyor tshul 'di lta bu la zhar byung ngos kyang tshang ba zhig dgos tshul gyi bskul ma byung bar brten gang gi slob ma'i tha shal 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /305

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/khub bdag lcang skya rol ba'i rdorje' gsang ba'i rnam par thar ba yon tan rin chen gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpal ldan tshogs gnyis byed po'i mthar son pas/ / sku dang ye shes dbyer med rdzogs byang chub/ / rtag pa'i 'azin las 'gro ba'i dpal gyur ba/ / bla ma dang po'i mgon po rgyal gyur cig / dngos kun stong par zhu ba'i bde ba che/ / nges pa lnga ldan gzugs sku'i rol pa las/ / slar yang bye ba phrag brgya'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ / brtan g.yo kun khyab 'jug pa bla na med/ / ye shes mkha' lding dbang por grub pa'i byin/ / bstan pa'i mkha' mthar rol pa'i shugs 'chang zhing / / brtse chen mig dmar sgron me'i gzi 'bar ba /srid pa rlung gi zas can zas su byed/ / bstan pa rdzogs ldan sprin gyi gdengs ka la/ / rnam 'byed bde 'thung dra bas 'khyud pa'i gar/ / snyan par grags pa'i rnga gsang phyogs bral du/ / rgod pa'i nga ro 'og min gnas su ldir/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa nyin mor byed pa yis/ / ma bzung cher snyigs thun gsum mtshan mo'i smag / thugs rje'i snang ba ral gri'i rno rgyun gyis/ /gcod la mnyam med zla ba rgyal ba'i sras/ / thugs bskyed dpyid kyi dpal mos rnam pa brgyar/ / bskyed bsring dbyar gyi lang tsho mngon dga'i dpal/ / bstan dang 'gro la sman dgu'i mdzad bzang gi / rtsi sman rigs kyi dbye ba bsam las 'das/ / gang gi gsang gsum 'khor lo nam mkha'i tshang / / 'jig rten 'dzin ma'i mtha' dang dmigs med du/ / mnyam phyir smra ba'i rgyal po mtha' dag kyang / / dum bur bsngags pa'i me tog sil ma 306

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/'thor/ / na tshod sprin gyi rgya las sngon gnas kun/ / thun tshod gzhan ba'in rjes dran dbyangs sgogs pa/ / de tshe mngon mkhyen mdongs mthas rol ba kun/ / rjes mthun lung gi gre 'gyur kun nas 'tsher/ / dgon gnas rten dang brten pa'i khyad par sogs/ / mthong ba'i chos las ma g.yos du mas kyang / / brjed ngas lam du stor rnams legs gsungs tshe/ / ngo mtshar dad pa'i padma 'bum du bzhad/ / 'jigs rung g.yul gyi klung chen brubs pa na/ / khyod kyi thugs rje'i brag rir 'chel ba yi/ / bgrang yas skye bor srog gi mchog sbyin gyis/ / gzhan phan thugs bskyed 'bras bzang ngang gis smin/ / ye shes zur phud lnga ba mi yi lhas/ / lang tsho kha 'bus me tog gzhon nu'i rgyan/ / thod bcings dga' ba brgya ba'i dpal thob tshe/ / dregs ldan nye dbang bye bas gcig car btud/ / gzhon nu'i lus can rgyal kun mes po'i blo/ / gang zhig rigs pa'i ral gri gdengs pa na/ / ring du sbyangs pa'i yus kyis rtog ge'i tshogs/ / snying dang lhan cig lce rtse skog mar bros/ / zab cing rgya che shing rta chen po'i gzhung / / rang rgyud shar gsum sde bdun mdo dang bcas/ / thogs med gzigs pa'i mkhyen rab rtse brgya yis/ / smra ngan sbyin skyes rgol ba'i spobs pa bcom/ / mi lam zol brten yab gcig ngag gi lha/ / ye shes mgon dang sing ha mu kha sogs/ / gegs med 'phrin las snang bas sa gsum du/ / dge legs sbyin pa'i skal bzang nye bar mtshon/ / khyad par 'dod pa'i grangs kyi bgrang bya'i tshe/ / 'jam dpal snying pos rten 'byung seng ge'i rgyud/ / rnam par 'khrol bas dngos 'dzin gzings bcom ste/ / mtha' bral lta ba'i gnas lugs rjen par gzigs/ / dbu tshad seng ge 'jing bsnol rigs gzhung gis/ / ring nas dngos por zhen pa bag chags bcas/ / spyod byed rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam gcig pur/ / mthong ba 307

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/tha ma'i dus 'dir khyod gcig pu/ / 'khor lo'i mgon po chos kyi rgya mtsho las/ / dus dgra'i smin byed nor bu'i mdzod blangs tshe/ / lta ba'i rta gdong me dang bde ba che/ / phrad pas dga' ba mtshon byed bdud rtsir 'phyur/ /dngos grub rtsa bar byang chub rdo rje yis/ / bsngags pa gang las nam yang mi g.yo bar/ nges don lha brgya'i snang ba 'gog med la/ / phyi rol gzigs snang ngo mtshar snying po min/ / dge ldan bstan pa'i srung ma nyi ma'i bus/ /bgegs dpung gzhom sogs 'byung 'gyur gzigs pa kun/ / ma 'khrul rmi lam snang bar btags pa yis/ / ting 'dzin sgyu ma'i rol bar 'jug cing ldang / /blo bzang bstan pa nyi ma'i 'od rlabs kyis/ / shes rab dar drag 'dab ma rgyas pa'i rtser/ / blo bzang chos tshul sprang rtsi'i bcud 'dzin yang / / da dung bshes gnyen 'tshol la nor bzang bzhin/ / de tshe 'jam dbyangs bla mas rten 'brel sgo/ / phye ste rgyal ba'i dbang po yongs 'dzin bcas/ / zhal skyin pho nyar mngags nas mgon khyod la/ / mdo sngags chos kyi rgyal srid rdzogs par gtad/ / ka ma rū bar bla ma te ru ka/ / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas mngon sum du/ / tshim pa drug ldan dga' bas ros mdzad kyang / / phyi rol 'ja' tshon snang bas byis pa brid/ / drang nges rgyu 'bras theg pa'i chu klung 'bum/ / skyes sbyangs rnam dpyod hub kyis drangs pa'i bcud/ / dge ldan rang lugs 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi/ / bdud rtsir 'bebs pa sa gsum skye dgu'i gsos/ / lha chos bdun ldan bka' gdams gtsang ma'i srol/ / dus mthar 'gag med srog tu khyod gzigs nas/ / rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas gsang ba ḍū ke'i tshogs/ / 'dzum zhal mngon gyur dgyes pa'i brda thabs bstan/ / lta bas rgyas btab rim gnyis gsang ba'i mdzod/ / ma tshang med par 'dzin cing spel ba yis/ / dbang 308

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyiskor/po'i tog las g.yar dam thod bcings pa/ / snying stobs chen po'i mched zla khyod min su/ / sor rtog rang mdangs ma ru tse yi bdag / tsi na'i yul skyong sprin ring rgyal po yang / / snang ba mtha' yas bka' rtags phyag rgya yis/ /nam yang mi 'bral las bzhi'i bran du bkol/ / so so rig bzhi'i rtsal rdzogs taspu ra/ / hor dang man ju'i skad kyis bka' bstan kun/ / tshig don 'khrul med rgyud du 'khrol ba yis/ / sngon byon lo paṇa kun gyi snyems pa 'phrog / thugs bskyed gur kum bar gyi bkod pa yis/ / khrims ldan ngur sprig 'chang ba 'dus sde'i phreng / / dbang phyogs ka shi'i ras bzang khyon 'gengs pa'i/ / dge legs mi zad bstan la ri mo byas/ / dbyangs ldan khros pa 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ / pha rol byad phur 'bar ba'i byin za sogs/ / nyer 'tshe zlog cing gnod 'tshe ba drungs phyung ste/ / ma dang sring bzhin 'dul 'bral med par bskyangs/ / sde bzhi'i dpal mdangs sa yi tshangs pa che/ / thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyang te ru ka / dkyil 'khor mchog tu rdzogs par smin mdzad de/ / nges don rdo rje'i rigs kyi sras su bskrun/ /don dam gsang ba'i gting mtha' mtshon min la/ / thun mong skye ba'i phreng ba du mar yang / / 'dzin ma 'dzin byed gang dang 'dab ma zung / / thub bstan lus 'degs spyod pa gcig tu gyur/ / sad rmi mnyam par rgyal dang rgyal sras kun/ / gdams shing rjes bstan bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pas/ / rin chen sems kyi chu gter 'phyur ba las/ / phyin drug spyod pa'i rlabs kyi 'khri shing g.yo/ / man jus rigs kyi padma kha 'bus kyang / / tshangs spyod ge sar bcud kyis ma bzung ba/ / khyod kyi thugs rje nyi 'od dang 'grogs pas/ / bslab gsum sbrang rtsi'i snying po ci yang rgyas/ / sa yi 'byer 'jig dpal gyi dgra zla kun/ / chos skyong bran khol drag po'i las sbyor gyi/ / mthu 309

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/stobs gom pa gcig gis rnam gnon khyod/ / chos ldan rgyal thabs srung ba'i khor yug bzhin/ / lnga phrag snyigs ma bdo ba'i chu gter nang / / bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i nor 'dzin bying rtsom pa/ / de tshe thugs bskyed rus sbal gyis bkur yang / / bka' drin bstan 'dzin yongs la khur du lci/ / mi mthun phyogs gyur bdud las mtshan mo'i smag / mdzad bzang thun mtshams 'od kyis nyer bcad de/ / gangs can lha gcig rgyal dbang nyin mor byed/ / snga phyir 'dren pa'i khyung sngon skyes de gang / / 'jam mgon thugs bcud khrid chen brgyad dang drug / 'dus pa lca dril 'khor chen dbang sogs kyis/ / sa yi nyi zla rig 'dzin sde gnyis sogs/ / mkhas dgu nges don yab rje'i srol du btsud/ / khyad par rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i/ /bka' srol ring nas nub pa slar gsos te/ / bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dbus 'gyur sgra bo cher/ / rgyud bzhi da gzod tshang ba khyod kyi drin/ / gzhan yang dbang bka' man ngag bshad pa'i rgyun/ / yongs su 'dzin med ches phrar gyur ba kun/ / bstan pa'i khur chen 'khyer ba'i mgon khyod kyis/ /rmanganas gsos phyir rgyal ba gnyis pa bzhin/ / de slad 'brog ri chen por tsong kha pa/ / mngon sum gzigs shing gzhan tshe bdud rtsi'i chus/ / sgo gsum sgrib bral rdo rje gsum bdag tu/ / byin rlabs nye brgyud sras kyi thu bor gyur/ / 'jam dpal zhing mchog rtse lnga la sogs su/ / rkyen sel nor sgrub cha dang ma 'dres pa'i/ / zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor lhur mdzad de/ / gsang chen nor bu'i them skas mchog tu 'dzegs/ / brtan g.yo'i dngos kun lhan skyes bde ba cher/ / sdom mdzad bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug gis/ /mchod chen mngon sum nyid du bstsal pa yi/ / byin rlabs bde chen bdud rtsi'i chang gis myos/ / gshin rje'i gshed po'i rim gnyis mthar son tshe/ /310

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/ston pa phun tshogs 'khor lo'i mgon khyod las/ / bka' srung mchog gis g.yar dam nyer blangs shing / / bsnyen sgrub gsang ba'i man ngag rtsom par bskul/ / thar lam dngos stobs gtan tshigs kyis bsgrubs te/ / mngon du gyur nas gzhan la 'doms pa'i tshul/ / 'jam dbyangs dngos kyis gdams pa 'di 'dra ba/ / khyod dang thogs med zhabs kyi ma 'dres chos/ /rnam gsum rigs dbye'i gtan tshigs mchog gyur 'dis/ / rtag tu shar ba'ibla ma yi dam lha/ / ma mgon srung ma'i tshogs kyi snang ba kun/ / rang mtshan nyid de nyams kyi do zla min/ / mdor na kun rtog spros pa las rlung bcas/ / yongs dag 'od gsal thugs kyi me long ngos/ / bde chen rang mdangs rgyu 'bras skyabs kyi lha/ / 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i gar gyis 'gran pa bzhin/ / gdul bya'i skal ba 'byung 'gyur 'pho 'jig sogs/ / gnas gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la/ / gzigs pa tshad mar gyur bzhin 'doms mdzad pa/ / khyod ni ston pa bde gshegs skyob pa nyid/ /thugs rje ga bur 'od kyis thub pa'i bstan/ / ris med kun la snang ba'i mchog sbyin zhing / / snying po kurdo'i dga' tshal bzhad pa na/ / yid mtsho dad pa'i rlabs kyi 'jo sgeg 'dzin/ / de phyir gsang gsum rin chen 'byung gnas las/ / ded dpon bshes gnyen dam pa'i bka' drin gyis/ / cha tsam bsod nams skal bar rnyed pa 'di/ / thar 'dod don mthun yongs la mgron du bkye/ / dge bas ma 'ongs tshe rabs padmo'i 'phreng / / 'dren mchog nyin byed 'od kyis mi gtong zhing / / thun mong lam gyi 'dab stong bzhad pa'i dbus/ / rimaganyis bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis bsten par shog /grangs ring bskal par brnag pa'i dgongs pa bzhin/ / thub bstan yang snying phyogs mthar rgyas pa dang / / de 'dzin mtha' dag drang srong chen po'i 311

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname gsung 'bum/lam/ / khyod kyis gdams pa'i rjes su slob gyur cig / mdor na stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' bla ma lha'i/ / go 'phang rnam par rgyal ba'i gnas thob ste/ / srid mtsho nyam ngar bying ba'i 'gro ba kun/ / bde chen thar ba'i lam la 'god gyur cig / ces nges pa don gyi bstan pa'i srog shing rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi gsang ba'i rnam par thar ba yon tan rin chen gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug lcang lung paṇḍi ta mkhan po ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis gsung nan chen posabaskul ba ltar 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes rgyal ba'i lung gis zinapa'i chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo dang ldan pa dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ /rmad byung gsang gsum snang ba dam pa'i mdzod/ / sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'od zer phyogs kyi gos/ / blo bzang legs bshad 'dab brgya'i dpal 'bar ba/ / chos kyi nyi ma srid zhi'i gtsug na rgyal/ / mkhyen rab gting mtha' bral ba'i chu gter che/ / dmigs med snying rje'i rlabs phreng rol ba las/ / sprul ba'i zlos gar g.yas 'khyil dung gi sgras/ / sa gsum khyab pa'i ngo mtshar brjod las 'das/ / khyad par thun gsum klong du 'khyams pa'i 'gror/ / snang ba'i mchog sbyin zla shel dri ma med/ / ngar 'dzin smag chen gcod la dpa' ba yi/ / lhan skyes 'od dkar 'jig rten mtshan mo'i mgon/ / dpal ldan 'phrin las bzang po'i ga bur rgyun/ / klu sgrub lugs bzang rgya mtsho'i bcud du 'bebs/ / nor 'dzin khyon yangs skyod pa'i legs byas kyi/ / ri mo'i gtsug lag kurdo'i rtse dga' 'dzin/ / de nas snying stobs rab brtan man dha ras/ / zab yangs chos kyi rgya mtsho bsrubs pa 312

sa / /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/༷ṭwā /nyi ma/ sdi ༷ dībhe rdo / ratshul phyoṭwāṃ/ṭwāṃ rjodir ༷ ༷ hūṃX skye/ sa/ ༷rdo rdo ṭwāṃ dhri rdostan/ lhan skyes dam pa'i rang bzhin mngar ba'i bsung / / bka' lung 'khrul bral dri yi bzhon par bcas/ / gdung sel bdud rtsi'i cho ga dang por grub/ /bshes gnyen lhun po'i gdengs ka mngon mtho zhing / / mdo rgyud man ngag nor bu'i tshogs kyis gtams/ / 'dzin las rlabs kyi zhags pas nor 'dzin bcings/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i dga' tshal du/ / mang thos gar gyis rol pa'i mi na ka/ / mkhas dbang gzhon nu'i brtan pa 'phrog byed pa'i/ /mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / 'chad pa'i rol mo skal bzang rna ba'i rgyan/ / rtsod ngag rigs lam rdo rje'i me char spro/ /sdeb legs rtsom pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ / smra ba'i dbang phyug mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / shes rab ral gris srid pa'i dgra sde 'joms/ / snying rje'i 'dzum gyis 'gro kun thar bar 'khrid/ / yang dag lta bas 'khor 'das mnyam par gzigs/ / rgyal sras dpa' bo mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / dag pa'i 'khor lo 'dab brgyar grol ba'i dpyid/ /dngos kun bde chen sbrang rtsi'i ro gcig tu/ / myong ba'i lhan skyes dga' bas rab myos pa/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso la gsol ba 'debs/ / rnal 'byor ma dpal thugs rje'i glog phreng can/ / legs bshad sprin sngon ral ba'i gdengs ka las/ / gzhan phan 'phrin las 'dod dgu'i char du bsnyil/ /byeṭwāṃṭwāṃ~X tram̐bye ṭwāṃ hūṃ ༷choXhūṃ kṣu dī dhrikhridī/ de /hūm̐ ༵hūṃ hūṃhūṃ ༷/ ༷/ tram̐ 313

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/gsol ba 'debs/ / gang gi thugs rje'i nyi 'od reg pa yis/ / mthar byed kurdo'i gdengs ka zum byed pa/ / 'chi med tshe la dbang ba'i lha tshogs mthus/ / dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog / bshes gnyen ri yi dbang po rab brtan cing / / 'phrin las nyi zla'i 'od kyis sa gsum khyab/ / bstan 'dzin gser ri'i phreng bas yong4bskor te/ / thub bstan sa chen rtag tu mdzes gyur cig / tshe rabs phreng bar khyod zhabs padmo'i rdul/ / spyi bor reg pa'i skal bzang mi nyams shing / / srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las yongs bzung ste/ / rnam dag lam bzang mngon du 'gyur bar shog / bdag gzhan 'gro la legs pa'i dpyid 'jo ba'i/ / rnam dkar legs byas smon pa'i dngos po kun/ / bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje bden pa'i mthus/ / gegs med lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang 7blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal snga nas kyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di ni/ / bstan pa'i gsal byed sprul ba'i sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas dang /rigs lam smra ba dkon mchog rgya mtsho bcas kyis bskul zhing / rang nyid kyang dad pa'i yid kyis mtshams sbyar ba la brten nas btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du bris pa'o/ /phun tshogs dge legs bye ba'i gzi 'od kyis/ / srid zhi'i dkyil 'khor rgyas par 'gengs mdzad pa/ / bla ma mchog gsum yi dam rgya mtsho yis/ / phan bde'i snang ba dam pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod/ / blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i thugs kyi bcud/ / thub bstan yang snying mdo sngags dam chos kyi/ / rgyal mtshan bsgreng phyir skye ba'i gar mdzad pa/ / 'dren mchog sprul ba'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ / blo gros dri med gser bzang 'khor lo 314

sa / / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/yis/ / thub bstan yongs la mnga' bsgyur chos kyi rje/ / tyāl kun spyi gzugs rje btsun bla ma yi/ / mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan bskal brgyar rtag brtan shog / mchog sprul dam pa'i sku tshe mdzad 'phrin dang / / bstan pa'i bya ba dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shing / / bstan 'dzin bu slob sa steng gang ba yis/ / bstan 'gro'i don chen lhun gyis grub gyur cig / byin rlabs 'od stong 'bar ba'i gdengs ka yis/ / dus kyi mun pa mthar byed tshe yi lha/ /rnam gsum thugs rje'i bden pa chen po'i mthus/ / mchog sprul dam pa'i sku tshe bskal brgyar spel/ / phyag drug mgon po las gshin dpal mgon dang / / ma cig dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas kyis/ / mi phyed rdo rje'i g.yar dam nyer dgongs te/ / 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ / bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje byin rlabs dang / / yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i bden stobs kyis/ / smon pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub pa yi/ / dge mtshan nor 'dzin kun tu khyab gyur cig / ces bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen dam pa mtshungs bral mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin po che blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di ni/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i bdag nyid dgon lung khri ba 'dan ma zhabs drung rin po ches gces las sne mo grwa rgan 'dusaspya nas bskul ba ltar 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dgon lung byams pa gling du bris pa'o/ /bu'i datt+waṃ ༵ dī sna dī dhri/ngapa dīduṭwāṃr bya'i dzo rnaXsnan laskye/ ba/'ithu dī sab /sdi nghrurje mdzad pa/ / chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'di'ang 'khrungs rab4gsol 'debs kyi kha skong du 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes zhus te de skabs gnang ba yin/ dge legs 'dab stong bzhad pa'i padma dkar/ /315

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/'dun ldan thugs bskyed smin pa'i ge sar las/ / phun tshogs 'azin las mngar ba'i bsung 'phro ba/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / ngag dbang dbyangs can mgrin mtshor rtag rol cing / /bstan pa'i gnad rdzogs bdud rtsis thugs ka gtams/ / sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la zla bral ba/ / mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / gang gi thugs rje zla ba'i ma ma las/ / gsar du tshes pa'i yang srid bdud rtsi'i 'od/ / thub bstan ku mud bzhad pa'i dpal yon can/ /mchog sprul dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / blo bzang rgyal bstan dbyar skyes lding khang rtser/ / lung rigs sgra brgya rgod pa'i dun du snyi/ /brdungs pas phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs mdzad pa/ / dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mer gsol ba 'debs/ / dus kyi mthar yang bu ram shing ba'i bstan/ / rnam dpyod dpung pas 'dzin la snying stobs mthu/ / zla bral 'jigs med smra ba'i seng ge khyod/ / bgrang yas bskal pa rgya mtshor zhabs brtan shog / bslu med rin chen gsum gyi bden pa'i mthu/ / yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i nus mthu dang / / dpon slob mi phyed dam tshig rdo rje'i mthus/ / smon pa'i re 'bras g.yur du za bar shog / tshe rabs phreng bar khyod kyis rjes 'dzin zhing / / mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par bsgrubs pa las/ / gsung gi bdud rtsis thar ba'i srog bzung ste/ / 'gro ba kun kyang srid las sgrol bar shog / ces pa 'di ni rang gi gam gcar rnams kyis bskul ngor 7dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes the bo chu tshan khar bris/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro la phan bde'i lhag bsam gyis/ / thub dbang bstan pa'i sgon me sa gsum du/ / gsal bar mdzad pa'i thugs bskyed lhun gyis grub/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / sngon tshe blo bzang 316

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/rgyal ba gnyis pa yi/ / thugs bcud snying po dpal ldan 'dus pa sogs/ /gsang chen gdams pa'i bka' babs chos kyi rje/ / shes rab seng ge'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / slar yang dge ldan bstan pa mtha' dag dang / / khyad par dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde/ / 'dzin skyong spel ba'i 'azin las zla med pa/ / dge 'dun phun tshogs zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / mdo smad nor 'dzin yangs pa'i thig le ru/ blo bzang 'jam dpal snying po'i lung rtogs bstan/ / bshad dang sgrub pas gsal mdzad ngag gi dbang / / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon rabs dam pa'i rnam thar gtsang ma'i srol/ / ji bzhin thub bstan spel ba'i khur bzhes te/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'od snang 'bum 'gyed pa/ /dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mer gsol ba 'debs/ / mi shigs rdo rje'i tshe yi mchog sbyin pa/ / snang ba mtha' yas rnam rgyal sgrol ma sogs/ / yi dam lha dang chos skyong srung ma'i mthus/ / dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar 'bas brtan shog / skye dang skye bar rje btsun bla ma yi/ / zhabs sen 'bral med gtsug gis bsten pa dang / / tshang la ma nor gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ / rdzogs par myong ba'i skal bzang thob par shog / 'di snang zhen log srid las nges 'byung dang / / gzhan phan byang sems phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i spyod/ / rtag chad mtha' bral dbu ma'i lta ba sogs/ / zab rgyas lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / thun mong lam sbyang gsang chen sgor zhugs te/ / dam tshig la gnas rim gnyis rnal 'byor kyis/ / bde chen zung 'jug go 'phang myur thob nas/ / ma lus 'gro ba srid las sgrol gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo la gcig tu gzhol ba'i ri khrod pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris 317

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/pa'o /phul byung zab rgyas gdams pa'i dga' ston gyis/ / skal ba ji bzhin smin cing grol mdzad pa/ / bka' drin mtshungs med skyabs gsum ngo bo nyid/ / dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mer gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes pa 'di ni mtshungs bral bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa kerte sprul ba'i sku rin po che nas dbang so so'i brgyud 'debs kyi mjug tu sbyor rgyu zhig dgos zhes bkas bskul ba ltar 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /yon tan 'byung gnas mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes/ / rnam mang bsam dang spyor bas gus bsten pas/ / tshang la ma nor gdams pa'i mdzod brnyes pa/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / mang thos ral ba gsig pa'i gdong lnga ba/ / 'jigs med rnam par dpyod pa'i gad rgyangs kyis/ / smra ngan spobs pa 'phrog pa'i dpal yon can/ / thub bstan gangs ri skyong la gsol ba 'debs/ / sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i theg mchog chos/ / zab cing rgya che'i bstan pa'i snying po kun/ / legs bshad sgron me'i 'od kyis gsal mdzad pa/ / bka' drin mtshungs med zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / ming tsam lhag mar gyur pa'i bstan pa 'di/ / cha shas tsam yang mkha' mnyam lus can gyi/ / phan bde'i srog tu nges phyir mgon po khyod/ /zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtshor rtag brtan shog / bstan srung rgya mtsho'i mthu dang bden stobs kyis/ / bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs brtan cing / / bstan 'dzin thugs mthun bshad sgrub 'phel ba yis/ / bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni mgron gnyer dka' bcu ngag dbang dpal bzang dang mchod dpon ngag dbang chos ldan gnyis kyis sngar nas bskul ba'i thog 7rje btsun sprul ba'i sku rin po che nas bka' gnang zhing phyag mdzod 318

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/chos rje dang dge rgan sogs kyis kyang bskul ma byung bar brten 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes thu'u bkwan bla brang bkra shis 'od 'bar du bris pa'o/ /bslu med dkon mchog thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings las/ / blo bzang bstan pa'i 'od snang 'bum phrag gis/ / snying gi mun pa sel ba'i sgron me mchog / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / dus 'di nas bzung skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ / khyod zhabs padmo 'bral med gus bsten cing / /legs gsung zab dang rgya che'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ / ngoms pa med par rtag tu myong gyur cig / de yi mthu las rgyu 'bras theg pa'i lam/ / 'khrul bral tshang la ma nor bstan pa'i gnad/ / mtha' dag ji bzhin nyams su blangs pa yis/ / zung 'jug go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang po'i bdag nyid ka ring sprul pa'i sku dkon mchog bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba'i ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes gro tshang dgon du bris pa'o/ /'jig rten gsum na dkon pa'i rin chen mchog / 'khrul bral bstan pa'i snying po mdo sngags kyi/ / legs bshad sgron mes thar lam gsal mdzad pa/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / bla ma lhag pa'i lha yi byin rlabs mthus/ / rnam dag thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin cing / /gegs med bshad sgrub bya ba'i dpung ba yis/ / thub bstan rgyal mtshan ring du 'dzin gyur cig / tshe rabs phreng bar khyod kyis rjes bzung mthus/ /thun mong lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum dang / / gsang chen theg pa'i lam bzang rim bgrod nas/ / mthar thug sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob par shog / ces pa 'di ni rmad du byung ba'i mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug skyes mchog dam pa gro tshang khri rgan sprul sku blo bzang dkon mchog nyi mas bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron 319

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/mes rdo rje 'chang gi lha khang nye 'dabs su bris pa'o/ /bla ma yi dam dkog mchog rin chen gsum/ / spyi dang khyad par khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ / bka' drin mnyam med bstan pa'i sgron me la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bo ru/ / rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis khyod bsten na/ /'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa kun sel zhing / / rnam dkar 'dod don 'grub par byin gyes rlobs/ / ji srid byang chub rdo rje'i gnas thob pa/ / de srid 'dren pa khyod kyis rjes 'dzin zhing / / gdams dang rjes su bstan pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ / yang dag lam gyi lus stobs rgyas gyur cig / mi khom ngan song skye ba'i rgyun bcad de/ / rtag tu 'khor lo bzhi ldan rten thob nas/ /tshang la ma nor mdo sngags lam bzang la/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin slob gyur cig / bslu med bla ma lha yi thugs rje'i mthus/ gnas skabs mthar thug don kun lhun grub cing / / ring min stobs bcu mnga' ba'i dpal thob nas/ / mkha' mnyam lus can srid las sgrol gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa gro tshang chos rje dge legs dbang rgyal gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzo mo mkhar du bris pa'o/ /zab cing rgya che'i legs bshad gdong lnga'i rgyud/ / srid pa'i kun spyor gru gzings mthar byed kyang / / skal bzang rna bar bdud rtsi'i dpyid 'jo ba/ / bla med bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / bde chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid ka lā shas/ / rmad byung 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dbang sbyin pa/ / yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtshos bcas pa'i mthus/ / rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog / ma 'ongs tshe rabs padma dkar po'i 'phreng / /320

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/bshes gnyen nyin byed bdag pos yongs bzung ste/ / gsung gsang 'od brgya'i snang ba dang 'grogs pas/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i sprang rtsi smin gyur cig / rnam dag chos 'dul spyod pa la gnas te/ / nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba sogs/ / tshang la ma nor rgyu 'bras theg pa yis/ / yang dag lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum bden pa'i mthus/ / bstan pa'i sgron me yun du gnas pa dang / / bshad sgrubazung 'jug bstan pa'i bya ba kun/ / dbyar gyi chu gter ji bzhin rgyas gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa ye shes shes rab kyis li ting che legs lha dar bcas nan cher bskul ba'i ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /dkon mchog rgyal ba'i thugs rje me shel khams/ / 'khrul bral mdo sngags bstan pa'i 'od brgya ba/ / 'gro blo'i rmongs mun sel ba'i sgron me mchog / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / mchog gsum mthu dang chos dbyings bden pa'i mthus/ / 'dren mchog dam pa'i sku tshe rab brtan cing / / dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ / 'bral med dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin par shog / sgo gsum dge ba ji snyed bsags pa kun/ / yang dag lam gyi rim pa myur bgrod de/ / bla med byang chub go 'phang mchog thob nas/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro kun 'dren pa'i rgyur gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni ri khrod pa dge slong blo bzang 'jam dbyangs kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /dkon mchog gsum 'dus ngo bo drin can rje/ / lung rtogs bstan pa'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i gnyen/ / 'gro blo'i ma rig mun sel sgon me mchog / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes pa 'di ni dad 321

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithon me'i gsung 'bum/ldan dge slong ngag dbang lhun grub kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes da tshang dgon du bris/ /bslu med dkon mchog thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings ngos/ / blo bzang bstan pa'i sgron me legs bzung ste/ / bgrang yas 'gro la thar ba'i lam ston pa/ / mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes pa 'di ni thugs dam la brtson pa dge slong blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis lam rim rgyud 'debs su de lta bu zhig dgos tshul ltar btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog rin chen gsum/ / dam can chos skyong rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas/ / dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ / nam yang mi 'bral bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig / dkon mchog thugs rje'i bdag nyid zla shel khams/ / mdo sngags bstan pa'i kurdo bzhad pa'iganyen/ / kun rmongs mun pa sel ba'i sgron me mchog / dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mer gsol ba 'debs/ / rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ / thugs bcud zab dang rgya che a bṛ tas/ / srid dang zhi ba'i gdung ba kun sel ba/ / theg mchog dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ / bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i chu gter che/ / mdo rgyud man ngag yid bzhin nor gyis gtams/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rlabs phreng rol pa can/ / bshes gnyen gdengs can dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /bslu med mchog gsum spyi dang bla ma lha'i/ / thugs rje'i bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ / mi 'dod nye bar 'tshe ba kun zhi nas/ / chos ldan smon pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog / rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' las mi 'da' bar/ / rdo rje'i g.yar dam lhur mdzad srung tshogs kyis/ / nam yang mi 322

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyisgor/g.yel mgon dang skyabs mdzad de/ / chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs kun tu yang / / legs tshogs rtsa ba bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ / rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gtsug bsten nas/ / byin rlabs bdud rtsis rtag tu tshim gyur cig / skye zhing skye bar dal ba'i rten thob cing / / yang dag lam bzang gegs med mthar phyin nas/ / phra rags 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal te/ / thar ba'i grong khyer mchog tu 'jug gyur cig / mdor na dge bcu'i khrims kyi rtsa brtan cing / / tshe dpal bsod nams yal ga 'bum ldan pa/ / chab srid dpag bsam sngon pa rgyas pa'i rtser/ / byang chub mchog gi 'bras bzang smin gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni yangs pa'i mnga' 'bangs mtha' dag chos bzhin du skyong ba la ma zhum zhing blang dor 'byed pa'i spobs pa dang / / gzu bor gnas pa'i rang bzhin can/ dad pa dang gtong ba'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa so mo'i rgyal mo bsod nams sgrol mas bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes so mo mkhar nor bu'i gling du bris pa'o/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i chos kun byang chub pa'i/ / snying po zab rgyas man ngag bdud rtsi'i chab/ / thar 'dod yongs la 'beb pa'i a gasta / /mtshungs med bshes gnyen rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / khyad par lta sgom spyod dang gzhi lam 'bras/ / kun la 'khrul bral 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom pas spel mdzad 'gro ba'i mig / thar 'dod ded dpon rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / so thar byang sems sdom pas rgyud sbyangs shing / / gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i sgor btsud de/ / man ngag ror bu'i dga' ston mchog sbyin pa/ / drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / khyad par dkon mchog gsum 'dus ngo bo nyid/ / thub dbang 323

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bstan pa'i sgron me legs bzung nas/ / mngon mtho nges legs lam bzang gsal mdzad pa/ / bka' drin gsum ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /'dis mtshon legs byas sa bon dzasbu'i 'bras/ / bsod nams zhing mchog ma dros mtshor brten pas/ / gnas skabs mthar thug dge mtshan gzi 'bar ba/ / gser bzang snying po mchog tu grub gyur cig / nad rims nyer 'tshe la sogs lus sems kyi/ / gdung ba ma lus drungs nas zhi ba dang / / mthun rkyen tshe dpal mnga' thang longs spyod rnams/ / dge bcu'i khrims dang lhan cig rgyas gyur cig / tshe rabs phreng bar dam pa'i mgon gyes bzung / / rnam dag bstan la tshul bzhin slob pa sogs/ / don gnyis dge ba'i legs smon ma lus pa/ / mchog gsum bden pa'i mthu yis 'grub gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni spyog rtse rgyal po'i sras mo dad mos dang lhag bsam mchog tu dge ba bsod nams mtsho rgyal gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /dkon mchog rgyal ba'i dbang po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / lung rtogs bstan pa'i bdag nyid dam pa'i chos/ / 'gro ba'i sgron me rigs grol dge 'dun te/ / skyabs gsum ngo bo bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ / rlabs chen thugs bskyed mchog gi sprin sngon las/ / phul byung legs bshad chos kyi char 'bebs pas/ / rnam grol thar ba'i myu gu bskrun mdzad pa/ / rje btsun bstan pa'i sgron mer gsol ba 'debs/ / sras bcas rgyal ba'i zhal skyin bla ma dang / / rgyal kun 'phrin las rang gzugs bcom ldan ma/ / dbyer med bla ma lha yi zhabs pad la/ / snying nas 'dud do thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs/ / rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol btab mthus/ / nyer 'tshe'i 'jigs pa kun las rnam rgyal zhing / / sde bzhi'i dpal gyi dge mtshan dar ba 324

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/yis/ / gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis lhun grub shog / deng nas brtsams te byang chub snying po'i bar/ / rtag tu dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes 'dzin cing / / mchog gsum byin rlabs snying la 'grogs pa yis/ / legs tshogs dbyar mtsho ji bzhin rgyas gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni dkon mchog gsum la dad pa'i bag chags kyi mthu brtas pa so mangs rgyal po'i sras mo bsod nams dbang mos bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / yid bzhin nor las dkon pa'i gdams pa mchog / 'khrul bral mdo sngags bstan pa'i snying po kun/ / dri med lung rigs sgron mes gsal mdzad pa/ / drin can bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / deng nas tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod kyis/ / nam yang 'bral med dgyes bzhin rjes 'dzin cing / / zab rgyas gsung gi gsang ba kun 'dzin pa'i/ / sras kyi thu bo mchog tu 'gyur bar shog / ji ltar gdams shing rjes su bstan pa bzhin/ / thun mong lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs te/ / gsang sngags sgor zhugs dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung / / rim gnyis lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar ba la/ / zhes sogs dang / skye bkun tu zhes sogs bya/ zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog 'jam dbyangs kyis bskul ngor 7 btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o /dkon mchog kun 'dus 'jigs med dbang po yi/ / bzhed dgongs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i khang bzang gi / khyon yangs gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me mchog / mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / rab 'byams gsung rab kun la blo gros kyi/ / snang ba rab rgyas 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yis/ / thar 'dod re ba yongs su tshim mdzad pa/ / mtshungs med bshes 325

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/gnyen dam pa zhabs brtan shog / dge 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum legs byas kun/ / gcig gyur mthu las mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rnams/ / deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ / mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam pas rjes 'dzin shog / ces pa 'di'ang dad brtson ldan pa rab 'byams pa shes rab rgya mtshos bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris/ /zla bral 'jigs med rnam dpyod gangs ri'i spor/ / yang dag rigs pa'i gad rgyangs cher sgrogs pa/ / smra ba'i seng ge khams gsum skye rgu'i gnyen/ / dge ldan bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal gyur cig / rlabs chen thugs bskyed ri bo mardo ras/ / tshogs gnyis 'o ma'i chu gter bsrubs pa las/ / 'khrungs pa'i rgyal sras snying rje'i zla ba mchog / lus can kurdo'i gnyen gcig khyod la 'dud/ / stobs bcu'i dpal ldan rgyal dbang grags pa'i bstan/ / rgya mtsho'i gos can yangs pa'i khor yug tu/ / spel mdzad bka' drin mtshungs med thugs rje'i gter/ / gang gi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / rim gnyis rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar son cing / / yi dam chos srung rgya mtshos 'phrin las bsgrub/ / zab rgyas man ngag gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ / gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag khyod la 'dud/ /gnas gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i ye shes kyis/ / blang dor ma lus ji bzhin 'doms pa yi/ / lus can yongs kyi 'dren pa bla na med/ / rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog / rgyal kun sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid/ / tshe mtha' yas dang rnam rgyal sgrol ma sogs/ / lhag pa'i lha tshogs thugs rje bden pa yis/ / 'dren mchog dam pa'i sku tshe bskal brgyar srings/ / mthu ldan rgyal ba'i bstan srung thams cad dang / / khyad par rgyal kun yum gcig dbyangs can ma/ / drag mo'i skur bstan 'dod khams 326

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/dbang phyug mas/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i 'phrin las g.yel med sgrubs/ /bdag sogs kun kyang skye zhing skye ba ru/ / khyod zhabs gus pas mchod pa mi gtong zhing / / zab cing rgya che'i gsung gi gsang ba'i mdzod/ / 'dzin pa'i sras kyi thu bor 'gyur bar shog / mdor na dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs brtan cing / / rnam dkar mdzad 'phrin snang ba phyogs bcur rgyas/ / lus can kun kyang chos 'byor dga' ston la/ / longs su spyod pa'i dge mtshan rgyas gyur cig / ces dge ldan bstan pa'i srog shing mtshungs zla med pa khri chen dpal ldan grags pa'i mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin po che 'jigs med rigs pa'i seng ge'i 'al snga nas kyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di ni rab 'byams pa grags pa dar rgyas kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /'jigs med stobs bcu'i lang tsho rab rgyas shing / / lung rigs gad rgyangs mthon pos sa gsum 'gengs/ / dpal ldan mtshungs bral smra ba'i sengage mchog / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / ring nas goms pa'i thugs bskyed dpung pa yis/ / thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i lding khang rtser/ / bshad sgrub gser gyi rgyal mtshan sgrengs mdzad pa/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / mkhas shing grub brnyes yongs 'dzin du ma las/ / zab dang rgya che'i gdams pa'i mdzod mnos te/ / thar 'dod yongs kyi re ba skong ba'i gnyen/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / tshogs gnyis lang tsho rgyas pa'i gzi byin gyis/ / sgrib pa'i dpung tshogs meg med bcom byas te/ / rnam grol bde ba'i dpal la dbang 'byor ba/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / bslab gsum dag pa'i cha shas yongs gang zhing / / 'chad rtsod rtsom pas 'od dkar dra ba 'gyed/ / blo bzang rgyal bstan ku mud bzhad pa'i gnyen/ / rje btsun bla 327

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / mthar byed dpung 'joms tshe yi lha tshogasadang / / yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i thugs rje mthus/ / rje btsun bla ma mchog gi zhabs brtan cing / / 'azin las 'od snang 'gog med 'phro gyur cig / bdag sogs kun kyang skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ khyod gsung bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis bskyang ba yis/ / yang dag lam bzang bgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ / sku gsum go 'phang bde blag 'grub gyur cig / ces dge ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po khri chen sprul pa'i sku 'jigs med rigs pa'i seng ge'i zhal snga nas kye zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di ni su nyid shog rab 'byams pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /mdo rgyud man ngag gdams pa bdud rtsi'i chus/ / dbang bskur chos kyi srid la mnga' bsgyur pa'i/ / bkra shis dge mtshan nor 'dzin kun tu khyab/ / chos kyi rgyal po bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ / mi zad ngag gi dbang phyug mchog brnyes te/ / dpal ldan bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i mtshor/ / legs bshad mgrin pa'i rdza rnga rtag 'khrol ba/ / bka' drin mtshungs med dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / legs bshad yal ga'i khyon yangs ngag gi dbang / / spong ba bsam gtan me tog rnam par bkra/ / bya ba las kyi dga' tshal shis par bsgrubs/ / 'khor lo gsum gyi dpal mnga' khyod la 'dud/ / ngag rig grub pa'i gnyis skyes kun gyi gtso/ / thub dbang bstan pa'i kurdo bzhad pa'i gnyen/ / bkra shis 'od snang bdud rtsi'i zer 'phro ba/ / smra ba'i zla ba mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho las 'ongs pa'i/ / legs bshad dbang gi rgyal po'i za ma tog /bkra shis gter gyi bum bzang dang mtshungs pa/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / yab gcig ngag gi dbang po'i byin rlabs kyi/ / glog 328

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyisgor/phreng bkra ba'i thugs kyi sprin sngon las/ / legs bshad gru char bsnyil bas 'jig rten kun/ / phul byung shis par bsgrubs la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod gsung legs bshad bdud rtsi'i bcud myang bas/ / sred pa'i nad brgya sel ba'i sman gcig pu/ / mtha' bral lta ba'i gnad kun 'byed pa la/ / rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter dang mtshungs par shog /blo chen rgyal kun thugs rje zla shel khams/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas zhing / / don gnyis kurdo'i dga' tshal rgyas mdzad pa/ / grub dbang smra ba'i zla ba gtsug na mdzes/ / blo gter 'jam mgon dgyes bzhad rdo rje yi/ / mdzad bzang gdugs dkar srid pa'i rtser bsgreng ba'i/ / bzhed don gegs med smon pa'i mthu grub pa/ / bka' drin mtshungs med dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / blo ldan skal bzang gdul bya'i 'dzin ma la/ / don zab gdams pa bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pas/ /gzhan phan thugs bskyed 'bras bzang lhun gyes grub/ / theg mchog dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ / bde stong dbyer med blo gros lus stobs rgyas/ / rim gnyis lam bzang ral ba'i khur gyes brjid/ / rgyud don legs par bshad pa'i gad rgyangs sgogs/ / grub mchog gdong lnga'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ / gdul bya rang rang blo dang 'tsham pa yi lam bzang spel bas 'gro ba'i don spyod cing / / rigs sngags grub pa'i dpung gis bdud sde gzhom/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso la gsol ba 'debs/ / rgyal gsung gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin rdo rje can/ / ngur smrig gar rol rje btsun bla ma yis/ / tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / rim gnyis lam bzang mngon du 'gyur bar shog /dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag po khyod kyi mthus/ / bdud bzhi'i g.yul 329

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i shāng 'bum/las nges par 'byung ba la/ / phyi nang gnod pas nam yang mi badzi ba'i/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i pha rol son par shog / ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / dmigs med snying rje'i pad dkar bzhad pa'i lha/ /bdud bzhi'i dgra las rnam rgyal rdo rje 'dzin/ / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ / gang gsung legs bshad dga' tshal las 'khrungs pa'i/ / bgrang yas dge 'dun rkang 'thung tshogs kyi dbus/ /phun tshogs 'khor lo gsum gyi 'bras smin pa/ / yab rje'i sras mchog zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / de yi thugs bskyed smin pa'i zlos gar las/ / ngag gi dbang phyug bzhad pa'i rdo rje yi/ / bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i phyir/ / legs byon mchog sprul dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje'i rtsa ba rab brtan cing / / gzhan phan 'phrin las yal ga'i khyon yangs pos/ / thar 'dod snying gi gdung ba sel mdzad pa/ / 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / gzhung dang gdams ngag kun la dbang 'byor te/ / bstan pa'i gnad kun nyams su bstar ba yis/ / sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la zla bral ba/ / mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / zab lam man ngag gdul bya'i dbang po dang / / 'tsham par bstan pa'i legs bshad dga' ston gyis/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin sgrub mdzad pa/ / mtshan nyid kun ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ / khyod kyi thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyes/ / yid kyi nyes ltung dri ma kun byang ste/ / brtse chen lhag bsam lus stobs rdzogs pa yis/ / rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son shog / ces mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan dam pa khri ngag dbang bkra shis/ grub pa'i dbang phyug blo bzang don grub/ khri chen sprul ba'i sku ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rnams chos sde 'di gar bka' drin lhag 330
