༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyisgor/par che ba'i gsol 'debs 'don srol tshugs kyang / yang srid myur 'byon la kha bsgyur byas pas 'brel ma chags shing mdzes lam chung bar brten/ gsol 'debs mdor bsdusapa re dgos tshul mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag rgyud pa dpon slob 'jigs med rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /dge legs 'bum phrag padma dkar po'i tshal/ / lhag bsam nyin byed snang ba dang 'grogs pas/ / dal 'byor zil dngar rdzogs pa sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ / thar 'dod bung ba'i nyer 'tsho rgyal gyur cig / 'jig rten che dgu'i rjes su mi 'brang bar/ / khengs dregs spangs te dam pa'i mgon nyid bsten/ / mos gus nyams med dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrungs/ / bshes gnyen thugs kyi sras po khyod la 'dud/ / tha snyad spun pa'i rjes su mi 'brang bar/ / nang don 'phags bod mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs la/ / sbyangs pas dri med rigs pa'i dga' ston phyong / / smra ba'i dbang bo mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / zab gnad thang mar brdal ba'i bshad pa dang / / grub mtha' de nyid 'byed pa'i rtsod pa dang / / tshig don phun tshogs rtsom pa'i dga' ston la/ / dbang bsgyur bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / las 'bras blang dor tshul la nges rnyed pas/ / mngon skog med par dran shes bag yod kyis/ / bslab khrims dag pa nyams len mthil du mdzad/ / gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ / mtha' yas 'gro la phan pa'i lhag bsam gye/ / 'bras bu rgyal bstan kho nar rag las pa'i/ / de nyid bshad dang sgrub pas spel mdzad pa/ / rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshol dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / rdo rje 'chang dngos bshes gnyen dam pa dag /bsten nas rdo rje'i dam tshig legs bsrungs shing / / rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i 331

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/dgongs don thugs su chud/ / dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ / rnyed bkur zang zing 'byor ba'i yo lang rnams/ / rnam smin khur chen 'gel ba'i dgra ra gzigs nas/ / mchog gsum zhing du bsdos te don ldan mdzad/ / dad ldan skye bo'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ / thub bstan rin chen ring du gnas 'dod pa'i/ / thugs bskyed shugs drag dri yi bzhon pa can/ / 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa'i dri bzang 'phro/ / bshes gnyen dpag bsam ljon pa rtag brtan shog / nam yang mi bslu dkon mchog bden pa'i mthus/ / bstan pa'i sgron me bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / / bdag kyang deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ / dgyes bzhin 'bral med rjes su 'dzin par shog / zab rgyas gdams pa bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyes/ / yang dag lam bzang lus stobs rab rgyas nas/ / bla ma lha yi go 'phang myur thob ste/ / ma lus 'gro ba srid las sgrol gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni rang gi gam gcar dad brtson tshul khrims ldan pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor 7dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs tsong kha pa'i/ / mdo sngags gzhung lugs mtha' dag spel slad du/ / rlabs chen smon lam mchog gis bsgrun pa'i sku/ / dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mer gsol ba 'debs/ / de ltar rtse gcig gus pas gsol btab mthus/ / mgon khyod zhabs zung srid mthar brtan pa dang / / bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rjes bzung legs bshad dga' ston myong bar shog / 'dis mtshon dge bas mar gyur 'gro ba rnams/ / theg mchog dge ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral zhing / / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i chos tshul kun bzung nas/ / sa lam bgrod pa myur du mthar phyin shog / ces pa 'di ni dad ldan slob ma blo bzang dka' 332

/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/bcus bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes smras pa'o/ /rnam dag nges 'byung khrims kyi rtsa brtan cing / / gzhan phan rgyal sras spyod pa'i gos bzang g.yo/ / bde stong ye shes nor bus mdzes pa yi/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ / ngag la dbang bsgyur blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ / bshad sgrub dpung bas gyen du 'degs pa la/ / sa chen 'di na snying stobs zla bral ba/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / tshe rabs 'phreng bar khyod kyis rjes 'dzin zhing / /mosagus rtsol med ngang gis skye ba dang / / bkur ste rnyed dang rim gro sgrub pa'i sgos/ / gcig tu mnyes pa 'ba' zhig sgrub par shog / de'i gsung chos kyi bdud rtsir ched brten pas/ / mngon rtogs tshogs kyi lam la rab zhugs te/ / smon 'jug sems bskyed grangs med tshogs brtsams nas/ /chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin la reg par shog / chos nyid don spyis mngon mthong sbyor ba'i lam/ / 'jig rten sgom byung drod rtse bzod mchog gi / rim pas gzung 'dzin rtog pa zil mnan te/ / mos spyod sa yi tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog / bden pa gsar mthong gtsor gyur rab dga'i sar/ / brgya phrag bcu gnyis yon tan gter thob cing / / kun bzang smon grub chos dbyings kun 'gro ru/ / mthong bas sbyin pa'i phar phyin lhag thob shog / de tshe som nyi spangs shing de yi rjes/ / mchog gi don du goms las 'chal ba'i khrims/ / kun tu mi 'byung dri ma med pa'i sar/ / tshul khrims lhag cing bcu 'gyur dpal thob shog / rgyu mthun mthong las chos tshol bzod pa yi/ /snang ba byed pa 'od byed sa nas ni/ / snga ma'i yon tan brgya yis bsgyur thob cing / / lhag pa'i sems sbyangs mngon shes sogs thob shog / 'dzin med mthong bas byang chub phyogs la yang / / sred lta sreg byed brtson 'grus 'bar 333

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/ba yi/ / 'od 'phros sa la lha dbang rnam rol zhing / / lhag pa'i shes rab dang po sbyong bar shog / mnyam nyid bcu yi skye 'phags dus gsum rgyud/ /tha dad bkag phyir bdud sogs rkyen ngan gyis/ / mi 'phrog lus can smin byed sbyangs dka'i sar/ / bden la mkhas pa'i bsam gtan lhag thob shog / shes rab phung po'am bslab pa rab sbyangs las/ / kun nyon rnam byang dam pa'i don du ni/ / min par mngon mthong mngon du gyur pa'i sar/ / shes rab lhag pas lus can grol byed shog / mtshan ma tha dad med pa ring song sar/ / bcu gnyis thabs mkhas lhag thob 'gog pa la/ / skad cig 'jug cing bslab pa'i 'bras la reg / grub la ma grub tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog / dag pa'i sa la bri 'phel med mthong bas/ / srid zhir mnyam zhing mi rtog zhing la dbang / / mtshan ma rtsol bas mi g.yo smon lam grub/ / stong gsum 'bum gyi rdul snyed dpal thob shog / so so rig ldan legs pa'i blo gros te/ / 'bras bu'i cha las ye shes gnas su mthong / /bsam pa'i stobs sogs rab rdzogs snga ma yi/ / yon tan grangs med bsgyur ba thob par shog / chos kyi sprin tshe 'od kyi dbang bskur las/ / ye shes lhag par thob cing rgyal ba yi/ / las la dbang bsgyur brjod med yon tan thob/ / tshogs gnyis legs grub rdzogs smin sbyong byed shog / de nas ches phra dri ma'i lhag ma rnams/ / rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyis rab spyangs te/ / yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang gi / go 'phang thob nas 'gro kun sgrol bar shog / ces skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang ྾ / / zhes sogs kyi tshig don bye ste sa lam gyi rim pa dang sbyar ba'i smon tshig sbyor tshul 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes/thugs dam dge spyor la mchog tu brtson pa'i rab 'byams pa dkon mchog chos bzang gis bskul ngor chos smra ba dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dben gnas yid dga' 334

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/chos 'dzin du bris/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i gsang gsum 'phrin las kyi/ / chos mdzod snying bo zab lam rdo rje theg / 'dzin skyong spel ba'i thugs bskyed mthu grub pa/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso la gsol ba 'debs/ / blo bzang rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par du/ / 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bzhad pa'i rdo rje yi/ /bzhed don ma lus lhun gyis grub mdzad pa/ / yab rje'i sras mchog dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / 'jigs med spobs pa'i rlabs phreng cher g.yo zhing / / phul byung lung rigs nor bu'i tshogs kyis gtams/ / mkhyen brtse'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' mi mngon pa/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i legs bshad sa 'dzin gyis/ / thub dbang bstan pa'i chu gter bsrubs pa las/ / lam bzang gsal byed nyi ma'i 'od 'bar ba/ / mtshungs med 'dren mchog dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / dri med bslab gsum nor bus rgyud gtams shing / / 'chad rtsod rtsom pas skal ldan rjes su 'dzin/ / mkha' khyab bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen mchog / bgrang yas bskal ba rgya mtshor zhabs brtan shog /ma 'ongs tshe rabs phreng ba kun tu yang / / bshes gnyen dam pas 'bral med rjes 'dzin cing / / zab rgyas gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bcud myang ste/ / yang dag lam bzang lus stobs rgyas gyur cig / blo bzang rgyal bstan phyogs mthar rgyasapa dang / / de 'dzin skyes bus sa steng kun khyab cing / / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang dar ba yis/ / legs tshogs lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa 'di ni a ro hor chin shog nas dad brtson ldan pa slob ma 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rgyal kun thugs rje'i dga' tshal las 'khrungs shing / / chos tshul 335

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname gsung 'bum/'dab yangs 'phags tshogs yongs 'du'i gtso/ / bstan 'dzin dam pa'i khrod na nyi zla ltar/ / mtshungs med rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /kun bzang spyod pa'i 'od stong rtse dga' yis/ / lung rtogs chos kye 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i gnyen/ / skal bzang gdul bya'i bsod nams mkhar 'phags pa/ / mchog sprul bstan pa'i nyi mar gsol ba 'debs/ / rnam kun srid na mngon dga' snying rje dang / / chos kun don gzigs 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis/ / bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i dpal ster ba/ / smra ba'i nyi ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / lus can kun la bde dga' mchog sbyin pa/ / sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags tshogs dge 'dun mthus/ / bstan pa'i nyi ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / / rnam dkar mdzad 'phrin gegs med rgyas gyur cig / 'gro kun gnas skabs mthar thug dga' bdes 'tsho/ / chosasrid 'byor ba lhun po'i spo ltar 'phags/ / bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs brgyar gsal ba yis/ / dge legs rgya mtsho'i dpal yon rgyas gyur cig / ces sku 'phreng du mar dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam par gyur ba kirti spul ba'i sku rin po che kun dga' chos 'phags bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang bo'i zhabs brtan smon tshig 'di ni/ bla ma dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan pa sogs kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rgyal ba'i sras po dri med grags pa dang / / dpal ldan zla ba'i zhabs dang dbu ma ba/ / rgyud chen gnyis sogs 'khrungs rabs tshar du dngar/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad par gsol ba 'debs/ / rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu rgyal ba'i bstan/ / 'khor lo gsum rgyas spel ba'i thugs bskyed mthu/ / zla bral rje btsun 'jigs med dbang bo dang / / blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ / mtha' klas 'gro ba'i mgon dang dpung 336

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyisgor/gnyen du/ / zhabs zung rdo rje'i re khā nyer brtan cing / / 'phrin las gser bzang 'od kyi snang ba yis/ / blo bzang bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas gyur cig / bdag kyang deng nas skye zhing skye ba ru/ / bshes gnyen dam pas dgyes bzhin rjes 'dzin zhing / / mdo sngags lam bzang ji ltar gdadams pa bzhin/ / yang dag sgrub pas nyams su len par shog / mtha' bral lta ba snying rje'i snying po can/ / gsang chen zab mo'i lam gyis rgyas btab pa'i/ /myur lam mchog gi bgrod pa la brten nas/ / zung 'jug dang po'i mgon po nyidagyur cig / ces pa 'di ni mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug dam pas mdo'i khri ba lha zhis sprul ba'i sku ngag dbang 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchogabastan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ / lung dang rigs pa'i sgon mes gsal mdzad pa/ / skal bzang thar 'dod yongs kyi mig gcig pa/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs gang du yang / / 'dren pa khyod min skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ / bla mgon dbyer med brtse bas phyag brkyangs te/ / mi khom ngan song g.yang las bsgral du gsol/ / ji srid byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /dal ba'i rten thob khyod zhabs gus pas mchod/ / khyod gsung ji bzhin bslab gsum nyams len gyis/ / thar ba'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par byin gyes rlobs/ / stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug lam bzang gis/ / rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son cing / / khyad par bde chen gsang sngags myur lam gyis/ / zung 'jug go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig / lhun grub 'phrin las gru gzings 'dum sbyar te/ / srid mtsho nyam ngar bying ba'i 'gro ba kun/ / bde chen thar ba'i zhing du 'khrid pa yis/ / ma lus rgyal ba'i mdzad 337

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgran 'i gsung 'bum/pa sgrub gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni a ba ga tā bai li ma tā pā li'i dgon pa kun dpal gling gi dge bskos blo bzang rab brtan gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gye ye shes gcig bsdus pa/ / rdo rje rnon po'i gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul gar/ / 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i mdo sngags kyi/ / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ / nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims dri bzang dang / / 'grogs pa'i grags snyan ma la ya rlung gis/ / srid pa'i gdung sel thar ba'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ / gnas brtan 'dul 'dzin chen por gsol ba 'debs/ / ma smad grags pa'i gzhir gyur rgyal sras kyi/ / spyod mchog thabs shes zung 'jug gar gyis rtsen/ / mtshan nyid bcu ldan theg mchog dge ba'i bshes/ / mtshungs med 'gro ba'i 'dren par gsol ba 'debs/ / grags pa mtha' yas gsang chen rdo rje theg / rgyal ba'i thugs bcud zab lam rim gnyis dang / / mtshan bcas mtshan med rnal 'byor la gnas pa/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso la gsol ba 'debs/ / bla ma yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i mthus/ / 'dren mchog dam pa'i rnam dkar mdzad 'phrin dang / / snyan pa'i grags pa sa steng kun khyab cing / / sku tshe rgyal mtshan bskal brgyar brtan gyur cig / bdag sogs kun kyang skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ / bla ma mchog gis dgyes bzhin rjes 'dzin cing / / rgyal dbang grags pa'i bstan la rab zhugs te/ / bshad dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin gyur cig / mdor na bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde kun/ / spel ba'i grags snyan dbyar rnga bzhad pa dang / / lhan cig bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ / dge mtshan yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyab gyur cig / ces 'jam mgon bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa sgo mang mkhan po sangs 338

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/rgyas rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di ni spongab bsam gtan la gcig tu gzhol ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang dkon mchog gis bskul te 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o /phul byung mkhyen pa'i grags pa lha yi rnga/ / zab rgyas chos kyi gdangs snyan nga ro yis/ / srid zhi'i rgud pa'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba/ / mtshan ldan bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / dpal ldan mkhas mang gtsug gi rgyan gyur kyang / / snyems bral zhi dul bag yod khrims kyis bsdams/ /thub bstan spel ba'i khur gyis mi ngal ba/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / thugs kyi bum bzang bslab gsum bdud rtsis gtams/ / sde snod gsum gyi legs bshad dga' ston spel/ / bgrang yas 'gro la thar lam mtshon pa'i mig / 'dren mchog dam pa bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /bdag kyang bshes gnyen dam pas rjes 'dzin cing / / bshad sgrub nor bu'i them skas rim bgrod nas/ / yang dag lam gyi ri dbang rtser son te/ / sku gsum 'chi med dbang po'i gnas thob shog / bla ma yi dam rin chen rnam pa gsum/ / thugs bskyed rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin mi yol ba'i/ / bden mthus ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu kun/ / gegs med lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces dge ldan bstan pa'i snang byed dam pa rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa rab 'byams pa 'jigs med snyan grags kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /dkon mchog gsum 'dus 'jigs med stobs bcu'i bdag / thub dbang bstan pa'i snying po lung rigs kyi/ / sgon me gsal byed smra ba'i seng ge mchog / khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ / 'di'ang rab 'byams pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i 'dun mos ltar gnang ba'o/ /339

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/dbyangs canam dmar mo'i bstod pa lha mo dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /mnyam bzhag mi g.yo stong ba'i me long ngos/ / brtse ba'i 'ja' tshon snang ba'i ri mo 'bum/ / rnam par bkra ba dbyangs can ngag gi lha/ / zla bral spobs pa bdag la grub par mdzod/ / khyod sku byu ru'i 'khri shing lang tsho'i dpal/ / snye ma'i nu 'bur g.yo bas mngon dga' zhing / / mu tig do shal gsar ba'i 'od chags des/ / dang ba'i sems kyi do ra mdzes gyur cig /zhal khyim li khris rab rgyas padma'i mtshor/ / smin legs rtsed 'jo'i gar rol bung ba'i mig / rna rgyan sprang rtsi'i dog par rjes chags bzhin/ / brtse ba'i zur mig g.yo bas rtag skyongs shig / 'khril ldem sked skabs sa ha ka ra'i ljon/ / mdzes byed 'og pag gzhon nu'i 'khri shing ngos/ / gdangs snyan sgra sgrogs dril chung bung ba'i khyu/ / rtag par rtsen pa so ga'i dus ston bzhin/ /gang gi zhabs skyes zla shel myu gu'i cha/ / reg pas kun rmongs gdung ba mthar mdzad na/ / rtse gcig gus bsten bdag gi yid mkha' la/ / rtag par rol cig dbyangs can kurdo'i gnyen/ / khyod gsung dri za'i 'jig rten rdzogs pa'i dpyid/ / bung ba'i phreng ba myos pa'i gdangs mtshungs par/ / ga ma gas bcings snyan 'gyur drug cu'i dbyangs/ / nam yang mi zad rna ba'i bdudacir mdzod/ / chos tshul mtha' bral snyems pa'i nor 'dzin khyon/ /gcig car 'khyud pa'i blo gros sngo bsangs ma/ / ting 'dzin rgyu skar bye ba'i rol ba can/ / yid rab dang ba'i chu mtshor 'pho gyur cig / grangs ring skye bar sgra dbyangs lha mo yi/ / zhabs skyes bsnun pa'i bdag blo paci la/ / thar 340

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/'dodakang drug dpyid gyur 'chad rtsod rtsom/ / lo 'bras g.yur du za ba'i dpal thob shog / mdor na smag chen srid pa'i 'brog dgon 'dir/ /'khyams pa'i 'gro la mtha' spangs zhi ba'i lam/ / snang ba'i byed po tshogs gnyis skya rengs kyis/ / drangs pa'i nyi ma chen por bdag gyur cig / ces sgra dbyangs lha mo la bstod pa 'dod gsol dang bcas pa 'di ni/ dad brtson ldan pa dge slong nyi ma grags pas bskul ngor rigs pa smra ba'i btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dpal ldan 'bras spungs su bris pa'o/ /dpal mgon klu sgrub zhabs la bstod pa dbu ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/rgyal bas chos tshul gang bstan pa/ / 'gro ba mun pas khebs pa la /'od gsal ba yi phyir yin pas/ / sgon ma klu sgrub rgyal gyur cig / dmigs las dmigs pa rnam mang bas/ / 'gro ba dub par gyur pa rnams/ /dmigs pa med pa zhi ba'i bder/ / 'khrid pa khyod ni ded dpon lags/ /shes rab phar phyin shes rab bslab/ / shes rab mdo sde'i mchog gyur phyir/ / shes rab gzhung mchog mdzad pa khyod/ / bstan 'dzin kun las bla mar gyur/ / rig gnas shes byar srid kun la/ / mun sangs blo gros rab rgyas pas/ / sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub ces/ / dngos por smra ba rnams kyang 'dud/ / ma rig 'gag pas yan lag kun/ / 'gag par mdo sde kun gsungs kyang / / gab pa srid pa'i srog rtsa ni/ / gsal bar gcod pa'i rigs pa byin/ / gzhan dag stong zhes bkag bar dang / / brten zhes sgrub pa nyid go bas/ / thag mkhan stabs bzhin phyogs su lhung / / khyod kyis 341

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/bzlog ste bde bar bzhugs/ / rgyu rkyen yan lag du ma zhig / tshogs nas phar la 'jog dgos pa/ / tshugs thub rang dbang bral ba'i rtags/ / des ni rten 'byung stong bar bshad/ / rang dbang ngo bos ma dmigs kyang / / sna tshogs snang ba mi 'gag pas/ / rkyen tshogs 'ja' tshon snang tsam dang / /'dra bar stong bas rten 'byung gsungs/ / ma tshogs pa la gnas med cing / / brgya stong tshogs la gcig pa med/ / gcig med pa la du ma med/ / gcig dang gzhan min ci yang med/ / dngos po rdzas dang ldog pa las/ / gcig dang tha dad rnam 'byed pa/ / gnyis la lce gnyis smra ba'i tshig / ji bzhin bden par ga la 'gyur/ / de bzhin la lar skye dang yod/ / gzhan 'gar 'gag dang med pa sogs/ / res 'ga' ba kun rdzun pa ste/ / bden pa gcig las 'gyur ba med/ / yod na rtag tu yod pa la/ / rkyen gyis ci bya gnyis ka mnyam/ / med par bden pa 'byung mi srid/ / shi ba bos kyang mgron du min/ / rgyu la rgyu yi dngos gnas tshe/ /'bras bur de 'char myug bzhin na/ / stong phyir stong tsam der 'char de/ /mkha' nyid snang dang mun par bzhin/ / tha dad ltos med rgyu 'bras min/ /yang na kun kyang der bajod rung / / ther zug rgyu ni 'bras bu'i gegs/ /de yis grol ba'i skabs kyang ci/ / dbang bsgyur bden pa bcos med la/ /bden min bcings kyang thabs gzhan ldan/ / grol sogs rung zhes bden gnyis kyi/ / sgrub pas thar 'dod dbugs 'byung mdzad/ / lta ngan kun gtso 'jig tshogs la/ / lta ba srid pa'i rtsa ba ni/ / lta kun mchog gyur mtha' bral gyi/ / lta bas bcad nyid thar bar bzhed/ / de phyir bgrod gcig shes rab rmad/ / 'on kyang theg chen nam mkha' ltar/ / byed po thabs ni de bas rmad/ / des na zab rgyas zung du mdzad/ / stong yang snang 342

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyiskor/ngo zhes bya 'dis/ / bden pa'i bya byed rang rong gi/ / 'gal 'du'i mi bde kun bsnyal bas/ / klan ga'i go skabs yongs las 'das/ / yod med mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam/ / yod med mtha' spangs zung 'jug don/ /gsal bar lung bstan gsal ba gnyis/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa tshad mar gnas/ / mar me mdzad kyang byon pa'i sngar/ / lung bstan brnyes pas dpag dka' yang / / phal ba lta bur byin rlobs pa/ / rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ / rung min don min kun bsal te/ / chos 'dul lta dang 'dus pa'i gnad/ / gsal mdzad sangs rgyas gnyis pa dang / / rgyal ba gnyis pa mtshan don gcig / de dag gshegs bshul nang gnas kyang / /'phye bo bdag cag bgrod nus min/ / rjes su 'o dod 'bod pa bzhin/ /gdung ba'i dbyangasakyis gsol ba 'debs/ / gus pas gsol btab dge smin pas/ / rgya chen thabs kyi gshog rlabs can/ / zab mo'i de nyid rigs pa yis/ / don gnyis mkha' la bgrod gyur cig / ces dpal mgon klu sgrub zhabs la bstod pa dbu ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba 'di ni tshul 'dir mos pa'i blo can hal ha rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ /blo gros bum bzang tshul khrims bdud rtsis gtams/ / 'jigs med spobs pas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ / rmad byung mdzad pas 'gro kun skyob mdzad pa/ / mchog sprul dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / blo gter kun bzang spyod tshul 'dab brgya bzhad/ / bslab khrims rnam par byeg pa~X bhe dhrirji dīX dī/'i rna/ ༵ jiXrsha me/ga rnaXrta /pyo rdog bstanghru dīXṭwāṃ~X ༷༵ chos tshul sbel ba'i phyir/ / khrims ldan dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtsug rgyan 343

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/du/ / 'jigs med gdong lnga'i khri la rtag bzhugs nas/ / bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng gyur cig / bdag kyang blo gsal rig bzang tshul khrims dag / srid la 'jigs shing bdag med gnas lugs mthong / / bstan pa'i yang snying rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ / mtshan ldan bshes gnyen rjes su slob gyur cig / blo ldan skal bzang gdul bya'i mos gus dang / / tshul khrims rnam dag smon pa'i bden tshig mthus/ /'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ / srid zhi'i gtsug tor rtse mor mdzes gyur cig / ces 'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyin byed rje btsun dam pa'i mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin po che blo bzang tshul khrims 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs pad brtan cing mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa'i don gyi smon tshig 'di ni hal ha khu re chen mo'i grwa rigs blo bzang tshe ring gis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rgyal kun thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ / nam mkha' zhing khams rab 'byams kun khyab pas/ / mtha' klas bstan dang 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa/ / khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ / khyad par rje btsun 'jam dpal snying bo yi/ / lung rtogs chos kyi bstan pa'i srog 'dzin cing / / gzhan phan 'phrin las sa gsum kun tu khyab/ / mtshungs med 'dren mchog dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / ring nas goms pa'i thugs bskyed rta ljang gis/ / nyer drangs mtshungs med mchog sprul nam mkha'i nor/ / dge ldan lugs bzang 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i gnyen/ / 'gro ba'i sgron me bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog / 'jam dpal bka' nyan chos kyi rgyal po sogs/ / bstan 'dzin srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i mthus/ / rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / / 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos 344

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyisgor/can khyab gyur cig / khyod zhabs gus pas bsten pa bdag cag kyang / / ji srid byang chub rdo rje'i gnas thob pa/ / de srid 'bral med dgyes bzhin rjes 'dzin cing / / mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes pa sgrub par shog / gang gi thugs rje'i gru gzings la brten nas/ / mdo sngags lam bzang rgya mtsho'i 'jing brgal te/ / mchog thun dngos grub nor bu'i dga' ston la/ /'dod dgur spyod pa'i skal bzang thob par shog / mdor na mgon khyod zhabs pad rtag brtan cing / / sde 'dir mdo sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas/ / yangs pa'i 'jig rten bde 'byor gyis 'tsho ba'i/ / bkra shis rgya mtshos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig / ces skye dgu'i 'dren mchog dam pa 'jam mgon bstan pa'i rtsa lag btsan po no min han mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin po che rje btsun 'jamadapal chos kyi bstaja'adzin 'azin las dpal bzang po'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di ni/ / dpa' ris 'bri gu dgon gyi khri pa mkhas btsun bzang po'i bdag nyid blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'dzin las/ khri zur skal bzang mchog grub/ khri zur ngag dbang chos rgya mtsho/ khri zur skal bzang dngos grub sogs thun mong nas skul ma byung ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /byang phyogs bstan pa'i dpung gnyen tsha gan ti yan chi ngag dbang bstan 'dzinacu mcho'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs bzhugs/zla med ston pa smra ba'i zla ba mchog / sgrib med yongs su dag pa'i ye shes kyis/ / ji bzhin kun tu gzigs pa'i bden gsung don/ / mngon gyur rgyal ba'i sras po rgyal gyur cig / rang bzhin dag pa'i zla shel dri ma'i sprin/ / rgyang bsrings kun tu bzang po'i bsil zer 'bum/ / srid pa srid 345

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/du spro ba'i dpal yon can/ / 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / spangs dang rtogs pa mngon par byang chub kyang / / gang 'dul bkod pa'i zla snang sprul ba'i gar/ / skal bzang mos pa'i dzing bur rtag 'char ba/ / bsam gtan dkar po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i cha shas yongs gang zhing / / gtan bde kurdo'i dga' tshal rgyas bya'i phyir/ / sde snod gsum gyi 'od dkar spro ba bo/ / smra ba'i dbang phyug mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / tshul khrims dag pa'i mkha' la rnam rol zhing / / phul byung bsam gtan ri dwags mtshan mas mdzes/ / shes rab 'od dkar dra ba 'bum 'gyed pa/ / grub pa'i dbang bo mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / lhag bsam mchog gis byang chub sems gnyis la/ / gtan du gomasabyus bcu drug cha rdzogs pas/ / dkar po'i chos kyi chu gter kun tu rgyas/ / zeg mchog bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / skye ba'i ljon pa sdug bsngal gzhir mthong ba'i/ / nges 'byung 'gro la rjes mtshon snying rje'i sems/ / theg gsum chos kun gcig gyur dgongs pa brnyes/ /sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / dgag sgrub gnang bkag phra ba'i cha la yang / / dran shes bag yod nges pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ / 'dar med dam tshig phyag brgya'i re ba 'chang / / 'dul 'dzin chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / ma zhum snying stobs go cha'i sgrub pa yis/ / nyon mongs dgra sde'i g.yul ngo gzhom pa la/ / brnag dka'i byang chub spyod pa kun bzod pa/ / dka' thub chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / grangs ring bskal par phyin drug bsdu bzhi sogs/ / spyod pa rnam bcu'i chos kyi ngang tshul las/ / mi g.yo rang gzhan smin cing grol byed pa/ / dge spyong chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / mdor na sku gnyis 346

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyisgor/'grub byed sems mchog gnyis/ / yan lag bcas la rtag gus sbyor ba yi/ / nyams len zab mo'i rtog pa mthar son pa/ / rnal 'byor chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / thun mong lam bzang goms pa'i rtsal rdzogs kyang / / sku gsum tshe 'dir sgrub pa rdo rje'i theg / kho nar gzigs pas rim gnyis rnal 'byor las/ / g.yo med rig 'dzin mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / las nyon 'chi ba chos skur sbyangs pa las/ / longs spyod rdzogs dang rags pa sprul pa'i skur/ / yid ngor ldang byed rim pa dang po'i lam/ /mthar phyin sngags 'chang chen por gsol ba 'debs/ / sku yi rdo rje'i ga la sngags kyi gdangs/ / gsung gi rdo rjes zla nyi'i rgyu ba bcad/ / dhustur lhan cig skyes dga' rdo rje'i thugs/ / mngon gyur rdo rje 'dzin par gsol ba 'debs/ / sgrib med 'od gsal gnyid du yur ba las/ / sgyu 'phrul dra ba bzhengs pas snang stong chos/ / ris med rgyan gyi 'khor lo mi zad par/ /dbang bsgyur grub pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / rang don rtog pa mchog gi rgyal thabs la/ / dbang bsgyur 'gro la brtse ba'i gzhan dbang gis/ /mdzad bzang thub dbang bstan pa'i dpal gyur pa/ / bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / khyad par rgyal kun dgongs pa'i bcud bsdus pas/ / mdo sngags zung 'jug 'khrul bral dge ldan bstan/ /'khor lo gsum gyis phyogs mthar spel ba yi/ / thugs bskyed lhun gyis grub la gsol ba 'debs/ / mdor na mang thos mkhas pa kun gyi gtso/ / mdo sngags lam gyis rgyud sbyangs grub pa'i rje/ / bstan 'gror phan dgongs bzang po'i mthu ldan pa/ / bslu med skyabs kyi dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / de ltar yon tan phung po chu yi khur/ / lhun stug grags pa'i sgra brgya rgod pa der/ / dang ba'i mdongs mtha' dga' bas rol ba yis/ /347

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/bstod pa'i tshig gi mgrin glu snyan par 'khrol/ / dge ba zla ba'i zhun mar 'bebs pa des/ / bdag sogs deng nas skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ / bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon dang mi 'bral zhing / / legs gsung bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis 'tsho bar shog / byang phyogs 'dzin ma'i rgyan gyur chos kyi grwar/ / rgyal yum dngos shugs dgongs pa'i zab rgyas chos/ / gzhi rten chos 'dul lung rigs mngon par bcas/ / legs bshad mi nub rgyal mtshan tshugs gyur cig / dbang gis smin byas dam tshig zhing sa la/ /gsang chen gdams pa'i lo 'dab g.yur za zhing / / zab gsal rim gnyis rnal 'byor 'bras smin pas/ / don gnyis dge mtshan lhun gyis grub gyur cig / skye dgu'i phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub pa'i bstan/ / cha shas kun nas mi nyams 'phel rgyas shing / / de 'dzin dam pa mchod yon dang bcas pa/ / dbyar mtsho ji bzhin rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dge slong 'jigs med rab brtan gyis nan tan chen pos yang yang bskul ba ltar 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du bris pa'o/ /blo gros dri ma med pa'i lha lam ngos/ / kun bzang spyod tshul yid 'ong bdud rtsi'i gter/ / zab rgyas chos kyi chu mtsho dar rgyas su/ / spel mdzad smra ba'i zla ba rgyal gyur cig / blo bzang grags bstan bdud rtsi'i bcud myang ste/ / chos kun gzigs pa'i lang tsho dar la bab/ / dpal ldan mkhas pa kun gyis gus bsten pa/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /nghru ༵ dī ṭwāṃrdo ༵ṭwāngarkani rdo bye ṭwāṃ rdo rdoX rdoX /dbya/rji~X /༵ ṭwāṃrdo ṭwāṃtt+waṃ rdo tt+waṃdī kyis bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / blogros rnam par rgyal 348

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyiskor/ba'i khang bzang rtser/ / lung rtogs chos kyi rgyal mtshan mngon mtho zhing / /gzhan phan 'phrin las dar gyi sham bu g.yo/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / skyabs gsum thugs rje bden mthus bla ma mchog /blo bzang bstan pa'i dpal du zhabs brtan cing / / chos srid mdzad 'phrin dar zhing rgyas gyur te/ / 'gro kun gtan bde'i dpal la 'god gyur cig / ces bstan pa'i 'byung khungs dpal ldan 'bras spungs bkra shis sgo mang gi chos kyi khri la mnga' gsol ba 'jam mgon bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po blo bzang chos dar ba'i zhal snga nas kyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di ni rnam dpyod yangs pa 'jigs med dam chos kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du bris pa'o/ /ngag dbang mkhyen gter 'jam dpal snying bo'i bstan/ / dge ldan lugs bzang mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi/ / legs bshad dga' ston 'gyed pa'i dpal yon can/ / bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / de nyid slar yang skal bzang gdul bya la/ / dge legs rgya mtsho'i mchog sbyin spel ba'i phyir/ / yang srid gzhon nu'i sku yi rnam rol ba/ / mchog sprul dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / rdo rje 'chang dngos 'jigs med dbang bo sogs/ / bshes gnyen dam pa du mas rjes bzung bas/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan lhun rdzogs pa/ / skal bzang dge legs rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ / bla ma yi dam mchog gsum rgya mtsho dang / / tshe yi mchog sbyin lhag pa'i lha tshogs mthus/ / rje btsun bla ma'i sku tshe rab brtan cing / / phrin las snang ba phyogs mthar rgyas gyur cig / yangs pa'i ljongs 'dir chos srid 'byor ba rgyas/ / mdo sngags zung 'brel bshad sgrub bstan pa dang / / dge bcu'i dpal gyi 'dab brgya ba'ad 349

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/pa yis/ / des legs sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig / ces bstan pa'i rtsa lag skal bzang dge legs rgya mtsho'i zhabs brtan smon tshig 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog nyi mas bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /phul byung dge mtshan snang ba 'bum phrag gis/ / srid zhi'i rgud pa'i mun pa drungs 'byin cing / / phan dang bde ba'i lam bzang gsal mdzad pa/ / mchog gsum thugs rje'i shis pas ring du skyongs/ / blo bzang rgyal bstan spel ba'i thugs skyed kyi/ / chu 'dzin klong las mdo sngags chos kyi char/ / 'jo bas gtan bde'i myu gu 'phel mdzad pa/ / mtshungs med mchog sprul dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / ring nas goms pa'i lhag bsam gru gzings mchog / mdo sngags chos tshul nor bus yongs bkang ste/ / skal bzang gdul bya'i tshogs kyi re skong ba'i/ / bzhed don gegs med lhun gyis grub gyur cig / tshe sbyin lhag pa'i lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus/ / 'dren mchog dam pa'i sku tshe rab brtan cing / / mkhas btsun bzang po'i mdzad bzang lhun rdzogs pas/ / blo bzang rgyal bstan phyogs mthar spel gyur cig / spyan ras gzigs dbang myur mdzad mgon po dang / / ma gcig 'dod khams dbang mo'i mthu stobs kyis/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i tshogs rnams kun bcom ste/ / smon pa'i 'bras bzang lhun gyis grub gyur cig /ces bstan pa'i gsal byed bur han bla ma'i sprul ba'i sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin chos 'phel gye zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di ni tā bla ma rab 'byams pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ dge bskos rab 'byams pa bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /dpal ldan yon tan dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shing / / thub bstan 350

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/bshad sgrub bdud rtsi'i 'od snang gis/ / rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu gsal mdzad pa/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / tshangs spyod brtul zhugs mchog gi dpal dang ldan/ / thub pa'i sras mchog bstan pa'i khur 'dzin zhing / / gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ /mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam pa zhabs brtan shog / 'chi med dpal ster lha tshogs thugs rje'i mthus/ / dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan zhing / / thub pa'i bstan srung rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs kyis/ / rnam dkar 'azin las gegs med rgyas gyur cig / mkha' mnyam lus can phan bde'i sgo gcig pu/ / dge ldan ring lugs phyogs mthar 'phel rgyas shing / / de 'dzin ngur smrig 'chang ba'i 'dus sde yi/ / bshad sgrub bya ba dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shog / mdor na bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu dang / / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chos srid dpal 'byor kun/ / phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel ba yis/ / rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i kun dga' rgyas gyur cig / ces 'dan ma sprul ba'i sku rin po che dpal ldan thub bstan rgya mtsho'i 'bas brtan smon tshig 'di ni phyag mdzod blo bzang bzod pa dang dka' bcu ngag dbang 'byung gnas gnyis kyi ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa yi/ / rlabs chen thugs bskyed sa bon smin pa las/ / rmad byung 'phrin las yal ga'i phyogs rdzogs pa/ /mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / tshul khrim sa bdud rtsis blo yi bum bzang gtams/ / bstan 'gror sman pa'i lhag bsam khur 'dzin zhing / / gsang chen 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i mthu ldan pa/ / gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin khyod zhabs brtan shog / dus gsum rgyal ba rgyal sras thugs rje yi/ / byin rlabs zad mi shes pa'i sprin phung las/ / dngos grub 351

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/rnam gnyis gru char 'jo ba yis/ / rnam dkar bzhed don lhun gyes grub gyur cig / bdag sogs kun kyang skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ / yongs 'dzin dam pas 'bral med rjes 'dzin zhing / / rgyu 'bras theg pa'i lam bzang rim bgrod de/ / bla med byang chub go 'phang myur thob shog / bla ma yi dam mchog gsum byin rlabs dang / / bdag sogs rtse gcig mos pa'i bden stobs kyis/ /ji ltar smon bzhin lhun gyis grub pa yis/ / bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i dge mtshan rgyas gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni 'bri gu dgon pa'i slob zur skal bzang mchog grub dang zhabs drung ngag dbang chos rgya mtsho gnyis kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /srid gsum bsod nams phung bo las rgyal ba/ / dpal stug spros bral bde ba mchog gi tshogs/ / lhun grub don gnyis ri mor yongs smin pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / rgyu med 'gro la mnyes gshin bde 'thung gi / rtse dga' rgyas pa lhag bsam chu ldan phreng / / kun rtog rgyu ba zad pa'i sngo bsangs sder/ / rol ba grub pa'i dbang bor gsol ba 'debs/ / tha dad khams kyi dzing bu rab 'byams su/ / gang 'dul bkod par 'char ba'i gzhan phan stobs/ / lhun rdzogs skal ba bzang po'i 'jig rten mig / rje btsun bstan pa'i sgron mer gsol ba 'debs/ / de nyid slar yang thugs bskyed brtsan po'i mthu/ / yid srub dpung ba mthar byed rdo rje yi/ / gdengs ka stong phrag nyi ma'i gzi 'bar ba/ / mchog sprul dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / dkon mchog thugs rje zla ba nor bu'i ༵dī/sa phre/༷ ṭwāṃlale / ṭwāṃ bag ba tt+waṃrdo ṭwāṃzeg ༵ ༵nghruṭwādhidzhai/ ga~Xdhi/ dam/ ༷sdi didīX ba 'debs/ / nges 'byung ri shis sbyangs pa yid bzhin mtsho/ / skyon bral 352

/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyiskor/bshad sgrub nor bus yongs gtams pa/ / thar 'dod mngon dga'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i dpyid/ / mtshungs bral 'gro ba'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ / yongs smin bstan pa'i nyin byed dmar bo'i 'od/ / dbang phyogs lhun po'i rtse mor chags pa'i ngogs/ / thabs mkhas 'jug pas ma rnams skyong mdzad pa/ / thugs rje'i bdag nyid mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / lung rigs 'dab ma g.yo ba'i 'thor rlung gis/ / smra ngan spobs pa'i ri bo ral byed cing / / rgyal bstan lha lam gcod pa'i gzi byin 'bar/ / bshes gnyen mkha' lding dbang bor gsol ba 'debs/ / dkon mchog kun 'dus bla ma yi dam lha/ / bstan srung sder bcas mthu yis 'dren pa mchog / dge ldan bstan pa'i dpal du legs bzhugs te/ / phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab gyur cig / mkhas btsun bzang po'i lte ba las thon cing / / ris med snying rje'i mu khyud kyis bsdams pa/ / gzhan phan rtsibs stong rab rdzogs gser sbyang gi / 'khor lo srid gsum bla na rtsen gyur cig / bdag sogs grol ba'i ro bda' mos gus kyi/ / bdud rtsis yid la gtams pa'i rjes 'jug kun/ / skye ba'i phreng bar rjes bzung byang chen gye/ / nor bu'i khri 'phang mchog la 'god gyur cig / legs smon dus su 'jo ba'i gru char gyis/ / dge 'dun chos 'byor dpal gyi 'dab rgyas shing / / sa dbang sde bzhi'i phun tshogs rlabs phreng 'phyur/ / snyan pa mkha' 'gro'i rdza rnga 'khrol gyur cig / mi 'gyur gdod ma'i rang bzhin a dar sha/ / bslu med rten 'byung snang ba mi 'gog pas/ / rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa smon pa'i dngos/ / ma lus gegs med 'bras bur smin gyur cig / ces byang phyogs chen po hor gyi yul du bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa thu med lo tsā pa bla ma'i sprul sku dkon mchog dge legs rgya mtsho'i zhabs brtan gsol 353

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/'debs 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa gnyer ba tshe 'phel/ gzhan yang mang thos sgrub la gzhol ba yon tan rgya mtsho sogs thu med shog gi grwa rigs spyi nas bskul ba ltar 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rgyal dbang grags bstan chos kyi gdugs dkar po/ / lus can yongs la phan bde'i grib bsil can/ / spel phyir skye ba'i zlos gar lhur mdzad pa/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'jigs med snying stobs lhag bsam yu ba brtan/ / gzhung lugs mang thos dar gyi sham bu bkra/ / rnam dag bslab gsum nor bu'i tog gis mdzes/ / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ / srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs ma lus pa'i/ / 'byung gnas mchog gsum spyi dang khyad par du/ / g.yung drung tshe yi mchog sbyin lha tshogs mthus/ / rje btsun dam pa bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog / yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs kyi/ / dpung bas nag phyogs bdud sde'i g.yul bcom ste/ / bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i 'phrin las kyi/ / ru mtshon phyogs kyi 'khor lor sgreng bar mdzod/ / skye zhing skye bar bdag sogs lus can kun/ / mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes 'dzin zhing / / yang dag lam gyi gru gzings la brten nas/ / srid pa'i mtsho las myur du sgrol gyur cig / ces bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa 'gyang ro sprul ba'i sku rin po che 'jigs med rgyal mtshan pa'i zhabs brtan smon tshig de ni kha kya'i rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bsam gtan gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rab 'byams rgyal kun rtag pa dam pa'i rgyu/ / zla ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin byang chub sems/ / 'jig rten dbang phyug nying sprul zlos pa'i gar/ / mtshungs med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / dge mtshan skal 354

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/bzang gdul bya'i 'dun mos mkhar/ / dkon mchog rin chen gsum 'dus nyin mor byed/ / blo bzang rgyal bstan 'dzin ma'i khor yug khyon/ / gsal mdzad mchog sprul dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / mtha' brgyad spros bral chos kyi phyag rgya ches/ / gsang chen theg par rgyas btab bstan pa'i gnad/ / kun rdzogs snying stobs chen po'i dgongs pa bzhin/ / spel phyir rdo rje'i khams su zhabs brtan shog / chos 'dul spyod pa rnam dag 'dab mas mdzes/ / gzhan phan lhag bsam mchog gi dri bzang 'thul/ / rim gnyis rtogs pa'i 'bras bu g.yur za ba/ / 'dren mchog sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rtag brtan shog / thugs bskyed kai la sha ri'i rgyun bzang po/ /bstan 'gro'i dpyid du 'bab pa lha yi chab/ / grags snyan rlabs kyi 'khri shing ral bar bcas/ / nor 'dzin khor yug shis pas skyong gyur cig / ces dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag rdzong dkar che ba tshang sprul ba'i sku dge 'dun dkon mchog blo bzang bstan 'dzin pa'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di ni lhag bsam rmad du byung ba sku skye blo bzang shes rab kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / bsod nams ye shes yang dag grub pa'i dngos/ / zung du 'jug pa rnal 'byor dga' tshal du/ / don gnyis 'bras bzang smin pas spa ba yi /rnam 'dren dpag bsam ljon pa rgyal gyur cig / 'jigs med rnam par dpyod pa'i gser ldan mar/ / bshad sgrub lung rigs chu bo 'bum 'dus pa/ / phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan rgya mtsho che/ / mchog sprul dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / brtse chen goms pas zhi ba'i mtha' las grol/ / rnam 'byed ral gris srid pa'i dra ba bcad/ / mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid skal ldan yongs kyi mgon/ / rje btsun dam pa bskal brgyar 'bas 355

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/brtan shog / byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i snang ba mi zad pas/ / tshe dpal kurdo rgyas byed snang mtha' yas/ / yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang bcas pas/ / sku tshe bskal brgyar brtan pa'i byin stsol cig / yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i thugs rje dang / / mi bslu 'gyur ba med pa'i rten 'brel gshis/ /skal bzang mos gus tshogs pa'i legs byas kyis/ / smon pa'i 'bras kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag rdzong dkar chung ba tshang sprul ba'i sku 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtsho'i zhabs brtan smon tshig 'di ni dad brtson phul du byung ba sku skye blo bzang shes rab kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /ji snyed spros pa'i dra ba chos dbyings su/ / zhi ba 'od gsal mchog gi rang gdangs las/ / gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul dra bar 'char bzod pa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso la 'dud/ / ngag rig grub pa'i dbang bo yongs kyi rje/ / bstan 'dzin mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ / lhun grub 'azin las bstan 'gro'i dpal du gyur/ / zla bral bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / blo chen rgyal kun bzang po'i 'phrin las kyi/ / bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde padma'i tshal/ / rgyas byed nyi gzhon 'od stong dra ba can/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'jigs med spobs pa gangs kyi ri bo'i sgor/ / lung rigs ral ba gsig pa'i gdong lnga ba/ / ri skyes skal ldan gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon/ / mchog sprul dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar mngar po'i bsung / / phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs pa'i sa mchog ljon/ / 'phrin las yal ga 'bum du bres pa yi/ / grib bsil dam pas 'gro kun skyong gyur cig / thugs rje zla ba'i 'phel ba rtsom pa yis/ / mi zad tshe yi chu gter 356

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyisgor/rgyas byed pa/ / tshe sbyin lha tshogs thugs rje bden pa'i mthus/ / skyabs gcig dam pa bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog / ye shes spyan ldan srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyang / / mi shigs rdo rje'i g.yar dam nyer dgongs te/ / sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa'i 'azin las kyi/ / bkra shis rgya mtshos phyogs kun khyab par mdzod/ / ces dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa rdzong dkar chung ba tshang sprul ba'i sku 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs 'di ni lhag bsam rmad du byung ba sku skye blo bzang shes rab kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /na mo ārya lo ke shā rā ya/ rmad byung thugs rje'i nor bu chu shel khams/ / mtha' yas gcig bsdus bdag nyid dkyil 'khor las/ / rnam dkar 'azin las snang ba'i mchog sbyin pa/ / mgon po spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ / gang la gang 'tsham thabs kyis 'gro ba kun/ / srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las sgol skyabs kyi phul/ / dug gsum nad gso mdzad pa sman pa'i mchog / mnyam nyid rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / brtan pa'i 'khor lo rgyal dbang grags pa yi/ / bka' srol sgrub brgyud bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gtso/ / zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa/ / 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / thun mong lam dang mtshan bcas mtshan med sogs/ / ting 'dzin sgyu 'phrul bye ba'i 'jug ldang gis/ / zag med bde ba'i dga' ston mngon gyur pa/ / ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / zab rgyas lam gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin kyang / / sbas pa'i tshul gyis skal ldan gdul bya rnams/ / smin cing grol mdzad theg mchog dge ba'i bshes/ / shes rab nyi ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / khyad par spyan ras gzigs dbang rnal 'byor gyis/ / 'gro 357

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgrom me'i gsung 'bum/kun bde ldan zhing du 'khrid pa yi/ / bka' babs 'phrin las zla med ma ṇi pa/ / shes rab bkra shis zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / bslab gsum rnam par dag pas thugs rgyud dul/ / sde snod mang thos gzhung lugs gdams par shar/ / 'khor lo gsum gyis rgyal bstan spel mdzad pa/ / blo bzang mkhas mchog zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / dge 'dun dkon mchog 'dus pa'i dga' tshal du/ / blo bzang bstan pa'i 'dab brgya rgyas byed pa'i/ / nyi ma gzhon nu 'azin las 'od stong can/ / mchog sprul dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / tshe yi mchog sbyin lhag pa'i lha rnams dang / / yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs kyis/ / rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / / 'phrin las snang ba phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig / bdag sogs kun kyang skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ / dam pa'i zhabs rdul mchod pa mi gtong zhing / / bka' bzhin sgrub pa snying por byas pa yis/ / yang dag lam bzang mngon du 'gyur bar shog / khyad par 'dir snang 'gags tshe bla ma dang / /spyan ras gzigs dbang dbyer med thugs rje'i mthus/ / zhing mchog bde ba can dang po ta lar/ / drangs te sras kyi thu bor 'gyur bar shog / ces pa 'di ni dad ldan slob ma don gnyer can du mas bskul ngor/ mkhas grub chen po shes rab bkra shis nyid kyi gsung la gzhi byas te/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong brtson 'grus bde chen no/ /rnam 'dren kun gyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul gar/ / rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs bzang phyogs kun tu/ / dar zhing rgyas mdzad 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / rnyog bral tshul khrims gtsang ma'i kā la sha/ / mang thos mthar son bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams/ /358

sa / / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/rmad byung 'phrin las dpag bsam yal 'dab g.yo/ / theg mchog dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ / skal bar 'tsham pa'i legs bshad sprin phung 'khrigs/ / smra ngan zil gnon rigs pa'i bde 'thung g.yo/ / don bzang snyan tshig dbyar rnga dal gyes bzhad/ / zla med bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / thub bstan spel ba'i smon lam grub pa'i mthus/ / byang phyogs 'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i khor yug kun/ / blo bzang rgyal bstan snying pos khyab mdzad pa/ / bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /thabs mkhas spyod pas rang rang mos pa bzhin/ / chos spyod rnam bcu'i srol bzang la bkod de/ / mchog dman skye bo yongs la phan mdzad pa/ / 'gro ba'i ded dpon chen mor gsol ba 'debs/ / mtshan tsam dran pa'i ga bur gzeg ma yis/ / dus kyi rgud pa'i tsha gdungs mthar byed pa/ / tshe yi lha tshogs dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mthus/ / dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog / bdag kyang deng nas byang chub snying bo'i bar/ /mgon po khyod kyis rtag tu rjes 'dzin zhing / / tshang la ma nor gdams pa'i bcud myangs te/ / rnam dag lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / ces lung dngatogs pa'i yon tan rgya mtshos mngon par mtho zhing byang phyogs skye 'gro'i dpung gnyenadam par gyur pa wang hu thog thu skal bzang ye shes dar rgyas kyi 'bas brtan gsol 'debs 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes o'u han zhabs drung yon tan dar rgyas dang /dka' bcu yon tan dpal bzang gnyis kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /blo ldan kun bzang rgyal ba'i sras po mchog / mkhas dang grub pa'i yon tan nyi gzhon zer/ / 'bum 'gyed thub bstan padma rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / blo gros lang tsho 359

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/dar ba'i rnam dpyod lus/ / bshes gnyen prog zhu gdams pa'i do shal sogs/ / thub bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis rab bkra ba/ / smra ba'i dbang phyug mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / lta bas rgyas btab gsang chen rdo rje theg / blo bzang 'jam dpal snying po'i dgongs pa'i gnad/ / nyams su myong ba'i spangs rtogs rtsal ldan pa/ / phul byung dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ / zab dang rgya che'i gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i chus/ / yongs gang thugs bskyed rin chen bum bzang gis/ / 'gro ba'i gdung sel mchod yon bsgreng mdzad pa/ / bslu med 'dren mchog dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lha yi thugs rje'i mthus/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan pa dang / / bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i mdzad bzang kun/ / lhag bsam dgongs pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig / phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rin chen sgon/ / yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun tu rab gsal zhing / / legs byas snang bas 'tsho ba'i lus can kun/ / gtan bde'i 'jug ngogs dam par gzhol gyur cig / de tshe dam pa'i mgon gyis mi gtong zhing / / yang dgalam gye mthun rkyen kun tshogs pas/ / sa lam bgrod pa myur du mthar phyin te/ / sku gsum go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig / ces bstan pa'i gsal byed sems nyid zhabs drung blo bzang mchog grub nyi ma'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul/ dad brtson ldan pa blo bzang lhun grub kyis bskul ngor 7dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig / sku dang ye shes dbyer med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / rgyal ba'i 'azin lasalung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ / de nyid rab tu rgyas byed dge 'dun te/ / mchog gsum thugs rjes byang chub bar du skyong / / phul byung mkhyen brtse'i ye shes nyin mor byed/ / 'phrin las 'od 360

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyiskor/stong 'bar ba'i rtse dga' yis/ / thub bstan padmo'i tshal rab rgyas mdzad pa/ /dge legs snang ba'i gter chen rgyal gyur cig / lhan skyes ye shes mngon gyur grub pa'i gtso/ / gzhan phan 'phrin las spyod pa'i skyed tshal las/ / ngo mtshar dri bsung rab rgyas yon tan gyi/ / me tog phreng mdzes mdo tsam spel bar bya/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba srid las sgrol bya'i phyir/ / ye shes sku mnga' rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ / zhing khams rab 'byams rgyas par 'gengs pa'i slad/ / sna tshogs sprul ba'i zlos gar cir yang bsgyur/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / ye shes mtshon gyis srid rtsa drungs phyung yang / / snying rje'i dbang gis zhi ba'i mtha' spangs te/ / yang srid nyer bzung dge mtshan ltas kyi 'phrin/ / gzhan las 'phags pa'i sgra snyan rab tu rgyas/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / rje btsun ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me yi/ / 'phrin las nyin byed 'od kyis rab phye ste/ / thos bsam 'dab phreng rgyas pa'i ge sa ra/ / rnam dag bslab gsum sprang rtsi'i khur gyis dud/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / snang ba mtha' yas dpal ldan yeshes sogs/ / dam pas rjes ṭwāṃnghru sne ༷༷ ṭwāṃbye bye byeṭwāṃ ༷/bhe ༵/ da/ /༷ ṭwāṃX ṭwāṃste / hūṃ /༷ ༷/ rdo bye bye ṭwāṃ ༵ ṭwāṃ bhe/she ༷rdoX bherdoX / // ༷/de shaṃ ṭwāṃbherte // ༷༷//shaṃ bhe bhebhe/ bhe 36/

ro / /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/gsum gyi rol ba ci yang ston/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / ye nas phul byung lhan skyes shes rab mthus/ / zab rgyas man ngag kun la dbang 'byor te/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'phrin las rnam dpyod kyis/ / rab mang gdul bya'i blo gros rgyas par mdzad/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / thar 'dod rnams la thar ba'i lam phye ste/ /bsod nams sde shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad cing / / grags pa'i 'phrin yig srid rtse las brgal tshe/ / rab dga' rgyas pa'i skye bo yongs kyis bkur/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'di snang zhen pa yong ye mi mnga' bar/ / thabs shes zung 'brel kun bzang 'phrin las kyis/ / bgrang yas gdul bya smin cing grol mdzad pas/ / dge ldan lugs bzangaphyogs bcur rab tu rgyas/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba dhridī ༷sa zi/ma /pa.e na ma/ gangango ༷ dī/ /༷ ༷༷ di~X ṭwāṃ dī/phrin/ ༷dī ṭwāṃ~Xl yesdi~X dwangs dge ba'i sa bon lhag par rgyas/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la /༷ la /byi ༷dī ba~Xs/ spru/༷ dī ṭwāṃ dī ༷ dī ṭwāṃX ༷ dhi bcaX / ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃpa ༵sdu/na la/ ༵ dbyar gyi chu mtsho ltar/ / rab tu rgyas pa'i dge mtshan dar bar shog /nidī~X dīṭwāṃdī sdisnyi bas dīrdo ṭwāṃX ༵ ṭwāṃ/ ༵ rdorjeb/ tu/ nghru~X ༈ nā ༵khyen ༵༵ ༷ 'gro ba srid las sgol gyur cig / ces a ro hor chin shog gi bstan pa'i gsal byed bla ma zhabs drung ye shes 'phrin las rab rgyas kyi rnam thar gsol 'debs 'di ni de ga'i grwa rigs rnams kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /362

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/bgrang yas rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / ngur smrig gar bsgyur rgyal ba gnyis pa yi/ / mdo sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa'i sgron me mchog / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gso ba 'debs/ / blo gro4rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang rtser/ / lung rtogs bstan pa yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ / chos ldan re 'bras 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa/ / mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes go yu nang sprul ba'i sku rin po che3ma gnyis kyi gsol 'debs mtshan sgra dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes dad brtson ldan pa chas pa'i grwa pa 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i ring lugs dge ldan gyi/ / legs bshad rtsibs stong rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo yis/ / thub bstan nor 'dzin yongs la mnga' bsgyur ba/ / zla med smra ba'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ / rab yangs blo gros rin chen bum pa bzang / / dge legs mchog sbyin bshad sgrub bdud rtsis gtams/ / bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i srog 'dzin pa/ / phul byung bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / mang thos mthar son blo bzang mkhas pa'i gtso/ / bde dge legs tshogs rtsa brtan btsun pa'i mchog / rgyal bstan 'dzin skyong spel ba'i lhag bsam can/ / 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / bsru med bla ma lha yi byin rlabs dang / / yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i nus pa'i mthu/ / bdag sogs dad mos tshogs pa'i rten 'brel mthus/ / dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog / rlabs chen thugs bskyed lte ba las thon cing / / bshad dang sgrub pa'i rtsibs stong 'bar ba yi/ / 'phren las gser sbyang 'khor los dbang bskur bas/ / bstan la rdzogs ldan dpal yon sbyin gyur cig /363

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/bdag sogs kun kyang tshe rabs 'phreng ba ru/ / dal 'byor mtshan nyid tshang ba'i rten thob cing / / bshes gnyen dam pas 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ /mdo sngags lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / mdor na rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs brtan cing / / 'khrul bral blo bzang rgyal bstan phyogs mthar rgyas/ / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chab srid dar ba yis/ / dge bcu'i dpal la rtag tu spyod gyur cig / ces mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan sngon byon dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar dang rjes su mthun pa lha btsun sprul ba'i sku sudī galnga ṇa shīṣā ṅgā ra'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dkon mchog ye shes sogs grwa rigs rnams kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i dam chos 'dzin pa'i phyir/ / tshe rabs mang por goms pa'i legs smon mthu/ / 'phel bas bshad sgrub 'azin las lhun gyis grub/ / mtshan ldan bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / blo ldan skal bzang gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ / tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i myur lam kun/ / ji bzhin 'doms pas thub bstan 'phel mdzad pa/ /thar pa'i sa mkhan mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / blo chen rgyal kun bzang po'i thugs bskyed dang / / tshe yi dpal ster lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus/ /mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam pa zhabs brtan cing / / rnam dkar mdzad 'azin gong du 'phel gyur cig / phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan yongs 'du'i ljon/ / 'phel ba'i rtsa ba rig grol 'dus pa'i sde/ / bshad sgrub bya ba las kyi 'khor lor bcas/ / dbyar gyi chu gter ji bzhin rgyas gyur cig /bdag sogs kun kyang tshe rabs phreng ba ru/ / yang dag dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes 'dzin cing / / sa dang lam gyi rtogs pa myur bgrod nas/ / zung 'jug 364

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyiskor/go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig / ces bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa gu shrī blo bzang tshe 'phel ba'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes dbon po chos rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ bka' bcu dkon mchog dpal ldan/ bka' bcu dkon mchog dbang rgyal rnams kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /brtse chen dbyings su dī yig sa bon las/ / nyer 'khrungs ratna asgyend+ra la sogs/ / bshes gnyen mang bsten legs gsung mdzod 'dzin pa/ /chos kyi dbang phyug dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / gang gi blo gros yid bzang rol ba'i lam/ / mi 'jigs spobs pa'i nyin byed 'bar ba'i gzis/ /thub bstan dri med 'dab brgya'i tshal 'byed pa/ / bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / blo ldan skal bzang gdul bya'i mos pa bzhin/ /sgra tshad snyan ngag kun dang khyad par du/ / mdo sngags bstan pa'i gnad kun 'doms mdzad pa/ / 'jigs med smra ba'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ / 'chad pa'i blo gros nam mkha'i mtha' ltar yangs/ / don bzang sdeb legs rtsom pa'i rgyan 'phreng 'dzin/ / rtsod ngag nga ros rgol ngan 'jigs mdzad pa/ / bshes gnyen mtshungs med dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / blo chen rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje dang / / bzang bo'i thugs bskyed lhag bsam bden pa'i mthus/ / 'jigs bral rdo rje'i khams su zhabs brtan cing / / bshad sgrub mdzad bzang gegs med mthar phyin shog / blo bzang rgyal bstan srung ma'i tshogs kyis kyang / / mi 'jigasabazhi ldan tshe dpag med mgon bzhin/ / rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar 'bas brtan pa'i/ / 'phrin las sdongs grogs lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /bdag kyang bshes gnyen dam pas rjes 'dzin cing / / blo gter 'jam pa'i 365

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/dbyangs dang kun bzang ltar/ / rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son nas/ / 'jigs med stobs bcu mnga' ba'i gnas thob shog / ces chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil gyi dus 'khor grwa tshang gi slob zur nges pa don gyi bshes gnyen chen po blo bzang 'jigs med pa'i zhabs brtan smon tshig 'di ni bzang po'i bag chags yongs su smin pas sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar gyi rjes su gzhol ba lha btsun sprul ba'i sku su dī kalnga ṇa shīṣā ṅgā ras bskul ba'i ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /lhan skyes ye shes mngon gyur padma 'byung / / 'khrul zhig grub dbang 'gyur med rdo rje'i zhabs/ / chos kyi rgyal bo 'jigs med dbang po'i sde/ /mtshungs med 'dren pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ / yi dam lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung zhing / / rim gnyis zab mo'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ /rgyal bstan spel ba'i legs smon mthu grub pa/ / dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / dam pa'i mgon las zab rgyas gdams pa mnos/ / tshul bzhin sgrub pas go 'phang mchog brnyes te/ / mtha' yas gdul bya smin cing grol mdzad pa/ / 'phrin las rab brtan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i thugs bskyed kyi/ / 'bras bu yongs smin phul byung mdzad bzang gis/ / lus can thar par 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mchog / ngag dbang bstan 'dzin zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo spro zhing sdud pa yis/ / ngo mtshar 'azin las rnam bzhi'i zlos gar gyis/ / gsang chen bstan la mnga' bsgyur grub pa'i rje/ /dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs 'gro la rjes chags pas/ / rnam kun mchog ldan ye shes gzugs kyi skur/ / bzhengs pa mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam pa khyod/ / bdag 366

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/sogs gdul bya'i mgon du brtan gyur cig / tshe rabs phreng bar dam pas rjes bzang ste/ / thun mong thun mong min pa'i lam bzang la/ / nges pa rnyed nas rtse gcig sgrub pa yis/ / zung 'jug go 'phang myur du thob par shog /ces bstan pa'i gsal byed tsar a lag ngag dbang bstan 'dzin pa'i 'bas brtan smon tshig 'di ni/ thang lung gcod pa spun dang / dpa' chung dgon bcas kyis bskul ngor ratna'i ming gi bris/ /tshe dang ye shes 'od stong 'bar ba yis/ / 'chi bdag mun pa'i smag rum mthar mdzad pa/ / bcom ldan tshe mtha' yas pa'i gzi byin gyis/ /mtshungs bral bshes gnyen dam pa zhabs brtan shog / mkhyen gter ngag gi dbang phyug kurdo'i gnyen/ / rnam 'byed shes rab lha yi lam yangs por/rol ba'i legs bshad 'od dkar dra ba can/ / smra ba'i dbang phyug mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / ngag la dbang bsgyur mkhas mchog padma dkar/ /rnam dag tshul khrims sbrang rtsi'i bcud ldan zhing / / shes dang ting 'dzin 'dab stong rab tu rgyas/ / bstan pa'i rtsa lag mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / mdo rgyud man ngag kun la dbang bsgyur zhing / / ji ltar shes pa'i gnad rnams tshul bzhin du/ / nyams su bzhes pas grub mchog rab brnyes pa/ / theg mchog dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ / mchog gsum byin rlabs bdag cag dad mos mthus/ / dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / / mdzad 'phrin 'od snang phyogs brgyar spro ba yis/ / bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i pad tshal rgyas gyur cig / gang gi 'azin las ma la yar skyes dri/ / phyogs brgyar 'dren byed bstan pa'i sbyin bdag che/ / mi yi dbang phyug sder bcas dpal 'byor kun/ / dbyar gyi chu mtsho bzhin du 'phel rgyas shog / skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / / 'bral 367

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / / sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ / rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog / ces mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen chen po ja ci bla ma ngag dbang shes rab kyi zhabs brtan smon tshig 'di ni dka' bcu ngag dbang chos grags kyis bskul ngor 7dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris/ /bskal bzang rnam 'dren kun las khyad par du/ / pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i thugs rje can/ / rgyu 'bras theg pa ma lus ston mdzad pa/ /thub dbang rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ / mtha' bral lta bas rgyas btab rdo rje theg / thub bstan snying po yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad/ / nyi ltar gsal mdzad sa gsum 'gro ba'i mig / 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / blo bzang thub bstan phyogs bcur spel slad du/ /kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i gsang gsum gyi/ / rgya mtsho'i klong las slar yang nyer 'khrungs pa/ / mtshungs med mchog sprul dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / rigs kun khyab bdag chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs/ / slar yang sa gsum 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen du/ / sprul pa'i gar gyis rnam rol lhur mdzad pa/ / 'dren mchog sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ / dkon mchog kun 'dus dam pa'i mgon la brten/ / bstan pa'i gnad rnams ji bzhin gtan la phab/ / legs bshad sgon mes 'gro la thar lam ston/ / theg mchog bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / bslab pa'i sgor bcug gtsug lag lam ston cing / / dbang khrid man ngag gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i chus/ / sgrib sbyangs thar pa'i sa bon smin mdzad pa'i/ / bla ma brgyud par bcasal gsol ba 'debs/ / nam yang mi khom gnas su mi lhung zhing / /rnam smin yon tan tshang ba'i dal 'byor rten/ / rim brgyud bshes gnyen 368

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyisgor/dam pas rjes 'dzin zhing / / bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin bsten par shog / de yi legs gsung gdams pa'i bcud myang ste/ / mtha' dag srid pa'i gnas la yid 'byung zhing / / 'gro drug pha mar shes pa'i byang chub sems/ / bskyed nas rgyal sras spyod la slob par shog / sngags kyi sgor zhugs dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung / / mtshan 'dzin dmigs med lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ / bden gnyis zung 'jug go 'phang myur thob ste/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro kun srid las sgrol gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni su nyid shog nas dad brtson ldan pa dge slong ngag dbang chos grags kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /rnam 'dren rgyal ba rgyal sras tshogs rnams dang / / yi dam chos srung rgya mtshor bcas pa yis/ / dge legs me tog bye ba'i gru char gyis/ / bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i mchog sbyin mdzod/ / ring nas goms pa'i thugs bskyed rta lngang gis/ / nyer drangs bkra shis dge mtshan 'od stong gis/ /thub bstan pad tshal 'byed pa'i nyi ma mchog / mtshungs med mchog sprul dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / legs bshad dar gyi sham bu rnam bkra zhing / /shisapa'i gdangs snyan g.yer kha'i sgra brgya 'khrol/ / bslab gsum nor bu'i tog mdzes nyi ltar gsal/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / byang phyogs nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khor yug tu/ / 'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs dri ma med/ / skye ba'i 'phreng bar spel pa'i thugs skyed bzhin/ / bshad sgrub bstan pa'i dpal du zhabs brtan shog / thugs rje byin rlabs 'od rnon 'bum phrag gis/ / 'chi bdag mun pa'i smag rum mthar byed pa/ / rnam par rgyal ma la sogs tshe lha rnams/ / mchog sprul dam pa'i sku tshe bskal brgyar spel/ / ring nas bsten pa'i chos srung rgya mtshos 369

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung ཿma/kyang / / phyi nang 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe'i g.yul bcom ste/ / chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor ma lus pa/ / yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / yangs pa'i ljongs 'dir nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi/ / rgyal blon sder bcas mnga' thang dpal 'byor rgyas/ / kun kyang dge bcu'i dpal la spyod pa yis/ / gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis lhun grub shog / ces 7'jam dbyangs gong ma'i lung gis ham shig po yan thu su ma'i mkhan po theng ri tho yan bla ma'i sprul sku gu thi phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi yang sprul bkra shis nyi ma'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di ni dad gtong rgyan gyis mdzes pa mi'i dbang phyug u rad gung ratna pā las bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /dge legs yongs 'du'i sa bon smin pa las/ / tshogs gnyis spyod pa yal ga'i phyogs rdzogs shing / / rmad byung don gnyis 'bras bu'i khur gyis brjid/ / 'dren mchog dpag bsam ljon pa rgyal gyur cig / blo bzang 'jam dpal snying po'i lung rtogs bstan/ / spel ba'i thugs bskyed smon lam mthu grub pas/ / thar 'dod yongs kyi sa mkhan gcig pur gyur/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / mdo rgyud man ngag kun la dbang 'byor cing / / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i ga bur gzeg ma yis/ / rgyal bstan phyogs mthar dar zhing rgyas mdzad pa/ / 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / blo ldan skal bzang dad pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ / dkon mchog thugs rje'i rta bdun gyis drangs pa/ / bstan pa'i gnyen gcig mtshungs bral rgyal ba'i sras/ / mtshan ldan bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i yi dam chos srung dang / /dkon mchog rnam gsum bden pa chen po'i mthus/ / mchog sprul dam pa bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / / bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 370

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyisgor/tshugs gyur cig / phul byung mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin phung po las/ / zab rgyas chos kyi gru char 'jo ba yis/ / thar 'dod zhing pa'i tshogs kyi re skong zhing / srid zhi'i dge mtshan chu gter rgyas gyur cig / skye ba'i 'phreng bar bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ / rjes bzung gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud myang ste/ / yang dag lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ / mkha' mnyam lus can kun gyi mgon gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed chas pa rgya mkhar sprul pa'i sku sogs kyis bskul ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /phun tshogs dge legs lung rtogs nor bu'i mdzod/ / bgrang yas thar 'dod thar par 'khrid pa'i gnyen/ / blo bzang bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa/ / smra ba'i nyi ma lus can gtsug na rgyal/ / dag pa'i sar gnas srid zhi mnyam nyid du/ / gzigs shing smon lam pha rol phyin rdzogs pas/ /gang 'dul sprul pa'i bkod pa chu zla bzhin/ / ston mdzad rgyal sras chen por gsol ba 'debs/ / dus mthar thub bstan yang snying phyogs kyi mthar/ /spel ba'i thugs bskyed bzang po'i rtsal rdzogs pas/ / rmad byung don gnyis dga' ston lhun gyis grub/ / bzang po don grub zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / bkra shis dge mtshan cha shas yongs gang zhing / / lhun grub 'phrin las 'od dkar dra ba yis/ / chos srid kun da'i dga' tshal rgyas mdzad pa/ / bkra shis lhun grub zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / spong ba bsam gtan 'khor lo la gnas shing / / khyad par zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis/ / grub pa mchog brnyes rtogs pa klong du gyur/ / za khu sgom rdon zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / blo gter 'jam mgon lugs bzang mdo sngags kyi/ / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs shing lus can rnams/ / phan 371

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'izlaname'i gsung ཿma/bde'i dga' ston dpal la sbyor mdzad pa/ / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / rnam dag bslab gsum bdud rtsis rgyud gtams shing / / sde snod gsum gyi legs bshad dga' ston spel/ / 'jam dpal gzhon nus rjes bzung ngag gi dbang / / 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ / spel phyir 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i gru gzings kyis/ / rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son pa/ / blo bzang 'phrin las zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / slar yang nges legs sbrang rtsi'i snying po can/ / bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i phyir/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam rol sprul pa'i sku/ /blo bzang nyi ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / dbang phyogs skal ldan gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ / zab rgyas gdams pa'i dga' ston mchog sbyin zhing / / thub bstan mi nub rgyal mtshan sgreng mdzad pa/ / rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog / bla ma yi dam mchog gsum mtha' dag dang / / ring nas bsten pa'i chos srung rgya mtsho'i mthus/ / 'dren mchog dam pa bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / / 'phrin las nor 'dzin kun tu rgyas gyur cig / rnam dag khrims ldan mdo sngags lung rigs kyi/ /dbyangs snyan sgogs pa'i mkhas pa'i skye bo yis/ / sde 'di yongs gang bstan pa'i bya ba kun/ / mi nyams srid mtha'i bar du rgyas gyur cig / mdor na rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs brtan cing / / dge 'dun thugs mthun bshad sgrub gong du 'phel/ / yul ljongs dge mtshan dpal gyis phyug pa yi/ / bkra shis dbyangs snyan sa gsum khyab gyur cig / ces 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa stag lung sprul pa'i sku blo bzang nyi ma'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs 'di ni/ bstan pa'i gsal byed se ra paṇḍi ta'i sprul pa'i sku ye shes chos bzang 372

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/grags pa/ tho'u zidon grub seng ge nang so don grub rab brtan/ chos rje blo bzang snyan grags/ dgon pa'i las sne grwa bgres rnams dang bcas spyi tshogs nas bskul ngor/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes gsungs pa'o/ /kun bzang rgyal sras spyod pa'i zlos gar 'bum/ / dge ldan bstan pa'i rgyan du legs sgyur ba/ / thar 'dod skye dgu'i 'dren pa bla na med/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / dge ldan lugs bzang byang nas byang gi mthar/ / spel ba'i thugs bskyed yang nas yang goms pas/ /dam pa'i 'khrungs rabs gcig nas gcig brgyud de/ / 'gro ba'i ded dpon mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / blo gros rab yangs kun tu dga' ba'i tshal/ / bshad sgrub 'phrin las padma 'bum bzhad cing / / thub bstan snying po'i 'bras bzang g.yur du za/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso la gsol ba 'debs/ / gang gi rmad byung thugs bskyed me shel khams/ / dkon mchog thugs rje'i mkha' la rnam rol pas/ / thub bstan sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rgyas mdzad pa/ / mtshungs med mchog sprul dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / rmad byung 'phrin las 'od rnon 'bum phrag gis/ / dge legs 'dzin ma'i khor yug gsal byed cing / / bslab gsum rtsal ldan lung rigs dbyangs sgrogs pa'i/ / rkang drug 'dus pa'i sde chen gang gyur cig / gang gi zhabs rdul mchod pa lhur len pa'i/ / 'khor slob sbyin pa'i bdag po mtha' dag kyang / / phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ / chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor rgyas gyur cig / ljongs 'dir nad mug 'khrug rtsod kun zhi zhing / / sa dbang 'khor bcas tshe dpal mnga' thang rgyas/ / kun kyang dge bcu'i dpal la spyod pa yis/ / bkra shis dge mtshan rtag tu rgyas gyur cig / ces byang phyogs bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen nyid tsheng yer ti ni megen hu thog 373

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung ཿma/thu dkon mchog thub bstan rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs brtan smon tshig 'di ni blo gros dang lhag bsam phul du byung ba zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pas bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /dngosagrub kun 'byung thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / / dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ / dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / bdud dpung ma lus 'joms mdzad gsang ba'i bdag /rmongs pa'i 'jigs 'phrog khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon/ / rgyal kun 'phrin las sgrub mdzad sgrol ma yum/ / gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha ba/ /blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i zhal snga nas gsungs so/ /bsru med dkon mchog thugs rje gcig bsdus nas/ / mkhas shing grub pa'i bshes gnyen rnam rol te/ / bstan pa'i sgron me 'dzin la zla med pa/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ / yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho spro bsdu'i bdag / bla ma lha yis 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / mdo dang sngags kyi lam bzang rim bgrod nas/ / bde chen sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa 'di ni dge slong dkon mchog dar rgyas kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rgyalakun ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba yis/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje mthar byed pa/ / 'jam dpal rdo rje mi yi zlos gar mkhan/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang bor gsol ba 'debs/ / dge ldan mdo sngags bstan pa'i gnad kun la/ / 'jam mgon bla ma nyid dang dbyer med pa/ /'dzam gling mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ / rnam dag bslab gsum nor bus yongs su 374

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/gtams/ / 'khor lo gsum gyi rlabs phreng ches cher g.yo/ / thar 'dod klu dbang tshogs kyi nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ / blo gros rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / mdo rgyud man ngag gdams pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ / zla bral grub pa'i go 'phang mchog brnyes nas/ / bgrang yas gdul bya smin cing grol mdzad pa/ / blo bzang bkra shis zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / dmigs med snying rje'i rtsa ba las thon pa'i/ / bshad sgrub rtsibs stong rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo yis/ / thub bstan nor 'dzin khyon la mnga' bsgyur ba/ /'jigs med dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / zla bral bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung / / rgya chen gzhung mang thos pa'i pha rol son/ / legs bshad bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed la mkhas/ / dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mer gsol ba 'debs/ / deng nas brtsams te skye zhingaskye ba ru/ / dam pa rnams kyis 'bral med rjes 'dzin zhing / / bka' bzhin sgrub pa snying por byed pa yis/ / mtha' yas legs tshogs rtsa ba tshugs par shog / thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs sngon 'gro bas/ / gsang ba mchogagi lam du smin byas nas/ / sku gsum go 'phang bde blag mngon gyur te/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba srid las sgol bar shog / mdor na mchog gsum bdag nyid bla ma dang / / yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i thugs rje'i mthus/ / ji ltar smon pa'i rnam dkar 'bras bu kun/ / gegs med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa 'di ni khya dge legs bshad gling nas rnam dpyod yangs pa'i dge bskos phun tshogs rgya mtsho dang dbu mdzad ngag dbang bsam gtan gnyis kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'o /dkon mchog rin chen thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings ngos/ / lung rigs 375

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/'od brgya 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis/ / thub bstan pad tshal bzhad pa'i dpal yon can/ / 'gro ba'i sgron me mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'di yang rje nyid kyi gsung ngo / /blo bzang thub bstan padma dkar po'i tshal/ / 'jigs med rnam dpyod nyi ma'i 'od snang gis/ / rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu rgyas mdzad pa/ / rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog / phul byung mkhyen rab gser gyi shing rta yis/ / mdo sngags thub bstan yongs rdzogs nor bu'i dpya/ /drangs te thar 'dod yongs kyi re skong ba'i/ / rnam dkar bzhed don lhun gyes 'grub par shog / gang gi mdzad bzang sprin gyi sgra dbyangs dang / /lhan cig 'dus pa'i sde chen mdongs mtha'i tshogs/ / bshad sgrub gtos bzang 'dzin pa'i 'jo sgeg gis/ / dge ldan bstan pa'i dga' tshal mdzes gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni 7skyabs mgon mchog nas dbus su gsan sbyong gi bzhed don 'grub pa'i smon tshig cig dgos zhes lhag bsam rnam dpyod yangs pa ja rong tho yon 'jigs med 'jam dbyangs kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /na mo gu ru shrī ma hā ka lā ya/ / shes bya kun la khyab pa'i mkhyen pa/ /lus can yongs la brtse ba'i snying rje/ / zung du 'jug pa bsru med skyabs mchog / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / bdag dang pha ma rigs drug 'gro kun/ / 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs las sgrol ba'i/ / mgon skyabs re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ / / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / rnyed dka' lan cig thob pa'i dal 'byor/ / de ring phan chad stong par zad do/ / tshe lhag chos kyis don ldan nus par/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / longs spyod gnyen 'bangs thams 376

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyiskor/cad bskyur kyang / / de dang 'brel ba'i sdig ltung khur nas/ / rang nyid gcig pu phyi mar 'gro tshe/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / yun ring 'grogs pa'i lus sems gnyis kyang / / 'chi bdag bdud kyis so sor phral te/ / rten med rnam shes rlung gis khyer tshe/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / rgyus med bar do'i srid par 'khyams shing / / 'khrul snang gshin rje'i 'jigs pas bdas te/ / rang nyid ci bya gtol med gyur tshe/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / skye shi'i 'khrul 'khor srid pa'i 'phrang ring / / thar med ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sar/ / mi dge'i las kyi gom stabs 'khyor tshe/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / sgo gsum bag med spyod tshul 'di yis/ / skye gnas ngan song gsum las ma 'das/ / de yi sdug bsngal bzod glags med pas/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / mtha' klas rgyal po'i gan mdzod bzhin du/ / shes rgyud gang ba sdeg pa'i phung po/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chab kyis byang bar/ dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / blo snying dkon mchog gsum la gtad de/ / las 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin sgrub pas/ / ngan song ngan 'gro'i skye sgo khegs par/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / 'khor ba'i bde 'bras ci tsam thob kyang / / ma ngoms bzhin du dbang med 'dor dgos/ / bsru brid btson ra 'di las thar par/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig /yang yang drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rnams/ / sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba'i tshul la/ / bcos min snying rjes phan pa bsgrub par/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / rgyal sras spyod la dpa' ba'i snying stobs/ / srid pa'i rtsa ba 'byin pa'i shes rab/ / zung 'brel lam bzang 377

sa / /gung bang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/mngon du 'gyur bar/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig /snyingaga'i 'dab brgyad ju ti'i dbus su/ / gang gi thugs rje'i nyi 'od lhung bas/ / tha mal kun rtog mun pa sangs par/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjesagazigs shig / spyan ras gzigs dbang zhi khro'i go 'phang / / mngon du byas nas mkha' mnyam 'gro kun/ / gtan bder 'god pa'i nus pa rnyed par/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung / / skyabs gsum kun 'dus ngo bor bltas te/ /gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs so/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / mdor na skyid sdug legs nyes kun la/ / khyod min re sa gzhan na med do/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes gzigs shig / ces bla ma mgon po dbyer med la 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs las sgrol ba'i phyir du gdung dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs pa lam gyi lus dang 'brel ba 'di ni dad brtson rnam dpyod yangs pa 'jam dbyangs phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes ser lung la rtsar bris pa'o/ /phul byung legs bshad zab mo'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ / sa gsum dkyil 'khor kun khyab bag yod pa'i/ / spyod tshul ma smad g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / / dge legs chu gter snying bo rgyal gyur cig / byin rlabs nyi ma'i gdengs ka mtho/ / man ngag rgya mtsho'i mjing la gnas/ / lhag bsam gser gyi rang bzhin can/ / bshes gnyen lhun po'i drung na mdzes/ / cher rlom ri bo'i phreng ba yis/ / ma bzung mang du thos pa'i chab/ / 'dun ldan thugs kyi gshong bu ru/ / lung rigs wu ba 'dzum zhing 'khyil/ / tshul bzhin dpyod pa'i ral gri yis/ / the tshom dra ba ma lus pa/ / gcig car bcad 378
