༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/pa'i rno rgyun gyis/ / srid pa'i btson ra shig shig 'dar/ / las 'bras ma 'cholagom stabs can/ / nges 'byung shugs kyis bgrod byed cing / / rgyal srasaspyod pa'i khur 'dzin pa'i/ / glang po lam gyi rim par 'gro/ / don dang ma 'brel 'byam bshad dang / / gzhung dang ma 'brel snyan tshig kun/ /brgal brtag me lha'i zhal zas su/ / stob pa'i blo gros rnam par dag /dpal 'byor khur gyis dub rnams kyis/ / ring du dor bya'i dbang khrid lung / / nor bu'i do shal ma lus pa/ / khyod kyi mgrin par lhan cig 'dril/ / dbyangs can ngag gi longs spyod la/ / dbang mdzad de yi zhal gyi sgor/ / blo gsal tshogs kyi re ba'i mig / bu lon chags pa bzhin du gtod/ / gsang chen chos kyi chu klung brgya/ / 'dus pa 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho cher/ / dam tshig rkya ba 'dzin mkhas der/ / rim gnyis nor bu lag rtser gnas/ / ji ltar bstan pa 'dzin byed pa'i/ / yan lag kun rdzogs khyod lta bu/ / gang las 'byung de dbus 'gyur du/ / mtshon byed grags pa'i mtshan ma yin/ / de slad smra ba'i seni khyod/ / thar 'dod mgon du rtag brtan cing / / rgyal ba'i bstan dang chabs gcig par/ / bzang po'i 'phrin las rgyas gyur cig / ces mdo smad bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgyud pa slob zur dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni/dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dkon mchog mkhyen rab kyis bskul bar brten/ deng dus che mtho'i rigs la 'ud kyis bstod pa lta bu ma yin par/ mkhas pa'i yon tan mthong ste rang bzhin bajod pa'i tshig gis gzengs bstod pa sngon byon dam pa'i lugs srol bzhin du mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dge ba can btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa 'di'ang blo dang ldan pa rnams chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rgyur gyur cig /stobs bcu'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i nyin mor byed/ / lung rtogs 379

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/'od kyi dra ba 'bum 'gyed pas/ / rig grol 'dab 'phreng bzhad pa'i pad tshal bcas/ / sa gsum dge legs snang bas khyab gyur cig / ring nas thugs bskyed brtsan po'i go bgos te/ / 'phags bod kun tu skye ba'i rnam rol gyis/ / rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho la/ / bslab pa'i ngo mtshar bkod pa bsam mi khyab/ / khyad par blo bzang rgyal ba'i chos tshul kun/ /thos bsam sgom pas ji bzhin legs rtogs nas/ / rtse gcig sgrub pas gtan bde'i mchog brnyes pa/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / zab rgyas man ngag spyan stong lha yi dbang / / thub bstan rin chen sa 'dzin rtser 'gying zhing / / skal bzang lha brgya'i tshogs kyi gnyen gyur pa/ / dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ / dkon mchog rgyal ba'i chos mdzod mdo sngags bstan/ / 'dzin phyir slar yang thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ / 'gro la dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs pa/ / mtshungs med mchog sprul dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / yi dam mchog gsum rgya mtsho'i thugs rje'i dpung / / rlabs chen thugs bskyed mthu dang bsgril ba yis/ / 'dren mchog dam pa'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / / don gnyis mdzad bzang lhun gyis grub gyur cig / tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i tshangs skud thogs/ / zab gsang ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i ril ba sbrengs/ / shes rab 'od 'bar sbyin sreg la brtson pa'i/ / drang srong tshogs kyis sde 'di yongs gang shog / ring nas rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos pa'i/ / rdo rje'i g.yar dam lhur mdzad srung tshogs kyis/ / bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod sde dang bcas/ / rtag tu srung skyob 'azin las g.yel med mdzod/ / mdor na deng nas byang chub gnas thob par/ / 'dren pa mchog gis dgyes bzhin rjes 'dzin zhing / / yang dag lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ / mtha' 380

༄/ /bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyisgor/yas 'gro kun 'dren pa'i dpal gyur cig / ces bstan pa'i gsal byed lung bzanganang sprul sku rin po che'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs 'di ni mang thos sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa blo bzang dkon mchog gis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /blo chen kun bzang thugs bskyed dpal dang ldan/ / bsod nams ye shesatshogs gnyis dkyil 'khor rgyas/ / thub dbang bstan pa'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen/ / mtshungs med 'gro ba'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ / mngon mtho cho rigs gtsang ma'i ma la yar/ / legs 'khrungs dpal 'byor yal ga'i phyogs rdzogs kyang / / nges 'byung dri bzhon g.yo ba'i tshul khrims kyi/ / dad ldad 'dul 'dzin chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /mar gyur 'gro ba'i ngang tshul zla snang 'bum/ / gsal 'char snying rje ma dros mtshorasprin pa'i/ / rin chen sems mchog gser bzang 'od 'bar ba/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i sgor zhugs te/ / dngos grub rtsa ba dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung / / rim gnyis bde stong ting 'dzin mchog la gzhol/ / rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / zab yangs mkhyen rab gting mtha' bral ba'i ngogs/ / lung rigs rlabs kyi phreng ba 'bum 'gyed kyang / / mang thos chu klung bye bas mi ngoms pa/ / smra ba'i dbang phyug mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / bshad sgrub nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa yi/ / rnam dag tshul khrims kun gsal me long ngos/ / nyes ltung rnyog pa'i sprin gyis ma gos pa/ / bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / yul dus tha mar bstan pa'i khur bzung nas/ / dge 'dun spel zhing chos spyod rnam pa bcu'i/ / 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang lhun gyis grub/ / 'gro ba'i 38/

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/ 'dren mchog dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / bla ma yi dam dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / spyi dang tshe yi mchog sbyin lha rnams mthus/ / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ / zhabs zung g.yo med rdo rje ltar brtan shog / gang gi 'phrin las rtsibs stong 'khor lo yis/ / thub bstan 'dzin ma'i gzhi la mnga' bsgyur ba'i/ / dge mtshan 'gog pa med pa'i gzi byin gyis/ / chos srid rdzogs ldan dga' ston rgyas gyur cig / bdag sogs kun kyang mtho ris yon tan gyi/ / dpal yon rdzogs pa'i rten bzang rim brgyud de/ /'bral med bshes gnyen dam pas rjes 'dzin cing / / yang dag lam bzang gegs med bgrod gyur cig / bla ma mchog gi zhabs pad rtag brtan cing / / sde 'dir bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas pa dang / / mi dbang sder bcas mnga' thang dar ba yi/ / phun tshogs dge mtshan rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / ces bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rtsa lag dam par gyur ba blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes bstan pa'i mgon po'i zhabs brtan smon tshig dang bcas pa 'di ni/ mi pham chos gling gi dge bskos ku shri grags pa bzang po/ bla brong phyag mdzod chos rje ngag dbang shes rab/ spyi so'i sde pa nang so ngag dbang bstan 'dzin sogs 'dus spyi nas dngul gyi maṇḍal/ gos yug lha dar bcas bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /bde mchog bla brgyud kyi kha skong ni/ blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa dang / / dbyer med chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhabs/ / kun mkhyen sangs rgyas bkra shis la/ / gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ / zab rgyas man ngag mdzod 'dzin pa/ / blo bzang ngag gi dbang po dang / / smin grol chos kyi rgyal po la/ / gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ / bgrang yas skal ldan gdul bya'i tshogs/ / smin mdzad ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dang / / grub 382

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyi skor/mchog dngos grub rgya mtsho la/ / gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /nyams rtogs yon tan mthar son pa/ / 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje dang / / gnubs ston bzhad pa'i rdo rje la/ / gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ / dge ldan bstan pa'i gnyen gcig pa/ / kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po dang / / rje btsun bstan pa'i sgron me la/ / gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ / nged las dngos su thob pa rnams ni rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs/ te ru ka dpal zhes sogs kyis 'thus shing / sa lugs ma gtogs pa'i bka' bab gzhan lnga yod pa dang / skyabs mgon de nyid nas gzhan 'ga' las kyang gsan 'dug cing / nged kyis yongs 'dzin rin po che'i mdun nas kyang thob pa sogs 'dir ma zebs pa'i brgyud pa'ang mang stabs/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po sogs/ / brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog rnams la/ zhes bsgyur na bde'o/ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i brgyud 'debs kha skong ni/ thub bstan srog shing 'jigs med dbang po'i sde/ / lam 'di'i bka' bab chos kyi rdo rje'i zhabs/ / thar lam gsal mdzad bstan pa'i sgon me la/ / gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ / zhes pa'o/ /'jigs byed bla brgyud gsol 'debs kyi kha skong ni/ sku gsum mngon gyur rgyal ba dben sa pa/ / lung rtogs mnga' bdag sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ / gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang / / bstan pa'i rtsa lag bstan 'dzin 'azin las zhabs/ / rig 'dzin chen po 'jam dbyangs grags pa la/ / gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ / kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde/ /383

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/'jigs mdzad mngon gyur blo bzang shes rab dang / / grub pa'i dbang phyug bde ba'i rdo rje la/ / gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /lung rtogs mnga' bdag dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / / rigs kun khyab bdag 'jigs med dbang po'i sde/ / bka' drin mtshungs bral bstan pa'i sgron me la/ / gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ / zhes so/ / lhun grub 'phrin las 'od zung gsum gyi gur/ / tshe dang ye shes utpal gyis gtams par/ / skal bzang skye bo bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa/ / bcom ldan yid bzhin 'khor lor gsol ba 'debs/ / ngag gi dbang phyug nas brgyud jo bo lugs/ / sa lugs rdo rje gdan pa'i brgyud pa dang / / bka' bab gsum pa kha che paṇa chen brgyud/ / bzhi pa a bhya kā ra'i brgyud pa dang / /paṇa chen ma ti brgyud pa gnyan lo'i lugs/ / ni ska li ga nas brgyud dpyal lugs dang / / bdun pa rngog lugs mar pa lo tsā'i brgyud/ / rol pa'i rdo rje nye brgyud sgar lugs dang / / dgu pa paṇa chen nags rin brgyud pa ste/ / bka' bab dgu yi brgyud pa rim byon nas/ / ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i bar/ / gdams pa'i srol 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang lhun grub zhabs/ / kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde/ / mang thos mthar son dge 'dun rgya mtsho ste/ / mkhas grub chen po gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ / rigs kun khyab bdag 'jigs med dbang po dang / / spangs rtogs mthar son chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs/ / thub bstan gsal mdzad bstan pa'i sgon me ste/ / bka' drin mtshungs med gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ / bla ma yi dam dbyer med thugs rje'i sprin/ / mkhyen brtse'i gdengs ka 'bum du dar ba las/ / byin rlabs char rgyun 'dzad med 'jo ba yis/ / re ba'i zhing sa yongs su smin par 384

༄/ / bstod tshogs gsol 'debs kyiskor/mdzod/ / dus min 'chi ba'i g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba mthar phyin cing / / ltos bcas skal bzang skye bo mtha' dag kyang / / 'chi med dga' ston dpal la sbyor gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni bzang po'i bag chags kyi mthu brtas pa ta le'i chos rje zhabs drung dkon mchog rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sher seng dang / / 'dul 'dzin chen po blo gros sbas pa'i zhabs/ / sde snod gsum 'dzin ye shes rtse mo ste/ /thub bstan rtsa lag gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ / zab lam mngon gyur skyabs mchog dpal bzang dang / / zung 'jug sar gshegs rgyal ba dben sa pa/ / mkhas shing grub brnyes sangs rgyas ye shes te/ / thar pa'i sa mkhan gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ / blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa chos rgyan zhabs/ / de sras thu bo brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan dang / / sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang blo gros te/ / skye dgu'i 'dren mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ / smra ba'i khyu mchog blo bzang shes rab dang / / rnal 'byor dbang phyug dge 'dun bkra shis zhabs/ / spangs rtogs mthar son ngag dbang blo bzang ste/ / bka' drin zla med gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ / dus mthar mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ / thub bstan mi nub rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa la/ / thugs bskyed zla bral 'jigs med dbang po'i sde/ / drin can rtsa ba'ibla mar gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes lam rim chung ngu'i bshad lung gi brgyud 'debs kha skong 'di ni/ bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po dus 'khor slob zur dkon mchog dar rgyas pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jigs med dbang bo'i zhabs/ / slar yang 385

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/thugs rjes sprul ba'i gar mdzad pa/ / rje btsun blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i sde/ / gdung 'tshob dam pa khri chen rnam gnyis bcas/ / mtshungs med yab sras rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs bcag / kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin 'di legs 'bul zhing / / sdig ltung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / / bdag sogs mgon du bskal brgyar rtag bzhugs nas/ / zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo legs bskor te/ / phyin ci log gi blo sna kun gzhom zhing / / yang dag lam bzang bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ / bla ma yi dam mchog gsum 'dus pa'i dngos/ / skyabs kyi dam pa khyod min gzhan med pas/ / byang chub bar du dgyes bzhin rjes 'dzin cing / / rtag tu khyod mnyes 'ba' zhig sgrub par shog / skye ba kun tu zhes sogs bya/ zhes pa 'di ni nyams len la mchog tu brtson pa ri khrod pa ngag dbang dkon mchog gis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /386

sa / /deb rgyanasna tshogs/༄7/ / dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi deb yig mgo rgyan phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i rol mtsho sogs deb rgyan sna tshogs bzhugs/༄7/ / dge legs dngos po srid dang zhi ba yi/ / rgyud du dar ba yongs kyis gus bsten gnas/ / stobs bcu'i shugs kyis yid srub las rgyal mgon/ / dpal ldan rigs kun bdag pos dge legs stsol/ /thugs bskyed sngo bsangs sde la gsang chen gyi/ / sprin 'phreng lta ba'i bde 'thung rgyas pa can/ / rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhabs dang sher seng sogs/ /'khor lo'i mgon po rim byon phyag gi yul/ / khyad par 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i mdo sngags kyi/ / pad tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen gcig rdo rje 'chang / /'jigs med dbang por mtshan gsol rgyal kun gye/ / 'dus zhal thugs rje'i bdag nyid gtsug na mdzes/ / blo bzang chos kyi gsang mdzod 'dzin pa yi/ / grags pa don mthun grub pa'i dpa' bo sogs/ / sde 'di 'khor lo gsum gyis skyong mdzad pa'i/ / bshes gnyen rim byon bka' drin rjes su dran/ / slar yang blo bzang mkhyen pa'i zla shel thugs bskyed cha shas yongs gang zhing / / thub bstan kun da'i gnyen gyur 'jigs med rnam dpyod bsil zer dra ba can/ / skyabs gcig dam pa'i 'phrin las 'dus sde'i bshad sgrub srid zhi'i phun tshogs kun/ / chabs cig rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu rgyas pa'i dge legs mchog sbyin mdzod/ / skal bzang bsod nams ka 387

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/shi'i ras bzang ngos/ / yab rje'i thugs bskyed pir gyis bris pa las ma tshang med pa'i dge mtshan mtha' dag tu/ / 'char bzod byed po'i ri mo yongs su smin/ / mtha' drug tshul bzhis rgyas btab rdo rje theg / bshad sgrub dpung pas 'dzin la mthun pa'i rkyen/ / ji snyed mkho dgus bskyangs pa'i drin gyi khur/ / rjes 'jug phrag par lce yang bkur ba'i 'os/ / rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig gi/ / re kha thod du bcings pa'i srung ma'i tshogs/ / spyi dang khyad par sngags 'chang bka' srung gtso/ / dam can skyes bu chen po 'khor bcas la/ / sde 'di'i chos srid longs spyod bya ba kun/ /snying nas bcol lo gnyer ro bdag mdzad de/ / bsam spyor log pa'i dgra sde gzhom pa dang / / mthun rkyen 'dod dgu'i legs tshogs char du snyil/ /ces dge legs su byed pa'i gtam gyis thog drangs te gleng bar bya ba ni/kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes grags pa'i gdugs dkar srid zhi'i bla na 'khor ba de nyid kyis yi dam lha'i lung bstan bzhin mdo smad kyi ljongs 'dir rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde 'di nyid dang dgon lung gi rgyud grwa gnyis btab ste gsang chen bstan pa dar ba'i byin rlabs dang rten 'brel gyi sgo phyes/ grub dbang sde khri rin po che'i bka' drin la brten nas 'dir chos srid kyi rkang tshugs shing / de nas skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang pos 'khor lo gsum ma tshang ba med pa'i sgo nas yun ring du bskyangs te/ da lta spyir rgyud sde rab 'byams dang / sgos su gsang bde 'jigs gsum ya ma bral ba'i 'chad nyan lad mo tsam ma yin par rgyud don man ngag gis phye bas mtha' chod pa dang / dpal ldan smad rgyud ltar gyi 'grig lam phra zhib/ cho ga phyag len/'don rta dbyangs sogs sgo gang thad nas bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan du 'gyur 388

༄/ / deb rgyanasna tshogs/nges pa/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchod rdzas rol cha dbang chas sogs kyi skor dang / nye bar mkho ba'i phyi nang gi yo byad/gdan cha/ thab cha sogs kyi skor/ phog ja tshul thebs kyi spyi rdzas/ su rug zhing sa dang bcas pa gang sa nas gzhan la 'gram chu ldang mi dgos par phun sum tshogs pa 'di bzhin la/ slan chad kyang snga mas bsgrigs bzhag pa 'di chud ma zos pa'i steng nas yar tshes kyi zla ba bzhin gong 'phel du gtong dgos/ /'on kyang deb snga ma gong 'og 'dzol cha dang 'byin 'jug ha cang mang bas rdzob por song skyon gyis deb rang la cha bzhag mi chog par so so'i kha la ltos dgos stabs/ la las spyi don khur len gyi lhag bsam gtsang mas zhib thigs su byed na'ang / 'ga' zhig rig pa rtsang bas chal chol du 'gro ba dang /'ga' zhig las 'bras go log gis gzhung don steng nas mi bzang byed pa dang /'ga' zhig rang 'dod phyogs lhung gi rdzun 'phong 'gebs pa sogs 'then khyer sna tshogs pas mtho dman hang song che ba yong gin 'dug gshis/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i bgrang bya gsum pa dkar po zhes pa sa mo sbrul gyi lo dpon slob khri thog pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho/ bla ma dbu mdzad dkon mchog dbang phyugabla brang sku tshab/ grwa tshang gi las sne/ dge rgan bzhi bcas 'dzom thog nas zhib dpyod kyis deb gsar bsgrig 'di bzhin bgyis pa yin/ 'phral du bkol dgos rnams dang po nas mdo phugs 'byed pa ma gtogs/ deb chen du thebs phyin de la gras rgyag pa grwa sa chen po'i lugs srol la med pas phyin chad rtsis sprod thams cad 'di ga sor bzhag byed dgos/ rtsis sprod skabs debakyi sa khungs ma stongs pa kho nas mi chog par/ rgyun du'ang rang rang la gang bab kyi do dam le shor med pa gal che bas/ sku gsung thugs rten rnams la snad ma zhugs pa'i rdul phyis/ phan tshun kun tu mchod pa/ sgrub mchod 389

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/sogs skabs so sor gal che chung dang bstun nas mchod rdzas rab 'bring tha ma'i rim pas bsham tshul/ rnga rol sogs bkram sdud skabs skyon yod med lta ba/ tshe 'bar rkang du yod rgyun ma chad pa dgos pas mtshan mo me zon gzab pa/ phan tshun gang du'ang sdod mkhan med skabs sgo phyes nas mi 'jog par sgo lcags rgyag rgyu/ 'du khang gi phyi nang thams cad la gad dar/ steng gi wa kha thigs tshags gdan cha yol ba thug sogs kyi bzo btsem/ sa rtsi dkar dmar nag gsum/ rdo yab dang pu shu'i kha sogs gso ba/ btsan khang du gang byung migatong zhing mchod pa bsang rdzas sogs gtsang sbra thon nges/ rung khang du yangagatsang sbra dang tsha grang chu tshod shin tu thig pas dad rdzas dge 'dun gye zebs su 'gro nges pa/ spyi pas kyang gtong sgo gang dgos sngar rgyun ma nyams pa dang / lhag par rgyun ja grwa ba'i rkyen theg nges gal che bas rnam pa kun tsu so so nas theg pa khur blang dang / las sne mos ngo dga' zol 'jog tu ma song bar legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin ma lhod pa nyi ma gcig la cha bzhag pa lta bu zhig byed dgos/ de la dkon gnyer gye rtsis sprod sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod rdzas kyi skor/ ja ma'i rtsis sprod btsan khang dang rung khang gi skor/gnyer ba'i rtsis sprod spyi rdzas kyi skor dang gsum/ ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba snang ba'i mdzod/ / nyon mongs 'ching brgya gcod pa'i 'od rnon zer/ / theg gsum rnam grol 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i gnyen/ / bu ram shing pas dus kun dge legs stsol/ / blo bzang dkyil 'khor mkhyen brtse'i ri dwags gzugs/ / grags pa bsil zer byed pa'i phreng ba yis/ / thub bstan chu gter mdo sngags rlabs phreng gi / rol pas nor 'dzin khyon yangs shis pas skyongs/ / 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu'i rol pa'i lding khang na/ / blo gros lang tsho bzhad pa'i 'dzum dkar gyis/ / rdo rje dbyings kyi dpal mor rjes chags 390

༄/ / deb rgyan tshogs/pa/ / kun mkhyen bla ma'i zhabs pad gtsug gis mchod/ / ngo mtshar legs byas khyon yangs dbyig ldan du kū la yi ras bzang ngos/ / thugs bskyed sprin sngon pir gyis bris pa'i dge mtshan bar gyi ri mo ni/ / bshad sgrub bya ba rgya chen beeḍūr dag pa'i khams su 'phos pa yi/ / thub bstan dbyar gye lang tsho mi nyams 'jigs med dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ / rnam 'dren nyin mor byed pa gang gi mthu/ / gser bzang 'od kyis bkra ba padmo'i phreng / / dge legs 'dab brgya'i snying po mchog gsum rten/ / mchod pas rdzas bcas sbrang rtsi'i khur gyis mdzes/ / bde chen ye shes rang mdangs sku lnga las/ /gsung gi rgyal bo gnas chung be ha ra/ / la sogs mthu ldan srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ / dus kun g.yel med stangs 'dzin bya ra mdzod/ / khyad par kun gzigs ye shes dri med kyi/ / rang bzhin mchog sprul dam pa'i 'phrin las dang / / chabs gcig chos srid 'byor ba mi zad pa'i/ / dge mtshan yangs pa rtag tu brtan gyur cig / ces shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis sngon bsus te gleng ba skabs kyi don ni/ 'gro ba'i phan bde mtha' dag gi gzhi rten rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyag gcig yin cing / de'i rtsa bar gyur ba ni chos 'dul ba yin la/ de'ang tshul bzhin 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde dang /las thams cad kyi rten gnas mal gyi gzhi sogs la rag las pa'i dbang gis bla ma gong ma rnams kyis kyang dge 'dun gyi sde/ gtsang khang / sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang bcas pa gsar bsgrun nyams gsos sogs kyi sgo nas bstan pa'i rmang gzhi 'dzin par mdzad cing / / khyad par du skyabs mgon thugs rje'i bdag nyid mtshan brjod par dka' ba kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i bka' drin kho na la brten nas/ chos sde chen po 'dir 'dzam gling gi dpal 'byor thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa ltar/ lha rten/ mchod rdzas/391

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 4ma/nyer spyad sogs/ 'du khang chen mo rten dang brten pa cha lag dang bcas gzhan 'gran med pa 'di lta bu byung yang slar nyams chag tu mi 'gyur ba shin tu gal che la/ snga sor gyi deb rnying rnams 'dzol cha che bar 'dug stabs/ sa rta'i zla tshes la rab 'byams pa shes rab rgya mtshos khur blangs thog tshogs 'du lhan rgyas kyis deb gsar du bsgrigs te/ mchod rdzas gsar rnying thams cad lhag lus su mi 'gyur zhing mdzes pa'i ched du/ bzang gras/ 'bring gras/zher ba'i gras/ gsar rnying sogs tshan tshan du bsgrigs te tho bkod pa 'di don ltar gnas shing wa kha thigs tshags steng 'og kun tu res mos kyis mchod 'bul ma chag pa/ phyi nang thams cad du gad dar/ dus tshigs so sor bab 'os kyi mchod rdzas bkram sdud/ tha na gral gdan dang steng 'og gi yol ba'i bzo btsem tshun chod hor khungs su ma lus pa dgos pa'i rting gnon kun gyis 'gan khur bzhes dgos la/ dngos gzhi sku gsung thugs rten/ mchod cha sogs kyi rim pa ni/ zhes dkyus dang sbrel lo/ / dge ldan bkra shis 'khyel gyi 'dukhang chen mo rten dang brten par bcas pa'i deb yig phun tshogs bye ba'i gan mdzod kyi mgo rgyan du stsal ba'o/ /stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' rgyal ba'i nyin mor byed/ / srid pa'i mun 'phrog chos kyi 'od brgya'i rlabs/ / reg pas ldan grol 'dab yangs 'phags tshogs bcas/ / mchog gsum shis pa'i me tog char du snyil/ /phul byung smon lam bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / nad rims gdon sogs snyigs ma'i gdung ba kun/ / bcil nas 'chi med thar pa'i srog sbyin pa/ /bde gshegs bdun gyi bden pas deng 'dir skyongs/ / gang gi thugs bskyed go la'i lam yangs por/ / mdo sngags rig gnas snang byed 'phreng ba kun/ / thub bstan nam mkha'i rgyan du rtag 'char ba/ / yab rje 'jigs 392

༄/ /deb rgyanasna tshogs/med dbang bo'i zhabs la 'dud/ / blo bzang thub bstan yang snying gser gyi ri bo'i spor/ / 'jigs med rnam dpyod gzims par mchog sprul nyi ma'i 'od/ /'dus sde padma'i dga' tshal bshad sgrub sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ / 'gran pa ji bzhin dar ba'i dge mtshan rgyas gyur cig / sngags 'chang bka' srung zangs kyi beg tse can/ / ma hā tsi na'i yul skyong bkwan yun ching / / gso rig skyong mdzad zhing blon dbyer med pas/ / dus rnams kun tu srung skyob bya ra mdzod/ / legs byas dpal yon dar ba'i dga' tshal du/ / 'dren mchog byugs rje'i nyi 'od 'khyil ba yis/ / 'khor lo gsum gyi pad dkar bzhad pa'i bsung / / skal bzang rkang drug yongs kyi gsos su gyur/ / khyad par mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin pa'i phul/ / srog zungs rdo rje'i khams su sgrub pa po/ / gso rig gzhan phan gling gi gtsug lag khang / / brten par bcas pa'i dkar chag 'dir brjod bya/ / de'ang lus can yongs kyi phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yin la/de 'dzin pa'i tshul bshad pa dang sgrub pa zung las ma 'das kyang / bshad sgrub gnyi ga'ang bya ba las kyi 'khor lo la brten dgos pa dam pa'i chos 'dul bar yang gzhi bcu drug gi rjes su de dag rnams kyi rten gnas mal gyi gzhi zhes gsungs shing / don 'di la dgongs te bla ma gong ma rnams kyis kyang dge 'dun gyi sde phyag 'debs dang / de'i gtsug lag khang sku gsung thugs rten dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs sogs bya ba'i 'khor lo 'di la nan tan che bar mdzad do/ / khyad par du skyabs mgon thugs rje'i bdag nyid rje btsun 'jigs med dbang po de nyid kyis bstan 'gro'i don 'ba' zhig thugs la brnag pas grwa tshang 'di nyid kyang gsar du btab ste rig gnas chen po lnga'i ya gyalagazhan rjes su 'dzin pa gso ba rig pa'i lag len gtsor gyur gyi 'chad 393

༄/ /gung thang bstanaba'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/nyan dang sgrig lam la sogs pa'i srol gsar du btsugs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po dus 'khor dpon slob ngag dbang don grub la bka' gnang ste khong gis grwa khang gsar rgyas byas shing / dad pa dang gtong ba'i rgyan gyis spa ba tho yon rab rgyas kyis kyang rten bzhengs spyi rdzas sogs gang ci'i sbyin bdag gi mthil byas/ gzhan yang skyabs mgon mchog gi thugs rje la brten nas phyogs ris med kyi grwa rigs sbyin bdag du mas gus mchod dang blang gis lha rten mchod rdzas sogs gang thad nas phun sum tshogs par yod pa 'di bzhin slad kyang nyams chag tu mi 'gyur ba shin tu gal che bas/ las byed tshang mas khur du blangs te 'du khang gi wa kha thigs tshags/ phyi nang gi gad dar rgyun gyi mchod 'bul dang / skabs skabs kyi mchod rdzas bkram sdud sogs gang la'ang khral chos dang sla chos su ma song bar grwa tshang gi zhabs 'degs su bsam ste tshags su thon nges pa byed dgos/ de la thog mar sku gsung thugs rten gyi rim pa ni/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dam can rdo rje legs pa'i sgo nas sho mo brtag par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis sho rdel gsum rgyu dang ri mo 'god tshul sogs lag len bzhin byas la/ ched dmigs kyi sgrub pa'ang sngon du btang na legs pas rten dang mchod gtor sogs 'du byas te/rten gyi drung du 'bru dkar gyi steng du dar dkar po'i gdan la sho rdel rnams bzhag rang yi dam du gsal bas dam can gyi mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa'i sgo nas bsnyen pa grangs gsog dang / thun gyi mthar sngags kyi mjug tu/ legs nyes kyi blang dor ma lus pa gsal bar ston cig / ces spel tshig btags pa dang ye dhasmo ci 'grub bzla/ srung ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te sho rdel la thim pas blang dor 'khrul med du ston pa'i nus pa dang ldan par byin gyes brlabs pa'i dmigs pa bya/ gtor 'bul sogs 394

༄/ /deb rgyanasna tshogs/dkyus bzhin byas la tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas rab rtags thon gyi bar dang / de min yang zhag grangs ci nus su bsgrubs te gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs dang yid ches kyis blo 'gel thub pa bya/ de rjes lag len la 'debs pa'i tshe/ nub phyogs pha wang long bu'i sku mkhar nas/ / dam can rdo rje legs pa 'khor dang bcas/ / legs nyes blang dor ji bzhin ston pa'i phyir/ / thogs med rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis 'dir gshegs shig / ring nas rtse gcig gus pas khyod bsten cing / / bsnyen sgrub mchod gtor 'bad pa lhur blangs te/ / yid ches brtan pos re ltos 'cha' ba la/ / nam yang bslu ba med pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / bdag cag rnams ni ma rig mun pas bsgribs/ / lha khyod dus gsum gzigs pa'i spyan dang ldan/ / de phyir skog tu gyur ba'i blang dor gnas/ / 'khrul med gsal bar ston cig sa ma ya/ /na mo drin can rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha/ gsang ba sngags kyi bka' srung / dam can skyes bu chen po rdo rje legs pa/ thugs kyi dgyes sde bstan ma bcu gnyis/ 'khor gyi gtso bo ging chen sde bzhi/ btsan 'khor dge bsnyen sum brgya drug cu/ g.yas kyi ru 'dren ma sangs spun dgu/g.yon gyi ru 'dren zur ra skyes drug gzhan yang bka' nyan las byed/ sprul ba yang sprul/ snang zhing srid pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis sngon nas zhal gyis bzhes pa'i rdo rje'i g.yar dam dang /bdag gis mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i don la dgongs te blang dor gyi gnas bdag gis ma shes par khyed rnams la gsol ba btab ste bden pa bdar nas dris pa yin pas ji lta ba bzhin du lung ston cig bzang po ngan 395

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/du ma ston/ ngan pa bzang du ma ston/ legs nyes kyi go ma 'dzol/ nye ring gi dus ma bsnor/ gsang zhing gab sbas ma mdzad par ji lta ba bzhin du bstan nas rmongs pa'i mun pa sol cig the tshom gyi 'ching ba chod cig blo snying bkal ba'i re ba don dang ldan par mdzod cig ces gdung shugs drag pos bden pa bdar te/ oṃ badzra sā ju sa ma ya bhag tram̐ she ni kra ma ṇi sa ma ya sa ju tri dza dza : baṃ ho zhes dang / oṃ badzra sā ju dza zhes ci 'grub bzlas la phu btab/ skabs don gyi ming smos nas ma sbas bar gsal bar lung ston cig ces brjod de ltos pa med par 'phen no/ sho mig gsum par bab na/ zhes pa nas/ lag tu 'byor par nges so/ / zhes pa'i bar gyi sho brtag tshul dngos ni lcags ra sprul sku'i gsung bzhin byas pas 'thus/ de'ang spyir sho mo brtag tshul dam pa gong mas mdzad pa mang du 'dug kyang lcags ra sprul skus mdzad pa 'di lag tu blang bde zhing dgos don thams cad tshang bas 'du che bar brten mdo dbus kun tu dar so che bar snang / der lha mo'i sgo nas brtag rgyu byas 'dug kyang dpyad tshul de nyid gzhir bzhag la gsol 'debs bden brjod sogs rang gis gtso bor bsten pa'i yi dam chos srung gang gi sgo nas byas kyang don 'dra bar ma zad/ 'brel dang yid ches kyi stobs kyis byin rlabs myur khyad lhag par che bas/ dam can rdo rje legs pa srung ma'i gtso bor byed pa rnams ni de'i sgo nas brtag tshul 'di bzhin byas na legs so/ /zhes pa 'di'ang dad stobs kyi rgyan dang ldan pa u rad gung ratna bā las dam can la brten pa'i sho brtag tshul zhig dgos tshul byung bar brten/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa 'dis kyang kun la phan thogs par gyur cig /'gro ba'i bla mar gyur ba sangs rgyas dang / / de yi bstan pa dam pa'i chos yin la/ / de nyid 'dzin byed dge 'dun tshogs yin pas/ / mchog 396

༄/ / deb rgyanasna tshogs/gsum phan bde'i rtsa bar mthong bas 'dud/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas/ / rgyal blon sder bcas chos srid dpal 'byor 'phel/ / dge 'dun thugs mthun dus tshogs bshad sgrub bcas/ / dbyar mtsho lta bur rgyas pa'i byen stsol cig / de'ang rgyal ba'i bstan pa lung rtogs gnyis su nges pas/ de 'dzin pa'i sde'ang mtshan nyid po ti lnga dang rig gnas gtsor gyur gyi bshad grwa dang / rgyud sde bzhi dang lam rim sogs gtsor gyur gyi sgrub grwa gnyis su yod pa las 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas te 'god pa la/'jug pa po rten gyi gang zag dge tshul slong gi sdom ldan/ rtsa ba babla dang chang sogs kyi skyon med nges rab byung gi rtags cha lugs tshang zhing tshogs 'don rags rim blo 'dzin dang / yi ge byang zhing sde 'dir zhugs nas yun ring sdod 'dun can dang chos la don gnyer can zhig dgos/ 'don pa skyabs 'gro ltung bshags/ mdo sgrol gdugs dkar/ smon lam chos spyod/ srung ma'igator chog sogs dgon sde kun tu dar che ba rnams med mi rung yin la/de'i steng du lam rim zhig tshogs 'don du byed rgyu byung na nyin re bzhin rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa la bag chags 'jog pa'i dgos pa shin tu che bas ci nas kyang gtso bor byed dgos/ de'ang legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba bla ma mkhas btsun zung du 'brel ba zhig bla mar bkur la/ de nyid kyis so so'i blo tshod dang mthun par lam rim gye don zhib tu 'khrid cing rtsi bzhag kyang gtong /tshogs 'don du byed tshe yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa/ bla brgyud gsol 'debs/ byin rlabs dpung zhus sogs sbyor chos rgyas bsdus ci rigs sngon du 'gro bas gzhung dngos gzhi nged kyis bris pa de nyid gsung bas 'thus/ zhal 'don gyi rigs dal brel snyoms shing 'don rta dbyangs gang gi tshe'ang dbu mdzad dang mgrin gcig pas dang ba 'dren pa byed/ tshogs kyi 397

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/bzhugs lugs kyang ya yo med pa tshul mthun ma gtogs yar lta mar lta kha btumagazhog gcus hu cag gi sgra long gtam sogs mi byed/ dge tshul slong gang yin kyang rang rang gi bslab bya khrid de 'gro 'dug spyod lam kun tu chos 'dul ba dang mthun pa nyams len gye snying bor byed/ kha 'thab lag 'dzing khe log sogs khyim pa sun 'byin gyi rigs byed mkhan lta bu sgrig 'gal che chung la ltos pa'i rtsad gcod las byed rnams nas btang snyoms su ma lus pa byed/ bla ma las sne bslab pa rgan pa yon tan can la bkur gzos sogs ya rabs kye tshul dang mthun pa byed/ rang gi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs la bsam ste tshogs chos grwar phebs lugs sogs las sne'i ngag bkod dang len bya/ mdor na bya ba thams cad las 'bras dang sdom gsum bcas mtshams gzhir bzhag pas tshe rabs gtan gyi mdun ma mi 'chug cing / yul phyogs kyi bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i grogs su 'gyur ba zhig ci nas kyang mdzod mdzod/ 'di don bzhin byed pa rnams la nged kyis kyang yi dam chos srung rgya mtshor rnam dkar smon pa bzhin 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs kyi 'phrin las bcol ba byed/ ces pa 'di ni so lon ku lu khu khu'i shog gi dgon pa bkra shis chos gling du 'grig lam sngar rgyun gyi thog lam rim gsar tshugs dang bcas pa'i bca' khrims yi ger 'khod pa zhig dgos zhes gu shrī tā bla ma dkon mchog ye shes kyis lhag bsam dag pas bskul ba bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dgas bgyis pas kun la dge bar gyur cig /398

༄/ /dben gnasayid dga' chos 'dzin gyi bca' yig༄༅/ / dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi bca' yig yang dag sgrub pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo gu ru mu nī rdo ya/ gang la brten na srid dang zhi ba'i 'jigs pa kun 'phrog cing / / ting 'dzin shes rab 'bras bcas yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ / tshul khrims phung po yongs su rdzogs pa mnyam med dge sbyong che/ / thub pa'i dbang po'i zhabs sen bdud rtsi'i 'od kyis shis pas skyongs/ / zab rgyas mdo dang mngon pa'i bka' babs ma pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / chos 'dul bstan pa'i rin chen mdzod 'dzin 'phags pa'i gnas brtan tshogs/ / bshad sgrub snang bas sa gsum khyab mdzad rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ / 'phags yul mkhas dang grub pa'i tshogs rnams kun la gus pas 'dud/ / tshul gnyis gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan phul byung zhabs/ / ston pa chen po thugs sras sku mched gsum dang glang shar sogs/ / lha chos bdun ldan rnam thar la gnas bka' gdams gong ma sogs/ / gangs can ljongs 'dir sngon byon skyes mchog de kun dang bas mchod/ / khyad par rgyal bstan ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur pa na/ / snying stobs chen pos nyi ltar gsal mdzad rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhabs/ / sras mchog rnams dang de yi sku 'phreng gdan rabs rim byon sogs/ / gser mdog cod paṇa 'chang ba'i bstan 'dzin ma lus phyag gi 399

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/yul/ / 'jam dbyangs dgyes bzhad sto bzang 'od 'bar thub bstan yangs pa'i mkhar/ / 'dīgās sted spobs pa'i dbang sgyur rgyal sto rdo rje nyi ma'i 'od/ / ngag dbang bshad sgrub bstan pa sprang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rgyas byed pa'i/ / 'dren pa mtshungs med rnams kyes da dung byang chub bar du skyongs/ / rang la brtse ba mi dman legs nyes blang dor shes 'dod cing / / thos rjes sgrub la gzhol ba'i dal 'byor don ldan byas pa rnams/ /sngon rabs dam pa'i gsung gi rjes su zlos pa 'di mnyan te/ / sgo gsum bag yod la gnas thub pa'i brtul zhugs 'di longs shig / ye shes spyan ldan srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang / / khyad par ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug mas/ / lhag bsam dag pas khrims su bcas pa kun/ / yid la smon bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / de'ang rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lhas/ / 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ / bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur ste dang / / bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ lus can yongs kyi sdug bsngal ma lus pa sel ba'i sman dang / bde legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che kho na yin la/ bstan pa'i ngo bo ni mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ / lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ / de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / / sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brjod bya bslab pa gsum du nges pas rjod byed sde sgod gsum du nges pa dang / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis bstan pa 'dzin tshul yang / sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan dang /bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len las gzhan med do/ / de ltar na bstan pa rin po che yun du gnas pa ni de bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin pa'i dge 400

༄/ / dben gnasathad dga' chos 'dzin gyi bca'athaga'adun gye sde la rag las pa'i tshul/ mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas/ skye dgu rnamasakyi phan bde ni/ / ma lus rgyal ba'i bstan las byung / / bstan pa'i chu bo 'phel ba'i gzhi/ / dge 'dun chu gter chen po ste/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ dge 'dun yang grangs kyi mang nyung dang / 'byor pa'i che chung la mi ltos kyi/ chos 'dul ba dang mthun pa'i bca' khrims rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa gal che ste/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtshos/ spyir bstan dang 'gro la phanapa'i thabs/ / zhing dag pa dge 'dun sde la rag / don de phyir dge 'dun spyi khrims la/ / thabs mkhas pa'i sgo nas phan btags na/ / chos 'dul ba'i phyag srol yun ring gnas/ / zhes gsungs so/ / des na bstan pa'i gzhi ma chos 'dul ba'i kun spyod gzhir byas shing / mdor bsdus rung mthun du grags pa'i don bzhin bla ma gong ma rnams kyis yul dus dang bstun pa'i dgag sgrub kye bslab bya 'ga' zhig dang bcas dge 'dun gye spyi khrims su mdzad pa'i don bzhin brjod pa la/ thog mar 'jug pa bo rten gyi gang zagazhugasanas blang dor ji ltar byed tshul/ de'i yan lag 'grig lam thor bu'i skor dang gsum/dang po ni/ mkhan slob tshad ldan las dge tshul slong gi sdom pa mnos shing / gzhan nas gnas dbyung byas pa sogs kha smras ngan pas phog pa ma yin pa/ rtsa bzhi chang sogs kyi mthong thos dogs gsum med pas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa gtso bo yin te/ bshes spring las/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ / yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs/ / zhes pa ltar tshul khrims ni bde legs thams cad kyi gzhi rtsa yin zhing / tshul khrims 'chal bas dge 'dun gyi rdzas til 'bru tsam yang longs spyod mi rung ba'i tshul/mdo las/ lcags gong me lce 'bar 'dra ba/ / zos par gyur pa ches sla 401

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/yi/ / tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdom pas/ / yul 'khor bsod stoms za ba min/ / zhes dang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ tshul 'chal yul 'khor bsod stoms spyod pa ni/ / lcags gong me lce 'bar ba za bar skye/ / tshul 'chal dge 'dun btung ba 'thung ba ni/ / zangs zhun 'bar ba 'thung bar skye bar 'gyur/ / shes ldan khyed la mang du smos ci dgos/ / tshul khrims 'chal ba'i sa ni gom gang dang / / zas ni kham gcig btung ba chu phor gang / / tsam zhig dge 'dun rdzas la longs spyad na/ / log 'tsho yin te dmyal bar skye bar gsungs/ / zhes sogs ltar nyes dmigs shin tu che bas/tshul 'chal gyi dogs gnas tsam yod na'ang sde 'dir zhugs mi chog /lo'ang 'grig lam 'khur mi nus pa'i ha cang rgas ches pa dang gzhon ches pa ma yin pa/ zhar 'azeng sgur bo sogs mdzes pa'i bar chad dang bral zhing /gtadapa gsum mam bzhi'i sgo nas sde 'dir tshe dang sgrub pa bsnyams te sdod pa'i 'dun pa can tshogs 'don gyi skor phal cher tshags su tshud pa dgos/dge slong yin na chos gos rnam gsum dang / dge tshul yang bla gos mthang gos gding ba lhung bzed sogs tshad dang ldan pa/ li'am zangs ser sogs kyi maṇḍal/ sgom zhwa/ zla gam/ gzan sogs kyang mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba/phreng ser ram bo ti tsa/ chab ril g.yogs ma chab thur can sogs mdor na 'jug pa'i rten dang yo byad tshul dang mthun pa dgos/ dge 'dun gyi zhal grangs ha cang mang na 'ur dang g.yeng ba che bas dben pa tshad ldan zhig mi yong zhing / ha cang nyung na tshogs 'don sogs mi 'chun pas grangs mo gnyis kyi bcad pa byas yod stabs sngar nas snyan gsan phul te zhal grangs dang bstun nas 'jug mtshams dod pa bla ma dang gnas brtan la mjal te tshogs su 'jug cing bgres pa tshad ldan re brten nas 'grig lam phra zhib nges pa byed 402

༄/ / dben gnasa'ad dga' chos 'dzin gyi bca'athagadagos/gnyis pa zhugs nas blang dor byed tshul la/ rgyun gyi spang blang dang dge sbyorabu tshul spyir bstan pa dang / tshogs kyi 'grig lam bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ blang dor tshul bzhin byed pa la thog mar thos pa'i sgo nas mi shes pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo khegs pa zhig gal che bas/ spyir thos pa gang byas kha phyir bltas su ma song bar chos kyi mde'u sne nang du bskor te nyams su len shes pa dang / khyad par du sdom gsum so so'i bslab bya/ lam rim rgyas bsdus ci rigs sogs mnyan te gcig shes gnyis shes lag len du zebs pa dgos/ mnyan pa'i yul yang rang gi nye phyogs tsam la ma yin par bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan nges shig legs par brtag nas btsal dgos te/mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/ nyin zhag gcig gi lam gyi skyel ma la'ang /blo gtad thub mi thub sna tshogs pa yod na/ skye ba gtan gyi 'dun ma rtsa ba'i bla ma 'tshol ba'i tshe mtshan nyid tshang ma tshang the tshom mi skye zhing / rang bza' btung dang gcam bu'i ngag gis bkris pa tsam rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ khyi dang glo ba phrad pa ltar 'jug ga la rigs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / dus dbang gis bla ma mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa zhig ma rnyed na'ang /don dam snye ma las/ rtsod ldan dbang gis bla ma skyon dang yon tan 'dres/ / rnam pa kun tu sdig pa med pa yod ma yin/ / gang zhig yon tan lhag pa yang ni legs dpyad nas/ / bu rnams kyis ni de la brten par 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skyon yon gnyis las yon tan lhag pa dang /de'i nang nas kyang snying por gyur ba yun du 'grogs pa na tshe 'di phyi gnyis las phyi ma'i don dang / chos 'jig rten gnyis las chos kyi phyogs su blo sna 'khrid cing tshul khrims gtsang ma la sbyor ba zhig med mi rung du bsten dgos/403

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bla mar ma bsten pa'i gong du mtshan nyid dang ldan mi ldan lta ba ma gtogs/chos 'brel bzhag zin nas mdzad pa ci snang yang rang snang ba ma dag pa yin snyam nas skyon rtog 'gog dgos te/ rang ngos nas dad pa spyong nus na bla ma'i ngos nas ji ltar yin kyang sangs rgyas thams cad der 'dus te byin gyis rlobs pa'i tshul/ po to bas/ bla ma yon tan che dang chung min/ / gang la dad pa de yis de 'dul/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ deng sang chos shes par rlom pa mang po zhig rang gi bla ma la smad ra re btang nas nga la chos 'brel zhig kyang yod/ de yin na'ang ngas drang po bshad pa yin zer ba ni rang gi don snying rul ba phyir ngoms pa yin pas bdud kyi tshig tu shes par byos la dug bzhin spongs/ rang gis de 'dra mi gleng bar ma zad drung du bla ma'i skyon brjod mkhan byung na rang gi tshig 'gro tshe ngas (nga'i)bla ma yin pas de 'dra ma zer zhes 'gog dgos la/ de mi nus na thabs kyis gzhan du bshol nas 'gro zhing phyis de 'dra la 'dris 'grogs mi byed/ des mtshon te dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dang 'grogs shing de'i rdzas la spyad na dngos grub kyi sgo 'gag par 'gyur bas 'go ba'i nad bzhin shin tu 'dzem dgos/ nyams len byed pa la nyams su len rgyu dang 'dor rgyu'i bye brag de'i phan yon dang nyes dmigs kyi khyad par phyogs tsam zhig ma go bar sngags kyi grangs bsags pa tsam gyis bogs mi thon pa ni/ mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rjes/ thos pa med pa'i sgom pa de/ / lag rdum brag la 'jus pa 'dra/ / zhes dang / rje bla mas/ blang dor gnas la kun nas 'thom pa'i mun/ / yang dag thos pa'i sgron mes ma bsal bar/ / lam mi shes na thar pa'i grong mchog tu/ / 'jug par 'gyur pa smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas thos pa gal che la/thos pa de'ang thos lo tsam gyi grangs gsog pa dang / tshe 'di'i rnyed 'tshol 404

༄/ / dben gnasayid dga' chos 'dzin gyibaca' yigasogasakyi lag char ma song bar sgom sgrub kyi yan lag tu 'gyur nges pa'i thos pabyed tshul dang nyan pa'i yul sogs tshul dang mthun pa dgos/ bslab bya sogs nyan yang de phral nas lag len du ma btab na rgyud dred nas slar ci byasakyang mi phan pa zhig 'byung bas bslab bya rgyas bsdus gang 'tsham re byang bar bzung nas bla ma'i gsung dang gnyis ka sbyar te lag tu lon nges kyis nyan pa'i dgos don ma 'chug pa bya/ de'ang thun drug gi rnal 'byor ma chag par byaba'i zhar la ltung ba bsngo bgrang byas te sngags byang sems kyi bcas 'gal rnams nyin zhag gi drug cha'i nang du bshags pa dang / so thar gyi nyes pa rnams kyang nyal kha tshun la bshags te ltung ba dang zhag tu mi 'grogs pa byed/'gro 'dug spyod lam gang gi skabs su'ang shes pa rgya yan la ma btang bar dbang po'i sgo bsdams te dran shes rgyun chags su bsten nas ltung bas ma gos pa la 'bad/ khyad par byang sems la dmigs pa'i khong khro skad cig ma gcig sgyes na'ang bskal ba stong du bsags pa'i dge rtsa 'joms par spyod 'jug las gsungs shing / byang sems gar yod mi shes pa dang / grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa la khros na 'khor sgyur gyi skye ba grangs med pa 'grub pa'i rgyu'i bsod nams nyams par mdo las gsungs la/ bla ma gcig gi drung nas dbang nyan pa'i grogs rdo rje spun la khros na rtsa ltung du 'gyur bas rdo rje dmyal bar skye ba sogs nyes dmigs bsam gyis mi khyab cing / dus dbang gis 'byung nye bas shin tu bsgrims te 'gog dgos/ mtshang nas rgol ba'i kha 'dzing byas na brgya phyag mchod me snyan dar bcas dang / lag 'dres pa byung naganas nas dbyung / ma byin len du 'gro ba la mtha' gcig tu gzhan gyi rdzas rku mi dgos par/ pha rol la ster dgos pa'i gla rngan rin thang tshang ba lta bu thabs ci rigs kyis ma byin na'ang pham par 'gro bas/ blo rgod mdog kha 405

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/po'i rigs la 'di 'dra 'byung nye zhing / de byung na rgyal kha lon pa ma yin gyi/rang gi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba chad pa'i pham tshabs de las che ba med/der ma zad rdzas phran tshogs tsam brkus na'ang blo lang la shor te rdzas chen po rku ba la'ang ci mi snyam pa 'byung bas/ rkus kyi rigs che chung gang byas kyang gnas nas dbyung / bre log srang log bun skyed byas pa sogs kyang rkus dang khyad par med/ de bzhin du pyos 'gyur gye rigs 'thung ba dang / khrims grogs med par nye du ma yin pa'i bud med dang gnas gcig tu nyal ba la pham pa dang por mi 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan yang dag mi 'dug pa dang / lag bstar te so nam byas pa dang mtshon cha thogs pa dang / grong gi kha mchu sogs kyi gseb tu the gtogs byas pa dang / 'grig 'gal gyi chad las bzhag pa ngos mi len zhing lan slog pa sogs kyang gnas nas phyung ste slar mi snyen/ tha ma kha 'then pa/ khyims(khyim) pa pho mo'i gos dang mtshon cha sogs nang du bzhag pa/ khyims(khyim) pa sun 'byin du 'gro ba'i gtam 'dzem med du smra ba/ gong du bkag pa'i gos kyi rigs gyon pa/ gzan sham med par srang du 'gro ba/ rlung nad can lta bu ma yin par phyi dro'i kha zas dang sgog tsong 'dzem med du za ba/ ming ngan 'dogs pa/ gzhan la nyes med kyi skur pa 'debs pa sogs byas na'ang ltung bshags dang phyag sbrags nas bshags pa byed du 'jug long gtam mang na chags sdang sna tshogs drangs te don med du nyes pa chen po gsog pas smra ba nyung bar bya/ gzhan gyis ngan smras byas pa sogs pha rol bo la bshad de sems mi mthun par song na bden rdzun la ma ltos par dbyen gyi nyes pa 'byung zhing dge 'dun thugs mi mthun pa sogs kyi dgag bya che bas de 'dra'i rigs mi gleng / lhag par ngag 'chal sna tshogs smras te gzhan gyi dge sbyor la bar chad byas na nyes pa lce ba'i tshul/ de bzhin 406

༄/ / dben gnasathadadaga' chos 'dzin gyi bca' yigagashegs pa'i ye shes mdzod kyi mdo klu sgrub kyi mdo kun btus su drangs pa las/chos 'dod pa rnams la rnam par g.yeng bar byed pa ni tshig kyal ba rnams kyi nang na chen po yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ phan tshun gyi gshag (shag) dang skor lam sogs su 'tshogs nas long gtam mi bya zhing /lhag par mtshams dang snga dgung gi thun gye skabs phan tshun gye nang du mi 'gro/zhogs par brda gtong ba'i bar thun gnyis dang / dgung mo thun brda btang nas thun gnyis te thun bzhi ma chag par byed pa 'di rgyun gyi dge sbyor gyi gzhung lta bu yin pas/ zhog ka nam gyi sum cha lus pa tsam na bzhengs pa'i rnal 'byor zhu ba glus bskul lta bu'i dmigs pa dang / mamatha' 'ang nyin deradage spyor la 'bad nas chud zos su mi gtong snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs drag btang la/ ngag byin rlabs 'gyur sngags phreng sngags sogs dang / dus dran bsten pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas rnams sngon du btanganas lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len cha tshang ba'i thun gnyis/ dgung mo'ang blo nus dang bstun pa'i mdo sngags kyi nyams len sngar bzhin la/ khyad par ltung ba'i bsngo bgrang gtso bor byas la nyin der ltung ba byung ma byung brtags nas bshags bsdams dang / chos skyong la gtor ma phul te dge sbyor mthar phyin pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba bcas thun gnyis byas la sang snga bar bzhengs rgyu'i 'phen pa btang ste nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas seng ge'i nyal thabs su gzim/ de skad du bshes spring las/ rig pa'i bdag nyid nyin par mtha' dag dang / / mtshan mo'ang thun gyi stod smad bzlas nas ni/ / mnal tshe'ang 'bras bu med par mi 'gyur bar/ / dran dang ldan par de dag bar du mnol/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / lhag par dgung re bzhin nyin mo de la dge sbyor tshad ldan byung 'dug gam mi 'dug brtags te 407

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/byung 'dug na dga' ba skyed/ sdig ltung du mas gos pa'am le lo dang stoms las sogs kyis don med du 'das 'dug na/ kye ma bdag pha yul gnyen bshes thams cad bskyur nas dben gnas 'dir 'ongs pa yin kyang / dge spyor la mi 'bad par tshe stong zad du btang na dben par sdod pa'i gcan gzan ri dwags sogs dang khyad ci yod/ rang gis rang bslus par 'dug snyam du bsam dgos te/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/ pha yul nye du longs spyod kun bor nas/ / rtse gcig dam chos sgrub par dam bcas te/ /gzhan gyi yul du rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi yis/ / dal 'byor don med byed pa smyon pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / des mtshon te sdod sa ri khrod du bsdad kyang bsam rgyu rnyed bkur snyan grags kho na bsam pa dang sgom ltar snang la mgo 'khor ba ni don med kho na yin pas/ 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis/dam pa'i gdams pas spros pa ma chod par/ / zhi gnas bying bo zhig la sems bzung nas/ / gti mug mun pa yang yang spel byed pa/ / byi ba tshang du nyal ba'i sgom chen yin/ / dad dang 'dun pas sems rgyud ma thul bar/ /'gran 'dod dben pa'i ri la gnas bcas te/ / 'dod yon dgos dgu rtag tu yid byed pa/ / gcan gzan ri la nyal ba'i sgom chen yin/ / thar pa'i lam stor nyes pa kun spel nas/ / bzang 'dod ri brag gnas pas dus 'das te/ / de rjes yon bdag pho mo'i grong chog mkhan/ / wa 'dra lung stong 'grim pa'i sgom chen yin/ / chos brgyad 'dod pa rtswa yi me bzhin 'bar/ /kha phyir kun tu rgyu ba'i brtson 'grus can/ / log pa'i 'tsho bas rtag tu 'tsho byed pa/ / khyi rkun grong mtha' nyul ba'i sgom chen yin/ / rgyal po ngan pa'i tshul 'dzin ngur smrig can/ / chags sdang mtshon sbyor du ma'i 'khor gyis bskor/ / mi dge'i phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas byed pa/ / ngan song gnas 408

༄/ / dben gnasayid dga' chos 'dzin gyi bca' yigagasum spel ba'i sgom chen yin/ / zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don la bsams te rang sems la zhu dag btang nas/ sgom chen tha ma'i mtshan nyid de lta bur ma song bar/ rab byung na/ lta ba spros bral rnam dag shugs 'chang zhing / /g.yeng med sgom pa rnam dag yan lag ldan/ / spyod pa rnam dag g.yu yi ral pa can/ / seng ge gangs la gnas pa'i sgom chen yin/ / zhes pa lta bu lta sgom spyod gsum gye yang rtser son zhing don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa sgrub nus pa zhig byung na legs la/ ma mtha'ang / theg mchog sgrub pa tshul bzhin ma nus kyang / / dbang bzhi'i dam tshig me tog chun po ni/ / mgo yi thod bzhin rab tu srung byed na/ / srid pa myur du sgrol ba'i sgom chen yin/ /zhes pa lta bu sa lam gyi nyams len rgya chen po ma lcogs kyang khas blangs pa'i dam sdom tshul bzhin du bsrung / phyi ma phan chad kyi bsam blo rgyun du btang te 'khor ba spyi dang khyad par ngan song gi sgo khegs pa zhig ci nas kyang bya dgos/de ltar nyin mtshan dus kun don med du ma song ba dang / dgung zhog gi thun rnams gzugs brnyan du ma song bar tshul dang mthun pa sems la 'dzin rgyu yod pa bya/ dge sbyor gnad du 'gro ba u tshugs kho na'i kha na med par byed tshul mkhas dgos pas/ thun gye bar mtshams su lam rim blo sbyong / dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar/ las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag gtso bor ston pa mdzang (mdzangs)blun dang las brgya ba 'dul ba lung lta bu/ rim gnyis kyi khrid yig sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung che ba rnams la dpe klog rgyud dang 'dres nges pa/ sbyor ba'i chos drug ltar gnas khang gi phyi nang du gad dar gtsang sang nge ba dang / mchod pa gtsang ma gang 'byor chag med du 'bul ba/ phyag dang skor ba byed pa/ satstsha 'debs pa sogs sgo mtha' dag nas tshogs gsog sgrub spyong gi thabs la 'bad/ chos mthun gyi yo byad phran tshegs sgrib dgos pa 409

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/rnams kyang zhar la tshags su tshud par bya/ nor rdzas yo byad kyang chog shes kyis tshod ma bzung bar mkho ba'i bsam mno kho na btang na sred pa je cher song nas mi dgos dgu dgos shing / ji tsam yod kyang chog rgyu med pa zhig 'byung ste/ tshoms las/ gangs can dang ni mnyam pa yi/ / gser gye ri bo yod gyur kyang / / nor des gcig kyang yid tshim pa/ / shes par gyis la 'dod 'dun skyungs/ / zhes dang / 'ba' ra bas/ gling bzhi'i nor la dbang bsgyur kyang / / med kyin chad pa ma gtogs pa/ / 'dang zhing lhag pa yong dus med/ / ces gsungs pa yin la/ rang gis chog shes sten thub na yo byad kyis gang du mi phongs te/ shes rab sdong bu las/ chog shes nges pa'i bdag nyid can/ / 'tsho ba gang na'ang btsal mi dka'/ / rtswa dang lo ma chu yi gnas/ / gang na'ang med pa ma yin no/ / zhes gsungs so/ / khyad par du rab tu byung nas tshul khrims rnam dag cig bsrung na bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs rjes 'tsho bas dbul ba zhig mi 'ong ste/ mdo las/ khyim pa'i skye bo thams cad kyis/ / sen mo'i steng du zhing rmod kyang / / nga yi rab tu byung ba rnams/ / 'tsho bas phongs par mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs pas/ rdo rjes tshig gis nam yang bslu mi srid do/ / lhag par sgom chen thur du ma 'dril na/zanagong gyen du 'dril ba'i dpe ltar sgom sgrub rnam dag cig ma byung dogs pa'i sems khral ma gtogs/ lo zla mang po'i lto gos kyi sems khral rgyab tu bskyur te 'phral gyi rnyed pa 'phral du za zhing rgyu nor mang po med pas gzhan zhig tu 'gro na'ang / lham sna bsgyur bas ban gzhis rdzogs pa bka' gdams glegs bam las/ 'phral la zas 'tshol bya dang 'dra/ / yig ste lang bas gzhis rdzogs pa/ / gsungs pa de bzhin zhig byung na bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung sgos las/ sngar nga'i khas zas mi rnyed pa la/ da zas kyis nga'i kha 410

༄/ /dben gnasayidadaga' chos 'dzin gyi bca' yigami rnyed par 'dug gsungs pa ltar 'gro ba kun gye mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur ba ma gtogs yo byad kyis brel mi srid pas kha rag sgom chung gis/ so nam ma byas yo byad ma bsags kyang / / sgom chen 'khyag gam ltogs nas shi ba gang / / sngon chad mthong zhing thos pa ma byung ste/ / ma 'ongs pa na'ang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs so/ / des na nyams len gnad du mi 'gro ba'i rkyen sdug shos lto rgyab kyi don du nor rdzas la sred pa che zhing chog mi shes pa 'dir snang bas/ lto gos gang byung gis chog shes pa 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi la gnas pa nges pa don gyi dge sbyong gi tshul dang mthun par byed/gnyis pa tshogs kyis 'grig lam bye brag tu bshad pa la/ tshogs brda btang ba dang ma 'gyang bar spyod lam mdzes pas 'du zhing sgo 'phyor du bzhugs nas dung btang ba dang dmigs brtse ma gsung bzhin par nang du phebs/ grib ma sor gcig yan chad kyi bslab pa'i rgan gzhon brtsis te chos 'dul ba ji lta ba byung na shin tu legs la/ 'on kyang 'dul ba mdor bsdus kyi don bzhin yul dus dang bstun dgos pas/ dgag bya dang dbos pa yod tshedagon pa'i gral rim dang mthun par byed/ gral du bzhugs tshul ha cang dgye ba dang sgur ba ma yin zhing ya yo 'khyag 'khyog tu ma song ba dgos/ sku drang bar bsrang zhing dbu cung zad sgur te lo yag gi snye ma ltar bzhugs pa las/ kha btum gzhog gcus/ g.yas lta g.yon lta/ ka ba dang rtsig pa la bsnyel ba/ long gtam smra ba/ gzhan la yig brda dang mchu tshugs byed pa/zla gam gyi mdun phye nas sdod pa sogs spyod lam mi mdzes pa'i rigs spangs te tshul dang mthun par bzhugs/ tshogs 'don gyi rim pa rgyun chags su skyabs 'gro sngon du 'gro ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar dmigs brtse ma gang 'gro re/ yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa/ byin rlabs spungs zhus/41/

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum gyis sems bskyed pa rnams nges can la sngon du gtong zhing / gnas bcu'i phyag mchod/ sher snying bdud zlog dang bcas pa/ sgrol ma/ tshe gzungs/ seng gdong ma sogs dang gtor 'bul/gtor ma brgya rtsa chu sbyin bca4ma chag par byed/ zhal 'don dal brel 'tsham zhing rta 'dur gang yin sngar rgyun ma nyams pa dang / g.yas 'then g.yon 'then du ma song bar dbu mdzad dang bstun nas mgrin gcig tu 'ur chem gyis gsungs/ ḍa dril rol mo sogs kyang snga phyi ma shor bar 'grig pa byed/bzhi pa'i nang du bdag 'jug rnams dang / bcu gnyis par tshes gtor gyi 'don pa rta dbyangs rol cha dang bcas gshar sbyang byed/ gsar zhugs rnams kyis de'i sngon nas dbyangs sogs nges mkhan re'i rtsar slob dgos/hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gcig nas bzung zla ba bzhi'i ring / tshes lnga la 'jigs byed kyi bdag 'jug tshes brgyad la bla mchod/ sman bla 'jigs byed/ tshes bcu la bde mchog tshes bcu gsum la bde lam/ tshes bco lnga la gsang 'dus/ nyi shu tham pa la mi 'khrugs pa/ nyi shu lnga la bde mchog gi bdag 'jug nyi shu brgyad la bla mchod dang phyag chen/ nyi shu dgu la mgon chos lha mo gsum gyi bskang gso bcas dus bzang dgu re dang / rgyun par tshes lnga/tshes bcu/ nyi shu/ nyer lnga ma gtogs pa'i dus bzang lnga re byed/ zla ba de bzhi dang gsum pa bzhi pa ste zla ba drug gi ring gso sbyong la sngags byang sems so thar gsum ga'i phyir bcos dang / rgyun par so thar gye phyir bcos sngon du gtong / bstan pa'i gzhi ma chos 'dul ba yin zhing / de la las brgya rtsa zhig yod na'ang / da lta dus dbang gis phal cher 'grib ste shul na ma nyams par yod pa gzhi gsum gyi phyag len tsam du snang bas 'di la rtsis po cher bya/ gso spyong gi skabs nad pa thu mo dang bsnyen mtshams lta bu ma yin pa'i mtshams pa 412

༄/ /dben gnasayidadaga' chos 'dzin gyi bca' yigadakyus ma sogs su yang ma lus par phebs/ ma phebs pa rnams kyang 'dun pa dang yongs dag phul ba sogs gzhi gsum gyi phyag bzhes phra zhib tshul dang mthun par byed/ mdor na bstan pa'i gzhi ma chos 'dul ba'i kun spyod la rag las pas nang re bzhin 'bral spang thub dbang gi sku'i mdun du dus dran bsten nas me la reg pa sogs kyi tshe de dran par byed pa/ rung khang byin rlabs/ dgung re bzhin yo byad gang byung brtag ste byin rlabs byed pa/ nub lhag bsrung ba/ bza' btung dang zags pa dor rjes chab len pa/ rung chu 'debs pa/ bza' btung gi dus dang gtsug lag khang du 'gro ba'i tshe mchil lham mi 'go ba/ 'gro ba'i tshe gzan skyor byas nas blum por bgo ba sogs spyodalam gang gi tshe'ang ston pa'i bcas pa rjes su dran pa'i shes bzhin gyes zin pa byas na tshogs gsog sgrib spyong rlabs po che zhor la 'grub pas don che ba yin gyi/ rgyun par sgo gsum bag med rgya yan du btang nas chos byed dus shig zur na yod pa bzhin byas pas go mi chod de/ 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon pos/ dran pa g.yengs med cig ma shes na/ / lus ngag tab tab kyi kha na med/ / ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ / gsum pa de'i yan lag 'grig lam thor bu'i skor ni/ bslab pa bgres padang sku yon can rang las blo kha mtho ba'i rigs la zhwa phud gzan 'bebs zhe sa sogs bkur gzos byed/ nad pa la mang mas khur len gyis do dam byed cing kho rang la cha rkyen med na spyi rdzas steng nas sman rim gro dang / skam tshogs kyis sku rim nan tan byed/ nad sos nas 'byor na ngang dran gyis spyi rdzas sogs bsab na legs/ de 'dra'i skabs spyi ba'i gdan cha mchod cha sogs g.yar kyang phangs med mi byed par do dam pa rnams kyis phyir rtsis sprod cing phyogs gzhan du spyi rdzas g.yar bo mi byed/ grwa pa gshegs skabs cha rkyen 413

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gang yod tshogs che chung la zhal 'debs su 'gro nges byed/ spyil bu ri khrod du gsar zhugs la 'tshong ba las gzhan la btsong mi chog cing / spyil bu bshig pa dang spyil bu gnyis gcig tu 'dril ba sogs kyang mi byed/ de 'dra'i 'tshong yul ma 'grig na bla ma'am spyi la 'bul zhing des dge thebs sprod pa dang /slar ri khrod pa gsar zhugs la gtod pa byed/ spyil bu gcig tu sgom pa gnyis lhan du sdod pa mi byed cing / bdun cu brgal bas gang yang mi 'dzom pa ma gtogs grwa pa bsten mi chog / grwa ba gshegs pa'i chas sogs nyo tshong gang la'ang yul dus kyi rin thang tshad ma ma gtogs gcig gis gcig la btsong phyogs mi bya/ gzhan gyis nyo ba'i bar du mi 'tshang zhing rin thang 'os nges bcad pa las chad lhag du mi 'jal/ 'di nas phyogs gzhan la grong chog tu song mi chog par ma zad gzhan du chu spos pa'i skabs de nas kyang grong chog la mi 'gro/ spyir gnas skor dang gnyan khrod 'grim pa sogs kyang don che'ang sde 'dir zhugs zin nas dran rgyu mang na dge sbyor mthar mi thon cing mig ltos laganod pas/ rgyal dbang kun dga' dpal 'byor gyis/ khyod yang na tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ / yang na phyogs med kyi ldom bu gyis/ / zla 'ga' zas 'tshol gyi gnas skor de/ / 'gro min sdod min cig ma lags sam/ /gsungs pa'i dpe ltar ngos bzung med pa zhig 'byung bas/ jo bo chen pos/phan tshun 'gro ba'i dus ma yin/ sa gcig tu sdod pa'i dus yin/ gsungs pa dang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / ri khrod mthun pa'i grogs dang bcas pa'i gnas der dge sbyor 'phel na/ 'pho skyas mang po dge sbyor gyi sad yin pas gzhi bzung / gsungs pa bzhin sdod tshugs pa byed/ dang po ri khrod du 'jug pa'i tshe'ang / rje mi la ras pas/ nga skyid pa gnyen gyis ma tshor zhing / sdug pa dgra yis ma tshor bar/ / ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na/ /414

༄/ / dben gnasathadadaga' chos 'dzin gyi bca' yigarnal 'byor bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ / gsungs pa lta bu bsam blo zhib tu btang nas tshe 'jug ri khrod 'dir skyel thub pa zhig byed dgos snyam nas yong ba yin stabs/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ dang por 'byor ba brtag nas ni/ /brtsam mam yang na mi brtsam bya/ / brtsams nas ldog par mi bya'o/ / zhis gsungs pa bzhin dam bca' mthar thon pa zhig byed pa ma gtogs g.yas 'gro g.yon 'gro mang po'i mgo mi rtsom/ lo re bzhin lo mtshams pa gnyis gsum re byung na legs shing / zhal grangs nyung stabs tshogs la gnod na mi legs pas bzhi las lhag pa mi byed/ las rung ma song ba rnams ston dbyid la gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs kyi las rung lta bur zla mtshams re byed par dmigs bsal gtong zhing / de min tshogs 'don ma nyams pa gtso bor byed dgos pa'i stabs nam 'grig tu mtshams byed zer ba la gnang ba mi sbyin/lo mtshams pa dang 'gro 'dug mi thub nges pas nad pa thabs sdug yun ring can ma gtogs pa tshogs su ma 'ongs pa la ja thug dang mar gye skal ba mi gtong / ham pa gang che'i dbang du ma btang bar ja skal sogs cha stoms par bgo lugs tshul dang mthun par byed/ 'gyed phog tshar gang la'ang sku skal man chad su la'ang skal 'phar mi gtong / gnas brtan la bsngo rten/spyi 'jog rnam bzhag sogs kyang sbyin bdag gi 'byor bstun las tshad bzung gis zhe sun mi skur/ 'brug pa sangs rgyas rdo rjes/ rgyu 'bras zhib tig ngang nas/ / dgon pa'i zhabs tog rem na/ / de ka chos rang yin pas/ /'bad na lags so drung chen/ / zhes pa ltar spyi don du bsam pa rnam dag gis tshong bsgyur byed dgos byung na'ang / bre dang srang la g.yo sgyus mgo skor sogs dge 'dun log 'tsho la spyor ba'i zhabs 'dren byed mi rung ste/ zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ las gang sangs rgyas kyis ni rtag smad pa/ / srang dang 415

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/tshad la g.yo sgyu byed par zhugs/ / de 'dra sdig pa nyon mongs las byas pa/ / las ngan byed pa de dag ngan song 'gro/ / zhes gsungs so/ / mdor na be'u bum sngon po las/ snying nas thar ba 'dod pa rnams kyis/ / skyes pa'i yul spangs nye du thag bsrings/ / mthun pa'i yul 'dug bshes gnyen rtag bsten/ / 'du 'dzi kun spangs tshul bzhin yid byed/ / de la thar ba ring ba ma yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang yul gyi 'khri ba chod cing grong ba'i skye bo sogs mang po dang 'dris 'grogs mi byed/ chen po'i ngo 'dzin sogs kyis sna thag mi la mi gtod/ mang po'i 'du 'tshogs dang don med kyi 'chal gtam/ 'gro 'dug nyo tshong sogs bya byed mang po mi rtsom par/ da res tshe lhag 'di'i steng nas mdo sngags cha tshang ba'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs 'di 'dra dang mjal ba'i tshod kyi nyams len rmad du byung bas zung 'jug gi go 'phang bsgrubs te ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi mgon byed thub pa zhig dang / ma mtha' 'ang thog mar rang nyid phyi ma ngan song du mi ltung ba'i blo rtse yod pa zhig mi byed pa'i thabs ga la yod snyam du rang sems nang du bskor nas/ sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams la gnas mi gnas/ chos dang mthun mi mthun dran shes rgyun du bsten te nyi ma gcig dang / ja bar gcig kyang chud zos su ma song ba zhig mdzad na nges par gtan gyi bde skyid mgo tshugs pa zhig 'ong ste/ mnyam med jo bo chen pos/ rang gi sems la chongs dang kha tshig min gyi gros la gsan par rigs/ / de ltar mdzad na bdag kyang dga' la rang gzhan kun yang skyid par mchis/ / zhes dang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i zhal nas/ chos byed na de bzhin mdzad na dga'/ / de susaphyas skyid pa'i rgya mtshor gnas/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ de ltar ci nas kyang lag len du thebs pa zhig mdzod mdzod/ dus las mi yol 416

༄/ /dben gnasayidadaga' chos 'dzin gyi bca'athagathugs bskyed rgya mtsho'i mthus/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mgon dang skyabs gyur ba/ / bla ma yi dam dkon mchog rnam gsum mthus/ / smon pa'i re 'bras lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dang / / khyad par ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug mas/ / sde 'dir chos srid dge mtshan 'phel ba dang / / bca' khrims nyams pa med pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / rnam dag khrims ldan dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde/ / thugs mthun bshad sgrub dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas/ / mthong thos dran reg skye bo thams cad kyang / / bla med byang chub dpal la spyor gyur cig / ces dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi bca' yig yang dag sgrub pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mang thos sgrub la gzhol ba'i gnas brtan rdo rams pa dkon mchog dge 'dun gyes nan cher bskul zhing / rang gis kyang 'di 'dra ba zhig gal che bar mthong ste/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa 'di don bzhin dge 'dun rnams nas phyag len du thebs pa dang / dam can srung ma rnams kyis 'azin las g.yel ba med par mdzod mdzod/ /mnyam med drang srong chen po'i rjes zhugs te/ / thos don yang dag sgrub la gzhol rnams kyi/ / khrims su bya ba thar pa'i gzhung lam mchog /par du bskrun pa'i legs byas dge tshogs mthus/ / gsung rab gdams par shar ba'i nyams len gyis/ / sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs pa dang / / de yi mthu las mkha' mnyam lus can kun/ / yang dag lam gye dga' ston myong gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni mkhyen dpyod yangs pa kyā hu tā bla ma 'jigs med dge 'phel dang sngags rams pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho gnyis kyis lhag bsam dag pas rgyu yo na sbyar te 'di nyid par du bsgrubs pa'i par byang du/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /417

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlan me'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ /yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi bca' yig zur 'debs bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /de'ang khri thog lnga bcu pa zhal snga nas dge 'dun phun tshogs la/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdo smad du phebs gar/ nged kyis dgon pa btab 'jog rgyu yin pas slar khyed rang tshos skyong dgos zhes dgongs gzhi can gyi bka' gnang ba ltar/sku tshe der dga' ldan khrir pheb rgyu dang rje'i gser gdung bzhengs pa sogs sku don rgya che bas mdo smad du pheb pa ma shar yang / sku tshe rjes ma ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku na shin tu phra mo'i dus sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang dpon mo rnam rgyal sgol mas gdan drangs pa'i mtshams sbyor la brten nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ gsan sbyong mtha' chod pa dang dgon pa'i 'dzin skyong yang dag gnang / de skabs dgon 'dir 'chad nyan legs kyang nye skor du sgrub grwa med pas bshad sgrub gnyis ldan du bya bar dgongs shing / dgon pa'i byang skyor lta bur phan pa'i rten 'brel la'ang dgongs te sgrub sde 'di btab/ chos 'dul ba'i kun spyod gtsang ma gzhir byas te bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams len tshang ba'i sgom sgrub kyi srol btsugs nas de don ltar gyi bca' yig kyang bzhag 'dug na'ang / gtso bor sems rgyud 'dul ba'i thabs rtsal 'don byas te gsungs pa las/ 'phral gyi bya byed skor zhib cha ma gnang 'dug pas/ 'grig lam gnon mkhan dang 'khur mkhan kun la de 418

༄/ /yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi bca' yigazur 'debs/rigs gsal cha gal che bar mazong nas bca' yig rgyas pa zur du bzhag yod pas de gzhir bya/de la nye bar mkho ba'i zhib cha thun mong ma yin pa'i skor zur 'debs kyi tshul du 'god pa la/ 'jug pa po rten gyi gang zag tshul dang mthun pa ni/sngon gyi bag chags can gang zag khyad par ba re gnyis ma gtogs nyi shu ma lon bar du brtan cha mi 'ong bas nyi shu yan chad lon pa dang / drug cu rtsa lnga drug yan lon tshe sngar ma lob pa'i 'grig lam ji bzhin 'khur mi thub stabs de yan chad du ma brgal ba dgos/ gzhan nas 'ong ba'i rigs la skyon can sogs yin min thog mar sne sbyor mkhan dang / yul phyogs de'i grwa pa sogs la dris te sgo 'dogs gcod pa'i khur len gnas brtan gyis byed/ rab kyis grwa sa chen por thos pa mthar phyin pa dang / de min yang grwa sa 'grim myong ba gal che/ sde 'dir 'ongs pa'i dgos don tshogs gsog sgrib spyong gi ched yin la/ zhal 'don gyi rim pa 'di skyes bu dam pa gong ma rnams gnad gang che thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas bzhag pa yin pas/ 'di ji lta ba zhig byung na de las lhag pa rang gi gshag tu'ang byed rgyu med par ma zad dge 'dun mi phyed 'dun pa'i stobs kyis tshogs su byas pa lhag par stobs che ba dang / 'tsho ba thams cad sbyin bdag gi dad zas yin stabs ma mtha' zhal 'don gtsang ma cha tshang re med na las sgrib snga ma sbyong rgyu las gsar du dkor sgribange lcer 'gro bas/ sgrub grwar ma zhugs gong nas 'don cha yongs rdzogs bzung tshar ba'am/ ma mtha' 'ang bde lam gyis gtsos 'don cha phyed lhag tsam bzung tshar ba dgos pas de yod med gnas brtan gyis lta zhing / rjes ma'i rim pa'ang lo phyed gnyis tshun la rdzogs thub pa dgos tshul bkod pas khyab pa dang de mthun gyi rting skul byed/ yo byad tshul dang mthun pa ni chos 419

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gos rnam gsum sogs ha cang hrul bas dug por ma song ba dang / lhung bzed dang gding ba ha cang chung grags pa ma yin pa dgos/ rnam sbyar dang lhung bzed gsar zhugs dus brnyan po las ma 'byor na'ang zla ba bzhi lnga tshun la 'dzom dgos pa'i bkod khyab byed/ pags thul g.yogs med pa/ rtsag 'gag drag lhan med pa/ gong 'dab kyi spu phyi rol tu mngon pa/ lham lcags 'dzer ma dang rong lham/ phu thung ma'i rigs sogs gyon mi chog ljongs rgyu sogs kyi skabs su rba mkhar bsnams srol yod pa bzhin rab mkhar gsil dang / de min yang rba dang smyug ma gdong drug gi dbyug pa cod pan dang dril chung sogs gra 'grigs pa dgos kyi/ lcang dbyug re'i rtser ras shur btags pa lta bu bzung mi chog gra can pag khug sogs kyang dgon dang mthun pa byed/chos nyan tshul dang nyan pa'i yul tshul dang mthun pa ni/ lam rim blo sbyong bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs kyi khrid/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs kyi dbang bka'/ bka' bstan bcos tshad ldan gye lung lta bu rang bstan la mthun sgrub kyi chos rgyun tshad ldan ma gtogs/ grub mtha' mi mthun pa'i chos rgyun sna tshogs nyan mi chog cing / sde 'dir zhugs nas skar rtsis sman sogs slob pa dang / sngar bslab yod kyang mngon tshan che ba mi byed/ mnyan pa'i yul lta spyod rnam par dag pa/ rang gi bla ma chos skyong sogs la 'gras med pa ma gtogs grub thob dang skye rgyud yin zer tshad la 'ur zhog gis sna sha mi sbyin/gnas brtan las thog pa'am zur ba rgyud sbyangs shing sku yon can re'i mdun nas sngags byang sems so thar rnams kyi bslab bya rtsa tshig re'i steng nas 'khrid cing lag len du btab rim bzhin dogs pa gang byung 'phral 'phral zhus te ngo 'phrod nges byed/ lo re bzhin ston dpyid gang rigs la sgrub sde 'dir lam rim gyi bka' chos re'ang ma chag pa byung na legs/420

༄/ / yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi bca'a'agajar 'debs/thun gyi skor tshul dang mthun pa ni/ zhog ka nam ma lang gong du thun gcig dang / nyi dros kyi brda gtong ba'i bar du thun gcig dgung mo brda btang nas mun sros kyi bar du thun gcig dang / de nas srod yol gyi bar thun gcig byed/ thun brda snga 'phyi dus dus kyi nyi tshod la chags bzhag ste cha mnyam pa'i khur len gnyer bas byed cing / gnas brtan gyis kyang bgod pas khyab par bya/ ja bzhes na'ang zhog ka nam ma lang gong dang / dgung mo mun sros tsam ma gtogs me btang mi chog thun gyi skabs gling nas sus kyang ku co dang rtig sgra chob sgra mi byed/ spyi don ma gtogs par yas mas su 'gro dgos na thun gyi brda ma btang gong du phyir 'byor nges byed/ gal te ma sleb na phyi nyin zhog ka tshogs kyi skabs phyag gsum byas te gnas brtan la thun ma zin pa'i rgyu mtshan zhu/ chos nyan lta bu'i do gal chen po la dgung thun mi zin par nges na 'gro tshe de lugs kyi dgongs pa zhu/ thun ma zin kyang snga phyir ma zhus na gnas brtan gyis nyes pa bsgrags te phyag 'tshal du gzhug zhog thun gyi grol brda ma byung gong du thabs med kyis 'gro dgos pa'i rkyen glo bur ba byung na gnyer ba brgyud de gnas brtan la dgongs pa zhu/ thun gyi skabs bro skye la lta bu med mi rung du yongs dgos byung yang 'phral du phyir mngags/gal te zhag sdod dgos na gnas brtan la dgongs pa zhu khang las lta bus thun nang du me gtong dgos la yang dgongs pa zhu/ 'on kyang mdzo rta sogs thabs med min na zhag tu bzung mi chog sprang bo gling gseb tu mi gtong zhing khyi dang byi la khar mi bskyil/lto gos sogs la 'dod chung chog shes tshul dang mthun pa ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ nor rnams kun gyi nang na chog shes pa/ / rab mchog legs par lha mi'i ston pas gsungs/ / kun tu chog shes mdzod cig chog mkhyen 421

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgon me'i gsung 'bum/na/ / nor mi bdog kyang yang dag 'byor pa lags/ / gsungs pa ltar chog shes na yo byad mi mang yang dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong la/ chog ma shes na nor ji tsam mang ba bzhin gsog bsrung gi sdug bsngal myong ba ma gtogs longs spyod pa'i bde ba mi myong ste/ shes rab sdong bu las/'bad pas bsags pa'i nor la ni/ / yang dang yang du nyug byed pa/ /bkren pas bye ba ji bzhin du/ / nor rnams sdug bsngal kho nar zad/ ces dang / rtsi shing ji tsam mang ba na me 'chor ba'i nyen che ba ltar nor mang na dgra kun nas sdang zhing srog la rgol ba'i bar du 'gyur ba'i tshul/ shes rab brgya pa las/ bdog pa ha cang spel ba yang / / mjug tu rgud pas gdungs par 'gyur/ / tshang tshing mang dang ldan pa yi/ / sa phyogs tshig par gyur pa bzhin/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / lhag par bza' btung gi don ma gtogs bsam rgyu dang bshad rgyu med pa ni ri khrod pa'i rkang drangs pa yin te/ tsa na lnga'i bstan bcos las/ lto ba 'gengs pa 'ba' zhig 'dod gyur pa/ / de yi bsam pa phyugs dang khyad par ci/ zhes dang / po to pas/ lto phyir gnam ldib pa la chos mi 'ong gsungs shing / yang de nyid kyis/ ltogs kyis dogs pa las shi yis dogs pa mi 'dug ang / gsungs te/ dbyed ka ltogs kyis dogs nas ston 'tsho ba btsal ba'i tshod la bltas na/ de tshun la 'chi bdag sleb nyen yod pas phyi mar phan nges kyi chos shig sgrub dgos rgyu yin zhing / da lta chom rkun sogs kyis rgyu nor sna re phrogs kyis dogs nas skrag cing gnyid mi 'ong ba la bltas na'ang / 'chi bdag sleb dus zas gos dang phral bas mi choganoraphas dang phral bas mi chog khang khyim yul 'khor dang phral bas mi chogaganyen mdza' bshes dang phral bas mi chog/ lus longs spyod thams cad dang nyin gcig la 'brel thag chad de slar ldog pa lta zhog mig gis mthong rgyu tsam 422

༄/ /yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi bca'ayigazur 'debs/yang yod mi srid par 'gro bas/ de lta bu'i dgra stobs po che de do nub gleb bamasang gleb cha med pa mngon sum du grub bzhin du 'jigs skrag cung zad kyang mi skye ba 'di las lhag pa'i glen tshul med cing nges par gdon gyis brlam pas dran rig ngos ma zin pa yin te/ skye bo gso thigs las/ shin tu blun pa la la dag / 'che ba'i rnam pa rab brjed nas/ / bya ba mang po rtsom byed de/ / bdud kyis bslus par rig par bya/ zhes gsungs so/ / zas gos yo byad kyis phongs mi phongs rtsol sgrub byas ma byas dang / ser snas bsdams ma bsdams kyi dbang na med par bsod nams kyi skal ba yod med la thug ste/tsa na ga'i bstan bcos las/ 'byor pa spyad pas mi zad cing / / skal ba zad pas zad par 'gyur/ / sbyin pas zad par mi 'gyur zhing / / ma spyad pa yis 'phel mi 'gyur/ zhes las dbang gis lag tu 'ong dgos kyi de med na/ kho la rgyu nor mang po zhig byung na rang bsam pa de brnab sems yin pas rnyed pa'i sgo 'gog pa ma gtogs phan thogs rgyu ci'ang med pa ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ brnab sems yid la re ba 'joms/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / des na sbyin bdag gi bzang ngan dang gnyer ba'i gtong sgo phra sbom gyi gleng mo mngon tshan che ba rgyun par mi byed/ 'on kyang gnyer ba kho rang yang phyi ma'i don bsam nas 'ong mkhan yin zhing / slar rang gis kyang dge 'dun dang lhan du chos dang zang zing la longs spyod dgos pa gang thad nas bsam ste sbyinabadag gi dad zas chud ma zos par dge 'dun pa'i nyams su phan nges byas ste gtong dgos/ gal te tshul bzhin ma byung na bla ma dang gnas brtan gyis rtsad gcod ngo dga' zol 'jog tu ma song ba byed/ gnyer bas dge 'dun gyi don du phyogs kyi sbyin bdag sogs la slong mo dang dus bzang sogs kyi rteng skul byed srol sngar rgyun ltar byas chog kyang / ha cang sdug thug mdog 423

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/dang / zhal 'deb che chung la 'khang ba sogs gzhan ma dad pa'i rgyur 'gro ba mi byed/ dkon mchog gsum gyi nang nas kyang dge 'dun gyi dkor ni shin tu gnyan pas rang skal las lhag pa ja phor gang la'ang ma 'bag pa gal che/sngar rgyun gyi gtong sgo ma chag pa thub na gnyer la bsnyad pa'i rnyed 'tshol sna tshogs mi byed cing / de 'dra'i sgo nas grags 'dod kyi gtong sgo 'phar ma byas pa'ang dge mtshan mi che bas dpe lam gcig la cha bzhag yod pa bya/dge 'dun gyi bzhed pa dang mi mthun bzhin du rnyed pa phyir bsgyur na nyes pa che ba 'dul ba lung las gsungs pa ltar yin kyang / gnyer ba kha thabs zhan pa'am nam dus ngan pas sbyin bdag rnyed dka' ba byung ste/ thabs med par dus bzang gi snga phyir sbyin bdag byung ba dus bzang dang gseg sprod dgos shar tshe dge 'dun rnams nas kyang gnas tshul gzigs te thugs kyi dgongs pa khrol ba byed/ mdor na bsam rgyu'i gtso bo lto gos su ma song bar blo kha chos phyogs su 'khor ba'i gtan gyi dgos don ma 'chug pa byed/ tshogs 'tshogs tshul dang bzhugs lugs tshul dang mthun pa ni/ thun brda mang ja yod tshe cong nyis rdung dang / ja 'gyed tshwa ra sogs la sum rdung byed pas der bstun pa'i yo byad ma lus pa byas la rjes lus su ma song bar tshogs mnyam du 'dzom pa byed/ gral g.yas spungs g.yon spungs su ma song bas ma mnyam pa dang /tshogs nyung tshe mtha' nas gdong gral du bsnan te sdod tshul gnas brtan gyes bkod pa bzhin byed/ ming btags che ba dang gnas brtan zur ba rnams gral mgor byed cing / ming btags dkyus ma rnams ming btags kyi snga phyi ltar byed/ dgon pa nas 'ongs pa rnams grwa sar tshogs chos lo ji tsam 'grim pa brtsis te de'i rtsis kyi gral mtshams su gzhugs/ gral gdan sogs la phang med dang / gral bar du ja 'pho ba/ thug pa'i nang gi sha 'phen pa/ lag pa 424

༄/ /yidadaga' nga 'dzin gyibaca'ayigazur 'debs/phyir byung ste rtsam pa dzi ba/ kham ha cang che ba/ kham snga ma ma zos par khar bcug pa/ ja sogs rang thad du ma sleb gong nas phor ba radzed pa/ phu cag gi sgra cher byed pa/ zas kyi dus mchil snab mngon du 'dor ba sogs mi byed/lho sgo sogs kyi dus sbyin bdag gi nang du bltas te gar 'gro mi 'tsho bar mdun du bltas nas bzhugs tshugs pa byed/ sku gzugs ma bde ba lta bu'i rkyen thabs med byung na ma gtogs/ bsngo ba ma tshar gong du mi 'gro/ tshogs grol khar dge rtsa bsngo bas kha bsgyur byas te grol/ tshogs bar du grol chud byed tshe na bza' bsum nas 'jog pa las pags thul gyi spu phyir bsngan pa dang g.yas 'phen g.yon 'phen du byas te mi 'jog gung tshigs kyi skabs rtsa ba'i bla ma la bshos bu dang brgyud pa'i bla ma la gcig sangs rgyas byang sems la gcig yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gcig ste/ mtheb kyu gsum phud la dbang ba'i 'byung po dang / 'phrog ma dang de'i bu rnams la mching bu gsum lhag ma'i mching bu rnams phyag len ltar bshams shing ha cang chung ba mi bya/phud mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsam ste zas bsngo yon sbyong sogs dal bus gsung / rang rang gi gshag (shag) tu gung tshigs byed skabs kyang phud mchod sogs tshogs ltar byas na legs/ tshogs nas 'gro dgos pa sogs kyi tsheganas brtan gyi mdun du 'ongs te gus pa'i spyod lam gyes rgyu mtshan dang bcas gnang ba zhu tshul dmigs ltos dang mthun pa byed/ gzhi gsum gyi phyag bzhes tshul dang mthun pa ni/ gnyer pa'i gaṇḍi brdung ste gso sbyong la yar 'tshogs ma thag 'phags pa'i gnas brtan rnams ltung ba phyir bcos pa'i yul dang dpung gnyen du bsam ste spyan 'dren cing phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa dang bcas pa sngon du btang / de rjes dge tshul yod na bkar te dge slong gi phyir bcos bya/ de nas dge tshul rnams nang du 'ongs nas phyir 425
