༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/bcosakhyas la skabs gsum pa dang zla med ston pa ma lhan du gsung / dge tshul dbang thob mkhan yin na phyir bcos rgyas pa'i tshe de'i sngon la 'ong du 'jug gso sbyong grub nas/ sangs rgyas sprul pa zhes sogs gnas bcu'i 'phro gsung / gso sbyong la dge slong thams cad kyis snam sbyar dang dge tshul rnams chos bos nges can du bzhes dgos/ las kyi skabs dpung ba btum nasaldod pa yar lta mar lta byed pa sogs spyod lam mi mthun pa'i rigs mi byed/ gso sbyong gi nyin snga mar rang rang gi thad kyi srang bar sogs gad dar bya/ thabs med kyis chu spor dgos pa dang gnyer pa ma gtogs tshang mas dbyar khas len dgos/ dgos pa gal chen ma gtogs rgyun du dbyar byin rlabs byas te dgon pa sogs su song nas dbyar khas blang yod med mi shes pa lta bu mi byed/ dbyar gyi dus gnas ral ba dang grum pa bcos dgos par gsungs pa ltar yin la/ rgyun par yang gnas khang byi dor bya ba spyor ba'i chos dang po yin pas/ dge sbyor gye dus khams dwangs pa'i thabs dang /bsod nams kyi zhing rnams spyan 'dren pa'i yul du dmigs te nang du gad dar legs par bya/ des mtshon te phyi'i sa rtsi pu shu'i kha dang rdo yab gso ba/steng gi thigs chag dang sngo 'bal ba sogs do dam gang drag byed pa ma gtogs/nomangos phugs su bcug ste ming tshe blos btang la snyad btags nas khang ba 'thor zhig tu btang ste gzhan gyi mig sngar mi mdzes pa mi byed/ 'du khang la'ang lo re bzhin thigs chag dang dbyar dus nyin kha shas re'i mtshams nas wa kha bsal ba/ dgun dpyid kha ba 'phyag rgyu sogs dang / rgyun par 'du khang dang rung khang gi phyi nang kun tu gad dar sogs gnyer bas do dam ma lhod pa dgos la/ nyin ltar gyi mchod pa brje ba/ rgyun gyi tshe 'bar/ gtor kha gso ba/ dus bzang dang lho sgo sogs kyi skabs cho ga rang rang dang mthun 426

༄/ /yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi bca'ayigazwar 'debs/pa'i mchod pa bsham pa/ mtshan mo sgo cha sdom pa/ skabs skabs su gral gdan skam spug chu mgo'i rag gso shing snyigs ma gsol rgyu sogs las ka gang bab snyoms las su ma song ba byed/ gal te le shor byung na skabs skabs su gnas brtan gyis so sor tshig brda 'phrod pa byed/ mang mas kyang 'du khang nye skor dang chu 'gram du mchil snabs dang phyag dar sogs mi 'dor/ 'di dag dbyar gyi dam tshig tu byed dgos par ma zad rgyun du'ang lag len 'deb dgos/ dbyar grol nas ljongs rgyu'i skabs chos gos dang sgom zhwa bzhes te rba mkhar bsnams nas 'phags pa'i mi smra ba'i brdul zhugs kyis ser 'phreng byas te dal bus pheb/ ngal gso ba'i skabs su dbu zhwa phud de/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pas yi dwags 'gro ba gcod/ ces sogs dang / skar ma rab rib ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad gdangs dang bcas pas gsungs te yul gyi lha klu sogs la chos sbyin bya/ mdor na chos 'dul ba nas lam du 'gro tshul gyi spyod lam dang / dmag gi nang / chang 'tshong dang bshan pa'i khyim la sogs pa 'gror mi nyan pa'i yul du ma gsungs pa ltar/ phyogs gang du 'gro na'ang dran shes bsten te gzhan kyi mig sngar mi mdzes pa dang / rang gi dge spyor nyams pa'am/ nyon mongs skye ba'i rkyen dang skur 'deb kyi dogs pa yod pa'i rigs la shin tu 'dzem dgos/ ja skal sogs bgo lugs tshul dang mthun pa ni/ snod gang che byas te dge 'dun mang las lhag na ja phor gang blangs kyang khe chung la dkor sgrib lce bas 'dod dbang du mi gtong bar sku skal man chad thom tshad gcig la cha bzhag pas mnyam po 'ong ba dang lo mtshams pa rnams la'ang skal ba ma 'gyang bar skyel ba sogs gnyer bas khur len byed/lo mtshams pa la chu'ang ja ma chu len gnyis kyis bgos te skyel/ chu dgos pa'i zhog ka chu rtags 'jog cing / de zhag tu 'gyang song na gtso bor gnyer 427

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/ pas do dam dang ri khrod pa gang mthong gis kyang brda sbyor/ ja skal skyel thang mang na tshogs nyung la ja 'deb tshong mang bas sbyin bdag gi bsam pa mi rdzogs pa'am/ ja gsher 'gro bas mang ja gsum man la ja skal thang gcig dang /lnga drug re yod kyang thang gnyis las lhag mi byed/ 'jigs byed bdag 'jug la mang ja lnga/ tshes brgyad la mang ja bzhi/ bde mchog chog rkyang la mang ja lnga/bde lam la mang ja lnga/ lho sgo yod tshe drug gsang 'dus dang spyor la bzhi/rgyas pa la lnga/ mi 'khrugs pa mang ja gsum/ bde mchog bdag 'jug la mang ja drug phyag chen la mang ja gsum/ lho sgo yod tshe bzhi/ mgon chos la mang ja bzhi lho sgo yod tshe lnga/ 'di 'dra kun dpe gcig la cha bzhag pa ma gtogs so so'i 'dod dbang du btang mi chog mdor na sgrig lam gyi khog bca' yig dkyus ltar yin kyang / zhib cha'i rigs zur 'debs 'di dang sbyar nas byed dgos pas/ yi ge gnas brtan gyis bzung ste mtshams mtshams su tshogs par snyan sgon dang rting gnon mi g.yel ba byed dgos/ /428

༄/ /ma ru hor chen dgon pa'i bca' yigaro༅/ / a ru hor chen dgon pa bkra shis bsam 'grub gling gi bca' yig chos kyi snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄ / / oṃ bde legs su gyur cig / dge mtshan bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / / legs byas 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpag bsam shing / /yang dag thar lam gsal ba'i sgon me mchog / rgyal ba'i bstan pa ring du gnas gyur cig / gang gi bka' bzhin sgrub pa lhur blangs na/ / nam yang mi bsru gtan bde'i srog ster ba/ / lha mi'i ston pa rnam 'dren shākya'i tog / sras dang slob mar bcas la gus phyag 'tshal/ / khyad par rgyal ba'i dbang bo tsong kha pa/ / kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams/ / dbyer med thugs rjes byang chub bar du skyong / / dge ldan bstan pa'i srung ma kun gyi gtso/ / 'jam dpal bka' sdod las kyi gshin rje dang / / ma cig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug mas/ / sde 'dir srung skyob g.yel med 'phrin las mdzod/ / rnam grol don gnyer don mthun 'dus pa'i sde'i/ / khrims su bcas pa'i bca' yig gru gzings che/ / bshad sgrub ba dan dkar pos mdzes pa 'dir/ / zhugs nas bslab gsum nor bu'i dga' ston mdzod/ / de'ang phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan rin po che yun du gnas pa ni/ de nyid 'dzin cing spel ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde zhig la rag las pas/ 'phags pa'i yul du paṇa grub 429

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/rnams kyis dpal na lend+ra sogs chos gzhi du ma btsugs shing / gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'jam mgon bla ma yab sras kyes gdan sa chen po gsum sogs phyag 'debs mdzad/ de nas lnga brgya tha ma'i skabs su bstan pa byang nas byang du dar ba'i lung bstan dus la babs pa na/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdo smad bstan pa'i 'byung khungs dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil btab/ de dag gi thugs rje'i 'od zer rim par 'phros pa las chos sde 'dis mtshon phyogs 'dir chos grwa che chung mang du chags pa yin la/ dge 'dun gyi sde yang bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag tu 'gyur nges shig 'byung ba chos khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung / bshad sgrub kyi 'khor lo zung du 'brel ba zhig la rag las pas sde 'dir khrims su bya ba'i rim pa'ang / thog mar 'jug pa po rten gyi gang zag rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom ldan/ nag chang rkus sogs kyi mthong thos dogs gsum med cing / grwa tshang gzhan nas gnas dbyungacos pa ma yin pa/ lta grub gtsang zhing skyabs 'gro ltung bshags sgrol sher sogs blo 'don dang yi ge'i rgyugs 'phrod pa'i thog nas grwa tshang du 'jugade nas gsar bu rnams chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i phyir chos mthun gyi dge rgan re bsten dgos/ des kyang 'dul ba'i kun spyod dang 'dzin skyor byed lugs sogs gnas kyi bla ma'i ming don mthun par byed/ las sne mo rnams kyis pha rol po'i blo 'dzin gyi tshod dang bstun nas zla ba re re'i mtshams su rgyugs bzhag ste/ grwa tshang rang gi 'don cha ma rdzogs bar du tho yig steng nas chad lus med par len/ gzhung chen mo'i blo 'dzin sogs yon tan slob mkhan rnams la legs sos gzengs bstod/ spyir yang yon tan can dang grwa ba bgres pa rnams la zhwa phud gzan 'bebs kyis mtshon pa'i rtsi 'jog go ma log par bya/ dgon nang du bud med zhag tu mi sdod cing nyin skor 'ong ba rnams 430

༄/ / ma ru hor chen dgon pa'i bca'ayigakyang dge bskos la dgongs pa zhu/ sho mig mang sogs bag med kyi rtsed mo'i rigs dang / rgyang skad ku co tsab hral gye 'phyong (mchong)rgyug sogayokhyim pa sun 'byin du 'gro ba'i bya ba byas mi chog mi dpung gra sdeb las sne mor lan slog pa rnams gnas nas dbyung zhing / gzhan ma'i mkhon ('khon) 'dzing rnams la bab 'os kyi chad pa 'gel/ las sne mo rnams kyis kyang nye ring du ma song ba'i 'grig lam gyi rting gnon las 'bras dang mthun par byed/ ston dpyid gnyis su long skabs dang bstun nas cho ga chos spyod rnams kyi 'don rta dbyangs gar thig sogs phyag len phra zhib grwa ba skor re la slob tu bcug yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong chag med du byas te/ rgyud nyes ltung gis ma gos pa'i thabs la 'bad/ gso sbyong nam yin gyi zhogs ga'i tshogs la 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po gsung zhing / rgyun gyi zhogs tshogs la bla mchod/ 'jigs byed bdud las rnam rgyal/ gdugs sher sgo la gsum/ skabs su gang gtso che ba'i tshe gzungs/ seng gdong ma/ lo gyon ma/ rnam 'joms/ yig drug sogs ci rigs bab bstun/ lhun grub bde stong ma/ rab 'byams rgyal ba ma/rnam dag smon lam ma rnams gsungs/ tshogs 'tshogs skabs tshogs bcu btang nas ma 'gyangs par phebs shing 'du khang mtha' skor nas phyag skor sogs zhal 'don dang sbrags nas byed/ nang du phebs nas ya yor ma song ba'i gral gyi bzhugs lugs/ dbu mdzad kyis 'don pa gang bskul mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig gi sgo nas tshang mas khur du bzhes te gsung tshul/bzhes pa sogs la phu cags kyi sgra med par 'dul ba ltar gyi bzhes lugs sogs sgo thams cad nas dang ba 'dren nges pa byed/ phar phebs tshur phebs kyi tshe'ang na bza' mnab lugs dang phebs tshul sogs spyod lam bag dang ldan par bya/ rgyun du'ang bstan pa'i gzhi ma chos 'dul ba kho na la rag las 431

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/pas/ phyi nang kun tu bslab pa'i bsrung mtshams ngo lkog med pa la 'bad pa nyams len gyi mthil du byed/ tshes brgyad bco lnga gnyis kyi dus bzang la chos spyod smon lam 'gro gang che dang / nyi shu dgu la bskang gso rtsal du 'don/bcu pa'i nyi shu lnga/ gnyis pa'i tshes lnga/ bcu pa'i nyer bdun/ dang po'i nyer bdun rnams la rje bdag nyid chen po/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku snga phyi/ 'di ga'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dus mchod sngar rgyun ltar ma chag pa byed/ zla ba dang po'i smon lam dang / bdun pa'i smon lam gyi zhogs tshogs la 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ tsha rting mar brgyad stong pa grangs gsog dang / bka' 'gyur klog 'don/ gung tshigs dang dgung jar chos spyod smon lam gtso bor 'don/ bzhi pa'i bco lngar sman bla rgyas pa'i dus bzangagatong zhing / des mtshon te drug pa'i drug dgu pa'i nyer gnyis cho 'phrul sogs kyi dus chen rnams su sgyung gnas/ phyag skor/ sa tshwa 'debs pa/rten la mchod 'bul sogs dge sgrub la 'bad/ bcu gnyis pa'i mar ngo chos skyong thams cad kyi bskang gso gzab rgyas gtong zhing / lhag par chos rgyal la rtsal du bton te/ grub na gtor rgyag rgyas pa dang / de ma grub kyang lo'i dbyu gu tshang bar byas te drug cu pa gang mang bstan pa spyi sgos kyi rim gror dmigs nas bsngo/ sbyin bdag gi mang 'gyed sogs kyang dge 'dun gyi phyogs su 'gro nges pa'i do dam las byed rnams kyis khur du len/ nad pa lta bu ma yin pas tshogs la ma chag par phebs shing / phebs mi thub pa'i dgos pa byung tshe dge bskos la dgongs pa zhu/ zhag bcu grangs lhag tshe bla mar yang dgongs pa zhu dgos la/ dgongs pa zhus kyang grong nang du yun ring mi sdod/ mdor na rnam pa kun tu rang gis khas blangs pa'i bcas khrims dang / dge 'dun gyi nangakhrims spang blang 'dzol med du byas na rang gi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs kyi 432

/ /ma ru hor chen dgon pa'i bca' yiga'adun ma thams cad bde blag tu 'grub cing / de dag la yi dam chos srung rnams kyis kyang mgon skyabs g.yel ba med par mdzod cig ces thugs rje bskul ba'i mtshams sbyor nan tan bgyid ces go bar bya ba'i yi ge lcags bya'i zla tshes dge bar chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil nas bris pa dge legs 'phel/ /de'ang chos ldan gyi bya ba khyad par can la 'jug pa'i thog mar yul khyad par can la skyabs su 'gro ba'am mchod par brjod pa sngon du 'gro dgos/de'ang rtsom pa'i mgo yin na mchod brjod dang / bshad pa dang tshogs gleng lta bu'i skabs gus 'dud zer/ bstan pa spyi skad la skyabs 'gro zer ba don la khyad med/ mchod brjod byas nas las su bya ba gang la 'jug pa yin zhe na/sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub kyis/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de/ / bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing / / bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa/ / bcom ldan shākya seng ge zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can des dang por theg pa mchog gi rigs kyi nus pa yongs su smin te 'gro ba yongs su sgrol ba'i lhag bsam gyi go cha bzhes nas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du dag pa dang ma dag pa'i skye ba sna tshogs brgyud de phyin drug bsdu bzhis bsdus pa'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu la bslab par mdzad/mthar 'og min stug po bkod par sgrib gnyis kyi 'ching ba bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus par spangs nas sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub mngon du mdzad de zhing khams 'byam klas par sprul pa'i bkod pa sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ / khyad par du mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir gzigs pa rnam pa lnga la gzigs nas ser 433

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/skya'i grong du yab rgyal po zas gtsang dang / yum sgyu ma lha mdzes kyi sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo nyer dgu'i bar du rgyal srid bskyangs te ma rung ba'i skye bo dregs pa can rnams sgyu rtsal sogs kyi sgo nas 'dul bar mdzad/ mthar byang chub kyi shing drung du lo drug dka' ba spyad de shing rta'i sa ga'i dus chen gyi srod la bdud btul/ gung la mnyam par bzhag tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan te/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ / bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed/ / su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas/ / mi smra nags kyi nang du gnas par bya/ / zhes gsungs nas zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i bar du chos ma gsung bar bzhugs/ de nas tshangs pa chen pos gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul te gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ wa ra ḍā sir chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi'am zhib rtsis kyis tshes drug la 'khor lnga sde bzang po la bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor/ de nas bya rgod phung po'i rir bka' bar ba mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor ram shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos 'khor bskor/ de nas yangs pa can la sogs par bka' tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor bskor te/ mdor na gdul bya'i dbang po'i rim pa dang bstun nas chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong ngamagrub mtha' 'og ma ltar chos phung brgyad khri gsungs pa yin/ de thams cad tshur bsdu na/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan dang / / tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang / / rtogs brjod de lta bu byung dang / / skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang / / rmad byung gtan la phab pa'i sde/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis dang / de'ang bsdu na dgu dang / de dag kyang bsdu na mdo sde rgyan las/ sde snod dag ni gsum mam gnyis kyang rung / zhes gsungs pa ltar mdo mngon 'dul ba'i sde snod gsum 434

༄/ / ma ru hor chen dgon pa'i bca'ayigamam/ zeg pa che chung gi sde snod gnyis su 'du/ de'ang 'dul ba'i sde snod lung sde bzhi'i brjod don ni sdom pa ma thob pa thob pa/ thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba/ nyams pa phyir bcos pa'i thabs gsum du bsdus nas ston pa 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba ni dgongs 'grel kun gyi nang nas rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bur gyur pa'i dbang gis rje yab sras kyi dus nas bzung da lta'i bar du 'dul ba'i 'chad nyan de'i steng nas bshad pa yin/ mngon pa'i sde snod la lung gi mngon pa dang rigs pa'i mngon pa gnyis yod/ lung gi mngon pa la mngon pa gong 'og gnyis yod/ 'og ma ni mdzod rtsa ba dgongs 'grel mtha' dpyod yan lag dang bcas pa yin/ theg chen gyi mngon pa la kun rdzob pa dang don dam pa'i dbang du byas pa gnyis yod pas de dag ston pa rtsa ba 'jug bzhi gsum sogs yin/ lhag par chos rnams kyi don dam pa'i rang spyi'i mtshan nyid ston pa la 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod thams cad kyis dbu ma 'jug pa bshad gzhir byas nas gtan la phab pa yin/rigs pa'i mngon pa ni slob dpon phyogs glang gi tshad ma mdo/ de'i dgongs 'grel dpal chos kyi grags pa'i tshad ma sde bdun/ gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum/ 'phros pa yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos bzhi las/ lus lta bu tshad ma rnam 'grel ni thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mngon sum rjes dpag gi rigs pas sgrub pa la 'gran zla dang bral bas na nang rig pa'i bstan bcos kyi gtso bor rje yab sras kyis bzhed do/ / mdo sde'i sde snod ni/rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi rab dang phul dang gtso bo dang rtse mor gyur pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo sde yin la/ de la dgongs pa 'grel pa rgya 'grel nyer gcig tu grags pa sogs yod kyang mngon rtogs rgyan ni rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi don ma tshang ba med par ston pa la 'di nyid mchog tu 435
ra / /gung bang bstan ba'i name'i gsung 'bum/gyur pa yin no/ / 'di'ang 'jam dbyangs bla ma de nyid kyi gsung bshad dri ma med pa zhal nas thos pa ji lta ba bzhin yi ger bkod pa'o/ /436

༄/ /khri bshad bzhugs so/༄༅/ / khri bshad bzhugs so/༄7/ /'o lags so/ / ji skad du/ rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma de dag gi /'azin las snying la zhugs pas phyogs kun tu/ /dpal ldan rdo rje zeg pa'i bstan pa mchog / ma lus rgyas par byed pa'i bkra shis shog / ces dam pa'i chos kyi mnga' bdag dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam grub pa'i dngos brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje bskul ba'i bden tshig gis shis pa brjod pas sngon bsus te/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung / gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtshor thos bsam sgom pa'i go cha lhur bzhes pa'i dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs kyi dbus su gang zhu ba yin na/ spyir 'gro ba kun la rgyu med par mnyes gshin pa'i rnam 'dren rgyal ba thams cad dang / khyad par snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus su mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir byon nas rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa'i chos 'khor ma lus bskor bar mdzad pa ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid ni 'phral yun du bka' drin che ba kun gyi rtsa ba yin la/ de nas gtad rabs bdun dang / 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ lca nag dril gsum/la lī ta badzra/ chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams dang / dus zhabs pa che chung sogs mdo sngags so so'i bshad sgrub kyi khur 'dzin pa'i paṇḍi ta dang grub pa'i dbangaphyug gnam gyi skar tshogs lta bu rim par byon pa rnams bka' drin che/sgos su mdo sde kun gyi za ma tog dang rgyud sde kun gyi rgyal po/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud dung phyur gnyis dang bye ba phrag gsum gyi yang rtse dpal gsang ba 437

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/'dus pa'i bstan pa 'di nyid la mtshon nas rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi dbang du byas na/ ston pas chags bral gyi theg pa gtso bor ston bzhin pa'i skabs su/ gsang sngags chags bcas kyi lam gyis 'tshang rgya ba'i theg pa'i mchog 'di dang por zhu ba po chos rgyal ind+ra zu ti/ klu las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ bram ze chen po sogs thog mar bka' drin che/ de nas mdor byas/ mdo bsre/ rim lnga/ spyod bsdus sogs kyi sgo nas rgyud don blta ba'i mig 'byed pa klu sgrub yab sras dang / rtsa ba'i rgyud du mtha' drug tshul bzhis rgyasabatab pa'i zab gnad mtha' dag bshad rgyud chen po drug gi sgo nas rgya cheragatan la phab ste/ gnam la nyi zla gnyis dang / sa la gsal ba gnyis zhes grags pa'i byed po dpal ldan zla ba'i zhabs sogs bar du bka' drin che/rgyud don sil bur gnas pa mtha' dag gdul bya blo mchog dman kun gye nyams len gyi rim par gcig tu 'dril tshul gsal bar mdzad pa dpal nā ro ta ba dang mnyam med jo bo chen po sogs tha mar bka' drin che/ gangs ri'i rwa bas bskor ba'i byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di'i dbang du byas na spyir rigs gsum kun tu bzang po sogs kyi rnam 'phrul chos rgyal mes dbon gong ma thams cad dang / ska cog zhang gsum/ mal gyo mar do/ 'brog mi/ tsa mi/rwa skyo sogs mun gling chos kyis dkar por bsgyur ba'i lo paṇa rim byon bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i bka' bab kyi bstan pa'i cha shas so so nas gdul bya'i skal ba dang 'tsham par 'dzin skyong spel ba'i skyes chen dam pa snga phyi ji snyed cig byon pa thams cad bka' drin che ba'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pas/ mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas/ / rtag tu ri mor bya ba'i 'os/ / bkur 'os brjed par bya ba'i mchog / phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab/ / ces pa'i don lta bu yin mod kyang / 'dir thun mong ma yin pa me tog phog pa'i lha skal du 438

༄/ /khri bshad bzhugs so/gyur pa dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lam la sgos su mtshon na/ lo chen rin chen bzangapo/ sgra bsgyur mar pa/ mgos khug pa lhas btsas sogs bstan pa'i yang snying 'di nyid dang por bsil ldan gyi ljongs su spel bar mdzad pa de rnams thog mar bka' drin che/ de nas rgyal ba dbang po'i tog gi spyan sngar thugs bskyed dam bca' mdzad pa bzhin/ zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba dang gsang chen rdo rje theg pa zung du 'jug pa'i lam bzang 'di nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin gsal bar mdzad pa la rgyal ba nyid dang dbyer ma mchis pa 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po/ sras kyi thu bo mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur pa rnams dang khyad par sngon rgyal sras snying stobs chen po de nyid kyis 'khor rgyal sras rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas bzhengs te thugs bskyed dam bca' mdzad pa'i rten 'brel dang rgyu mthun gyis/ rje bla mas 'grel ba bzhi sprags kyi glegs bam phyag tu bsnams nas 'di la bdag thub pa su yod gsung ba'i dus su rje bla ma'i mdun der sras kyi thu bo gser gyi ri bo'i 'phreng ba lta bu bsgrigs yod pa'i nang nas rje btsun shes rab seng ge bzhengs nas khas len zhus shing /rjebla ma'i bka' bzhin smad rgyud rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'dus sde phyag 'debs mdzad/ khong gi sras kyi thu bo 'dul nag pa dpal ldan bzang po la bka' phab ste srad rgyud btab pas rgyud pa stod smad gnyis su grags pa byung nas rgyud kyi rgyal bo 'di nyid kyi bshad sgrub nyin mo bzhin du gsal bar mdzad pas rje yabasras rnams bar du bka' drin che/ smad rgyud la khrid chen brgyad dang /stod rgyud la khrid chen drug tu gtso bor grags pa rnams de skabs gdul bya dbang po mchog tu gyur pa rnams la rang rang gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi khungs dang sbyar/ 'phags bod kyi dgongs 'grel mkhan po so so'i bzhed srol ma 'dres 439

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/pas spu ris phyes/ nyams myong rdo rus thug pa'i man ngag gis gzer btab/sbyang gzhi spyong byed/ smin lam grol lam/ lag rjes thams cad rwa sprad de zung 'jug lag bcangs su gtod pa lta bu zhig yod 'dug pa/ phyi nas dus kyi rim pas de ji lta ba bzhin dka' 'ang / rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dbang bka'/yi dam gyi lha du ma'i rjes gnang / 'phags bod kyi gzhung tshad ldan rnams kyi lung rgyun/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal lung gis brgyan pa'i khrid sogs dam pa bar ma chad pa las brgyud de 'ongs pa'i gdams pa zab mo rnams thar 'dod yongasakyi nyer 'tsho'i gzhi rten gcig pur da lta'i bar du rgyun ma nyams par spel ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rim par byon pa rnams bka' drin che/ khyad par du 'jam mgon bla ma'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs par bka'i 'khor los 'dod dgur mnga' bsgyur ba'i khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje de nyid nas bka' pod chen po lngas mtshon pa'i legs bshad kyis sa steng khyab par mdzad pas bstan pa'i srog bzung zhing / lha dang bla mas lung bstan te mdospad du rgyud grwa gnyis 'deb par gsung ba bzhin dgon lung gi rgyud pa dang 'di gnyi ga btab ste rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rmang gzhi btsugs/ de nyid slar yang bstan 'gro'i mgon skyabs gcig pur byon pa bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i skyabs mgon thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rje btsun 'jigs med dbang po'i zhal snga nas de nyid kyis sngar sa bon tsam du gnas pa de nyid rgyud don 'chad nyan gyi sdong po/ cho ga phyag bzhes cha lag dang bcas pa'i lo 'dab rgyas shing / zab lam rim gnyis kyi 'bras bu smin pa'i dpag bsam gyi ljon pa chen por mdzad/ de nas slar yang rang cag rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa skyabs mgon mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che 'di 440

༄/ / khri bshad bzhugs so/nyidakyi rnam par byon nas bzhugs pa'i gzi byin gyis rgyud sde'i 'chad nyan/dge 'dun gyi 'dus tshogs/ chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor gang thad nas gra ma nyams par gnas pa 'di byung ba yin pas/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje sku 'phreng rim byon yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams tha mar bka' drin che/ bla med rdo rje zeg pa'i sbas pa dang mthar thug gi don sogs la ltos na/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi jeg pa ni yig don dang spyi don tsam 'ig yin mod/ bdag lta bus rang blo'i nus pa gang yod kyis sbyangs na'ang de'i 'gro phyogs tsam yang shes dka' ba'i tshe/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi thugs kyi gsang mdzod 'di lta bu blos mi dpog par ma zad sngar sbyang ba'ang ma song bas/khyed rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po sku tshe hril bor rgyud don 'chad nyan gyis sgo 'dogs bcad cing / bsam sgom gyis myong ba byang chub pa rnams la 'chad nyan byed rgyu dka' na'ang / skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' gyen bzlog ma nus pas/ de ring gza' skar tshes grangs phun sum tshogs par dam pa rim byon gyisabyin gyis brlabs pa'i chos kyi gdan khrir 'khod pa la/ spyir sger kun nasalegs 'bul sogs rgya cher bstar ba 'di dag bsngo bya'i rdzas su byas te bsngo ba re byed pa'i phyag srol 'dug pa bzhin byed pa la/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams nas spyir dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis bsngags pa'i smonaganas rnam par dag pa lhun gyis grub pa dang / khyad par du rang cag dpon slob rnams kyis sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i 'chad nyan/ bslab gsum rim gnyis kyi nyams len sogs bstan pa'i bya ba 'dun pa chig dril gyi sgo nas byed pa la phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe'i rigs gang yang mi 'byung zhing /'dod don mtha' dag ji ltar smon pa bzhin du 'grub ste/ 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa rin po che'i mdzes rgyan du 'gyur ba dang /441

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/mkha' mnyam lus can yongs kyi phan bde'i dpal du 'gyur ba sogs kyi spyan dmigs rgya gang che gsal btab ste bsngo ba'i mthun 'gyur thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ bsngo ba bya/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /zhes sogs sho lo ka gnyis/ rmad byung lam 'di rang nyid gcig pus kyang / / zhes sogs/ gtsug lag khang rnams klog pa dang / / sogs/'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / / zhes sogs/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i/ / zhes pa nas/ bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni stag lung sprul pa'i sku rgyud pa'i khrir bzhugs skabs de dang 'brel mtshungs pa'i khri bshad cig dgos tshul byung ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /gang zhig rnam par dkar ba'i dad gus/ zhes pa nas/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam bzang gsal bar mdzad pa gsang bdag sa snying sogs kye rnam 'phrul zla ba bzang po dang lha dbang la sogs pa chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams dang dus zhabs pa che chung sogs rgya gar du srol bzang po 'di nyid spel pa'i paṇa grub ji snyed cig byon pa rnams bka' drin che/ zhes pa nas/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang / de nas sku phreng bar ma tshad med pa'i bka' drin dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'chad pa legs bshad/ zhes pa nas/ mgul ba mdzes par mdzad pa/ 'khor lo gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i khur rang nyid gcig pus bdag gir mdzad cing / khyad par rang cag rjes 'jug rnams ma 'ongs pa na drag po 'khor lo can gyi bstan pa dang mjal te yang dag pa'i lam gyis btsan sa zin pa'i phyir stong chen yi ge lnga'i mthar thug bde ba chen po dang /thig le yi ge drug gi phyag rgya chen mo zung du 'jug pa gnyis med dus kyi 'khor 442

༄/ / khri bshadabazhugs so/lo'i bshad sgrub kyi rkang tshugs pa'i phyir e waṃ chos kyi 'khor lo'i gling 'di nyid gsar 'debs mdzad pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun dkon mtshag 'jigs med dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / de nyid slar yang rang cag rnams kyi mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam par byon pa/ gzhon nu nyid nas mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyi rtsal yongs su rdzogs shing / rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las kyis rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu khyab pa/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ skyabs gcig mthong ba don ldan mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med nyi ma'i zhal snga nas yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams bdag cag rnams la bka' drin lhag par che/ zhes sogs dkyus ltar ro/ / 'di ni dus 'khor dpon slob kyi khri 'don skabs kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung gi khri bshad kyi nang du snon rgyur stsal pa'o/ /443

lhu/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / mdo'i chigs bcad gsum gyi don cung zad bkral ba sogs le'u tshan thor bu sna tshogs bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo mu dīsdu ya/ gso spyong sogs kyi skabs su gdon pa/ skar ma rab rib ces sogs dang / brtsam par bya zhing zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum gyi don cung zad dgrol ba la/ dang po ni rdo rje gcod pa las/ skar ma rab rib mar me dang / / sgyu ma zil ba chu bur dang / / rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bur/ / 'dus byas chos rnams de ltar blta/ / zhes gsungs pa 'dis khyad par bzhi'i sgo nas 'dus byas thams cad don dam par med pa'i tshul la 'jug par gsungs te/ rang bzhin gye mtshan nyid/ ro myang ba'i mtshan nyid/nyes dmigs kyi mtshan nyid/ nges par 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid do/ / de la rang bzhin gyi mtshon nyid ni skar ma dang / rab rib dang / mar me'i dpe gsum gyis gtan la phab ste/ skar mas snang stong gnyis tshogs kyi rang bzhin/rab rib kyis stong pa'i rang bzhin/ mar mes snang ba'i rang bzhin mtshon pa yin/ dang po ni/ 'jug pa las/ dngos kun yang dag brdzun pa mthong ba yis/ / dngos rnyed ngo bo gnyis ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ / gsungs pa ltar/dngos po thams cad kyi steng na mi rtog ye shes la snang tshul dang / tha snyad pa'i rnam rtog la snang tshul gye rang bzhin gnyis re yod pa'i snga ma ni gnas lugs mthar thug don dam pa dang / phyi ma kun rdzob pa'i gnas lugs yin/ khyad 444

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/par de gnyi ga skar ma'i dpe gcig pus mtshon nus te/ nyin mo skar ma mi mthong bar nam mkha' g.ya' dag snang ba bzhin/ 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes kyis kun rdzob pa'i spros pa ci yang ma gzigs par dgag bya rnam par bcad pa'i stong pa kho na gzigs mtshan mo mun pa 'thibs pa na skar ma'i tshogs ches gsal bar 'char ba bzhin/ tha snyad pa'i shes pa'i ngo bor kun rdzob kyi chos sna tshogs su 'char zhing / khyad par du ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bcas pa la ma dag pa'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs su 'char ba yin te/ zur phyi ma 'di la tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i ngo bor 'jog tshul don mthun gcig dang /phyin ci log gi 'khrul snang don mi mthun gyi cha gnyis su 'byed dgos/ ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi dbang gis yul rang ngos nas bden grub tu shar ba'i snang ba de ni blo 'khrul ba de'i ngo kho nar yod kyi/ don la med pas rab rib kyi dpes snang tshul de ltar du grub pas stong pa gtso bor mtshon pa yin te/'jug pa las/ rab rib med la'ang skra shad blor 'gyur na/ / de lta ma yin de phyir de yod min/ / zhes pa ltar/ don dam par grub na de nyid de'i gnas lugs mthar thug tu 'gyur dgos shing / de ltar na gnas lugs tshol ba'i rigs shes kyis dpyad mthar rnyed dgos rgyu la/ de'i ngo bor ma grub phyir te/ dper na rab rib can gyis mthong ba'i skra shad de nges par yod na mig la skyon med pa'i gang zag gis lhag tu gsal bar mthong dgos rgyu la des ma mthong ba de don la ma grub pa'i dbang gis yin pa dang 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /yul rang gi yo bos ma grub kyang snang phyogs kyi cha rnams bsnyon med du 'jog dgos pa ni/ rkong bu la mar me ngo bo nyid kyis mi gnas kyang / mar dang sdong bu sogs du ma 'dus pa na mar me 'byung ba bston med pa bzhin/ las dang nyon mongs sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs 'dus pa'i dbang gis srid pa'i skye ba 445

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/sogs 'khor 'das thams cad 'byung ba yin no/ / dngos smra ba rnams/don byed nus pa gang yin pa/ / de 'dir don dam yod pa ste/ / zhes sogs kyis rgyu rkyen du ma 'dus nas 'bras bu skyed pa de don dam par grub pa'i rgyu mtshan du bshad kyang / dbu ma ba'i lugs 'dir rgyu rkyen du ma 'dus nas bskyed pa de nyid rang bzhin gyis med pa'i rgyu mtshan mthar thug pa yin te/go cha'i bkod pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ chos rnams rkyen ni mang po dag /lhan cig 'dus las byung ba yin/ / rkyen ni mang po 'dus pa'i phyir/ / rang bzhin gyis ni med pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ro myang ba'i mtshan nyid ni sgyu ma'i dpes bstan te/ dper na sprul gzhi de'u shing tsam la sgyu ma mkhan gyis yid du 'ong mi 'ong gi dngos po sna tshogs su sprul pa na de la brten nas chags zhen dang / 'jigs skrag sogs sna tshogs skye'ang don dngos gnas la phan gnod ci yang 'byung du med pa ltar/sems can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'ang don rang gi ngo bos grub pa med bzhin du bden 'dzin gyi ma rig pas bslad pa'i dbang gis chags sdang sna tshogs skyes te sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar byed pa yin pas/ bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa las/ sgyu ma lta bu yin pa de ni mi bslu ba ma yin te rnam pa gzhan du gnas pa'i dngos po la rnam pa gzhan du snang ba'i phyir ro/ / zhes pa ltar/ khyi rdo phyir 'brang ba'am/ byis pa la spar mo stong ba bcang ste bstan pa bzhin kha khrid nas re dogs sna tshogs la sbyor ba dper byas te/ don la de'i rjes su 'brang nas ro ma myang bar zhen pa log dgos zhes pa yin no/ /gsum pa nyes dmigs kyi mtshan nyid la/ mi rtag pa'i tshul gyis nyes dmigs su lta tshul dang / sdug bsngal ba'i tshul gyis nyes dmigs su lta tshul gnyis/ snga ma zil ba'i dpes bstan te/ rtswa rtse'i zil ba phra mo de nyi 'od phog 446

༄/ / le'u tshan thor bu sna tshogasabazhugs so/pa sogs rkyen cung zad tsam gyi mod la skam par 'gyur ba shin tu mi brtan pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa bzhin/ 'dus byas thams cad rang grub tsam nasagyis 'byung gi rgyu la mi ltos par 'jig pa'i ngang tshul can yin pas yid brtan cung zad kyang med de/ 'di la dgongs nas mdo dang rgyan du mi rtag pa la ma mchis pa'i rnam pa dang med pa'i rnam pa zhes gsungs shing / dbus mthar yang / mi rtag don ni med don dang / / zhes sogs gsungs pa yin no/ / chu bur gyi dpes sdug bsngal ba'i tshul gyi nyes dmigs bstan te/ chu bur ni rdol ba na'ang chu'i rang bzhin/ yal ba na'ang chu'i rang bzhin du 'gro ba ltar/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba ni mdo las/ gang cung zad tshor ba 'di ni 'dir sdug bsngal lo/ / zhes pa ltar/ tshor ba sdug bsngal skyes tsam nas sdug bsngal gyi rnam par 'byung / zag bcas kyi bde ba rnams 'gags pa na sdug bsngal gyi rnam par 'gro bas 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal du bshad/ btang snyoms ni sdug bsngal kun gyi gzhi byed pas khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes bshad de/ de gsum ga byis pa rnams kyi bsam ngor bde sdug dang mchog dman gyi khyad par yod kyang / 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi gzigs ngor/ 'khor bakhab kyi rtse mo na/ / bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ / gsungs pa bzhin bde ba'i rang bzhin cung zad kyang med par sdug bsngal las ma 'das pas/sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /bzhi pa nges par 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid ni stong nyid sgom tshul dngos yin te/ thal 'gyur pa'i lugs 'dir 'khor ba'i rtsa ba mthar thug bden 'dzin kho na dang / zhi sgo gnyis pa med pa stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kho na yin pas 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ba'i thar pa thob pa la med mi rung du dekho na dgos kyi/ mi rtag sdug bsngal sogs su bsgoms pas gnas skabs 447

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/'khor ba las yid 'byung ba tsam 'ong yang / srid pa'i rtsa ba mthar thug drungasaphyung ste sems kyi dri ma ma lus par sbyong mi nus pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa zhes/ / bya ba gsum po sems spyong byed/ / mchog tu sems ni sbyong byed pa'i/ / chos ni rang bzhin med pa yin/ / zhes so/ / 'di'i thad kyi ka ma la shī la'i rdor gcod 'grel par/ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ gal te chos la bdag med so sor rtog / de ltar brtag nas gal te sgom byed pa/ / de ni mya ngan 'das thob 'bras bu'i rgyu/ / rgyu gzhan gang yin des ni zhi mi 'gyur/ / zhes sogs drangs te thar pa thob pa la nges par rtogs dgos par gsungs pa ni bdag med tsam la bya yi/ bden stong kho nar mi rung ste theg gsum rtogs rigs mi 'dra ba'i phyir dang / 'grel pa de nyid du/ 'dus byas thams cad ni bdag med pa rnam pa gnyis dang ldan te/ zhes gsungs/ bdag med gnyis stong gzhi'i sgo nas bzhagapa min pas thal 'gyur ba'i de dang mi 'dra ba 'dus byas thams cad ces pas shes so/ / dbyig gnyen gyi 'grel par yang / gang zag dang chos kyibadag med pa dang rjes su 'brel ba la dmigs pas nges par 'byung ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs te phyogs mthun no/ / des na 'di la 'das pa'i dngos po/ da ltar ba'i dngos po/ ma 'ongs pa'i dngos po rang bzhin med par sgom tshul gsum yod pas/ dang po ni rmi lam gyi dpes mtshon pa yin te/'jug pa las/ rmi lam dmigs pa'i yul dag mthong nas ni/ / zhes sogs ltar/ dri lam du rmis pa'i dngos po dran pa las 'dod chags sogs skye'ang /de'i tshe mi lam gyi dngos po de nyid med par mngon sum du grub pa bzhin/'das pa'i las kyi 'bras bu myong du yod kyang las de ngo bo nyid kyis grub mi dgos so/ / rtsa she rab byed bdun par yang / / rmi lam ji bzhin sgyu ma 448

༄/ / le'u tshan thor bur tshogs bzhugs so/bzhin/ / dri za'i grong khyer ji bzhin du/ / de bzhin skye dang de bzhin gnas/de bzhin du ni 'jig pa gsungs/ / zhes dpe gsum gsungs pa'i rmi lam gyi dpe des 'das pa mtshon par shes rab sgon mer bshad pa'ang 'di dang 'dra'o/ / da ltar ba'i dngos po rnams glog gi dpes gsungs te/ de ni thog mar 'di nas byung / bar du 'di la brten te gnas/ tha mar 'dir 'gro zhes ngos gzung rgyu med par yud tsam zhig dkar lam gyis snang nas de ma thag med 'gro ba bzhin/ da ltar ba'i dngos po rnams kyang sems kyi snang cha tsam las bya byed las gsum dang / rgyu 'bras ngo bo gsum sogs sgo gang nas btsal kyang mi rnyed pa rig shes kyis btags don btsal ba tsam nas dmigs pa'i gtad so zhig ste yal 'gro ba glog mi brtan pa dang dpe sbyar ba yin no/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dngos po rnams sprin dang dpe sbyor tshul ni/ nam mkha' stong sang tsam la char 'bebs pa sogs kyi nus pa med kyang der sprin tshogs pa las char 'bebs pa dang / des lo tog smin pa sogs 'bras bu brgyud mar 'byin thub pa bzhin/ sems rang bzhin gyes 'od gsal ba der yang las nyon dang gnas ngan len gyi bag chags sogs du ma tshogs pa las ma 'ongs pa na rnam smin gyi 'bras bu sna tshogs pa 'byung rung la/ de'ang rtog pas btags pa tsam yin gyi/ ma 'ongs pa'i dngos po de dag don dam par grub na grangs can gyi mngon par mi gsal ba'i myu gu bzhin rgyu de la 'bras bu thams cad gnas dgos pas/ sprin la'ang lo tog dang zan la sogs pa de la brten pa'i 'bras bu thams cad yod par thal ba'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ / rgyu 'bras tha snyad pa la phan tshun phrad pa mi dgos kyang / don dam par rgyu 'bras su 'gro ba la bya byed phrad pa dgos pas 'dir sprin gyis 'bras bu ma 'ongs pa skyed par 449

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gsungs pa 'dis ma 'ongs pa'i dngos po de dag don dam par ma grub pa go dgos so/ / brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jug par bya/ / 'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ / 'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ / zhes pa'i don ni bam lnga las/ / brtsam par bya zhing zhes bya ba ni brtson par gyes shig pa'o/ / 'byung bar bya zhes bya ba ni 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ba'i phyir dgon pa la sogs pa dben par songs shig cesabyu ba'i tha tshig go / sangs rgyas bstan ba zhes bya ba ni bden pa bzhi bstan pa la'o/ / 'jug par bya zhes bya ba ni mgo bo dang gos la me 'bar ba ltar brtson par gyis shig pa'o/ / zhes gsungs la/ so thar brjed byang dang so thar gzhung 'grel gnyis su'ang tshig ris de ji lta ba bzhin 'byung / khyad par bshes gnyen gyi 'dul ba bsdus pa las/ brtsam zhes bya ba ni rab tu byung ba'i sbyor ba'o/ / 'byung bar bya zhes bya ba ni rab tu 'byung ba'o/ /zhes sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi lta bur gsungs te/ snga phyi gung bsgrigs na 'dul ba'i mdor/ nges par 'byung ba tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas te/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin khams gsum 'khor ba mtha' dag me 'bar ba'i 'obs dang btson dong ltar mthong ba'i nges 'byung gi bsam pa bcos ma ma yin pa ni so thar gyi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rmang gzhi yin pas blo 'byongs nges su skyed pa zur snga ma'i don dang / de nas 'dod chung chog shes kyis 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi la gnas te tshul khrims mig gi 'bras bu ltar srung bar byed pa gnyis pa'i don no/ / 'dis tshogs sbyor gyi lam gnyis kyang bsdus par bya dgos te/ so sor thar pa'i skad dod pra ti mo kṣa zhes pa'i pra ti dang bor byas na dang por thar pa zhes thar pa'i mgo rtsom pa'i don du gsungs pa dang /tshogs lam la thar pa cha mthun zhes pa'ang go don mtshungs shing / mngon pa 450

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/kun btus su tshogs lam gyi mtshan gzhi smos pa na 'dod chung tshog shes dbang po'i sgo sdom pa sogs la gtso bor gsungs pa gnad gcig go des tshogs sbyor sdud dgos pa 'og gi tshig lhag mas kyang shes te/ 'dul ba bsdus pa las/ 'jug par bya zhes bya ba ni mthong ba'i lam skyed pa'o/ / 'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya zhes bya ba ni sgom pa'i lam mo/ / zhes phyi ma gnyis mthong sgom gyi lam la sbyar ba na snga mas tshogs sbyor sdud dgos pa 'os med kyi rigs ༷rdo ༷ṭwāṃrdo ༵ /latsho//bam tt+waṃ~X /brdordo ༷rno ༵ ṭwāṃṭwāṃdī dro ngazhe ༵ didī dī ṭwāṃ ༷ byedī ༵ gsungs pa dang dgongs pa gcig ste/ rgyan las/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang / / shes pa'i skad cig rnam bzhi yis/ / lam shes nyid la mthong ba'i lam/ / zhes dang / sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la/ / chos shes rjes su shes pa dang / / bzod shes skad cig bdag nyid 'di/ / kun shes tshul la mthong ba'i lam/ / zhes pa ltar mdo sde rnams su mthong lam gang ston pa na bden pa bzhi mthong tshul gyi sgo nas gsungs shing / mthong lam gyi ming la'ang bden pa mngon rtogs zhes zer ba'i phyir/ de bzhin du bam lngar/'chi bdag ces bya ba ni 'chi ba'o/ / sde zhes bya ba ni sred pa la sogs pa'i 'khor ro/ / zhes pa dang / khyad par bshes gnyen gyis sgom lam la sbyar ba gnyis kyang gnad gcig tu 'bab ste/ sred sogs kyi nyon mongs sa bon dang bcas pa gzhom byed sgom lam las ma 'das pa'i phyir ro/ / mdzad byang 'gyurabyang med pa rgya cher 'grel zer ba las/ brtsam par bya ba ni rab tu 'byung bar brtsam par bya'o/ / dbyung bar bya ba ni gdon mi za bar rab tu 'byung bar bya'o/ / sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug pa ni rab tu byung ba tsam gyis chog pa ma yin pas bstan pa'i sde snod gsum bsgrub par bya'o/ / 'chi bdag 451

༄/ /gung thang bsnyan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/gi sde 'joms pa ni sde snod gsum sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu yod par bya ba'i phyir rga shi'i sdug bsngal gzhom zhing / zhes gsungs pa 'di'ang snga phyi'i go rim sogs 'brel chags pa zhig snang bas de bzhin bshad na/ mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ / sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ / zhes pa ltar/ nges 'byung gi bsam pa shugs drag pos bskul te rab tu byung ba'i tshul khrimasarnam par dag pa blangs la bslab bya rnams mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du srung bar byed dgos pa rkang ba dang po'i don/ de'i steng du rgyal ba'i gsung rab la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad/ sgom pas nyams su len dgos pa rkang pa gnyis pa'i don/ mthar sgom byung rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis nyon mongs pa sa bon dang bcas pa glang chen gyis 'dam bu'i tshal bcom pa bzhin rmeg med du byas nas drungs 'byin dgos pa rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi don no/ / khyad par de gsum po lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum la sbyar du'ang rung ste/thog mtha' gnyis tshul khrims dang shes rab la spyor tshul go sla la/ rkang pa gnyis pa'i don lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa la spyor tshul ni/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam gtan gyi skabs su 'grel pa don gsal las/zeg pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i sems rtse gcig pa dang zhes gsungs pa ltar/gzhan gye lta ba ngan pa sogs kyis mi 'phrog par rgyal ba'i bstan pa la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i rtse gcig tu gyur te/ tsha bas gdungs pa'i glang chen mtsho la bsnyegs pa bzhin rgyal ba'i bstan pa la 'jug pa'i don no/ / gang zhig rab tu bag yod pas/ / chos 'dul 'di la spyod gyur pas/ / skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs te/ / sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur/ / zhes pa'i rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis bslab pa srung ba'i thabs dang / phyi ma gnyis kyis bsrung ba'i phan yon bstan pa yin/ bslab pa srung ba'i thabs du ma yod kyang gnad 452

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogasabazhugs so/gcig tu bsdus pa ni bag yod pa yin pas/ mdo rtsa bar yang gdams ngag bcu gcig gsungs pa'i mjug tu/ bsgrub par bya ba thabs bajod pa dang bcas pa yang ngo / / zhes bslab bya srung byed kyi thabs bag yod gtso bor gsungs so/ / de'i rgyu mtshan ni so sor thar pa'i mdo 'di nyid las kyang /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub dang / gzhan yang gang dag de lta bu dang mthun pa/ dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi phyogs rnams kyang bag yod pas 'thob bo/ / zhes gsungs so/ / bam lnga las/ chos zhes bya ba ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'o/ / 'dul ba zhes bya ba ni yang dag par sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid do/ / zhes gsungs la/ rgya cher 'grel gzhan de las/ chos ni yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / rtog pa dang / rtsol ba dang / dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ / 'dul ba ni/ yang dag pa'i ngag dang / las kyi mtha' dang /'tsho ba gsum mo/ / zhes sbyor tshul cung zad mi 'dra zhing / spyir 'dul ba'i don sa sde las/ ltung ba 'dul ba dang / nyon mongs pa 'dul ba'o/ / zhes gnyisagasungs pas/ phyi ma'i dbang du btang na sde snod gsum ga la 'dul ba'i sgra 'jug go / bsrung ba'i phan yon ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las brgal ba'i thar ba'i go 'phang thob par gsungs te/ lam lnga'i tha ma mi slob pa'i lam yang 'dis bstan pa yin no/ / skye ba'i 'khor ba zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni srid pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad kyi gzhi shing ljon pa'i rtsa ba lta bu ni las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khor bar nying mtshams sbyar ba'i skye ba 'di nyid yin pas/ rnam 'grel las/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung po/ / zhes gsungs shing / skyes rabs las kyang / skye ba'i rdzong las tshegs chung thar par 'gyur/ / zhes 'khor ba las thar pa la skye ba las thar ba zhes gsungs pa 453

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/yin no/ / sdug bsngal tha mar byed pa zhes pa'ang thar pa mngon du byas pa'i ming gi rnam grangs yin te/ mdo las/ gang sdug bsngal 'di ma lus par spangs pa/ nges par spangs pa/ byang bar gyur pa/ zad pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba/ 'gog pa/ nye bar zhi ba/ nub pa/ sdug bsngal gzhan gyi mtshams mi sbyor zhing mi 'byung mi skye ba 'di ni zhing ba/ 'di ni gya nom pa ste/'di lta ste phung bo thams cad nges par spangs/ srid pa zad pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba/ 'gog pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ tshigs bcad 'di gnyis ni rnam grol don du gnyer ba rnams kyis nyams su blang bya'i gnad ma tshang ba med par ston pa'i gdams pa'i mchog sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nying khu yin pas/ srid pa 'khor lor yang lam bden mtshon byed la tshigs bcad 'di gnyis bri bar gsungs shing / rgyal po u dra yā nas kyang ston pa'i sku gzugs rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi ri mo dang bcas pa'i mthar tshigs su bcad pa 'di gnyis bris te bskur ba mthong bas srid pa'i 'ching ba bcad de chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba thob nas/ ring na gnas pa'i thub dbang gis/ /shes rab mig ni rnam spyor mdzad/ / gang la de 'dra'i gsos mnga' ba'i/ /sman pa'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes ched du brjod par byas pa yin no/ / zhes mdo'i tshigs bcad gsum gyi don cung zad bkrol ba 'di ni hal ha ja sag thu rgyal po'i shog nas lhag bsam dang rnam dpyod phul du byung ba rab 'byams pa dkon mchog smon lam gyes bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /chos brgyad 'ching ba drungs nas phyung / / chos kun de nyid thugs su chud/ / bzhad pa'i rdo rje la btud nas/ / rdo rje'i tshig gi mdud dgrol 454

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/bya/ / de'ang / lta ba'i zung 'jug ma shes na/ / snang srid chos skur ga la shes/ / sgom pa'i zung 'jug ma shes na/ / sdug bsngal rgyan du ga la shes/ / spyod pa'i zung 'jug ma shes na/ / zhen pa rang log ga la 'ong / /zhes bya ba ni gang bshad par bya ba'i chos so/ / de la lta ba'i zung 'jug ni kun byang gi chos rnams don dam par med mnyam yin kyang tha snyad tsam du blang dor rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag bsnyon med du 'jog dgos pas snang stong gnyis 'gal med zung du 'jug pa'i don yin te/ de ltar na 'khor 'das gnyi ga tha snyad tsam du mchog dman dang / kun rdzob pa'i dngos po la dri ma dag ma dag gi dbye ba so sor 'byed rgyu yod kyang / rang bzhin la dri ma'i slad pa ma zhugs par yongs su dag pa khyad med pas/ chos thams cad gzod ma nas zhi ba dang rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa zhes gsungs te/ chos can gyi steng nasakhyad 'byed pa ma gtogs/ 'khor ba dang myang 'das gnyi ga'i steng gi chos nyid kyi ngo bo la mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba 'byed rgyu med do/ / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis sher mdo las/ gzugs rnam par dag pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rnam par dag pa zhes sogs dang / rgyan las/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs/ / dag pa nyid de/ zhes gsungs shing / dbu ma rtsa bar yang / mya ngan 'das mtha' gang yin pa/ / de ni 'khor ba'i mtha' yin no/ / zhes gsungs/ 'di la gzhung chen mo rnams su srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi tha snyad mdzad cing / sa skya pa dang bka' brgyud pa rnams la lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ces grags so/ / sgom pa'i zung 'jug ni sdug bsngal can gyi sems can rnams la brtse ba'i gzhan dbang du gyur te sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa yin/ 'di'i zung du 'jug lugs ni sems can gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mthong ba'i tshe gzhan la sdug bsngal phra mo tsam 455

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/byung bar mthong na'ang sha'u la me phog pa ltar mi bzod pa'i brtse ba dang /rang thog tu dka' spyad dang sdug bsngal ci tsam byung yang mi skyo bar byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur nas dang du len nus pa'i bzod pa'i go cha gnyis zung du 'jugadagos pa yin/ de'i stobs kyis sdug bsngal rgyan du shes tshul ni spyod 'jug las/ gzhan yang sdug bsngal yon tan ni/ / skyo bas dregs pa sel bar byed/ / 'khor ba pa la snying rje skyes/ / sdig la 'dzem zhing dge la dga'/ / zhes sogs sdug bsngal rgyan du lta tshul mang du gsungs te/ de dag gi don bsdus te paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ snod bcud sdig pa'i 'bras bus yongs gang ste/ / mi 'dod sdug bsngal char ltar babs gyur kyang / / las ngan 'bras bu 'dzad pa'i rgyur mthong nas/ / rkyen ngan lam du lhongs par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes gsungs te/ de ltar byas na rkyen ci byung yang rgyan dang dge ba'i grogs su 'char bas/ blo sbyong rtsa tshig las/ yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsgom/ / zhes gsungs pa yin zhing / mdo las chos thams cad bde bar gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gsungs pa bslab btus su drangs pa ltar ro/ / bka' brgyud gong ma rnams/ rkyen ngan dge ba'i skul ma yin/ / sdug bsngal sdig pa'i phyags ma yin/ / gsungs pa sogs shin tu mang la/ zung du 'jug rgyu'i ya gcig shos gzhan steng du sdug bsngalabasgom pas snying rje bskyed dgos tshul ni shin tu grags che bas ma spros so/ / bod 'dir lta sgom spyod gsum du grags kyang gzhung chen mor lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum du gsungs pa de'i nang gi ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang /phar phyin drug las bsam gtan gyi phar phyin la byed pas de gtso bor byang chub kyis sems la ngos 'dzin dgos pa rgyan rtsa 'grel dang spyod 'jug gis shes so/ / spyod pa'i zung 'jug ni/ rnyed sogs bzhi la dga' ba dang / ma rnyed 456

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/pa sogs bzhi la mi dga' ba med pa gnyis zung du 'jug pa ste/ mdor na 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'ching ba btsan chod du byas nas mgo snyoms pa yin pas/ 'di la nang gses kyis phye na dpal nā ro pa chen po'i man ngag 'gro mgonagatsang ba rgya ras kyis gsal bar mdzad pa skyid sdug lam 'khyer/ lha 'dre lam 'khyer sogs ro snyoms skor drug 'byung / mdor na sems chags sdang gi dbang gis phyogs ris su gyur pa 'gog pa'i thabs rgyal bas chos tshul ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad chos brgyad mgo mnan nas blo sbyong ba'i thabs sha stag yin la/ de'i rtsa ba mthar gtugs na lta ba'i go ba phu thag chod pa la rag las te/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa zhes/ / bya ba gsum po sems spyong byed/ / mchog tu sems ni spyong byed pa'i/ / chos ni rang bzhin med pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de ltar chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa na rnyed pa dang grags pa sogs ci tsam byung yang skyug nad can gyis zas mthong ba bzhin zhen pa gting nas log pa zhig 'byung ba ni spyod pa'i zung 'jug shes pas zhen pa rang log 'byung tshul yin la/ rgyu mtshan mtha' chod pa dbu ma rtsa ba dang rgyal sras zhi ba lhas rnyed bkur longs spyod sogs ci tsam byung yang de dag dang bcas te gang du 'dong ba'i gtol med tshul gsungs pa sogs kyi steng nas shes dgos so/ / bstan pa'i snying po bslabagasum gyi/ / gnad don gdams par 'khyer ba'i tshul/ / cung zad bkral ba'i dge ba'i mthus/ / bstan pa'i snying po rgyas gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa wang kyā rab 'byams pa grags pa rab brtan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du yid la shar tshod kyi tho tsam zhig sku 'bum byams pa gling du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /457

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronami'i gsung 'bum/'khor lo'i rnam gzhag mdor bsdus bzhugs/dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'khor lo'i khungs dang dmigs pa phan yon sogs mdo tsam brjod na/ srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / rigs drug gi skye sgo 'gog pa/ bar do gsum sbyong zhing bton pa las kyang bskor ba dag pas phan yon lhag par che ba sogs snga 'gyur la bshad pa shin tu mang / gsar ma'i rgyud kyi tshig zin la lag 'khor du byed rgyu'i bshad pa med kyang tshad ldan gyi skyes chen du mas phyag bzhes su bstar zhing / mdo dbusakyi dgon gnas kun tu dar rgyas su mdzad pas yid ches kyi gnas su grub par ma zad/ myur bar 'khor ba dang lha'i sngags/ / zhes dang /khyogs dang khro bo'i bzlas pa'i 'khor tshul gzhan yang yod la/ sngags kye yi ge mar me'i 'phreng ba bzhin du 'khor tshul sogs mang du gsungs pa dang / rdo rje'i tshig sbram las/ myur mgyogs 'khor lo bskor na che/ / 2 nga zhes snying ga'i sngags 'phreng 'khor ba'i dgos pa bshad pa rnams phyi'i 'khor lo bris te bskor ba'i khungs su 'gyur te/ lhag pa'i lha dang chos skyong mang po'i sgrub thabs be'u bum sogs su las bzhi sgrub byed dang / srog 'khor bri tshul sogs bshad pa rnams nang du sgom don gyi 'gros dang bstun pa yin la/ 'dus par/oṃ ni ri lu tsa na ga'i/ / zhes sogs nang gi rdzas kyi thig le sgom tshul bshad pa'ang tha snyad kyi sgo nas phyi'i ril sgrub gyi khungs su tshad ldan mang pos gsungs pa dang / kun gzigs lnga pas gzungs gzhug dbu nas dril ba'i khungs sngags 'khor gyi mgo nang nas rtsom pa la gtugs pa sogs nang gi sngags 'khor bsgom pa phyi'i 'khor lo bri ba'i khungs su 'gro na/ sngags 'phreng 'khor 458

༄/ /ryā tshan thor busna tshog bzhugs so/bar bshad pa phyi'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i khungs su 'gro ba gdon mi za ba'i phyir ro/ / dmigs rim ni de'i nang du yod pa'i mdo dang gzungs rnams las 'odazer spros te sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu mchod pa phul/ de dag gi byin rlabs bsdus te thim zhing / yang 'od zer 'phros nas rang lus la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad byang ste rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ yang phyogs bcur 'phros te snod bcud thams cad kyi ma dag pa sbyangs nas dag pa'i rten dang brten par gyur/ thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu mdo dang gzungs rnams 'ur 'ur gsung zhing thugs de bzhin nyid kyi ngang du gyur par bsams pa 'khyer so gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang / yig 'bru rnams las rang sgra bsgrags te gdul bya rnams smin grol la bkod pa'i dmigs pa byas na chos 'khor bskor ba'i rten 'brel du'ang 'gyur ro/ / phan yon ni de dag rang rang bklags pa la phan yon ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad 'byung ste/sngags re gnyis shing byang la bris nas thang 'ga' bskor bas nad rims sad ser sogs zhi ba mngon sum du grub na/ bsam pa rnam par dag pas gzungs khyad par can du ma bskor ba la phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de 'dra la reg pa'i rlung gis phog pa tsam gyis kyang sdig sgrib tshan po che byang zhing thar ba'i sa bon bskrun par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes pa 'di ni hal ha khu re chen mo'i grwa rigs dad ldan dge slong blo bzang bsam gtan gyis skor ba dang 'khor lo'i rgyu mtshan phan yon dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul zer yang / snga ma mchod rten mthong grol chen mo'i dkar chag tu bshad zin pas/ 'khor lo'i rnam gzhag tho tsam zhig 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du bris pa'o/ /bshes gnyen bsten tshul rigs pa bzhi'i sgo nas gtan la 'bebs tshul ni/ de la thar ba'i go 'phang ni 'khrul ba zad pa yin zhing / 'khrul ba zad 459

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/pa'i nges shes rnyed pa rigs pa bzhis gtan la 'bebs pa dgos kyi/ mos mno'i nges pa tsam ni 'dam la btab pa'i phur ba bzhin so mi thub par gsungs so/ / des na lam gyi lus thams cad de bzhis gtan la 'bebs dgos pas/ thog mar bshes gnyen bsten tshul la mtshon na/ ltos pa'i rigs pa ni/ bka' gdams gong ma rnams mig gis bltas pas song na chog pa la'ang lam mkhan dgos na/ thar bar bgrod pa la bla ma med thabs med pas rnam grol sgrub pa la bla ma las gal che ba med gsungs pa bzhin/ long pa lam mkhan la ltos pa ltar thar par bgrod pa bla ma la ltos par bsgrubs pa yin/ bya ba byed pa'i rigs pa ni/ rnam 'grel las/ skyob pa nyid gzigs lam gsung ba/ / 'bras med phyir na rdzun mi gsung / / zhes pa ltar ston pa sangs rgyas nas bzung bla ma rnams gzhan don kho nar lam la goms pas 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing 'bras bu mngon du byas pa na don de gdul bya la gdams pa yin pas bka' bzhin bsgrubs na don gnyis kyi bya ba thams cad lhun gyis grub par gdon mi za ba yin/ 'thad pas sgrub pa'i rigs pa ni/ rten 'dir zas kham gcig la spyod pa'ang rgyu med dang mi mthun pa'i rgyu las mi 'byung bas/ rin chen 'phreng bar/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde/ / zhes sogs ltar zas sbyin 'bras/ spyod pa'i rten tshul khrims/ 'tshe ba med pa bzod pa sogs kyis yin la/ de dag shes pa'i shes rab lhan skyes su mi 'byung bas ston mkhan zhig dgos pas/ blang dor ston mkhan de nyid bla ma yin pas/ bla ma legs tshogs kun gye rtsa bar rgyu sngon song sgrub kyi 'bras rtags kyis bsgrubs pa yin/ chos nyid kyi rigs pa zhes pa stong nyid kho na la byed mi dgos par/ me gyen du 'bar ba dang / chu thur du 'bab pa chos nyid du grags pa ltar 'chol ba med pa yin zhing / de'ang lung las/460

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ / 'bras bu de 'dra 'byung bar 'gyur/ / gsungs pa bzhin rang gi bla ma tshul bzhin du bkur na rang nyid 'gro ba kun gyi mgon dngagatsug rgyan du 'gyur ba rgyu 'bras rten 'byung mi bslu ba'i chos nyid yin zhing / 'di'ang mthar gtugs na rtsa she las/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ / de la thams cad rung bar 'gyur/ / zhes pa ltar chos nyid stong pa nyid dngos la'ang thug yod pas/ 'di legs par go na bstan pa mtha' dag gi gnad la nges pa skye'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni byang phyogs thor god kyi yul nas 'ongs pa dad brtson blo dang ldan pa'i dge slong blo bzang chos 'phel gyis/ ji ltar thos pa'i don la rigs pa bzhis/ / zhes sogs ltar lam gyi lus yongs rdzogs rigs pa ba'is gtan la 'beb tshul gyi dpyad pa'i sgo 'byed byed lta bu bshes gnyen bsten tshul la sbyar ba zhig dgos zer ba bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /dad pa gsum sgom tshul mdor bsdus te/ sras bcas rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bka' bzhin bsgrubs na 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin pa/ / bslu med skyabs kyi dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes rtsa tshig gi steng nas gshar sgom dang sbrags te bya/ zas gos gnas mal nor longs spyod/ tha na me tog gi tshal chu gtsang tshun chad mthong tshe/ lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs/ / yid 'ong mchod pa'i 'os su gyur ba kun/ / bsod nams zhing mchog bla ma lha la dbul/ / brtse bas bzhes nas byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ / zhes bla ma la mchod par 'bul/ chags sdang gi rtog pa ngan pa dang nad gdon gye nyer 'tshe sogs byung ba'i tshe/ kye ma kye ma mgon po thugs rje can/ / khyod min skyabs gzhan nam yang mi 'tshol bas/ / myur ba myur 46/

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bar thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ / srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun las bskyab tu gsol/ / zhes gsol ba gdab/ snying ga'i padmar gnyug ma'i rlung sems dang / / dbyer med bzhugs pa bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ / phyin ci log gi rtogs pa kun zhi zhing / / zab rgyas lam bzang mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces pa'i steng nas rgyun du bla ma'i snang ba dang mi 'bral zhing / 'og nas 'byung ba'i mdo sngags kyi lam kun la rtsa 'grel gung bsgrigs te bag chags ci thebs bya/ de'i ngang nas gzhan la chos bshad dang byin rlabs sogs byed pa'i tshe/ kye hud long bas long khrid mi nus pas/ / bdag la re ltos 'cha' ba 'di dag kun/ / 'dren pa khyod kyis thugs rje'i phyag brkyangs te/ / bde chen thar pa'i sa la drang du gsol/ / zhes snying gar bzhugs pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs shing des byin gyis brlabs par bsams/ zhes bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag snying po'i rtsa tshig gi dgongs don lag len du 'deb tshul shin tu mdor bsdus pa zhig dgos zhes g.yi'i smad kyi bla ma lhag bsam rnam dpyod yangs pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes the bo'i chu tshan khar bris pa'o/ /'dun stobs dang rlung stobs zhes pa rlung gi rnal 'byor goms te zhugasaganas thim gsum ji bzhin byung ba'i tshe gnyid du 'gro kha lta bur sdud rim gyi dmigs pas stong bzhi rim gyis drangs nas mthar thams cad stong ba 'od gsal gyi tshe chos sku la nga rgyal 'jog cing / de las lugs zlog tu langs te rmi lam gyi snang ba shar ba na longs sku'i lam 'khyer dang / sad par rtsom pa na sprul sku'i lam 'khyer te gnyid dus kyi bsre ba skor gsum gsungs pa dang /dus kyi 'khor lor sad rmi gnyid mthug gi thig le so sor sems gtad de der rlung bsdus pa na gnyid chos sku/ mi lam longs sku/ sad pa sprul sku'i lam 462

༄/ /le'u tshan thor bur tshogs bzhugs so/'khyeragasum gyi dge sbyor rnal ma 'byung tshul bshad pa rnams ni rlung stobs kyis yin la/ rlung sdud rim sogs ji bzhin byed mi thub na'ang / dper na da lta rang res nangs par snga bar ldang snyam du 'phen pa btang ba'i stobs kyis dus tshod der sad pa bzhin/ nyin par nas gnyid dus kyi dge sbyor de dag skyong rgyu'i 'dun pa yang yang gtong zhing / snang ba mtha' dag la rmi lam dang b.rado'i snang ba'o snyam du bltas na skabs de dag tu de ltar shar nas dge sbyor gyi 'phro skyong thub pa 'byung ba ni 'dun stobs yin/ 'pho ba'ang sgo gzhan rnams yi ge sogs kyis bkag ste 'og rlung gyen du bzlog pa'i shugs kyis rnam par shes pa spyi gtsug gser gyi sgo nas lhag pa'i lha'i thugs gar dngos su 'phen pa rlung stobs dang / rlung gi nus pa de ltar dngos su ma thon yang de ltar 'pho 'dod kyi 'dun pa yang yang sbyangs/ de'i don du tshogs bsags shing gsol ba yang yang btab ste de'i thugs shar 'phos pa'i mos pa rgyun chags su byas pa'i mthus 'pho ba 'byongs pa ni 'dun stobs yin te/ mtha' chodapar rdzogs rim gyi yi ge chen mo rnams dang dam pa'i gsung bgros las shes par bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di'ang hrun gar shog gi dge slong dkon mchog dpal bzang gi mos 'dun bzhin bstsal pa'o/ /bde gsang 'jigs gsum ya ma bral zhes pa ji ltar yin dris pa'i lan ni/ de'ang bde gsang 'jigs gsum ya ma bral zhes pa ni cha thams cad nas sbyar ba min gyi/ spyi'i 'gang bsgrig pa'am dod thub brtsis na legs par rim lnga gsal sgon las gsungs pa bzhin te/ rnam pa thams cad mtshungs dgos na ched du bya ba'i gdul bya khams tha dad pa la so sor gsungs pa don med du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'jigs byed lta bu'i nyams len la mtshon na mthar thug zung 'jug gi go 'phang sgrub pa'i thabs su 'gro dgos shing /463

༄/ /gung thang bstanasa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/zung du 'jug rgyu'i sgyu ma'i sku dang 'od gsal gyi thugs gnyis las/ snga ma'i sgrub gzhi lus ngag yid gsum rags phra shin tu phra ba 'byed tshul/ de las sgyu ma'i skur ldang lugs/ ma dag pa'i sgyu ma 'od gsal gyis sbyangs te dag pa'i sgyu ma'i sku 'grub tshul sogs mtha' chod pa 'dus pa la ma brten par shes mi nus/ 'od gsal gye thugs 'grub byed phyi nang gi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/rigs so so'i brtag tshul dang bsten thabs/ dga' bzhi dang stong bzhi sprod lugs sogs phyag rgya srog rtsol du 'gro ba'i gnad cha tshang ba 'khor lo sdom pa la ma brten par rtogs thabs med pas de gnyis kyi man ngag tshur blangs/rangagi sgos chos 'khrul 'khor sogs kyis sdig po che btsan thabs su skyob pa dang / bar chad sel zhing mthun rkyen rnam 'byed kyi shes rab sgrub pa zhi khro sbrags sgrub sogs sum dril du byed pa yin pas/ snga ma gnyis gtso bo rdzogs rim gyi dus yin kyang sgyu ma'i sku sgrub pa'i gnad thams cad kyi gzhi re bskyed rim skabs bar do longs sku'i lam khyer du tshang dgos pa dang / 'od gsal bsgrub pa'i gnad rnams 'chi ba chos sku'i lam khyer du gzhi things dgos/ de bzhin du zung 'jug gi gnad kyang phyag rgya 'du bya ba sogs ci rigs kyi khongs nas 'byung dgos pa bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa bskyed rim gyi man ngag las shes dgos par dril bu zhabs kyis gsungs pa lta bu yin/ 'dus pa'i lhag mos 'odagasal du sdud lugs ni de'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya la 'char sla zhing byin rlabs myur ba'i bogs 'byin pa yin kyang / dgos pa snod bcud 'od gsal du sdud pa rang yin pas/ 'dis gdul byas lha'i rnam par ma byas kyang sdud rim gyi dmigs pas 'od gsal 'dren thub pas dgos pa grub pa de nyid kyis chog 'byung bzhi'i thim rim 'dir yang gsal bas de'i tshe rags pa nyer lnga tshan tshan du bsdebs pa'i thim lugs don gyis 'grub/ lus dkyil 464

༄/ / le'u tshan thor bur tshogs bzhugs so/yod med dang yod kyang khams phra rags las sgrub tshul mi 'dra ba rang rang gi sgos chos yin pas phan tshun sbyor mi dgos/ phung khams rnams skabs 'di'i gshegs pa dang gshegs mar mos dgos pa dag pa'i skabs dang las rgyal mchog gi spro bsdus kyang shes/ dpa' gcig la'ang skabs thob tu yum gsal btab pas gsang mchod sogs byed dgos par kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas gsungs/ ligo li ya te zhes pa thim pa la 'jug pas yum gsal ma btab kyang mtshan ma gyen 'greng gi dmigs pas bde chen 'dren pa 'ig kyang yod par snang / rgyud sde bzhi gdul bya'i rim pas nyams su len tshul gyis phye ba las/ lha ngo bo tha dad pa dang mchog dman du mi rung ba dper na thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan sogs lha gcig rgyud so so ltar du nyams su len tshul 'byung bas shes dgos/ bla med kyi bde stong dbyeramed pa'i ye shes de brtan g.yo rab 'byams kyi rnam par 'char na bya rgyud kyi lha'i rnam par ci la mi 'char/ smyung gnas sogs kyi dus bla med kyi lha lta bu mi sgom zhes pa las dang po ba la skabs der lha gcig chos gcig tu dril na cung zad phan thogs pa yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad du mi rung ba min/'di 'dra'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang de'i nang nas kyang gtso 'khor mchog dman phyi nang gi rnam pa sogs mtha' dag chos dbyings su ro gcig pa'i stong nyid kyi go ba gting tshugs pa la rag las par sngags rim gyi bzlas pa'i thad du gsungs pa lta bu yin/ bla med kyi skabs chos gzungs kyi sku'i bsgrub gzhi thun mong ma yin pa rang chas su yod gsungs pa gnyug ma'i rlung dang sems la byed dgos kyi/ rang bzhin gnas rigs ni de sgrub pa'i rten byed pa tsam yin kyang phar phyin zeg pa dang thun mong ba yin la/ snga ma ni mdor ma zad rgyud sde 'og ma gsum las kyang gsal bar mi 'byung bar spyod bsdus su gsungs/ rlung 465

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname gsung 'bum/dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor sgom tshul tshig nyung dus mi rdzogs shing rgyas pa bri ma khom pas/ de'i khrid yig rnams su gzigs na legs/yang dris lan zhig ni/ bskyed rim mtshan nyid par 'gro ba la gzhi'i sku gsum dang rnam pa mthun zhing / lam dang 'bras bu'i de dang de'i smin byed du 'gro ba zhig nges par dgos pas/ 'dul 'dzin gyi 'khor chen sgrub thabs su longs sku'i lam 'khyer ma gsungs pa la/ sher 'byung pa dang rong ston/ye shes rtse mo/ lcang skya gong ma sogs mang pos dgag gzhag dang kha skong mdzad de/ de gsum tshang ba med mi rung yin par gsungs/ 'on kyang tshem bu dmar khrid 'di la rim gnyis kyi gnad tshang ngo zhes gsung bzhin du sku gsum lam 'khyer gyi rnam gzhag tshad ma'i skyes bu gong ma sus kyang kha ma bskangs par 'dug pas/ dgongs pa brtags na 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po snyigs dus lhag par 'grub sla ba'i snying rje'i lha yin gshis/ blo dman pa rnams kyis kyang de'i sgo nas rim gnyis la mos blo re tsam byed pa'i thabs su bla med kyi lam gyi 'gro lugs phyogs tsam dang sbyar nas gsungs pa yin 'dug pas/ las dang po bas re zhig 'di tsam la rim gnyis kyi gnad tshang ngo snyam du yid ches kyes sgom song na mtshams shig tu lha'i byin rlabs zhugs pas nyams rtogs 'phel te/ de bzhin nyid las byang chub pa de'ang 'chi dus kyi sdud rim lta bus stong pa 'dren tshab che bas chos sku'i lam 'khyer rnal mar 'ong la/ de byung na sa bon las byang chub par longs sku'i lam 'khyer mtshan nyid pa sogs lhag ma rnams kyang nges par 'byung ste/ dper na shārnyi ba sogs sems tsam pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen po rnams lhan skyes kyi bde ba dang rnam rig lugs kyi stong pa sbyar nas bsgoms na'ang rtogs pa je mthor song tshe 'dzin stangs 'gyur nas dbu ma'i lta bar 'gro tshul gsungs pa bzhin no/ /466

/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/des na dam pa gong ma rnams blo mchog dman kun la phan gdags pa'i thabs mkhas su 'di bzhin mdzad pa yin pas/ sku gsum lam 'khyer gsal bar ma thon phyin bskyed rim gyi gnad tshang bar mi 'gro snyam du yid mi ches pa'ang mi rung la/ sku gsum lam 'khyer gtan mi dgos snyam du rgyang skyur yang mi byed par/ mdo sde rgyan las sgom tshul drug gi nang gi smon pa'i rnam pas sgom lugs gsungs pa bzhin thog mar dngos zin gyi sgom tshul 'di bzhin byas la/rimagyis bskyed rim mtshan nyid tshang ba'i rtogs pa skye bar shog cig snyam du dmigs 'og tu bcug ste bsgom dgos pa yin no/ /tshem bu pa'i rdzogs rim sgom tshul spros bral gyi rnal 'byor skyong ba tsam las ma mthong la/ phyogs mthun rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rdzogs rim bde stong gi ye shesasgom tshul yang mi tra'i rgya gzhung don yod rdo rjes bsgyur ba gong 'og phal cher gye sgra 'gros khong snga ma'i lta ba skyong tshul dang 'dra ba zhig 'dug pas dgongs gzhi rtogs dka' la/ 'on kyang sgyu 'od srung gsum sgrub pa'i dbang gong ma gsum spyi dang mthun pa'i gtan tshigs kyis de'i bsgrub gzhi'i bden pa gnyis kyi rdzogs rim sogs kyang spyi dang mthun dgos par 'grub bo/ /des na kha skong tshul yang ma rgyud sgyu lus sgrub tshul mi gsal ba rnams la 'dus pa'i rgyud kyis kha 'gengs dgos pa dang / pha rgyud phyi nang gi rkyen gyis 'od gsal sgrub tshul mi gsal ba rnams la 'khor lo sdom pa sogs kyis kha 'gengs dgos par gsungs pas/ 'dir phyogs gnyi ga nas ci rigs par kha 'gengs dgos shin tu mang ngo / / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis rdzogs rim sgom tshul yang re zhig dam pa gong mas thabs mkhas kyis bkri tshul mdor bsdus mdzad pa 'di bzhin bskyangs na legs kyi/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs rje yab sras kyis gab dkrugs med par legs bshad thang mar brdal yod pa 467

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/rnams kyang blos 'chun dka' na/ sa 'og gi gter lta bur sbas nas yod pa rnams cha tshang bar byas te lag tu lon pa dka'/ de'i gnad kyis rdzogs rim sgom tshul sa bon tsam 'di re zhig bskyangs te tshogs gsog sgrib spyong ya ma bral bar byas la/ rim pa gong ma gong ma'i rtogs pa ji lta ba rgyud la skye ba'i gsol 'debs dang smon lam gyi rnam pas bsgom par byas tshe nyams rtogs rna lam skye lugs dpe dang bcas gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ / 'dir bro 'tshal ba dang thug pas dpyod pa'i sgo mdor bsdus tsam bris pa yin gyi/ so so'i rgyu mtshan mtha' chod par shes 'dod na rje bla ma'i legs bshad rgya mtsho lta bu las btsal b.rakhya'o/ / 'di ni tshem bu dmar khrid 'di la rim gnyis tshang bar grags kyang sku gsum lam 'khyer sogs ji bzhin mi 'dug pas/ rim pa gnyi ga'i gnad tshang nges par byas te lag tu len tshul zhig dgos zhes zhus pa'i lan du bstsal pa'o/ /gnako'u dgon gyi lo rgyas mdor bsdus/dge legs 'od kyis sa gsum padmo'i tshal/ / shis par bsgrubs pa skyabs gsum nam mkha'i nor/ / skye dgu'i legs byas yangs pa'i lha lam du/ / rol pa'i dge mtshan g.yo ba med gyur cig / dkon mchog rten gyi 'bras bus spa ba yi/ / lha yi khang bzang yangs pa'i dpag bsam ljon/ /bsod nams grib bsil snum po khor yug tu/ / 'bebs pa'i skal bzang bsod nams zong gis bsgrun/ / dad pas phye ba'i 'dren byed gser gyi skyog / byin rten rgya mtshor bcug ste byin rlabs kyi/ / chab rgyun rang rgyud dad pa'i zhing sa la/ / 'grem pa'i skye bo de dag skal ba bzang / / de yang 468

༄/ /le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/gan ko'u dgon zhes grags pa gnas ri rin chen spungs pa lta bu'i brag rtse mo mtho zhing a ka ru'i nags tshal dang dri zhim pa'i me tog sna tshogs pa dang /dwangs shing bsil ba'i chu mig du ma sogs kyis brgyan pa/ dam pa mang pos zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas chen khyad par du 'phags pa 'di nyid kyi nang rten gyi lo rgyus ni/ sngon yung lo rgyal po'i dus zun gyi mi gcig phyugs 'tshor phyin pas/ brag kha byang bstan zhig gi ngos na ri bong gnyis 'gro 'ong byed cing srog chags gzhan med pa la/ brag nang nas sgo 'byed rgyu yin nam zhes pa'i sgra lan gsum grags par phyugs dzi ngo mtshar skyes shing / slar gzhan gyis gros btab pa bzhin sgo phye zhes smras ma thag brag la sgo dod pa'i nang du phyin par yu'u she las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sku brnyan zhig 'dug pa rang gi khyim du gdan drangs kyang phyi nyin brag phugs su phebs song ba'i rkyen gyis der lhakhang brtsigs te rim gyis dgon sde 'di nyid chags/ phyis su sku snga ma de nyidanang rten du byas te 'jig rten gsum lhag par dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi snang brnyan mthong ba don ldan 'di nyid bzhengs pa yin la/gzhan yang rje btsun byams pa/ 'jigs byed mgon chos/ lha mo/ rnam sras/tha 'og chos rgyal rnams dang / thub pa'i dbang po/ bde gshegs brgyad/rgyal chen bzhi sogs kyi snang brnyan du ma/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog sogs sku gsung thugs rten chos mang po rnams 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhugs pa 'di lags so/ / smras pa/ sde 'dir mchod bkur lhur len skye bo rnams/ / gnas skabs chos 'byor bde dgas 'tsho ba dang / / mthar thugasrid pa'i rgya mtsho las brgal te/ / sku gsum nor bu'i gling du phyin par shog / ces gan ko'u dgon gyi lo rgyus mdo tsam brjod pa 'di ni bsngags 'os yon tan du mas mngon par mtho ba yang kyu hu thog thu sprul sku 'jam dbyangs klu sgrub dang /469

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs 'azin las bcas kyis bskul ngor/ gung thang pa she re ge thu no mon hān 7dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes shing yos zla tshes dge bar bris/bdemachog rang byon gyimadun nas gnang ba'i smon chig ni/ na mo gu ru shrī te ru kā ya/ brtan g.yo'i dngos kun lhan skyes bde ba che'i/ / sgyu 'phrul dra bar sdom mdzad he ru ka / stong nyid bha ga bzang mo rdo rje yum/ / mnyam spyor bla ma dang po'i mgon des skyongs/ / zung 'jug sar gshegs grub mchog pham mthing ba/ / rags pa'i za ma tog gi bkod pa'i lus/ / dpa' bo rnal 'byor mar bcas skur bzhengs te/ / skye dgu'i mgon por sgyu ma'i gar gyis rtsen/ / 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg dge ba yis/ / sa bon nyungs 'bru'i tshad kyang bla ma lha'i/ / thugs rjes yongs bzung yal ga'i phyogs rdzogs pa/ / sa gsum khyab pa'i bsod nams dpyid du 'bar/ / de slad bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun/ / ji srid byang chub rdo rje'i gnas thob par/ / thugs rje kyo bas nam yang mi gtong zhing / / mchog thun dngos grub bye ba'i dga' ston stsol/ / khyad par mtha' bral lta bas rgyas btab pa/ / zab gsang rdo rje theg pa'i lam bgrod nas/ / ring min te ru ka yi gnas thob ste/ / 'gro kun bde chen sa la 'god gyur cig / de yang rtenamachog 'di la lo rgyus ci rigs 'dug kyang / pham mthing ba rgya nag tu byon tshul rje'i gsung du'ang 'byung ba dang / dam pa du ma'i gsung gung 'grigs pas lo rgyus yongs grags ltar 'thad dam snyam/ de nyid sor bzhag la smon tshig dang bcas pa 'di ni/ 7gung thang pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bde mchog rang byon nyid kye mdun du bris pa'o/ /'phags mchog thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs tshul/ stobs bcu mnga' ba kun gyi thugs rje ni/ / gcig bsdus lhag pa'i lha yi rnam rol 470

༄/ /le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/ba/ / srid dang zhi ba'i 'jigs las sgrol ba'i gnyen/ / mgon po spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ / rnam 'dren kun gyis gdul bar ma nus pa/ / mtha' 'khob srin po gdong dmar bod yul gyi/ / 'gro la lhag par brtse ba'i snying stobs can/ / thugs rje'i gter khyod brtse ba'i spyan gyis gzigs/ / mtha' dbus kun na bstan pa gzugs brnyan tsam/ / bstan 'dzin phal cher bstan pa'i dbu 'phang smod/ / bstan srung g.yel bas bdud kyi dpung tshogs dar/ / dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal du gsol/ / mkhas rlom gzhung lugs don la ma reg cing / / btsun par bcos rnams blang dor ngo lkog 'dzol/ / grub par khas 'che khrel med spyon pa mang / / dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal du gsol/ / sde dpon khengs dregs spyod pa log par zhugs/ / yul khams nad dang 'khrug pa mu ges mnar/ / nyam chung skye bo mgon med sdug grir 'chi/ / dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal du gsol/ / lo 'bras mi smin sad ser than pas 'joms/ /rkang bzhi mi 'phel nad sna du mas gtses/ / zas nor bcud nyams nyin re bzhin du 'grib/ / dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal du gsol/ / mdor na rang rang dkon mchog bka' las 'das/ / las 'bras blang dor log par bsgrubs pa yis/ / sgod bcud mtha' dag sdig pa'i 'bras bus gang / / dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal du gsol/ / bag med byis pa rang nyid bdeg 'chos te/ / brtse ba'i ma la yus su byed pa bzhin/ / rang las smin pa'i nyam thag 'gro rnams kyis/ / gdung ba'i smre sngags khyod min su la gsol/ / rang gi las su dgongs pas mi skyob na/ / gzhan gyis bsags pa smin pa'i dogs ma mchis/ / de phyir brtse ldan brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ / srid dang zhi ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ / ngan song ngan 471

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/'gro'i g.yang las bsgral du gsol/ / las dang nyon mongs 'ching ba gcad du gsol/ / yang dag lam bzang bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon du 'gyur bar shog / ces pa 'di ni rab 'byams pa tshul khrims rin chen dang ar dge bsam 'grub gnyis kyis 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po la snyigs ma'i rgud pa zhi ba'i phyir gsol ba 'debs tshul zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /thugasarje chen po rang byung lnga ldan gyi dkar chagami mjed zhing gi rnam 'dren shākya'i tog / kha ba can gyi mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / sngongs 'di'i skyabs gcig 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde/ / dbyer med thugs rje bden pas deng 'dir skyongs/ / gnas 'di mgon po khyod kyi zhing khams yin/ / 'di na khyod kyi gdul bya yod do zhes/ / mkha' 'gros lung bstan nyid kyis zhal bzhes bzhin/ / thugs rje mthu dpung skyed pa'i dus la babs/ / bla ma spyan ras gzigs dbang myur mdzad mgon/ / dbyer med zhabs kyi padmor gsol 'debs na/ / bdag sogs pha ma rigs drug 'gro kun gyi/ / las nyon bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ / de'ang rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs kha ba can gye rgyal khams pur rgyal bod ces bya ba 'di la nang gses kyis bod dang bod chen gnyis su yod pa rnams mnyam med thub pa'i dbang pos 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi 'dul zhing du gtad cing 'phags pa nyid kyis bdag gir mdzad pa bzhin thabs du mas chos kyi snod du sgrub par mdzad la/ khyad par sprul ba'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skur bzhengs te chos kyi srol phye nas bstan 472

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/pa'i sgron me sbar ba na/ thog mar gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha du mas rgyal po nyid kyi sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i thugs rje chen po'i sku zhig bzhengs na legs par lung bstan pa bzhin chos 'khor lha sa'i rten gyi gtso bo rang byon lnga ldan gyi sku bzhengs te legs tshogs rten 'brel gyi sgo brgya phye ba yin no/ / de'ang rang byon lnga ni gnas chen brgyad kyi sa sna/ tsan dan gyi phye ma sogs sku rgyu rnams srungs nas bzhag par bcu gcig zhal rtsa phyag bcu pa'i sku rang byon du pheb pa dngagacig / skul ba'i dge slong a ka ra ma ti shī las lho phyogs sigo la'i gling nas tsan dan sbrul gye snying po las rang byon gyi thugs rje chen ngo 'i sku spyan drangs pa snga ma'i thugs gar ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs pa dang gnyis/ phyis rgyal po yab yum gsum ga 'phags pa'i drung du byon te chos sku stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ / 'gro ba'i don du bzhengs pa'i sku/ / zhes sogs kyis gsol 'debs mdzad pa'i mthar rgyal po thugs ka dang / rgya bza' nu ma g.yas/ bal bza' nu ma g.yon du thim zhing / slar yang gnas de dang de nas zhal bstan te chos gsungs pas de gsum so sor bgrang nas rang byon lngar byas pa yin no/ / de dang cha mthun par 'dir yang sku rgyu la rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ ri bo gru 'dzin/ ri bo rtse lnga/ tsa ri/ brag dkar dbu ma rta so sogs mi la'i sgrub phugs phal cher/ lo kyā tun sogs kyi gnas sa/ mtshad rtenakhya rung kha shor dang ko ma sā la garnya'i sku dkar/ mtsho ma pham dang chu bo gago'i phye ma sogs gnas chen du ma'i sa sna/ bzang drug sogs sman dang spos sna tshogs sbyar te legs par bsgrubs pas rang byon dang po'i don tshang / spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing khams ri bo gru 'dzin gyi tsan dan dkar po las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso'i sku thugs gar ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs pas gnyis pa'i don tshang / thal sbyar cung zad phye zhing gnas 473
