༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/so sor rgyal po yab yum gsum gyi sku bkod pas phyi ma gsum tshang la/ sku'i rnam pa'ang don la khyad par med na'ang bstan pa'i rmang 'dzug par zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi gtso che bas las bzhi'i zhal can rgyal po lugs su grags pa lha sa'i thugs rje chen po ltar byas pa yin no/ / nang rten gyi rim pa'ang ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi las chos sku'i ring bsrel gzungs 'jug rgyas bsdus cha tshang ma tshar nyer gcig thugs rje chen po'i gzungs ring stong phrag lhagayig drug khri tsho bzhi/ yig brgya nyis stong skor/ tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs/ byams pas dam bca'i gzungs/ tshe gzungs/ sgrol dkar sogs gzungs du ma/ dmigs brtse ma brgya phrag lhag bcas bzhugs so/ /sku gdung dang sku bal gyi ring bsrel yang sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / shā ri'i bu'i tshem las grub pa'i ril bu/ nag po spyod pa'i rus rgyan rdog gcigasrong btsan sgam po'i zhabs chags kyi dum bu/ jo bo rje'i snam sbyar rdo tshos ma'i cha shas/ mi la ras pa'i sgom thag dwags po lha rje/ phag mo gru pa/ po to pa/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa rnams kyi na bza'/ rje rin po che'i na bza' phyag phreng rdog gcig bya btang dus kyi dwa phang / sku 'bum tsan dan yi ge rang byon can/ rgyal tshab rje'i tshom 'bras/ mkhas grub rje'i bzhugs gdan nang 'tshang / paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i na bza'/rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho/ rgyal dbang lnga pa/rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho rnams kyi na bza'/paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan sogs sku phreng bzhi'i na bza'/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i na bza' gdung ras/ skyabs mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i dbu skra/ zhabs sen/ gdung ras/ na bza'/ 'phags pa lha rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku phreng bzhi'i na bza'/ rgyal sras ye shes grags pa/ khri chen 474

༄/ / le'u tshan thor bu sna tshogs bzhugs so/ dge 'dun phun tshogs/ khya dge blo gros rgya mtsho/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan/ klong rdol grub pa'i dbang phyug skyabs mchog blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho rnams kyi na bza'/ gtsang dbus kyi rten bsdus ril bu/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ rnam 'joms khrus ril/ gtsang chab ril bu/ ma ji ril bu sogs 'khrul med kyi rten sna mtha' yas pa bzhugs so/ / de'ang rang cag rnams kyi lha skal snying rje'i lha mchog 'di nyid kyi rten bzhengs mtshad 'bul sogs kyi phan yon ni spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las gsungs pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab cing / tha na mtshan tsam thos pa la'ang phan yon mtha' klas pa'i tshul chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i mdo las/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ming tsam la rtogs pa gang lags pa de'ang bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur na/ yi ger 'bri ba dang / gos dang rgyan gyi mchod pa chen po dag gis mchod pa bgyid pa dang / yi ger 'brir rtsol ba lta ci smos zhes gsungs pa ltar srid zhi'i rgud pa mtha' dag sel zhing mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus pa lhun gyis grub par 'gyur ro/ / smras pa/ sngon tshe rang byon lnga ldan 'phrin las bzhis/ / gangs can bstan pa'i rmang ga'i btsugs pa ltar/ / dus mtha' 'dir yang rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las kyis/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde yun du spel gyur cig /lha bab dus chen dang 'brel ba'i ston pa'i rnam thar ni/ lha yi lam nas rdzu 'phrul gyis bab ste/ / lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro kun 'dul mdzad pa/ / lha mi'i ston pa shākya'i rgyal po yis/ / lha bcas skye dgu yongs la shis pa stsol/ / zhes dge legs su byed pa'i tshig gis sngon bsus te gang zhu na/de'ang paṇa chen shākya shrīs/ bzhi ba'i bco lngar rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / drug pa'i drug la chos 'khor bskor/ / dgu pa'i nyer gnyis lha las babs /475

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/gsungs pa bzhin tha skar ram dbyu gu'i zla ba'i tshes nyer gnyis 'di ni lha bab kyi dus chen yin la/ de'ang dbu ma rin chen phreng ba las/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / / lha rnams kun las babs pa dang / / de bzhin du ni mya ngan las/ / 'das pa ston pa'i mdzad pa yin/ / zhes lha las babs pa de mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi gcig tu gsungs pa dang / theg bsdus las mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi grangs la mu stegs can gyi gnas su gshegs pa zhes mu stegs kyi ston pa ring 'phur dang lhag spyod kyi drung du thog mar phebs nas thar lam tshol ba'i tshul bstan te srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug gi bar mngon du mdzad kyang de dag 'khor ba'i rgyu las ma 'das par gzigs nas mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin bor te gzod thar lam tshol bar mdzad pa de nyid gcig tu bgrang ba gnyi ga'i dgongasagazhi ni zla ba snying po'i mdo las/ bdag gis mu stegs can gzhan dag / ces sogs gsungs pa ltar mu stegs kyi ston pa dang lta sgom spyod pa'i skyon ma mthong na thar 'dod rnams nang ba'i bstan pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol bar mi 'gyur bas mu stegs can pham par mdzad pa de ston pa'i mdzad chen gtso bo zhig tu mdzad pa yin la/ de'ang yongs su grags pa'i cho 'phrul mu stegs ston pa drug dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran nas pham par mdzad pa ni cho 'phrul chen po dang / lha las bab pa la cho 'phrul chung ngu'am cho 'phrul phyi mar grags pa yin/ mdzad pa 'di nyid bstan pa'i dus ni lcang skya gong mas mdzad pa'i dus chen gyi bshad par lcags byi zhes 'byung yang / lo 'di ston pa'i dbyar gnas bcu bdun par gsungs pas ston pa drag po lcags sprel la sku bltams shing / shing rta la sangs rgyas pa'i dbang du btang na dbyar gnas bcu bdun pa lcags khyi dang 'grigs pas snga ma yig skyon zhugs pa yin/ mdzad pa bstan tshul ni mu stegs ston pa drug sogs btul te skye bo thams cad ston pa nyan 476

༄/ /le'u tshan thor bu3 tshogs bzhugs so/thosadang bcas pa la ha cang gus pas dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur 'du 'dzi sogs ches mang ba de chos kyi bar chad du gzigs nas rgyun bcad pa dang /yumasgyu ma lha mdzes ma sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes yod pa de rjes su bzung ba sogs kyi ched du sum cu rtsa gsum du byon nas shing yongs 'du sa brtol gyi drung ar mo ni ga'i steng du shā ri'i bu dang 'od srung chen po sogs dgra bcom pa brgyad stong dang lhan du dbyar zhal gyis bzhes/ chos bzang lha'i mdun sar gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i mdo dang / lha'i dga' tshal du phebs nas 'od zer spro bsdu'i rol pas ngan song dgug dral sogs mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis lha'i dbang pos nor bu dri ma med pa bya ba lha'i bu zhig shi 'phos te 'ag bdun lon pa de gang du skye zhes zhus pas mnar med du skyes yod tshul gsungs pa na de skyob pa'i phyir du gsol ba btab pas ngan song spyong rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sprul nas brtag pa dang po gsungs/ phyag na rdo rjes brtag pa phyi ma gsungs te spyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi rnam gzhag sogs de nas byung ba yin/ snga ma'i yum gyi skye ba de nyid la dbyig ldan gyi gzungs bka' bstsal te smin cing grol bar mdzad/ skabs der lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i rkyen gyis lha'i dbang pos zhus nas rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gsung / de bzhin du lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa skyob pa'i phyir gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs mdo dang / lha rnams la mchod rten bgyid pa'i thabs rten 'brel snying po/ byams pas zhus te 'dzam bu'i gling pa rnams kyi nyer 'tshe bzlog pa'i thabs la mi g.yo ba'i rgyud sogs gsungs/ de'i tshe wa rā ḍā si'i rgyal bo u dra ya nas ston pa rjes su dran nas tsan dan koni ṣa las ston pa'i sku zhig bzhengs pa ston pa lha yul nas phebs pa'i bsu ba mdzad pa de da lta rgya nag tu bzhugs pa'i tsan dan jo bo 'di nyid yin par grags/ de'i tshe ston pa yun 477

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/ring por dngos su ma mjal ba'i dge slong rnams dang rgyal po u dra ya na sogs yid gdungs te mo'u gal gyi bu la ston pa gang du bzhugs yod ces dris pas sum cu rtsa gsum na dbyar zhal gyis bzhes yod tshul gsungs/ 'brug pa pad dkar gye chos 'byung du u dra ya nas mu stegs ston pa drug la dris tshul bshad kyang cho 'phrul snga ma bstan pa'i skabs nas ston pa gzhan lnga yul dbus su sdod ma tshugs par mtha' 'khob tu bros/ rdzogs byed bum pa phye mas bkang ba mgul du btags te chur lcebs pas kho rang gi slob ma rnams btsal du song ba na bu mo zhig gis/ ngan song sems can dmyal ba la/ / lag pa brkyang nas 'gro ba yi/ / rdzogs byed de ni chus g.yeng ste/ / rkang lag skya bor gyur cing 'dug / ces smras pas ro dzing bur yod pa mthong ste slob dpon gyis dgongs pa'i thar lam mthar thug pa 'di nyid yin par 'dug snyam nas kho rang rnams kyang chur lcebs par gsungs pas de dus ston pa drug ngom mi tshang zhing yul dbus su bsdad med pas lo rgyus de ma dag pa yin/ dgu ba'i bco lnga dbyar gnas rdzogs mtshams la dge slong rnams kyis zhus te mo'u gal gyi bu sum cu rtsa gsum du phebs nas sangs rgyas la 'dzam bu'i gling du 'byon par gsol ba btab pas da ste zhag bdun na grong khyer gsal ldan nam saṃ ga zhes a ba dza ra'i nags u dum wa ra'i shing drung du 'byon par 'gyur ro zhes bsgos shig gsung bas/ mo'u gal gyi bu skad cig de nyid la phyir phebs te rgyal po sogs la sbran pas thams cad kyis phyogs de byi ba dar dang chag chag byas/ de rjes ston pa lhag nas gong ma gong ma rnams su rim pa bzhin phebs te dga' ldan du sgrol ma sna tshogs 'byung ba dang sgrib pa rnam sel gyi rgyud/gzhan 'phrul dbang byed du sher phyin brgya lnga bcu dang rtogs pa bsdus pa/'og min du dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rgyud dang 'da' ka ye shes sogs 478

༄/ /le'u tshan thor bur tshogs bzhugs so/gsungs/ glang sum cu rtsa gsum du phebs nas lha'i bu zla bas zhus te sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u gsungs shing zla ba byang chub tu lung bstan/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i phyir gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs bka' stsal/ de'i tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyisabazo bo bi shwa garma la bka' bsgos te ston pa 'dzam bu'i gling du 'byon pa'ilam lha yul nas grong khyer gsal ldan gyi bar la dbus su baiḍūrya'i them skas/ g.yas su gser gyi them skas/ g.yon du shel gyi them skas sum rim du byas/ de nas nyi shu gnyis kyi nyin them skas dbus ma la bcom ldan 'das/g.yas ma la tshangs pas rnga yab thogs shing gzugs khams kyi lhas bskor ba/g.yon du brgya byin gdugs thogs shing 'dod khams kyi lhas bskor te byon/de'i tshe zhabs kho nas byon na mu stegs can rnams kyis lha yul du 'dod yon gyi g.yeng bas rdzu 'phrul nyams so zhes 'phya ba dang / rdzu 'phrul kho nas byon na lha rnams kyis them skas byas pa don med par 'gyur bas res 'ga' zhabs dang res 'ga' rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs te skye bo kun gyi mig dang yid la kun dga'i dpal ster zhing thar ba'i sa bon bskrun par mdzad/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs la brten nas mi thams cad kyis kyang 'dod gzugs kyi lha'i lus phun sum tshogs pa de mngon sum du mthong nas 'ga' zhig gis ltar smon pa byed/ de'i skabs su dge slong ma utpa la'i mdog 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs su sprul te ston par mjal du 'ongs pas 'ga' zhig gis 'khor sgyur la smon pa byed/ rab 'byor chung pas lha mi'i tshogs chen po 'di'ang myur du 'bral lo snyam du mi rtag pa yin la byas pas dgra bcom thob/ 'di tā ra nā thasaganas brtan rab 'byor yin pa lta bu zhig byas 'dug kyang sher mdo'i glingagazhi sogs dang mi 'grig pas mkhas pa gzhan gyis bshad pa ltar rab 479

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/'byor chung ba yin/ de'i tshe sems can so so'i bsam tshul mi 'dra ba de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs nas bka' stsal pa ni/ sa rnams gcig gis thob pa dang / / lha rnams su yang 'gro ba dang / / yang na ting 'dzin thob pa bas/ / rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mchog / ces sa thams cad la dbang ba'i 'khor sgyur dang / 'dod lha rigs drug khams gong mar skyes pa'i rgyu bsam gzugs brgyad la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang thob kyang 'khor ba las ma 'das pas snying po med la/ thar ba'i lam sna zin pa zhig gal che tshul gsungs te/ gdul bya bgrang las 'das pa la theg gsum thar pa'i sgo lam yangs por phyes/ de nas bzung ste dgu pa'i nyer gnyis la lha bab kyi dus chen du grags shing / mchod rten phyogs bzhir them skas kyis mtshan pa'i lha bab mchod rten du grags pa brtsigs/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa bar/rab tu byung ba'i gnas su dus ston bya ba chos dang mthun no/ / gsungs pa ltar dus chen de 'dra la dge 'dun rnams kyis chos ston byed pa'i srol ston pa zhal bzhugs dus nas bzung rgya gar tshun chad du dar ba bzhin/ phar phyin ston mo pa rnams kyis lha bab dus bzang byed pa 'di dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi phyag srol ma nyams pa skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa gong ma de nyid nas 'dzug par mdzad pa bzhin rang cag rnams kyis kyang byed rgyu byung ba 'di skal ba bzang po yin pas don dang ldan par 'gro nges pa zhig byed dgos/mtshams 'dir dus bzang gi 'grig lam sogs skabs su gang bab pa'i tshogs gtam byed/ ces pa 'di ni dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi sa mo yos lo'i phar phyin ston mo'i skyor dpon dkon mchog bzod pas bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /na mo ratna tra yā ya/ gang gi thugs rje a mṛ tas/ / las nyon gshin 480

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogasabazhugs so/rje'i 'jigs 'phrog cing / / 'chi med thar ba'i srog sbyin pa/ / dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyis skyongs/ / de'ang 'gro ba kun la phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pur gyur pa ni dkon mchog gsum po kho na yin la/delang zhing sa bzang bas mi chog par der sa bon rang gis 'deb dgos pa bzhin/ 'bras bu phan pa dang bde ba 'dod pa rnams kyis mchog gsum bslu ba med pa'i zhing la mchod cing bsnyen bkur bas bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi sa bon 'deb dgos te/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ 'jig rten dag na bde zhing skyid pa/ / de kun dkon mchog mchod las 'byung bas/ /de bas bde zhing skyid pa 'dod pas/ / dkon mchog mchod la rtag tu brtson bya/ / zhes gsungs so/ / mchod pa'i rnam grangs bla na yod med dang / phyi nangagasang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa sogs mtha' yas pa zhig yod kyang /mchog dman thams cad la lag len 'phral du mkho che ba ni yon chab dang mar me lha bshos sogs yin/ de dag 'bul ba'i snod 'byor bstun gyis rin po che las grub pa sogs byung na bzang la/ ma byung yang byi dor dang gtsang sgra thon pa shin tu gal che ste/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes kyis ting la mdzub rjes babs na'ang de ma thag phyis nas bsang dud mdzad pa sogs dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin bya/ mchod chu ha cang kha mthos pas rig pa mi brtan pa dang / phyir bo bas tshul khrims 'chal zhing 'khor mi 'du ba dang / kha ha cang dmas bas longasaspyod kyis dbul ba/ ting la yo can du bsgrigs pas dge spyor khrigs su mi 'ong ba sogs nyen shin tu che bas de ltar ma gyur par bkod pas mdzes pa/ 'bul tshul thog mtha' gnyis phra la bar du sbom pa nas 'bru ma'i tshul du bya bar gsungs/ 'bul ba'i tshe rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sngags sam/ ya nga na thun mong du mchod pa'i sprin gyi 481

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronasa'i khrung 'bum/gzungs brjod bzhin du phul na phan yon shin tu che/ mchod chu lan ci tsam phul yang ser sna sogs kye skyon 'jug nyen med pa dang / las nyon dkor sgrib sogs 'dag tshabs che zhing / byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi rtogs pas rgyud brlan pa sogs rten 'brel gye sgo khyad par can yod pas/ bka' gdamasagasar rnying gi dam pa gong ma rnams 'di la gtso bor mdzad do/ /mar me gtso bor 'od phul ba yin kyang rgyu'i zhun mar dang 'bru mar yang kha dog legs pa dri ro phun sum tshogs pa de lta bu byung na bsod nams rdzogs tshab lhag par che'o/ / mar me'i sdong bu'ang gser dngul sogs las byas pa'am/ snga ma 'ga' zhig shes rab phun sum tshogs pa'i phyir rgya khab kyi steng du ras bal gyes dkri ba'ang yod la/ ma mtha' 'ang dri bzang po'i shing ha cang sbom pa ma yin pa drang zhing rlan med pa'i steng du ras bal gyis dam lhod snyoms par dril te ring thung rkong bu'i tshad la dpag pas ji ltar 'tsham pa bya/mar me'i sdong bu srog shing dgos mi dgos kyi dogs pa byed kyang / de med par ras bal gyes tshod mi zin pas 'os med kyis 'grub la/ lung 'ga' zhig tu mar me'i sdong bu la shing bal gyi 'dab mas dkri bar gsungs pa sdong bu spyi tsam la mi 'grig pas nang gi srog shing la byed dgos pa dang / mgon po'i gtor chog tu yid dag gi phung po srog shing gi tshul du byas nas skra'i ras kyis dkri bar gsungs pa'i rigs 'gros kyis kyang shes so/ / la la 'od med par me ma shi tsam gyis rgyun gang ring byed pa mi legs la/ sdong bu ha cang sbom pas myur du 'bar ba'ang mi byed par/ 'od gsal ba'i steng nas dal 'bar byas na legs par bka' gdams kyi bstan rim las gsungs/ mar me phul bas mngon shes 'grub pa dang / chos kyi mig rnam par dag pa sogs phan yon du ma 'byung bar las rnam par 'byed pa'i mdo dang rin po che'i phreng ba sogs su 482

༄/ / le'utshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/gsungasal/ khyad par du ma rgyud kyi skabs gtum mo'i rnal 'byor la brten nas bde chen 'od gsal gyi ye shes 'dren pa la mar me phul ba rten 'brel gyi sgo lhag par che ba'i tshul bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u gnyis pa rtsa 'grel rnams kyis 'grub bo/ / zhal zas ni zan gtsang ma gang legs las bzos pa mar gsar ba'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i dbyibs phun sum tshogs pa phyag len bzhin bya dgos kyi/ sha ra pa'i gsung sgros las thud kyi sngo sa dang lo ma'i ser sa lta bu nas ma yin gye gang bzang ba nas bya dgos gsungs pa bzhin/ rang gis gang longs spyod rgyu de las bzang ba zhig dgos la/ ma mtha' 'ang de las mi zhan pa zhig byed dgos te/ bzang po rang gis longs spyod nas ngan pa dkon mchog la 'bul ba ni phan yon las kyang nyes dmigs che bas shin tu mi rung ngo / /der ma zad sman lnga dang snying po lnga la sogs pa'ang nang du bsres na gnas skabs su nad mug dbul ba sogs kyi gdung ba sel zhing nad kyi bskal pa sogs su mi skye ba dang / mthar thug dbang stobs sogs kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ro/ / mdor na rje bdag nyid chen pos/ 'di phyi'i bde legs thams cad 'byung ba'i zhing sa dam pa dus bzhi thams cad du rgyun chad med par bde legs kyi sa bon btab pas chog pa 'di la dad pa'i gshol gyis bsod nams kyi zhing med par gyur cig / ces mdo las gsungs pa ltar bya rgyu ma byung na ches shin tu phangs pa yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin bsod nams kyi zhing khyad par can la tshogs gang 'dod bsag tu yod pa'i skabs 'dir rang gis rang ma bslus pa byas te nus pa ci yod kyis dkon mchog la mchod pa rgya gang che dang / tha na zas kham gcig za na'ang de'i phud dkon mchog la bsngos te tshogs rlabs po che'i sbyor ba chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bskyang bar bya'o/ / mchog gsum byin rlabs sprin phung las/ /483

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/dngos grub rnam gnyis char 'bebs pas/ / mkha' mnyam lus can 'dzin ma la/ / dge legs lo tog rgyas gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni thu med shog nas rnam dpyod yangs pa rab 'byams pa ngag dbang rab rgyas kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /byams mgon thugs rje bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar gyis/ / bkra shis dge mtshan chu gter rgyas byed cing / / rnam grol kun da'i sa bon smin pa yis/ / chos srid rdzogs ldan dpal gyi sgo brgya phyes/ / zhes dge legs su byed pa'i tshig gis thog drangs te byams pa gling skor gyi lo rgyus dang phan yon cung zad brjod na/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i gsung gi dge ldan chos 'byung las/ skye dgu rnams ma 'ongs pa na rgyal ba byams pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe 'dus pa dang por skye ba'i rten 'brel du rgyal ba byams pa'i snang brnyan mchod pa'i tshogs du ma dang / tshe lo brgyad khri ba'i lus tshad pho mo stag seng ge g.yag la sogs pa dang bcas te phyir skor la gdan 'dren pa'i phyag len 'dzug par mdzad/ ces gsungs pa ltar rje bla ma'i mdzad chen bzhi'i ya gyal cho 'phrul smon lam gyi mchod pa'i mjug tu dgos dbang de lta bu la dgongs nas byams pa gling skor byed pa'i srol thog mar phye ba yin la/ spyir 'dul ba'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bya'o/ / de la dus ston bya'o/ / bltams pa dang gtsug phud dang dbu skra dang byang chub pa'i dus ston dag kyang ngo / / de grong khyer du gshegs par bya'o/ / zhes dang / khyogs kyis bkur ro/ / shing rtas kyang ngo / / de la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bsgreng ngo / / rol mo bya ba dang bkur bste chen po gzhan yang bzang ngo / / zhes dus chen so so la bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs khyogs dang shing rta sogs kyis btegs te mchod 484

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/pa'i bye brag du ma dang bcas dgon sde'am grong khyer gyi mtha' skor du skor ba byed pa'i srol ston pa zhal bzhugs pa'i dus nas bzung rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul sogs su rim pa bzhin dar ba yin pas/ dgon sde 'dir yang chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen gyi dus ston dang 'brel bar 'di bzhin byed pa skabs dang 'brel zhing dgos pa shin tu che ste/ gsal rgyal la gdams pa'i mdo las/ sku gzugs dag la skor ba byed pa de/ / phyi ma'i tshe na dgra chen rnams kyis btud/ / bzang po'i snod gyur yon tan rnams dang ldan/ /zhes spyir skor ba tsam la mngon mtho nges legs kyi phan yon tshad med pa 'byung bar gsungs la/ khyad par du 'di lta bu'i dus ston dang 'brel bar byams pa'i sku brnyan gdan drangs nas byams mgon 'jig rten du byon pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs te dga' ba'i sems kyis phyag dang mchod pa sogs byas na nges par rten 'brel gyi sgo khyad par can 'grig ste ma 'ongs pa na skye rgu tshe lo brgyad khri'i tshe 'khor sgyur dung gi mdun na 'don bram ze tshangs rab kyi sras su bltams shing bla na med pa'i byang chub mngon du mdzad de chos kyi bdud rtsi'i sgo mo phye ba na 'khor gyi thog mar 'gyur ba'i tshul ni 'phags pa byams pa'i mdo las/ me tog snyim pa gang tsam mam/ mar me gcig tsam 'bul ba'am/gzhan dag bsod nams byed pa la rjes su yi rang ba ste dge ba 'di dag byed pa'i lha dang mi rnams kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes dang / de dag ni byams pa sangs rgyas pa de'i tshe de'i drung du skye zhing dang po'i chos thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs la/gzhan yang byams pa 'byung ba'i mdo dang byams pa seng ge sgra'i mdo sogs du ma las kyang ston pa thub pa'i dbang ba dang byams mgon rnam gnyis kyi thugs bskyed 'brel ba'i stobs kyis bstan pa 'dir dge rtsa phra mo re bsgrubs pa tshun 485

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname gsung 'bum/chad kyang ma 'ongs pa na byams pas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur bsngos na 'grub sla bar gsungs so/ / der ma zad snyigs ma'i rgud pa sna tshogs kyis skye rgu rnams shin tu gzir ba'i dus 'dir mgon po 'di nyid kyi mtshan tsam la brten nas kyang 'jig rten mtha' dag bde zhing skyid par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa khyad par can yang yod de/ mgon po 'di la rje btsun byams pa zhes mtshan 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan phal po che'i mdo las thog ma kho nar byams pa'i sems kyi ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin par gsungs la/ ye shes thams cad kye 'od ces bya ba'i mdo las slob lam du byams pa bsgoms shing smon lam gnang ba nas bzung ste byams pa'i mtshan can du gyur bar gsungs pa dang / yum byams ma'i sras su 'khrungs pas byams pa zhes mtshan btags par rgya nag 'grel chen las 'byung ba lta bu ci rigs yod kyang gtso bor gyur ba ni zab rgyas gnyis kyi nang nas rgya che ba'i lam gyi bka' bab dang / de la rigs mang du yod pa las kyang rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa'i thugs rgyud kyi 'gro kun bde ba la 'god par 'dod pa'i byams pa chen po de nyid bzhin lag gi rnam par shar ba ni rje btsun 'di nyid yin pas de 'jig rten du byon pa'i rnam pa byas pa tsam gyis kyang 'gro ba rnams byams pa'i sems dang ldan zhing bde ba phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur te/ dam pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung las 'di'i tshe stag 'brong sogs rtsed mo byed pa'ang spyir de gnyis 'jig rten na mi mthun pa'i dper byed pa yin kyang / byams mgon 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe de'i thugs rje la brten nas yul gyi gcan gzan rnams kyang ma dang bu ltar gcig la gcig byams sems dang ldan par 'gyur bas de mtshon byed yin par gsungs so/ / mdor na dam pa gong ma rnams kyis bstan 'gror phan pa'i dgongs pa rlabs po che'i sgo nas 'dzug par mdzad pa 'di dag mdzes 486

༄/ / le'u tshan thor bur tshogs bzhugs so/chos dang ltad mo tsam du ma go bar 'di phyir dge ba'i phan yon la bsam ste phyag bzhes cung zad kyang ma 'chol bar lag tu lon pa shin tu gal che bas 'bad par bya dgos so/ / ma pham rgyal ba'i nyi ma 'jig rten du/ / 'byon pa'i rten 'brel thog ma'i sgo phye ba'i/ / dge 'dis 'jig rten bde zhing skyid pa dang / / ma 'ongs byams pa mgon pos rjes 'dzin shog / ces pa 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed su nyid tho yon chos rje'i sprul sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin chos 'phel gyis rang dgon du byams pa gling skor gyi srol gsar du 'dzug skabs de'i rgyu mtshan phan yon dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mtshog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /sngon tshong pa mang po zhig rgya mtshor yang yang phyin kyang 'dod pa'i don ma grub pas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i skye ba ded dpon legs par pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba zhig bzhugs pa de'i drung du song nas gsol ba btab pas khong ha cang bgres pa dang sngar rgya mtshor lan drug phebs pa'i tshe dgos don legs paragrub cing lan bdun 'gro ba'i srol med gsungs te re zhig 'al gyis ma bzhes kyang tshong pa rnams kyis khyed kyi thugs rje la brten nas nged cag gi 'dod don zhig ma grub na rang stobs kyis 'ongs mi 'dug pas cis kyang thugs rjes gzigs dgos zhes yang yang gsol ba'i ngo ma bzlog par rgya mtshor lhan du 'jug par mdzad/ 'on kyang de dag gi las dbang btsan pas mi mthun pa'i rlung drag po langs te rang dbang med par gru bdas nas 'o 'phreng can zhes bya ba'i rgya mtsho dang / me lce'i 'phreng ba can zhes bya ba'i rgya mtsho dang / ku sha'i 'phreng ba can zhes bya ba'i rgya mtsho dang / 'dam bu'i 'phreng ba can zhes bya ba'i rgya mtsho sogs rim bzhin brgal ba na steng nas drag po'ido char babs shing / rgya mtsho'i rba klong ri bo bla 'og brje ba lta bu/ nyi 487

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/ma'i dkyil 'khor yang de'i nang du nub pa lta bu shin tu 'jigs su rung ba de lta bur tshud par nye ba na tshong ba thams cad snying stor te 'gyel zhing / blo brtan pa 'ga' zhig gis ded dpon nyid la gsol ba btab ste nged cag thams cad rgya mtsho'i rba klong gis ril gyes mid pa 'di la khyed kyis thugs rjes gzigs zhes gdung bas 'o dod bos pa na brtse ba drag po skyes te de ma thag pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas spyi bor thal mo sbyar te 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad dpang por bzhag nas/ nged kyis shed phye ba tshun chad sems can gcig gi'ang srog la gnod pa byas pa med pas/de'i stobs kyis gru 'di phyir ldog par gyur cig ces bden stobs brjod ma thag mthun pa'i rlung gis gru phyir bsgyur/ las byed rnams kyis kyang ba dan la sogs pa bsgrengs te phyir 'khor bas/ mtshan mo der ded dpon gyis rgya mtsho'i nang gi sa rdo 'di dag bkra shis pa'i rdzas yin pas thub tshod re blangs nas gru nang du blug na gru'ang phyir ldog pa'i khyad yod gsungs pa na sa rdo yin pa'i blos rin po che'i rigs kyis gru bkang / phyi nyin nam langs pa'i tshe rang yul dang nye ba'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram zhig tu slebs shing / gru'ang rin po ches gang bar mthong nas thams cad shin tu dga' ste ded dpon la phyag dang bsnyen bkur rgya chen po byas so/ /bod kyi bla ma kha cig dkyil 'khor gyi thig 'deb pa sogs la thog mar bla ma dbang ldan du gnas nas byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ dkyil 'khor bri sgrub sogs zhi rgyas kyi las gtso bor gyur pa'i phyir dang / rgyud las zhi ba la shar dang /rgyas pa la byang gtso bor gsungs pa'i phyir ces bzhed do/ / de'ang 'thad par ma mthong ste/ dkyil 'khor bri sgrub sogs zhi rgyas gtso bor gyur pa ma yin pa'i phyir dang / de gnyis gtso na phyogs de gnyi gar sdod pa lhag par mi 488

༄/ /le'u tshan thor bulda tshogs bzhugs so/rung ba'i phyir dang / dbang ldan de gnyi gar mi gtogs pas rang gi zhe 'dod dang ma mthun pa'i phyir ro/ / dang po grub ste/ thun mong ba'i dngos grub las bzhi sogs gtso bor sgrub na dpa' bo gcig pa lta bus kyang chog pas/dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bris te sbyang gzhi sbyong byed tshang ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni mchog sgrub pa gtso bor byed dgos pa'i phyir/ 'on te mchog sgrub pa la'ang sdig ltung zhi ba dang sa lam gyi yon tan rgyas pa dgos pa'i gtso bo yin pas mi 'gal snyam na/ skabs de'i 'gal rkyen sel ba dang legs tshogs sgrub pa thams cad la dgos pas/ de ltar byas tshe rnam dkar gyi las la zhi rgyas gtso bor gyur pa'i khyab pa khas blangs dgos par 'gyur ro/ / rgyud las rgyasapa la byang gtso bor bsngags na thig 'deb pa'i tshe der 'khod nas thig 'deb pa rgyas par lhag par mi rung ste kha lhor bltas nas thig 'deb dgos pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ drag po'i sbyin sreg la byang nas lhor bltas te 'bul ba dang / rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg lho nas byang du bltas te dbul bar gsungs la/'di de las go bzlog pa'i phyir/ rigs pas kyang mi 'grub ste/ byang rnam sras dang dzi bha la sogs dngos grub ster ba'i lha rnams gnas pa'i phyogs yin pas der kha bltas nas dngos grub len dgos rgyu la rgyab ston pa mi rigs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du zhi ba la nub tu blta dgos par rgyud nas gsungs pa shar nasacub tu blta ba'i khungs su byed pa'ang gnod byed la sgrub byed du 'khrul ba'i nor ba chen po'o/ / shar byang gnyis zhi rgyas la gtso che na'ang de dbang ldan nas byed pa'i rgyu mtshan du 'brel ci yang med/ de gsum ga'i phyogs skyong ba'i bdag po so sor yod pas phan gnod kyi sgo gang yang mi gcig pa'i phyir/phyogs gnyi gar mi gtogs pa'i mtshams su 'jog dgos rgyu la phyogs gnyi gar gtogs pa'i khungs su byed na/ mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbus de 489

༄ / /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/mtha' gnyis gar gtogs pa dang / srid pa bar ma 'gro mi gtogs/ / zhes pade snga phyi'i 'gro ba gnyis gar gtogs pa sogs mi gtogs pa'i bshad pa thams cad gtogs pa'i khungs su sbyor dgos par 'gyur ro/ / dbang ldan shar du mi gtogs kyang byang du gtogs te de gnyis la don grub kyis rgyas 'deb pa'i phyir ro snyam na/ 'o na zhi ba dang 'brel ba'i rgyu mtshan stor ba yin pasakhyang du gtogs mi gtogs byed mi dgos kyi byang rang du gnas na chog par 'gyur ro/ 'o na dbang ldan nas 'deb ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin snyam na/spyir phyogs skyong bcu ka la 'das ma 'das gnyis dang / ma 'das pa la dkar phyogs pa nag phyogs pa gnyis re yod kyang / byang shar gyi bdag po phalab de ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po'i lus kyi bkod pa gcig yin zhing chos sgrub pa la brnag pa'i bdud du grags pa yin/ 'khor yang nag phyogs kyi 'byung po gdug pa can ches mang bas 'byung po'i rgyal po zhes gsungs te/ thog mar khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis de zil gyis mnan nas dkyil 'khor bris te sku gsum gyi rnal 'byor sgrub pa ni/ ston pas kyang thog mar bdud bcom ste byang chub mngon du mdzad pa'i rnam thar dang rten 'brel sgo bstun pa yin no/ /sku skye myur 'byon gyi de nyid gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ṭwāṃṭwāṃ /༷she/ bhenyi rdo bhesdi ༷/ rte/ byerte bhebhe ༷ shaṃ sdi/ ni/ hūṃ ༷ / ༷/ ṭwāṃṭwāṃ bhe di bhebye 490

/ /le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/kun snang gi bu kun skyong bya ba'i yul na shing bzo kun dga' dang lha bzo kun dga'azer ba gnyis yod pa nang mi mthun pas/ lha bzo kun dgas gcig shos gsod 'dod nas nyin gcig yi ge rdzus ma zhig yab rgyal pos bskur ba'i khul byas te rgyal po kun skyong la phul ba kha phyes par/ kun snang gi yi ge/ bu kun skyong la bskur don/ khyed rang khams bde zhing rgyal srid chos dang mthun paraskyong bzhin du yod pa gzhir bcas/ nged lha yul na bde skyid phun sum tshogs par yod/ 'dir lha khang zhig bzhengs rgyur shing bzo zhig dgos 'dug pas shing bzo kun dga' yar thongs/ gtong lugs lha bzo'i ngag bzhin byas pas chog zer 'dug par/ rgyal po kun skyong gis 'o na ji ltar gtong dgos byas pa la/ yul mi thams cad la shing khur re dang snum phor re khyer shog byas te shing brtsegs nas steng du snum byugs/ dbus su shing bzo lag cha dang bcas bzhag ste me btang nas rol mo mang po bar ma chad par drag tu brdungs na du ba'i rta la zhon nas 'gro ba yin zhus pas/ rgyal pos shing bzo bos nas de'i rgyu mtshan gsungs par/ kho'i sems la de 'dra mi srid/'di lha bzo kun dgas g.yo sgyu byas par 'dug pas/ nga rang gis kyang thabs byed dgos par 'dug snyam ste/ rgyal po la bka' bzhin zhu lags/ yin kyang nga la bya byed kyi 'phro 'ga' zhig yod pas nyi ma bdun la bsring chog pa dang /'gro ba'i tshe nga rang gi zhing dkyil nas song chog pa dgos zhus par de yong gsung / phyir 'ongs nas chung ma la rgyu mtshan bshad de bza' mi gnyi gas nyin mtshan med par sa brkos te khang ba'i nang nas zhing gi 'og bar du sa 'og brgyud de song chog pa byas/ zhing dkyil nas yar brtol ba'i kha rdo leb chen po zhig gis bkab/ steng du sa blugs nas mi mngon par byas so/ /'gro ba'i nyin rgyal po dang mi thams cad 'dus te shing brtsegs pa na/ khos 49/

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/rdo'i zur mi gnon pa dang nang nas ci byas kyang gzhan gyis mi mthong ba'i thabs su/ khyed tshos rtseg mi shes par 'dug kha yangs na du ba bkram nas song ste shugs med pas 'gro mi thub/ gting yangs la kha rub pa byas na du ba 'dril nas thogs pa med par lha yul du 'gro ba yin/ shing rtseg tshul nged rang shing bzo yin pas mkhas zer 'dod pa bzhin byas so/ / de nas du ba phyur gyis song ste rol mo brdung ba dang kho rang dong nang du babs/ kha rdos bcadade khyim du 'ongs so/ / lha bzo kun dgas kho 'tshig yod snyam dga' nas rdzun 'gebs su gnam la mdzub mo bsgrengs te mgo yug yug byed cing shing bzo ya gi na ya gi na byas mi rnams kyis bltas pas cang ma mthong la las du ba dum bu dum bur lhog lhog 'gro ba'i dbyibs la 'khrul te 'dug 'dug byas pas thams cad kyis bden par bzung nas ya mtshan du gleng ngo / / shing bzo khyim du sbas nas bsdad de lus la nyi ma dang bser bus ma phog pa byas/ chu dron dang 'o mas yang yang bkrus pas lus shin tu dkar por song / zla ba gcig tsam 'das pa dang dar dkar gyi lwa ba zhig bzos nas gyon/ yi ge rdzus ma zhig bzung nas rgyal po'i drung du song ste yi ge phul ba'i nang du/ shing bzo 'dis lha khang gi las ka la shin tu go chod pas phan thogs chen po byung / 'dir skyid po byas nas bsdad chog byas kyang khos bu smad gso dgos pa dang rgyal po'i phyag g.yog sgrub dgos zer nas phyir song yod pas/ nged kyi drin la bsam ste 'dir bdag rkyen gang gzab cig gyis/da tshon zhig gtong rgyur lha bzo kun dga' yong dgos shing yong lugs sngar bzhin byas pas 'thus byas 'dug pas/ rgyal po shin tu dga' nas gser dngul/ gos dar/ rta/ glang po che/ ma te/ ra lug sogs bdag rkyen tshad med pa byas so/ / de nas lha bzo bos te rgyu mtshan gsung bar/ shing bzo 492

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/mngon sum du phyir 'ongs pa mthong nas 'gro lugs shig yod dam snyam du 'khrul ba dang / shing bzo phyug por song ba mthong nas nor la rngam pas khas blangs so/ / de nas sngar ltar bsreg pa dang 'gro thabs ni med/ phyir 'bud 'dod kyang shing brtsegs che ba dang mes gdungs nas 'bud mi thub/ 'o dod bos kyang rol mo'i sgras bkab nas sus kyang ma tshor bar gson por bsregs so/ / dpe de dang ci zhig 'dra na/ da lta bla ma dang skyes bu dam pa'i ming re bzung ste gdeng ci'ang med par dkor rdzas 'ba' zhig bsags nas phyir skyes te longs spyod rgyu'i 'dang byed pa rnams de dang 'dra'o/ / ji ltar 'dra na lha bzo kun dgas kyang da lta sos bde mor yod dus mtho gang nam mkha' la 'phur mi thub na/ mes steng 'og kun nas bsreg dus lha yul du 'gro ba'i nus pa med pa shes bzhin du rang gis g.yo sgyu byas pa de rang blo rang la lkog tu mgyur pa yin mod/ de bzhin du da lta mi lus thob/ phyi nang gi mthun rkyen tshang / blo rig thabs gsum 'dzom pa'i dus su'ang tshe 'dir ji tsam sdod rgyu dang phyi mar 'gro rgyu'i dbang dang nus pa ci yang med pa rang gis mngon sum du grub pa 'di yin na/ las kyi rlung gis bdas/ bar do'i 'khrul snang gis g.yeng ste bya spu rlung gis khyer ba lta bu'i dus su phyi ma'i skye ba gang 'angod du len rgyu'i dbang med pa rang gi myong bas 'grub bo/ / 'on kyang shing bzo rang gi zhing nang nas phyir khyim du 'ongs te lha yul nas 'ong rdzu byas kha dog je dkar du song yod pa mthong bas nges par 'ong lugs shig yod dam snyam du 'khrul ba dang / nor rdzas la sred pas yid bslad de lha bzo kho rang yang lha yul du 'gro bar khas blangs pa'i dpe de bzhin du/ da lta 'byor ba dang grwa rigs cung zad yod pa'i bla mar ming btags tshad 'das pa na/ rang gi nye du'am/sbyin bdag lta bu re ltos byed sa re nas 'khrungs so zhes byis pa re gos dar 493

༄/ /༅ thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gyis btum ste lder sku bzhin du bzhag tshang mas blun dad kyis nor rdzas mang po 'bul ba mthong ba na/ nges par phar nang zhig nas rang gis gang 'dod du phyir 'ong lugs shig yod rgyu yin nam snyam du 'khrul zhing / snga ma'i nor rdzas blos ma thongs pa'i steng du da dung skye ba brgyud nas gsog 'dod kyi sred pas cung zad kyang bkol mi thub par rang nyid sku skye rgyu'i rtsis byed do/ /yang lha bzo kho rang gal la thug pa na gnam la 'phur ba lta ci/ shing brtsegs che ba dang mes gdungs pas phyir yang 'bud mi thub/ tha na ngan skad bton pa'ang rol mo'i sgras bkab nas sus kyang ma tshor bar gson por bsregs te gzhan la g.yo sgyu byas pa'i la yog rang la mthong chos su smin no/ / dpe de bzhin du skye shi'i 'phrang la slebs pa na bsam bzhin du dag pa'i skye ba 'dzin pa lta zhog dkor gye bud shing brtsegs che ba dang sdig ltung gi mes gdungs pas bde 'gro tsam du'ang thon mi nus la/ sngar gson gshin kun gyi mgo bskor ba'i la yog gis rang la dge rtsa byas pa de'ang gnad du mi 'gro ste/mchod khrus byed khul dang / gdung mjal phyag mchod byed khul sogs rang ngan song na sdug skad lhang lhang byed kyin yod pa'i thog tu phan rgyu med la gnod tshab che ba'i gdung rdzogs kyi chob chob mang po ni lha bzo bsreg dus kyi rol mo brdungs pa lta bu zhig 'byung ngo / / gal te rang dbang du skye ba len pa'i nus pa yod na'ang / skyes nas bstan pa la phan pa cung zad cig bya dgos kyi/ de 'dra'i dgos pa ci yang med tshe dag pa'i zhing du ma bzhugs par ma dag pa'i zhing 'dir byon nas gnyen bshes g.yog 'khor skyong ba tsam zhig yin na/ shing bzo kun dgas kho lha yul du sdod mi khom/ mi yul du song nas bu smad gso dgos zhes pa dang khyad med la/ mi tshe sdig la bskyal na 'chi dus dag zhing du 'gro 'dod kyang mgo thur du bstan nas mar ngan song du 'gro 494

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/dgos pa/ shing bzo kun dga' lha yul du 'gro kha sa 'og tu 'dzul ba lta bu zhig 'byung / da lta phal mo cher 'das rtags dang 'khrungs rtags 'grig 'grig mang po bshad nas blun po'i mgo bskor ba'ang / dud pa'i nang na ya gi ya gi byas pas gzhan rnams kyis bden par bzung ba dang 'dra'o/ /mdor na rang la 'brel ci yang med pa'i bu chung zhig la rang gi ming btags dus der cha rkyen ma 'dzom gyi dogs pas sdug gsog byed/ rang gi rnam shes ngo ma de gar 'gro dang / de'i steng la skyid sdug ci yong gi bsam blo tsam yang med pa ni nges par spyos pa yin te/ spyon pa'i spyo spyod kyang phan pa la gnod par bzung / gnod pa la phan par bzung / don med pa la 'bad/ don yod pa rnams bor ba las thu ba zhig byed rgyu med do/ / des na dbu ma bzhi brgya ba las/ rnam shes gnas pa med pa las/ / gal te spyon par 'gyur na ni/ / srid gnas spyon pa ma yin zhes/ / mkhas pa su zhig smra bar 'gyur/ / zhes pa ltar rang la nus pa med par shes bzhin du gzhan gyi g.yo sgyu la 'khrul ba'i zhor gyes rang yang de'i grangs su 'tshang ba ni rnam shes rnal du ma gnas pa yin la/ rnam shes rnal du ma gnas pa der spyon pa zer ba yin no/ / 'on kyang rgyu 'bras cha mi mtshungs pa'i spyod tshul spyon pa'i zlos gar 'di la blun po kun dga' bar 'dug pas/ de'i ming la spyon pa kun dga' 'am blun po kun dga' zhes thogs shig kye ma mi shes pa'i gdon gyis brlams pa'i spyod tshul 'di la mi srid pa ci yang srid par snang ste/ rang la 'brel ci yang med pa'i byis pa ma 'ongs pa zhig gi don du da lta nas sems khral byed cing 'bad pas bsags pa'i nor rdzas thams cad de'i don du 'jog de'i ched du bsags pa'i sdig ltung thams cad rang thog tu khur nas 'gro ba'i phyin ci log gi bdag gzhan mnyam brje ji tsam nyams su blangs kyin rang ga'an 495

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gnyi ga phung la spyor ba 'di 'dra byed pa las/ nges par bdag gzhan mnyam brje byed na rgyal ba'i gsung rab las 'byung ba bzhin mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad thog mtha' bar gsum du drin che tshul bsams te de dag gi sdig sdug thams cad rang steng du blangs/ rang gi bde dge thams cad de rnamasa'i nye ring med par btang na don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa zhig 'byung ngo / / chos bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bur bla gzugs byas/ / dus nyin mtshan med par dkor rdzas bsags/ / de spyod pa'i bdag po thang nas 'tshol/ /rang lag stong du 'gro ba a tsa ma/ / ro dngos grub can gyi gtam bklags tshe/ / don 'char tshul gye go ba 'di skyes nas/ / rang skal mnyam bcas la phan phyir bris/ / chos sgrub 'bras 'dzol ba med par shog / 'di ni shing khyi'i lor dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin nas dbyar zhal bzhes gnang ste/ dbyar ljongs kyi nyin skyo bsangs la phebs nas ro sgrung 'don bcug ste gsan/ dgung mo phyir phebs phral de'i nang gi lo rgyus le tshan la 'khris te 'di sam ṭa'i ngos la phyag bris gnang 'dug pa/ mtshang la rgol ba'i gdams pa khyad 'phags shig tu snang bas/ bdag ratna ā nan tas yi ger bkod pa'o/ /thar 'dod skyes bu bag pod la spyor ba'i gtam nyes pa'i sgo 'gog ces bya ba bzhugs/bla ma thub pa'i dbang po thugs rje'i bdag nyid chen po dang ldan pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / brtse bas nye bar dgongs te lus can mtha' dag bag med pa'i gnas las bskyab tu gsol/ / de'ang ched du brjod pa'i tshom las/bag yod 'chi ba'i 'jigs med de/ / bag med pa ni kun tu 'chi/ / zhes 496

༄/ / le'u tshan thor bur tshogs bzhugs so/rgyun du dran shes bsten te sgo gsum bag yod par gnas na nyes spyod mtha' dag rang 'gags su song ste srid zhi'i 'jigs pa thams cad las thar par 'gyur zhing / bag med pa'i dbang du song na dad brtson shes rab sogs yod kyang sgo du ma nas nyes pa'i g.yang du lhung ste phung bar 'gyur bar gsungs/de'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'dul ba'i mdo las kyang bslab pa brjod pa'i mjug tu don bsdus nas/ bag yod par sgrubs shig ces gdams pa yin no/ / bag medakyi spyod pa sna tshogs yod kyang shin tu smad pa ni chang dang tha ma kha rgyan po sogs khyim pa ya rabs rnams kyang 'dzem pa'i gnas su byed pas rab byung gis gtan nas byar mi rung la/ de bzhin du rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs dor te khyim pa'i chas sprod cing / 'gro 'dug spyod lam mtha' dag khyim pa ltar byed pa ni rang gis khas blangs pa'i sdom khrims dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa che bar ma zad bstan pa'i dbu 'phang smod pa'i bdud las su shes par byas te spong dgos so/ / chang gi nyes pa ni/ mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag 'dul ba lung / skyes rabs sogs su rgya cher gsungs pas 'dir mi spro 'ing / tha ma kha ni rgya gar na med pa'i dbang gis mdo sde las nyes dmigs dngos zin la gsal bar gsungs pa med kyang / gzhan la nyes dmigs gsungs pa'i rgyu mthun rigs pas sbyar nas shes shing 'dzem dgos pa ni rgyal ba nyid kyi dgongs pa yin no/ / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis kyang / 'di ston pas bcas pa mdzad pa'i dus su byung na chang dang khyad med du 'gog rgyu'i tshod yin/ gsungs tshul dam pa gong ma'i gsung rgyun las 'byung ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni 'dis sems myos par byed cing mang du bsten gyin spyod pa je rtsing du song ste 'phyar g.yeng sogs bag med pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs la 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / lhag par yang 'di ni thog ma bdud rigs kyi bud med cig 497

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgroname gsung 'bum/gis smon lam log par btab pa'i zla mtshan gyi sa bon las byung ba'i rdzas ngan yin pas/ de'i dud pa phog na sngags kyi nus pa nyams shing yi dam chos srung rnamasagayel bar 'gyur/ dkar phyogs kyi lha klu rnams dang 'go ba'i lha lnga sogs kyang dbye bar byed/ bdud rigs sogs nag po'i phyogs rnams sha rul la sbrang bu 'khor ba bzhin nye bar 'du zhing / de dag ji tsam 'dus pa bzhin du lus ngag yid gsum mi dge ba'i phyogs su 'khor ba dang / chos ldan gyi bya ba lam du mi 'gro bas ci byas thams cad log par song ste tshe dang bsod nams 'grib cing ngan song gi gting rdor 'gyur ro/ / der ma zad sgog skya dang / kun dong zos nas zhag bdun dang gsum du gtsug lag khang la sogs par 'jug mi rung bar gsungs na/ smon lam log pa'i rdzas ngan 'di lta bu'i dri ma khar zhen bzhin par gtsug lag khang sogs su song na rten rnams grib kyis mnol zhing rang la rnam smin lci'o/ / lhag par du ba mang du 'then na des rtsa lam rnams 'gags te 'pho ba sogs sbyangs kyang mi thebs la/'chi kha'i dus skyes bu dam pa gzhan gyis 'pho ba sogs btab kyang phan mi thogs pas gal che dus der gnod tshabs shin tu che bas 'gyod kyang 'phyis pa yin no/ / mdor na yi dam chos srung sogs mi dgyes shing dam pa rnams thugs khrel ba dang / glo nad grib dang cham pa gdon bgegs sogs kyi sna 'dren/ phyi mar rnam smin mi bzang ba sogs nyes dmigs che la/ bkres skom tsha grang gang gi nyams la'ang phan rgyu med pa spyon pa'i spyod pa lta bu 'dir blo ldan rtogs dpyod can zhig gtan nas 'jug tshul med do/ / de bzhin du khyim pa'i cha lugs gos dkar po sogs gyon pa/ mtshon cha thogs pa/ glu gar byed pa sogs khyim pa'i bya spyod ltar byed cing / bsam bzhin du rang rang khyim pa'i grangs der phar ji 'dra byed pa ni lag na yod pa'i yid bzhin 498

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/gyisgor bu mi gtsang ba'i dong du 'phang ba'am/ gser las dkon pa'i tsan dan sa mchog thal par byas pa dang 'dra bas/ rang gi rang bslu tshul dang gyong de las che ba med/ khyim pa rnams kyis kyang nged tsho la khyad ci yod ces brnyas shing / de'i shan gyis rab byung spyi la'ang mi gus par 'gro bas de dag gi bsod nams 'dzad cing bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren du 'gro ste 'di 'dra ba ni rang gzhan gnyi ga phung bar byed pas/ 'dul ba'i sde snod las khyim sun 'byin pa zhes shin tu smad do/ / der ma zad bag med kyi cha lugs sna tshogs byas na chos srung dang dkar phyogs skyong ba mtha' dag mi dgyes pas rang rang la bkra mi shis pa 'byung bar ma zad/ yul phyogs su'ang mtha' dmag gi gnod pa/ rje 'bangs gyen log sogs 'thab rtsod 'khrug long dang / 'go ba'i nad rims/ sad ser than pa sogs sgo thams cad nas mi 'dod pa sna dgu 'byung tshul zla ba snying po sogs kyi mdo dang / rgyal po bka' 'bum sogs tshad ldan du mas lung bstan 'dug kyang / lung khungs rnams 'dir ma drangs kyang lta 'dod na de dag tu gsal bas/ don gyi snying bo long bas glang rnga bzhin du bstan pa'i mjug tsam zin pa'i dus 'dir dran shes bzhin bsten nas sgo gsum bag yod par byas te rang gis rang ma bslus pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che lo zla re re tsam yin kyang gnas pa'i thabs la ci nus su 'bad dgos so/ / zhes pa 'di ni dad ldan dge slong 'jam dbyangs don grub kyis bskul zhing / rang gis kyang 'di rigs dgag bya che bar mthong ste phan semasakyi khul du/ 7 btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes skye bo rnams la 'azin du gsol ba yin no/ /ko tam bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren tha ma kha/ / kho thag chos la gcod byed tha ma kha/ / go rig dran pa slad byed tha ma kha/ / ngo tsha khrel 'dzem 'dor byed 499

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/tha ma kha/ / co 'dri bslu brid sna 'dren tha ma kha/ / cho rigs bzang po slad byed tha ma kha/ / jo bzang min pa'i dan rtags tha ma kha/ / nyo le dge sbyor 'chag byed tha ma kha/ / to ger tshun chad dri mnam tha ma kha/ / tho co'i spyod pa mthar zad tha ma kha/ / do gal ci yang med bzhin 'di la spyod/ / no bsam ci yang ma thongs 'di la dga'/ / po ti lnga la mkhas pa'ang 'di yis bslad/ / pho rabs snying stobs can yang 'di yis bslad/ / bo rnyi sgrub brtson 'ga' yang 'di yas bslad/ / mo btsun gtsang sbra can yang 'di yis bslad/ / tso ras tsam yang tsha grang skyob mi nus/ / tsho snum zas bzhin lus zungs skyed mi nus/ / dzo ki'i spyod bzhin grogs su 'khyer mi nus/ / wo brgyal don med mig chu 'dzag par zad/ / zho sogs zhim dgu bsten kyang bro ba bslad/ / zo mdog mi bde gdon dang nad rims slong / / 'o dod bos kyang lha srung 'khor mi nus/ / yo dong g.yang sa lta bu 'di spongs shig / ro langs gdon gyi sna 'dren 'di spongs shig / lo thog sa bcud nyams byed 'di spongs shig / sho dang khram la 'deb byed 'di spongs shig / so dang sems rgyud nag byed 'di spongs shig / ho ho bsam zhing bsam zhing 'gyod dgos pa/ / au to bla ma'i tsar lig khe tsho'i ang / /bla mchod kyi cho ga 'jigs byedakyi rnal 'byor gtso bor gyur pa'i sgo nas nyams su len chul bzhugs/de'ang bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor gtso bor gyur pa'i sgo nas nyams su len par 'dod pas tshogs zhing gi gtso bo rje rin po cher byed pa sogs gzhung gi dkyus ltar byas na shin tu 'brel che ste/ spyir 500

༄/ / le'u tshan thor bu sna tshogs bzhugs so/'jam dpal zhi khro mtha' dag ngo bo gcig kyang / sgos su rje bla ma ni dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed mi'i gzugs su shar ba'i tshul rje dge 'dun rgya mtshos/ ma rung gdug pa 'dul mdzad gshin rje'i gshed/ / mi yi gzugs kyi rnam rol tsong kha pa/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de'i rgyu mtshan yang chos rje don grub rin chen la mchims blo bzang grags pas mdo smad du sgrub pa nan tan byas na rdo rje 'jigs byed dang mjal bar lung bstan pa/ don grub rin chen rang nyid chu dkar ri khrod du bzhugs pa'i tshe mnal lam du rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis sang phod da tsam nged lung ba 'di'i mdar 'ong rgyu yin pas de'i bar du bde bar gyis zhes gsungs pa'i phyi lo dus tshod der rje bla ma sku 'khrungs shing /rje rang gis mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa la/ nged kyi rjes 'jug rnams yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed la byas na rten 'brel gyi sgo zhig yong ba yin gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'ang de yin no/ / rje 'di nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rje'i bstan pa 'di la'ang rdo rje 'dzigs byed kyis nga'i bstan pa zhes thun mong ma yin par bdag gir mdzad pa yin te/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa las/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ / nga yi bstan pa byung ba'i tshe/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa la/ / bka' bsgos las rnams tshul ba'in gyes/ / zhes chos rgyal la bka' bsgos pa dang / khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa gsang ba'i rgyud las kyang / da ni lnga brgya tha ma'i tshe/ / nga yi bstan pa 'byung bar byed/ / bstan pa thams cad nub pa'i tshe/ / nga yi bstan pa 'byung bar byed/ / ces gsungs so/ / 'o na de'i tshogs zhing gi gtso bo rje bla mar byas pa yin na phyag stabs yongs grags dang mi mthun pa ci yin skom na/ de ni rje bla ma ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod pa'i zhing du rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ror sangs rgyas pa'i phyag stabs su byas pa slar zhing mchog de nyid du skyes nas 501

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'izlanasa'i gsung 'bum/bstan pa'i snying po mthar thug pa zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba dang gsang chen rdo rje theg pa zung du 'jug pa'i lam bzang khyad par can mngon du byed nus kyi gdulabya skal ba mchog tu 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can yin par rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / skyabs mgon 'jigs med dbang po sogs zhal mthun no/ / cho ga'i tshig ris kyang dmigs bsal re gnyis ma gtogs rang sor bzhag pa legs te/ rgyud brtag pa gnyis par/'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / / rang gi tshogs ldan nyan po nga / / gsungs pa bzhin don la dbyer med kyang gdul bya'i snang ngor mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rje bla ma la zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mang du stsal pa'i snying po sprul pa'i glegs bam las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas bkod pa yin pas sgo mtha' dag nas rten 'brel gyi gnad gcig tu 'bab pas dgos pa shin tu che'o/ / des na skad cig dkrong skyed/ snod bcud dang mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa/ bde stong dbyer med ces sogs kyis tshogs zhing gsal 'debs pa'i bar dkyus bzhin byas la/ paṇa zhwas dbu la mdzes/zhes pa'i 'phror thugs gar 'jigs byed skyed tshul zhig bla mchod kyi khrid yig chen mor gsungs pa bzhin byas kyang chog mod/ lha bcu gsum tshang bar byed na/ phung po rnam dag bde gshegs lnga/ / zhes sogs kyang 'di'i lugs ltar gyis 'thus par byas chog ste/ spyir bla ma'i sku la skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus par bsam dgos shing / med du mi rung ba ni/ gshegs pa dang gshegs ma/ sems dpa' dang sems ma/ khro bo dang khro mo ste rigs 'di gsum ga'i gnad ma tshang na dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i bdag por mthong ba dang / dbang bskur ba sogs gnad tshang ba zhig mi 'byung bas/ sa skya pa rnams bla ma la gdan gsum tshang ba zhes zer ba dang / bka' gdams pa —502

༄/ /le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/rnams lha bzhir byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ / des na snga ma'i tshig mtshams nas 'di ltar bya ste/ skyil krung gis bzhugs thugs gar rnam shes rnam dag gshin rje'i gshed/ / sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag ni so bzhi bcu drug zhabs ldan zhing / / rdo rje ro langs ma dang mnyam sbyor chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid/ / spyi bo lte ba mgrin dang gsang bar me long ye shes sogs kyi dngos/ / phung po gzhan bzhi rnam dag gti mug gshin rje'i gshed sogs gshegs pa bzhi/ / lte ba snying mgrin dpral bar khams bzhi dag pa'i tshad med yum chen bzhi/ / phyag zhabs mthil la bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad stobs chen khro bo sgo srung bzhi/ / yul dbang skye mched sems dpa' sems ma'i bdag nyid bde skyong rnam par bcas/ / mtha' skor rim bzhin dngos brgyud bla ma zhes sogs man chad kyang dkyus ltar la/ skyabs mgon dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i 'phror/ cher snyigs dus mtha'i 'gro la brtser dgongs nas/ / khams gsum za byed khro bo'i rgyal po dang / / gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam rol pa/ / bla ma gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhi ba'i tshul gyis blo gros mchog ster zhing / / khro bo'i gar gyes gnod byed gdon bgegs 'joms/ / 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen kun stsol ba'i/ / bla ma gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / skye 'gro'i srog 'phrog las nyon rlung shugs bcas/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje ma lus pa/ /'joms mdzad srid zhi'i 'jigs sgrol ded dpon mchog / bla ma gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nyes kun bag chags zhes pa man chad gzhung bzhin/ bzlas pa'i skabs thugs gar hūṃ yig gi thig le'i nang du mi yig gis mtshan pa'i mthar 'jigs byed kyi sngags gsum dang dmigs brtse mas bskor b.rabasam ste bzla ba'am/ zhi khro sbrags sgrub byed 'dod na de'i thugs gar 503

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/'jamadabyangs gsal btab ste a ra pa tsa na bzla tshul gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya la/ rang rang gi thugs gar sa bon la sngags phreng gis bskor bar bsams nas 'khor rnams kyi sngags kyang bzlas na legs so/ / yon tan 'byung gnas zhes pa man chad dkyus ltar bya'o/ / smon lam gyi mjug gi/thob phyir bsngo/ / zhes pa'i 'phror/ khyad par bcom ldan 'jam dpal zhi khro yis/ / nam yang 'bral med dge ba'i bshes mdzad de/ / zung 'jug nor bu'i gling du phyin gyur nas/ / 'gro ba kun kyang srid las sgrol bar shog /ces sogs gshin rje'i gshed kyi bsngo smon rgyas bsdus shig rigs pas kyang mtha' brgyan parabya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni hal ha khu re chen mo'i grwa rigs dge slong dkon mchog mkhas grub kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang mi yi gar rol pa'i/ / yab rje bstan pa'i sgron me'i zhal snga nas/ / skye bo blo dman kun gyis go bde'i ched/ / phal skad tshul du gnang ba'i zab chos bzhugs/ / a las bzang tsho bzang ba chi a nyon da/rje btsun rin po ches dam pa'i chos gi nying khu rkyang ba gsung gi yod gi/ no zhas/ ya a rgya chi red/ bskyed rim rdzogs rim/ dbu ma'i lta ba tsho gsung gi yod ni e red/ khos/ te te/ khyod kha tshod ma mtho/ de tshos sngon na 'aspyo sgo ni'i chos zab mo cig re cig re yod/ slob dpon ārya de bos ra/ bsod nams min pa dang por bzlog bar du bdag ni bzlog pa dang / / tha mar lta zhig kun bzlog pa/ / zer ces rim pa rim pa yas 'gyo tshul zig bshad grod gi / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i ra/ 'og ma 'og ma'i lta ba gong ma gong ma'i steg zer ni'i thang na/ sangs rgyas gi bstan pa zer no 'di bo 'di skas a 'bud 'bud yas 'gyo na min ga ya tha na zab mo zig stsod gimyur mo zig grod gi badzes mchod rgyang yas snab pa mi 'gyo/ byang chub lam gyi 504

༄/ / le'u tshan thor bu sna tshogs bzhugs so/rim pa badzes zig mo/ khug len yas cho ga na rim pa zer sgo don shrīd ki ā/skyes bu gsum gi lam rim gi mgo tshugs sa bo 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom rgyu 'di yin/ 'di tshang ma'i kha nang na rtsar/ 'di'i bro kha phyogs mkhan dkon thag chod yin/ de'i rtags ga deng sang slob gnyer rgyag mkhan/ sgom sgrub yed mkhan gzhan don gi mying btag gi sku rim grong chog brda mkhan/ thams cad gi zhe 'dod dī/ rang rang skyid thabs zig phyug thabs zig mtho thabs zig 'di rkyang ba sems 'bu'i phug ga bcug 'dug ni po 'di tshe 'di snang gi dbang nga song ni red/ snang shes 'gong rgan 'di sgo 'phud mkhan na 'chi ba mitag pa sgom sgo ni red/ de ma yas a chos zab zab mtho mtho chi ra zig bca' kha yas nā ra/ de chos a mi 'gyo/ 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor ni min gi med zer ris mdo rgyud thams cad da jo bo yab sras tshos gsung grod gi ā/de'i stabs ki dam pa gong ma tshos mi rtag pa 'di rkyang ba gsung gi bsdad zigade ring rje btsun rin po ches de gsung ni red/ mi rtag pa 'di chos chung chung min/ mgo chos ā mjug rkyen 'dis yed da/ bar chos gi bskul ma 'dis yed da/ mjug mthar phyin skyang 'dis yed da/ khyed cha bro bltas gi nga rgad po chos rgyus sin re yod/ nos/ a rgya los zig los zig da yin nā/ mi rtag pa de tshos dra ma dri ma shes ā/ nged ki bka' 'gyur nang na/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ga'i sprin dang 'dra/ / 'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs/ /'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste/ / ri gzar 'bab chu ba'in du myur mgyogs 'gro/ / da rung cig re cig re yod ngas e 'don/ khos/ nyi hi/'don mi sgo mi sgo/ de sgra zig kyag btang ni red/ de'i mying nga shes ni mi zer/ne tshos ma ṇi bton ni ra khyad med/ kha gi bshad dus tshang mas 'di ru gzer ra ra/ de zer zhor ra/ phyi'i dgra 'dul rgyu/ nang gi gnyen skyong rgyu/ rgyu nom 505

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/pa bsog rgyu 'de a nyin mtshan nyis ka mi khom mā/ ya ra mdu ru ru/ mar ra mdu ru/ chi red/ phyin chad srid gsum rtag pas ldog kyi zig go ni min mo/khyed rnam pa rigs pa'i dbang phyug legs bshad 'dom mā 'ja' ne tshos ra/sgra chos can/ mi rtag pa yin par thal/ byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ skad cig ma yin pa'i cher/ gsung dī/ sa bsteb gtong thang gnam bgrwa gtong thang gnang gi ra/ bar 'ga' re bltas na skad cig ma mi sgo ni/ skal ba'i bar rā ra mi 'jig ci'i blo rtse zi ga āod khā red/ ngas sangs rgyas ka kha zhus ni min da/nga rgad pos bsam tshul yin na/ sgra chos can gsung gi 'dug rag gā/ rang rang chos can/ mi rtag pa yin par thal/ rnyed dka' rnyed na don che ba'i dal 'byor lan gcig thob pa 'di nam 'chi nges pa mi 'dug pas myur du snying po zhig len dgos par 'dug pa'i phyir/ gsung nge 'brus chung re kha nang nga gcig bskor na bka' drin che gi/ a tsa yi yi zhu rgyu mang mi nyan/ nga de ring mgon po rdo rje yin/ dus rgyun kho kho rang yin/ da mdo don rje btsun gi gsung na po 'di red/ thog mā/ rje lho brag mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/badzes ni po/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo pha rgan mar pa lo tsā mchod bajod yas ni red/ des nyon da gson da khyi ra pa/ badzes ni phong mgon po rdo rje snod ldan gi rin po che lta bu'i gdul bya yin ni po gi snod ldan nyan par bskul ni red/ khyed rug cha pos bzang nga chi a nyon pa/ nga'i zhor na yod kye red/a mja' ba tsho/ ras rus g.yang ma re bo bltas ma 'dug ga tshur chos ā nyon da/ sangs rgyas gi gsung 'di tsho'i sgra tsam zhig thos rgyu byung ni bo skal ba bzang ni yin/ sangs rgyas zhes bya'i sgra 'di yang / / 'jig rten dag na shin tu dkon/ gsung zig e spyo/ nos/ e a rgya/ mnyam por bsdad na gnyig gis dzi ma mi rig zer thang nga / khyod chos ā 'di 'dra zig mkhas ni bo 506

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/de ring min dam shes/ da rje btsun rin po che'i gsung tsho'i don mdo mdud mtha' sems mā 'dzin rgyu nyung nyung re shod de/ khos/ e dzā/ chos nyan tshul 'di a rten 'brel cig re 'grig rgyu yod ni red/ khyos shod da ma zer ra/gsung nga yin nā rdzos ra/ nos/ ya lags so lags so/ / gsung du gsol/thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas gsung du gsol/ zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ ya/ khos/ dī ra zig mtho bud thā ra/ da chos gi tshog gi/chos thams cad rten 'brel gi rang bzhin yin/ sbo da/ thog ma rang la rje btsun rin po ches/ 'brug 'ur sgra che yang stong sgra yin/ / gsung ba 'di chos ba 'jig rten pa tshang mas go dgos ni zig yin/ deng sang thos bsam sgom sgrub/ sbyin gtong / chi yas na zhe phugs de kho bzang gi e zer mam/blang bya cig ga med nis grags pa skam po zig gar ba med ni po 'di rang gi dge ba phran tshegs po 'jig rten chos brgyad da lpags nas chud zos ā gtong spyad pa yin/ snyan grags bdud kyi phye gtor zer/ rang gi bsod nams gi phyi re 'brus chung po/ grags skam gi rlung nga phyar btang ni chi len gyi yin/ di dga' gyi med/ 'jig rten gtam daste/ myi po kyag na 'chi ran/ rta bo kyag na btsong ran zer ra/ āo di 'phro/ 'ja' kha dog legs kyang yal nas 'gro/ / 'jig rten nyams su dga' yang rmi lam tsam/ / 'dod yo/na bde ba che yang sdeg pa'i rgyu/ / gsung zig ste rje btsun thugs rje can gi gsung 'di chi ma bden nā/ 'di na la las/ khang ba yar 'khor mar 'khor rigs mi gcig pa tsho phugs/ rgya nom bod nom khya khya rug rug tsho bsham/ phyi zog nang rdzas ug dmar gi tshang bsog bsog yas nes nang na nyams dga' mis mi tshad rang rang nga rang thig nas 'gyang bsdad yod thog ga 'chi bdag rgyal po rtseb nas byis thi khyas 'dzin 'dzin yas khyer dus/ tshe ba sog ngo skyag ges 507

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgon me'i gsung 'bum/sdong mgo khyer ra/ pho rog gis sdong rtsa khyer ra/ rang nga 'dzin rgyu khab skud pa zigagi med/ de med na med mo/ de'i don 'dag ga bsags nes sdig pa thams cad po gnya' ya khur ris 'gyo dgos/ tshe 'de e skyid brgyab ni po rmi lam zig rmis nis sad btang ni ra khyad med/ snying po med ni bo de dus shes ā/ 'gyod pa rtas mi zin ni po de dus yong dā ra/ don 'dag tshang song ni yin/ dang phyir song ni chos bca' ya brjes rung las ki gshin rjes mi gtong / chos bca' na bca' dus deng sang yin/ de ring nang snga gnyis ga'i ra gang snga la gzig ma brtsad na/ phugs ring po'i blo rtse ci yod/ de'i stabs ki rje btsun rin po ches/ de'i 'phro 'phro na/ 'dus byas rtag rtag 'dra yang myur du 'jig / rdzas kha sang yod pa de ring med/ / mi na ning yod pa da lo shi/ / grogs bzang po yod pa dgra ru sdang / / zas phan par zos pa dug tu 'gro/ / drin bzang po bskyangs pa kha 'gyod che/ / gsung ni red da/ 'di so lhag pa bshad ki chi 'dug tshang mas/ a ma a ma khis nyin par 'tsham por yin thā/ a ma khar rtsang cig na 'gyo bar ma dang shi song ziga.a ma na ni nga rgyu bzang thā ra/ do zig cang med ke brdzas khā 'dra 'dra/ nyin nyin khas bshad ki/ mngon sum ma rig gi/ dmar khrid 'deb ki la yod ni po de red/ gnyig da rna gis ma rig ma go ni ma red da/ sems 'di ā dkar sā zig ma brgyus ni red/ rang thog ga kha zig ma bskor ni po 'dis ma nyan ni red/ da rang gis rang nga snying zig rje dgo rgyu red ā/ tshe thung 'di'i skyid nā skyid khom chi yod/ sdug nā sdug khom chi yod/ dbugs rta rnga tsam pa 'di song dus sems ma 'dzin rgyu zig med na mi lus thob bā zer ram thob zer/ da 'og gsung thā ne min ni/ sdig sdug rang gis byas pa rang la gnod/ / khyod mgo brgya'i nang nas rang mgo gces/ / phyag sor mo bcu la gang bcad 508

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/tsha/ / bza' mang nang nas rang nyid gces/ / rang mgon 'don pa'i dus la bab/ / tshe 'di mi rtag myur du 'chi/ / chos la phyi bshol byar mi rung / /brtse ba'i gnyen gyis 'khor bar 'phen/ / o gnyen zer rgyu med/ deng sang phan 'dogs gā zer mkhan phal cher gi/ kha gi thong chos ma yed ma brdzes rung / rgyang bskor ni rgyu nom pa dgo tshus/ tshong kha bu log yed tshus/ de chos gi cha rkyen yin thang / 'dra 'dra 'grig 'grig tsho bshad nas/ kha 'jig rten gi gting nga bskor/ bag med gi bya ba ngan pa chos na bkag yod tshad po/ ā tshang mas de bca' gi yod gi/ 'dul ba yul dus yin zer/ spyod ngan rang gisakhyas/ bag ngan dus a 'jog ni po/ de'i mying nga sdig pagi grogs po zer ra/ bdud dga' rab dbang phyug yin badzes na chog / rog pa yod ni che ā phan ni red/ phyi mang po yod sā ste shor na rang rang e thar lta na min gi/rog pa sngo gi zer bsdad 'jog tshus med ā/ phyi mang rung rnam smin myong dus rang rang gi mgo yin/ mbi mang bar nas lus mi 'gyo ra/ sus phyong rog ga mi yed/ da nges nges gi da reb da rang mgo zig 'don dgo rgyu red/ nos a rgya kha lo nam tsha 'de ā thon rag ga rang mgo thon nis song ni yin/ da lhag pa chi 'don rgyu yin/ khos/ yā/ bya byis tshos 'ba' 'bu thus yi kha gsos 'gyo gi ra/ de rang mgo thon badzes ni ma red/ da sde bcas tshad po phyi tshe stong zad red/ rang mgo 'don na/ bla ma bsten pa'i dus la bab/ / tshe 'di ru bde laphyi mar skyid/ / dam chos byed pa'i dus la bab/ gsung thā a/ dang po lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul 'de ā rten 'brel ma 'chug pa zig dgo ni red/ de 'phro lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa tsho rim pas slob tshul mang rgyu red da/ de ring bshad nis thag mi chod/ nga rug tsho rje btsun rin po che'i zhabs phyi a 'gyo/ sgom re rgyag da/ nyams dang rtogs pa nang nas shar 509

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gi shar gi yong dus mdo sngags thams cad gdams par shar nas gtan gi bde skyid mgo tshugs yong / de dus rang mgo thon ni yin da/ gzhan gi mgo thon ni don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa brdzes ni po de yong rgyu red/de yang ji skad du/ ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang grags pa yi/ / zhes pa nas/ dpal ldan bla ma zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'ibastan pa rin po che phyogs brgyar spel ba'i thugs bskyed kyi mthu grub pa/sa gsum mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug rgyan/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bye ba'i mnga' bdag kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes grags snyan gyis sa steng khyab pa de nyid kun 'dzin zhes pa sa pho bya ba'i lor mdo khams smad 'dir sku 'khrungs/ dam pa'i rang rtags kye spyod pa mngon du gyur cing dgung lo bcu gsum pa la rab tu byung / dgung lo nyer gcig pa la dbus su phebs te bshad sgrub chos kyi dga' tshal dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar zhugs/ gzhung bka' pod lngas mtshon pa'i rgyu phar phyin theg pa'i chos tshul mtha' dag lhag ma med par thugs su chud/ dgung lo nyer dgu ba la dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dge 'dun smad rgyud rigs pa 'dzin pa'i grwar phebs te gsang chen chos kyi gan mdzod bdag gir bzhes/ dgung lo so gsum nas ri bo dge 'phel du phebs te thos don sgrub pas nyams su bzhes pa las mngon par rtogs pa 'i klong rdol/ lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i zab rgyas man ngag gi sgo brgya phyes nas skal bzang skye bo mtha' dag tshim par mdzad/dgung lo nga gsum gyi thog bkra shis sgo mang gi chos kyi khri la zhabs sen bkod de 'chad nyan gyi rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs/ khyad par sa'i steng na 'gran zla med pa'i legs bshad bka' pod chen po lnga gsar du brtsams pa'i 'phrin las kyis shar rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar du khyab/ dgung lo re gnyis pa sa 510

༄/ /le'u tshan thor bu sna tshogs bzhugs so/mo glang gi lo dpon ju nang gis mdo smad du gdan drangs te bstan pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i chos sde chen po 'di nyid phyag 'deb mdzad/mdor na 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum/ bshad sgrub bya ba las kyi 'khor lo gsum gang gi cha nas kyang 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa de nyid slar yang 'jig rten du byon pa ji lta ba zhig mdzad de/ sku'i bkod pa de nyid kyi 'dul skal yongs su rdzogs pa na re zhigazag med chos sku'i dbyings su sprul pa'i snang ba nye bar bsdus pa'i dus chen khyad par can dang 'brel bar/de'ang ji skad du/ gangs can mkhas grub/ ces pa nas/ skal ldan smin cing grol mdzad/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ khams gsum skye dgu'i bla ma nges don chos kyi rgyal bo/ bka' drin mtshungs med mtshan brjod par dka' ba skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang rje btsun 'jigs med dbang po de nyid nges pa'i don du bgrang yas bskal ba'i sngon nas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de/stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing mtshan 'dzin 'pho 'jig gi dri ma mtha' dag spangs su zin na'ang / thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor mu mtha' yas pa'i zhingakhams kun tu gang la gang 'tsham gyi sprul pa'i bkod pa chu zla bzhin du ston par mdzad pa las/ rang cag rnams kyi rigs kyi bdag por bzhengs pa skyabs mgon thugs rje'i mnga' bdag de nyid ni rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i nang tshan sa pho spre'u'i lor mdo smad sa yi thig le 'dir shing sā la chen po lta bu'i rigs phun sum tshogs par sku'i skye ba bzhes/ rgyal ba'i sras po gzhon nu nor bzang bzhin du chos kyi tshul la ngoms pa mi mnga' zhing / legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen kho na la rag las par gzigs nas gangs can gye ljongs 511

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/'dir bzhugs pa'i mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom gyi tshad ma'i skyes bu bcu phrag gsum las brgal ba rigs kyi cod pan du bzhes/ mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag gis bsdus pa'i dbang lung khrid man ngag bshad pa'i rgyun sogs sa'i steng na yod do cog gi gdams pa'i bdud rtsi ma lus pas thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gtams/ dbus gtsang gi gdan sa chen po bzhi dang bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan dpal gyi sa skya man chad nas shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i ska rags can gyi gong ma'i rgyal khab yan chad kyi skal ldan gdul bya mtha' dag rang rang gi skal ba dang mthun par smin pa brgyad ci rigs kyi sgo nas smin cing grol bar mdzad/ mnyam med bu ram shing ba'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i bstan pas gar khyab kyi sa steng yongs la bshad sgrub bya ba las kyi 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa phyag rjes rgyal ba'i dbang bo rim byon rnams dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i sgo nas khyab par mdzad de/ rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul pa'i phyir lcags mo phag gi lo rje bla ma dga' ldan du byon pa'i dus chen dang sgo bstun nas mdzad pa'i tha ma bstan pa'i dus chen yin pas/ thams cad kyis bla ma'i bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i dad gus dang /dge ba'i ngo bo 'bum phrag tu 'gyur ba'i phan yon gyis yid drangs te/ nang yid kyi mchod pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs rim/ phyi rags pa'i mchod pa phyag mchod gling me zhal 'don sogs gang thad nas rang rang gi bsod nams rdzogs phyir dang / skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i dmigs rkyen du 'gro nges pa'i gnad smin zhig ci nas bka' drin skyong bar zhu/ /de'ang ji skad du/ 'jigs mdzad bde gsang 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun tshogs/ / zhes pa nas/ rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab mdzad/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gsang chen bstan pa yongs kyi bka' 512

༄/ /le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/bab rje btsun shes rab seng ge'i rnam sprul rje bla ma'i gdan rabs lnga bcu pa khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs de nyid mdo sngags kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son te dga' ldan gyi khrir phebs nas rje'i gser gdung chen mo gsar bskrun mdzad cing rgyal ba pad dkar 'dzin pa'i yongs 'dzin mdzad de/bod dbus gtsang gi chos srid bstan pa yongs kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'ang bu slob phyogs kyi bla chen dang mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes bu gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu brgya phrag mang po yod na'ang / nang gi thugs sras gcig pu 'di nyid yin pas mdo smad du phebs dus khong gdan sa'i stabs kyis pheb rgyur ma song yang / kun mkhyen bla ma'i zhal nas/ ngas dgon pa btab 'jog rgyu yin/ slar khyed rang tshos skyong dgosagasungs pa la/ dung dkar zhig phul te khyed kyi legs bshad gang du dar ba'i phyogs der chos kyi dung 'bud par shog cig ces smon lam btab pa'irten 'brel gyis sku tshe rjes ma dbus su 'khrungs na'ang / sku na phra mo'i dus dpon mo rnam rgyal sgol mas gzhung sa chen por zhus te gdan drangs/'di nas gsan sbyong mthar phyin par mdzad/ rgyud pa'i khrir bzhugs shing /skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dbus su phebs nas dgon pa'i 'dzin skyong phra nyag gi skabs su tshogs chen khri'ang lan gnyis mdzad de bka' drin chen pos bskyangs/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi snyan grags sa steng kun tu khyab pas 7'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos gser gye rgyal khab tu gdan drangs te dang po nas bdag rkyen sogs tshad med pa gnang yang / snga ma'i thugs smon gyi stobs kyis der bzhugs ma 'dod par bsam bzhin du gzugs sku'i bkod pa nye bar bsdus pa'i dus chen khyad par can dang 'brel bar/de yang ji skad du/ ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam mgon chos rje yi/ / zhes 513

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/pa na bshes gnyen bzang po/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dpal ldan mkhas pa ma lus pa'i gtsug gi nor bu ngag dbang mkhyen pa'i gter dang gnyis su med pa kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i bka' srol mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi chos tshul mtha' dag phyogs brgyar spel pa'i thugs bskyed rlabs po che dus su smin pa 'jam mgon mchog gi thugs kyi sras po/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu phyin pa khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis dpal bzang po de nyid mdo smad kyi yul 'dir 'khrungs te gzhon nu nyid nas sngon goms kyi bag chags sad pas dam pa'i rnam par thar pa shugs 'byung du lhun gyis grub cing / khyad par dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing sar phebs te/kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje rigs kyi cod pan du bsten nas thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos kyi snying po ma lus pa rgya mtsho'i gling nas nor bu len pa bzhin du ngoms pa med par bdag gir bzhes/ dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi rigs smra bye ba'i khrod na 'gran zla med pa khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas thob ste/ rtsod ngag rdo rje'i me char gyis smra ngan yongs kyi dam bca'i brag ri bye mar brlag mdo smad du phebs te 'jam dbyangs bla ma nas brgyud pa'i gsang sngags kyi gdams pa mtha' dag gang la gang 'tsham du 'chad pa'i bshad pa lha'i rnga chen gyis skal ldan mtha' dag rmongs pa'i gnyid las slong bar mdzad/ spyi don zur bkol sogs bka' rtsom nor bu'i do shal gyis thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang mdzes par mdzad pa sogs bstan pa'i bya ba mtha' dag khur du bzhes te/ dgon sde 'di nyid kyang lo grangs nyi shu rtsa lhag gi bar du skyong bar mdzad nas/ ngo skal gyi gdul bya rdzogs pa na gzugs kyi sku'i bkod pa spros bral chos sku'i dbyings su sdud par mdzad pa'i dus chen khyad par can dang 'brel bar/514

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogs bzhugs so/sde khri rin po che'i rnam thar/ de yang ji skad du/ blo bzang bstan pa'i lung rtogs nor bu mchog / ces pa nas/ bshes gnyen dam pa/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i mdo sngags kyi bka' srol bzang po bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi sgo nas mngon par 'degs pa'i phyir du gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje mi'i srid par rol pa grub pa'i dbang phyug sde khri rin po che blo bzang don 'grub dpal bzang po de nyid mdo smad khri ga'i yul du 'khrungs/dgung lo bcu drug gi steng nas dbus su phebs te bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar zhugs/ smra ba'i dbang phyug dam pa bya bral dge 'dun phun tshogs pa dge rgan du bsten pas dka' pota chen po lnga la sbyangs pas gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes te tshul khrims mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung bas gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen por gyur/ lha sa smon lam gyi grwa skor mdzad pas mkhas pa'i snyan grags kyis sa steng khyab/ kun mkhyen bla ma sgo mang gi khrir bzhugs skabs/ sgo mang gi sde ba dang dge bskos sogs kyi khur thams cad bzung ste phrin las kyi shing rta kha lo gyen du bsgyur zhing / grwa tshang gis dka' pota chen po lnga'i bka' rtsom zhu rgyu sogs bstan 'gro'i sman yon gyi sgo brgya phyes/ kun mkhyen bla ma mdo smad du phebs skabs ma cig lab sgron gyi dus nas thugs bskyed lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba'i don bzhin zhabs phyir phebs te chos sde chen po 'di nyid gsar du 'debs rgyu sogs chos srid phrin las mtha' dag gi srog shing gcig pur gyur/ rgyud pa'i khri dang tshogs chen gyi khri rim par mdzad de gdan sa yun ring du bskyangs shing / khyad par du dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyud grwa 'di nyid ni grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen 515

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/po 'di nyid kyi bka' drin kho na la brten nas rkang tshugs pa yin/ khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi sprul pa'i sku dbus gtsang nas gdan 'dren rgyu'i 'char ston sogs kyang dam pa 'di nyid nas mdzad pa sogs phyag rjes shin tu mang la/ khyad par du rang cag grwa slob thams cad la bka' drin 'khor mtha' ma mchis pa thub bstan yongs kyi mnga' bdag khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po de nyid thog mar gdan sar phebs rgyu'i skor la/ nag phyogs bdud rigs kyi 'tshe ba shin tu mang bas don smin dka' bar byung ba na/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'di nyid kyi thugs bskyed dang nus mthu kho na la brten nas 'gal rkyen gyi dbang du ma song bar gdan sar bkod de da lta rang cag rjes 'jug thams cad chos srid rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la longs spyod rgyu byung ba yin pas spyir bstan 'gro yongs la bka' drin che zhing /khyad par rang dgon 'di nyid du gtogs pa rnams la rje btsun 'di nyid las bka' drin che ba 'ga' yang ma mchis shing / de ltar bstan 'gro'i don gye mdzad pa rlabs po che mtha' dag thugs kyi bzhed pa bzhin lhun gyis grub ste/dgung lo don bzhi pa me pho stag gi lo chu stod zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa dang po'i nyin zhing 'dir gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus te/ byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang du gshegs pa'i dus chen dang 'brel bar/de yang ji skad du/ blo gros khang bzang zhes pa nas/ dpal ldan bla ma/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal kun ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i mkhyen rab rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang gsang gsum yon tan nor bu'i tshogs kyis yongs su gtams shing / lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mkha' mnyam gdul bya'i dpal du gyur pa'i grags snyan kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khor yug kun tu khyab pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po de 516

༄/ / le'u tshan thor bu sna tshogs bzhugs so/nyid mdo smad tsong kha'i yul du sku bltams/ dbus 'gyur gyi ljongs su phebs te ka dī ka lnga bcu pa nas rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bar gyi rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa la thos bsam gyes sgro 'dogs bcad/ thos pa'i don mtha' dag yi ge na gcig kyang 'dor rgyu med par gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen dang lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa gcig tu dril rte gtan la phab pas gzhung lugs mtha' dag gdams par shar/ ji ltar gtan la phab pa bzhin du nyams su bzhes pas lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs pa mtha' dag mdo rgyud nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsar du mngon du gyur pa'i tshul bstan te rjes 'jug skal ldan gyi gdul bya mtha' dag kyang yang dag pa'i lam bzang tshang la ma nor ba de nyid nas khrid de rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub gnyis ldan gyi sgo nas nyi ma bzhin du gsal bar mdzad pas rgyal ba rang nyid slar byon pa bzhin du gyur/ dpag par dka' ba'i mdzad pa rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi rnam thar phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa las kyang lhag pa lta bur gyur pas grags snyan gyis sa steng khyab cing / de la brten nas dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa zhes 'khrul bral gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu'i lugs bzang 'di nyid 'jig rten kun tu dar rgyas yun ring du gnas pa byung / mgon po de nyid sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs nas gzugs sku rags pa'i bkod pa bsdus te dga' ldan chos kyi mdun sar gshegs pa'i dus chen khyad par can dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo zhes grags pa 'di nyid yin pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzad pa khyad par can bstan pa'i dus chen rnams dang 'dra bar dge ba 'bum 'gyur du 'gro ba'i phan yon dang / rang cag rnams la dus gsum rgyal ba las kyang 'jam mgon bla ma bka' drin che tshul sogs sgo du 517

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/ma nas bsams te rang rang gis ci nus kyis tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong zhal 'don gyi rim pa dgung mo gling me sogs thams cad khral chos sla chos su ma song bar/ rang gi tshogs rdzogs pa dang bstan pa'i dmigs rkyen du 'gro nges shig bka' drin skyong bar zhu/de'ang ji skad du/ gangs can mkhas grub ces pa nas/ chos kyi rje/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang cag rnams kyi 'dren mchog dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po yab rje 'jigs med dbang po de nyid nges pa'i don du spangs rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam 'dren stobs bcu'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad zin kyang thun mong gi snang ngor gsum ldan ngur sprig 'chang ba'i sku'i rnam par bstan te gangs can mkhas grub kun gyi zhabs kyi padmo la nye bar gtugs nas bsam spyor gnyis kyis bsten tshul gzhon nu nor bzang dang 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po bzhin du mdzad cing / sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhis bsdus pa'i zab rgyas kyi gdams pa ma tshang ba med pa tha snyad rig gnas dang bcas bstan pa'i cha lag yongs su rdzogs pa'i bang mdzod la 'dod dgur dbang bsgyur/ de nas stod dbus gtsang bal bod kyi mtshams man chad nas shar rgya mtsho'i mtha' yan chad rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i bstan pas gar khyab kyis thams cad du 'khor lo gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad cing / skal ldan gyi gdul bya mtha' dag dbang lung khrid man ngag 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas so so'i skal ba bzhin gang 'tsham du smin cing grol bar mdzad de dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs pa na slar yang sku'i bkod pa snga phyi brje ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings su dzim pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dus chen khyad par can yin pas/ bla ma'i bka' drin dran zhing rang rang gi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs la bsam ste tshogs kyi zhal 'don rnams dang / rang 518

༄/ / le'u tshan thor bur tshogs bzhugs so/rangagi gshag (shag)tu phebs nas kyang ci 'byor gyi mchod pa 'bul ba/ kha ton dge spyor byed pa/ mtshan mo'i gling me tsho'ang khral lta bu zhig tu ma go bar gtsang sbra thon zhing gang mang mang 'bul rgyu dang / de'i skabs su'ang ki cha habalung sogs rtsed mo lta bu zhig tu ma btang bar gsol 'debs chos spyod 'don pa sogs mdor na skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i dmigs rkyen du 'gro ba zhig ci nas kyang bka' drin skyong bar zhu/ /rig pa'i gnas chen po lnga dang 'brel ba'i gus 'dud bzhugs/rnam par dag pa'i ye shes nam mkha'i nor/ / 'phrin las 'od stong gser gyi thur ma yis/ / gnas lnga rig pa'i blo mig 'byed mdzad pa/ / rnam 'dren shākya seng ger spyi bos 'dud/ / baiḍūr mchod sdong g.yo ba'i sprin sngon las/ / gzhan phan thugs bskyed zag ma'i sprang char gyes/ / lus can srid pa'i tsha gdung gzhil mdzad pa/ / bcom ldan sman pa'i rgyal por gus pas 'dud/ / longs spyod 'khor lo'i klong du rtsen pa las/ / snyan ngag musnyi ka yi zur phud can/ / sgra rig rlabs 'phreng 'gyed mdzad 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / dbyangs ldan dga' mar bcas la gus pas 'dud/ brtse chen ye shes sgyu 'phrul drang srong che/ / klu sgrub zhabs dang dpal ldan dpa' bo sogs/ / lus can gdung ba sel pa'i cho ga mkhan/ / bka' drin mtshungs bral rnams la gus pas 'dud/ / yid ches gnam ru'i rgyud du drangs pa yi/ / dri med dngos stobs rigs pa'i nyag phran gyis/ / smra ngan dam bca'i 'phreng ba gcod mdzad pa/ / 'phags yul paṇa chen rnams la gus pas 'dud/ / bod yul 'gro ba'i rgyud dang 'jig rten gye/ / bzo yi dngos po 519
