༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/rags pa tshun chad nas/ / blang dor gnas kun 'doms mdzad thugs rje'i gter/ / chos rgyal lo paṇa gong ma rnams la 'dud/ / khyad par mdo sngags zab gsang lam gyi lus/ / yongs su rdzogs pa nang don rig pa'i gnad/ /ji bzhin gsal mdzad 'jam mgon tsong kha pa/ / yab sras brgyud par bcas la gus pas 'dud/ / lnga rig bstan pa gser gyi 'khor lo che/ / ris med 'dzin mar 'pho ba'i kha lo pa/ / dpal ldan mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjer gus pas 'dud/ / de yi thugs bskyed zla ba'i myu gu yi/ / 'phel ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'od dkar gyis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can cig car gsal mdzad pa/ / kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang por gus pas 'dud/ / sras bcas rgyal bas bsngags brjod me tog gi / 'phreng ldan bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i mtshor/ / legs bshad mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol ba yi/ / bshes gnyen rim byon rnams la'ang gus pas 'dud/ / sngon tshe thub pas bka' bsgos srung ma'i tshogs/ / spyi dang khyad par rig pa'i gnas rnams kyi/ / bka' srung zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul la/ / gus pas 'dud do brtse bas bdag skyongs shig / ces pa 'di ni yul mdo smad kyi chos sde chen po bkra shis 'khyil gyi grwa tshang bzhi'i ya gyal gso rig gzhan phan gling gi dpon slob mdo sngags rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa blo bzang 'jigs med nas/ bla ma gling bsre'i skabs grwa tshang bzhi'i bla ma gzhan gsum mdo sngags so so la bshad pa dang / khong rig gnas lnga la thun mong du bshad pa gnang dgos gshis gus 'dud kyang de dang 'brel mtshungs pa zhig dgos tshul ltar 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mtshan ldan bshes gnyen dam pa gus bsten nas/ / dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshe la long med dang / /520

༄/ / le'u tshan thor busna tshogasabazhugs so/spyi dang bye brag 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis/ / gting nas yid 'byung sngon 'gro'i chos rnams sgrub/ / rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun dang mnyam brje yis/ / thabs mchog kun rdzob byang chub sems bskyed dang / / rten 'brel zab mo'i de nyid rig pa yi/ / shes rab don dam byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ / cher snyigs dus 'dir phyi nang rkyen ngan tshogs/ / sprin ltar ldang ba bcos kyis mi lang bas/ / de kun thabs dang shes rab sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i lam gyi grogs su sgyur/ / nyin bzhin sems gnyis sbyong ba'i 'phen pa bzhin/ / goms byed mthun rkyen gsog cing 'gal rkyen sbyong / / kun kyang rdzogs byang rgyu ru bsngo ba ste/ / stobs lnga'i nyams len mi tshe hril gyis skyongs/ / glo bur rkyen ngan gang gis mi 'phrog par/ / ci byas nga bdag gces 'dzin gnyen po ru/ / 'gro ba rang sems dpang bo thub pa yis/ / rtag tu dga' spro'i gdeng dang ldan par byas/ / dngos dang brgyud pa'i gzhan gnod bsam sbyor dang / / bag med tho co'i spyod pa kun spong zhing / / sdom gsum spyi dang khyad par blo sbyong gi / dam tshig kun las 'da' ba med par bya/ / rtag tu dran shes bag yod bya ra yis/ / sgo gsum nyes spong ci byas gzhan don dang / / byang chub rgyu ru 'gyur la bslab byas na/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma bde blag 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes blo sbyong gi don tshan bdun tho tsam du bkod pa 'di ni yu rab dam chos dga' ston gling gi khri ba chos kyi spyan ldanablo bzang chos 'phel gyis bskul ngor/ 7 btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes 'phral du smras pa'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / / /dkon mchog thugs rje'i bden mthus legs bshad 'di/ / bstan pa'i sgon mer yun du gnas pa dang / / 'brel thogs kun kyang gnas skabs dga' bdes 'tsho/ / mthar thug rtag pa dam pa'i gnas thob shog /521

gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/dpar sgrig dpe skrun mi sna/blo 'dri sa/ bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan/dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/gling rgya bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/gung thang thub bstan/bsod nams rgya mtsho/gtso sgrig pa/gtso sgrig pa gzhon pa/ 'jam dga'/sbyilngabajus 'god pa/ tsha lag tshe ring rgyal/rtsom sgrigakongs mi/ mgon po dar rgyas/ phur kho/ rta mgrin rdo rje/'phrin las rgyal mtshan/ ban de mkhar/ting 'dzin bkra shis/ rta rdo/lag bstar rtsom sgrig pa/ ting 'dzin bkra shis/

ra / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/dkon mchogakunadangos 'jigs medadabang bo'iris/ /bshad sgrubabastanapa'i bdagapharadabang bskurabazhin/ /lung rtogasanya zlazung sgron meyis/ /skye gu'i rmongs munasel ba 'di rmadabyungaka /zhes bal ma panitas mdzad pa'i chigs bcad kyis mdun bsus te mkhasagrubayongs kyi gtsug rgyan rje btsun dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum dpe spun byed par mthun rkyen spur mkhan a ri'i zam pa'i thebs mtshogasaparabugs che༅/ 2 4 mi 7khri cho

spyi khyab jus 'god pa/ tsha lag tshe ring rgyal/ṣṭha me ma 〉da 16 me zhu chen pa/ dbus skyabs/ṣṭha 11 ma zartsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ ting 'dzin bkra shis/zoṣṭha cho zomamapomadzes cha jus 'god pa/ garma rdo rje tshe ring /zam shāmi zo jopar zhu 'gan 'khur pa/ bde skyid me togazoṣṭhaṣṭhatsho sgo sa/ ༄7/ / gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/(tha)gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes brtsams/zomi rigasadape skrun khang gis bskrun zhing 'grems spel byas/(pe cin ho phing li byang lam ang 14pa/ sbrag ang 100013kha par ang grangs/ 58130076)pe cin kreng ta'o par khang nas par btab/2006lo'i zla1par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/286lo'i zla2par pe cin du par thengs dang po brgyab/deb tshad 85047ma11684la 172 dpar shog 16 652dpar grangs 0001—2 000 deb rer sgor 33 50
